rows.original: moving. Presently, it doesn’t seem like there’s any kicking, but you can clearly hear their heartbeat
rows.translation: 活动。现在似乎还没有任何踢动，但你可以清楚听见他们的心跳
rows.raw: " moving. Presently, it doesn’t seem like there’s any kicking, but you can clearly hear their heartbeat"

rows.translation: 声

rows.original: . The sounds of the life you’ve helped to create makes your heart swell with a deep sense of pride and love.
rows.translation: 。这些由你参与创造的生命发出的声响，让你的心中涌起深深的自豪与爱意。
rows.raw: ". The sounds of the life you’ve helped to create makes your heart swell with a deep sense of pride and love."

rows.original: “I think it’s more than one!” you say excitedly, prompting Amber to giggle happily.
rows.translation: “我觉得不止一个！”你兴奋地说道，惹得安珀开心地咯咯直笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I think it’s more than one!” you say excitedly, prompting Amber to giggle happily."

rows.original: “Hehe, I never thought I’d have someone feeling my belly like that, you know,” she starts. “It’s not half-bad, how can I explain? It makes me feel... loved,” she says, her eyes distant as she savors the word. “Hey, [pc.name], thanks for being a part of my life.”
rows.translation: “嘿嘿，你知道吗，我从没想过会有人像这样摸我的肚子，”她开口说道。“感觉还挺不错的，该怎么形容呢？这让我觉得自己... 被爱着，”她目光悠远，细细品味着这个词。“嘿，[pc.name]，谢谢你走进我的生命。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hehe, I never thought I’d have someone feeling my belly like that, you know,” she starts. “It’s not half-bad, how can I explain? It makes me feel... loved,” she says, her eyes distant as she savors the word. “Hey, [pc.name], thanks for being a part of my life.”"

rows.original: You actually blush a little from those words. Then, suddenly it occurs to you: “Say, do you have any hobbies? You know, besides fucking?” You might have an inkling of what else she’s interested in, but it would be nice to know for sure – perhaps you and Amber could do it together one of these days. It could even help you choose a present for a special occasion, who knows?
rows.translation: 听到这些话，你竟真的微微红了脸。然后你突然想到：“话说，你有什么爱好吗？我是说，除了做爱以外？”你或许隐约猜得到她还对什么感兴趣，但还是想得到确切答案——也许哪天你和安珀可以一起做。说不定还能帮你为某个特殊场合挑选礼物，谁知道呢？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou actually blush a little from those words. Then, suddenly it occurs to you: “Say, do you have any hobbies? You know, besides fucking?” You might have an inkling of what else she’s interested in, but it would be nice to know for sure – perhaps you and Amber could do it together one of these days. It could even help you choose a present for a special occasion, who knows?"

rows.original: Besides, you can’t help but enjoy hearing someone you love talk about something they’re truly passionate about.
rows.translation: 况且，听心爱的人谈论真正热爱的事物，总会令人忍不住感到愉快。
rows.raw: " Besides, you can’t help but enjoy hearing someone you love talk about something they’re truly passionate about."

rows.original: She seems to deflate a bit, but quickly rebounds, since you were thoughtful enough to ask that. “Well, my libido has been getting in the way of it, but I really, really like painting miniature figures!”
rows.translation: 她似乎泄了点气，但想到你特意关心这件事，很快又振作起来。“这个爱好一直受我的性欲影响，不过我真的、真的很喜欢给微缩模型上色！”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe seems to deflate a bit, but quickly rebounds, since you were thoughtful enough to ask that. “Well, my libido has been getting in the way of it, but I really, really like painting miniature figures!”"

rows.original: “Wow, I didn’t peg you for a painter. How did it start?”
rows.translation: “哇，我真没看出来你还是个画家。你是怎么开始的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wow, I didn’t peg you for a painter. How did it start?”"

rows.original: “It was when I landed a gig painting murals back in my homeworld. The pay was worse than shit, but at least I found out I really enjoy painting stuff. One day, I came across a bunch of minis someone had thrown away, and the rest is history.”
rows.translation: “以前我在故乡接到过一份画壁画的活儿。报酬烂得要命，但至少我发现自己真的很喜欢画东西。有一天，我偶然找到了一堆别人扔掉的微缩模型，之后的事你也能猜到了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It was when I landed a gig painting murals back in my homeworld. The pay was worse than shit, but at least I found out I really enjoy painting stuff. One day, I came across a bunch of minis someone had thrown away, and the rest is history.”"

rows.original: “Do you have any right now? Can I see them?”
rows.translation: “你现在还有吗？我能看看吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Do you have any right now? Can I see them?”"

rows.original: “I actually had a little collection, but ever since I got like... this,” She gestures down at herself, “it’s been hard to keep track of them, so I’ve lost most by now.” She sulks a bit, but her expression lights up as she makes a realization. “...but I guess I can always start a new collection, right?”
rows.translation: “其实我以前有一小批收藏，但自从我变成... 这样以后，”她朝自己的身体比划了一下，“就很难顾得上它们，所以现在已经丢掉大半了。”她闷闷不乐了一会儿，但突然想到什么，神情随之一亮。“...不过我随时都能重新开始收藏，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I actually had a little collection, but ever since I got like... this,” She gestures down at herself, “it’s been hard to keep track of them, so I’ve lost most by now.” She sulks a bit, but her expression lights up as she makes a realization. “...but I guess I can always start a new collection, right?”"

rows.original: You nod in agreement, taking the note that this is something she’s into, and offer her a reassuring rub on the shoulder.
rows.translation: 你赞同地点点头，记下她喜欢这种东西，并安慰地揉了揉她的肩膀。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod in agreement, taking the note that this is something she’s into, and offer her a reassuring rub on the shoulder."

rows.original: <i>“You know, we can have our kid
rows.translation: <i>“你知道，我们可以让我们的孩子

rows.translation: 在育儿所里照看它们。那样我们就不会弄丢了。我们甚至可以一起给一些模型上色，那一定很好玩。”
rows.raw: " watch them at the nursery. That way we won’t lose them. We can even paint some together, that’d be fun.”"

rows.original: “Yeah, you’re right!” She exclaims, giving you a tight squeeze.
rows.translation: “是啊，你说得对！”她大声说道，用力抱紧了你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, you’re right!” She exclaims, giving you a tight squeeze."

rows.original: The next several minutes are spent cuddling, chatting and catching up on what you’ve both been doing as of late, and you make sure to caress her middle the entire time.
rows.translation: 接下来的几分钟里，你们相互依偎、闲聊，并交流彼此近来的经历，而你全程都不忘轻抚她的腹部。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe next several minutes are spent cuddling, chatting and catching up on what you’ve both been doing as of late, and you make sure to caress her middle the entire time."

rows.original: Amber took longer than normal to answer the door, and as soon as you lay eyes on her, you understand why:
rows.translation: 安珀这次比平时晚了许久才来开门，而你一看到她便明白了原因：
rows.raw: "Amber took longer than normal to answer the door, and as soon as you lay eyes on her, you understand why:"

rows.original: The dryad is sitting at the bank of a small stream, and
rows.translation: 树灵正坐在一条小溪岸边，
rows.raw: "The dryad is sitting at the bank of a small stream, and"

rows.original: she looks exhausted, including a sullen expression and bags under her eyes. When she sees you, her face brightens up a little.
rows.translation: 她看起来疲惫不堪，不仅神情阴郁，眼睛下面还挂着眼袋。看到你时，她的脸色稍稍明亮了一些。
rows.raw: " she looks exhausted, including a sullen expression and bags under her eyes. When she sees you, her face brightens up a little."

rows.original: “Hey, you sure are a sight for sore eyes,” she manages a weak smile.
rows.translation: “嘿，看到你真让人舒心，”她勉强露出一丝微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, you sure are a sight for sore eyes,” she manages a weak smile."

rows.original: “What’s up?” you ask with concern.
rows.translation: “怎么了？”你担心地问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What’s up?” you ask with concern."

rows.translation: <i>“哦，没什么大事，只是怀孕而已。我想已经到了比较难熬的阶段。做什么都比平时更容易疲惫，而且

rows.original: “Oof, sounds rough,” you offer, planting a light kiss on her lips and offering a sympathetic smile as you stroke her hair. You let your gaze wander to her tauric middle, taking note of how thick it is. In a way, this makes you feel really proud of yourself.
rows.translation: “嘶，听起来真不好受，”你说着轻吻她的嘴唇，又一边抚摸她的头发，一边投去同情的微笑。你的视线落到她半人马形的腰腹，注意到那里已经变得多么粗壮。从某种意义上说，这让你对自己感到无比自豪。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oof, sounds rough,” you offer, planting a light kiss on her lips and offering a sympathetic smile as you stroke her hair. You let your gaze wander to her tauric middle, taking note of how thick it is. In a way, this makes you feel really proud of yourself."

rows.original: “Oh, you have no idea!” she retorts, but her voice has lost most of the bitterness it has earlier.
rows.translation: “哦，你根本想象不到！”她反驳道，不过声音中已经少了先前的大部分苦涩。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, you have no idea!” she retorts, but her voice has lost most of the bitterness it has earlier."

rows.original: “Actually, I can relate,” you say, stroking your [pc.belly] for emphasis.
rows.translation: “其实我能理解，”你说着抚摸自己的[pc.belly]，以此强调。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Actually, I can relate,” you say, stroking your [pc.belly] for emphasis."

rows.original: Her mouth makes an embarrassed “Oh, true”, and you both start laughing.
rows.translation: 她尴尬地说了声“哦，也是”，随后你们一起笑了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer mouth makes an embarrassed “Oh, true”, and you both start laughing."

rows.original: You give her shoulders a reassuring squeeze, which elicits a contented sigh. “Hmm, that’s good, please don’t stop...” she pleads, lying down so as to give you easier access to her upper body.
rows.translation: 你安慰地捏了捏她的肩膀，惹得她满足地叹了口气。“嗯，真舒服，拜托别停...”她恳求着躺下，好让你更容易碰到她的上半身。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give her shoulders a reassuring squeeze, which elicits a contented sigh. “Hmm, that’s good, please don’t stop...” she pleads, lying down so as to give you easier access to her upper body."

rows.original: And just like that, what was supposed to be a simple comforting gesture turns into a long massage session as your [pc.fingers] carefully work the kinks in her shoulders, neck and back. “You really like that, don’t you?” you ask.
rows.translation: 就这样，原本简单的安慰举动变成了一场漫长的按摩；你的[pc.fingers]仔细揉开她肩膀、脖颈和背部的僵硬之处。“你真的很喜欢这样，对吧？”你问道。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd just like that, what was supposed to be a simple comforting gesture turns into a long massage session as your [pc.fingers] carefully work the kinks in her shoulders, neck and back. “You really like that, don’t you?” you ask."

rows.original: “I do, you really know how to use your hands,” she compliments with a languid sigh. “Gosh, I’ve been so tense these past few days, this is just the kind of thing I’ve been needing!”
rows.translation: “嗯，你真的很会用手，”她懒洋洋地叹息着称赞道。“天啊，这几天我一直绷得太紧了，这正是我需要的！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I do, you really know how to use your hands,” she compliments with a languid sigh. “Gosh, I’ve been so tense these past few days, this is just the kind of thing I’ve been needing!”"

rows.original: “It’s the least I can do for the mother of my kids,” you say and proceed to knead the few spots still unattended. When you’re finished, you gently plant a kiss on her forehead.
rows.translation: “这是我至少该为孩子们的母亲做的，”你说完，继续揉捏那几处尚未照顾到的地方。结束时，你轻轻吻了吻她的额头。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s the least I can do for the mother of my kids,” you say and proceed to knead the few spots still unattended. When you’re finished, you gently plant a kiss on her forehead."

rows.original: “Thanks, that was almost better than sex,” she giggles. “Since I’m already sitting, wanna feel the belly?”
rows.translation: “谢谢，这感觉都快比做爱还好了，”她咯咯笑道。“反正我已经坐下了，想摸摸肚子吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thanks, that was almost better than sex,” she giggles. “Since I’m already sitting, wanna feel the belly?”"

rows.original: “No shit, Sherlock!” Amber laughs. “Well, at least this one wasn’t too strong...” A new kick happens. “OOF, why did I have to open my damn mouth?!”
rows.translation: “废话，夏洛克！”安珀笑道。“好吧，至少这一下不算太重...”又一次踢动传来。“呜，我干嘛非得乌鸦嘴啊？！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No shit, Sherlock!” Amber laughs. “Well, at least this one wasn’t too strong...” A new kick happens. “OOF, why did I have to open my damn mouth?!”"

rows.original: The deertaur looks at you wide-eyed, “Are you some sort of psychic?”
rows.translation: 鹿人马睁大眼睛看着你，“你是什么灵能者吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe deertaur looks at you wide-eyed, “Are you some sort of psychic?”"

rows.original: “I have my ways,” you wink mischievously. She keeps on looking at you for a long time, trying to decide if you’re telling the truth or just pranking her with vague speech. Ultimately, she shrugs.
rows.translation: “我自有办法，”你顽皮地眨眨眼。她久久凝视着你，试图判断你是在说实话，还是只用含糊其辞的话捉弄她。最后，她耸了耸肩。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I have my ways,” you wink mischievously. She keeps on looking at you for a long time, trying to decide if you’re telling the truth or just pranking her with vague speech. Ultimately, she shrugs."

rows.translation: “不管那是什么魔法，如果你愿意再施展一些，我可不会介意，”安珀提议道。你非常乐意满足她，陪伴她和你的孩子

rows.original: As you kiss her goodbye, Amber holds your hand, stopping you for a moment. “I just want you to know you mean a lot to me, okay? More than I can put into words.”
rows.translation: 当你吻别她时，安珀握住你的手，让你停留片刻。“我只是想让你知道，你对我真的很重要，好吗？重要到我无法用言语表达。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you kiss her goodbye, Amber holds your hand, stopping you for a moment. “I just want you to know you mean a lot to me, okay? More than I can put into words.”"

rows.original: “You too,” you say with a smile.
rows.translation: “你对我也是，”你微笑着说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You too,” you say with a smile."

rows.original: The next hour passes in a blur as you make all the necessary calls and take her to a hospital. As soon as you drop your name, a nurse is immediately designated to assist her – it’s one of those times you’re glad to be a Steele. Apparently, her early labor has been very short, and she’s already well into active labor! You stay by Amber’s side the whole time, helping her to stay calm and use the breathing techniques taught by the nurse.
rows.translation: 接下来一个小时在一片忙乱中飞逝，你打完所有必要的电话，把她送进医院。你刚报上姓名，一名护士便立刻被指派来协助她——这种时候你很庆幸自己姓斯蒂尔。显然，她的早期产程非常短，如今已经深入活跃期！你始终陪在安珀身旁，帮助她保持冷静，并按照护士教导的方法呼吸。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe next hour passes in a blur as you make all the necessary calls and take her to a hospital. As soon as you drop your name, a nurse is immediately designated to assist her – it’s one of those times you’re glad to be a Steele. Apparently, her early labor has been very short, and she’s already well into active labor! You stay by Amber’s side the whole time, helping her to stay calm and use the breathing techniques taught by the nurse."

rows.original: Not even thirty minutes later, she is taken to the delivery room, where a doctor with experience in tauric-body childbirth is waiting. To your surprise, the place looks little like a normal hospital room, save for some medical equipment to the side. It’s spacious and outfitted with floor-level bedding, perfect for the deertaur to lie on her side, the tauric lower body resting comfortably on clean sheets.

rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, you need to be taking care of yourself, too. Kids need healthy parents, and that goes both ways.”"

rows.original: “Good girl.” You smile, planting a kiss on her cheek. “I guess I’ll let you get some shuteye, then.”
rows.translation: “乖女孩。”你微笑着亲了亲她的脸颊。“那我就让你好好睡一会儿吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good girl.” You smile, planting a kiss on her cheek. “I guess I’ll let you get some shuteye, then.”"

rows.original: “Wait,” Amber states. “...please be careful out there, okay?”
rows.translation: “等等，”安珀说道。“...在外面一定要小心，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wait,” Amber states. “...please be careful out there, okay?”"

rows.original: “Of course. A Steele always comes home safe.”
rows.translation: “当然。斯蒂尔家的人总会平安回家。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course. A Steele always comes home safe.”"

rows.original: After one last embrace, Amber leaves you to get some rest, and you leave on your way.
rows.translation: 最后拥抱一次后，安珀离开你去休息，你也动身上路。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter one last embrace, Amber leaves you to get some rest, and you leave on your way."

rows.original: You quickly realize that she has no reason to worry, since her reproductive genes have likely not been affected at all by any mods she’s taken. “I don’t think you have any reason to worry. You were human before all the mods, right?” You say, calming her nerves a touch. She simply nods, and you continue: “Mods don’t usually affect your reproductive genes, so whatever genetic material you gave me is sure to be human, too. There shouldn’t be any real complications.” She lets out a huge sigh of relief, gently resting an arm on your shoulders and leaning on you.
rows.translation: 你很快意识到，她没有理由担心，因为她服用的改造剂很可能根本没有影响生殖基因。“我觉得你完全不用担心。接受所有改造前，你是人类，对吧？”你说道，稍稍安抚了她的神经。她只是点点头，于是你继续说：“改造剂通常不会影响生殖基因，所以你给我的遗传物质肯定也是人类的。应该不会出现真正的并发症。”她如释重负地长叹一声，轻轻把手臂搭在你的肩上，靠住了你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou quickly realize that she has no reason to worry, since her reproductive genes have likely not been affected at all by any mods she’s taken. “I don’t think you have any reason to worry. You were human before all the mods, right?” You say, calming her nerves a touch. She simply nods, and you continue: “Mods don’t usually affect your reproductive genes, so whatever genetic material you gave me is sure to be human, too. There shouldn’t be any real complications.” She lets out a huge sigh of relief, gently resting an arm on your shoulders and leaning on you."

rows.original: You quickly realize that... you don’t know, either! In a flash, your Codex is out, and you desperately try to find whatever information you can about body modding and tauric babies. Eventually, you land on a page that says body modding doesn’t usually impact one’s gametes, save in very special cases. You chide yourself for having to look that up, since what you’ve been told about your dad should’ve tipped you off.
rows.translation: 你很快意识到... 你也不知道！转眼间，你便取出百科，拼命查找关于身体改造和半人马宝宝的一切资料。最后，你找到一个页面，上面说除了极少数特殊情况，身体改造通常不会影响配子。你责怪自己居然还得查这件事，毕竟听说过的那些父亲往事本该早就给你提示。

Eventually, you land on a page that says body modding doesn’t usually impact one’s gametes, save in very special cases. You chide yourself for having to look that up, since what you’ve been told about your dad should’ve tipped you off."

rows.original: You quickly relay the information to Amber, “Hey, it’s alright, between our genetics the kid should be a human, just as you were. The modding won’t interfere with them at all.” She lets out a sigh of relief, cradling you in an arm.
rows.translation: 你迅速把资料转述给安珀：“嘿，没关系，结合我们的遗传基因来看，孩子应该会是人类，就像以前的你一样。身体改造完全不会干扰宝宝。”她如释重负地叹了口气，用一条手臂将你搂进怀中。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou quickly relay the information to Amber, “Hey, it’s alright, between our genetics the kid should be a human, just as you were. The modding won’t interfere with them at all.” She lets out a sigh of relief, cradling you in an arm."

rows.original: “You’re probably right, yeah!” she says, followed by a bout of nervous laughter. “Sorry, I always assumed if I was gonna have a kid, I’d be the one carrying them! It’s a different feeling, looking after someone else carrying your baby. ...babies? Guess we’ll know in time, huh? I just want them to be healthy, is all...”
rows.translation: “你大概说得对，是啊！”她说道，随后紧张地笑了一阵。“抱歉，我一直以为如果自己有孩子，肯定会由我来怀！照顾一个怀着你宝宝的人，感觉完全不同。...宝宝们？我想迟早会知道，对吧？我只是希望宝宝健康...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re probably right, yeah!” she says, followed by a bout of nervous laughter. “Sorry, I always assumed if I was gonna have a kid, I’d be the one carrying them! It’s a different feeling, looking after someone else carrying your baby. ...babies? Guess we’ll know in time, huh? I just want them to be healthy, is all...”"

rows.original: “Yeah, that’s understandable...” You murmur, leaning in to plant a tender peck on her cheek.

rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, that’s understandable...” You murmur, leaning in to plant a tender peck on her cheek."

rows.original: To cut the ensuing silence before it can stretch, you chime in with a thought that had been occupying your mind for some time, having gotten to know Amber well by now.
rows.translation: 为了在随后的沉默拉长之前将其打破，你说出了一个萦绕心头已有一段时间的想法；毕竟如今你已经相当了解安珀。
rows.raw: "\n\nTo cut the ensuing silence before it can stretch, you chime in with a thought that had been occupying your mind for some time, having gotten to know Amber well by now."

rows.original: “Say, do you have any hobbies? You know, besides fucking?” It would be nice to know what else she’s interested in – perhaps you and Amber could do it together one of these days. It could even help you choose a present for a special occasion, who knows?
rows.translation: “话说，你有什么爱好吗？我是说，除了做爱以外？”知道她还对什么感兴趣一定很好——也许哪天你和安珀可以一起做。说不定还能帮你为某个特殊场合挑选礼物，谁知道呢？
rows.raw: "\n\n“Say, do you have any hobbies? You know, besides fucking?” It would be nice to know what else she’s interested in – perhaps you and Amber could do it together one of these days. It could even help you choose a present for a special occasion, who knows?"

rows.original: If there’s one thing life has taught you, it’s that lovers only get more passionate the closer you get to them.
rows.translation: 如果生活教会过你一件事，那就是恋人之间越亲近，感情便越炽烈。
rows.raw: " If there’s one thing life has taught you, it’s that lovers only get more passionate the closer you get to them."

rows.original: Besides, you can’t help but enjoy hearing someone you love talk about something they’re truly passionate about.
rows.translation: 况且，听心爱的人谈论真正热爱的事物，总会令人忍不住感到愉快。
rows.raw: " Besides, you can’t help but enjoy hearing someone you love talk about something they’re truly passionate about."

rows.original: She seems to deflate a bit, but quickly rebounds since you were thoughtful enough to ask that. “Well, my libido has been getting in the way of it, but I really, really like painting miniature figures!” You recall that she mentioned something to that effect once... “It started when I landed a gig painting murals back in my homeworld. The pay was worse than shit, but at least I found out I really enjoy painting stuff. One day, I came across a bunch of minis someone had thrown away, and the rest is history.”
rows.translation: 她似乎泄了点气，但想到你特意关心这件事，很快又振作起来。“这个爱好一直受我的性欲影响，不过我真的、真的很喜欢给微缩模型上色！”你想起她以前提过类似的事... “以前我在故乡接到过一份画壁画的活儿。报酬烂得要命，但至少我发现自己真的很喜欢画东西。有一天，我偶然找到了一堆别人扔掉的微缩模型，之后的事你也能猜到了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe seems to deflate a bit, but quickly rebounds since you were thoughtful enough to ask that. “Well, my libido has been getting in the way of it, but I really, really like painting miniature figures!” You recall that she mentioned something to that effect once... “It started when I landed a gig painting murals back in my homeworld. The pay was worse than shit, but at least I found out I really enjoy painting stuff. One day, I came across a bunch of minis someone had thrown away, and the rest is history.”"

rows.original: “I actually had a little collection, but ever since I got like... this,” She gestures towards her tauric half and genitals, “it’s been hard to keep track of them, so I’ve lost most by now.” She sulks a bit, but her expression lights up as she makes a realization. “...but I guess I can always start a new collection, right?”
rows.translation: “其实我以前有一小批收藏，但自从我变成... 这样以后，”她指了指自己的半人马下半身和生殖器，“就很难顾得上它们，所以现在已经丢掉大半了。”她闷闷不乐了一会儿，但突然想到什么，神情随之一亮。“...不过我随时都能重新开始收藏，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I actually had a little collection, but ever since I got like... this,” She gestures towards her tauric half and genitals, “it’s been hard to keep track of them, so I’ve lost most by now.” She sulks a bit, but her expression lights up as she makes a realization. “...but I guess I can always start a new collection, right?”"

rows.translation: “亲爱的，话说，你碰巧有没有什么甜食？”看到她的表情变得淫荡，你赶紧补充：“我是说食物！”

rows.original: “Oh, I think I have a stash of mangoes!” She stammers, gently setting you aside and rushing off to search around for her stash. In short order, she returns, cradling a box in her arms, which she sets next to you. “Here, take this!” You open your mouth, but before you have a chance to respond, a ripe Mhen’gan mango is promptly stuffed inside, which your body opts to begin chewing before its presence has even fully registered in your mind.
rows.translation: “哦，我好像藏了一些芒果！”她结结巴巴地说着，轻轻把你放到一旁，冲出去翻找自己的存货。没过多久，她便抱着一个箱子回来，将其放在你身旁。“来，吃这个！”你张开嘴，还没来得及回答，一颗成熟的门加芒果便被迅速塞入口中；你的身体甚至还没完全意识到它的存在，就擅自咀嚼起来。

rows.original: The fruit, at this moment, is the most delicious thing you’ve ever had in your maw, and Amber is evidently a goddess, providing you with the comfort and nourishment you require, ensuring the safety and health of your child. The two of you spend a good, long while resting in each other’s warmth as she idly feeds you, until she interjects, a hint of sadness in her voice.
rows.translation: 此时此刻，这枚水果是你这张嘴尝过最美味的东西，而安珀显然就是一位女神，为你提供所需的舒适与营养，保障孩子的安全和健康。你们在彼此温暖的怀抱中休息了很久，她心不在焉地喂着你，直到她突然开口，声音中带着一丝悲伤。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe fruit, at this moment, is the most delicious thing you’ve ever had in your maw, and Amber is evidently a goddess, providing you with the comfort and nourishment you require, ensuring the safety and health of your child. The two of you spend a good, long while resting in each other’s warmth as she idly feeds you, until she interjects, a hint of sadness in her voice."

rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, I... have things I need to take care of before I go to sleep.” She looks at you, a smile on her face, but you know she’s reluctant to part ways. “And I know you’re a really busy person. I don’t want this to end, but we should both really get going...”"

rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah...” You mutter, reluctantly getting yourself to your feet, to which she follows suit. “But it was nice to catch up with you, Amber.”"

rows.original: Burt chuckles, “Uh... wow, you must be really hard up for credits. Okay.” He reaches under the bar and pulls out a black aluminum can with the crossed crab claw Jolly Roger on the front. He jerks on the pull tab and a strange hiss escapes the can. “So, uh... do you want me to put this in a dirty glass then, it might cut the flavor a bit.”
rows.translation: 伯特轻笑道：“呃... 哇，你一定真的急缺信用点。好吧。”他把手伸到吧台下，拿出一个黑色铝罐，正面印着交叉蟹钳组成的海盗旗。他猛地拉开拉环，罐中传出奇怪的嘶声。“所以，呃... 要我把它倒进脏杯子里，也许能稍微压一压味道。”
rows.raw: "Burt chuckles, “Uh... wow, you must be really hard up for credits. Okay.” He reaches under the bar and pulls out a black aluminum can with the crossed crab claw Jolly Roger on the front. He jerks on the pull tab and a strange hiss escapes the can. “So, uh... do you want me to put this in a dirty glass then, it might cut the flavor a bit.”"

rows.original: He pours the urine colored fluid into a glass and pushes it across the bar to you. It smells like dirty gym socks dipped in honey, and when you toss the glass back, you find that it kind of tastes like it too.
rows.translation: 他把尿液色的液体倒入杯中，沿吧台推给你。闻起来像浸过蜂蜜的脏运动袜；当你仰头喝下时，发现味道差不多也是如此。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe pours the urine colored fluid into a glass and pushes it across the bar to you. It smells like dirty gym socks dipped in honey, and when you toss the glass back, you find that it kind of tastes like it too."

rows.original: The drink settles in your guts like a lead weight, and makes it a little hard to focus, forcing you to blink your eyes several times before you are looking at just a single Burt again, instead of handsome twins.
rows.translation: 酒液像铅块一样沉进肚子，让你很难集中精神。你不得不眨了好几次眼，眼前才重新只剩一个伯特，而不是一对英俊的双胞胎。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe drink settles in your guts like a lead weight, and makes it a little hard to focus, forcing you to blink your eyes several times before you are looking at just a single Burt again, instead of handsome twins."

He then smiles and slides the glass across the bar top to you."

rows.original: The drink smells of honey, with only the barest of hints of the alcoholic nature stinging your nostrils. It is a delightful aroma, and when you sip from the glass you are treated with a rich and floral flavor that really is quite enjoyable.
rows.translation: 这杯酒散发着蜂蜜香气，只有酒精本性最轻微的一丝刺激刺入鼻孔。香味令人愉悦；你抿了一口，浓郁而芬芳的滋味在舌尖绽放，确实相当美味。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe drink smells of honey, with only the barest of hints of the alcoholic nature stinging your nostrils. It is a delightful aroma, and when you sip from the glass you are treated with a rich and floral flavor that really is quite enjoyable."

rows.original: You spend a little time enjoying your drink, savoring the flavor and complexity while you make small talk with Burt. All told, it is a rather pleasant experience.
rows.translation: 你花了一些时间享用饮品，一边品味其中的风味与层次，一边和伯特闲聊。总体来说，这是段相当愉快的体验。

rows.original: Burt grins at you and softly says, “Ah, a connoisseur. This stuff is the finest mead you can buy.” He turns from you and grabs a gold bottle from the top shelf behind the bar, bringing it over and drawing the cork before letting you smell the pungent and rich flavors that have gathered on the plug during the time the bottle has been on the shelf.
rows.translation: 伯特朝你咧嘴一笑，轻声说道：“啊，一位行家。这可是你能买到的最顶级蜂蜜酒。”他转过身，从吧台后方最高的架子上取下一只金色酒瓶，拿过来拔出软木塞，让你闻闻瓶子摆在架上期间积聚在瓶塞上的辛辣浓郁香气。
rows.raw: "Burt grins at you and softly says, “Ah, a connoisseur. This stuff is the finest mead you can buy.” He turns from you and grabs a gold bottle from the top shelf behind the bar, bringing it over and drawing the cork before letting you smell the pungent and rich flavors that have gathered on the plug during the time the bottle has been on the shelf."

rows.original: Burt reaches under the counter and brings up a fluted wine glass before pouring it half full of the crystal clear golden wine, filling the usually stale and smoky air of the bar around you with the scent of wildflowers in full bloom and rich notes of honey and sex. He sets the glass down before you and says, “Do enjoy, [pc.name].”
rows.translation: 伯特从柜台下拿出一只笛形酒杯，倒入半杯晶莹剔透的金色酒液。盛放野花的芬芳以及浓郁的蜂蜜与性爱气息，顿时充满你周围通常沉闷而烟雾缭绕的酒吧空气。他把酒杯放到你面前，说道：“好好享用，[pc.name]。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBurt reaches under the counter and brings up a fluted wine glass before pouring it half full of the crystal clear golden wine, filling the usually stale and smoky air of the bar around you with the scent of wildflowers in full bloom and rich notes of honey and sex. He sets the glass down before you and says, “Do enjoy, [pc.name].”"

rows.original: This clearly isn’t the kind of drink you can just slam down, so you relax at the bar as you slowly roll the drink around in the glass and take the occasional sip from it, savoring every drop of the majestic alcohol. It is honestly hard to imagine why this drink isn’t far more expensive than it is, but it lets you get a taste of what it must be like to be a CEO with money to burn on life’s finest things.
rows.translation: 这显然不是能一口灌下去的饮料，于是你放松地坐在吧台旁，缓缓晃动杯中酒液，偶尔抿上一口，细细品味这杯华美佳酿的每一滴。老实说，很难想象这种酒为什么没有贵得多，不过它确实让你尝到了担任挥金如土、尽享世间精品的CEO会是什么感觉。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis clearly isn’t the kind of drink you can just slam down, so you relax at the bar as you slowly roll the drink around in the glass and take the occasional sip from it, savoring every drop of the majestic alcohol. It is honestly hard to imagine why this drink isn’t far more expensive than it is, but it lets you get a taste of what it must be like to be a CEO with money to burn on life’s finest things."

rows.original: Burt smirks, “The best thing about owning a bar, is that everyone wants to dump their worries on me when they come to get hammered. I’ve heard about every piece of bad luck and tragedy on the frontier. What do you want to talk about?”
rows.translation: 伯特坏笑道：“开酒吧最好的一点，就是每个人来买醉时都想把烦恼倾诉给我。边境上每一种厄运和悲剧，我几乎都听过。你想聊些什么？”
rows.raw: "Burt smirks, “The best thing about owning a bar, is that everyone wants to dump their worries on me when they come to get hammered. I’ve heard about every piece of bad luck and tragedy on the frontier. What do you want to talk about?”"

rows.raw: "Danaume"

rows.original: Burt frowns as you ask him about himself, “Yeah, figures you would want to know about me. Everybody wants to know my story. Look [pc.name], you seem like a good kid and all, but there are some things a man just doesn’t like to talk about. Why don’t you at least buy a drink before trying to buddy up to me, huh?”
rows.translation: 你问起伯特本人的事，他皱起眉头。“是啊，就知道你会想了解我。每个人都想听我的故事。听着，[pc.name]，你看起来是个好孩子，不过有些事男人就是不喜欢谈。你至少先买杯酒，再来和我套近乎，怎么样？”
rows.raw: "Burt frowns as you ask him about himself, “Yeah, figures you would want to know about me. Everybody wants to know my story. Look [pc.name], you seem like a good kid and all, but there are some things a man just doesn’t like to talk about. Why don’t you at least buy a drink before trying to buddy up to me, huh?”"

rows.original: Burt sighs and pulls out his bar towel, spending a long and silent moment just wiping down the bar top, trying to get some imagined smudge out of the way between himself and you. When he finally talks, his voice is low and quiet, “So I was born a hop, skip and a jump from old Earth herself, back coreward, and I had a pretty good life. I was the kinda guy you would expect from the civilized parts of the galaxy, straight laced and closed-minded. I even joined the T.S.C. military and learned discipline and duty.”
rows.translation: 伯特叹了口气，拿出酒吧毛巾，久久沉默地擦拭着吧台，仿佛想抹掉你们之间某块并不存在的污渍。终于开口时，他的声音低沉而安静：“我出生在离老地球只有几步之遥的核心方向，曾经过着相当不错的生活。我就是你会在银河文明区域见到的那种人，循规蹈矩又思想封闭。我甚至加入了T.S.C.军队，学会纪律与职责。”
rows.raw: "Burt sighs and pulls out his bar towel, spending a long and silent moment just wiping down the bar top, trying to get some imagined smudge out of the way between himself and you. When he finally talks, his voice is low and quiet, “So I was born a hop, skip and a jump from old Earth herself, back coreward, and I had a pretty good life. I was the kinda guy you would expect from the civilized parts of the galaxy, straight laced and closed-minded. I even joined the T.S.C. military and learned discipline and duty.”"

rows.original: “Everything started to go wrong when my mom died. She wasn’t killed or anything, she just died. Old age. She couldn’t afford the age treatments, I mean, who can. I resigned my commission and went to deal with the liquidation of her estate, and after that I started drifting among the core worlds, trying to find direction in life. I thought I had found it too... but, it wasn’t to be. My old life is gone, and I can’t go back, so I ended up out here, tending a bar on the sleaziest backwater on the frontier.”
rows.translation: “一切都从我母亲去世时开始出错。她不是被杀的，只是去世了。年事已高。她负担不起延龄治疗，我是说，谁负担得起呢。我辞去军职，回去处理她的遗产清算；之后便开始在核心世界间漂泊，试图找到人生方向。我还以为自己找到了... 可惜，事与愿违。过去的生活已经消失，我也回不去了，于是最后来到这里，在边境最破烂的穷乡僻壤经营一家酒吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Everything started to go wrong when my mom died. She wasn’t killed or anything, she just died. Old age. She couldn’t afford the age treatments, I mean, who can. I resigned my commission and went to deal with the liquidation of her estate, and after that I started drifting among the core worlds, trying to find direction in life. I thought I had found it too... but, it wasn’t to be. My old life is gone, and I can’t go back, so I ended up out here, tending a bar on the sleaziest backwater on the frontier.”"

rows.original: Burt chuckles and tucks his rag back into his apron pocket, “Well [pc.name], if you want to know more than that, you are going to have to get to know me better.” and he gives you a bit of a suggestive wink.
rows.translation: 伯特轻笑一声，把抹布塞回围裙口袋。“好吧，[pc.name]，如果还想知道更多，你就得先和我熟悉一些。”说着，他略带暗示地朝你眨眨眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nBurt chuckles and tucks his rag back into his apron pocket, “Well [pc.name], if you want to know more than that, you are going to have to get to know me better.” and he gives you a bit of a suggestive wink."

rows.original: Burt pours you a glass of mead, and then pours himself one as well, downing his in a single swig before setting the glass down hard enough that half the bar can hear it. He takes a deep breath and lets the mead calm his nerves. “I like you, [pc.name], you’re a good kid. And I don’t just mean good in bed... not that you aren’t. There are just some things a man isn’t comfortable talking about.”
rows.translation: 伯特给你倒了一杯蜂蜜酒，也给自己倒了一杯。他一口将自己的酒喝光，把杯子重重放下，声音大得半间酒吧都能听见。他深吸一口气，让蜂蜜酒安抚自己的神经。“我喜欢你，[pc.name]，你是个好孩子。我不只是说你在床上很棒... 当然你确实很棒。只是有些事会让一个男人难以启齿。”
rows.raw: "Burt pours you a glass of mead, and then pours himself one as well, downing his in a single swig before setting the glass down hard enough that half the bar can hear it. He takes a deep breath and lets the mead calm his nerves. “I like you, [pc.name], you’re a good kid. And I don’t just mean good in bed... not that you aren’t. There are just some things a man isn’t comfortable talking about.”"

rows.original: He sighs, “I owe you something though, so here’s the deal. The Black Void set me up. I’m sure you’ve heard of them. I mean, anyone who has ever rolled dice or bought something they shouldn’t have had has dealt with them at least indirectly. They framed me for something they didn’t want to have on their heads, something bad enough that I can’t ever risk visiting the core again.”
rows.translation: 他叹了口气。“不过我欠你点东西，所以就这么说吧。黑色虚空陷害了我。你肯定听说过他们。我的意思是，任何掷过骰子、或买过不该买之物的人，都至少间接与他们打过交道。他们把一件不想背在自己头上的事栽赃给我，而那件事严重到让我永远不敢冒险回核心区。”

I mean, anyone who has ever rolled dice or bought something they shouldn’t have had has dealt with them at least indirectly. They framed me for something they didn’t want to have on their heads, something bad enough that I can’t ever risk visiting the core again.”"

rows.original: Burt mutters, “Damnit... Okay, I’ll tell you everything, but only to make up for Three-Dee going off on you like that. I had a fiancee, a head researcher at Xenogen, she was brilliant and beautiful, the whole package. Henrietta was her name, had a doctorate in xenobiology before she was even out of puberty.” He gives a wistful sigh and seems to drift off in his memories for a moment before getting back to his story.
rows.translation: 伯特低声咒骂：“该死... 好吧，我会把一切都告诉你，但只是为了补偿三迪那样攻击你。我曾有个未婚妻，是异种基因公司的首席研究员。她既聪明又漂亮，样样俱全。她叫亨丽埃塔，甚至还没过青春期就拿到了异种生物学博士学位。”他惆怅地叹了口气，似乎短暂沉入回忆，随后才继续自己的故事。
rows.raw: "Burt mutters, “Damnit... Okay, I’ll tell you everything, but only to make up for Three-Dee going off on you like that. I had a fiancee, a head researcher at Xenogen, she was brilliant and beautiful, the whole package. Henrietta was her name, had a doctorate in xenobiology before she was even out of puberty.” He gives a wistful sigh and seems to drift off in his memories for a moment before getting back to his story."

rows.original: “She was researching genetic predispositions towards mental disease and criminal behavior. I doubt you’ve heard of her work, it’s a dead end...” he shakes his head and sighs, “I swear, as long as there have been people who could tell the difference between right and wrong, someone has hoped to cure it. Anyway, she made this drug, called H1d3, that she had hoped would work. It modified the person’s genetic code. It was supposed to make their bodies physically ill at the attempt to commit crimes, but it was never exact enough. Instead it just stripped all the test subjects of any semblance of free will, and jacked their libido through the roof. They would do anything you asked them to do without even putting up a fight. It was horrible. So Xenogen canceled the project.”
rows.translation: “她研究的是精神疾病和犯罪行为的遗传倾向。你大概没听说过她的研究，那是一条死路...”他摇摇头叹息道，“我敢说，只要人们还分得清是非，就总会有人希望把犯罪治好。总之，她制造了一种叫作H1d3的药物，希望它能够生效。它会修改人的遗传代码。本来应该让人在试图犯罪时产生生理不适，但效果始终不够精准。相反，它剥夺了所有受试者的一切自由意志，还把性欲推到顶点。他们会完成你提出的任何要求，甚至不会反抗。太可怕了，所以异种基因公司取消了这个项目。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“She was researching genetic predispositions towards mental disease and criminal behavior. I doubt you’ve heard of her work, it’s a dead end...” he shakes his head and sighs, “I swear, as long as there have been people who could tell the difference between right and wrong, someone has hoped to cure it. Anyway, she made this drug, called H1d3, that she had hoped would work. It modified the person’s genetic code. It was supposed to make their bodies physically ill at the attempt to commit crimes, but it was never exact enough. Instead it just stripped all the test subjects of any semblance of free will, and jacked their libido through the roof. They would do anything you asked them to do without even putting up a fight. It was horrible. So Xenogen canceled the project.”"

rows.original: Burt props his elbows on the bartop and drops his head into his hands, “That should have been the end of it... but somehow, the Black Void got their hands on the serum, and on my fiancee. She wouldn’t tell them how to make it, so they injected her with it, but the sample they had was old, H1d3 degrades over time. It left her a near brainless bimbo. She couldn’t tell them how to manufacture it after that.”
rows.translation: 伯特把手肘撑在吧台上，双手抱住脑袋。“事情本该就此结束... 可不知怎么，黑色虚空拿到了血清，还抓住了我的未婚妻。她不肯告诉他们如何制造，于是他们给她注射了血清；但他们拿到的样本已经老化，而H1d3会随时间降解。最后她变成了几乎没有脑子的花瓶女。那样一来，她更不可能告诉他们怎么生产血清。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBurt props his elbows on the bartop and drops his head into his hands, “That should have been the end of it... but somehow, the Black Void got their hands on the serum, and on my fiancee. She wouldn’t tell them how to make it, so they injected her with it, but the sample they had was old, H1d3 degrades over time. It left her a near brainless bimbo. She couldn’t tell them how to manufacture it after that.”"

rows.original: “So they dumped her in our apartment, and hid the hypo in my kit locker. They called the T.S.C. domestic security and told them that I had been selling lab rats to slavers, and had turned Henrietta into one and was about to sell her off as well. I was working security for Xenogen at the time, so I was an easy target. They had raided my place before I got home, and I saw them bringing her out. I ran, and I never looked back. I’m still on the T.S.C.’s most wanted list, but they don’t have a lot of reach here yet, so....” Burt shrugs, “That’s my story.”
rows.translation: “所以他们把她扔回我们的公寓，又把注射器藏进我的装备柜。他们联系T.S.C.国内安全部门，声称我一直把实验鼠卖给奴隶贩子，还把亨丽埃塔也变成了实验鼠，正准备将她一并卖掉。当时我在异种基因公司负责安保，自然成了很容易下手的目标。他们在我回家前就突袭了住所，我看见他们把她带出来。我逃了，从此再也没有回头。我至今还在T.S.C.最高通缉名单上，不过他们的势力暂时还很难伸到这里，所以...”伯特耸耸肩。“这就是我的故事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So they dumped her in our apartment, and hid the hypo in my kit locker. They called the T.S.C. domestic security and told them that I had been selling lab rats to slavers, and had turned Henrietta into one and was about to sell her off as well. I was working security for Xenogen at the time, so I was an easy target. They had raided my place before I got home, and I saw them bringing her out. I ran, and I never looked back. I’m still on the T.S.C.’s most wanted list, but they don’t have a lot of reach here yet, so....” Burt shrugs, “That’s my story.”"

rows.original: Burt chuckles and tucks his bar rag into a pocket on his apron, “You want to know about Burt’s Badass Mead Hall, huh? Can’t say that I blame ya. Sadly, there isn’t a lot to say about it. I won it in a card game, and the previous owner didn’t really give a lick about it. Had Three-Dee running it, and she’s glitchy as hell.” He shakes his head, “Frankly, I’m surprised I can even keep the place going.”
rows.translation: 伯特轻笑着，把酒吧抹布塞进围裙口袋。“你想了解伯特猛男蜂蜜酒馆，是吧？不能怪你。遗憾的是，这里没多少故事可说。我打牌赢下了它，而前任店主根本不在乎这地方。他让三迪经营酒馆，可她的故障严重得要命。”他摇摇头。“坦白说，我很惊讶自己居然还能让这里继续营业。”
rows.raw: "Burt chuckles and tucks his bar rag into a pocket on his apron, “You want to know about Burt’s Badass Mead Hall, huh? Can’t say that I blame ya. Sadly, there isn’t a lot to say about it. I won it in a card game, and the previous owner didn’t really give a lick about it. Had Three-Dee running it, and she’s glitchy as hell.” He shakes his head, “Frankly, I’m surprised I can even keep the place going.”"

rows.original: You inquire about who Three-Dee is.
rows.translation: 你询问三迪是谁。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou inquire about who Three-Dee is."

rows.original: Burt grins, “Three-Dee is a virtual bartender made by KihaCorp. Stands for Digital Drink Dispenser. Basically she’s a series of robotic limbs worked into the underside of the bar, and a cheap holoprojector with a VI just smart enough to make drinks to order and take credits. But when I got here, she had been hacked so many times that she is pretty unpredictable now. I try to only use her when I need a break.”
rows.translation: 伯特咧嘴笑道：“三迪是基哈公司制造的虚拟酒保，名字代表‘数字饮料分配器’。基本上，她就是安装在吧台下方的一系列机械臂，再配上廉价全息投影仪和一个只聪明到足以按单调酒、收取信用点的虚拟智能。不过我来到这里时，她已经被黑过太多次，现在完全无法预测。我尽量只在需要休息时才使用她。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBurt grins, “Three-Dee is a virtual bartender made by KihaCorp. Stands for Digital Drink Dispenser. Basically she’s a series of robotic limbs worked into the underside of the bar, and a cheap holoprojector with a VI just smart enough to make drinks to order and take credits. But when I got here, she had been hacked so many times that she is pretty unpredictable now. I try to only use her when I need a break.”"

rows.original: You mention that you are curious about the patrons of the Mead Hall.
rows.translation: 你提到自己对蜂蜜酒馆的顾客很好奇。
rows.raw: "You mention that you are curious about the patrons of the Mead Hall."

rows.original: Burt considers your question for a moment, before shrugging and saying, “Well, there is this Ausar girl who is in here most nights. If you like hologames, you should definitely seek her out. I’m pretty sure she is the best gamer on the planet. If you plan on challenging her though, two suggestions. First, don’t do it drunk. Second, don’t bet anything to her that you can’t afford to lose.”
rows.translation: 伯特思考了片刻你的问题，随后耸肩说道：“嗯，有个奥萨女孩大多数晚上都会来这里。如果你喜欢全息游戏，绝对应该去找她。我很确定她是这颗星球上最厉害的玩家。不过如果你打算挑战她，我有两条建议。第一，别喝醉了再去。第二，别拿任何输不起的东西和她下注。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBurt considers your question for a moment, before shrugging and saying, “Well, there is this Ausar girl who is in here most nights. If you like hologames, you should definitely seek her out. I’m pretty sure she is the best gamer on the planet. If you plan on challenging her though, two suggestions. First, don’t do it drunk. Second, don’t bet anything to her that you can’t afford to lose.”"

rows.original: You inquire about the employees of the Mead Hall.
rows.translation: 你询问蜂蜜酒馆的员工。
rows.raw: "You inquire about the employees of the Mead Hall."

rows.original: Burt chuckles, “Ah, well... other than myself and Three-Dee, there are a few other employees, the most popular of whom is probably my waitress Honey.” He nods to the cute flat chested blonde with the full and curvy posterior bouncing between tables and dropping off mugs of mead. “She’s a great waitress, and has some special talents all her own. If you fancy a show, she is a fine dancer... her show usually starts just before closing time. I’d highly recommend catching it... not to mention catching the souvenirs she casts off as she dances.” he says with a chuckle and a waggled eyebrow to highlight the innuendo.
rows.translation: 伯特轻笑道：“啊，这个嘛... 除了我和三迪以外，还有几名其他员工，其中最受欢迎的大概是我的服务员哈妮。”他朝那个可爱的平胸金发女孩点头；她丰满而曲线玲珑的臀部在桌间来回弹动，不断送上一杯杯蜂蜜酒。“她是个很棒的服务员，还有自己独有的特殊才艺。如果想看表演，她跳得相当不错... 表演通常就在打烊前开始。我强烈建议你去看看... 更别提还能接住她跳舞时脱下来的纪念品。”他说着轻笑一声，又挑了挑眉毛来强调其中暗示。
rows.raw: "\n\nBurt chuckles, “Ah, well... other than myself and Three-Dee, there are a few other employees, the most popular of whom is probably my waitress Honey.” He nods to the cute flat chested blonde with the full and curvy posterior bouncing between tables and dropping off mugs of mead. “She’s a great waitress, and has some special talents all her own. If you fancy a show, she is a fine dancer... her show usually starts just before closing time. I’d highly recommend catching it... not to mention catching the souvenirs she casts off as she dances.” he says with a chuckle and a waggled eyebrow to highlight the innuendo."

rows.original: Burt watches Honey prance about for a moment, an almost fatherly look on his face as he watches her, before he looks back to you, “If you do catch her show, don’t be an ass about it. No one ends up stuck out in this jungle because their life was perfect in the core.”
rows.translation: 伯特带着近乎父亲般的神情看哈妮雀跃地忙碌了一会儿，随后重新看向你。“如果你真的去看她表演，别表现得像个混蛋。没有人会因为自己在核心区的生活完美无缺，最后被困在这片丛林里。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBurt watches Honey prance about for a moment, an almost fatherly look on his face as he watches her, before he looks back to you, “If you do catch her show, don’t be an ass about it. No one ends up stuck out in this jungle because their life was perfect in the core.”"

rows.original: “So you’re doing business with the zil now?” you ask.
rows.translation: “所以你现在开始和兹尔人做生意了？”你问道。
rows.raw: "“So you’re doing business with the zil now?” you ask."

rows.original: “Yeah! What they want is really simple stuff - basic medicine, fabrics, building material - and what they’re selling, well, you can’t get it anywhere else in the galaxy.” He kisses his fingers effusively. “These are golden days, [pc.name]. Golden. Now I’ve got a surplus to work with, I can really start to think about all the things that might be done with that honey, cuz you know it’s amazing stuff. Not just mead, but perfume... therapeutic massages... aphrodisiac... once I send it off to a lab and know all of its properties...”

rows.original: “Oh yeah,” Burt says, sobering. “They reckon those Snugglé folks took their land when they built their big ass farm, way out there. They want them gone, they’ve made that pretty damn clear.” He sighs, knitting his fingers. “Not gonna lie, that’s a tough ask. Snugglé aren’t some two bit operation you can send a few letters to your system delegate about and expect they’ll pack up tomorrow. And plenty of people are going to want ‘em here, because they mean jobs and security. It’s a tough ask [pc.name], no question about that.”

rows.original: Burt grins, “Ah, the Zil, one of my favorite subjects. They are a lot like Terran honey bees, but don’t let that mix you up. They aren’t a hive mind, and any of them are able to have kids. They are more of a tribal kind of people, gathering in small bands and working the jungles they live in for their natural bounties. They are good people, and usually pretty peaceful. They follow that whole ‘make love, not war’ idea, and even if you piss them off, they are more likely to fuck you than kill you. Don’t underestimate them though. They aren’t complete primitives, and they have some nasty surprises.”

rows.original: Traffic on these hard-packed paths is light the whole way around the small town of Esbeth. No matter where you are, you usually don’t see more than a few people. Most of them appear to be townsfolk on the way to some errand or in the process of improving a ramshackle abode, but every now and again you see someone who is out hunting and prospecting like yourself, kitted out for a fight and looking at everything with sharp eyes. While the road continues on to the west and east, to the north you see one of the many pre-fabricated buildings in the colony, somewhat out of place among the shacks and more nondescript buildings. A pair of industrial stacks spewing out harmless wafts of steam denotes use, while the colorful and somewhat stretched sign up front declares: Crazy Carl’s Crude Cylinder Collection Cache. The crude neon outline of a handgun helps you fill in the blanks.
rows.translation: 这些坚实土路环绕着埃斯贝斯小镇，沿途行人稀少。无论身在何处，你通常都只能看见寥寥数人。他们大多是赶着办事或正在修缮简陋住所的镇民，但偶尔也能看到与你一样外出狩猎勘探的人；他们全副武装，随时准备战斗，以锐利目光打量四周。道路继续向西、向东延伸；北边则矗立着殖民地众多预制建筑中的一栋，与棚屋及其他不起眼的建筑相比略显突兀。一对工业烟囱喷出无害蒸汽，表明这里仍在使用；前方色彩缤纷、略显拉伸的招牌则写着：疯卡尔粗制枪械收藏仓。一把手枪的粗糙霓虹轮廓帮你补全了字面之外的信息。

Not wanting to waste the controlled atmosphere you quickly hop inside as the commercial door slides shut behind you.

rows.original: While it takes a moment for your eyes to adjust to the change in lighting, you are a little surprised at what you see. This isn’t exactly just a gunsmith or even just a weapons shop; it is some sort of convenience store, too! It has an inviting, commercial atmosphere with pale white tiling and bright lighting while the plain walls of the establishment are adorned with various model weapons, rifles especially, above the shelves. The store’s floor space is dominated by rows of simple shelves crammed full of goods. With a cursory glance, you glean that the store is stocked to be a survival or hunting-focused convenience store as a secondary given the array of things like simplistic foods, basic and archaic supplies like compasses, local maps, and so forth, as well as more advanced supplies such as full environmental suits, recharging equipment and replacement parts for instruments such as common scanners and the like. The sort of items that you might need to get by out on the frontier, tailored for explorers and adventurers like yourself.
rows.translation: 眼睛花了片刻才适应光线变化，眼前景象令你有些惊讶。这不完全是枪匠铺，甚至也不只是武器商店；它还是某种便利店！淡白色瓷砖与明亮照明营造出亲切的商业氛围，朴素墙壁则在货架上方装饰着各式武器模型，尤其以步枪居多。店内空间主要被一排排塞满商品的简易货架占据。匆匆一瞥，你便看出这家店也兼营侧重生存与狩猎的便利商品：简单食物、指南针和本地地图等基础古旧用品，以及全套环境防护服、充电设备、常见扫描仪等仪器的替换零件之类先进物资。都是在边境讨生活可能需要的物品，专为你这样的探索者和冒险家准备。

None of your supplies are poorly stocked and your trusty codex makes up for most of the tools, so the ‘convenience’ of the store is lost unless you want to pick up a snack. On the flipside, however, this area of the store is just a secondary portion for its real advertised purpose.

rows.original: Disengaging from the thick stacks of various knick-knacks you move to the back of the store where the cashier counter is manned by the owner of the store: ‘Crazy’ Carl. Or at least so you assume, based on the simple jerkin with his name tag attached to it. The man rests laid back in his comfortable-looking office chair, hands in his lap with a book reader tucked away off to the side while he gives you his full attention like the polite business man he seems to be. You’re not entirely sure how long he has been waiting at attention for you, but you don’t pay it any mind.
rows.translation: 你离开堆得厚厚的各式杂物，走向店铺后方；收银台由店主‘疯子’卡尔亲自看管。至少从他穿着的简朴紧身上衣及其姓名牌来看，你是这么猜的。这个男人放松地靠在看起来很舒服的办公椅上，双手放在腿间，电子书阅读器收在一旁；他全神贯注地招待你，就像个彬彬有礼的生意人。你不太确定他究竟保持专注地等了你多久，不过也没有在意。
rows.raw: "\n\nDisengaging from the thick stacks of various knick-knacks you move to the back of the store where the cashier counter is manned by the owner of the store: ‘Crazy’ Carl. Or at least so you assume, based on the simple jerkin with his name tag attached to it. The man rests laid back in his comfortable-looking office chair, hands in his lap with a book reader tucked away off to the side while he gives you his full attention like the polite business man he seems to be. You’re not entirely sure how long he has been waiting at attention for you, but you don’t pay it any mind."

rows.original: Carl is old. With the advances in medical science you can hardly venture a guess at his age, but you can still tell he is old. A fully bald human male with little tufts of white hair ringing his shiny dome and thicker tufts appearing on his chin in the form of a well-kempt beard. His skin is fairly clean outside of a few natural blemishes on his cheeks, the product of a modern age; no liver spots, discolorations or anything of the sort. Beyond all that he actually looks pretty fit, too, with thick arms and a stocky sort of appearance, especially with his slight lack of stature. Altogether he looks to be the pinnacle of health, even if he is an old coot. He’s all smiles as you approach the counter, bright blue eyes glittering. Evidently he’s the jovial sort.
rows.translation: 卡尔很老。得益于医学进步，你几乎猜不出他的年龄，但仍能看出他非常老。这名人类男性完全秃顶，闪亮头皮周围环绕着几簇白发，下巴上则长着更浓密、打理整齐的胡须。拜现代技术所赐，除了面颊上几处天然斑点外，他的皮肤相当干净；没有老年斑、色素变化或类似痕迹。不仅如此，他看起来其实还很健壮：双臂粗壮，体型敦实，个头也略显矮小。总的来说，即使是个老家伙，他也堪称健康巅峰。你走近柜台时，他满面笑容，明亮蓝眼闪闪发光。显然是个快活的人。
rows.raw: "\n\nCarl is old. With the advances in medical science you can hardly venture a guess at his age, but you can still tell he is old. A fully bald human male with little tufts of white hair ringing his shiny dome and thicker tufts appearing on his chin in the form of a well-kempt beard. His skin is fairly clean outside of a few natural blemishes on his cheeks, the product of a modern age; no liver spots, discolorations or anything of the sort. Beyond all that he actually looks pretty fit, too, with thick arms and a stocky sort of appearance, especially with his slight lack of stature. Altogether he looks to be the pinnacle of health, even if he is an old coot. He’s all smiles as you approach the counter, bright blue eyes glittering. Evidently he’s the jovial sort."

rows.original: What’s behind him practically sets your mental image of him in stone: not mere desks and paperwork like you’d expect from an office space, but instead raw works of industry. Large machines, certainly bigger than you, sprawl across the narrow space behind him. It’s set up so there is only room to settle in one spot, though that’s likely intentional, keeping it all accessible from that one position. Cramped, but efficient.
rows.translation: 他身后的景象几乎让你对他的印象彻底定型：那里并非办公区常见的桌椅文件，而是原始工业设备。数台肯定比你还大的巨型机器铺满他身后的狭窄空间。布局只留出一个能坐人的位置，不过这很可能是刻意为之，好让他从那里就能操作所有设备。拥挤，却很高效。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat’s behind him practically sets your mental image of him in stone: not mere desks and paperwork like you’d expect from an office space, but instead raw works of industry. Large machines, certainly bigger than you, sprawl across the narrow space behind him. It’s set up so there is only room to settle in one spot, though that’s likely intentional, keeping it all accessible from that one position. Cramped, but efficient."

rows.original: You enter the pre-fabricated building once again, finding that nothing has really changed. You’re pleasantly distracted by the cool, air-conditioned atmosphere in contrast to the more muggy air outside. It would be more pleasant if it wasn’t for the constant burning smell niggling at your senses. The array of aisles are stocked with just as much as last time, though just like every other time you don’t really need anything in the convenience section.
rows.translation: 你再次进入这栋预制建筑，发现一切都没有真正改变。与外面更加闷热的空气相比，凉爽的空调环境令人愉快地分了神。若不是持续不断的焦煳气味刺激着感官，这里本会更加舒适。一排排货架仍像上次一样商品充足，不过也和每一次一样，你其实不需要便利区里的任何东西。
rows.raw: "You enter the pre-fabricated building once again, finding that nothing has really changed. You’re pleasantly distracted by the cool, air-conditioned atmosphere in contrast to the more muggy air outside. It would be more pleasant if it wasn’t for the constant burning smell niggling at your senses. The array of aisles are stocked with just as much as last time, though just like every other time you don’t really need anything in the convenience section."

rows.original: Milling past the goods absently you make your way to the back counter, where the old coot sits as always. Carl is pretty quick to glance up from his reader to give you a smile.
rows.translation: 你心不在焉地走过商品区，来到后方柜台，那个老家伙一如既往地坐在那里。卡尔很快从阅读器上抬起头，朝你露出笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\nMilling past the goods absently you make your way to the back counter, where the old coot sits as always. Carl is pretty quick to glance up from his reader to give you a smile."

rows.original: “Hey there, stranger. Whacha need? Nothin’ in your hands, I see; old eyes ain’t givin’ out just yet. Here for a gunshow?”
rows.translation: “你好啊，陌生人。需要什么？我看你手里什么都没有；老眼睛还没不中用呢。来看枪展的？”
rows.raw: "“Hey there, stranger. Whacha need? Nothin’ in your hands, I see; old eyes ain’t givin’ out just yet. Here for a gunshow?”"

rows.original: You go to nod before realizing the bad joke, making you hesitate a moment.
rows.translation: 你正要点头，却反应过来这是个烂笑话，顿时犹豫了一下。

rows.original: You lean gently against the counter and put on a friendly face, not-so-subtly hinting that you’d like to get to know him a little before making a purchase. Especially one as expensive, and legally gridlocked, as a firearm!
rows.translation: 你轻轻倚着柜台，摆出友善的神情，不算含蓄地暗示自己想在购买前先了解他一些。尤其这还是枪械，既昂贵，又受重重法律限制！
rows.raw: "You lean gently against the counter and put on a friendly face, not-so-subtly hinting that you’d like to get to know him a little before making a purchase. Especially one as expensive, and legally gridlocked, as a firearm!"

rows.original: “Eh? Alrigh’, I sympathize some. Lesse... well! Name’s Carl! Carl Jakovich.”
rows.translation: “嗯？好吧，我能理解一些。让我想想... 啊！我叫卡尔！卡尔·雅科维奇。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Eh? Alrigh’, I sympathize some. Lesse... well! Name’s Carl! Carl Jakovich.”"

rows.original: You are disappointed that the nominal alliteration doesn’t continue, though he does.
rows.translation: 你有点失望，名字没有继续保持押头韵，不过他的话还没说完。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou are disappointed that the nominal alliteration doesn’t continue, though he does."

rows.original: “Hm. Been workin’ in this buisness since I was a brat. Mother did it and I just kinda helped. Goin’ with it in the end just made sense, ya know? Besides, I’d like to call myself pretty good at it. Made quite the little empire in my name, ya know!”
rows.translation: “嗯。我从毛头小子时就在干这一行。母亲做这个，我就跟着帮忙。最后继续干下去也很合理，懂吧？再说，我觉得自己还挺擅长的。靠这个名头建立了一座小小帝国，知道吗！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hm. Been workin’ in this buisness since I was a brat. Mother did it and I just kinda helped. Goin’ with it in the end just made sense, ya know? Besides, I’d like to call myself pretty good at it. Made quite the little empire in my name, ya know!”"

rows.original: You get a solid scoff out of him when you glance behind yourself into the simplistic stock, pointedly.
rows.translation: 你刻意回头看了看身后简陋的存货，引得他重重嗤笑一声。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou get a solid scoff out of him when you glance behind yourself into the simplistic stock, pointedly."

rows.original: “Ha! Ya think this is my main place of business? Nah, I’m retired! Technically, anyway. This is more of a hobby than a real bit of work now. Only gonna be out here for a bit. Got a bit stir crazy and hey, lil’ cuz’ got married. Might as well step in and mind the store for a bit so she can have a lively time, eh? I’ll head back home when she’s done and see to a bit of civilization n’ life in the mean time. Everyone wins!” There is a short little pause before he bashfully murmurs, “Well. Such as it is, anyway.”
rows.translation: “哈！你以为这是我的主营店？才不是，我退休了！至少理论上是这样。现在更像兴趣，不算真正工作。我只会在这待一阵子。有点闲疯了，而且小表妹结婚了。那我何不暂时过来照看店铺，让她快活一阵，对吧？等她忙完我就回家，中间也顺便享受一点文明和生活。大家都赢！”他短暂停顿一下，随后腼腆地低声道：“嗯。就当是这样吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ha! Ya think this is my main place of business? Nah, I’m retired! Technically, anyway. This is more of a hobby than a real bit of work now. Only gonna be out here for a bit. Got a bit stir crazy and hey, lil’ cuz’ got married. Might as well step in and mind the store for a bit so she can have a lively time, eh? I’ll head back home when she’s done and see to a bit of civilization n’ life in the mean time. Everyone wins!” There is a short little pause before he bashfully murmurs, “Well. Such as it is, anyway.”"

rows.original: There is a chuckle from you in response. Still, you find yourself a bit curious; how’d he make his fortune? This sort of work pays pretty well, sure, but it’s not exactly consistent.
rows.translation: 你轻笑着回应。不过，你仍有些好奇；他是怎么赚到财富的？这行当然收入不错，却算不上稳定。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere is a chuckle from you in response. Still, you find yourself a bit curious; how’d he make his fortune? This sort of work pays pretty well, sure, but it’s not exactly consistent."

rows.original: “Ah... kicked off way back when, prolly why you haven’t heard of me. Might not’ve been born yet even, sprout! Way back when I was just a pretty proficient, prolific craftsman. All sorts of shooters, just not a lot of clients n’ fame to go ‘round. Then comes around a future-legend, buys up a massive load of my stock over the course of a few months and sets me off as a result. Tinkered with his stuff when he needed it, too, but mostly just was a shopkeep. Said who he got his prized guns from and my popularity shot up, heh. Had a place everywhere, pretty big deal. Started to die down ‘gain, though, and I got old enough to start wantin’ to liquidate and sell off my assets to retire. Now it’s just a few stores run by my family that’s in the business usin’ the name to get them by.” His expression reeks of nostalgia as his mind wanders, shaking his head with a fat grin. “Ah, Victor Steele. Good lad, him, wonder how he’s doing...”
rows.translation: “啊... 那是很久以前的事了，可能正因如此，你才没听过我。那时你甚至还没出生呢，小家伙！很久以前，我只是个相当熟练又高产的工匠。各种枪都做，只是客户和名气不够分。后来一位未来的传奇出现，几个月里买走我大量存货，结果也让我一炮而红。他需要时，我也会摆弄他的装备，不过大部分时间只是个店主。他告诉别人那些宝贝枪是从哪来的，我的人气便一下蹿升，嘿。到处都有店，生意可大了。不过后来又开始衰退，而我也老到想清算、出售资产退休。现在只剩几家店，由入行的亲属经营，借我的名号维持生意。”思绪飘远时，他脸上满是怀念，咧着大嘴摇了摇头。“啊，维克多·斯蒂尔。好小子，不知现在过得怎么样...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah... kicked off way back when, prolly why you haven’t heard of me. Might not’ve been born yet even, sprout! Way back when I was just a pretty proficient, prolific craftsman. All sorts of shooters, just not a lot of clients n’ fame to go ‘round. Then comes around a future-legend, buys up a massive load of my stock over the course of a few months and sets me off as a result. Tinkered with his stuff when he needed it, too, but mostly just was a shopkeep. Said who he got his prized guns from and my popularity shot up, heh. Had a place everywhere, pretty big deal. Started to die down ‘gain, though, and I got old enough to start wantin’ to liquidate and sell off my assets to retire. Now it’s just a few stores run by my family that’s in the business usin’ the name to get them by.” His expression reeks of nostalgia as his mind wanders, shaking his head with a fat grin. “Ah, Victor Steele. Good lad, him, wonder how he’s doing...”"

rows.raw: "One of the more pressing questions you have is one of the first ones you had: ‘Crazy Carl’s Crude Cylinder Collection Cache’?"

rows.original: Carl immediately responds with a loud, jovial guffaw. “Ha! I’ll say, yeah! Quite the eye catcher, ain’t it? Sticks in yer head. The original when I was younger and a bit of a sprout was just ‘Carl’s Gunshow’, ya can think of how well that turned over.”
rows.translation: 卡尔立刻发出洪亮欢快的大笑。“哈！是吧，我就说嘛！很吸睛，对不对？让人忘不掉。我年轻时最初的店名只是‘卡尔枪展’，你可以想想那生意有多好。”
rows.raw: "\n\nCarl immediately responds with a loud, jovial guffaw. “Ha! I’ll say, yeah! Quite the eye catcher, ain’t it? Sticks in yer head. The original when I was younger and a bit of a sprout was just ‘Carl’s Gunshow’, ya can think of how well that turned over.”"

rows.original: Eh. That could work.
rows.translation: 嗯。那名字也能用。
rows.raw: "\n\nEh. That could work."

rows.original: “Nawh, now this place... lil’ niece, not eight years old, was listening in when I was talking about the place. Told me she thought it was dumb, ought to name it somethin’ else. Gave her a few days to think of one’, just to keep her busy. Slams down that number and - ho boy! Didn’t even know they taught those words just yet, surprising lil’ tyke. Had a good laugh with it, stuck with my word and slapped it on. Good idea in the long run, got quite a bit more returning folks over it. Strangely, alliteration keeps better than a childish joke.”
rows.translation: “不，现在这个名字... 我的小侄女当时还不到八岁，听见我谈起店铺。她说这名字很蠢，应该换一个。我给了她几天想新名字，只是想让她有事可做。结果她一下就抛出这个，嚯！我都不知道她已经学会那些词了，真是个让人惊讶的小家伙。我笑得不行，也信守承诺把名字挂了上去。长远来看，这是个好主意，回头客多了不少。奇怪的是，押头韵比幼稚笑话更让人记得住。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nawh, now this place... lil’ niece, not eight years old, was listening in when I was talking about the place. Told me she thought it was dumb, ought to name it somethin’ else. Gave her a few days to think of one’, just to keep her busy. Slams down that number and - ho boy! Didn’t even know they taught those words just yet, surprising lil’ tyke. Had a good laugh with it, stuck with my word and slapped it on. Good idea in the long run, got quite a bit more returning folks over it. Strangely, alliteration keeps better than a childish joke.”"

rows.translation: “出名后就更没法改了。不过那小家伙觉得我疯疯癫癫，还是让我有点伤心。算啦。”

rows.original: “Oh yeah, before he got famous even.” The old man leans back in his chair, causing it to creak in complaint as the thick smile on his face grows wider. It looks like he’s reminiscing about matters, though his silent reprieve doesn’t last. “Bit of a weirdo back then, though. Wry thing, ran around willy-nilly and got into everyone’s business. Got arrested for wanderin’ to folks houses a few times, even. Anyway. Once the lad got going he actually kept comin’ back to my place. Said he liked the name. Only one that ‘stood out’. Decided to buy one of everythin’ for ‘collection’s sake’, then he actually did. Of course, back then my stock was a lot bigger than what you see out here. Heh... he always said where he got ‘em, too. Good business.”
rows.translation: “当然，而且是在他成名前。”老人靠回椅背，椅子不满地吱呀作响，他脸上浓浓的笑容也变得更大。他似乎陷入回忆，不过安静没有持续太久。“当时是个有点古怪的家伙。性子机灵，四处乱跑，什么人的事都要插一脚。甚至好几次因为闯进别人家被捕。总之，那小子开始闯荡后，其实一直会回我店里。他说喜欢这个名字，是唯一‘很突出’的那家。后来决定‘为了收藏’每样都买一件，而且真这么做了。当然，那时候我的存货比你在这里看到的多得多。嘿... 他也总会告诉别人东西是从哪买的。好生意。”

Decided to buy one of everythin’ for ‘collection’s sake’, then he actually did. Of course, back then my stock was a lot bigger than what you see out here. Heh... he always said where he got ‘em, too. Good business.”"
