rows.original: You tap the counter to get Carl’s full attention, unnecessarily, before speaking. “You mentioned something about a robot?”
rows.translation: 你敲了敲柜台，让卡尔全神贯注地听你说话，尽管根本没这个必要。“你刚才是不是提到过一个机器人？”
rows.raw: "You tap the counter to get Carl’s full attention, unnecessarily, before speaking. “You mentioned something about a robot?”"

rows.original: “Machina, but yeah. Things apparently been goin’ haywire around here, or at least they were a bit back. Ain’t too sure what’s the reason, but the powers that be are considerin’ it was some nefarious visitor hacking everything. Wasn’t the Zil or some astro event, anyway. Got the security systems all twitchy and set the various attendants on edge until we got someone in here to reset the lot of ‘em. No one got hurt, but I wasn’t the only one to lose something.” The old man leans back in his seat with an audible creak, hand lazily scritchin at his long chin-whiskers. “Gotta say, the nurse-bot got pretty interesting. If a bit psychotic and clingy.” He stifles a light little chuckle and you can only imagine the implications.
rows.translation: “机械体，没错。这里的东西显然一度全都出了故障，至少不久前是这样。原因还不太确定，不过当权者认为，是某个心怀不轨的访客黑进了所有设备。总之，不是兹尔，也不是什么天文现象。安保系统全都抽风，各种服务机器人也变得神经兮兮，直到有人来把它们全部重置。没人受伤，但丢东西的可不只我一个。”老人靠回座椅，椅子响亮地吱呀一声；他懒洋洋地挠着下巴上的长胡须。“不得不说，护士机器人变得挺有意思。就是有点精神错乱，而且太黏人。”他忍住一声轻笑，你只能想象其中意味。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Machina, but yeah. Things apparently been goin’ haywire around here, or at least they were a bit back. Ain’t too sure what’s the reason, but the powers that be are considerin’ it was some nefarious visitor hacking everything. Wasn’t the Zil or some astro event, anyway. Got the security systems all twitchy and set the various attendants on edge until we got someone in here to reset the lot of ‘em. No one got hurt, but I wasn’t the only one to lose something.” The old man leans back in his seat with an audible creak, hand lazily scritchin at his long chin-whiskers. “Gotta say, the nurse-bot got pretty interesting. If a bit psychotic and clingy.” He stifles a light little chuckle and you can only imagine the implications."

rows.original: Can’t the local security help?
rows.translation: 当地安保不能帮忙吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nCan’t the local security help?"

rows.original: “Overworked, underpaid and terribly staffed. Plus they’re a bit busy right now. Can’t go rummaging through the jungle lookin’ for lost goods that are probably fried, anyway. No, I’m afraid it’s a personal problem or nothing once it leaves the grounds.”
rows.translation: “工作过量、薪水太低，人手还少得可怜。而且他们现在有点忙。总不能跑进丛林搜寻很可能已经烧坏的失物。不，东西一旦离开场地，恐怕就只能自己解决，否则就算了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Overworked, underpaid and terribly staffed. Plus they’re a bit busy right now. Can’t go rummaging through the jungle lookin’ for lost goods that are probably fried, anyway. No, I’m afraid it’s a personal problem or nothing once it leaves the grounds.”"

rows.original: Hm. You’ll probably be going through the jungle here, actually.
rows.translation: 嗯。其实你大概会穿过这里的丛林。
rows.raw: "\n\nHm. You’ll probably be going through the jungle here, actually."

rows.original: “Eh? You?” Carl pushes himself forward, arms pressing into the countertop as he looks you over with no small amount of scrutiny. He seems rather thorough about it, too, glancing over every cleft of your body, every pronounced bit of your
rows.translation: “嗯？你？”卡尔身体前倾，双臂压在柜台上，带着毫不掩饰的审视将你从头到脚打量一遍。他看得相当仔细，目光扫过你身体的每一道沟壑、你每一处突出的
rows.raw: "\n\n“Eh? You?” Carl pushes himself forward, arms pressing into the countertop as he looks you over with no small amount of scrutiny. He seems rather thorough about it, too, glancing over every cleft of your body, every pronounced bit of your "

rows.original: and the nature of your weapons - you can’t help but get a little self-conscious. Even when he leans back, evidently done peering into your very soul, he doesn’t exactly look impressed. “Well, if you’re going out there I suppose I could give you a little purpose for it, but I’m not too sure I’d feel comfortable with ya runnin’ out against a bunch of tribals like the other would-bes that run through here.”
rows.translation: ，以及武器的性质，让你不由得有些不自在。即使他靠回去，显然已经看透你的灵魂，也完全没有露出满意的神情。“好吧，如果你真要出去，我想可以给你一点目标，但我不太放心让你像其他经过这里的冒失鬼一样，跑出去对付一群部落民。”
rows.raw: " and the nature of your weapons - you can’t help but get a little self-conscious. Even when he leans back, evidently done peering into your very soul, he doesn’t exactly look impressed. “Well, if you’re going out there I suppose I could give you a little purpose for it, but I’m not too sure I’d feel comfortable with ya runnin’ out against a bunch of tribals like the other would-bes that run through here.”"

rows.original: You scoff defensively, reassuring the old coot that nothing on this planet could slow you down, let alone an out-of-control bot.
rows.translation: 你防备地嗤笑一声，向这个老家伙保证，这颗星球上没有任何东西能拖住你，更别提失控的机器人了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou scoff defensively, reassuring the old coot that nothing on this planet could slow you down, let alone an out-of-control bot."

rows.original: You hold your hands up and try to reassure the old man; you’re not the hottest shit this side of the galaxy, but you can manage.
rows.translation: 你举起双手，试着让老人放心；你算不上银河这一带最厉害的人物，但还是应付得来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hold your hands up and try to reassure the old man; you’re not the hottest shit this side of the galaxy, but you can manage."

rows.original: <i>“Well, at least you’re a bit more
rows.translation: <i>“好吧，至少你还比较
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Well, at least you’re a bit more "

rows.original: confident
rows.translation: 自信
rows.raw: "confident"

rows.original: humble
rows.translation: 谦虚
rows.raw: "humble"

rows.original: . Alright.” Carl speaks in a resigned manner as he leans forward again, tapping at his counter-console and bringing up the image of a robot - your target. It’s a fairly compact thing, probably no bigger than the average person’s torso, though all the spindly arms coming out of it for its various gadgets and functions give it a larger presence. Looks like it floats in the air, too, which will help it stand out some more in the middle of the jungle, bright steel-white aside. Though that’s only assuming it still works. “Here’s the forge machina. Nothin’ too special, all in all. Ran off into the jungle to ‘fix’ things. If it’s still runnin’ right, relatively speaking, it might come at you to make modifications, so watch yerself. Don’t throw yourself in danger just for me: if it comes at you, shoot it. Besides, I just need the tools on it. Anything extra is just that.”
rows.translation: 。行。”卡尔无奈地说道，再次向前倾身，轻点柜台控制台，调出一个机器人的影像，也就是你的目标。它相当紧凑，大概不比普通人的躯干更大，不过各种工具与功能对应的细长机械臂从主体伸出，让它显得更加庞大。它似乎还能飘在空中；除了一身明亮银白外，这也能让它在丛林中更加显眼。当然，前提是它仍能运作。“这就是锻造机械体。总体来说没什么特别的。它跑进丛林，要去‘修理’东西。如果还算正常运作，它可能会冲过来改造你，所以当心点。别只为我让自己身陷危险：它要是冲你来，就开枪。再说，我只需要上面的工具。其他东西都只是附带。”
rows.raw: ". Alright.” Carl speaks in a resigned manner as he leans forward again, tapping at his counter-console and bringing up the image of a robot - your target. It’s a fairly compact thing, probably no bigger than the average person’s torso, though all the spindly arms coming out of it for its various gadgets and functions give it a larger presence. Looks like it floats in the air, too, which will help it stand out some more in the middle of the jungle, bright steel-white aside. Though that’s only assuming it still works. “Here’s the forge machina. Nothin’ too special, all in all. Ran off into the jungle to ‘fix’ things. If it’s still runnin’ right, relatively speaking, it might come at you to make modifications, so watch yerself. Don’t throw yourself in danger just for me: if it comes at you, shoot it. Besides, I just need the tools on it. Anything extra is just that.”"

rows.original: You nod. That actually ought to be pretty easy. You’ve had worse.
rows.translation: 你点点头。这其实应该相当容易。更糟的情况你都遇到过。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod. That actually ought to be pretty easy. You’ve had worse."

rows.original: The coot cocks a cheeky grin as he leans back once again, the chair giving off another pathetic, woeful whine from the shifting weight. “Ha, it’s pretty fast. If you do manage to get to it in one piece there’s an off-red button hidden away in the undercarriage. It’ll switch to a factory-default profile and send it hovering back to its home beacon. Which is here, of course. If not, you’ll have to carry it home in a sack. Good news is it weighs about as much as a bucket of water.”
rows.translation: 老家伙再次靠回去，露出顽皮笑容；重量转移时，椅子又发出一声可怜悲惨的哀鸣。“哈，它速度很快。要是你真能完好无损地接近它，底盘下藏着一枚暗红色按钮。按下后，它会切换成出厂默认配置，飘回自己的归航信标。当然，信标就在这里。不行的话，你就得装进袋子背回家。好消息是，它的重量大约和一桶水差不多。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe coot cocks a cheeky grin as he leans back once again, the chair giving off another pathetic, woeful whine from the shifting weight. “Ha, it’s pretty fast. If you do manage to get to it in one piece there’s an off-red button hidden away in the undercarriage. It’ll switch to a factory-default profile and send it hovering back to its home beacon. Which is here, of course. If not, you’ll have to carry it home in a sack. Good news is it weighs about as much as a bucket of water.”"

rows.original: Heh, you’re used to lugging around pocketfuls of use-impaired junk all the time as is!
rows.translation: 嘿，你本来就习惯随身拖着一口袋功能受损的垃圾四处走！
rows.raw: "\n\nHeh, you’re used to lugging around pocketfuls of use-impaired junk all the time as is!"

rows.original: Though that might be a bit too self-referencing.
rows.translation: 不过这话或许有点太自我指涉了。
rows.raw: " Though that might be a bit too self-referencing."

rows.original: “Now, if you do it I’ll be able to work on the toys again. Might just have something for you, then.”
rows.translation: “好了，你要是办成，我就又能加工这些玩具了。到时说不定有东西给你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now, if you do it I’ll be able to work on the toys again. Might just have something for you, then.”"

rows.original: Off to the jungle with you!
rows.translation: 出发去丛林吧！
rows.raw: "\n\nOff to the jungle with you!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Eh? Got any news on the bot?”
rows.translation: “嗯？那机器人有消息吗？”
rows.raw: "“Eh? Got any news on the bot?”"

rows.original: You shake your head. Nothing thus far, sadly.
rows.translation: 你摇摇头。遗憾的是，目前毫无发现。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shake your head. Nothing thus far, sadly."

rows.original: “Ah, well. I ain’t expecting much. Keep snoopin’ about if you run around in the ferns. I’ll have something for ya if you do, but I can’t give you anythin’ for trying. Don’t get stung by the locals, though.”
rows.translation: “啊，好吧。我也没抱太大希望。要在蕨林里四处走，就留心找找。你真找到，我会给你点东西，不过光是尝试可得不到奖励。还有，别被当地人蜇了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, well. I ain’t expecting much. Keep snoopin’ about if you run around in the ferns. I’ll have something for ya if you do, but I can’t give you anythin’ for trying. Don’t get stung by the locals, though.”"

rows.original: The Robot
rows.raw: "The Robot"

rows.original: “Ah, yes!” Carl brightens the moment you bring the subject up, rolling his creaking chair back to tug something out from underneath the counter - the machina! Pretty beat up, mostly courtesy of you, but intact. If currently limp and inert, anyway. “Ya got it back in good shape! Workin’ shape, anyway. Just need for the manufacture to toss me with the diagnostic information and it’ll be floatin’ ‘round being a bother yet again. Ya did good, sprout! Gotta say I’m even a bit surprised.”
rows.translation: “啊，没错！”你一提起这事，卡尔立刻喜形于色；他让吱呀作响的椅子向后滑，从柜台底下拖出某样东西，也就是那台机械体！它伤得很重，主要拜你所赐，但仍然完整。至少眼下只是软塌塌地毫无反应。“你把它完好地带回来了！好吧，是能修好的状态。只要制造商把诊断信息扔给我，它很快就会再次飘来飘去惹麻烦。干得好，小家伙！不得不说，连我都有点意外。”
rows.raw: "“Ah, yes!” Carl brightens the moment you bring the subject up, rolling his creaking chair back to tug something out from underneath the counter - the machina! Pretty beat up, mostly courtesy of you, but intact. If currently limp and inert, anyway. “Ya got it back in good shape! Workin’ shape, anyway. Just need for the manufacture to toss me with the diagnostic information and it’ll be floatin’ ‘round being a bother yet again. Ya did good, sprout! Gotta say I’m even a bit surprised.”"

rows.original: Tempering your welling pride you
rows.translation: 你压下心中涌起的自豪感，
rows.raw: "\n\nTempering your welling pride you"

rows.original: smirk
rows.translation: 坏笑
rows.raw: "smirk"

rows.original: bashfully hold back your bravado
rows.translation: 腼腆地收起夸耀
rows.raw: " bashfully hold back your bravado"

rows.original: and simply ask if anything else needs to be done.
rows.translation: ，只是询问还有没有其他事需要完成。
rows.raw: " and simply ask if anything else needs to be done."

rows.original: “Nawh, I’m good. But you deserve something for it. While the bot ain’t workin’ right, I can still make do with its tools, so I finished up that rifle you were spyin’ earlier.” Carl reaches down and leaves the rag-doll of a robot back down under the desk, coming up with the stylishly purple weapon you pointed out not that long ago! He holds it out towards you so you can appraise it as he speaks, the gleam of light giving it an attractive shine. “The ZK rifle! Slug magazines with mag-boosted firing action. Real beauty, this thing. Did some modifications to it here and there. Actions smoothed out and tapered down. See the input panel by the trigger? Fixed the wiring and gave it new lining, buttons are subtle to prevent anything catching on them and the spring needs direct force. The input for the bayonet was removed - never made - and instead more coolant coils were added around the barrel, all smoothed out to keep it balanced. Swapped out the old sight for a corrective pop out one - a reflexive. Still can land shots at range with it. Did as much as I could with the barrel, but the ZK’s inherent design flaw is that the mag rails warp with each shot. Inset in the barrel was dug in more, but short of absolutely redesigning the firearm as a whole there isn’t anything you can do for that.”
rows.translation: “没了，我这边很好。不过你应该得到奖励。机器人还没正常运作，但我仍能凑合使用它的工具，所以完成了你早些时候盯着看的那把步枪。”卡尔俯身把布娃娃般的机器人放回桌下，随后拿起不久前你指过的那把时髦紫色武器！他伸到你面前，让你在他说话时仔细鉴赏；光线闪耀，令枪身泛着诱人光泽。“ZK步枪！使用弹丸弹匣和磁力增强射击机构。真是件美人。我到处做了一些改装。机构更加顺滑，也削得更低。看见扳机旁边的输入面板了吗？我修好了线路，换了新衬层；按钮很低调，不会被东西勾住，弹簧也需要直接施力。刺刀接口被拆掉了，反正从没造过刺刀；枪管周围则加了更多冷却线圈，并全部磨平以保持平衡。旧瞄具换成了校正式弹出瞄具，也就是反射式瞄具。远距离仍然能打中。我已经尽可能改造枪管，但ZK的固有设计缺陷是磁轨每射一发都会变形。枪管内嵌部分挖得更深，可除非彻底重新设计整把枪，否则没法解决。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nawh, I’m good. But you deserve something for it. While the bot ain’t workin’ right, I can still make do with its tools, so I finished up that rifle you were spyin’ earlier.” Carl reaches down and leaves the rag-doll of a robot back down under the desk, coming up with the stylishly purple weapon you pointed out not that long ago! He holds it out towards you so you can appraise it as he speaks, the gleam of light giving it an attractive shine. “The ZK rifle! Slug magazines with mag-boosted firing action. Real beauty, this thing. Did some modifications to it here and there. Actions smoothed out and tapered down. See the input panel by the trigger? Fixed the wiring and gave it new lining, buttons are subtle to prevent anything catching on them and the spring needs direct force. The input for the bayonet was removed - never made - and instead more coolant coils were added around the barrel, all smoothed out to keep it balanced. Swapped out the old sight for a corrective pop out one - a reflexive. Still can land shots at range with it. Did as much as I could with the barrel, but the ZK’s inherent design flaw is that the mag rails warp with each shot. Inset in the barrel was dug in more, but short of absolutely redesigning the firearm as a whole there isn’t anything you can do for that.”"

rows.original: Following along without missing a beat, you nod firmly in understanding. The ZK series was already known for being a solid go-to carbine and this fixes up some of the flaws. A less egregious action that won’t catch on anything, reinforcement prevents the vulnerable wiring from being affected by environmental circumstances or attacks and the poor accuracy has been improved by adding more coolant, making the rails take longer to heat up and warp. The weapon is still marked for short ranges,
rows.translation: 你毫无迟滞地跟上讲解，坚定点头表示理解。ZK系列本就以可靠的通用卡宾枪闻名，这次改装修复了部分缺陷。没那么突出的机构不会被东西勾住，加固结构使脆弱线路免受环境或攻击影响，更多冷却装置也改善了糟糕精度，让磁轨需要更久才会升温变形。这把武器仍被标注为适合短距离，
rows.raw: "\n\nFollowing along without missing a beat, you nod firmly in understanding. The ZK series was already known for being a solid go-to carbine and this fixes up some of the flaws. A less egregious action that won’t catch on anything, reinforcement prevents the vulnerable wiring from being affected by environmental circumstances or attacks and the poor accuracy has been improved by adding more coolant, making the rails take longer to heat up and warp. The weapon is still marked for short ranges, "

rows.original: but you’re confident that you would have a much more dependable weapon.
rows.translation: 但你确信它会可靠得多。
rows.raw: "but you’re confident that you would have a much more dependable weapon."

rows.original: of course.
rows.translation: 当然。
rows.raw: "of course."

rows.original: “And it’s yours. As a reward.”
rows.translation: “它归你了。作为奖励。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And it’s yours. As a reward.”"

rows.original: Quite the expensive reward!
rows.translation: 这奖励可真昂贵！
rows.raw: "\n\nQuite the expensive reward!"

rows.original: “Nah, it’s fine. Legally speakin’ this place doesn’t even have the permit to sell it normally, so this is under the table. You’ve got somethin’ going on if you sallied forth into that mess and came out with this ‘ole bucket, I might as well enable ya and make sure you don’t come out like the bucket later on. Now, then, ‘fore I do...”
rows.translation: “不，没关系。从法律上讲，这家店甚至没有正常出售它的许可证，所以算私下交易。你能闯进那片烂摊子，又带着这只‘旧桶’出来，肯定有两下子；我不妨帮你一把，确保你以后不会也变成那只桶的样子。好了，在我交给你之前...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nah, it’s fine. Legally speakin’ this place doesn’t even have the permit to sell it normally, so this is under the table. You’ve got somethin’ going on if you sallied forth into that mess and came out with this ‘ole bucket, I might as well enable ya and make sure you don’t come out like the bucket later on. Now, then, ‘fore I do...”"

rows.original: Uh oh.
rows.translation: 哦哦。
rows.raw: "\n\nUh oh."

rows.original: “Do you have a license for HC-5 class weapons and energy disposal, a Klamer’s certification card or other U.G.C accepted Eighteen Ninety Weapons Treaty-accommodating titles?”
rows.translation: “你有HC-5级武器与能源处置许可证、克拉默认证卡，或者其他受联合银河邦联承认、符合一八九〇武器条约的资质吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Do you have a license for HC-5 class weapons and energy disposal, a Klamer’s certification card or other U.G.C accepted Eighteen Ninety Weapons Treaty-accommodating titles?”"

rows.original: You give a firm nod. “Of course.”
rows.translation: 你坚定地点头。“当然。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give a firm nod. “Of course.”"

rows.original: You can get one by the end of the day. Legally, of course.
rows.translation: 你今天结束前就能弄到一张。以合法方式，当然。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can get one by the end of the day. Legally, of course."

rows.original: You hesitate a half-moment before nodding, lying with a silver tongue, “Absolutely.”
rows.translation: 你犹豫了半秒，随后点头，用三寸不烂之舌撒谎道：“当然有。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hesitate a half-moment before nodding, lying with a silver tongue, “Absolutely.”"

rows.original: You briefly hesitate, the answer coming swift after a moment of internal reflection, “Better. I’m a licensed kineticist. I can handle a gun if I can handle my own mind bullets. That's telekinesis, Carl.”
rows.translation: 你短暂犹豫，心中思量片刻后迅速给出答案：“有更好的。我是持证念动力者。连自己的意念子弹都能控制，枪当然不在话下。这叫念动力，卡尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou briefly hesitate, the answer coming swift after a moment of internal reflection, “Better. I’m a licensed kineticist. I can handle a gun if I can handle my own mind bullets. That's telekinesis, Carl.”"

rows.original: You nod disinterestedly. As if you were worried about UGC regulations on the unintegrated planets along the Rush’s rim!
rows.translation: 你漠不关心地点头。说得好像你会在乎星球大开发边缘那些未整合行星上的联合银河邦联规定！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod disinterestedly. As if you were worried about UGC regulations on the unintegrated planets along the Rush’s rim!"

rows.original: “Oh, good. Wouldn’t want this to get miss cousin in trouble with the sheriff, now. Here ya are.”
rows.translation: “哦，那就好。可不能让表妹因为这事惹上治安官。拿去吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, good. Wouldn’t want this to get miss cousin in trouble with the sheriff, now. Here ya are.”"

rows.original: You barely hide your eagerness as you reach forward, taking the mean piece of rifle in your hand. This is your gun. There are many like it, but this one is now yours.
rows.translation: 你伸手接过那把凶悍步枪，几乎掩饰不住急切。这是你的枪。世上有很多类似的枪，但这一把现在属于你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou barely hide your eagerness as you reach forward, taking the mean piece of rifle in your hand. This is your gun. There are many like it, but this one is now yours."

rows.original: Flirt
rows.translation: 调情
rows.raw: "Flirt"

rows.original: Magic Ted
rows.raw: "Magic Ted"

rows.original: Time for a little fun.
rows.translation: 该找点乐子了。

rows.original: Before you is a [silly|THICC|curvy], Amazonian zil woman in cutesy, pastel chef’s attire; she gives you a warm smile with her golden, insectile eyes and thick, comically serious-looking oval eyebrows. Her long chestnut hair is braided into charming twin tails that bob when she walks. Cute, stubby horns point out of the sides of her chef’s hat, though they would still sting if she were to headbutt you. Her bovine ears are white with chocolate brown spots. The dangerously sharp stinger at the end of her plump thorax has a pink ribbon tied around it, as if to make it less threatening. Even in her modest apron her sinfully decadent curves ooze with sexuality, the thick obsidian nipples on her big FF-cups peeking through the fabric; her natural chitinous armor is presumably unable to cover them as they endlessly leak with delicious honey. She always smells like a sugary sweet treat[pc.isTreated|, her pheromones slamming into your nose like a truck].[dulcie.fucked| Her honey is sweeter than the average zil’s, comparable more to a baked dessert than the more floral tang of other honey you’ve tasted.]

rows.original: “So what’s a zil like you doing in Esbeth? Especially a Treated one... [pc.isTreated|You look like one of us.|Aren’t you guys from a hidden village?]” Her smile fades. “Indeed. We are the ‘Bull Village’ now.” There’s an uncomfortable pause. “Our village used to be run by our women. My mother was the last chieftess. I was supposed to be the next leader of the tribe, but...” She chuckles somewhat pitifully. “I never preferred power. Not really the confrontational kind. My mother saw me as... a disappointment.” Another pause. “I actually did not mind the bulls, at first. Being bossed around and given a new body was... arousing, as much as I hate to admit it.” Her round face burns scarlet as she turns her gaze away indignantly, clearly embarrassed by her past. “They are real lightweights in reality. Then I was given a place to stay at the bar.” You look at her in amazement. “Woah.” “Yeah. rows.original: “Say, you can issue identity papers right?” you inquire. “Oh but of course,” Flahne chuckles, her cleavage threatening to spill out of her top as she leans forward. “Issuing and scrutinizing documents is like 70% of my job. Why do you ask, sugar? Need a copy of your birth certificate or something?” You clarify that you want to help a venus pitcher obtain travel documents, drawing an incredulous stare from her as you explain [venus.name]’s situation. “...I see. Well your friend isn’t eligible for a U.G.C passport since her species hasn’t been formally uplifted yet. Sorry, sugar, my hands are tied.” “There must be some other form of ID you can issue her.” Flahne exhales sharply. For a moment, the rhythmic tapping of her fingers on a keyboard is all you hear. “Okay, okay...she could apply for an Emergent Species Identity Card. But she would have to appear in person for psychometric and health evaluations. And there’s the application fee...” “Just how steep?” “Mhmm,” Flahne pauses, her eyes narrowing with satisfaction as she finishes off a lollipop. “Two-hundred and fifty credits.”

rows.original: The scientist’s face snaps up to regard you, and you nearly take a step back under his piercing, inhuman glare. He looked like a normal enough human, barring the blue hair, but his eyes are a piercing, almost glowing blue, wrapped around a pair of deep black slits that would look more at home on a feline than a human. “I suppose you must be here about the notice I posted on the bounty board, yes?”
rows.translation: 科学家猛然抬头看向你，那道锐利而非人的目光几乎逼得你后退一步。除了蓝色头发，他看起来还算是个普通人类；然而，他的眼睛呈锐利得近乎发光的蓝色，围绕着一对深黑竖瞳，比起人类，那双瞳孔显然更适合长在猫科动物脸上。“我猜你一定是为了我贴在悬赏板上的告示而来，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe scientist’s face snaps up to regard you, and you nearly take a step back under his piercing, inhuman glare. He looked like a normal enough human, barring the blue hair, but his eyes are a piercing, almost glowing blue, wrapped around a pair of deep black slits that would look more at home on a feline than a human. “I suppose you must be here about the notice I posted on the bounty board, yes?”"

rows.original: You nod, wondering what exactly the vague message meant.
rows.translation: 你点点头，心里好奇那则含糊不清的信息到底是什么意思。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, wondering what exactly the vague message meant."

rows.original: You say that you aren’t but would like to know more about it anyway.
rows.translation: 你说自己不是，但还是想了解一下。
rows.raw: "You say that you aren’t but would like to know more about it anyway."

rows.original: You nod, figuring you can score some cash even if you didn’t see his notice.
rows.translation: 你点点头，心想就算没看见他的告示，也能借此赚上一笔。
rows.raw: "You nod, figuring you can score some cash even if you didn’t see his notice."

rows.original: You nod confidently, expecting to make some quick cash off the obviously inept scientist.
rows.translation: 你自信地点点头，觉得能从这个显然不太靠谱的科学家身上轻松赚点快钱。
rows.raw: "You nod confidently, expecting to make some quick cash off the obviously inept scientist."

rows.original: He brushes a lock of brilliant azure behind his ear and smiles knowingly. “I knew someone on this backwater would come. You adventurous types barely even need a promise of money to go brave death and enslavement, right?” He chuckles and shakes his head. “Where are my manners, [pc.name]? I am Julian S. Haswell, senior Xenogen researcher here on Mhen’ga.”
rows.translation: 他把一绺亮丽的蔚蓝头发拨到耳后，露出心照不宣的笑容。“我就知道这个偏远地方会有人过来。你们这些冒险者就算没有金钱承诺，也几乎会主动去挑战死亡和奴役，对吧？”他轻笑着摇摇头。“瞧我这礼数，[pc.name]。我是朱利安·S·哈斯韦尔，异源生物科技驻门加的高级研究员。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe brushes a lock of brilliant azure behind his ear and smiles knowingly. “I knew someone on this backwater would come. You adventurous types barely even need a promise of money to go brave death and enslavement, right?” He chuckles and shakes his head. “Where are my manners, [pc.name]? I am Julian S. Haswell, senior Xenogen researcher here on Mhen’ga.”"

rows.original: Julian actually leans over his desk to shake your hand and grace you with a warm smile. “I got your name from my secretary, of course. Don’t let the busy scientist routine fool you, I am quite perceptive.” His expression turns thoughtful as he breaks contact with you and begins to pace back and forth. “To get to the crux of my quandry, I need samples of the local life for my research. It’s hard to synthesize new transformatives in a vacuum. Naturally occurring templates reduce development times exponentially.”
rows.translation: 朱利安竟然探身越过桌面与你握手，还赐予你一个温暖的笑容。“当然是我的秘书告诉了我你的名字。别被科学家忙碌的表象骗了，我的观察力相当敏锐。”他松开你的手，开始来回踱步，神情也变得若有所思。“直说我的难题吧，我需要当地生物的样本来进行研究。凭空合成新的转化物非常困难，而自然形成的模板能成倍缩短研发时间。”
rows.raw: "\n\nJulian actually leans over his desk to shake your hand and grace you with a warm smile. “I got your name from my secretary, of course. Don’t let the busy scientist routine fool you, I am quite perceptive.” His expression turns thoughtful as he breaks contact with you and begins to pace back and forth. “To get to the crux of my quandry, I need samples of the local life for my research. It’s hard to synthesize new transformatives in a vacuum. Naturally occurring templates reduce development times exponentially.”"

rows.original: You look at him and ask, “What kind of samples do you need exactly?”
rows.translation: 你看着他问道：“你究竟需要什么样的样本？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look at him and ask, “What kind of samples do you need exactly?”"

rows.original: “Good question, [pc.name],” Julian says with a sage nod. “To be specific, I need one of the locals subdued and brought here - one of the zil, to be specific. Their sexual excretions are an absolute gold-mine in the making, and I need more data to synthesize a proper product.” He points to a benign-looking box on his desk. “This is a capture harness. They’re illegal in most places... but not here. Yet. All you have to do is disable one of the zil and then throw the box at them. It will restrain them and summon a transport drone to bring them to our facilities here.”
rows.translation: “问得好，[pc.name]，”朱利安老成地点了点头。“具体来说，我需要有人制服一名当地居民并带到这里 - 确切地说，是一名泽尔。他们的性分泌物是一座亟待开采的绝对金矿，我需要更多数据才能合成出合适的产品。”他指向桌上一个外表无害的箱子。“这是捕获束具。在绝大多数地方都属于违禁品...但这里还不是。暂时还不是。你只要让一名泽尔失去反抗能力，再把箱子扔向对方。它会将目标束缚起来，并召来运输无人机，把目标送到我们这里的设施。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good question, [pc.name],” Julian says with a sage nod. “To be specific, I need one of the locals subdued and brought here - one of the zil, to be specific. Their sexual excretions are an absolute gold-mine in the making, and I need more data to synthesize a proper product.” He points to a benign-looking box on his desk. “This is a capture harness. They’re illegal in most places... but not here. Yet. All you have to do is disable one of the zil and then throw the box at them. It will restrain them and summon a transport drone to bring them to our facilities here.”"

rows.original: “Like, what’s a zil?” you ask.
rows.translation: “呃，泽尔是什么？”你问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Like, what’s a zil?” you ask."

rows.original: “Zil?” you ask.
rows.translation: “泽尔？”你问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Zil?” you ask."

rows.original: Julian cocks an eyebrow. “You must be new to Mhen’ga. The zil are bug-like humanoids native to this world. Not overly dangerous, though they do seem rather aggressive in their sexual copulations. They’re only rated as a class one threat. Any well-equipped explorer should be able to hold their own against them.” He spins the blocky capture harness around and looks back to you.
rows.translation: 朱利安挑起一边眉毛。“你一定刚来门加。泽尔是这个星球原生的一种昆虫型人形生物。危险性不算太高，不过他们在性交时似乎颇为好斗。威胁等级只有一级。任何装备精良的探险者都应该有能力对付他们。”他转了转那套方方正正的捕获束具，又望向你。
rows.raw: "\n\nJulian cocks an eyebrow. “You must be new to Mhen’ga. The zil are bug-like humanoids native to this world. Not overly dangerous, though they do seem rather aggressive in their sexual copulations. They’re only rated as a class one threat. Any well-equipped explorer should be able to hold their own against them.” He spins the blocky capture harness around and looks back to you."

rows.original: Julian smiles at you. “Surely you can appreciate what we can learn, regardless of the gray areas upon which we now tread, correct? There is only profit to be made here, friend, for both of us. One thousand credits worth, to be precise.”
rows.translation: 朱利安朝你微笑。“即使我们现在踏入了某些灰色地带，你肯定也能理解我们可以从中学到多少东西，对吧？朋友，这里只有利润等着我们两人去赚。准确来说，是价值一千信用点的利润。”
rows.raw: "\n\nJulian smiles at you. “Surely you can appreciate what we can learn, regardless of the gray areas upon which we now tread, correct? There is only profit to be made here, friend, for both of us. One thousand credits worth, to be precise.”"

rows.original: Seeing the worry in your eyes, Julian shakes his hands apologetically. <i>“It won’t be painful, I promise. If anything, quite the opposite. I simply need a few small tissue samples and large volumes of their sexual secretions for study, and then we’ll release them into the jungle. Surely a thousand

I simply need a few small tissue samples and large volumes of their sexual secretions for study, and then we’ll release them into the jungle. Surely a thousand "

rows.translation: 的报酬肯定能让你的良心好受一些。”

rows.original: The scientist looks at you as if your decision has already been made for you. Will you take the device and go capture a zil for him or refuse?
rows.translation: 科学家看着你，仿佛早已替你做完决定。你要接过装置，去为他捕获一名泽尔，还是拒绝？
rows.raw: " The scientist looks at you as if your decision has already been made for you. Will you take the device and go capture a zil for him or refuse?"

rows.translation: 接受
rows.raw: "Accept"

rows.translation: 拒绝
rows.raw: "Decline"

rows.original: You grab the capture harness and nod to the scientist. “I’ll do it.”
rows.translation: 你拿起捕获束具，对科学家点点头。“我接了。”
rows.raw: "You grab the capture harness and nod to the scientist. “I’ll do it.”"

rows.original: “Excellent!” Julian cheers. “Male or female will do. I need them both eventually. The credits will be transferred to your account as soon as we have the creature in custody. Now...” Julian seats himself, “if you’ll excuse me, there is a mountain of work to do and only one researcher to get it all done.” He turns back to his work, dismissing you without another word.
rows.translation: “太好了！”朱利安欢呼道。“雄性或雌性都行。反正我最终两种都需要。一旦生物落入我们手中，信用点就会转入你的账户。现在...”朱利安重新坐下，“如果你不介意，我这里有堆积如山的工作，却只有一名研究员来全部完成。”他转回去继续工作，一句话也没再说，直接把你晾在一旁。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Excellent!” Julian cheers. “Male or female will do. I need them both eventually. The credits will be transferred to your account as soon as we have the creature in custody. Now...” Julian seats himself, “if you’ll excuse me, there is a mountain of work to do and only one researcher to get it all done.” He turns back to his work, dismissing you without another word."

rows.original: “No thank you, Doctor,” you say with a shake of your head. “I’m not interested in a job like this.”
rows.translation: “不必了，谢谢，博士，”你摇着头说道。“我对这种工作不感兴趣。”
rows.raw: "“No thank you, Doctor,” you say with a shake of your head. “I’m not interested in a job like this.”"

rows.original: “Nah, I don’t think I’ll start a career as a slaver today, Doctor,” you say with a shake of your head. “I’m sure you can find someone else to do your dirty work.”
rows.translation: “不了，我今天可不打算投身奴隶贩子的事业，博士，”你摇着头说道。“我相信你能找到别人替你干这些脏活。”
rows.raw: "“Nah, I don’t think I’ll start a career as a slaver today, Doctor,” you say with a shake of your head. “I’m sure you can find someone else to do your dirty work.”"

rows.original: “Hahahaha, nope!” you laugh at the Doctor’s face. “This is some kinda police sting, isn’t it? Fucking entrapment! Look, I don’t give a shit about the natives, but I’m not gonna hang myself doing something this stupid. You want a zil, go talk to them yourself.”
rows.translation: “哈哈哈哈，免谈！”你当着博士的面笑了出来。“这是什么警方设下的圈套吧？他妈的诱捕执法！听着，我才不在乎这些土著，但也不会因为干这种蠢事把自己送上绞架。你想要泽尔，就自己去跟他们谈。”
rows.raw: "“Hahahaha, nope!” you laugh at the Doctor’s face. “This is some kinda police sting, isn’t it? Fucking entrapment! Look, I don’t give a shit about the natives, but I’m not gonna hang myself doing something this stupid. You want a zil, go talk to them yourself.”"

rows.original: “A pity,” Julian retorts. “Science will have to march on, I suppose. Do come back if you change your mind.” He seats himself and returns to work without another word.
rows.translation: “真遗憾，”朱利安反驳道。“我想，科学只能继续向前迈进了。如果你改变主意，欢迎再来。”他坐回原位，一言不发地继续工作。
rows.raw: "\n\n“A pity,” Julian retorts. “Science will have to march on, I suppose. Do come back if you change your mind.” He seats himself and returns to work without another word."

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.translation: 你暂时拒绝了这个提议。
rows.raw: "You decline the offer for now."

rows.original: Julian seems nonplussed by your admission but does not press you. He seats himself and resumes his work, having gotten enough from you already.
rows.translation: 朱利安似乎对你的坦白无动于衷，也没有继续逼问。他已经从你这里得到了足够的信息，于是坐回原位，继续自己的工作。
rows.raw: "\n\nJulian seems nonplussed by your admission but does not press you. He seats himself and resumes his work, having gotten enough from you already."

rows.translation: 你拿起那套熟悉而小巧的束具，向朱利安点了点头。
rows.raw: "Picking up the familiar, compact harness, you nod to Julian."

rows.original: “Fantastic! I can’t wait to have another subject in the lab.” He taps a key to open the door and seats himself, returning to his undoubtedly massive workload. “This is the beginning of a beautiful partnership, [pc.name],” he idly admits after settling in.
rows.translation: “太棒了！我已经迫不及待想在实验室里见到另一个实验对象了。”他按下按键打开门，随即坐回去，继续处理那份毫无疑问极为庞大的工作。“[pc.name]，这会是一段美好合作的开端，”坐定之后，他漫不经心地说道。

rows.translation: 书桌后坐着一名肤色苍白得惊人、几乎像白化病患者的人类，身下的悬浮椅正轻轻上下起伏。他似乎被电脑与闪烁的全息显示画面分去了注意力，不过想引起他的注意应该易如反掌。

rows.raw: " chest glows angrily, and you wonder just what you’re supposed to do now."

rows.original: That question is answered by the high-pitched whine of atmospheric engines. A sleek, metallic probe a little bigger than a jet-bike zips into the area and dangles a magnetic anchor, snapping it onto the square plate at the center of the harness. Looking very much like an insect in a spider’s trap, the zil is reeled in closer. The probe extends a number of intricately worked “legs” to wrap around its acquisition and immediately zips off, leaving you alone with your thoughts.
rows.translation: 大气层内引擎的高亢尖啸回答了这个问题。一台比喷气摩托稍大一些、线条流畅的金属探测器疾驰而来，垂下一枚磁性锚，啪地吸在束具中央的方形板上。泽尔看起来就像落入蛛网的昆虫，被慢慢卷近。探测器伸出数条结构精密的“腿”包裹住捕获物，随即飞速离去，只留下你独自思考。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat question is answered by the high-pitched whine of atmospheric engines. The probe extends a number of intricately worked “legs” to wrap around its acquisition and immediately zips off, leaving you alone with your thoughts."

rows.raw: "“Tell me how you got that scar,” you say, ladening your tones with cold authority. Kane tenses. You wait until, reluctantly, he looks you in the eye, and you make sure he sees you’re serious. “The truth, this time. I control you. Do as I say.”"

rows.original: The big zil stares back at you, resentment and barely controlled anger tensing his jaw and whitening his lips.
rows.translation: 高大的泽尔回瞪着你，怨恨与勉强压抑的愤怒绷紧了他的下颌，也让双唇失去血色。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe big zil stares back at you, resentment and barely controlled anger tensing his jaw and whitening his lips."

rows.original: “The very last time my brother visited here, I confronted him,” he says at last. The words sound like they are being torn from him by force. “I had tried everything to convince him to abandon his servitude to the landstealers. I used wisdom, as the Word-Wolf did. I tried to dominate him. I threatened him with disownment. I felt sure, I just had to find the right words, the right deeds... he was such a sissy, all through his life he had given in to me, about this he was so certain, but I thought it was only a matter of time before he caved and saw sense. I didn’t hate him, you know?!” Kane almost wails, grabbing at a tree trunk and ripping great hunks of bark off of it, brandishes them to the sky. “I wanted for us to be brothers again. That’s all I wanted.”
rows.translation: “我兄弟最后一次来这里时，我找他对质了，”他终于说道，那些话听起来像是被人硬生生从他嘴里扯出来。“为了让他放弃给夺地者当奴才，我什么办法都试过。我像言语之狼那样以智慧劝说，也试过压服他，还威胁要与他断绝关系。我当时深信，自己只需要找到正确的话语、正确的做法...他从小就是个软蛋，一辈子都对我言听计从。这件事上他虽然异常坚定，但我以为他迟早也会屈服，会想明白。我并不恨他，你明白吗？！”凯恩近乎哀号着抓住一棵树干，撕下大片树皮，朝天空挥舞。“我只想让我们重新成为兄弟。那就是我的全部心愿。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The very last time my brother visited here, I confronted him,” he says at last. The words sound like they are being torn from him by force. “I had tried everything to convince him to abandon his servitude to the landstealers. I used wisdom, as the Word-Wolf did. I tried to dominate him. I threatened him with disownment. I felt sure, I just had to find the right words, the right deeds... he was such a sissy, all through his life he had given in to me, about this he was so certain, but I thought it was only a matter of time before he caved and saw sense. I didn’t hate him, you know?!” Kane almost wails, grabbing at a tree trunk and ripping great hunks of bark off of it, brandishes them to the sky. “I wanted for us to be brothers again. That’s all I wanted.”"

rows.original: “That night, though.” Kane lifts his hands, lets the bark drop. “I lost control. I grabbed him, shook him, told him I was forbidding him from going back to work for those thieves, those fucking alien tyrants. Know what he did?” He stares at you, face wild with rage, and points at the scar. “Picked up a piece of flint and struck me across the face with it. Held it to my throat, and told me never to come near him again.”
rows.translation: “但就在那天晚上。”凯恩抬起双手，任由树皮落地。“我失去了控制。我抓住他，摇晃他，告诉他我禁止他回去给那些小偷、那些该死的外星暴君工作。你知道他做了什么吗？”他满脸狂怒地瞪着你，指向那道伤疤。“他捡起一块燧石，朝我脸上划了过去。然后抵住我的喉咙，叫我永远别再靠近他。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That night, though.” Kane lifts his hands, lets the bark drop. “I lost control. I grabbed him, shook him, told him I was forbidding him from going back to work for those thieves, those fucking alien tyrants. Know what he did?” He stares at you, face wild with rage, and points at the scar. “Picked up a piece of flint and struck me across the face with it. Held it to my throat, and told me never to come near him again.”"

rows.original: “And I never have,” he continues thickly, after several moments. “And I made a pact with myself. To never let anyone have that amount of control over me again. That is what I think about, whenever I see my reflection in the water. That, starwalker, is how I got this scar.” He glares at you, from beneath that tangled mop of hair. “Happy now?”
rows.translation: “而我从此再也没有靠近过他，”过了好一会儿，他声音滞涩地继续说道。“我也向自己立下誓约，绝不再让任何人对我拥有那种程度的掌控。每当在水中看见自己的倒影，我都会想到这件事。星行者，这就是我留下这道疤的经过。”他从那头纠结蓬乱的头发下怒视着你。“现在满意了？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And I never have,” he continues thickly, after several moments. “And I made a pact with myself. To never let anyone have that amount of control over me again. That is what I think about, whenever I see my reflection in the water. That, starwalker, is how I got this scar.” He glares at you, from beneath that tangled mop of hair. “Happy now?”"

rows.original: “A naleen hassled the outskirts of our village for a while,” Kane replies, poker-faced. “Different tribe to the waterfall group we’ve struck a pact with. Killed two younger zil and made off with a winter store of mangoes before I really got onto his case. He thought he was really smart, because he found a cache of honey somewhere and smeared it on himself before he went on his little raids, disguising his smell. Didn’t think to disguise the smell of mango, though.”
rows.translation: “曾经有一条纳林骚扰了我们村庄外围一段时间，”凯恩面无表情地回答。“不是我们与之结盟的瀑布部族。等我真正盯上他时，他已经杀了两个年轻泽尔，还抢走了过冬储备的芒果。他觉得自己特别聪明，因为不知从哪里找到了一批蜂蜜，每次出去袭击前都涂满全身，掩盖自己的气味。可他没想到还得掩盖芒果味。”
rows.raw: "“A naleen hassled the outskirts of our village for a while,” Kane replies, poker-faced. “Different tribe to the waterfall group we’ve struck a pact with. Killed two younger zil and made off with a winter store of mangoes before I really got onto his case. He thought he was really smart, because he found a cache of honey somewhere and smeared it on himself before he went on his little raids, disguising his smell. Didn’t think to disguise the smell of mango, though.”"

rows.original: He scratches his face, eyes far away.
rows.translation: 他挠了挠脸，目光投向遥远之处。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe scratches his face, eyes far away."

rows.original: “Got me really good with his claws just before we netted him and trussed him up, down in the funguses. Fought hard, I’ll give the fucker that. We brought enough honey to smear him properly, from mane to tail, and then we threw him into a big razor-mite pit.” He sighs happily. “I think about those screams whenever I’m having trouble getting to sleep.”
rows.translation: “我们在菌地里用网套住他、把他捆起来之前，他用爪子狠狠伤了我。那混蛋确实拼命反抗，这点我承认。我们带了足够的蜂蜜，从鬃毛到尾巴把他彻底涂满，然后扔进一个满是剃刀螨的大坑。”他幸福地叹了口气。“每当我睡不着时，就会回想那些惨叫。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Got me really good with his claws just before we netted him and trussed him up, down in the funguses. Fought hard, I’ll give the fucker that. We brought enough honey to smear him properly, from mane to tail, and then we threw him into a big razor-mite pit.” He sighs happily. “I think about those screams whenever I’m having trouble getting to sleep.”"

rows.original: “Quinn has not told you about the Great Pinse Hunt?” Kane replies, poker-faced. “That surprises me. Particularly as its skull hangs over her bed. Imagine the serpent part of a naleen, only 12 feet long. Now picture the head of a great sea beast, and many legs, like a crawling insect. That is a pinse. They are rare in these parts, so when we caught wind that one was migrating through the lower jungles almost all of us hunters got together and set out to vanquish it. Imagine the honor bestowed upon the one to deliver the killing blow to such a beast!”
rows.translation: “奎因没告诉过你那场大钳兽狩猎？”凯恩面无表情地回答。“真让我意外，尤其是那东西的头骨就挂在她床头。想象一下纳林的蛇身，只不过长达12英尺；再想象一头巨型海兽的脑袋，以及像爬虫一样的许多条腿。那就是钳兽。它们在这一带很罕见，所以当我们得知有一头正迁徙穿过下层丛林时，几乎所有猎人都聚在一起，出发讨伐它。想想看，对这样一头野兽施以致命一击的人会得到何等荣耀！”
rows.raw: "“Quinn has not told you about the Great Pinse Hunt?” Kane replies, poker-faced. “That surprises me. Particularly as its skull hangs over her bed. Imagine the serpent part of a naleen, only 12 feet long. Now picture the head of a great sea beast, and many legs, like a crawling insect. That is a pinse. They are rare in these parts, so when we caught wind that one was migrating through the lower jungles almost all of us hunters got together and set out to vanquish it. Imagine the honor bestowed upon the one to deliver the killing blow to such a beast!”"

rows.original: He scratches his face, eyes far away.
rows.translation: 他挠了挠脸，目光投向遥远之处。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe scratches his face, eyes far away."

rows.original: <i>“What a hunt that was. Through the ironwoods, far to the Eastern Swamps it drew us, always one step ahead. It knew we were following it, sometimes it doubled back and tried to surprise us, falling upon us with a roar that shook the boughs. It wounded some of us fiercely, others tired and had to go back, so that in the end it was just three of us, closing in on its watery lair.
rows.translation: <i>“那真是一场狩猎。它引着我们穿过铁木林，一路深入遥远的东部沼泽，始终领先一步。它知道我们在追踪，有时还会折返试图打我们一个措手不及，伴着震动树枝的咆哮扑向我们。它重伤了几个人，另一些人精疲力尽，不得不回去；到最后只剩下我们三人，逐渐逼近它的水中巢穴。
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“What a hunt that was. Through the ironwoods, far to the Eastern Swamps it drew us, always one step ahead. It knew we were following it, sometimes it doubled back and tried to surprise us, falling upon us with a roar that shook the boughs. It wounded some of us fiercely, others tired and had to go back, so that in the end it was just three of us, closing in on its watery lair."

rows.original: We had put a dozen arrows into it, we knew it could no longer flee. Nothing is more dangerous than such a creature when cornered.”
rows.translation: 我们已经往它身上射了十几箭，知道它再也逃不掉。这样的生物被逼入绝境时最为危险。”
rows.raw: "\n\nWe had put a dozen arrows into it, we knew it could no longer flee. Nothing is more dangerous than such a creature when cornered.”"

rows.original: He flicks his hand towards your face suddenly, close enough for you to feel the air, making you twitch.
rows.translation: 他突然朝你的脸挥了一下手，近得让你感受到气流，害你猛地一颤。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe flicks his hand towards your face suddenly, close enough for you to feel the air, making you twitch."

rows.original: “That’s how close it got - when it reared out of the water, both sets of teeth splayed. Cut me across the eye, but revealed its soft underbelly to me. I managed to fly backwards just as it fell back down, aiming to crush me with its last action upon this world.” He indicates with two fingers. “That much closer, and it would have taken my head clean off. Instead - the honor was all mine.”
rows.translation: “当时就是这么近 - 它从水中直立而起，两排牙齿全部张开。爪子划过我的眼睛，却也向我暴露了柔软腹部。它随即倒下，试图用自己在这个世界上的最后一个动作把我压死；我勉强及时向后飞开。”他用两根手指比划。“再近这么一点，我的脑袋就会被整个削掉。可结果是 - 全部荣耀都归我所有。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s how close it got - when it reared out of the water, both sets of teeth splayed. Cut me across the eye, but revealed its soft underbelly to me. I managed to fly backwards just as it fell back down, aiming to crush me with its last action upon this world.” He indicates with two fingers. “That much closer, and it would have taken my head clean off. Instead - the honor was all mine.”"

rows.original: “When the male zil of my tribe come of age, they embark together on a truth quest, into the caverns,” Kane replies, poker-faced. “You’ve seen the naleen caves - this whole mesa is riddled with such tunnels. You find the entrances and descend deep into the cool darkness, until you’re so far down you cannot see a thing, and you may hear the very heartbeat of the world, the deepest truth of them all. Then, perhaps, the zpirits will grant you a vision - or teach you a lesson. The sparkle fungus helps with this, of course.”
rows.translation: “我们部族的雄性泽尔成年时，会一起踏上真理之旅，进入洞穴，”凯恩面无表情地回答。“你见过纳林洞穴 - 这整片台地到处都是那样的隧道。找到入口，深入凉爽的黑暗，一直走到完全看不见任何东西的深处；在那里，你或许能听见世界本身的心跳，那是所有真理中最深的一层。然后，泽灵也许会赐予你异象 - 或是给你一个教训。当然，闪光菌也很有帮助。”
rows.raw: "“When the male zil of my tribe come of age, they embark together on a truth quest, into the caverns,” Kane replies, poker-faced. “You’ve seen the naleen caves - this whole mesa is riddled with such tunnels. You find the entrances and descend deep into the cool darkness, until you’re so far down you cannot see a thing, and you may hear the very heartbeat of the world, the deepest truth of them all. Then, perhaps, the zpirits will grant you a vision - or teach you a lesson. The sparkle fungus helps with this, of course.”"

rows.original: “Sparkle fungus.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sparkle fungus.”"

rows.original: “Yeah,” says Kane, tracing the line of the scar, lost in reminiscence. “It grows in damp patches in the lower jungle. Brew it with water and whistlegrass, drink a cup and you’ll see all sorts of things. Of course, once we were down deep in the caverns the other boys dared me into drinking three full cups. And because I was young and stupid, I did. Tripped and fell down a 30 foot drop believing I had become a vanae and was blind, cut my face and broke my wing. The others thought I was a goner. But I got out of there. Worst three hours of my life, but I climbed my way out of that sightless pit, inch by hallucinating inch.”
rows.translation: “没错，”凯恩说道，沿着疤痕的轮廓抚摸，沉浸在回忆中。“它生长在下层丛林的潮湿地块。用水和哨草一起煮，喝上一杯，你就会看见各种东西。当然，有一次我们深入洞穴后，其他男孩激我喝下整整三杯。那时的我又年轻又愚蠢，于是真的照做了。我以为自己变成了瓦奈，而且双眼失明，一脚踩空，从30英尺高处摔了下去，划伤脸，还折断了翅膀。其他人都以为我死定了。但我从那里逃了出去。那是我一生中最糟糕的三个小时，可我还是爬出了那个伸手不见五指的深坑，在幻觉中一寸又一寸向上攀爬。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah,” says Kane, tracing the line of the scar, lost in reminiscence. “It grows in damp patches in the lower jungle. Brew it with water and whistlegrass, drink a cup and you’ll see all sorts of things. Of course, once we were down deep in the caverns the other boys dared me into drinking three full cups. And because I was young and stupid, I did. Tripped and fell down a 30 foot drop believing I had become a vanae and was blind, cut my face and broke my wing. The others thought I was a goner. But I got out of there. Worst three hours of my life, but I climbed my way out of that sightless pit, inch by hallucinating inch.”"

rows.original: He smiles wryly.
rows.translation: 他苦笑起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe smiles wryly."

rows.original: “So yeah, the zpirits gave me my lesson. One of humility, of wariness - and the need, always, to rely upon one’s self.”
rows.translation: “所以，是的，泽灵给了我一个教训。要谦逊，要警惕 - 还要永远依靠自己。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So yeah, the zpirits gave me my lesson. One of humility, of wariness - and the need, always, to rely upon one’s self.”"

rows.original: “Are you ever going to tell me how you actually got that scar?” you ask,
rows.translation: “你究竟什么时候才肯告诉我，那道疤到底是怎么来的？”你问道，
rows.raw: "\n\n“Are you ever going to tell me how you actually got that scar?” you ask,"

rows.original: trying to keep the irritation out of your voice.
rows.translation: 努力不让恼火流露在语气中。
rows.raw: " trying to keep the irritation out of your voice."

rows.original: not bothering to keep the irritation out of your voice.
rows.translation: 完全不打算掩饰语气里的恼火。
rows.raw: " not bothering to keep the irritation out of your voice."

rows.original: “Or are you just going to tell me another lie every time?”
rows.translation: “还是说，你每次都只打算再编一个谎话骗我？”
rows.raw: " “Or are you just going to tell me another lie every time?”"

rows.original: “All of those things happened,” Kane replies, utterly unabashed. “I could have gotten it during any one of them. What does it matter? What you’re really asking when you ask that question is for me to tell you about myself, and I’ve done that.
rows.translation: “那些事全都发生过，”凯恩毫无愧色地回答。“这道疤可能是在其中任何一次留下的。有什么区别？你问这个问题时，真正想要的是让我说说自己，而我已经说了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“All of those things happened,” Kane replies, utterly unabashed. “I could have gotten it during any one of them. What does it matter? What you’re really asking when you ask that question is for me to tell you about myself, and I’ve done that."

rows.original: I don’t ask all that much about you. Know why?” He reaches out suddenly, pulling you into his strong, wiry arms, hands molding themselves into your [pc.ass] hungrily. “Because who you and I were doesn’t matter,” he growls. He kisses you roughly, hard lips rubbing against your own, tubular tongue invading your mouth, before pulling away again. “It’s what we will do together that’s truly important.”
rows.translation: 我并没有问你太多自己的事情。知道为什么吗？”他突然伸手，把你拉进强壮精瘦的双臂，双手饥渴地揉捏起你的[pc.ass]。“因为你我曾经是谁并不重要，”他低吼道。他粗暴地吻住你，坚硬的双唇摩擦着你的嘴唇，管状舌头侵入你口中，片刻后才再次退开。“我们将要一起做什么，才真正重要。”
rows.raw: " I don’t ask all that much about you. Know why?” He reaches out suddenly, pulling you into his strong, wiry arms, hands molding themselves into your [pc.ass] hungrily. “Because who you and I were doesn’t matter,” he growls. He kisses you roughly, hard lips rubbing against your own, tubular tongue invading your mouth, before pulling away again. “It’s what we will do together that’s truly important.”"

rows.original: Those stories entertained you. That is all you wanted. That is all I’m willing to give.” He finishes curtly, clearly wishing the conversation to be over. Maybe if you really asserted yourself upon him, you could force him to spill the beans...
rows.translation: 那些故事逗你开心了。你想要的不过如此，而我愿意给的也仅此而已。”他生硬地结束话题，显然希望这段对话到此为止。 也许只要真正向他展示自己的强势，你就能逼他吐露真相...
rows.raw: " Those stories entertained you. That is all you wanted. That is all I’m willing to give.” He finishes curtly, clearly wishing the conversation to be over.\n\nMaybe if you really asserted yourself upon him, you could force him to spill the beans..."

rows.translation: 疤痕
rows.raw: "The Scar"

rows.original: Ask how he got it.
rows.translation: 询问疤痕是怎么来的。
rows.raw: "Ask how he got it."

rows.original: Quinn
rows.translation: 奎因
rows.raw: "Quinn"

rows.original: Quinn
rows.translation: 奎因
rows.raw: "Quinn"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “What do you think of Quinn?”
rows.translation: “你怎么看奎因？”
rows.raw: "“What do you think of Quinn?”"

rows.original: “Better than some leaders I can remember. But she thinks she’s smarter than she is,” Kane replies insouciantly, leant back against his tree. “Let herself be tricked by the Word-Wolf, and then by you. She listens to pretty sounding truths in the moment, rather than the deep truths that run below. That’s just her female nature, as much as she tries to deny it.”
rows.translation: “比我记得的一些领袖强。不过她以为自己比实际更聪明，”凯恩漫不经心地回答，倚靠在树上。“先是让言语之狼耍得团团转，后来又被你欺骗。她只听当下那些悦耳的真理，却不听深藏在表面之下的真理。无论她多么想否认，这就是她的雌性本能。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Better than some leaders I can remember. But she thinks she’s smarter than she is,” Kane replies insouciantly, leant back against his tree. “Let herself be tricked by the Word-Wolf, and then by you. She listens to pretty sounding truths in the moment, rather than the deep truths that run below. That’s just her female nature, as much as she tries to deny it.”"

rows.original: “Better than some leaders I can remember. She has taken control of this tribe, sheltered the Word-Wolf, and followed this war through admirably,” Kane replies. “You cannot ask much more of a Quinn. But... things shall change. She isn’t reliable. No female leader is, ultimately.”
rows.translation: “比我记得的一些领袖强。她掌控了这个部族，庇护言语之狼，也令人钦佩地把这场战争坚持到了最后，”凯恩回答。“对一位奎因，你很难要求更多。但...事情会改变。她靠不住。说到底，任何女性领袖都靠不住。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Better than some leaders I can remember. She has taken control of this tribe, sheltered the Word-Wolf, and followed this war through admirably,” Kane replies. “You cannot ask much more of a Quinn. But... things shall change. She isn’t reliable. No female leader is, ultimately.”"

rows.original: He doesn’t think women should be leaders, you take it.
rows.translation: 看来，他认为女人不该成为领袖。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe doesn’t think women should be leaders, you take it."

rows.original: “I don’t know how things work for starwalkers. Perhaps what I just said is insulting to you,” the wasp returns, in a tone that spells out exactly how much he cares about that. “All I know is how it is for zil. Females are just as smart and fierce and able as males when they are young, yes - but once they kindle, things change. They become doey-eyed for their mate, the scent-link does that, and they lose their killer instinct. They can no longer conquer and dominate, no longer want to. They seek peace and succor for their young above all else, and so wind up being dominated themselves.”

rows.original: “My brother started calling me it, when he first became a slave to the landstealers,” he replies. “Before then, I was Leads-Hunt-Far. He got that name, Able, off the landstealers, and... I think he meant it as a joke.” He snorts, shrugging. “I made him explain it to me. Some old starwalker myth about two brothers, one favored by the zpirits, the other made jealous by it. Of course, that was the kind of thing he loved, didn’t he? The landstealers were a blessing in his mind, and if we’d all just get on our knees for them too, we’d be all favoured sons as well.” He laughs contemptuously. “Sissy idiot. But warriors are defined by their enemies. And if mine decides I am the vengeful brother, someone who spites their power and favors... very well. I can play that role they have so carelessly handed me. It pleases me.”
rows.translation: “我兄弟刚开始给夺地者当奴隶时，就开始这样叫我，”他回答。“在那之前，我叫远引猎途。他从夺地者那里得到了艾布尔这个名字，而且...我想他是把它当成了一个笑话。”他哼了一声，耸耸肩。“我逼他给我解释过。是某个星行者的古老神话，讲述两个兄弟，一个受到泽灵眷顾，另一个因此心生嫉妒。当然，他就是喜欢那种东西，不是吗？在他心里，夺地者是一种恩赐，只要我们也向他们屈膝，就都能成为备受宠爱的儿子。”他轻蔑地笑了。“软弱的蠢货。但战士由自己的敌人定义。如果我的敌人认定我是那个复仇的兄弟，是蔑视他们力量与恩宠的人...那也很好。我可以扮演他们如此轻率地塞给我的角色。我很满意。”

rows.raw: "\n\n“So Able used to live here?” you ask."

rows.original: “Yeah. Quiet-Breeze, as he was then.” Kane shifts restlessly against the tree he’s leaning against. “You’ve met him, haven’t you? You know what he’s like. He was zipping back and forth from there to here in that stupid sack they gave him to wear, trying to make us all be friends.” He fans his hands underneath his chin and speaks in a mockingly high voice. “‘They didn’t know it was our land! I’m sure they’ll be reasonable if you just talk to them! They’ll give you a stupid sack to wear too!’” His voice curdles in disgust. “I chased him out, in the end. Couldn’t bear looking at what he’d become anymore.”
rows.translation: “对。那时他叫静谧微风。”凯恩不安地靠着身后的树挪动。“你见过他，对吧？你知道他是什么样。他穿着那些人给他的愚蠢布袋，在两边来回乱窜，想让我们所有人都成为朋友。”他在下巴下方扇动双手，换成嘲弄的尖细嗓音。“‘他们不知道那是我们的土地！只要你们跟他们谈谈，他们肯定会讲道理！他们也会给你一件愚蠢的布袋穿！’”他的声音因厌恶而变得刺耳。“最后我把他赶了出去。我再也无法忍受看见他变成的样子。”

rows.original: “No!” snaps Kane, face darkening even further. “We still aim to drive the landstealers away. And he betrayed his kind for them, willingly became a slave to those who would make us all slaves, take away our world from beneath us. He traded his tribe and family for whatever crumbs off the table the landstealers let fall, and by that bargain he can live the rest of his life.”

rows.translation: 他这样做时出了很大力气 - 这或许是转入进攻的好机会...
rows.raw: " He’s exerting himself pretty hard doing that - this might be the opportunity to press the offensive..."

rows.original: It’s tough as fuck keeping yourself upright against this assault. Perhaps a trick would make him stop...
rows.translation: 在这场冲击下保持站立简直他妈的困难。也许用点花招能让他停下来...
rows.raw: " It’s tough as fuck keeping yourself upright against this assault. Perhaps a trick would make him stop..."

rows.original: The zil equals your own pressure, side-stepping back and forth shoulder to shoulder with you, growling and chuckling harshly in your ear.
rows.translation: 泽尔以同等力量与你对抗，肩膀紧贴着你左右踏步，在你耳边粗声低吼轻笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zil equals your own pressure, side-stepping back and forth shoulder to shoulder with you, growling and chuckling harshly in your ear."

rows.original: This is surely a prelude to him trying to trip you. If you watched out for that, it would be a plum chance to trip him back...
rows.translation: 这显然是准备绊倒你的前兆。如果留意他的动作，就会得到反过来绊倒他的绝佳机会...
rows.raw: " This is surely a prelude to him trying to trip you. If you watched out for that, it would be a plum chance to trip him back..."

rows.original: Maybe if you suddenly heaved his arm, you’d unbalance him...
rows.translation: 也许突然猛拉他的手臂，就能让他失去平衡...
rows.raw: " Maybe if you suddenly heaved his arm, you’d unbalance him..."

rows.original: Kane flexes his muscles... and in the same instant you switch both hands to his arm, hauling him completely off balance as he tries to turn you the other way. You heave him off of his feet!
rows.translation: 凯恩绷紧肌肉...就在同一瞬间，你把双手都移到他的手臂上；他试图把你转向另一边时，你猛力一拽，让他彻底失去平衡。你直接把他掀离地面！
rows.raw: "Kane flexes his muscles... and in the same instant you switch both hands to his arm, hauling him completely off balance as he tries to turn you the other way. You heave him off of his feet!"

rows.original: You slam him into the ground with a punishing, chitin-cracking thump. No way he’s getting back up after that.
rows.translation: 你把他狠狠砸向地面，发出足以震裂几丁质的沉重闷响。他绝不可能再爬起来。
rows.raw: " You slam him into the ground with a punishing, chitin-cracking thump. No way he’s getting back up after that."

rows.original: He manages to recover, snarling as he swings back around to grab at your shoulder, but you can see in his face he’s shook by that sudden reverse.
rows.translation: 他设法恢复过来，低吼着转回身，一把抓向你的肩膀；但你能从他脸上看出，这次突然反制让他着实受惊。
rows.raw: " He manages to recover, snarling as he swings back around to grab at your shoulder, but you can see in his face he’s shook by that sudden reverse."

rows.original: You suddenly shove forward, and after only a couple moments of heated, snarling resistance, Kane caves!
rows.translation: 你突然向前猛推。仅仅经过片刻激烈的低吼抵抗，凯恩就屈服了！
rows.raw: "You suddenly shove forward, and after only a couple moments of heated, snarling resistance, Kane caves!"

rows.original: You follow through, pedalling him backwards until he trips and you tackle him to the ground. He’s down.
rows.translation: 你顺势继续进逼，踩着步子把他不断向后推，直到他绊倒，你也随之把他扑倒在地。他倒下了。
rows.raw: " You follow through, pedalling him backwards until he trips and you tackle him to the ground. He’s down."

rows.original: He manages to recover after an exhilarating back pedal, digging his heels into the ground and stopping your forward momentum with a throaty, defiant growl, but you can see in the shiver of his arms that you’ve burned through a lot of his energy doing that.
rows.translation: 令人振奋地连退几步后，他终于设法稳住身体，脚跟深深踩进地面，喉中发出挑衅的低吼，挡住了你向前的势头；但从他手臂的颤抖就能看出，这次抵抗消耗了他大量体力。
rows.raw: " He manages to recover after an exhilarating back pedal, digging his heels into the ground and stopping your forward momentum with a throaty, defiant growl, but you can see in the shiver of his arms that you’ve burned through a lot of his energy doing that."

rows.original: Kane flicks his leg at you... and you easily sidestep it, whipping your [pc.leg] at his standing leg at the same time.
rows.translation: 凯恩朝你扫腿...你轻松侧步避开，同时甩出自己的[pc.leg]，踢向他支撑身体的腿。
rows.raw: "Kane flicks his leg at you... and you easily sidestep it, whipping your [pc.leg] at his standing leg at the same time."

rows.original: He emits a surprised, rough squawk as you take him out cleanly. You smack him to the grass as cleanly as any martial arts master. This contest is over!
rows.translation: 你干净利落地扫倒他，令他发出惊愕粗哑的叫声。你像任何一位武术大师那样漂亮地把他摔上草地。这场较量结束了！
rows.raw: " He emits a surprised, rough squawk as you take him out cleanly. You smack him to the grass as cleanly as any martial arts master. This contest is over!"

rows.original: The armored limb buckles, and for a moment you think you’ll be able to clean him out entirely... but he recovers in the next instant, surging back into your arms with a defiant cry. Still, you definitely spooked him, and his knee is still probably feeling that.
rows.translation: 覆甲的肢体猛然弯曲，有那么一刻，你以为自己能彻底放倒他...可下一瞬间他便恢复过来，发出不服输的喊声，再次冲进你的双臂。不过，你肯定吓到了他，而且他的膝盖多半还在隐隐作痛。
rows.raw: " The armored limb buckles, and for a moment you think you’ll be able to clean him out entirely... but he recovers in the next instant, surging back into your arms with a defiant cry. Still, you definitely spooked him, and his knee is still probably feeling that."

rows.original: Kane flexes his muscles... and in the same instant you switch both hands to his arm, hauling him completely off balance as he tries to turn you the other way. You don’t quite have the panache to turn it into a real reverse - he almost immediately swings back around, grabbing your shoulder hard in order to regain balance - but at least you blocked his move.
rows.translation: 凯恩绷紧肌肉...就在同一瞬间，你把双手都移到他的手臂上；他试图把你转向另一边时，你猛力一拽，让他彻底失去平衡。你没能漂亮地完成真正的反摔 - 他几乎立刻转回身，用力抓住你的肩膀恢复平衡 - 但至少你挡住了他的招式。
rows.raw: "Kane flexes his muscles... and in the same instant you switch both hands to his arm, hauling him completely off balance as he tries to turn you the other way. You don’t quite have the panache to turn it into a real reverse - he almost immediately swings back around, grabbing your shoulder hard in order to regain balance - but at least you blocked his move."

rows.original: You suddenly shove forward, and after only a couple moments of heated, snarling resistance, Kane caves! He manages to recover after an exhilarating back pedal, digging his heels into the ground and stopping your forward momentum with a throaty, defiant growl. Still, you stopped him from overpowering you.
rows.translation: 你突然向前猛推。仅仅经过片刻激烈的低吼抵抗，凯恩就屈服了！令人振奋地连退几步后，他终于设法稳住身体，脚跟深深踩进地面，喉中发出挑衅的低吼，挡住了你向前的势头。不过，你还是阻止了他压倒你。
rows.raw: "You suddenly shove forward, and after only a couple moments of heated, snarling resistance, Kane caves! He manages to recover after an exhilarating back pedal, digging his heels into the ground and stopping your forward momentum with a throaty, defiant growl. Still, you stopped him from overpowering you."

rows.original: Kane flicks his leg at you... and you easily sidestep it, whipping your [pc.leg] at his standing leg at the same time. Unfortunately, you don’t have the strength to carry the move out cleanly - your [pc.leg] merely tangles with his, and after a clumsy scuffle you both regain balance. Still, the main thing is you stopped him from tripping you.
rows.translation: 凯恩朝你扫腿...你轻松侧步避开，同时甩出自己的[pc.leg]，踢向他支撑身体的腿。可惜你的力量不足，没能干净利落地完成动作 - [pc.leg]只与他的腿纠缠在一起，一番笨拙扭打后，你们都重新站稳。不过最重要的是，你阻止了他绊倒你。
rows.raw: "Kane flicks his leg at you... and you easily sidestep it, whipping your [pc.leg] at his standing leg at the same time. Unfortunately, you don’t have the strength to carry the move out cleanly - your [pc.leg] merely tangles with his, and after a clumsy scuffle you both regain balance. Still, the main thing is you stopped him from tripping you."

rows.original: You prepare to really put the hurt on him... and then suddenly he’s swinging nimbly to one side, hauling you forwards with a frightening strong surge, sending you flying into a tree trunk!
rows.translation: 你准备让他狠狠吃点苦头...可他突然灵巧地摆向一侧，以强得惊人的爆发力将你向前扯去，害你整个人飞向一根树干！
rows.raw: "You prepare to really put the hurt on him... and then suddenly he’s swinging nimbly to one side, hauling you forwards with a frightening strong surge, sending you flying into a tree trunk!"

rows.original: Your forehead makes firm contact with the wood, and the whole world shudders, turns upside down with pain. You try and regain your balance, and collapse to the turf instead with a nauseous groan.
rows.translation: 你的前额结结实实撞上木头，整个世界为之一颤，在痛苦中翻转。你试图恢复平衡，结果却伴着恶心的呻吟瘫倒在草地上。
rows.raw: " Your forehead makes firm contact with the wood, and the whole world shudders, turns upside down with pain. You try and regain your balance, and collapse to the turf instead with a nauseous groan."

rows.original: You smack the side of your head against the wood, a star-flecked wave of pain crashing into you. You stagger back around woozily, manage to regain a hold on Kane before he can finish you... but you doubt you can take another blow like that again.
rows.translation: 你的头侧撞上木头，点点星光夹杂着痛苦浪潮冲击全身。你昏沉地踉跄转身，总算在凯恩给你最后一击之前重新抓住他...但你怀疑自己再也承受不了另一下这样的撞击。
rows.raw: " You smack the side of your head against the wood, a star-flecked wave of pain crashing into you. You stagger back around woozily, manage to regain a hold on Kane before he can finish you... but you doubt you can take another blow like that again."

rows.original: You try and counter him... and he easily steps through it, batting away your attempt to stop his charge. Your heart leaps into your throat as you feel yourself being powerfully borne backwards.
rows.translation: 你试图反制他...他却轻松跨过你的阻挡，挥开你试图制止冲锋的动作。感觉自己被强大力量向后推去时，你的心猛地提到嗓子眼。
rows.raw: "You try and counter him... and he easily steps through it, batting away your attempt to stop his charge. Your heart leaps into your throat as you feel yourself being powerfully borne backwards."

rows.original: You stumble, then trip backwards, and with a howl of triumph, Kane forcibly bears you to the ground with a winding thump. You try and wriggle your way out of his iron grip and find you can’t do it - not anymore.
rows.translation: 你先是踉跄，随后向后绊倒；凯恩发出胜利嚎叫，强行把你压倒在地，撞得你喘不过气。你试图扭动身体挣脱他的铁腕，却发现自己已经做不到了 - 再也做不到了。
rows.raw: " You stumble, then trip backwards, and with a howl of triumph, Kane forcibly bears you to the ground with a winding thump. You try and wriggle your way out of his iron grip and find you can’t do it - not anymore."

rows.original: You manage to recover before he manages to carry you to the ground, gritting your teeth and digging great clumps of grass out of the ground with your [pc.feet]. But boy oh boy, you doubt you can weather another charge like that.
rows.translation: 在他成功将你压倒之前，你设法稳住身体，咬紧牙关，用[pc.feet]从地上掀起大团草皮。可天啊，你怀疑自己还能不能再扛住一次这样的冲锋。
rows.raw: " You manage to recover before he manages to carry you to the ground, gritting your teeth and digging great clumps of grass out of the ground with your [pc.feet]. But boy oh boy, you doubt you can weather another charge like that."

rows.original: You put your weight down, preparing to put a stop to his antics... and he neatly steps forward and swipes your [pc.legs] from under you!
rows.translation: 你沉下重心，准备制止他的花招...他却利落地向前一步，从下方一扫，让你的[pc.legs]失去支撑！
rows.raw: "You put your weight down, preparing to put a stop to his antics... and he neatly steps forward and swipes your [pc.legs] from under you!"

rows.original: The world turns upside down, and you land on the turf with a winding thud. Kane is immediately on top of you, pushing your wrists to the ground, and you find you simply don’t have the strength to push him off. It’s over.
rows.translation: 世界上下翻转，你沉重地摔在草地上，撞得喘不过气。凯恩立刻压到你身上，把双腕按向地面；你发现自己根本没有力量推开他。结束了。
rows.raw: " The world turns upside down, and you land on the turf with a winding thud. Kane is immediately on top of you, pushing your wrists to the ground, and you find you simply don’t have the strength to push him off. It’s over."

rows.original: You go sprawling, but just about manage to regain your [pc.feet] before he can bear you to the ground. Your nerves are shot, though - your muscles are shivering. You really hope he doesn’t pull that off again.
rows.translation: 你摔得四仰八叉，却勉强在他把你压倒前重新站稳[pc.feet]。不过你的神经已经绷到极限 - 肌肉也在颤抖。你真希望他别再成功使出这一招。
rows.raw: " You go sprawling, but just about manage to regain your [pc.feet] before he can bear you to the ground. Your nerves are shot, though - your muscles are shivering. You really hope he doesn’t pull that off again."

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: You throw your weight against the big, athletic zil, struggling and straining against him, the two of you spidering around the clearing, your [pc.feet] digging into the dirt, back and forth.
rows.translation: 你把全身重量压向高大矫健的泽尔，与他竭力角力；你们两人在空地上来回绕行，如蜘蛛般挪动，[pc.feet]深深踩进泥土。
rows.raw: "You throw your weight against the big, athletic zil, struggling and straining against him, the two of you spidering around the clearing, your [pc.feet] digging into the dirt, back and forth."

rows.original: He may be considerably smaller than you, but that doesn’t seem to deter him one bit; he’s stronger than his size suggests and is constantly shifting his grip and hold, refusing to let you use your bulk to overwhelm him.
rows.translation: 他的体型或许比你小得多，但这丝毫没有令他退缩；他的力量远超身材给人的印象，而且不断变换抓握与钳制方式，不让你利用体格将他压倒。
rows.raw: " He may be considerably smaller than you, but that doesn’t seem to deter him one bit; he’s stronger than his size suggests and is constantly shifting his grip and hold, refusing to let you use your bulk to overwhelm him."

rows.original: The two of you are well matched in size, roughly equal in terms of range and weight, and within a few moments you know you won’t win based on those attributes alone.
rows.translation: 你们两人的体型旗鼓相当，身高与体重大致相等；短短片刻，你便明白仅凭这些条件无法取胜。
rows.raw: " The two of you are well matched in size, roughly equal in terms of range and weight, and within a few moments you know you won’t win based on those attributes alone."

rows.original: You have to throw every sinew into stopping the considerably bigger creature from simply overwhelming you. This will be a tough, tough battle for someone of your diminutive size, something Kane was probably counting on.
rows.translation: 你必须调动每一丝力量，才能阻止这个体型大得多的生物轻易压倒自己。对你这样身材娇小的人来说，这会是一场极其艰难的战斗，而凯恩很可能正是看准了这一点。
rows.raw: " You have to throw every sinew into stopping the considerably bigger creature from simply overwhelming you. This will be a tough, tough battle for someone of your diminutive size, something Kane was probably counting on."

rows.original: Your eyes sting with sweat and your muscles burn with exertion. You can’t take much more of this...
rows.translation: 汗水刺痛你的双眼，肌肉也因用力而灼痛。你已经撑不了多久了...
rows.raw: " Your eyes sting with sweat and your muscles burn with exertion. You can’t take much more of this..."

rows.original: The grin on Kane’s face has been wiped from his face and he is now wrestling you with everything he’s got left in the tank, his long, strong limbs quivering with effort.
rows.translation: 凯恩脸上的笑容已经消失，现在正用尽最后的全部力量与你角力，修长有力的四肢因竭力而颤抖。
rows.raw: " The grin on Kane’s face has been wiped from his face and he is now wrestling you with everything he’s got left in the tank, his long, strong limbs quivering with effort."

rows.original: Arm Grab
rows.raw: "Arm Grab"

rows.original: Push
rows.raw: "Push"

rows.original: Trip
rows.raw: "Trip"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: Whoops
rows.translation: 哎呀
rows.raw: "Whoops"

rows.original: Kane Machine Broke
rows.translation: 凯恩机器坏了
rows.raw: "Kane Machine Broke"

rows.original: We’re so sorry about this. Please report.
rows.translation: 对此我们万分抱歉。请报告这个问题。
rows.raw: "We’re so sorry about this. Please report."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The intense smell of him - wild honey, sexual and demanding - is overwhelming when he’s got you clinched like this, practically trying to rut you into submission. The sugary, suggestive smell pokes your deepest impulses, begging you to give in and let the lovely-smelling creature do with you as he may.
rows.translation: 他把你牢牢钳住时，那股强烈气味 - 野性、充满性欲而又咄咄逼人的蜂蜜香 - 变得压倒一切，仿佛他正试图以发情交配逼你屈服。甜蜜而充满暗示的气味挑动你最深处的冲动，诱求你放弃抵抗，任由这个气味美妙的生物随意摆布。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe intense smell of him - wild honey, sexual and demanding - is overwhelming when he’s got you clinched like this, practically trying to rut you into submission. The sugary, suggestive smell pokes your deepest impulses, begging you to give in and let the lovely-smelling creature do with you as he may."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: You stand over the strong, wiry insect boy, chest heaving and wings quivering in the dirt, ready at the first sign of resistance to hand out another whupping. When he does finally look up at you, though, you see the expression of a beaten dog, resentful and fearful. You relax.
rows.translation: 你站在强壮精瘦的昆虫男孩身前；他胸膛剧烈起伏，翅膀在泥土中颤抖，而你已经做好准备，只要出现一丝反抗迹象，就再狠狠教训他一顿。不过，当他终于抬头看你时，你看见的却是一条败犬般的表情，既怨恨又恐惧。你放松下来。
rows.raw: "You stand over the strong, wiry insect boy, chest heaving and wings quivering in the dirt, ready at the first sign of resistance to hand out another whupping. When he does finally look up at you, though, you see the expression of a beaten dog, resentful and fearful. You relax."

rows.original: “Fine,” he growls, pulling himself up into a kneel. “Fine. Whatever you want - we shall do, starwalker. You have earned that right. For now.”
rows.translation: “好吧，”他低吼着撑起身体，跪在地上。“好吧。无论你想要什么 - 我们都会照做，星行者。你赢得了这份权利。暂时如此。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fine,” he growls, pulling himself up into a kneel. “Fine. Whatever you want - we shall do, starwalker. You have earned that right. For now.”"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: Your body is ablaze with sweet, pheromonal need, you can’t think of anything but how much your [pc.groin] needs some manual relief... and suddenly it’s all you can do. Your hands tremble out of Kane’s, dive down to your groin, and a moment later you’re squatted on the grass, shamelessly moaning as you masturbate furiously, desperate to get the sugary heat out of you.
rows.translation: 你的身体被甜蜜的信息素需求点燃，脑中只剩[pc.groin]多么需要用手缓解...而你突然也只能这么做。你的双手颤抖着挣脱凯恩，猛地探向胯间；片刻后，你已经蹲在草地上疯狂自慰，无耻地呻吟，绝望地想把那股甜腻热意排出体外。
rows.raw: "Your body is ablaze with sweet, pheromonal need, you can’t think of anything but how much your [pc.groin] needs some manual relief... and suddenly it’s all you can do. Your hands tremble out of Kane’s, dive down to your groin, and a moment later you’re squatted on the grass, shamelessly moaning as you masturbate furiously, desperate to get the sugary heat out of you."

rows.original: The zil simply watches, smirkingly enjoying the fruits of his victory.
rows.translation: 泽尔只是静静看着，坏笑着享受自己胜利的果实。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zil simply watches, smirkingly enjoying the fruits of his victory."

rows.original: A victorious growl is pushed out of Kane’s heaving chest when he sees that you can no longer carry on fighting.
rows.translation: 看见你已经无法继续战斗，凯恩剧烈起伏的胸膛中挤出一声胜利低吼。
rows.raw: "A victorious growl is pushed out of Kane’s heaving chest when he sees that you can no longer carry on fighting."

rows.original: “Going to see sense now?” he asks, looming over you. “Now you have been driven into the dirt. Go on, let me here you say it. Who is your dominant?”
rows.translation: “现在愿意认清道理了吗？”他居高临下地问道。“现在你已经被打进泥土里了。来吧，让我听你说出来。谁是你的支配者？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Going to see sense now?” he asks, looming over you. “Now you have been driven into the dirt. Go on, let me here you say it. Who is your dominant?”"

rows.original: “You are,” you have to say. “...Sir.”
rows.translation: “是你，”你不得不说道。“...主人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You are,” you have to say. “...Sir.”"

rows.original: “Good.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good.”"

rows.original: He lets you get back up
rows.translation: 他让你重新站起来
rows.raw: "\n\nHe lets you get back up"

rows.original: once you’re done,
rows.translation: ，等你结束以后
rows.raw: " once you’re done,"
