rows.original: You ask Mia about herself. “Me? I’m Mia.” You give her a look, which prompts a laugh from the vanae-morph. “Let me finish, you goof. I’m a xenobotanist and I got here... a while ago. I don’t remember how long, actually. Doesn’t matter much to me. Time flies when you have fun.” “I’ve always dreamed of the lifestyle I live out right now. You know, bouncing planet to planet. Go out into the wild, record some plants, come back to a nice bar and then write up a paper about whatever new flora I find on my adventures. I feel almost tempted to make a blog about all the other stuff that happens to me. You know, the more ‘adult’ antics.” “Though I gotta say, the best part is all the people I’ve bumped into. I didn’t expect to get as much support as I’ve had. See, I grew up in a strict household. The kind of place where parents condition you for a mundane life and make it apparent they’d only accept you if you had one.” Mia pauses and takes a slow slip of her drink. “Eh, we’re fine now! Don’t worry! rows.original: You keep silent, allowing her to cool off with another gulp from her mug before she continues. “So, there I was, stuck here with not too much more than what I had on my back and in my carry bags. I certainly didn’t have a lot of credits left, but fortunately, flats in a frontier town come cheap. So I started looking for a job; I figured there had to be someone here who could and would hire me. And of course, I was right,” she smirks, buffing her nails on her breast’s fur. “Xenogen was looking for a receptionist, and I was the first one to get my foot in the door. And so I’ve been here ever since; modding myself with spare savings, and building up my credits until the day comes I can buy a new ship and take off on my own again.” She sighs wistfully at the thought.
rows.translation: 你保持沉默，让她从杯中又喝下一大口，冷静以后才继续。“所以我就这么被困在这里，身上和随身包里没剩多少东西。当然也没剩多少信用点，不过幸好边境小镇的公寓很便宜。于是我开始找工作；我觉得这里肯定有人能够而且愿意雇用我。当然，事实证明我没错，”她坏笑着，在乳房的毛皮上擦亮指甲。“异源生物科技当时正在招聘前台，而我是第一个成功迈进门槛的人。从此以后，我就一直待在这里；用多余积蓄改造自己，不断积攒信用点，直到有一天能买一艘新飞船，再次独自出发。”想到这里，她向往地叹息。

rows.raw: "\n\nShe went through a lot, that’s for sure. You tap her arm comfortingly and tell her that once you get to the bottom, the only way left is up. Plus she doesn’t seem to be the type to let the world kick her about."

rows.original: “You got that right, buster; when life kicks me, I kick it right back!” she cheers. Then she looks at you and smiles. “But it’s nice to hear some support, now and then, so... thanks. Well, enough about where I came from; was there anything else you wanted?”
rows.translation: “这话说得对，老兄；生活踹我一脚，我就狠狠踹回去！”她欢呼道。随后她看向你，露出微笑。“不过偶尔听见有人支持也很不错，所以...谢谢。好了，关于我的来历已经说得够多；你还有别的想问吗？”

rows.original: “You’d like to know a little about me?” Kelly replies, momentarily puzzled before regaining her good cheer. “Well, sure, I can share a few things. My name is Louise Epona - yeah, I know, it sounds kind of odd that I go by Kelly, but I always felt more like a Kelly than a Louise.” She giggles and pokes her tongue out - it’s very long and vibrant yellow, you notice - at how silly her real name is. “Parents, what can you do about them, huh?” she says, shrugging her shoulders. “But seriously, call me Louise and we’re going to have a problem.” She winks at you. Despite her mocking tone, you do detect a hint of threat....
rows.translation: “你想多了解我一点？”凯莉回答，短暂困惑后重新恢复欢快。“好吧，当然，我可以分享几件事。我的名字是露易丝·伊波娜 - 对，我知道，明明叫这个名字却自称凯莉，听起来有点奇怪，但我一直觉得自己更像凯莉，而不是露易丝。”她咯咯笑着，吐出舌头 - 你注意到那根舌头非常修长，呈鲜艳黄色 - 仿佛觉得自己的真名很可笑。“父母嘛，你能拿他们怎么办，对吧？”她耸着肩说道。“不过认真说，叫我露易丝，我们之间就会有麻烦。”她向你眨眼。尽管语调带着戏谑，你的确听出了一丝威胁....

rows.original: “Now, I know what you’re probably thinking - I’m a modder as well as a staff member, right? This gorgeous furry coat and these sweet ears and all the rest of it, it all came out of a bio-sculptor’s toolkit, yeah?” she smirks at you and then shakes her head, floppy ears swishing through the air from the motions. “Well, you’d be partly right. I do have a couple of mods in my system, and I’m very happy with them. However, the most obvious things about me? All natural, I assure you. See, I’m not one of those ‘furries’ that you humans have, who mod themselves to look more animal-like - though we do have one of those here in Esbeth; you met Penny yet? She’s our chief of security, really nice girl, sure you’d like her,” she interjects into her own conversation. “Now, where was I? Ah, yes, I’m not a human at all. I’m a laquine.”
rows.translation: “现在，我知道你多半在想什么 - 我不只是员工，也是个改造者，对吧？这身漂亮毛皮、这对甜美耳朵，还有其他一切，都是生物塑形师工具箱的成果，是吧？”她朝你坏笑，随后摇头，垂耳随着动作划过空气。“嗯，你只说对了一部分。我的体内确实有几项改造，而且我非常满意。不过我身上最明显的部分？我向你保证，全是天然的。你瞧，我不是你们人类所谓的那种‘兽迷’，他们会把自己改造成更像动物的样子 - 虽然埃斯贝斯确实有一个这样的人；你见过佩妮了吗？她是我们的安保主管，是个非常好的女孩，相信你会喜欢她，”她突然在自己的话题中插了一句。“现在，我说到哪里了？啊，对，我根本不是人类。我是拉奎因。”

From. My. Lips.” Her eyes hood themselves in a seductive smoulder, her lips pouting invitingly.

After all, what’s a sexy bunny without a big sexy butt?” she jokes, winking at you. “And don’t think I haven’t noticed you staring at my boobs, either; I think I wouldn’t be the only one happy to give them a few extra inches,” she smirks. This doesn’t stop her from handing you her plate, though."

rows.original: Maybe you would, but doing that using food is just wrong. It’s common knowledge that the only proper way to expand a sexy bunny’s assets is through careful massage and the special application of beauty creams.
rows.translation: 也许你确实会开心，但用食物达到目的根本不对。众所周知，让性感兔女郎的资本膨胀，唯一正确的方法就是细心按摩，再特别涂抹美容霜。
rows.raw: "\n\nMaybe you would, but doing that using food is just wrong. It’s common knowledge that the only proper way to expand a sexy bunny’s assets is through careful massage and the special application of beauty creams."

rows.original: “Oh, I’m all for using those, too,” she purrs. “But it can be so hard to get the rubbing done right... maybe some sweet thing would be willing to give me a hand or two the next time...?”
rows.translation: “哦，我也完全赞成用那些东西，”她柔声低吟。“可是按摩时要把手法做对，实在太难了...也许下次会有哪个甜心愿意借我一两只手...？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, I’m all for using those, too,” she purrs. “But it can be so hard to get the rubbing done right... maybe some sweet thing would be willing to give me a hand or two the next time...?”"

rows.original: Maybe... if she behaves and asks you nicely.
rows.translation: 也许吧... 只要她表现乖巧，再好声好气地求你。
rows.raw: "\n\nMaybe... if she behaves and asks you nicely."

rows.original: “Behave? Who brought you home to dinner? Who slaved over a hot oven to give you a hand-cooked meal? More importantly, who promised to help me earlier?” she pouts.
rows.translation: “表现乖巧？是谁带你回家吃晚饭的？是谁守着滚烫的烤箱，辛辛苦苦给你做了一顿饭？更重要的是，之前是谁答应要帮我的？”她噘嘴说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Behave? Who brought you home to dinner? Who slaved over a hot oven to give you a hand-cooked meal? More importantly, who promised to help me earlier?” she pouts."

rows.original: You already helped her with shopping, not to mention how you helped her get honey for cooking. You’re pretty sure that covers your debt... for the moment.
rows.translation: 你已经帮她买过东西，更别说还帮她弄到了烹饪用的蜂蜜。你很确定这足以抵清欠她的人情... 至少暂时如此。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou already helped her with shopping, not to mention how you helped her get honey for cooking. You’re pretty sure that covers your debt... for the moment."

rows.original: “I... oh, that’s right. In fact, considering what you’ve done, I think it might be me who’s in debt to you now,” she comments, looking thoughtful. “Yes... well, I’ll have to do something about that,” she notes, smiling to herself as she nods her head decisively. She then grimaces, her stomach audibly growling. “But first... let’s have dinner,” she tells you.
rows.translation: “我...哦，说得对。事实上，考虑到你做过的事，我想现在可能是我欠了你的债，”她若有所思地说道。“没错...好吧，我得想办法处理这件事，”她自顾微笑，坚决地点点头。随后她做了个鬼脸，肚子响亮地咕咕叫。“不过首先...还是吃晚饭吧，”她告诉你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I... oh, that’s right. In fact, considering what you’ve done, I think it might be me who’s in debt to you now,” she comments, looking thoughtful. “Yes... well, I’ll have to do something about that,” she notes, smiling to herself as she nods her head decisively. She then grimaces, her stomach audibly growling. “But first... let’s have dinner,” she tells you."

rows.original: You nod and hand over her plate before starting to gather food for yourself.
rows.translation: 你点点头，把她的盘子递过去，随后开始给自己盛食物。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod and hand over her plate before starting to gather food for yourself."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Serve Her
rows.translation: 服侍她
rows.raw: "Serve Her"

rows.original: You will serve dinner.
rows.translation: 由你上晚餐。
rows.raw: "You will serve dinner."

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 否
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: Quiet Browser & LD
rows.raw: "Quiet Browser & LD"

rows.original: You get up, taking your own plate in hand. You thank her, but it’s simpler if you get the food yourself.
rows.translation: 你拿着自己的盘子站起身。你谢过她，但还是自己取餐更省事。
rows.raw: "You get up, taking your own plate in hand. You thank her, but it’s simpler if you get the food yourself."

rows.original: Kelly just smiles and nods in an understanding fashion. “Okay, that’s fine,” she replies. “Just give me the utensils when you’re done so I can get my own.”
rows.translation: 凯莉只是善解人意地笑着点点头。“好吧，没关系，”她答道。“你盛完后把餐具给我，我再自己来。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKelly just smiles and nods in an understanding fashion. “Okay, that’s fine,” she replies. “Just give me the utensils when you’re done so I can get my own.”"

rows.original: You quickly fill your plate with the appropriate portions you’ll be having, handing over the utensils for Kelly to gather her own food. She wastes little time in dishing up her own servings as well.
rows.translation: 你迅速在自己的盘子里装好适量食物，随后把餐具交给凯莉，让她自行取餐。她也毫不磨蹭地盛好了自己的份量。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou quickly fill your plate with the appropriate portions you’ll be having, handing over the utensils for Kelly to gather her own food. She wastes little time in dishing up her own servings as well."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 否
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: Everyone will get their own meal.
rows.translation: 每个人各自取餐。
rows.raw: "Everyone will get their own meal."

rows.original: Use Hers
rows.translation: 用她的
rows.raw: "Use Hers"

rows.original: Use Kelly’s “all natural” honey for flavoring. Warning: may contain giant [herm|npc|f]cock.
rows.translation: 使用凯莉的“纯天然”蜂蜜调味。警告：可能含有巨大的[herm|npc|f]鸡巴。
rows.raw: "Use Kelly’s “all natural” honey for flavoring. Warning: may contain giant [herm|npc|f]cock."

rows.original: Help Her
rows.translation: 帮助她
rows.raw: "Help Her"

rows.original: Quiet Browser & LD
rows.raw: "Quiet Browser & LD"

rows.original: You easily locate the jar and with a gentle tap on her shoulder you hold it out for her.
rows.translation: 你轻松找到了罐子，轻轻拍了拍她的肩膀，把罐子递给她。
rows.raw: "You easily locate the jar and with a gentle tap on her shoulder you hold it out for her."

rows.original: “Oh! Thanks, [pc.name],” she replies, reaching out and taking it from you, then turning back to the bowl of ingredients, where she pours in some honey and starts mixing it all to make a glaze. “This will take a little while to cook, so I suggest you make yourself comfortable,” she informs you.
rows.translation: “哦！谢谢，[pc.name]，”她一边回答，一边伸手接过，随后转回那碗食材，倒入蜂蜜，开始将一切混成糖衣。“这个要过一阵子才能煮好，所以我建议你先休息一下，”她告诉你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh! Thanks, [pc.name],” she replies, reaching out and taking it from you, then turning back to the bowl of ingredients, where she pours in some honey and starts mixing it all to make a glaze. “This will take a little while to cook, so I suggest you make yourself comfortable,” she informs you."

rows.original: With a smile, you nod and tell her not to be long.
rows.translation: 你微笑着点点头，叫她别耽搁太久。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith a smile, you nod and tell her not to be long."

rows.original: “Hey, culinary art takes time,” she smirks over her shoulder, then bends back to her task, finishing the mixing and taking it to the stove to start cooking it properly.
rows.translation: “嘿，烹饪艺术是需要时间的，”她回头坏笑，随后重新俯身工作，完成搅拌，把它端到炉灶上正式加热。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, culinary art takes time,” she smirks over her shoulder, then bends back to her task, finishing the mixing and taking it to the stove to start cooking it properly."

rows.original: Eventually, Kelly is finished with the glaze and has set it aside for when the meat is ready, coming out and plopping herself casually on the couch beside you.
rows.translation: 凯莉终于做完糖衣，将其放在一旁等待火腿烤熟，然后走出来，随意地在你身旁瘫上沙发。
rows.raw: "\n\nEventually, Kelly is finished with the glaze and has set it aside for when the meat is ready, coming out and plopping herself casually on the couch beside you."

rows.original: “Sorry it took so long; you must have been bored stiff waiting for me,” she apologises to you.
rows.translation: “抱歉花了这么久；你等我一定都无聊透了，”她向你道歉。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry it took so long; you must have been bored stiff waiting for me,” she apologises to you."

rows.original: Yes, what kind of hostess is she? Leaving you all alone to sit on the couch?
rows.translation: 是啊，她算哪门子主人？居然把你独自丢在沙发上？
rows.raw: "\n\nYes, what kind of hostess is she? Leaving you all alone to sit on the couch?"

rows.original: “I know, I’m so sorry, but I’ll make it up to you, I promise,” she giggles, grinning shamelessly. “Trust me, dinner will be well worth the wait.”
rows.translation: “我知道，真的很抱歉，不过我保证会补偿你的，”她毫无羞意地咧嘴笑着。“相信我，这顿晚餐绝对值得等待。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I know, I’m so sorry, but I’ll make it up to you, I promise,” she giggles, grinning shamelessly. “Trust me, dinner will be well worth the wait.”"

rows.original: Not at all, is your curt reply.
rows.translation: “一点也不。”你冷淡地答道。
rows.raw: "\n\nNot at all, is your curt reply."

rows.original: Kelly stretches and makes herself comfortable. “So... we got time until dinner is served.” She leans over, batting her eyes at you. “Why don’t you tell me more about yourself? The brave Captain Steele?”
rows.translation: 凯莉伸了个懒腰，让自己坐得舒服些。“所以...离晚餐上桌还有一段时间。”她靠过来，朝你眨巴双眼。“何不多讲讲你自己的故事？勇敢的斯蒂尔船长？”
rows.raw: "\n\nKelly stretches and makes herself comfortable. “So... we got time until dinner is served.” She leans over, batting her eyes at you. “Why don’t you tell me more about yourself? The brave Captain Steele?”"

rows.original: Well, since she’s been nice enough to invite you for dinner, you suppose you could share a bit about yourself.
rows.translation: 好吧，既然她这么好心地邀请你共进晚餐，你觉得可以稍微讲讲自己的事。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, since she’s been nice enough to invite you for dinner, you suppose you could share a bit about yourself."

rows.original: Besides, it’s not like you got anything to hide. You stretch yourself, displaying your body in all its naked glory for her benefit.
rows.translation: 况且你也没什么好隐瞒的。你伸展身体，为她尽情展现自己赤裸身体的全部风采。
rows.raw: " Besides, it’s not like you got anything to hide. You stretch yourself, displaying your body in all its naked glory for her benefit."

rows.original: She openly ogles your nude form, licking her lips, but surprisingly doesn’t do anything more than that, letting her appreciation speak for itself.
rows.translation: 她毫不掩饰地盯着你的裸体，舔了舔嘴唇；但出人意料的是，她没有做出更多举动，只让欣赏之情不言自明。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe openly ogles your nude form, licking her lips, but surprisingly doesn’t do anything more than that, letting her appreciation speak for itself. "

rows.original: She smiles and draws herself up. <i>“So,
rows.translation: 她微笑着挺直身体。<i>“所以，
rows.raw: "She smiles and draws herself up. <i>“So, "

rows.original: mister
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "mister"

rows.original: miss
rows.translation: 小姐
rows.raw: "miss"

rows.original: big, bad space explorer; what tales do you have to tell of Mhen’ga? I hear our jungles are full of all sorts of strange critters; surely someone as brave as you has met a few of them?” she grins, leaning herself against you, one breast pressed insistently against your [pc.chest]. “I’ve... had a bad experience or two in the woods, so I stay in town, where it’s safe, but I still always wanted to know more about what’s out there, ya know?” she asks, shrugging her shoulders.
rows.translation: 这位又高大、又凶猛的太空探险家；关于门加，你有什么故事可讲？听说我们的丛林里到处是稀奇古怪的生物；像你这么勇敢的人，肯定见过其中几种吧？”她咧嘴笑着倚靠你，一只乳房执意压上你的[pc.chest]。“我在林子里...有过一两次糟糕经历，所以总待在安全的城里。不过我一直很想知道外面还有什么，你懂吧？”她耸肩问道。
rows.raw: " big, bad space explorer; what tales do you have to tell of Mhen’ga? I hear our jungles are full of all sorts of strange critters; surely someone as brave as you has met a few of them?” she grins, leaning herself against you, one breast pressed insistently against your [pc.chest]. “I’ve... had a bad experience or two in the woods, so I stay in town, where it’s safe, but I still always wanted to know more about what’s out there, ya know?” she asks, shrugging her shoulders."

rows.original: You admit, a bit awkwardly, that you haven’t been out of the city limits yourself. At least not yet.
rows.translation: 你有些尴尬地承认，自己还没离开过这座城市的范围。至少暂时没有。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou admit, a bit awkwardly, that you haven’t been out of the city limits yourself. At least not yet."

rows.original: “Oh...” she notes quietly, looking a little disappointed. Then she brightens and shrugs her shoulder. “Okay then, never mind. I’m sure you must have other stories to tell about yourself? Maybe something from your past?” she suggests.
rows.translation: “哦...”她轻声说道，看起来略显失望。随后她又振作起来，耸了耸肩。“好吧，那就算了。我相信你肯定还有其他关于自己的故事？也许是过去的经历？”她提议道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh...” she notes quietly, looking a little disappointed. Then she brightens and shrugs her shoulder. “Okay then, never mind. I’m sure you must have other stories to tell about yourself? Maybe something from your past?” she suggests."

rows.original: You nod, of course. Now where to start....
rows.translation: 你当然地点点头。现在该从哪里说起呢....
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, of course. Now where to start...."

rows.original: Well, in that case you’d be happy to tell her about your experiences.
rows.translation: 既然如此，你很乐意向她讲述自己的经历。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, in that case you’d be happy to tell her about your experiences."

rows.original: She draws herself up and watches you expectantly, a smile on her lips as she gleefully awaits your story.
rows.translation: 她挺直身体，满怀期待地注视你，嘴角带着微笑，兴高采烈地等你讲故事。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe draws herself up and watches you expectantly, a smile on her lips as she gleefully awaits your story."

rows.original: She knows the Zil, of course. You’ve certainly seen your share of them, they aren’t exactly difficult to get around.
rows.translation: 她自然知道泽族。你当然也遇见过不少，毕竟在附近根本不难发现它们。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe knows the Zil, of course. You’ve certainly seen your share of them, they aren’t exactly difficult to get around."

rows.original: “Maybe for you,” she mutters a little sourly, clearly not having had such an easy time when she’s encountered it. “What’s your secret to handling them?” she asks, curiously.
rows.translation: “也许对你是这样，”她略带酸意地嘟囔，显然自己遇见泽族时没那么轻松。“你对付它们有什么秘诀？”她好奇地问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maybe for you,” she mutters a little sourly, clearly not having had such an easy time when she’s encountered it. “What’s your secret to handling them?” she asks, curiously."

rows.original: Most people have weaknesses that can be exploited. You’ve had enough training that you’ve developed a keen eye when analyzing your enemies. It’s like you can sense what is more or less likely to work. After you got that down, it’s just a matter of exploiting it.
rows.translation: 大多数人都有可供利用的弱点。你受过充分训练，在分析敌人时练就了敏锐眼光，仿佛能感觉出什么更可能奏效，什么效果不佳。一旦掌握这点，剩下的就只是加以利用。
rows.raw: "\n\nMost people have weaknesses that can be exploited. You’ve had enough training that you’ve developed a keen eye when analyzing your enemies. It’s like you can sense what is more or less likely to work. After you got that down, it’s just a matter of exploiting it."

rows.original: “Ah, just like fixing an engine,” she notes, openly proud at making the connection. “First you study it, then you break it down, then you eliminate what isn’t relevant, then you fix what is,” she concludes.
rows.translation: “啊，就像修理引擎，”她说道，显然为自己能联想到这一点而骄傲。“先研究，再拆解，然后排除无关的东西，最后修好有问题的部分，”她总结道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, just like fixing an engine,” she notes, openly proud at making the connection. “First you study it, then you break it down, then you eliminate what isn’t relevant, then you fix what is,” she concludes."

rows.original: You think over the subject for a moment. Yeah, it’s somewhat like that, but not really. You’ll try to explain if she wants, but it’s not really something you can teach in short notice. You know she’s a bright girl, but that’s one of the things you only get with experience.
rows.translation: 你思考了片刻。对，多少有点像，但也不完全一样。如果她愿意，你可以试着解释，不过这并不是短时间内能教会的东西。你知道她很聪明，但有些事终究只能靠经验获得。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou think over the subject for a moment. Yeah, it’s somewhat like that, but not really. You’ll try to explain if she wants, but it’s not really something you can teach in short notice. You know she’s a bright girl, but that’s one of the things you only get with experience."

rows.original: She thinks it over. “...Nah, maybe some other time? But I’d love to hear more about how you ‘handle’ them, personally....”
rows.translation: 她想了想。“...算了，也许改天吧？不过我更想听听，你亲自是怎么‘对付’它们的....”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe thinks it over. “...Nah, maybe some other time? But I’d love to hear more about how you ‘handle’ them, personally....”"

rows.original: Now, that’s a tale in its own right....
rows.translation: 这个嘛，本身就是一段值得讲述的故事....
rows.raw: "\n\nNow, that’s a tale in its own right...."

rows.original: You’ve met an interesting species that look like a mix of cats and snakes. Their upper halves look like humanoid cats, while their lower halves is like a snake.
rows.translation: 你遇见过一个有趣的物种，看起来像猫与蛇的混合体。上半身近似猫科人形，下半身则像蛇。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve met an interesting species that look like a mix of cats and snakes. Their upper halves look like humanoid cats, while their lower halves is like a snake."

rows.original: “Half snake, half cat? That’s a pretty weird look,” Kelly notes. “So, what do they do when you meet them?”
rows.translation: “半蛇半猫？这模样还真古怪，”凯莉评论道。“所以，遇到它们时，它们会做什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Half snake, half cat? That’s a pretty weird look,” Kelly notes. “So, what do they do when you meet them?”"

rows.original: You explain that they’re quite predatory. The ones you’ve met are mostly hunters, and if they get you... well... they live in a forest, surrounded by zil pheromones. It’s not too difficult to imagine what they do when they catch their prey.
rows.translation: 你解释说，它们很有掠食性。你见过的基本都是猎手；如果被它们抓住...嗯...它们生活在一片充满泽族信息素的森林里。想象它们捉到猎物后会做什么，其实并不困难。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou explain that they’re quite predatory. The ones you’ve met are mostly hunters, and if they get you... well... they live in a forest, surrounded by zil pheromones. It’s not too difficult to imagine what they do when they catch their prey."

rows.original: “Figures,” she notes, a wry smile on her lips as she nods.
rows.translation: “果然如此，”她说道，嘴角挂着一抹无奈笑意，同时点点头。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Figures,” she notes, a wry smile on her lips as she nods."

rows.original: They are not likely to come close to the city though. From what you gather, they prefer to be sneaky, so it’s not likely they’d expose themselves.
rows.translation: 不过它们不大可能靠近城市。据你了解，它们偏爱潜行，因此应该不会主动暴露自己。
rows.raw: "\n\nThey are not likely to come close to the city though. From what you gather, they prefer to be sneaky, so it’s not likely they’d expose themselves."

rows.original: “I... guess that’s good to hear,” she admits, looking distracted.
rows.translation: “我...想来这算是好消息，”她心不在焉地承认道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I... guess that’s good to hear,” she admits, looking distracted."

rows.original: You begin to recount the details of your encounter, warning her about the dangers one might pose....
rows.translation: 你开始复述那次遭遇的细节，提醒她这种生物可能造成的危险....
rows.raw: "\n\nYou begin to recount the details of your encounter, warning her about the dangers one might pose...."

rows.original: You’ve seen a curious plant. It tries to lure you using a bait that looks like a girl so it can trap you into a pod and have its way with you.
rows.translation: 你见过一种奇特植物。它会用外貌酷似女孩的诱饵引你上钩，再把你困进豆荚中，随意摆布你的身体。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve seen a curious plant. It tries to lure you using a bait that looks like a girl so it can trap you into a pod and have its way with you."

rows.original: An antique-looking candlestand, lit by a single gently burning candle, has been placed at the end of the table where the two of you will be sitting, and the lights have been dimmed just enough to make its own light visible.
rows.translation: 一只古董模样的烛台摆在你们两人将要就坐的桌子末端，上面点着一根温和燃烧的蜡烛；灯光恰好调暗到足以让烛光显现。
rows.raw: " An antique-looking candlestand, lit by a single gently burning candle, has been placed at the end of the table where the two of you will be sitting, and the lights have been dimmed just enough to make its own light visible."

rows.original: You admire the whole set up, nodding as you take a step to pull your chair. That’s pretty fancy, you comment. Far more than you expected anyway.
rows.translation: 你欣赏着整套餐具布置，点点头，迈步拉开椅子。你说，这还真够讲究，远远超出了预期。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou admire the whole set up, nodding as you take a step to pull your chair. That’s pretty fancy, you comment. Far more than you expected anyway."

rows.original: Ah, Kelly; she’s never going to change, is she? Such a contradictory creature, she is. You can’t help but let your feelings show on your face.
rows.translation: 唉，凯莉；她永远都不会变，对吧？真是个矛盾的家伙。你忍不住让心情显露在脸上。
rows.raw: "\n\nAh, Kelly; she’s never going to change, is she? Such a contradictory creature, she is. You can’t help but let your feelings show on your face."

rows.original: “What? You think just because I like a bit of casualness in life I’m completely unsophisticated?” she giggles, then moves to pull out her own chair, stopping before actually seating herself. “Ah, guests first?” she suggests with a smile, indicating your seat with her hand. “That’s what my mom always said.”
rows.translation: “怎么？你觉得我只是喜欢生活随意一些，就完全不懂情调吗？”她轻笑着走去拉自己的椅子，却在真正坐下前停住。“啊，客人优先？”她微笑着提议，伸手示意你的座位。“我妈妈总这么说。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What? You think just because I like a bit of casualness in life I’m completely unsophisticated?” she giggles, then moves to pull out her own chair, stopping before actually seating herself. “Ah, guests first?” she suggests with a smile, indicating your seat with her hand. “That’s what my mom always said.”"

rows.original: Seeing no reason to refuse her invitation, you take your seat, place your serving in front of you, and patiently wait for her to take hers. Happily she flops down into her seat and pulls herself in to the table. “Alright! I’m so hungry... I was starting to wonder just how long this stupid ham was gonna take to cook,” she pouts, her belly grumbling as if in emphasis.
rows.translation: 你看不出拒绝邀请的理由，于是坐下，把自己那份放到面前，耐心等她入座。她开心地瘫进自己的椅子，拉近餐桌。“好啦！我快饿死了...刚才都开始怀疑这块蠢火腿到底还要烤多久，”她撅嘴抱怨，肚子也像要强调似的咕咕作响。
rows.raw: "\n\nSeeing no reason to refuse her invitation, you take your seat, place your serving in front of you, and patiently wait for her to take hers. Happily she flops down into her seat and pulls herself in to the table. “Alright! I’m so hungry... I was starting to wonder just how long this stupid ham was gonna take to cook,” she pouts, her belly grumbling as if in emphasis."

rows.original: You exchange smiles and promptly dig in. The ham is delicious; you praise Kelly on her recipe.
rows.translation: 你们交换微笑，随即开始大快朵颐。火腿十分美味，你称赞凯莉的食谱。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou exchange smiles and promptly dig in. The ham is delicious; you praise Kelly on her recipe."

rows.original: “Thank you!” she beams, already forking up a big piece for herself. “I’m quite proud of my cooking - I didn’t go to home economics class for nothing, I’ll have you know,” she jokes, then gobbles down her forkful.
rows.translation: “谢谢！”她喜笑颜开，已经叉起一大块给自己。“我对自己的厨艺很自豪；我可不是白上家政课的，”她开着玩笑，一口吞下叉上的食物。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thank you!” she beams, already forking up a big piece for herself. “I’m quite proud of my cooking - I didn’t go to home economics class for nothing, I’ll have you know,” she jokes, then gobbles down her forkful."

rows.original: The rest of the meal passes mostly in silence. Of course, there’s always some time for small-talk, but the both of you focus on filling your respective bellies whilst enjoying each other’s company.
rows.translation: 接下来的晚餐大多在沉默中度过。当然，偶尔也会闲聊几句，不过你们都专注于填饱各自的肚子，同时享受彼此陪伴。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe rest of the meal passes mostly in silence. Of course, there’s always some time for small-talk, but the both of you focus on filling your respective bellies whilst enjoying each other’s company."

rows.original: It doesn’t take long for you to finish stuffing yourself. You drain the last of your drink and sigh, completely satisfied for the moment. Once more, you compliment Kelly’s cooking.
rows.translation: 没过多久，你便把自己彻底填饱。你喝完最后一点饮料，叹了口气，此刻已经完全满足。你再次称赞凯莉的厨艺。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt doesn’t take long for you to finish stuffing yourself. You drain the last of your drink and sigh, completely satisfied for the moment. Once more, you compliment Kelly’s cooking."

rows.original: “You’re welcome,” she tells you, hiccups, then giggles. “Sorry, ate a bit too fast there,” she apologizes, then climbs to her feet. “Just sit back and relax, honey. I’ll just clear the table and be with you in a second,” she tells you, blowing you a kiss. Then she sets about gathering up her cutlery and taking yours, stacking it atop hers and strutting off to the kitchen, humming contentedly as she goes.
rows.translation: “不客气，”她告诉你，打了个嗝，随后咯咯笑起来。“抱歉，刚才吃得有点太快了，”她道歉后站起身。“只管靠着休息吧，亲爱的。我收拾一下桌子，马上就来陪你，”她边说边送来一个飞吻。随后她开始收拢自己的餐具，又拿走你的，堆在自己那份上，大摇大摆地走向厨房，一路心满意足地哼着歌。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re welcome,” she tells you, hiccups, then giggles. “Sorry, ate a bit too fast there,” she apologizes, then climbs to her feet. “Just sit back and relax, honey. I’ll just clear the table and be with you in a second,” she tells you, blowing you a kiss. Then she sets about gathering up her cutlery and taking yours, stacking it atop hers and strutting off to the kitchen, humming contentedly as she goes."

rows.original: Help Her
rows.translation: 帮助她
rows.raw: "Help Her"

rows.original: Quiet Browser & LD
rows.raw: "Quiet Browser & LD"

rows.original: You decide you’d rather help her get the dishes done. It’s the least you can do, besides you can relax with her later.
rows.translation: 你决定还是帮她把餐具洗完。这是你至少能做的事，况且之后还可以和她一起放松。
rows.raw: "You decide you’d rather help her get the dishes done. It’s the least you can do, besides you can relax with her later."

rows.original: Kelly pauses, looking back at you in surprise. “You wha-?” she starts, then shakes her head and grins. “Why, thank you, honey... or do you have some ulterior motive in mind, hmm?” she grins and pokes her tongue out at you teasingly, then continues on to the kitchen; if that is the case, it clearly doesn’t bother her.
rows.translation: 凯莉停下来，惊讶地回头看你。“你什——？”她刚开口，便摇摇头露出笑容。“哎呀，谢谢你，亲爱的...还是说，你心里另有企图，嗯？”她坏笑着朝你调皮吐舌，随后继续走向厨房；即使真是如此，她显然也不介意。
rows.raw: "\n\nKelly pauses, looking back at you in surprise. “You wha-?” she starts, then shakes her head and grins. “Why, thank you, honey... or do you have some ulterior motive in mind, hmm?” she grins and pokes her tongue out at you teasingly, then continues on to the kitchen; if that is the case, it clearly doesn’t bother her."

rows.original: You go after her, rolling your eyes at her antics.
rows.translation: 你翻着白眼追上她，为她的举动哭笑不得。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou go after her, rolling your eyes at her antics."

rows.original: Kelly places the dirty things in the sink and starts to fill it. “I’ll wash, you dry; okay by you?” she asks, moving over slightly to give you room to join her.
rows.translation: 凯莉把脏东西放进水槽，开始注水。“我来洗，你来擦；没问题吧？”她问道，稍微挪开一点，给你腾出加入的空间。
rows.raw: "\n\nKelly places the dirty things in the sink and starts to fill it. “I’ll wash, you dry; okay by you?” she asks, moving over slightly to give you room to join her."

rows.original: You get in position, smiling mischievously as you give her hips a nudge with your own, pushing her slightly as you grin.
rows.translation: 你站到位置，坏笑着用臀胯撞了她一下，把她稍微推开。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou get in position, smiling mischievously as you give her hips a nudge with your own, pushing her slightly as you grin."

rows.original: She meets your grin with one of her own, returning your hip bump. <i>“Down,
rows.translation: 她用自己的笑容回应你的坏笑，又用臀胯撞回来。<i>“安分点，
rows.raw: "\n\nShe meets your grin with one of her own, returning your hip bump. <i>“Down, "

rows.original: boy
rows.translation: 男孩
rows.raw: "boy"

rows.original: girl
rows.translation: 女孩
rows.raw: "girl"

rows.original: ; time for that after we’re done,” she giggles.
rows.translation: ；等做完再玩那个，”她轻笑道。
rows.raw: "; time for that after we’re done,” she giggles."

rows.original: Not being one to back down from a hip-bump fight, you throw her off again.
rows.translation: 你可不是会在臀撞大战中退缩的人，于是又将她撞得一歪。
rows.raw: "\n\nNot being one to back down from a hip-bump fight, you throw her off again."

rows.original: The return bump is much harder, enough to make you rock back a step, Kelly grinning mischievously as she does. “Whoops,” she says, clearly not apologetic at all.
rows.translation: 她这次撞回来时用力得多，足以让你向后踉跄一步，而凯莉则顽皮地咧嘴笑着。“哎呀，”她说道，显然毫无歉意。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe return bump is much harder, enough to make you rock back a step, Kelly grinning mischievously as she does. “Whoops,” she says, clearly not apologetic at all."

rows.original: So that’s how she wants to play, huh? Well two can play that game! You bump her right back.
rows.translation: 所以她想这么玩，对吧？那这场游戏当然可以两个人一起！你立刻撞了回去。
rows.raw: "\n\nSo that’s how she wants to play, huh? Well two can play that game! You bump her right back."

rows.original: She lets out a grunt of surprise, giggling as she resettles herself. “Alright, alright, truce! Before I end up falling into the sink.”
rows.translation: 她惊讶地闷哼一声，轻笑着重新站稳。“好了，好了，停战！不然我最后要掉进水槽里了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe lets out a grunt of surprise, giggling as she resettles herself. “Alright, alright, truce! Before I end up falling into the sink.”"

rows.original: Fine, fine. You’ve had your fun... for now.
rows.translation: 好吧，好吧。你已经玩够了...至少暂时如此。
rows.raw: "\n\nFine, fine. You’ve had your fun... for now."

rows.original: Nonsense, you can take care of everything by yourself.
rows.translation: 胡说，你自己完全能处理一切。
rows.raw: "\n\nNonsense, you can take care of everything by yourself."

rows.original: “Don’t tempt me,” she drawls, then grins. “But thanks for the offer,” she adds, before plunging her hands into the soapy water.
rows.translation: “别勾引我，”她慢吞吞地说道，随后咧嘴一笑。“不过还是谢谢你的好意，”她补充着，把双手探进肥皂水里。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t tempt me,” she drawls, then grins. “But thanks for the offer,” she adds, before plunging her hands into the soapy water."

rows.original: Well, you tried. You give her back an appreciative tap as you wait for her to handle you the dishes to dry. She smiles at the gesture and sets to work at a leisurely yet productive pace.
rows.translation: 好吧，你已经试过了。等待她递来餐具擦干时，你赞赏地轻拍她的后背。她因这个动作露出笑容，开始以悠闲却高效的节奏工作。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, you tried. You give her back an appreciative tap as you wait for her to handle you the dishes to dry. She smiles at the gesture and sets to work at a leisurely yet productive pace."

rows.original: You nod and get in position.
rows.translation: 你点点头，站到自己的位置。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod and get in position."

rows.original: Things go smoothly, and in no time you’re both finished.
rows.translation: 一切进行顺利，没过多久，你们便双双完成。
rows.raw: "\n\nThings go smoothly, and in no time you’re both finished."

rows.original: “And done,” she says with a grin as the last piece is put away, the sink giving out a final gurgle as the last of the water runs down the drain. “Thanks for the help, sweet thing,” she says, turning to face you. “I think somebody’s earned themselves a little reward...” she purrs as she says this, arms draping over your shoulders, one leg tucking itself up behind her as she bends in and kisses you sweetly on the lips. She holds you there for a moment or two, then lets you go and steps back. “But I don’t feel like doing anything in the kitchen now... how about we go back to the living room?” she suggests.
rows.translation: “完成，”最后一件餐具放回原位时，她笑着说道，而最后一点水流进排水口，水槽也发出一声咕噜。“谢谢帮忙，小甜心，”她转身面对你。“我看某人已经为自己赢得了一份小奖励...”她柔声低吟，双臂搭上你的肩膀，一条腿向后屈起，俯身甜甜吻住你的双唇。她让你在那里停留片刻，才松开手退后。“不过我现在不想在厨房里做什么...我们回客厅怎么样？”她提议道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And done,” she says with a grin as the last piece is put away, the sink giving out a final gurgle as the last of the water runs down the drain. “Thanks for the help, sweet thing,” she says, turning to face you. “I think somebody’s earned themselves a little reward...” she purrs as she says this, arms draping over your shoulders, one leg tucking itself up behind her as she bends in and kisses you sweetly on the lips. She holds you there for a moment or two, then lets you go and steps back. “But I don’t feel like doing anything in the kitchen now... how about we go back to the living room?” she suggests."

rows.original: Seeing no reason to refuse, yet. You agree to go with her.
rows.translation: 你暂时看不出拒绝的理由，便答应和她一起去。
rows.raw: "\n\nSeeing no reason to refuse, yet. You agree to go with her."

rows.original: She smiles and struts towards the door, wiggling her bouncy bunny butt with deliberate seductive intent as she goes.
rows.translation: 她微笑着大摇大摆走向门口，途中刻意以诱人的方式扭动弹性十足的兔臀。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe smiles and struts towards the door, wiggling her bouncy bunny butt with deliberate seductive intent as she goes."

rows.original: Relax
rows.translation: 放松
rows.raw: "Relax"

rows.original: Quiet Browser & LD
rows.raw: "Quiet Browser & LD"

rows.original: Nodding, you head over to her couch, plopping down and sighing as you lean back and close your eyes for a spell.
rows.translation: 你点点头走到她的沙发旁，一屁股坐下，向后靠去，叹着气闭目休息片刻。
rows.raw: "Nodding, you head over to her couch, plopping down and sighing as you lean back and close your eyes for a spell."

rows.original: Kelly carries on into the kitchen nonplussed, and from within you can hear the sounds of running water and dishes being scrubbed. Soon enough, she finishes her tasks and comes out to join you.
rows.translation: 凯莉若无其事地继续走进厨房，你能从里面听见流水和刷洗餐具的声音。没过多久，她完成任务，出来陪你。
rows.raw: "\n\nKelly carries on into the kitchen nonplussed, and from within you can hear the sounds of running water and dishes being scrubbed. Soon enough, she finishes her tasks and comes out to join you."

rows.original: Help Her
rows.translation: 帮助她
rows.raw: "Help Her"

rows.original: Help Kelly find her honey jar.
rows.translation: 帮凯莉寻找蜂蜜罐。
rows.raw: "Help Kelly find her honey jar."

rows.original: Quiet Browser & LD
rows.raw: "Quiet Browser & LD"

rows.original: Shopping with her is quite an experience. Kelly can be quite the energetic hopping bunny when she wants to. Since you’re getting a free meal out of this, you don’t mind helping, however it’s true that this is more than simple grocery shopping. Unless skin care, fur care and cleaning supplies suddenly became a part of the cooking process when you were not looking....
rows.translation: 跟她一起购物是种相当独特的体验。凯莉想活跃时，确实能成为一只精力旺盛、蹦蹦跳跳的兔子。既然能因此吃到免费的一餐，你并不介意帮忙，不过这显然不只是购买食品杂货。除非在你没注意时，护肤品、毛发护理品和清洁用品突然也变成了烹饪流程的一部分....
rows.raw: " Shopping with her is quite an experience. Kelly can be quite the energetic hopping bunny when she wants to. Since you’re getting a free meal out of this, you don’t mind helping, however it’s true that this is more than simple grocery shopping. Unless skin care, fur care and cleaning supplies suddenly became a part of the cooking process when you were not looking...."

rows.original: As the bags start piling up it becomes harder and harder to keep up with her. You find yourself getting winded easily - of course, the fact that you don’t really have time to sit down and adjust the bags to make them more convenient could be a factor.
rows.translation: 袋子越堆越多，跟上她也变得越来越困难。你发现自己很容易气喘吁吁；当然，没有时间坐下来重新调整袋子、让它们更方便携带，也可能是个原因。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs the bags start piling up it becomes harder and harder to keep up with her. You find yourself getting winded easily - of course, the fact that you don’t really have time to sit down and adjust the bags to make them more convenient could be a factor."

rows.original: “Hey, [pc.name], what’s up? You’re slower than a honey-glazed snail,” Kelly comments as she finds herself continually delayed by you. She takes a look at you and blinks as she sees just how much you’re struggling with her groceries. “Ah. Okay, we’ve got enough for today, we can head back to my place now,” she promises you.
rows.translation: “嘿，[pc.name]，怎么了？你比裹了蜂蜜糖衣的蜗牛还慢，”凯莉发现自己总被你拖慢，便如此评论。她打量你一眼，看见你被自己的杂货折腾得如此辛苦，不由眨了眨眼。“啊。好吧，今天已经买得够多了，现在可以回我家，”她向你保证。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, [pc.name], what’s up? You’re slower than a honey-glazed snail,” Kelly comments as she finds herself continually delayed by you. She takes a look at you and blinks as she sees just how much you’re struggling with her groceries. “Ah. Okay, we’ve got enough for today, we can head back to my place now,” she promises you."

rows.original: You sigh with relief when you start to head to her home.
rows.translation: 开始朝她家走时，你如释重负地叹了口气。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sigh with relief when you start to head to her home."

rows.original: Her bags soon start piling up and you’re thankful that you’re strong enough to carry them. Still, keeping up with Kelly can be quite difficult. She shows no shame as she starts to pile bag upon bag whilst you’re carrying.
rows.translation: 她的袋子很快越堆越多，你也庆幸自己有足够力气搬动。不过，要跟上凯莉依然颇为困难。你已经抱着一堆东西，她却毫不客气地继续将袋子一个接一个堆上来。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer bags soon start piling up and you’re thankful that you’re strong enough to carry them. Still, keeping up with Kelly can be quite difficult. She shows no shame as she starts to pile bag upon bag whilst you’re carrying."

rows.original: <i>“It’s so nice to have a strong
rows.translation: <i>“能有一个强壮的
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“It’s so nice to have a strong "

rows.translation: 男子
rows.raw: "man"

rows.translation: 女人
rows.raw: "woman"

rows.original: along to help out; it’s such a bother having to make multiple trips every time I want to get some shopping done. You’re so sweet to help me out like this, [pc.name],” she chirps gleefully.
rows.translation: 随行帮忙真是太好了；每次买东西都得来回跑好几趟，实在太麻烦。你愿意这样帮我，真是太贴心了，[pc.name]，”她开心地说道。
rows.raw: " along to help out; it’s such a bother having to make multiple trips every time I want to get some shopping done. You’re so sweet to help me out like this, [pc.name],” she chirps gleefully."

rows.original: By the time you start heading back to her house you admit you were getting tired; you were running of room to carry her stuff too.
rows.translation: 等你们开始往她家走时，你承认自己已经累了；能用来携带她那些东西的空间也越来越少。
rows.raw: "\n\nBy the time you start heading back to her house you admit you were getting tired; you were running of room to carry her stuff too."

rows.original: “And that’s the last of it,” she declares happily, closing the final cupboard. “You’re such a sweet
rows.translation: “最后一件也放好了，”她开心地宣布，关上最后一个橱柜。“你真是个贴心的

rows.translation: 女人

rows.original: , to help a little lady like myself,” she says, turning her head to look over her shoulder to shoot a mock-innocent smile at you as she does. With a sigh of relief, she starts to fiddle with her bra-like mini-top, casually dropping it to the floor once it springs free of her breasts, then bending over to start removing her pants, ass up and pointed towards you, each shapely curve of buttock and leg emphasised as her pants slide with slow, deliberate motion down to the floor. She steps out of them with one foot, and then a delicate backwards kick flicks the garment away.

rows.translation: 你甚至懒得看它 – 只想冲破那股将你压制在地的迷雾，奋力反抗。另一只手刚才是不是还给它指了路？谁知道呢。拟膜怪每次遇到新室友，似乎都会变得异常兴奋。身体各部位擅自行动这种事，对你来说早已司空见惯。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou don’t even bother looking at it – trying to pierce through the haze that’s pinned you down to fight it off. Did your other hand just direct it or something? Who knows. The Mimbranes always seem to get riled up when they run into a new roommate. Experiencing various parts of your body acting of their own accord has become second nature to you by now."

rows.original: You can’t feel your hand anymore. The parasite must have already smothered your other hand and has moved onto that integration. Does it turn you on still? Maybe. It’s hard to say. It probably would have been faster had you just gone limp the instant the damn thing fell out of the sky at you.
rows.translation: 你已经感觉不到自己的手了。寄生虫一定早已将另一只手完全包裹，现在开始进行融合。这依然会让你兴奋吗？也许吧。很难说。要是那该死的东西从天而降扑向你时，你立刻瘫软下来，过程大概还会更快。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t feel your hand anymore. The parasite must have already smothered your other hand and has moved onto that integration. Does it turn you on still? Maybe. It’s hard to say. It probably would have been faster had you just gone limp the instant the damn thing fell out of the sky at you."

rows.original: Seems like you’ve got a bit of angry lust for no good reason. Or you’re frustrated. Or just confused. Or– oh, things are back to normal. That same normal you’ve run into
rows.translation: 看来你心里莫名积着几分愤怒的欲火。或许是挫败感。或许只是困惑。又或是– 哦，一切恢复正常了。就是你已经经历过
rows.raw: "\n\nSeems like you’ve got a bit of angry lust for no good reason. Or you’re frustrated. Or just confused. Or– oh, things are back to normal. That same normal you’ve run into "

rows.original: times now. You look down at your hand; three bumps are arranged on your palm same as they are on your other one.
rows.translation: 次的那种“正常”。你低头看向手掌；三颗凸起排列在掌心，与另一只手上的一模一样。
rows.raw: " times now. You look down at your hand; three bumps are arranged on your palm same as they are on your other one."

rows.original: With your wits back with you, a heavy sigh accompanies the gathering of your equipment. Best not to dwell on this further.
rows.translation: 理智恢复后，你沉重地叹息一声，开始收拾装备。最好别再纠结这件事了。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith your wits back with you, a heavy sigh accompanies the gathering of your equipment. Best not to dwell on this further."

rows.original: Your conqueror is actually a little confused. All of its prime targets have been taken! But it would seem that your parasitic attachments are doing their damnedest to keep their friend from being discouraged. The constant movement and noise around your body struggles against the haze that’s locked you into a stuffy bout of sensual passion. Trying to stay current on the Mimbrane’s actions is proving to be a difficult ordeal.
rows.translation: 你的征服者其实有些困惑。所有首选目标都已经被占据了！不过，你身上的寄生附属物似乎正竭力不让朋友灰心。身体周围持续不断的动作与声响，对抗着那股把你困在闷热肉欲中的迷雾。想要跟上拟膜怪的一举一动，正变成一场艰难考验。
rows.raw: "Your conqueror is actually a little confused. All of its prime targets have been taken! But it would seem that your parasitic attachments are doing their damnedest to keep their friend from being discouraged. The constant movement and noise around your body struggles against the haze that’s locked you into a stuffy bout of sensual passion. Trying to stay current on the Mimbrane’s actions is proving to be a difficult ordeal."

rows.original: That’s when a slick, smooth touch of your palm garners your attention. The parasite is prodding at your hand, seemingly examining it. Though you lack the coherence to whip your arm away, you’re at least able to clench your fingers. Your grip isn’t quite up to your full potential, but you do manage to snag the Mimbrane’s inquisitive corner. It doesn’t startle the creature, however, much to your disappointment. If anything, the direct contact with the parasite’s oily top side is only making your inner turmoil worse.
rows.translation: 就在这时，掌心传来的滑腻触感吸引了你的注意。寄生虫正戳弄你的手，仿佛在进行检查。虽然你神志不清，没法猛然抽开手臂，至少还能收紧手指。握力远不及正常状态，却还是成功抓住拟膜怪探来的一个角。令你失望的是，这并未吓到它。恰恰相反，与寄生虫油滑上表面的直接接触，只让你内心的骚动变得更加剧烈。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s when a slick, smooth touch of your palm garners your attention. The parasite is prodding at your hand, seemingly examining it. Though you lack the coherence to whip your arm away, you’re at least able to clench your fingers. Your grip isn’t quite up to your full potential, but you do manage to snag the Mimbrane’s inquisitive corner. It doesn’t startle the creature, however, much to your disappointment. If anything, the direct contact with the parasite’s oily top side is only making your inner turmoil worse."

rows.original: No, instead the Mimbrane casually wraps the rest of its body around your weak fist. You make a weak gesture, relinquishing your grapple to try and move your fingers in some useless attempt to escape the parasite. All you manage to do is make it easier for it to work its way around your digits and onto your palm. Falling back to making another fist is your final recourse, unable to move or react intelligibly enough to effectively defend yourself.
rows.translation: 不，拟膜怪只是若无其事地把身体其余部分裹上你无力的拳头。你虚弱地动了动，松开抓握，试图活动手指，以这徒劳举动逃离寄生虫。结果你只让它更容易绕过指头，爬上掌心。你最终只能再次握拳，既无法移动，也无法作出足够清醒的反应来有效保护自己。
rows.raw: "\n\nNo, instead the Mimbrane casually wraps the rest of its body around your weak fist. You make a weak gesture, relinquishing your grapple to try and move your fingers in some useless attempt to escape the parasite. All you manage to do is make it easier for it to work its way around your digits and onto your palm. Falling back to making another fist is your final recourse, unable to move or react intelligibly enough to effectively defend yourself."

rows.original: The gesture proves meaningless, and soon it appears you’ve found yourself a wriggling glove of sorts, grasped firmly onto your wrist. Next comes the recognizable sensation of the Mimbrane integrating into your nervous system. Though you can’t get a coherent feeling from them, you can at least still move your fingers. Soon, the moist, warm feeling of entrapment is replaced with the comparatively cool breeze of the jungle.
rows.translation: 这个动作毫无意义，很快你似乎便多了一只不断蠕动的手套，牢牢扣在腕部。接下来是拟膜怪融入神经系统时那种熟悉感觉。尽管你无法从中获得连贯感受，至少仍能活动手指。不久，受困其中的湿热触感便被丛林中相对凉爽的微风取代。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe gesture proves meaningless, and soon it appears you’ve found yourself a wriggling glove of sorts, grasped firmly onto your wrist. Next comes the recognizable sensation of the Mimbrane integrating into your nervous system. Though you can’t get a coherent feeling from them, you can at least still move your fingers. Soon, the moist, warm feeling of entrapment is replaced with the comparatively cool breeze of the jungle."

rows.original: You’ve gotten rather used to this process by now. The jolt of normalcy isn’t even a shock anymore. The hunt for the creature’s eyes and mouth doesn’t even take long; a triage of tiny bumps lay concealed square center on your [pc.skinTone] palm. You rub your other thumb over them, a tad surprised to see how much more durable the typically sensitive additions are. You suppose the Mimbrane has a grasp on what a hand actually is and has modified itself accordingly.
rows.translation: 如今你已经相当习惯这个过程。恢复正常时的冲击甚至不再令你惊讶。寻找这生物的眼睛和嘴巴也没花多少时间；三颗微小凸起隐藏在你[pc.skinTone]掌心的正中央。你用另一只手的拇指摩挲它们，有些惊讶地发现这些通常十分敏感的新增部位变得耐用许多。看来拟膜怪理解了手的实际用途，并相应调整了自己。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve gotten rather used to this process by now. The jolt of normalcy isn’t even a shock anymore. The hunt for the creature’s eyes and mouth doesn’t even take long; a triage of tiny bumps lay concealed square center on your [pc.skinTone] palm. You rub your other thumb over them, a tad surprised to see how much more durable the typically sensitive additions are. You suppose the Mimbrane has a grasp on what a hand actually is and has modified itself accordingly."

rows.translation: 拟膜兽包裹住你的[pc.foot]。

rows.original: There don’t seem to be very many other signs of wildlife around at the moment. The involuntary movement of your body paired with the unusual sounds produced by the Mimbranes must be keeping them at bay. It’s too bad; now would be the perfect time for a little birdwatching.
rows.translation: 眼下周围似乎没有多少其他野生动物的踪迹。你身体不由自主的动作，加上拟膜怪发出的异常声响，大概把它们都吓退了。真遗憾；现在本来正适合观赏一下鸟类。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere don’t seem to be very many other signs of wildlife around at the moment. The involuntary movement of your body paired with the unusual sounds produced by the Mimbranes must be keeping them at bay. It’s too bad; now would be the perfect time for a little birdwatching."

rows.original: The Mimbrane weaves into your nervous system.
rows.translation: 拟膜兽接入了你的神经系统。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Mimbrane weaves into your nervous system."

rows.original: It’s so hot. It’s always hot when you lose to these things. But when you’re absorbing nature like this, it’s hard to ignore every facet of it, regardless of how it came about. Sure, the lust fog surrounding you weighs on you like a steaming bag of bricks, but it isn’t like the jungle is that much better typically. How many creatures must love living here, you wonder.
rows.translation: 太热了。输给这些东西时总是这么热。不过，当你像这样全身心感受自然，便很难忽略它的任何一面，无论事情如何发生。笼罩你的欲望迷雾确实像一袋冒着蒸汽的砖块般沉重，可这片丛林平时也好不到哪里去。你不禁好奇，究竟有多少生物热爱在这里生活。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s so hot. It’s always hot when you lose to these things. But when you’re absorbing nature like this, it’s hard to ignore every facet of it, regardless of how it came about. Sure, the lust fog surrounding you weighs on you like a steaming bag of bricks, but it isn’t like the jungle is that much better typically. How many creatures must love living here, you wonder."

rows.original: Do the venus pitchers get many catches out in the middle of nowhere like this?
rows.translation: 捕蝇草在这种荒郊野外也能捕到许多猎物吗？
rows.raw: " Do the venus pitchers get many catches out in the middle of nowhere like this?"

rows.original: You can’t feel your [pc.foot].
rows.translation: 你感觉不到自己的[pc.foot]了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t feel your [pc.foot]."

rows.original: Maybe if it were winter it wouldn’t be as uncomfortable around here. Surely most of the unsavory types wouldn’t enjoy even a slight drop in temperatures. It’s doubtful that the seasons make much of a difference around here, though, you figure. That seems to be how jungles usually work, right? Maybe it was foolish to imagine otherwise.
rows.translation: 如果现在是冬天，这里或许不会如此难受。哪怕气温稍稍下降，那些令人不快的家伙想必也不会喜欢。不过你估计，季节在这里大概没多大区别。丛林通常就是这样，对吧？也许认为会有所不同，本身就很愚蠢。
rows.raw: "\n\nMaybe if it were winter it wouldn’t be as uncomfortable around here. Surely most of the unsavory types wouldn’t enjoy even a slight drop in temperatures. It’s doubtful that the seasons make much of a difference around here, though, you figure. That seems to be how jungles usually work, right? Maybe it was foolish to imagine otherwise."

rows.original: Things are back to normal.
rows.translation: 一切恢复了正常。
rows.raw: "\n\nThings are back to normal."

rows.original: That’s it. Panting’s gone. Your desire to fuck something is back to your more sustainable levels. The jungle feels like its typical self. You don’t even bother examining your new parasite. There’s no need. You’ve already gotten used to feeding a foot, as it were. Same as the rest of your body. This is common practice for you at this point.
rows.translation: 结束了。喘息消失了。想找东西交配的欲望也恢复到较为持久的程度。丛林重新变回平常的模样。你甚至懒得检查新寄生虫。没有必要。可以说，你早已习惯用一只脚喂养它了。身体其他部位也一样。事到如今，这对你已经是家常便饭。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s it. Panting’s gone. Your desire to fuck something is back to your more sustainable levels. The jungle feels like its typical self. You don’t even bother examining your new parasite. There’s no need. You’ve already gotten used to feeding a foot, as it were. Same as the rest of your body. This is common practice for you at this point."

rows.original: You take your equipment and go, refusing to dwell on what transpired.
rows.translation: 你拿起装备离开，拒绝细想刚才发生的事。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take your equipment and go, refusing to dwell on what transpired."

rows.original: ...Again! You’ve succumbed again! Your body is covered in these things! Where will this Mimbrane go? Do you even care?
rows.translation: ...又来了！你又屈服了！这些东西爬满了你的身体！这只拟膜怪会去哪里？你还在乎吗？
rows.raw: "...Again! You’ve succumbed again! Your body is covered in these things! Where will this Mimbrane go? Do you even care?"

rows.original: You’ve honed the act of retreating back to your subconscious into an art at this point. Anything to escape the repeated anguish these Mimbranes throw you under. You can barely even feel the parasites manipulating your body in all sorts of strange and unnatural ways. It’s the same as always, you figure.
rows.translation: 事到如今，你已经把退回潜意识的做法磨炼成一门艺术。只要能逃离这些拟膜怪反复将你推入的痛苦，怎样都好。你甚至几乎感觉不到寄生虫正以各种怪异而不自然的方式操纵身体。你觉得，一切都与往常相同。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve honed the act of retreating back to your subconscious into an art at this point. Anything to escape the repeated anguish these Mimbranes throw you under. You can barely even feel the parasites manipulating your body in all sorts of strange and unnatural ways. It’s the same as always, you figure."

rows.original: You’ve given up trying to figure out why you keep losing to what amounts to a rag in the wind. You can’t concentrate immediately after the fact, and when the parasite’s on you, you’re done caring. Are you even frustrated anymore? When something becomes so commonplace, can someone continue to act surprised?
rows.translation: 你已经放弃追究，为何自己总会输给一块随风飘荡的破布。事发后你根本无法集中精神；等寄生虫爬上身体，你也不再在意。你如今还会感到沮丧吗？一件事变得如此寻常后，人还能继续表现得惊讶吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve given up trying to figure out why you keep losing to what amounts to a rag in the wind. You can’t concentrate immediately after the fact, and when the parasite’s on you, you’re done caring. Are you even frustrated anymore? When something becomes so commonplace, can someone continue to act surprised?"

rows.original: The commotion calms down, leaving only your labored panting to your ears. A moist, deft touch lands on your [pc.foot], snapping you out of the odd bout of self-pity. You can’t get a good view over your struggling [pc.fullChest], but it would appear the parasite has opted to attach itself to your foot. Oily coverings weave their way between your toes, along your arch and up your ankle. As always, little time transpires before your extremity is sealed within the creature’s undulating, form-fitting grip.
rows.translation: 骚动逐渐平息，耳边只剩自己吃力的喘息。湿润而灵巧的触感落在[pc.foot]上，将你从这阵古怪的自怜中惊醒。你无法越过不断挣扎的[pc.fullChest]看清情况，但寄生虫似乎选择附着在脚上。油滑的覆盖物穿过脚趾之间，沿足弓攀上脚踝。一如往常，没过多久，你的肢端便被封进这生物起伏不定、贴合形体的紧握中。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe commotion calms down, leaving only your labored panting to your ears. A moist, deft touch lands on your [pc.foot], snapping you out of the odd bout of self-pity. You can’t get a good view over your struggling [pc.fullChest], but it would appear the parasite has opted to attach itself to your foot. Oily coverings weave their way between your toes, along your arch and up your ankle. As always, little time transpires before your extremity is sealed within the creature’s undulating, form-fitting grip."

rows.original: You cease paying attention to the little thing once the familiar feeling of it weaving its way into your nervous system kicks in. The sensation of forgetting how your body part is constructed is old hat, no matter how bizarre it feels each time. It’ll be over soon anyway; may as well try and focus on something beyond the excruciating humidity and torrents of desire...
rows.translation: 当那种熟悉的、它正钻入神经系统的感觉出现时，你便不再理会这个小东西。忘记自己身体部位如何构成的感觉虽然每次都很诡异，却早已不足为奇。反正很快就会结束；不妨试着把注意力放到别处，避开令人难熬的湿热与汹涌欲望...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou cease paying attention to the little thing once the familiar feeling of it weaving its way into your nervous system kicks in. The sensation of forgetting how your body part is constructed is old hat, no matter how bizarre it feels each time. It’ll be over soon anyway; may as well try and focus on something beyond the excruciating humidity and torrents of desire..."

rows.original: ...Usually it can be difficult to get even the vaguest semblance of a clear head when you’re thrown into a rut like this. Sure, your body still feels like it wants to penetrate and be penetrated and do anything else it can to get through these anxious times. But here, safe in your mind, you’ve at least gotten better at not thinking like a psychopathic pervert. Maybe the repetition of being artificially driven to want to bang something isn’t doing as well of a job as it once did?
rows.translation: ...通常，被抛入这种发情状态时，哪怕想恢复最模糊的一丝清醒也十分困难。当然，你的身体依然渴望插入与被插入，渴望用尽一切办法熬过这些焦躁时刻。但至少在安全的内心深处，你已经越来越不会像一个精神失常的变态那样思考。也许这种反复强行催生的交配欲，已经不如过去那么有效了？
rows.raw: "\n\n...Usually it can be difficult to get even the vaguest semblance of a clear head when you’re thrown into a rut like this. Sure, your body still feels like it wants to penetrate and be penetrated and do anything else it can to get through these anxious times. But here, safe in your mind, you’ve at least gotten better at not thinking like a psychopathic pervert. Maybe the repetition of being artificially driven to want to bang something isn’t doing as well of a job as it once did?"

rows.translation: 你透过一道低矮的植物墙发现了什么：一片直径数十英尺、晶蓝如水晶的圆形湖面，平静而安宁。你很高兴再次见到阳光，于是迈步向前；但很快便意识到这里不止你一人。一曲轻柔的异星歌谣随风飘来，语言舒缓而婉转，肃穆美感近乎催眠。你循声前进，寻找歌声源头；[pc.ears]很快将你引向小湖岸边不远处的一道孤独身影。那是一位美丽的女性，正涉过齐腰深的湖水。她闭着双眼，面朝你的方向，双手梳理长长的橙发，让你将裸露胸膛上那对硕大、完美而浑圆的乳房尽收眼底。她的躯干似乎完全覆盖着纤薄顺滑的毛皮，在水中闪闪发亮，带有鲜艳的黑橙虎纹，与飘逸长发颇为相似。她的声音完美地越过宁静湖面，异星旋律引人入胜，充满诱惑。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou notice something just through a small wall of growth: a crystal blue circle some few dozen feet across, placid and quiet. Happy to see the sun again, you make your way forward, though soon you realize that you are not alone here: a quiet alien song is carried by the wind, the language languid and lilting, almost hypnotic in its solemn beauty. You step forward, searching for the source, and your [pc.ears] soon lead you to a lone figure just beyond the shore of the small lake, a beautiful feminine figure wading through the waist-high water. With eyes closed, the woman faces you, hands running through long orange hair, giving you a perfect view of the large, perfect round breasts on her bare chest. Her torso seems wholly covered in thin, smooth fur that glistens in the water, bearing a bright tiger stripe pattern of black and orange, not unlike her flowing locks. Her voice carries perfectly over the quiet lake, her alien melody captivating and alluring."

rows.original: To your surprise, the woman grins at you, hands resting on her hips just below the water’s surface, doing nothing to hide her bosom. “Well, well, what have we here?” she says, voice soft and smooth, alien despite the nearly human face it comes from. Her pointed, feline ears perk up as she glides toward you, moving with a stepless grace. You stumble back, hand grasping a weapon as the woman approaches, her form sliding out of the water to reveal a long, reptilian tail in place of legs, easily longer than the feline body atop it. Your Codex gives an alarmed chirp, identifying the creature as a Naleen, the apex predator on Mhen’ga.
rows.translation: 令你惊讶的是，女子朝你咧嘴一笑，双手搭在水面下方的髋部，丝毫没有遮掩胸脯。“哎呀、哎呀，看看这是谁？”她说道，声音柔和顺滑；尽管来自一张近似人类的脸庞，听来却充满异星感。她尖尖的猫耳竖了起来，以不见步伐的优雅姿态向你滑来。女子靠近时，你踉跄后退，伸手握住武器；她的身体滑出水面，显露出取代双腿的修长爬行类尾巴，长度轻易超过上方的猫科躯干。你的终端发出警报般的鸣叫，将这种生物识别为纳林，正是门加的顶级掠食者。

rows.original: She’s lived on mhen’ga her entire life, so she can probably shed some light on the planet for you. “You’ve been here longer than I have, so I was hoping you could help me with the jungle?” you ask her. “Hmm, well, I can try, but a lot of things that might be notable to you, might be mundane for me... But I’ll try to help,” she agrees as she gets up. “Let’s see,” she mutters to herself, digging through the pile of junk she’s stolen. “Ah, this’ll do,” she says, grabbing a tattered shirt and a piece of charcoal from the burned out fire pit. She draws a crude map of the jungle onto the fabric. “Up far forth is all zil, past the cliffs. Around here,” she says, poking the charcoal at the area around her cave. “You’ll run into zil, other naleen, and those weird snakes with pussies on their tails — plus me, of course,” she purrs lustfully. “Oh, and I did run into one of those frog ladies once. And if you see any of those plant bitches, don’t trust them, just steer clear.” She gestures down at the middle portion of the crude map. “Down here there’s not much... more naleen, those plant bitches, and some parasites. Although I did see a strange rock once, but I don’t tend to go down there, so I don’t remember where.” Continuing further south on her map, she continues telling you what she’s seen. “Right between these two areas, I saw a metal rock that’s blown the trees away. It’s next to a weird talking ball made from metal. I don’t tend to wander deeper into the woods past that point. The tentacle ladies that live down there aren’t that welcoming.” “Oh, and there’s some weird metal log standing upright over here,” she says, pointing at the eastern part of the jungle. “Saw it once, but I’m not going to poke my nose into rusher stuff further,” she continues. “That’s about everything noteworthy nearby I can think of,” she finishes, tossing the charcoal into the direction of the fire pit. She wipes her palm clean and leans closer to you, “So, how about we forget about that, and I’ll show you around my body instead?” she purrs.

rows.original: When you tell your mate that you’d like to just spend some time together, the naleen frowns, obviously struggling with this concept. “Not mating? Not fighting? Not hunting? Just... spending time together? Why, what’s the purpose?! Is this something star-dwellers often do?”
rows.translation: 你告诉伴侣自己只想和他共度一段时光时，纳利恩皱起眉头，显然很难理解这个概念。“不交配？不战斗？不狩猎？只是...一起度过时间？为什么，有什么目的？！这是住在星星上的人经常做的事吗？”
rows.raw: "When you tell your mate that you’d like to just spend some time together, the naleen frowns, obviously struggling with this concept. “Not mating? Not fighting? Not hunting? Just... spending time together? Why, what’s the purpose?! Is this something star-dwellers often do?”"

rows.original: You can’t help chuckling at the barrage of questions, which prompts him to stare at you with a mix of annoyance and confusion, failing to understand what’s so funny. A few seconds later, you answer his question, saying that it’s a very common thing your people do, a... bonding ritual of sorts.
rows.translation: 一连串问题令你忍不住轻笑；他带着恼火与困惑交织的神情盯着你，完全不明白哪里好笑。几秒后，你回答他的问题，说这是你的族人非常常见的行为，一种...类似增进感情的仪式。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t help chuckling at the barrage of questions, which prompts him to stare at you with a mix of annoyance and confusion, failing to understand what’s so funny. A few seconds later, you answer his question, saying that it’s a very common thing your people do, a... bonding ritual of sorts."

rows.original: The naleen regards you with renewed respect and waits for you to elaborate. Pursing your [pc.lipsChaste] in thought, you try to find the words to explain it in a way that will make it appealing to him – it’s a ritual to strengthen the connection between two or more people, so that... so that they can be better for each other.
rows.translation: 纳利恩重新以尊敬的目光看待你，等待进一步说明。你若有所思地噘起[pc.lipsChaste]，试图找到一种能让他产生兴趣的解释方式–这是一种强化两人或多人之间联系的仪式，这样...这样大家就能更好地对待彼此。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe naleen regards you with renewed respect and waits for you to elaborate. Pursing your [pc.lipsChaste] in thought, you try to find the words to explain it in a way that will make it appealing to him – it’s a ritual to strengthen the connection between two or more people, so that... so that they can be better for each other."

rows.original: Surprisingly, your mate nods in agreement, “A hunter has to be able to take care of oneself, but sometimes one’s strength alone is not enough. What’s involved in this ritual? Do we make offerings to the ancestors, sing to appease nature spirits? Perhaps perform the cleansing dance under the rain?”
rows.translation: 出乎意料的是，伴侣赞同地点了点头。“猎人必须有能力照顾自己，但有时仅凭个人力量并不足够。这项仪式包含什么？我们要向祖先献上供品，唱歌安抚自然之灵？或许还要在雨中表演净化之舞？”
rows.raw: "\n\nSurprisingly, your mate nods in agreement, “A hunter has to be able to take care of oneself, but sometimes one’s strength alone is not enough. What’s involved in this ritual? Do we make offerings to the ancestors, sing to appease nature spirits? Perhaps perform the cleansing dance under the rain?”"

rows.original: You chuckle yet again and tell him it’s not that complicated, you just have to tell each other about yourselves – things you like, things you don’t like, things you did recently – and ask what you’re curious to know about the other person. So as not to make the ‘ritual’ too mundane, you add that it works better when sharing some food. As a sort of offering, yes.
rows.translation: 你再次轻笑，告诉他事情没那么复杂；你们只需互相讲述自身情况–喜欢的事物、不喜欢的事物、最近做过的事情–再询问自己对对方感到好奇的内容。为了不让这场“仪式”显得过于平淡，你又补充说，分享一些食物时效果更好。没错，就当作某种供品。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou chuckle yet again and tell him it’s not that complicated, you just have to tell each other about yourselves – things you like, things you don’t like, things you did recently – and ask what you’re curious to know about the other person. So as not to make the ‘ritual’ too mundane, you add that it works better when sharing some food. As a sort of offering, yes."

rows.original: The naleen nods slowly, “Well, I don’t have anything on me right now, so guess we’ll have to do it the simple way this time...”
rows.translation: 纳利恩缓缓点头。“好吧，我现在身上什么也没带，看来这次只能用简单方式进行了...”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe naleen nods slowly, “Well, I don’t have anything on me right now, so guess we’ll have to do it the simple way this time...”"

rows.original: With your encouragement, an hour goes by with your mate recounting his more impressive hunts, fights with other males and the time he was captured by a group of vanae huntresses and subjected to their milk, though he managed to escape a few days later. rows.original: The naleen takes you to the entrance of a cave and bids you wait. He returns a few minutes later carrying several items strung neatly on a net slung on his back, made of braided straw rope. Among them, you can see several coconuts and a large clay jar. You question what he’s going to do with all that, but he tells you it’s a surprise and proceeds to lead you on an hour-long walk.
rows.translation: 纳林带你来到一处洞穴入口，嘱咐你留在原地等待。几分钟后，他带着几件物品返回；它们整齐串在一张编织稻草绳制成、斜挎在背后的网兜上。其中，你看见了几颗椰子和一只大陶罐。你问他准备拿这些东西做什么，他却只说这是惊喜，随后领着你步行了整整一小时。

You question what he’s going to do with all that, but he tells you it’s a surprise and proceeds to lead you on an hour-long walk."

rows.translation: 船员们尽最大努力协助你，手忙脚乱地满足你的每项需求。你轻声发笑–有时他们似乎比你还要紧张，但不知怎的，仅仅有人陪伴就能让你安心。在熟悉的环境里，放松要容易得多。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour crew assists you as best they can, frantically providing for your every need. You chuckle – at times, they seem more nervous than you, but somehow their mere presence puts you at ease. It’s much easier to relax in a familiar environment. "

rows.original: Azra, especially, is very helpful, assisting you with her vast experience as a mother.
rows.translation: 阿兹拉尤其帮得上忙，以身为母亲的丰富经验协助你。
rows.raw: "Azra, especially, is very helpful, assisting you with her vast experience as a mother."

rows.original: Over the next couple of hours, the pain builds up to the point where you know you’re very close to giving birth. Contractions come close together, lasting over a minute each, but you don’t want to push before you’re fully dilated, so you hold out for another several minutes. When the time is right, you assume a kneeling position and begin to push, groaning from the painful strain but trying to focus your efforts where it counts.
rows.translation: 接下来几个小时里，疼痛不断增强，令你知道分娩已经非常接近。宫缩间隔很短，每次持续超过一分钟；但你不想在宫口完全张开前用力，于是又坚持了几分钟。时机成熟后，你采取跪姿，开始用力；痛苦的紧绷令你呻吟，但仍努力把力量集中在关键部位。
rows.raw: "\n\nOver the next couple of hours, the pain builds up to the point where you know you’re very close to giving birth. Contractions come close together, lasting over a minute each, but you don’t want to push before you’re fully dilated, so you hold out for another several minutes. When the time is right, you assume a kneeling position and begin to push, groaning from the painful strain but trying to focus your efforts where it counts."

rows.original: Slowly, you feel the first snake-kitten traveling down your canal, until its bald head emerges a few minutes later. The rest of the body soon follows, revealing a long lower half already covered in smooth scales, even though the fur coat on their upper is still very thin. The sex is impossible to determine at this stage, since their genitals are concealed.
rows.translation: 你缓缓感觉第一只蛇猫幼崽沿产道移动；几分钟后，光秃秃的脑袋探了出来。身体其余部分很快随之而出，露出已被光滑鳞片覆盖的修长下身，尽管上身毛发依旧十分稀薄。此阶段无法判断性别，因为生殖器还隐藏着。
rows.raw: "\n\nSlowly, you feel the first snake-kitten traveling down your canal, until its bald head emerges a few minutes later. The rest of the body soon follows, revealing a long lower half already covered in smooth scales, even though the fur coat on their upper is still very thin. The sex is impossible to determine at this stage, since their genitals are concealed."

rows.original: As you cradle the kit in your arms, you’re worried at first, because they aren’t crying. However, this worry melts away as the baby opens their cat-snake eyes, looking into yours with curiosity, and lets out a little laugh. You smile back beatifically. Yes, your child is perfectly healthy, naleen are just that quiet.
rows.translation: 你把幼崽抱在怀里，起初因其没有哭泣而感到担忧。不过，宝宝睁开猫蛇般的双眼，好奇地望着你，又轻轻笑出声时，忧虑便烟消云散。你慈爱地回以微笑。没错，你的孩子非常健康；纳林就是如此安静。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you cradle the kit in your arms, you’re worried at first, because they aren’t crying. However, this worry melts away as the baby opens their cat-snake eyes, looking into yours with curiosity, and lets out a little laugh. You smile back beatifically. Yes, your child is perfectly healthy, naleen are just that quiet."

rows.original: Your mate gently cleans them up and puts
rows.translation: 你的伴侣温柔地把幼崽清理干净，随后将其放到
rows.raw: "\n\nYour mate gently cleans them up and puts"

rows.original: Your helper gently cleans them up and puts
rows.translation: 你的帮手温柔地把幼崽清理干净，随后将其放到
rows.raw: "\n\nYour helper gently cleans them up and puts"

rows.original: You clean them up and put
rows.translation: 你把他们清理干净，并将
rows.raw: "\n\nYou clean them up and put"

rows.original: your kit in the cradle. After a brief moment of respite, you begin to deliver their sibling – the process repeats until the cradle is filled with an entire litter of little half-naleen. By the end of it, you are simply exhausted, but also incredibly happy and relieved.
rows.translation: 你的幼崽放进摇篮。短暂喘息后，你开始接生他们的兄弟姐妹 – 这个过程不断重复，直至摇篮里装满一整窝半纳琳幼崽。结束时，你已经精疲力竭，却也无比幸福、如释重负。
rows.raw: " your kit in the cradle. After a brief moment of respite, you begin to deliver their sibling – the process repeats until the cradle is filled with an entire litter of little half-naleen. By the end of it, you are simply exhausted, but also incredibly happy and relieved."

rows.original: Despite the soreness, you make sure to feed each of your kits in turn, bringing their face to your bosom for their first feeding of [pc.milkNoun]. Afterwards, you gaze lovingly at your children, watching as they doze off into a peaceful sleep, all properly clean and fed.
rows.translation: 尽管身体酸痛，你仍确保依次喂养每个幼崽，将他们的脸带到胸前，第一次喂食[pc.milkNoun]。随后，你慈爱地凝望孩子，看着已经清洗干净、吃饱喝足的他们逐渐进入安稳梦乡。
rows.raw: "\n\nDespite the soreness, you make sure to feed each of your kits in turn, bringing their face to your bosom for their first feeding of [pc.milkNoun]. Afterwards, you gaze lovingly at your children, watching as they doze off into a peaceful sleep, all properly clean and fed."

rows.original: mhen’ga
rows.raw: "mhen’ga"

rows.original: NaleenMale
rows.raw: "NaleenMale"

rows.original: Then, your gaze falls upon your mate, who’s watching the kids enraptured. Gently, you draw him out of his daze, whispering the questions that have been burning in your mind for the past minute: does he want to keep the kits? Can he even care for them?
rows.translation: 接着，你的目光落到伴侣身上；他正入迷地注视孩子。你轻柔地让他回过神来，低声问出过去一分钟里一直萦绕脑海的问题：他想留下这些幼崽吗？他真的有能力照顾他们吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nThen, your gaze falls upon your mate, who’s watching the kids enraptured. Gently, you draw him out of his daze, whispering the questions that have been burning in your mind for the past minute: does he want to keep the kits? Can he even care for them?"

rows.original: The naleen looks torn for a moment. At length, he replies: “Yes, but... the jungle has been changing very fast since your star-peoples arrived, and it will continue to change, probably in ways I can’t even imagine. So I... I think they’ll have a better future with you, my mate.”
rows.translation: 纳琳一时显得十分纠结。良久后，他回答：“想，但...自从你们星际来客抵达后，丛林变化得非常快，而且还会继续变化，大概会以我根本无法想象的方式。所以我...我觉得跟着你，他们会有更好的未来，我的伴侣。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe naleen looks torn for a moment. At length, he replies: “Yes, but... the jungle has been changing very fast since your star-peoples arrived, and it will continue to change, probably in ways I can’t even imagine. So I... I think they’ll have a better future with you, my mate.”"

rows.original: As he finishes, you can see pain in his expression. It’s obvious he wants to stay with his kids, but he’s putting their wellbeing first. You... didn’t expect this kind of selfless foresight.
rows.translation: 他说完后，你能看见脸上的痛苦。他显然想和孩子留在一起，却把他们的福祉放在首位。你...没有料到他会表现出如此无私的远见。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs he finishes, you can see pain in his expression. It’s obvious he wants to stay with his kids, but he’s putting their wellbeing first. You... didn’t expect this kind of selfless foresight."

rows.original: Nodding in agreement, you tap a few buttons on the Codex, calling for the drones that will take your kids to the Tavros nursery. In the minutes before that happens, you take the chance to snuggle with your mate, reassuring him that the kits will be well-cared for. He doesn’t exactly understand most of what you try to describe from your homeworld, but he accepts it nonetheless.
rows.translation: 你赞同地点头，在CODEX终端上轻触几个按钮，呼叫无人机把孩子送往塔夫罗斯站育儿所。在无人机抵达前的几分钟里，你趁机依偎伴侣，向他保证幼崽会得到妥善照顾。对于你试图描述的母星事物，他大多无法准确理解，却仍接受了这个决定。
rows.raw: "\n\nNodding in agreement, you tap a few buttons on the Codex, calling for the drones that will take your kids to the Tavros nursery. In the minutes before that happens, you take the chance to snuggle with your mate, reassuring him that the kits will be well-cared for. He doesn’t exactly understand most of what you try to describe from your homeworld, but he accepts it nonetheless."

rows.original: Before leaving, he gives you a warm smile and a kiss, followed by a possessive love bite on your neck. Thankfully, it’s poison-free this time. “See you later, my mate,” he winks.
rows.translation: 离开前，他向你露出温暖笑容并送上一吻，随后又占有欲十足地在颈上留下爱咬。幸好这次没有毒。“回头见，我的伴侣，”他眨眼说道。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore leaving, he gives you a warm smile and a kiss, followed by a possessive love bite on your neck. Thankfully, it’s poison-free this time. “See you later, my mate,” he winks."

rows.original: However, you know they can’t stay with you, not when you’re in a dangerous mission that constantly puts you in harm’s way. And so, tapping a few buttons on the Codex, you call for the drones that will take your naleen litter to the Tavros nursery.
rows.translation: 然而，你知道他们不能留在身边；你正在执行一项危险任务，时时刻刻都可能身陷险境。于是，你在CODEX终端上轻触几个按钮，呼叫无人机把这窝纳琳幼崽送往塔夫罗斯站育儿所。
rows.raw: "\n\nHowever, you know they can’t stay with you, not when you’re in a dangerous mission that constantly puts you in harm’s way. And so, tapping a few buttons on the Codex, you call for the drones that will take your naleen litter to the Tavros nursery."

rows.original: The minutes pass in a blissful daze as you rest next to your children, basking in the warm feelings of motherhood, your heart filled with pride, relief and immense love. Once the drones arrive, you gently tuck your sleeping kits inside the life-support capsules, sending them off with a wistful smile. They’ve only been away for a few minutes, and you already miss them.
rows.translation: 你在孩子身旁休息，沉浸在母性的温暖感受中，内心充满骄傲、宽慰与无尽爱意；几分钟在幸福恍惚间流逝。无人机抵达后，你轻柔地把熟睡幼崽安置进生命维持舱，带着依依不舍的微笑送他们离开。他们才离开几分钟，你便已经开始想念。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe minutes pass in a blissful daze as you rest next to your children, basking in the warm feelings of motherhood, your heart filled with pride, relief and immense love. Once the drones arrive, you gently tuck your sleeping kits inside the life-support capsules, sending them off with a wistful smile. They’ve only been away for a few minutes, and you already miss them."

rows.original: You should pay them a visit as soon as you recover...
rows.translation: 恢复之后，你应该尽快去看望他们...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou should pay them a visit as soon as you recover..."

rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.raw: "Skom"

rows.translation: 纳琳幼崽
