rows.original: You approach your kits and hold one of them in your arms. They look puzzled at you for a short moment until their eyes shine with recognition, and they begin to wave their little arms about, trying to grasp your fingers. Ouch – those claws are already sharp! You make soothing sounds to calm them down, then
rows.translation: 你走近幼崽，将其中一个抱在怀里。他们先困惑地看了你一会儿，随后双眼因认出你而发亮，开始挥舞小手，试图抓住你的手指。好痛 – 那些爪子已经很锋利了！你发出安抚声让他们平静下来，随后
rows.raw: "You approach your kits and hold one of them in your arms. They look puzzled at you for a short moment until their eyes shine with recognition, and they begin to wave their little arms about, trying to grasp your fingers. Ouch – those claws are already sharp! You make soothing sounds to calm them down, then "

rows.translation: 袒露胸口，把他们带到乳头前喂食[pc.milkNoun]。
rows.raw: "bare your chest, bringing them to a nipple for some [pc.milkNoun]."

rows.original: play with them for a bit.
rows.translation: 陪他们玩上一会儿。
rows.raw: "play with them for a bit."

rows.original: After a few minutes, a sibling begins to mewl, trying to get your attention. Such a crybaby, that one! Patiently, you put the one in your arms down and start tickling their sibling as payback. They love it! After playing for a couple of minutes, you
rows.translation: 几分钟后，一个兄弟姐妹开始喵喵叫，试图吸引你的注意。这孩子真爱哭！你耐心地放下怀中幼崽，开始挠其兄弟姐妹的痒作为报复。他们非常喜欢！玩了几分钟后，你
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a few minutes, a sibling begins to mewl, trying to get your attention. Such a crybaby, that one! Patiently, you put the one in your arms down and start tickling their sibling as payback. They love it! After playing for a couple of minutes, you "

rows.original: bring them to your chest for some [pc.milk] as well. Not long after this, yet another kit mewls, prompting you to bring them to your other breast. Sheesh, they’re so demanding! But at the same time, tending to their needs is so satisfying...
rows.translation: 也把他们带到胸前喂食[pc.milk]。没过多久，又一只幼崽喵喵叫起来，促使你把他们带到另一只乳房前。天啊，他们要求真多！但与此同时，满足他们的需求又让人如此充实...
rows.raw: "bring them to your chest for some [pc.milk] as well. Not long after this, yet another kit mewls, prompting you to bring them to your other breast. Sheesh, they’re so demanding! But at the same time, tending to their needs is so satisfying..."

rows.original: decide to sing for them.
rows.translation: 决定唱歌给他们听。
rows.raw: "decide to sing for them."

rows.original: You spend the next couple of hours doting on each and every one of your naleen babies before tucking them in the cradle and singing a lullaby, until they doze off into a peaceful sleep, filled with happy dreams.
rows.translation: 接下来几个小时，你宠爱照顾每一个纳琳宝宝，随后把他们安置进摇篮并唱起摇篮曲，直到他们进入充满美梦的安稳睡眠。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou spend the next couple of hours doting on each and every one of your naleen babies before tucking them in the cradle and singing a lullaby, until they doze off into a peaceful sleep, filled with happy dreams."

rows.original: On your way out, you take the opportunity to instruct the staff on the kits’ fur-care routine. It is imperative that coconut-based products be used daily, and the kits are to be bathed with coconut water at least once a week. Yes, all
rows.translation: 离开时，你趁机向工作人员说明幼崽的毛发护理流程。必须每天使用椰子制品，而且每周至少要用椰子水给幼崽洗一次澡。没错，全部
rows.raw: "\n\nOn your way out, you take the opportunity to instruct the staff on the kits’ fur-care routine. It is imperative that coconut-based products be used daily, and the kits are to be bathed with coconut water at least once a week. Yes, all "

rows.original: of them. Furthermore, coconut is to be included in their diet in balanced amounts. The staff members nod along with confused faces, but their hands never stop taking notes. Good.
rows.translation: 只。此外，日常饮食中还必须加入分量均衡的椰子。工作人员满脸困惑地点头附和，手上却始终没有停止记录。很好。
rows.raw: " of them. Furthermore, coconut is to be included in their diet in balanced amounts. The staff members nod along with confused faces, but their hands never stop taking notes. Good."

rows.raw: "Skom"

rows.original: Naleen Kids
rows.translation: 纳林孩子
rows.raw: "Naleen Kids"

rows.original: They grow so fast! Your naleen children are already able to slither and coil with such grace, you can scarcely believe they were just little kits not so long ago. They can speak, albeit still far from perfectly, and each one of them is already showing individual traits: one is vigorous and athletic, another one is social and charismatic, another one is smart and bookish... Of course, they have their flaws too, but who doesn’t?
rows.translation: 他们长得真快！你的纳林孩子已经能够如此优雅地滑行盘绕，你简直不敢相信，不久前他们还只是小幼崽。他们已经学会说话，尽管离流利还差得很远；而且每一个都已展现出独特性格：一个活力十足、热爱运动，另一个善于社交、魅力非凡，还有一个聪明好学、嗜书如命...当然，他们也有自己的缺点，但谁又没有呢？
rows.raw: "They grow so fast! Your naleen children are already able to slither and coil with such grace, you can scarcely believe they were just little kits not so long ago. They can speak, albeit still far from perfectly, and each one of them is already showing individual traits: one is vigorous and athletic, another one is social and charismatic, another one is smart and bookish... Of course, they have their flaws too, but who doesn’t?"

rows.original: It’s easy to fantasize about what their futures will be, but for now you just want to spend some time with them, before they grow even more. As soon as you make your presence known, your kits swarm you, fighting to see who can wrap their arms and coils on you faster. Soon enough, you’re on the floor, bound by several snake-kittens eager to show just how much they adore their
rows.translation: 想象他们未来会成为怎样的人十分容易，但眼下，你只想趁他们还没有长得更大，陪伴他们一段时间。你刚一现身，幼崽们便蜂拥而来，争抢着看谁能最快用双臂和蛇身缠住你。很快，你便倒在地板上，被好几只蛇猫幼崽牢牢捆住；他们迫不及待地想要展现自己有多么爱他们的
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s easy to fantasize about what their futures will be, but for now you just want to spend some time with them, before they grow even more. As soon as you make your presence known, your kits swarm you, fighting to see who can wrap their arms and coils on you faster. rows.translation: 父亲
rows.raw: "father"

rows.original: mother
rows.translation: 母亲
rows.raw: "mother"

rows.original: It takes a while to convince them to let you go, and once you do, they start proposing all sorts of games. The most popular is hide and seek, with you searching for them in the large jungle playground. Did the staff expand this area even more?
rows.translation: 你花了一番功夫才说服他们放开自己，随后他们便开始提出各种游戏。其中最受欢迎的是捉迷藏，由你在宽阔的丛林游乐场中寻找他们。工作人员是不是又扩建了这片区域？
rows.raw: "\n\nIt takes a while to convince them to let you go, and once you do, they start proposing all sorts of games. The most popular is hide and seek, with you searching for them in the large jungle playground. Did the staff expand this area even more?"

rows.original: The games go on for a few hours, until Briget gently interrupts you, saying it’s time for the kids to study. They barrage her with boos and awws, but the nurse-maid gynoid is as strict with them as she was with you – which you find very reassuring even as it fills you with nostalgia.
rows.translation: 游戏持续了几个小时，直到布丽姬特温柔地打断你，说孩子们该去学习了。他们用嘘声和哀叹轮番轰炸她，可这位保姆型雌性机器人对他们依旧严格，一如当年对待你时那样–这让你感到无比安心，同时又心生怀念。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe games go on for a few hours, until Briget gently interrupts you, saying it’s time for the kids to study. They barrage her with boos and awws, but the nurse-maid gynoid is as strict with them as she was with you – which you find very reassuring even as it fills you with nostalgia."

rows.original: With a pang of longing, you say goodbye to your naleen kids, promising to come visit them again soon. You know they won’t be in the nursery forever, eventually they’ll have to go to school and learn how to socialize with other species, so you should dote on them while they’re still young.
rows.translation: 你怀着一阵不舍向纳林孩子们道别，答应很快还会再来看望他们。你知道他们不会永远待在育儿室里，最终必须去上学，学习如何与其他种族交往；所以趁他们还小，你应该尽情宠爱。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith a pang of longing, you say goodbye to your naleen kids, promising to come visit them again soon. You know they won’t be in the nursery forever, eventually they’ll have to go to school and learn how to socialize with other species, so you should dote on them while they’re still young."

rows.original: “Here, starwalker,” coos the female zil sitting next to you, dangling a thin vine covered in bloated, oblong fruits. Going off her unfocused eyes, she’s already pretty drunk. “Open wide...” You let her lean over you, breathing in her fermented honey scent as she feeds you the fruits - watery, fizzy, citrusy. Those are - those are pretty nice! She giggles as, enthused, you reach out and tear off a leg of dark green meat. What do you know: It tastes like chicken.
rows.translation: “来吧，星行者，”坐在旁边的雌性泽尔轻声说道，手中晃着一根细藤，上面结满肿胀的椭圆果实。从她失焦的双眼判断，她已经醉得不轻。“把嘴张大……”你任她俯身靠近，呼吸发酵蜂蜜的香气，让她把果实喂进嘴里；多汁、带气泡，充满柑橘味。它们，它们还挺好吃！你兴奋地伸手撕下一条深绿色烤肉，她随即咯咯笑起来。真没想到，它吃起来居然像鸡肉。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Here, starwalker,” coos the female zil sitting next to you, dangling a thin vine covered in bloated, oblong fruits. Going off her unfocused eyes, she’s already pretty drunk. “Open wide...” You let her lean over you, breathing in her fermented honey scent as she feeds you the fruits - watery, fizzy, citrusy. Those are - those are pretty nice! She giggles as, enthused, you reach out and tear off a leg of dark green meat. What do you know: It tastes like chicken."

rows.original: You rise from the table maybe an hour later, mouth greasy, gut full. You’ve got all the calories you’ll need to keep you going through the night, but... oof... you hope nobody’s going to ask you to move fast anytime soon.
rows.translation: 大约一小时后，你从桌边起身，嘴里油腻腻的，肚子也填得满满当当。维持整夜活动所需的热量已经全部摄入，不过……呃……你希望短时间内没人要求自己快速移动。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou rise from the table maybe an hour later, mouth greasy, gut full. You’ve got all the calories you’ll need to keep you going through the night, but... oof... you hope nobody’s going to ask you to move fast anytime soon."

rows.original: The lean male slaps away your hand when you tentatively reach for one of the stone jugs hanging from a nearby tree.

rows.original: “No. Unless you want blindness. Not properly brewed yet. Here.” He picks up another, virtually identical jug, and pours out two cups, thrusting one into your hand. “To the pollen! To our Quinn!” You swallow it back with him. It’s mead, basically - mead, with its intense fire buried low under the crashing sweetness of honey.
rows.translation: “不行，除非你想失明。还没正确酿好。拿这个。”他拿起另一只几乎完全相同的壶，倒出两杯，把其中一杯塞进你手里。“敬花粉！敬我们的奎因！”你和他一同仰头喝下。基本上就是蜂蜜酒；它猛烈的灼烧感深埋在蜂蜜冲击般的甜味之下。
rows.raw: "\n\n“No. Unless you want blindness. Not properly brewed yet. Here.” He picks up another, virtually identical jug, and pours out two cups, thrusting one into your hand. “To the pollen! To our Quinn!” You swallow it back with him. It’s mead, basically - mead, with its intense fire buried low under the crashing sweetness of honey."

rows.original: “All good things come from the sweetness,” the male says, grinning as he watches you blink a couple of times. “Come! Drink again! I insist. To the breezes! To our Quinn!”
rows.translation: “一切美好事物都源于甜蜜，”雄性微笑着说道，看着你眨了几下眼睛。“来！再喝一杯！我坚持。敬微风！敬我们的奎因！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“All good things come from the sweetness,” the male says, grinning as he watches you blink a couple of times. “Come! Drink again! I insist. To the breezes! To our Quinn!”"

rows.original: Yeah! To the breezes! To the... thingie. You stagger through the crowd a bit later, cup still in hand, feeling much warmer, relaxed and friendly about all the nice, yellow and black people you’re spending this evening with.
rows.translation: 对！敬微风！敬...那个什么。过了一会儿，你手里仍端着杯子，踉踉跄跄地穿过人群，感觉暖和许多，身心放松，也对今晚共度时光的所有黄黑相间的好人们倍感亲切。
rows.raw: "\n\nYeah! To the breezes! To the... thingie. You stagger through the crowd a bit later, cup still in hand, feeling much warmer, relaxed and friendly about all the nice, yellow and black people you’re spending this evening with."

rows.original: “I see you as... a firebird. Yeeess,” she breathes, painting cold stripes of orange and red dye onto your arms and face. You try not to flinch as she works. “From the sky you come in your fiery silver bird, and you burn amongst us, changing everything and catching the eye with your rebirth. Yes!” She plops her brushes back into her pots, beaming proudly at the wide patterns of fiery colors she’s painted onto you. “Now go and dance, firebird. Shake your feathers!”
rows.translation: “在我眼中，你就像...一只火鸟。没错，”她轻声说道，将一道道冰凉的橙红染料涂上你的手臂与脸庞。她工作时，你竭力忍住不退缩。“你乘着燃烧的银色巨鸟从天空降临，在我们中间燃烧，改变一切，以重生吸引所有目光。没错！”她把画笔扔回罐中，骄傲地看着涂在你身上那些宽阔的烈焰色彩纹样，笑容满面。“现在去跳舞吧，火鸟。抖动你的羽毛！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I see you as... a firebird. Yeeess,” she breathes, painting cold stripes of orange and red dye onto your arms and face. You try not to flinch as she works. “From the sky you come in your fiery silver bird, and you burn amongst us, changing everything and catching the eye with your rebirth. Yes!” She plops her brushes back into her pots, beaming proudly at the wide patterns of fiery colors she’s painted onto you. “Now go and dance, firebird. Shake your feathers!”"

rows.original: You’re slightly self-conscious of it as you mingle back amongst the crowd, but the stuff quickly dries, sinking into your [pc.skin], so that it’s only when you wave your arms around that you remember you look like you’ve had a serious accident with a sun tan bed.
rows.translation: 你回到人群中交际时，对这身打扮略感不自在，不过染料很快便干透，渗入[pc.skin]；只有挥动手臂时，你才会想起自己看起来仿佛在日晒床上遭遇了一场严重事故。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re slightly self-conscious of it as you mingle back amongst the crowd, but the stuff quickly dries, sinking into your [pc.skin], so that it’s only when you wave your arms around that you remember you look like you’ve had a serious accident with a sun tan bed."

rows.translation: 你在坡道底部撞见了拉赫。这名奥萨人手中拿着一只满得危险的石罐，还把毛皮披肩换成了一顶白色羽毛头饰。
rows.raw: "You stumble into Lah at the bottom of the ramp. The ausar’s got a dangerously full stone jar in his hand, and he’s substituted his fur stole for a head-dress of white feathers."

rows.original: “Hear you’re taking part in - in Quinn’s big ritual later,” he grins. “That’s cool. If I’m honest I - I’ve never been big into these sexual dynamics all of these native races are into. Performo...performing... nervousness, I guess. It’s good you’re here to take on that kind of thing.”
rows.translation: “听说你晚些时候要参加 - 参加奎因的盛大仪式，”他咧嘴笑道。“挺酷的。说实话，我 - 我一直不太擅长这些本地种族喜欢的性关系。表演...表演...紧张吧，我猜。幸好你在这里，能应付那类事情。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hear you’re taking part in - in Quinn’s big ritual later,” he grins. “That’s cool. If I’m honest I - I’ve never been big into these sexual dynamics all of these native races are into. Performo...performing... nervousness, I guess. It’s good you’re here to take on that kind of thing.”"

rows.original: He swills his mead around, standing with you and gazing over the swirling crowd of zil.
rows.translation: 他摇晃着蜂蜜酒，和你站在一起，眺望不断旋转舞动的兹尔人群。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe swills his mead around, standing with you and gazing over the swirling crowd of zil."

rows.original: “But it’s great, isn’t it?” he slurs. “Seeing all of these rituals of theirs. In... proteiny state. Centuries from now they’ll be carved in stone, unquestionable, but now, they’re still - still forming. And we’re part of that, me ‘n you.” He slaps you on the shoulder, squeezes you into his lean side. “We’re part of that - that slosh. Changing it for the better. Changing it for the... ooh I’m sloshed. S’cuse me, Steele...”
rows.translation: “不过这很棒，对吧？”他含糊说道。“看着她们所有这些仪式。处于...原始状态。几百年后，它们会被刻进石头里，变得不容质疑，可现在还在 - 还在形成。而我们也是其中一部分，我和你。”他拍了拍你的肩膀，把你拉到精瘦的身侧。“我们是那片 - 那片浪潮的一部分。让它变得更好。让它变得...噢，我喝醉了。失、失陪一下，斯蒂尔...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But it’s great, isn’t it?” he slurs. “Seeing all of these rituals of theirs. In... proteiny state. Centuries from now they’ll be carved in stone, unquestionable, but now, they’re still - still forming. And we’re part of that, me ‘n you.” He slaps you on the shoulder, squeezes you into his lean side. “We’re part of that - that slosh. Changing it for the better. Changing it for the... ooh I’m sloshed. S’cuse me, Steele...”"

rows.original: He staggers off towards the bushes. Shaking your head, you consider your options.
rows.translation: 他踉踉跄跄地走向灌木丛。你摇摇头，考虑起自己的选择。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe staggers off towards the bushes. Shaking your head, you consider your options."

rows.original: “So.” Kane appears out of the gloom at the bottom of the ramp so suddenly and silently you gasp. And, of course, that fills your mouth and head with his scent. So intoxicating and powerful... black, horny memories bloom in your head, and your [pc.knees] turn to water.
rows.translation: “那么。”凯恩如此突然且无声地从坡道底部的阴影中现身，令你倒吸一口气。当然，这也让他的气味灌满你的口鼻与脑海。那香气令人陶醉，强烈无比...黑暗淫荡的记忆在脑中绽放，你的[pc.knees]也软得如同流水。
rows.raw: "“So.” Kane appears out of the gloom at the bottom of the ramp so suddenly and silently you gasp. And, of course, that fills your mouth and head with his scent. So intoxicating and powerful... black, horny memories bloom in your head, and your [pc.knees] turn to water."

rows.original: “You’re taking part in our Quinn’s little ritual,” he says, pupil-less eyes trailing up and down your body. The driest of smiles twitches the corner of his mouth. “As her champion.”
rows.translation: “你要参加我们奎因的小小仪式，”他说道，没有瞳孔的双眼上下打量你的身体。嘴角因一抹极淡的笑意而微微抽动。“作为她的勇士。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re taking part in our Quinn’s little ritual,” he says, pupil-less eyes trailing up and down your body. The driest of smiles twitches the corner of his mouth. “As her champion.”"

rows.original: “Yes.” You couldn’t lie to him even if it wasn’t pointless to; nor could you step away when he strides forward and takes you into his lean, strong arms, hands possessively roaming down your body, coming to rest on your [pc.ass] to give it a good, hard squeeze.
rows.translation: “是。”即便说谎并非毫无意义，你也无法对他撒谎；当他大步上前，把你纳入精瘦有力的双臂时，你同样无法后退。他的双手充满占有欲地游遍身体，最终停在[pc.ass]上，用力挤了一把。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes.” You couldn’t lie to him even if it wasn’t pointless to; nor could you step away when he strides forward and takes you into his lean, strong arms, hands possessively roaming down your body, coming to rest on your [pc.ass] to give it a good, hard squeeze."

rows.original: The tall zil withdraws his hands the next moment and is gone, disappearing back into the shadows as swiftly and silently as he appeared. As if he were nothing more than a sudden, horny apparition conjured up by your own mind. Trying to shake a little sense into yourself, you take stock of your options.

rows.original: Some leather drums are being enthusiastically thumped, along with wooden instruments rather like glockenspiels. The main sound moving the stamping, gyrating crowd though is the vocals, which every zil is joining in with - that wordless, soaring, buzzing sound, which builds and subsides, builds and subsides, seemingly mimicking the way dancers join and leave the central centrifuge of bodies.
rows.translation: 有人正热情地敲打皮鼓，还有一些很像钟琴的木制乐器。不过，真正驱动跺脚扭动人群的主要声音来自歌声，每个兹尔都加入其中 - 那种无词、高亢而嗡鸣的声音时而高涨、时而消退，高涨再消退，仿佛在模仿舞者加入与离开中央人体离心机的过程。

rows.original: It’s a rhythm that makes it easy to wait for a dip and then join in, bouncing your [pc.hips] against countless carapace-clad counterparts, join hands, spin partners and be spun yourself, find the heady, suffocating centre and then be flung back out to the periphery. Build... then subside. Build... then subside. You do your best to mimic the sound, your partners laughing goodnaturedly at your clumsy attempts at it.
rows.translation: 这种节奏让人很容易等待低谷后加入；你用[pc.hips]碰撞无数覆盖甲壳的同伴，彼此牵手，带着舞伴旋转，也任舞伴转动自己，找到令人迷醉窒息的中心，再被甩回外围。高涨...然后消退。高涨...然后消退。你竭力模仿那种声音，舞伴们则善意地嘲笑你笨拙的尝试。

You watch as one of them pulls on the fibrous, tightly-secured vine and then launches himself with it over the river... almost making it to the other side before falling with a bellow and a crash into the water below.

rows.raw: "\n\n“The starwalker!” cheers one. “[pc.He] conquered the cliff. Surely [pc.he] can conquer the river!”"

rows.original: The vine is pushed into your hands amongst shouts, laughter and swigs of honey liquor. You pull at it experimentally, consider the looming drop into the cold, swift water. Oh, what the hell. There’s no backing down in front of drunken teenagers.
rows.translation: 在叫喊、笑声和大口饮用蜂蜜酒的喧闹中，藤蔓被塞进你手里。你试探地拉了拉，望向下方冰冷湍急的河水。哦，管他的。在醉酒青少年面前可不能退缩。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe vine is pushed into your hands amongst shouts, laughter and swigs of honey liquor. You pull at it experimentally, consider the looming drop into the cold, swift water. Oh, what the hell. There’s no backing down in front of drunken teenagers."

rows.original: You firmly grab hold, run backwards a bit, and then launch yourself into thin air. Your heart races as you’re flung way out into the open air. You fix your eye on the opposite shore. You aren’t going to have enough momentum to reach it... or worse, you’ll come down on the awkwardly on the lip... no, no, you’ve got this, you’ve got this! You let go at the apex of the swing, do a reasonable Tarzan impression as you fly through the air, and land in a cloud of sand, following it up with a perfect forward roll.
rows.translation: 你牢牢抓住藤蔓，向后助跑几步，随后纵身跃入空中。身体被远远甩到开阔空域，令你心跳加速。你紧盯对岸。动量不够让你抵达那里...更糟的是，你会以别扭姿势摔在岸边...不，不，你能行，你能行！摆荡到最高点时，你松开双手，在空中飞行时相当逼真地模仿了一回泰山，最后落进一片沙尘，并以完美的前滚翻收尾。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou firmly grab hold, run backwards a bit, and then launch yourself into thin air. Your heart races as you’re flung way out into the open air. You fix your eye on the opposite shore. You aren’t going to have enough momentum to reach it... or worse, you’ll come down on the awkwardly on the lip... no, no, you’ve got this, you’ve got this! You let go at the apex of the swing, do a reasonable Tarzan impression as you fly through the air, and land in a cloud of sand, following it up with a perfect forward roll."

rows.original: The mob of male zil howl and cheer with amazement on the opposite side, and you allow yourself a couple of bows in their direction. STAR-WALK-ER! STAR-WALK-ER! Is still reverberating across the river as you swagger back towards the main party. Void, you feel so pumped after doing that!
rows.translation: 对岸成群的雄性兹尔惊叹地嚎叫欢呼，你也朝他们的方向鞠了几躬。星-行-者！星-行-者！口号依然回荡在河面上，而你趾高气扬地走回主会场。虚空啊，做完这件事后，你感觉浑身充满力量！
rows.raw: "\n\nThe mob of male zil howl and cheer with amazement on the opposite side, and you allow yourself a couple of bows in their direction. STAR-WALK-ER! STAR-WALK-ER! Is still reverberating across the river as you swagger back towards the main party. Void, you feel so pumped after doing that!"

rows.raw: "You are feeling amped up! The temporary sensation increases your physique and aim by 15%, each."

rows.original: You firmly grab hold, run backwards a bit, and then launch yourself into thin air. Your heart races as you’re flung way out into the open air. You’re doing it! You’re doing it! You’re... not doing it. Oh One no, that is way too far to jump.
rows.translation: 你牢牢抓住藤蔓，向后助跑几步，随后纵身跃入空中。身体被远远甩到开阔空域，令你心跳加速。你成功了！你成功了！你...并没有成功。唯一神啊，不行，这距离实在远得跳不过去。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou firmly grab hold, run backwards a bit, and then launch yourself into thin air. Your heart races as you’re flung way out into the open air. You’re doing it! You’re doing it! You’re... not doing it. Oh One no, that is way too far to jump."

rows.original: For a fleeting moment you consider opening your [pc.wings] and letting them do the rest, but then reflect that all of the winged males took their own dunkings fair and square.
rows.translation: 有那么一瞬间，你考虑过展开[pc.wings]完成剩下的路程，可随即想到所有有翼男性都堂堂正正地亲自落水了。
rows.raw: " For a fleeting moment you consider opening your [pc.wings] and letting them do the rest, but then reflect that all of the winged males took their own dunkings fair and square."

rows.original: You let go and cannonball into the cold, deep water below. Refreshing is one word for it.
rows.translation: 你松开手，像炮弹一样坠入下方冰冷的深水。用“提神醒脑”来形容倒也没错。
rows.raw: " You let go and cannonball into the cold, deep water below. Refreshing is one word for it."

rows.original: The zil are laughing fit to burst as they haul you back onto the bank, but it’s pretty good-natured. A jar of warming mead is shoved into your hand, and the pleasant evening air quickly dries your [pc.skinFurScales]
rows.translation: 基尔们把你拉回岸上时，简直笑得快要喘不过气，不过基本没有什么恶意。一罐暖身蜂蜜酒被塞进你手里，宜人的晚风很快吹干了你的[pc.skinFurScales]
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zil are laughing fit to burst as they haul you back onto the bank, but it’s pretty good-natured. A jar of warming mead is shoved into your hand, and the pleasant evening air quickly dries your [pc.skinFurScales]"

rows.original: Ironwood logs with shaven, flat tops - they must have been painstakingly cut down and then hoisted up the waterfall from the lower jungle - have been positioned around the chieftain’s circle. Onto them a smorgasbord of food is being ferried from the cooking fires, which are busy blazing away in the peripheries of the village. Stone urns filled with golden fluid hang from the cedar-like trees.
rows.translation: 削平顶端的铁木原木被摆放在酋长圆形广场四周；它们肯定经过艰苦砍伐，再从下层丛林沿瀑布运到这里。各式各样的食物正从烹饪篝火旁送来，摆到原木上；村庄外围的篝火依旧熊熊燃烧。装满金色液体的石瓮悬挂在雪松般的树木上。
rows.raw: "\n\nIronwood logs with shaven, flat tops - they must have been painstakingly cut down and then hoisted up the waterfall from the lower jungle - have been positioned around the chieftain’s circle. Onto them a smorgasbord of food is being ferried from the cooking fires, which are busy blazing away in the peripheries of the village. Stone urns filled with golden fluid hang from the cedar-like trees."

rows.original: The tribal zil are everywhere, either chatting with one another in groups, sweating over the fires, settling themselves down in front of the feast, or thronging excitedly in the village below. There seems to be way more of them than usual, most of them either painted or in the process of being painted in sticky, garish dyes. The hubbub is the low, ululating buzz of a swarm of drunken wasps. Are other tribes present here, or is it simply that, in the normal course of events, most of them are usually in the jungle below?
rows.translation: 部落里的基尔无处不在：有的三五成群地交谈，有的守着火堆忙得满头大汗，有的在盛宴前坐下，还有的兴奋地聚集在下方村庄里。他们的人数似乎远比平常更多，大多数不是已经涂上彩绘，就是正在用黏稠艳俗的染料上色。四周的喧闹声如同一群醉酒黄蜂低沉而起伏的嗡鸣。这里还有其他部落参加，还是说在正常情况下，他们大多只是在下层丛林活动？
rows.raw: "\n\nThe tribal zil are everywhere, either chatting with one another in groups, sweating over the fires, settling themselves down in front of the feast, or thronging excitedly in the village below. There seems to be way more of them than usual, most of them either painted or in the process of being painted in sticky, garish dyes. The hubbub is the low, ululating buzz of a swarm of drunken wasps. Are other tribes present here, or is it simply that, in the normal course of events, most of them are usually in the jungle below?"

rows.original: The suns have set entirely, and the mood is more serious and tense when you emerge back at the top of the village. The zil seated around the circle of logs are still talking to one another, but in a low murmur, and most of the food and drink has been cleared away.
rows.translation: 两轮太阳已经完全落下。当你重新出现在村庄顶部时，气氛变得更加严肃紧张。围坐在原木圈旁的兹尔仍在互相交谈，但声音低沉得只剩窃窃私语，大部分食物与饮料也已被收走。
rows.raw: "The suns have set entirely, and the mood is more serious and tense when you emerge back at the top of the village. The zil seated around the circle of logs are still talking to one another, but in a low murmur, and most of the food and drink has been cleared away."

rows.original: A drum begins to thump, slow and precise, and the chatter dies entirely. Quinn appears in the torch-light, sedately making her way to her place, at the opposite end of the circle. She’s covered in bright blue dye, wavy patterns of it that subtly frame her small boobs and crotch plate, and her carapace is studded with pieces of amber that catch the light of the flames. On her head is a headdress which must be the skull of a creature with very impressive horns, beads and feathers swaying from its branches. Through the eye sockets, her golden eyes catch the flicker of the firelight.
rows.translation: 鼓声开始响起，缓慢而精准，交谈声彻底消失。奎因出现在火炬光芒中，庄重地走向自己位于圆环另一端的位置。她浑身涂满亮蓝色染料，波浪般的纹样巧妙勾勒着小巧乳房与胯甲的轮廓；甲壳上镶嵌着块块琥珀，捕捉着火焰的光辉。她头戴一顶饰冠，似乎取自某种拥有惊人巨角的生物头骨，串珠与羽毛从角枝上摇曳垂下。她金色的双眼透过眼窝，映照着跳动的火光。
rows.raw: "\n\nA drum begins to thump, slow and precise, and the chatter dies entirely. Quinn appears in the torch-light, sedately making her way to her place, at the opposite end of the circle. She’s covered in bright blue dye, wavy patterns of it that subtly frame her small boobs and crotch plate, and her carapace is studded with pieces of amber that catch the light of the flames. On her head is a headdress which must be the skull of a creature with very impressive horns, beads and feathers swaying from its branches. Through the eye sockets, her golden eyes catch the flicker of the firelight."

rows.original: The seat to her right is empty. You don’t need any prompts from the runner to [pc.move] across and settle yourself down there. Quinn’s expression doesn’t waver; she looks carved, like some ancient deity that has stepped out of the night, a vision somewhere between life and death.
rows.translation: 她右侧的座位空着。不用带路人提醒，你便[pc.move]过去，在那里坐下。奎因的表情纹丝不动；她仿佛由人雕刻而成，宛如某位从夜色中走出的古老神祇，是一道介于生死之间的幻象。

rows.original: Lah is already in place to her left, resplendent in his white feathered headdress. He looks uncomfortable, but plentiful amounts of mead seem to have stilled his twitchiness for now.
rows.translation: 拉已经在她左侧就位，头戴白色羽毛饰冠，光彩夺目。他看起来颇不自在，但大量蜂蜜酒似乎暂时平息了他的神经质抽动。
rows.raw: " Lah is already in place to her left, resplendent in his white feathered headdress. He looks uncomfortable, but plentiful amounts of mead seem to have stilled his twitchiness for now."

rows.original: Kane is already in place to her left. The rugged zil has made no particular effort to dress up for the occasion, and is slumped scowling in his chair. He can’t hide a certain amount of interest flickering on his face, though, as the drums begin to pick up.
rows.translation: 凯恩已经在她左侧就位。这个粗犷的兹尔并未特意为场合装扮，只是皱着眉瘫坐在椅子上。不过，随着鼓点开始加快，他脸上闪过的几分兴趣却怎么也藏不住。
rows.raw: " Kane is already in place to her left. The rugged zil has made no particular effort to dress up for the occasion, and is slumped scowling in his chair. He can’t hide a certain amount of interest flickering on his face, though, as the drums begin to pick up."

rows.original: “The time for the Droning Ball is upon us,” Quinn intones. She rises and forms a U with her arms above her head, framing the skull crown. “The zpirits demand I produce, for my tribe. To make use of this hallowed, fertile time and usher in the beginnings a new cycle. I have, on my side, one half of the new whole; my starwalker champion that has brought us
rows.translation: “嗡鸣舞会的时刻已经到来，”奎因庄严宣告。她站起身，双臂举过头顶摆成U形，将头骨冠冕框在其中。“泽灵要求我为部族繁衍。我们要利用这段神圣而丰饶的时光，开启崭新的循环。我身边已经有了全新整体的一半；我的星行者勇士为我们带来了
rows.raw: "\n\n“The time for the Droning Ball is upon us,” Quinn intones. She rises and forms a U with her arms above her head, framing the skull crown. “The zpirits demand I produce, for my tribe. To make use of this hallowed, fertile time and usher in the beginnings a new cycle. I have, on my side, one half of the new whole; my starwalker champion that has brought us"

rows.raw: " glorious victory"

rows.original: . Now, I require the other half. Draw, from the ancient stock of my people, the best, the brightest. Who would dare call themselves such?”
rows.translation: 。现在，我需要另一半。从我族古老的血脉中选出最优秀、最耀眼的一位。谁敢如此自称？”
rows.raw: ". Now, I require the other half. Draw, from the ancient stock of my people, the best, the brightest. Who would dare call themselves such?”"

rows.original: “Yes, my Quinn, I would.” A tall, lean male steps into the ring, sinking his assegai into the sand.
rows.translation: “是的，我的奎因，我愿意。”一个高挑精瘦的雄性走入圈中，将阿塞盖矛插进沙地。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes, my Quinn, I would.” A tall, lean male steps into the ring, sinking his assegai into the sand."

rows.original: “Yes, Quinn, I would!” A shorter, more boyish male strides forward, bow clutched in his hand.
rows.translation: “是的，奎因，我愿意！”一名更加矮小、更具少年气的男性大步上前，手中紧握弓箭。

rows.original: You follow Quinn upwards into the darkness. The spell of their skull-crowned deity broken, you can hear the rest of the tribal zil now getting very involved with one another behind you; the lavender-scented woods are alive with the sounds of sighs, gasps, the hum of insect wings and low voices. Clearly this is a night they all look forward to.

rows.original: “All who fought today showed honor and bravery,” Quinn says, calm and composed as a statue. “But it is your victory today that shall be spoken of for many moons to come. Step forward, you three. You have earned the chance to prove yourself in... other ways.”

rows.original: You awake in the heat of the Mhen’gan middle of the day, yawning and stretching, and after a quick wash in the river make your back up to the circle. You find Quinn already stationed back on her grand, carved chair. She looks unperturbed, glossy and clean, as if nothing had transpired last night - except, perhaps, for a slightly wider smile stretching her round face, maybe a certain far-away gleam in her golden eyes. As tactfully as you can, you ask if everything went according to plan.
rows.translation: 你在门加正午的炎热中醒来，一边打哈欠一边伸展身体；在河中迅速洗漱后，你沿原路返回圆圈。你发现奎因已经再次坐上宏伟的雕花座椅。她神色从容，光洁干净，仿佛昨晚什么也没有发生；或许只有圆脸上的笑容变得稍宽了一些，金色双眼里也多了一丝若有所思的遥远光芒。你尽可能委婉地询问一切是否按计划进行。
rows.raw: "You awake in the heat of the Mhen’gan middle of the day, yawning and stretching, and after a quick wash in the river make your back up to the circle. You find Quinn already stationed back on her grand, carved chair. She looks unperturbed, glossy and clean, as if nothing had transpired last night - except, perhaps, for a slightly wider smile stretching her round face, maybe a certain far-away gleam in her golden eyes. As tactfully as you can, you ask if everything went according to plan."

rows.original: “We shall see in the moons to come, won’t we?” comes the cool response. She taps a thoughtful finger on her knee. “But I believe the zpirits were pleased. I’m sorry you weren’t able to overcome my warriors, [pc.name]. But you fought honorably, and I believe the zpirits were pleased. As I told you, you are a blessing upon this tribe, and if I cannot be gotten with child even if I have you by my side... then I shall know it was never meant to be.” She eyes you teasingly. “And perhaps you learnt something about being content with just a slice of the fruit treat, rather than fight and get none, hmm?”
rows.translation: “未来几个月内自然会见分晓，对吧？”她冷静地回答，用一根手指若有所思地轻点膝盖。“不过，我相信泽灵非常满意。很遗憾，你没能战胜我的战士，[pc.name]。但你战斗得十分光荣，我相信泽灵非常满意。正如我告诉你的那样，你是这个部落的福祉；如果有你陪在身边，我仍然无法怀上孩子……那我便会明白，这件事从来不曾命中注定。”她戏谑地打量你。“而且，或许你已经学会满足于只拿一片水果点心，而不是争斗一番，最后什么也得不到，嗯？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We shall see in the moons to come, won’t we?” comes the cool response. She taps a thoughtful finger on her knee. “But I believe the zpirits were pleased. I’m sorry you weren’t able to overcome my warriors, [pc.name]. But you fought honorably, and I believe the zpirits were pleased. As I told you, you are a blessing upon this tribe, and if I cannot be gotten with child even if I have you by my side... then I shall know it was never meant to be.” She eyes you teasingly. “And perhaps you learnt something about being content with just a slice of the fruit treat, rather than fight and get none, hmm?”"

rows.original: You are fighting the trio of male zil who have chosen to contest your claim to Quinn. Generally speaking, they are typical lads for their species - equipped with hoverboard-sized insect wings, clad in sturdy black chitin everywhere except their yellow faces, antennae bobbing above their shaggy brown hair. They are all slathered in arresting, garish war paint. The two wielding short spears are 5' 10" and wiry, athletic and tall, jut-jawed and determined. The other is maybe 5' 8", equipped with a bow and is more effeminate: slim, full thighs and a cute, heart-shaped, yellow face bobbing around in the dusky light.
rows.translation: 你正在与三名雄性兹尔战斗，他们选择挑战你对奎因的所有权。总体而言，他们都是这一物种的典型青年：长着悬浮滑板大小的昆虫翅膀，除了黄色脸庞以外，全身都覆盖坚固黑色甲壳；蓬乱棕发上方的触角不断晃动。他们身上全都涂满醒目而俗艳的战斗彩绘。两名手持短矛的兹尔身高五英尺十英寸，精瘦矫健而高挑，下巴突出，神情坚定。另一名大约五英尺八英寸，装备一把弓，气质也更加阴柔：身材纤细，大腿丰满，一张可爱的黄色心形脸庞在昏暗光线中上下晃动。
rows.raw: "You are fighting the trio of male zil who have chosen to contest your claim to Quinn. rows.original: “I am the daughter of the Chieftain of the Great Western Rift,” the zil replies, with an air of relaying something extremely impressive. “I became one of the wives of the old Chieftain here, as part of a truce between our two tribes. When he died, there was disagreement as to who should replace him, as there always is. I defeated some of his wives, husbands and children in the ring; the rest submitted. That was a good night.”
rows.translation: “我是西部大裂谷酋长的女儿，”兹尔回答，语气仿佛正在讲述一件极为显赫的事情。“作为两个部落休战协议的一部分，我成为了这里老酋长的一名妻子。他死后，众人对继任者产生了分歧，这种事一向如此。我在竞技场里击败了他的部分妻子、丈夫和孩子；其余人则向我臣服。那是一个美好的夜晚。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I am the daughter of the Chieftain of the Great Western Rift,” the zil replies, with an air of relaying something extremely impressive. “I became one of the wives of the old Chieftain here, as part of a truce between our two tribes. When he died, there was disagreement as to who should replace him, as there always is. I defeated some of his wives, husbands and children in the ring; the rest submitted. That was a good night.”"

rows.original: Her faint smile broadens slightly in fond memory.
rows.translation: 温馨的回忆让她嘴角淡淡的笑容稍微扩大。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer faint smile broadens slightly in fond memory."

rows.original: <i>“In answer to your question though, no, I did not become Quinn until the word-wolf arrived. Before then, I was simply a chieftain, among many other chieftains throughout these lands.
rows.translation: <i>“不过，回答你的问题：不，直到言语之狼到来以后，我才成为奎因。在那之前，我只是一名普通酋长，和这片土地上的许多其他酋长并无区别。
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“In answer to your question though, no, I did not become Quinn until the word-wolf arrived. Before then, I was simply a chieftain, among many other chieftains throughout these lands."

rows.original: With the words he gave me, I became something more - unique, imbued with the unquenchable truth of the stars. With it, we stands as equals in knowledge to the evil land-stealers. And they do not match our bravery!”
rows.translation: 他带来的话语让我成为更加超然的存在，独一无二，并被群星永不熄灭的真理浸透。凭借它，我们的知识足以与邪恶的夺地者平起平坐。而他们的勇气根本无法与我们相比！”
rows.raw: " With the words he gave me, I became something more - unique, imbued with the unquenchable truth of the stars. With it, we stands as equals in knowledge to the evil land-stealers. And they do not match our bravery!”"

rows.raw: "\n\nShe favors the ausar at her side with the proud, beatific smile. He looks uncomfortable."

rows.original: Although I know now that it was a form of deceit he used to control me, I hold onto it.” She pauses slightly in thought. “To my people, it continues to hold a ring of power; it makes their leader unique and modern, and they are proud to serve me. To me though - it speaks of humility. Of being too eager to grasp power to properly question where it came from. This is an important thing for me to remember. I will let it shape me.”
rows.translation: 尽管我如今知道，那是他用来控制我的一种欺骗手段，我依旧保留着这个名字。”她稍稍停顿，陷入思索。“对我的族人而言，它依旧带着力量的回响；它让他们的领袖显得独特而现代，他们也以服侍我为荣。然而对我而言，它代表着谦卑，代表着自己曾如此急切地抓取权力，甚至没有认真质疑权力来自何方。这是我必须牢记的重要教训。我会让它塑造自己。”

rows.original: “Yes! What an amusing trap that is, do you not agree?” she chortles. “I could not be prouder of the warriors who devised it. Still! You got out of it and fought your way back up here, didn’t you? Perseverance is a finer trait than unthinking agility.”
rows.translation: “对！那个陷阱很有趣，你不这么认为吗？”她咯咯笑道。“我为设计它的战士们感到无比骄傲。不过！你还是从里面逃了出来，并一路战斗着回到了这里，对吧？坚韧不拔是比不假思索的敏捷更加优秀的品质。”

rows.original: She taps her finger on the wax-polished arm of her chair.

rows.raw: "\n\nShe taps her finger on the wax-polished arm of her chair."

rows.original: “The naleen prey upon all creatures that live in the jungle. That is an unfortunate but unbreakable truth. However, as ravenous and evil as they are, they can be reasoned with. We know many like to come to the caves to perform their mating rituals in peace - we know that were we to do nothing about it, we would lose many of our own as after-sex snacks. And they would lose some also, in acts of retribution. They would never be able to truly relax.” The zil plays idly with a tuft of fur on her chair-pelt. “Of course, naleen cannot come to an agreement to such as us unless it seems heavily weighted in their favor. They are extremely prideful creatures. And so - the pitfall. I explained that we carved it in deference to them, and that we would send tribute sliding down to them during orgy season from time to time, so long as they left our own alone. They liked this a lot - and we gained an easy way of getting rid of intruders. The peace has held.”
rows.translation: “纳琳会捕食生活在丛林里的一切生物。这是个令人遗憾，却无法改变的事实。不过，尽管他们贪婪而邪恶，仍然可以与之讲道理。我们知道，许多纳琳喜欢来到洞穴，安静地举行交配仪式 - 也知道若对此不加干预，许多族人便会沦为他们性交后的点心。而纳琳同样会在报复行动中损失成员。他们永远无法真正放松。”兹尔漫不经心地玩弄着椅垫上的一簇绒毛。“当然，除非协议看起来极度偏向他们，否则纳琳不会与我们这样的存在达成共识。他们是极其骄傲的生物。因此 - 我们设计了那个陷坑。我向他们解释，我们是出于敬意才开凿它；只要他们不伤害我们的族人，我们就会在群交季不时把贡品顺着坑道送下去。他们非常喜欢这个安排 - 而我们也获得了一种轻松处理入侵者的方法。和平一直维持至今。”

rows.original: “We have,” Quinn replies, stroking the arm of her chair absentmindedly. “It has been... slow. When my envoys first approached the star-people settlement they hid inside their buildings, and shouted about turning the white stings on us. However - once pots of honey were left and my warriors returned, they were willing to talk.” She snorts. “Soft and greedy.”
rows.translation: “成功了，”奎因回答，心不在焉地抚摸椅子扶手。“进展...很缓慢。我的使者第一次接近星际来客定居点时，他们躲进建筑，叫嚷着要用白色毒刺对付我们。不过 - 留下几罐蜂蜜、我的战士撤离后，他们便愿意交谈了。”她哼了一声。“软弱而贪婪。”

rows.original: “They are happy to trade goods for honey - star food, wondrously fine and colorful silks. These things are excellent to have. But we have made it very clear that this peaceful trade can only continue if the land-stealers, those you call Snug Lay, are driven away. There is one - a Huge Man, who seems to like our honey a lot. He listens the closest when we talk of this, I am told. We shall see.” She gives you the golden eyeball, faint smile firmly in place. “I believe the path you have set us on is the correct one. For now.”
rows.translation: “他们很乐意用货物换取蜂蜜 - 星际食物，还有精美得不可思议、色彩缤纷的丝绸。这些东西非常值得拥有。但我们已经非常明确地表示，只有赶走那些窃地者，也就是你们所称的舒适乐，和平贸易才能继续。其中有一个 - 巨人，似乎特别喜欢我们的蜂蜜。据我所知，我们谈到这件事时，他听得最认真。拭目以待吧。”她用金色眼睛望向你，脸上仍牢牢挂着淡淡笑容。“我相信你为我们指出的道路是正确的。至少现在如此。”

rows.original: “They have not taken any of our land, and do not trouble us,” replies Quinn with regal indifference. “Save sending enjoyable morsels into the jungles from time to time. If they expand, and begin to act in the same manner the land-stealers did... they have their example. I hope another one will not have to be made.”

rows.original: The jungle here is marvellously colorful. Hues of verdant green swim between vibrant yellows and lurid reds, shining up from the interwoven lichens in a rainbow of beauteous light. Whenever you press down upon some of it, the light brightens, lighting the way as you go. Ferrous trees as big as buildings rise up to the east, and smaller gray ones to the west cluster so tightly that you cannot go in that direction. There is an obvious track leading east between the looming giants, though: the undergrowth and even some of the trees have been cut back mechanically.
rows.translation: 这里的丛林色彩绚丽得令人惊叹。葱郁绿色在鲜亮黄色与刺眼红色之间流淌，从交织的地衣中泛起，形成美丽的彩虹光芒。每当你踩上其中一些，光芒便会增强，照亮前路。楼宇般巨大的含铁树木矗立于东方，西边较小的灰树则密集得无法通行。不过，在高耸巨木之间有一条明显向东延伸的小路；灌木丛甚至部分树木都被机械砍伐清理。

rows.original: Void, fuck and One, the manor is on fire! Other parts of the plantation are drooling smoke as well, but none quite so dramatically as its gleaming white centrepiece: A filthy cumulonimbus of blooming gray and flickering yellow towers over the plantation, lending the chaotic scene in front of you a pallor of unreality. Male zil flit over the lush fields and females trample across them, furiously battling drones, defense turrets and panicking prisoners in an ugly free-for-all. The nearest turret to you cycles and clicks, fruitlessly attempting to acquire targets that have already gotten past it; the head of the other lolls on its base, sparking and broken.

rows.original: Parts of the plantation continue to smolder, but it does at least look like there isn’t going to be an all-out forest fire anymore. The only signs of movement are a few drones, bobbing hopelessly over the fields, performing logistic checks and preparing repair routines for an administration that has abandoned them. The zil have departed, taking their wounded with them, and you can’t see a single orange jumpsuit in sight. Fled into the jungle? Hunkered down in the dorms? Taken prisoner? Impossible to say.
rows.translation: 种植园部分区域仍在闷烧，但至少看来已经不会再爆发全面森林火灾。仅有的活动迹象是几台无人机；它们绝望地漂浮在田野上空，执行物流检查，为已经抛弃它们的管理机构准备维修程序。泽尔已经撤离，并带走伤员；视野中一件橙色连体服也没有。逃进丛林了？躲在宿舍里？被俘虏了？无从判断。

rows.original: If it was quiet before, Thare Plantation is deathly silent now. The once carefully controlled plant species are running wild, the most successful clambering over the white fences and gobbling up the ground of the rest. Although even they, in turn, are doomed; you can already see globules of giant fungus and the sproutlings of ironwood sprinkling where the perimeter once was. Rising above the eerie, ragged fields to the south-east is the blackened carcass of the manor. To the west the alien wilderness encroaches.

rows.original: Able buzzes out of the air and opens the gate for you. His tar black eyes flick from you to the fugitive ausar, his slender face full of questions - but he doesn’t ask them.
rows.translation: 艾布尔嗡嗡地从空中飞出，为你打开大门。他那双焦油般漆黑的眼睛从你身上转向那名在逃的奥萨尔人，清秀的脸上写满疑问；但他什么也没问。
rows.raw: "Able buzzes out of the air and opens the gate for you. His tar black eyes flick from you to the fugitive ausar, his slender face full of questions - but he doesn’t ask them."

rows.original: THARE MANOR
rows.raw: "THARE MANOR"

rows.original: “Sir is waiting for you.”
rows.translation: “先生正在等您。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sir is waiting for you.”"

rows.original: That he is. Darnock stands on the steps of the manor, a proud beam splitting his face, and opens his arms wide as you come up the driveway, Lah in front of you.
rows.translation: 他确实在等你。达诺克站在庄园的台阶上，脸上绽开自豪的笑容。你沿车道走来时，他张开双臂，而拉走在你的前面。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat he is. Darnock stands on the steps of the manor, a proud beam splitting his face, and opens his arms wide as you come up the driveway, Lah in front of you."

rows.original: “My dear [pc.boyGirl],” the old human exults. “I knew I had placed my faith wisely when I put you in charge of this little matter. Well done, ah, well done indeed!”
rows.translation: “我亲爱的[pc.boyGirl]，”老人欣喜地说道。“我就知道，把这件小事交给你时，我的信任并未错付。干得好，啊，确实干得很好！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My dear [pc.boyGirl],” the old human exults. “I knew I had placed my faith wisely when I put you in charge of this little matter. Well done, ah, well done indeed!”"

rows.original: Still smiling, he ambles down to take the ausar in, doing a full circuit before looking him in the eye.
rows.translation: 他仍面带微笑，缓步走下来端详这名奥萨尔人，绕着他走了整整一圈，才直视他的双眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nStill smiling, he ambles down to take the ausar in, doing a full circuit before looking him in the eye."

rows.original: “It is such a relief to see a prodigal returning to the flock whole and unscarred,” Darnock says, with a kind of grave affableness. “Do you have anything to say, Remi? Words of wisdom? One of your, aha, impassioned denunciations? Is it too much to hope... a chastened apology?”
rows.translation: “看到迷途之人完好无伤地回归羊群，实在令人如释重负，”达诺克以一种庄重而和蔼的口吻说道。“你有什么想说的吗，雷米？来几句至理名言？还是再发表一番，啊哈，慷慨激昂的谴责？又或者，我们能否奢望……听到一句诚心悔过的道歉？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It is such a relief to see a prodigal returning to the flock whole and unscarred,” Darnock says, with a kind of grave affableness. “Do you have anything to say, Remi? Words of wisdom? One of your, aha, impassioned denunciations? Is it too much to hope... a chastened apology?”"

rows.original: Lah spits in his face.
rows.translation: 拉朝他脸上啐了一口。
rows.raw: "\n\nLah spits in his face."

rows.original: “Be that as it may,” Darnock continues, reaching for his handkerchief, “I am glad that you are back. Redemption is achievable by anyone - and one day, that intelligence and energy of yours shall be turned to better purposes. We shall be certain of it.”
rows.translation: “即便如此，”达诺克一边继续说，一边伸手去取手帕，“我还是很高兴你回来了。任何人都有机会得到救赎；总有一天，你的才智与活力会被用于更有价值的事业。我们定会确保如此。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Be that as it may,” Darnock continues, reaching for his handkerchief, “I am glad that you are back. Redemption is achievable by anyone - and one day, that intelligence and energy of yours shall be turned to better purposes. We shall be certain of it.”"

rows.original: He motions, and two security droids lumber over to haul Lah away. Darnock leads you into his dining room.
rows.translation: 他打了个手势，两台安保机器人便迈着沉重的步子走来，将拉拖走。达诺克领着你进入他的餐厅。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe motions, and two security droids lumber over to haul Lah away. Darnock leads you into his dining room."

rows.original: “First thing’s first,” he puffs, settling himself down in his favorite armchair and swiping up a holo-screen. Your codex chirrups. “
rows.translation: “先说最重要的事，”他喘着气坐进自己最喜欢的扶手椅，随手调出一道全息屏幕。你的CODEX终端发出提示音。“
rows.raw: "\n\n“First thing’s first,” he puffs, settling himself down in his favorite armchair and swiping up a holo-screen. Your codex chirrups. “"

rows.original: credits. Easily what I’d pay a PMC to do the job you just did, but nowhere near as neatly.” He points at a blank stretch of wall, and satellite footage of the zil settlement is beamed there.
rows.translation: 信用点。这正是我雇一家私营军事公司完成你刚才那项工作时愿意支付的价码，只是他们绝不可能处理得如此干净利落。”他指向墙上一片空白区域，基尔定居点的卫星画面随即投射在那里。
rows.raw: " credits. Easily what I’d pay a PMC to do the job you just did, but nowhere near as neatly.” He points at a blank stretch of wall, and satellite footage of the zil settlement is beamed there."

rows.original: “Looks like there was quite the scuffle there,” he observes. “Do you have any idea how our friend Remi managed to persuade them to defend him so zealously?”
rows.translation: “那里看来发生了一场相当激烈的冲突，”他观察道。“你知道我们的朋友雷米究竟是怎么说服他们如此狂热地保护他吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Looks like there was quite the scuffle there,” he observes. “Do you have any idea how our friend Remi managed to persuade them to defend him so zealously?”"

rows.original: You explain how Lah had set himself up as a quasi-prophet, and that you had to drive the zil off in order to retrieve him.
rows.translation: 你解释了拉如何把自己塑造成近似先知的人物，以及为了带回他，你不得不击退那些基尔。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou explain how Lah had set himself up as a quasi-prophet, and that you had to drive the zil off in order to retrieve him."

rows.original: “Captivating stuff!” declares Darnock, eyes and teeth flashing. “This will make fine material for your autobiography one day Steele - keep seeking out swashbuckling adventures like this and you’ll even overshadow your dear old dad!”
rows.translation: “真是引人入胜！”达诺克宣称，双眼和牙齿都闪闪发亮。“这些事有朝一日会成为你自传里的绝佳素材，斯蒂尔。继续寻找这种潇洒刺激的冒险，你甚至能盖过亲爱的老父亲！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Captivating stuff!” declares Darnock, eyes and teeth flashing. “This will make fine material for your autobiography one day Steele - keep seeking out swashbuckling adventures like this and you’ll even overshadow your dear old dad!”"

rows.original: “Things are looking remarkably peachy up there,” he remarks. “How did you ever manage to nab our friend Remi away from them?”
rows.translation: “那里的一切看起来好得出奇，”他评论道。“你到底是怎么从他们手里把我们的朋友雷米带回来的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Things are looking remarkably peachy up there,” he remarks. “How did you ever manage to nab our friend Remi away from them?”"

rows.original: You explain that you were able to talk the zil down, that they handed Lah over of their own accord, and that they shouldn’t be a problem in the future.
rows.translation: 你解释说，自己成功说服基尔冷静下来，他们主动交出了拉，而且以后应该不会再造成问题。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou explain that you were able to talk the zil down, that they handed Lah over of their own accord, and that they shouldn’t be a problem in the future."

rows.original: “Hmm.” Darnock strokes his chin and eyes you beadily. “Slightly naive of you, I’m afraid. The lesson they shall carry away from this is that they can wage war against us without any repercussion. It really does do to be firm with natives in situations like this. Still!” He raps the desk firmly. “It would be exceedingly ungracious of me to browbeat an honest attempt to resolve matters peacefully.”
rows.translation: “嗯。”达诺克抚摸下巴，以锐利的小眼睛盯着你。“恐怕你稍微有些天真。他们会从这件事中学到：即使向我们发动战争，也不必承担任何后果。面对这种情况，确实应该对原住民保持强硬。不过！”他用力敲了敲桌面。“如果我因为一次诚实的和平解决尝试而严厉斥责你，未免太没有风度了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm.” Darnock strokes his chin and eyes you beadily. “Slightly naive of you, I’m afraid. The lesson they shall carry away from this is that they can wage war against us without any repercussion. It really does do to be firm with natives in situations like this. Still!” He raps the desk firmly. “It would be exceedingly ungracious of me to browbeat an honest attempt to resolve matters peacefully.”"

rows.original: You follow a supple, white-clad rump, a pair of wings the size of hoverboards and the scent of deep honey back out into the marble hall and up a grand staircase. Able leads you into a plush guest room, heavy on dark wood and lace. A large, claw-footed tub catches your eye in the adjoining washroom. Insects dance beyond the tall duraflex windows.
rows.translation: 你跟随一只包裹在白衣中的柔韧臀部、两片悬浮板大小的翅膀，以及浓郁蜂蜜的香气，返回大理石大厅，登上一座宏伟楼梯。艾布尔领你进入一间豪华客房，里面大量使用深色木料和蕾丝装饰。相邻洗浴间内，一只带有兽爪形支脚的大浴缸吸引了你的目光。昆虫在高大的耐屈折玻璃窗外飞舞。
rows.raw: "You follow a supple, white-clad rump, a pair of wings the size of hoverboards and the scent of deep honey back out into the marble hall and up a grand staircase. Able leads you into a plush guest room, heavy on dark wood and lace. A large, claw-footed tub catches your eye in the adjoining washroom. Insects dance beyond the tall duraflex windows."

rows.original: “I know,” he says stonily, before you can speak. “I was listening.” He looks at the carpet, scuffs at it with his boot. “It was stupid of me to think you could reason with my chieftain. There’s just too much for them to understand, and they’d been letting the ausar fill their minds with his anger for too long. In the end... in the end, they were in the wrong. We must learn from the star-walkers, not drive them away. Perhaps it had to be this way.” He lets out a shuddering sigh. “...Would you like a bath? Or something else?”
rows.translation: “我知道，”你还没来得及开口，他便冷冷说道。“我一直在听。”他低头看着地毯，用靴子在上面蹭了蹭。“是我太愚蠢，居然以为你能和我的酋长讲道理。他们需要理解的东西实在太多，而那个奥萨人又用自己的怒火灌输了他们太久。最终...最终，错的是他们。我们必须向星行者学习，而不是把他们赶走。或许事情只能这样结束。”他颤抖着叹了口气。“...你想洗个澡吗？还是想要别的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I know,” he says stonily, before you can speak. “I was listening.” He looks at the carpet, scuffs at it with his boot. “It was stupid of me to think you could reason with my chieftain. There’s just too much for them to understand, and they’d been letting the ausar fill their minds with his anger for too long. In the end... in the end, they were in the wrong. We must learn from the star-walkers, not drive them away. Perhaps it had to be this way.” He lets out a shuddering sigh. “...Would you like a bath? Or something else?”"

rows.original: “Thank you so much for talking my chieftain down and not shooting my brothers and sisters,” he whispers, the moment he closes the door. He hovers a bit, unsure of himself, and then abandons decorum to hug you tightly around the midriff. “I was so worried about them... and about you. I thought all sorts of terrible things - that they’d kill you, or come back and do something awful like set the fields on fire - but you solved everything. You’re amazing.” The slender zil looks

rows.original: “Of course, the real rewards for your actions today are out there - waiting to be reaped,” he says with a happy sigh, gazing out over the fields. “The inspection shall be a success, of that I am sure, and Mhen’ga will take one small step on the path towards prosperity and civilization.” He looks over at you mistily. “Do stop in again, in due course. We will be trialing some of the most successful fruit and vegetable hybrids we have so far manufactured, plants with truly incredible properties. I want you to be one of the first to try them. Until then - why don’t you take a well-deserved rest? The guest bedroom, and Able, stand ready.”
rows.translation: “当然，你今天行动的真正回报就在那里，等待收割，”他望着田野，开心地叹息道。“视察一定会成功，我对此深信不疑；门加也会在通往繁荣与文明的道路上迈出小小一步。”他目光朦胧地看向你。“以后一定要再来看看。我们将试种目前制造出的几种最成功的水果与蔬菜杂交品种，这些植物拥有真正不可思议的特性。我希望你能成为最先品尝它们的人之一。在那之前，你何不享受一场应得的休息？客房和艾布尔都已准备就绪。”

rows.original: You go inside to his dining room and wait for him to settle in his chair before giving a debriefing. The old human plays with a pen, humorless smile frozen on his lips as you explain that you settled matters with the zil, and they agreed to stop attacking the plantation - but that Lah himself escaped into the jungle before you could nab him.
rows.translation: 你跟着他走进餐厅，等他在椅子上坐定，才开始汇报。你解释自己已经与兹尔解决争端，对方也同意停止袭击种植园 - 但拉本人在你逮住他之前逃进了丛林。这个老年人类把玩着一支笔，唇边凝固着毫无笑意的微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou go inside to his dining room and wait for him to settle in his chair before giving a debriefing. The old human plays with a pen, humorless smile frozen on his lips as you explain that you settled matters with the zil, and they agreed to stop attacking the plantation - but that Lah himself escaped into the jungle before you could nab him."

rows.original: “A fine tale, one which I’m sure will garner you much acclaim once the celebrity sites get ahold of it,” he says at last, tapping the pen on his desk. “
rows.translation: “精彩的故事。我敢肯定，等名流网站得到消息，你会赢得许多赞誉，”他终于说道，用笔轻叩桌面。“
rows.raw: "\n\n“A fine tale, one which I’m sure will garner you much acclaim once the celebrity sites get ahold of it,” he says at last, tapping the pen on his desk. “"

rows.original: Steele melts the heart of the sultry alien princess and solves the stand-off through wit and chivalry - alas, the fiery rabble rouser slips through [pc.hisHer] grasp. To appear dramatically in a later installment, perhaps! However. Allow me to apply a less rosy gloss to this.”
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔融化了性感异星公主的芳心，以智慧和骑士精神化解对峙 - 可惜，那个性如烈火的煽动者从[pc.hisHer]掌中溜走。也许会在后续篇章里戏剧性地重新登场！不过，请允许我给这件事添上一层不那么美好的解释。”
rows.raw: " Steele melts the heart of the sultry alien princess and solves the stand-off through wit and chivalry - alas, the fiery rabble rouser slips through [pc.hisHer] grasp. To appear dramatically in a later installment, perhaps! However. Allow me to apply a less rosy gloss to this.”"

rows.original: Darnock gets up and walks slowly over to the veranda, arms behind his back.
rows.translation: 达诺克站起身，双手背在身后，缓缓走向露台。
rows.raw: "\n\nDarnock gets up and walks slowly over to the veranda, arms behind his back."

rows.original: “I have nothing but your word that this illiterate zil leader - whom by your own admission has zero respect for our values - will call off the attacks. Lah is still at large, perhaps poised to wreak more havoc. Or attempt a hijack on some unfortunate tourist in Esbeth, who knows? And I now must explain to the Snugglé inspector why I am one prisoner short. In sum: this has been an almost complete failure. I cannot in good faith reward you for it.”
rows.translation: “我只有你的一面之词，声称这个目不识丁的兹尔首领会停止袭击，而依你自己所说，她对我们的价值观毫无尊重。拉仍逍遥法外，或许正准备制造更多破坏。也可能会试图劫持埃斯贝斯某个倒霉游客，谁知道呢？现在，我还必须向舒适乐的检查员解释为什么少了一名囚犯。总而言之，这几乎是一次彻底失败。我实在无法心安理得地为此奖励你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I have nothing but your word that this illiterate zil leader - whom by your own admission has zero respect for our values - will call off the attacks. Lah is still at large, perhaps poised to wreak more havoc. Or attempt a hijack on some unfortunate tourist in Esbeth, who knows? And I now must explain to the Snugglé inspector why I am one prisoner short. In sum: this has been an almost complete failure. I cannot in good faith reward you for it.”"

rows.original: He favors you with that wintry smile.
rows.translation: 他向你露出那抹冰冷笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe favors you with that wintry smile."

rows.original: “Let this be an important lesson, my touchingly naive young charge - what makes the best sounding story is not necessarily the best outcome, for you or anyone. Still! If - if - these zil do indeed desist their attacks, and Lah is smart enough not to lay low in the interim, then you should stop by again. If we are allowed to, we shall be trialing some of the most successful fruit and vegetable hybrids we have so far manufactured, plants with truly incredible properties. I want you to be one of the first to try them. Because I am a soft old fool at heart.”
rows.translation: “把这当作一堂重要课程吧，我那天真得令人感动的年轻学生：听起来最精彩的故事，对你或任何人而言都未必是最好的结果。不过！如果，如果这些兹尔确实停止袭击，而且拉足够聪明，没有在此期间隐匿起来，那你应该再来一趟。如果我们获得许可，就会试验至今培育出的几种最成功的水果与蔬菜杂交品种，那些植物拥有真正不可思议的特性。我希望你成为首批试用者之一。因为归根结底，我是个心软的老傻瓜。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Let this be an important lesson, my touchingly naive young charge - what makes the best sounding story is not necessarily the best outcome, for you or anyone. Still! If - if - these zil do indeed desist their attacks, and Lah is smart enough not to lay low in the interim, then you should stop by again. If we are allowed to, we shall be trialing some of the most successful fruit and vegetable hybrids we have so far manufactured, plants with truly incredible properties. I want you to be one of the first to try them. Because I am a soft old fool at heart.”"

rows.original: He collapses back into his chair with a weary sigh and flicks a holo-display up into existence in front of him.
rows.translation: 他疲惫地叹息一声，瘫回椅子上，随手在面前唤出一道全息显示屏。

rows.translation: “现在快走吧，如果还有其他需求，就去找艾布尔照料你。我现在必须设法雇佣一些真正的专业人士。”

rows.translation: 种植园田野开阔无垠，清新空气拂过你的[pc.skin]，与丛林的闷热相比简直是上天恩赐。
rows.raw: "Fresh air, blessed next to the mugginess of the jungle, washes over your [pc.skin] in the open expanse of the plantation’s fields. "

rows.original: Drones hover over the pristine green fields like lazy flies in summer, presumably watching over the workers, dotted here and there; sweat-soaked backs bent to the lash of the ceaseless sun. Was the insistent hum of these robots here before? You don’t think so. This extra security detail is a new development.
rows.translation: 无人机像夏日里懒散的苍蝇般悬浮在一尘不染的绿色田野上空，想必正在监视零星分布各处的工人；他们汗湿的后背在永不停歇的烈日鞭笞下弯曲。这些机器人执拗的嗡鸣以前就在这里吗？你觉得并没有。这支额外安保队伍是最近才出现的。
rows.raw: "Drones hover over the pristine green fields like lazy flies in summer, presumably watching over the workers, dotted here and there; sweat-soaked backs bent to the lash of the ceaseless sun. Was the insistent hum of these robots here before? You don’t think so. This extra security detail is a new development."

rows.original: The fields are deserted; the only sounds are the night insects and the distant, slightly terrifying strains of the Mhen’gan jungle.
rows.translation: 田野空无一人；唯一的声音来自夜间昆虫，以及远处曼亘丛林略显恐怖的声响。
rows.raw: "The fields are deserted; the only sounds are the night insects and the distant, slightly terrifying strains of the Mhen’gan jungle."

rows.original: To the east are some low lying buildings which presumably function as dormitories. To the south, behind a tall wall, gate and manicured lawn, lies a multi-tiered white manor house. Its neo-classical design and spotless frontage, nestled within this tropical paradise, speaks only of immense opulence. On the wall next to the gate is a speaker and a brass sign which reads “THARE PLANTATION. A Snugglé enterprise.”
rows.translation: 东边有几栋低矮建筑，大概是宿舍。南边则有一栋多层白色庄园宅邸，坐落在高墙、大门与精心修剪的草坪之后。它采用新古典主义设计，正面一尘不染，静卧于这片热带天堂之中，只透露出无比奢华。大门旁的墙上装有扬声器，还有一块黄铜标牌，上面写着“塔雷种植园。舒适乐旗下企业。”
rows.raw: "\n\nTo the east are some low lying buildings which presumably function as dormitories. To the south, behind a tall wall, gate and manicured lawn, lies a multi-tiered white manor house. Its neo-classical design and spotless frontage, nestled within this tropical paradise, speaks only of immense opulence. On the wall next to the gate is a speaker and a brass sign which reads “THARE PLANTATION. A Snugglé enterprise.”"

rows.original: “There’s a great waterfall to the north of here,” Able answers in a rush. “There is a camp - a, that is to say, a zil camp - at the top of it. The ausar is sheltering there, with them.”
rows.translation: “这里北边有一道大瀑布，”艾布尔急匆匆地答道。“瀑布顶端有一座营地 - 呃，也就是说，一座兹尔营地 - 那个奥萨尔就和她们一起躲在那里。”

rows.original: “...sex?” mumbles Able after a pause, shrugging. “Um. We don’t like it when people take our belongings without winning them fairly. That’s the whole reason why the clan are attacking the plantation. We like being able to roam the forests free of danger. And... there’s something else the ausar is giving them. I don’t know what, but they are really committed to protecting him, it’s as if- as if he were an endless supply of food, or something. If you can work out what it is he’s offering them...”
rows.translation: “...性爱？”艾布尔停顿片刻，耸着肩低声说道。“呃。我们不喜欢别人没有通过公平获胜就拿走我们的东西。氏族会袭击种植园，完全就是因为这个。我们喜欢能在森林中自由游荡，不受危险威胁。而且...那个奥萨尔还给了她们别的东西。我不知道那是什么，但她们真的铁了心要保护他，就好像-就好像他是取之不尽的食物之类的东西。如果你能弄清楚他到底给她们提供了什么...”

rows.original: “Challenge the ausar to a fair fight,” Able replies immediately. “He holds the chieftain’s ear. You have to earn the right to replace him, if only for a while. But...” he pauses again. “Even if you manage that, you’ll still have to convince the chieftain. It won’t be easy - they have been listening to the ausar for some time, and have been afraid of the star-people for longer. You will have to - convince them with things zil value, to get them to agree with whatever bargain you want to strike.”
rows.translation: “向那个奥萨尔发起一场公平的决斗，”艾布尔立刻答道。“酋长很听他的话。你必须赢得取代他的权利，哪怕只是暂时取代也行。不过...”他又停顿了一下。“即使你做到了，也仍然得说服酋长。这不会容易 - 她们听从那个奥萨尔已经有段时间了，而畏惧星际来客的时间更长。你必须 - 用兹尔看重的东西来说服她们，让她们同意你想达成的交易。”

rows.original: . The zil that are harboring the ausar - they are my clan. They are very angry. Before Master came, this was their farming land, and they believe themselves wronged. That is how the ausar is turning them against the plantation. But-” the zil sucks in a lungful of air. “But they are not unreasonable, or, or stupid. They are afraid - afraid of all the changes that have happened since the star-people arrived, all seemingly against them. I know our ways seem strange to you, but our chieftain is just - if you were to approach her according to our customs, she would listen to you. You could resolve this peacefully, I am sure of it.”
rows.translation: 。那些收留奥萨人的泽尔-她们是我的氏族。她们非常愤怒。主人到来之前，这里是她们的农田，她们认为自己遭受了不公。那个奥萨人正是这样煽动她们反对种植园。但-”泽尔深吸一口气。“但她们并非不讲道理，也，也不愚蠢。她们害怕-害怕行星旅者到来后发生的所有变化，因为那些变化看起来全都对她们不利。我知道我们的习俗在您看来或许很奇怪，但我们的酋长很公正-如果您按照我们的习俗接近她，她会听您说话。我确信，您可以和平解决此事。”

rows.original: “The zil have attempted to disguise their paths of approach, but satellite surveillance shows that they have almost certainly made camp on the highlands to the north. There seems to be a zil settlement there, at the head of a large waterfall. You will find our ausar friend there, I am sure of it.”
rows.translation: “兹尔试图掩盖接近路线，但卫星监控显示，他们几乎肯定在北部高地扎营。那里似乎有一处兹尔定居点，位于大型瀑布源头。我确信你会在那里找到我们的奥萨朋友。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The zil have attempted to disguise their paths of approach, but satellite surveillance shows that they have almost certainly made camp on the highlands to the north. There seems to be a zil settlement there, at the head of a large waterfall. You will find our ausar friend there, I am sure of it.”"

rows.original: “If you know where they are...” you say slowly.
rows.translation: “既然你知道他们在哪里...”你缓缓说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“If you know where they are...” you say slowly."

rows.original: “...why haven’t I directed an orbital laser strike on their position? Hired a team of SagiTom mercs to go up there and, ah, take care of business?” The professor smiles at you humorlessly. “Firstly: I want Remi alive. He is not some psychopathic pirate with his empathy burnt out, beyond redemption. His and the zils’ eternal souls can be saved. They WILL be saved. Secondly: He is playing a clever game, Steele. Such brute tactics would be noticed, recorded and would prove that Mhen’ga is too dangerous to be civilized. I shall not make a martyr of him. That is why I turn to a single trustworthy hunter, well experienced with the Mhen’gan jungle, to bring him back.”
rows.translation: “...为什么我没有指挥轨道激光打击他们的位置？雇一队萨吉汤姆佣兵上去，啊，处理问题？”教授毫无笑意地朝你微笑。“第一：我要活捉雷米。他不是那种同理心被烧毁、无可救药的疯子海盗。他和兹尔的永恒灵魂都能获救。他们一定会获救。第二：他的手段很聪明，斯蒂尔。如此粗暴的战术会被注意、被记录，并会证明门亨伽太过危险、无法文明化。我不会让他成为殉道者。因此，我才求助于一名值得信赖、熟悉门亨伽丛林的猎手，把他带回来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...why haven’t I directed an orbital laser strike on their position? Hired a team of SagiTom mercs to go up there and, ah, take care of business?” The professor smiles at you humorlessly. “Firstly: I want Remi alive. He is not some psychopathic pirate with his empathy burnt out, beyond redemption. His and the zils’ eternal souls can be saved. They WILL be saved. Secondly: He is playing a clever game, Steele. Such brute tactics would be noticed, recorded and would prove that Mhen’ga is too dangerous to be civilized. I shall not make a martyr of him. That is why I turn to a single trustworthy hunter, well experienced with the Mhen’gan jungle, to bring him back.”"

rows.original: “How dangerous would you say this R.K. Lah is?” you ask. Darnock brings up the lean ausar’s profile on the main screen again, clicks into a subset menu. You are treated to various shaky recordings of Lah participating in a protest march, shouting an address to an angry crowd of eco-protesters, his gray tail disappearing hurriedly behind a building as a line of riot police advance over glass and rubble...
rows.translation: “你认为这个RK·拉有多危险？”你问道。达诺克再次在主屏幕调出精瘦奥萨人的档案，点进一个子菜单。接下来播放了几段晃动录像：拉参加抗议游行、向愤怒的环保抗议人群发表演说，以及防暴警察列队踏过玻璃与瓦砾时，他的灰色尾巴匆忙消失在建筑后方...

You are treated to various shaky recordings of Lah participating in a protest march, shouting an address to an angry crowd of eco-protesters, his gray tail disappearing hurriedly behind a building as a line of riot police advance over glass and rubble..."

rows.original: “He isn’t a murderer or some out-of-control mercenary,” the old human replies at length, staring up into Lah’s round, yellow eyes. “On the other hand - his psych report and history suggest he is unstable. He certainly does have a penchant for arson, as my crops have learnt to their intense displeasure. His last fire bombing attack on a Xenogen lab seriously injured someone - not the intention, but collateral damage is an unfortunate necessity when you are fighting the Dog, is it not?”
rows.translation: “他不是杀人犯，也不是失控佣兵，”老年人类沉默良久后回答，抬头凝视拉那双圆圆的黄色眼睛。“另一方面 - 他的心理报告和过往表明，此人情绪不稳定。他确实偏爱纵火，我的作物已经极其痛苦地领教过了。他上次针对异源生物科技实验室的燃烧弹袭击严重伤害了一人 - 这并非本意，但在与恶犬战斗时，附带损害是不幸却必要的，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“He isn’t a murderer or some out-of-control mercenary,” the old human replies at length, staring up into Lah’s round, yellow eyes. “On the other hand - his psych report and history suggest he is unstable. He certainly does have a penchant for arson, as my crops have learnt to their intense displeasure. His last fire bombing attack on a Xenogen lab seriously injured someone - not the intention, but collateral damage is an unfortunate necessity when you are fighting the Dog, is it not?”"

rows.original: “The most worrying thing is the hold he’s developed over this tribe of zil. I cannot imagine what he’s told them to get them to obey him, and with such fearlessness and precision. I don’t think there will be any avoiding fighting them, driving them to the four corners so he stands alone, Steele - it seems to be the only language the bee people understand, alas.”
rows.translation: “最令人担忧的是，他竟掌控了这个兹尔部落。我无法想象他说了什么，才让他们如此无畏、精准地服从。我认为无法避免与他们战斗，把他们赶向四面八方，直到他孤身一人，斯蒂尔 - 唉，这似乎是蜜蜂人唯一理解的语言。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The most worrying thing is the hold he’s developed over this tribe of zil. I cannot imagine what he’s told them to get them to obey him, and with such fearlessness and precision. I don’t think there will be any avoiding fighting them, driving them to the four corners so he stands alone, Steele - it seems to be the only language the bee people understand, alas.”"

rows.raw: "Darnock clasps your hand tightly at the door, clapping your shoulder."

rows.original: “The very best of luck hunting the bounder down, dear Steele. Much rides on your success. The One will watch over you, of that I am sure!”
rows.translation: “祝你猎捕那个无赖时好运至极，亲爱的斯蒂尔。许多事情都取决于你的成功。唯一神会保佑你，我对此深信不疑！”

rows.original: Darnock flicks his hand at the screen, and a prisoner’s file is projected onto it. A lean, male ausar gazes down at you; solemn, hungry yellow eyes beneath a shock of gray hair. MD6 - 605631 REMI-KELLEN LAH, reads the plate he’s holding up.
rows.translation: 达诺克朝屏幕弹动手掌，一份囚犯档案投影出来。一名精瘦雄性奥萨人低头望向你；蓬乱灰发下，是严肃而饥渴的黄色双眼。他举起的牌子上写着：MD6 - 605631 雷米-凯伦·拉。

rows.original: “I must make clear,” Darnock continues, “that it was a bureaucratic snafu that had Remi sent here in the first place. Send me your thieves, I told Snugglé! Send me your petty criminals, your unlicensed prostitutes, your drug addicts - I will change them. I will HEAL them. Just don’t send me any eco-warriors. Don’t send me any activist ausar serving five years for a fire-bombing campaign against Xenogen. Because doing that might... it might cause problems.”
rows.translation: “我必须说明，”达诺克继续说道，“雷米最初被送到这里，是官僚程序出了岔子。把你们的小偷送给我，我这样告诉舒适乐！把你们的轻罪犯、无证妓女、瘾君子送来 - 我会改变他们。我会治愈他们。只是别送任何生态战士。别把因针对异源生物科技发动燃烧弹行动而获刑五年的奥萨活动人士送来。因为那样做可能...可能会造成问题。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I must make clear,” Darnock continues, “that it was a bureaucratic snafu that had Remi sent here in the first place. Send me your thieves, I told Snugglé! Send me your petty criminals, your unlicensed prostitutes, your drug addicts - I will change them. I will HEAL them. Just don’t send me any eco-warriors. Don’t send me any activist ausar serving five years for a fire-bombing campaign against Xenogen. Because doing that might... it might cause problems.”"

rows.original: The professor signals with two terse fingers and the prisoner file slides away, replaced by a geographical map of the immediate area. The perimeter of the plantation is shown, and a number of angry red circles intersect it.
rows.translation: 教授用两根手指简短示意，囚犯档案便滑开，换成周边地区的地理地图。种植园边界显示出来，数个愤怒的红圈与其相交。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe professor signals with two terse fingers and the prisoner file slides away, replaced by a geographical map of the immediate area. The perimeter of the plantation is shown, and a number of angry red circles intersect it."

rows.original: “Since Lah escaped, we have been attacked six times by a tribe of zil. They use tactics which are completely out of keeping for their kind, exploiting programming blind spots to get past the turrets and destroy our crops. They are not out for sex; it is pure, targeted aggression.” He gestures. A fuzzy video recording appears on the main screen, shot in night vision. A rangy figure is gesticulating wildly at insect-winged others, who are quickly dragging large pods into what looks like sugar cane.
rows.translation: “自从拉逃脱后，我们已经遭兹尔部落袭击六次。他们使用完全不符合该族习惯的战术，利用程序盲区绕过炮塔、摧毁作物。他们不是来寻欢的；这是纯粹且有针对性的侵略。”他挥手示意。主屏幕出现一段以夜视模式拍摄的模糊录像。一个瘦高身影朝其他长着昆虫翅膀的人疯狂打手势，后者迅速把大型豆荚拖进看似甘蔗的作物中。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Since Lah escaped, we have been attacked six times by a tribe of zil. They use tactics which are completely out of keeping for their kind, exploiting programming blind spots to get past the turrets and destroy our crops. They are not out for sex; it is pure, targeted aggression.” He gestures. A fuzzy video recording appears on the main screen, shot in night vision. A rangy figure is gesticulating wildly at insect-winged others, who are quickly dragging large pods into what looks like sugar cane."

rows.original: “But at what price, you may ask, dear Steele,” mutters Darnock, switching the recording off. The screen fades away entirely, and is replaced by the vista of the plantation fields beyond, into which the old human stares. “A wannabe revolutionary escapes, hooks up with some delinquent zil nearby and attempts to harass my quiet, noble quest here. What is this, really, to a company with Snugglé’s resources? But there is a lot at stake here, Steele. And I believe Lah knows it.”
rows.translation: “但代价是什么，你也许会问，亲爱的斯蒂尔，”达诺克关掉录像，低声说道。屏幕彻底淡去，取而代之的是外面种植园田野的景象，老年人类凝视着那里。“一个自命不凡的革命者逃走，与附近几个不良兹尔勾结，企图骚扰我在这里安静而高尚的事业。对拥有舒适乐这等资源的企业而言，这究竟算什么？可这里牵涉甚广，斯蒂尔。而且我相信拉知道这一点。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But at what price, you may ask, dear Steele,” mutters Darnock, switching the recording off. The screen fades away entirely, and is replaced by the vista of the plantation fields beyond, into which the old human stares. “A wannabe revolutionary escapes, hooks up with some delinquent zil nearby and attempts to harass my quiet, noble quest here. What is this, really, to a company with Snugglé’s resources? But there is a lot at stake here, Steele. And I believe Lah knows it.”"

rows.original: A finger is flicked; a vid-window silently opens in front of you. Details of an impending visit from a Snugglé evaluation team appear in your lap.
rows.translation: 一根手指轻弹；视频窗口在你面前无声开启。舒适乐评估小组即将来访的详情出现在你腿上。
rows.raw: "\n\nA finger is flicked; a vid-window silently opens in front of you. Details of an impending visit from a Snugglé evaluation team appear in your lap."

rows.original: “Mhen’ga stands at a crossroads, Steele,” says Darnock, turning away from the prospect to look you in the eye with a quiet smile. “Lah wishes to force it down the path of darkness. By harnessing the savagery of the natives, he aims to demonstrate to the evaluators that this world is too dangerous, too wild to be agri-formed and brought into the light of the wider galaxy. I have no doubt he believes his intentions noble. But make no mistake - they are to the detriment of every living being on this planet. If the evaluators find this plantation untenable because the zil are too war-like, they will almost certainly be denied sapient rights via the U.G.C. Mhen’ga may even be deemed too dangerous to settle - Esbeth will be abandoned. Snugglé shall be denied a fantastic world to study and foster. The pirates and slavers lurking in the wings handed a vast, free buffet.”
rows.translation: “门加正站在十字路口，斯蒂尔，”达诺克说道。他从眼前的景象转过身，带着平静的微笑直视你的双眼。“拉想强迫它走上黑暗之路。他意图利用原住民的野蛮，向评估人员证明这个世界过于危险、过于蛮荒，不适合接受农业化改造，也无法被带入广阔银河的光明之中。我毫不怀疑，他相信自己的意图十分高尚。但绝不要误会 - 他的行动会损害这颗星球上的每一个生命。如果评估人员认定兹尔过于好战，导致这座种植园无法维持，他们几乎必然无法通过U.G.C.获得智慧生物权利。门加甚至可能被判定为过于危险，不宜定居 - 埃斯贝斯将遭到遗弃。舒适乐也将失去一个可供研究与培育的绝佳世界。而潜伏在侧的海盗与奴隶贩子，则会得到一座庞大而免费的自助餐厅。”

By harnessing the savagery of the natives, he aims to demonstrate to the evaluators that this world is too dangerous, too wild to be agri-formed and brought into the light of the wider galaxy. I have no doubt he believes his intentions noble. But make no mistake - they are to the detriment of every living being on this planet. If the evaluators find this plantation untenable because the zil are too war-like, they will almost certainly be denied sapient rights via the U.G.C. Mhen’ga may even be deemed too dangerous to settle - Esbeth will be abandoned. Snugglé shall be denied a fantastic world to study and foster. The pirates and slavers lurking in the wings handed a vast, free buffet.”"

rows.original: Darnock gestures, and this time a screen doesn’t pop up. Your attention is instead directed out the patio towards the green wall of the jungle, looming beyond the serried plantation fields.
rows.translation: 达诺克抬手示意，这次却没有屏幕弹出。你的注意力转而越过露台，望向丛林形成的绿色高墙；它高耸在排列整齐的种植园田地之外。
rows.raw: "\n\nDarnock gestures, and this time a screen doesn’t pop up. Your attention is instead directed out the patio towards the green wall of the jungle, looming beyond the serried plantation fields."

rows.original: “Lah is out there somewhere, Steele. Find him. Bring him to justice. Your reward shall be substantial - both fiscally, and in terms of the great good you shall render this world.”
rows.translation: “拉就在外面的某个地方，斯蒂尔。找到他。把他绳之以法。你的报酬会十分丰厚 - 无论金钱方面，还是你将为这个世界带来的伟大福祉。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Lah is out there somewhere, Steele. Find him. Bring him to justice. Your reward shall be substantial - both fiscally, and in terms of the great good you shall render this world.”"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: Darnock is gazing up at a large hologram screen, projected onto the patio doors, when you come in. He is actually standing in a small enclave of such holo-screens, all of which are displaying tightly packed information. He turns at your approach, a pensive expression shifting into a warm smile when he sees who it is.
rows.translation: 你走进来时，达诺克正抬头凝视投影在露台门上的巨大全息屏幕。事实上，他站在一小片全息屏幕组成的围区中，每一块都显示着密密麻麻的信息。你走近时，他转过身；看清来人是谁后，若有所思的表情化作温暖笑容。
