rows.original: Steele,” he says, clapping you on the shoulder. “I knew you would come. The slightest hint of adventure, or a friend in need - that’s all it took for Victor Steele to appear, tail up and ready for action! Like father, like
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔，”他说着拍了拍你的肩膀。“我就知道你会来。只需一丝冒险的气息，或是一位需要帮助的朋友 - 这就足以让维克托·斯蒂尔立刻现身，精神抖擞，随时准备行动！有其父必有其

rows.raw: "\n\n“What’s this about?” you say. Darnock raises his hand."

rows.original: “Not another word, Steele! Sit yourself down. Act as if you just spent the best part of a day ploughing through space traffic and then a hostile jungle, just to take audience with a foolish old man.”
rows.translation: “别再说了，斯蒂尔！坐下来。就当你刚花了大半天穿过拥堵的太空航道，又闯过一片充满敌意的丛林，只为来见一个愚蠢的老头。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not another word, Steele! Sit yourself down. Act as if you just spent the best part of a day ploughing through space traffic and then a hostile jungle, just to take audience with a foolish old man.”"

rows.original: You do so. A glass of water and a small meal is provided to you by a silent, unsmiling Snugglé prisoner employee. Munching, you watch as the professor goes back to silently gazing at the screens thrown across the glass windows and plush furnishings of the veranda. From what you can gather from a cursory glance, they are analytics of the plantation’s probationers.
rows.translation: 你照办了。一名沉默且面无笑容的舒适乐囚犯雇员为你送来一杯水和一份简餐。你边吃边看教授重新沉默地凝视那些投映在玻璃窗与露台豪华陈设上的屏幕。匆匆一瞥之下，你判断上面显示的是种植园服刑人员的分析数据。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou do so. A glass of water and a small meal is provided to you by a silent, unsmiling Snugglé prisoner employee. Munching, you watch as the professor goes back to silently gazing at the screens thrown across the glass windows and plush furnishings of the veranda. From what you can gather from a cursory glance, they are analytics of the plantation’s probationers."

rows.original: “Problem with the prisoners?” you venture.
rows.translation: “囚犯出了问题？”你试探着问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Problem with the prisoners?” you venture."

rows.original: “Something like that,” the white-haired human sighs. He sounds reluctant, as if he were talking to you about something taboo. “A laborer jumped the fence a few weeks ago. It would not ordinarily be a problem - the jungle usually discharges them either to the plantation or Esbeth, quivering and begging to be taken back. Unfortunately, in this particular laborer’s case, the jungle itself was the goal.”
rows.translation: “差不多吧，”白发人类叹息道。他听起来并不情愿，仿佛正在与你谈论某种禁忌。“几周前，一个劳工翻过了围栏。通常来说，这不会构成问题 - 丛林往往会把他们吐回种植园或埃斯贝斯，让他们颤抖着哀求被重新接纳。遗憾的是，对这个特定劳工而言，丛林本身正是他的目标。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Something like that,” the white-haired human sighs. He sounds reluctant, as if he were talking to you about something taboo. “A laborer jumped the fence a few weeks ago. It would not ordinarily be a problem - the jungle usually discharges them either to the plantation or Esbeth, quivering and begging to be taken back. Unfortunately, in this particular laborer’s case, the jungle itself was the goal.”"

rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: Able promptly buzzes out of the sky a short while after you press the button. He seems more tense and furtive than usual; his black eyes flicking up to yours and then away, his long tongue nipping in and out of his mouth, as if he were tasting something on the air.
rows.translation: 你按下按钮没多久，艾布尔便嗡鸣着迅速从空中飞来。他似乎比平时更加紧张鬼祟；黑色双眼先抬起望向你，随即又移开，长舌在嘴里进进出出，仿佛正品尝空气中的某种东西。
rows.raw: "Able promptly buzzes out of the sky a short while after you press the button. He seems more tense and furtive than usual; his black eyes flicking up to yours and then away, his long tongue nipping in and out of his mouth, as if he were tasting something on the air."

rows.original: “Master would like to see you,” he says. The gate silently opens, gravel crunches as you are led up the immaculate path. “He says it is important.” The petite zil pauses at the steps, hands balling his Snugglé shirt. “Could you - once you have talked to Master, could we talk? I- I mean, you don’t have to. Just- just if you want.” Eyes turned to the ground, he gestures at the open door of the mansion.
rows.translation: “主人想见你，”他说。大门无声开启；他领着你走上整洁无瑕的小径，碎石在脚下嘎吱作响。“他说事情很重要。”娇小的兹尔在台阶前停下，双手攥紧舒适乐制服。“能不能 - 等你和主人谈完以后，我们能谈谈吗？我- 我的意思是，你不一定非要答应。只是- 只是如果你愿意。”他垂眼望着地面，朝敞开的宅邸大门示意。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Master would like to see you,” he says. The gate silently opens, gravel crunches as you are led up the immaculate path. “He says it is important.” The petite zil pauses at the steps, hands balling his Snugglé shirt. “Could you - once you have talked to Master, could we talk? I- I mean, you don’t have to. Just- just if you want.” Eyes turned to the ground, he gestures at the open door of the mansion."

rows.original: THARE MANOR
rows.raw: "THARE MANOR"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You choke and wheeze as you push towards the heat of the manor inferno. The wind is thankfully running from behind you; you doubt you’d be able to approach otherwise.
rows.translation: 你咳嗽喘息着朝庄园熊熊燃烧的热浪前进。所幸风从你身后吹来；否则你怀疑自己根本无法靠近。
rows.raw: "You choke and wheeze as you push towards the heat of the manor inferno. The wind is thankfully running from behind you; you doubt you’d be able to approach otherwise."

rows.original: R.K. Lah is standing by the soot-touched walls, watching the fire go, mouth slightly ajar. He looks over you at you vaguely at your approach, before turning back to it, entranced. Orange flickers in his wide, gray eyes.
rows.translation: R.K.拉站在被煤烟熏黑的墙边，注视火势蔓延，嘴巴微微张开。你走近时，他茫然地越过你看了一眼，随即又着迷地转回火场。橙色火光在他睁大的灰色双眼中闪烁。
rows.raw: "\n\nR.K. Lah is standing by the soot-touched walls, watching the fire go, mouth slightly ajar. He looks over you at you vaguely at your approach, before turning back to it, entranced. Orange flickers in his wide, gray eyes."

rows.original: “Did everyone get out?” you shout, over the fire’s roar and the melee in the fields behind you. Lah starts out of his trance, and barks a wry laugh.
rows.translation: “所有人都出来了吗？”你盖过火焰轰鸣与身后田野里的混战声大喊。拉从恍惚中惊醒，讥讽地笑了一声。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Did everyone get out?” you shout, over the fire’s roar and the melee in the fields behind you. Lah starts out of his trance, and barks a wry laugh."

rows.original: “The warden had a private one-seater jet stowed in one wing. Had a go at giving us the ‘friends, neighbours’ spiel when we broke through the perimeter - arms outstretched, you know - and then booked it to his getaway car the second the fire got going. Can you believe that bastard? I can’t imagine his corporate masters will be particularly glad to receive him back to their bosom.” The ausar folds his thin arms. “But all the staff got out. I made sure of that.”
rows.translation: “典狱长在侧翼藏了一架私人单座喷气机。我们突破外围时，他还试图对我们发表那套‘朋友们，邻居们’的演说，张开双臂，你懂的，可火势刚一起，他就立刻逃向自己的逃生座驾。你敢相信那个混蛋吗？我想，他背后的企业主子应该不会特别高兴地欢迎他重回怀抱。”奥萨人抱起纤细双臂。“不过所有员工都逃出来了。我亲自确保了这一点。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The warden had a private one-seater jet stowed in one wing. Had a go at giving us the ‘friends, neighbours’ spiel when we broke through the perimeter - arms outstretched, you know - and then booked it to his getaway car the second the fire got going. Can you believe that bastard? I can’t imagine his corporate masters will be particularly glad to receive him back to their bosom.” The ausar folds his thin arms. “But all the staff got out. I made sure of that.”"

rows.original: “What about Able?” you ask. Lah frowns; his lips form an ‘o’. Fire gouts out of an upstairs window.
rows.translation: “艾布尔呢？”你问道。拉皱起眉头，嘴唇形成一个‘O’形。一股火焰从楼上窗户喷出。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What about Able?” you ask. Lah frowns; his lips form an ‘o’. Fire gouts out of an upstairs window."

rows.original: “Able,” you shout in his ear. “A zil boy, about so high. He worked for Darnock.”
rows.translation: “艾布尔，”你贴着他耳朵大喊。“一个兹尔男孩，大概这么高。他替达诺克工作。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Able,” you shout in his ear. “A zil boy, about so high. He worked for Darnock.”"

rows.original: “I didn’t see any zil,” he replies. His adam’s apple bobs. “None of ours went into the house.”
rows.translation: “我没看见任何兹尔，”他回答。喉结上下滚动。“我们的人没有谁进过宅邸。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I didn’t see any zil,” he replies. His adam’s apple bobs. “None of ours went into the house.”"

rows.original: You both watch silently as the roof thunderously caves in, throwing up a blizzard of sparks.
rows.translation: 你们默默看着屋顶轰然塌陷，掀起一场火星暴雪。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou both watch silently as the roof thunderously caves in, throwing up a blizzard of sparks."

rows.original: “Cheer up, friend,” Lah says bracingly, once the noise has died down. “I know this - it all looks a bit ugly now, but it was necessary. Somebody stood up for the little guy! No mega-conglomerate in the galaxy is going to touch Mhen’ga with a twelve foot volgar-pole now. The zil, and the naleen, and the vanae - they can continue to live their innocent lives in peace. The land will remain as it has - has always been: a paradise that anyone can partake of and enjoy. Because the corporate fascists’ own instrument of oppression turned against them. [pc.HeShe] was willing to stop, listen and realize what was right.”
rows.translation: “振作起来，朋友，”声响平息后，拉振奋地说道。“我知道，现在这一切看起来有些难看，但这是必要的。终于有人站出来替弱者发声了！现在，银河系里没有哪家巨型企业集团敢拿十二英尺长的沃尔加杆碰曼亘。兹尔、纳林和瓦奈可以继续平静地过着纯朴生活。土地会保持原样，永远如从前一般，成为人人都能参与并享受的天堂。因为企业法西斯自己的压迫工具反过来对付了他们。[pc.HeShe]愿意停下来倾听，并认识到什么才是正确的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Cheer up, friend,” Lah says bracingly, once the noise has died down. “I know this - it all looks a bit ugly now, but it was necessary. Somebody stood up for the little guy! No mega-conglomerate in the galaxy is going to touch Mhen’ga with a twelve foot volgar-pole now. The zil, and the naleen, and the vanae - they can continue to live their innocent lives in peace. The land will remain as it has - has always been: a paradise that anyone can partake of and enjoy. Because the corporate fascists’ own instrument of oppression turned against them. [pc.HeShe] was willing to stop, listen and realize what was right.”"

rows.original: He claps you on the shoulder, and with one last lingering look at the burning ruins, heads towards the fields.
rows.translation: 他拍了拍你的肩膀，最后久久看了一眼燃烧的废墟，随后朝田野走去。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe claps you on the shoulder, and with one last lingering look at the burning ruins, heads towards the fields."

rows.original: “I’m going to go reign the zil warriors in. There’s no need - no need for more violence. Particularly not against my old chain gang mates, hahaha! I am sure the chieftain has already said it, but you will be forever welcome in our village. As their, ah, their word-wolf, you can be assured of that.”
rows.translation: “我要去约束兹尔战士。没必要，没必要再发生更多暴力。尤其不能针对我以前苦役队的伙伴，哈哈哈！我相信酋长已经说过了，不过我们村庄将永远欢迎你。身为他们的，呃，他们的言语之狼，你可以相信这一点。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m going to go reign the zil warriors in. There’s no need - no need for more violence. Particularly not against my old chain gang mates, hahaha! I am sure the chieftain has already said it, but you will be forever welcome in our village. As their, ah, their word-wolf, you can be assured of that.”"

rows.original: You are left with your own thoughts at the former plantation’s gates.
rows.translation: 你独自留在昔日种植园的大门前，面对自己的思绪。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou are left with your own thoughts at the former plantation’s gates."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Beyond the brass gates, the gutted manor house continues to smolder fitfully. The fire has mostly run its course now the roof has fallen in, but flames continue to lap at the base and the heat and acrid smoke is overpowering. There must have been a lot of old fashioned wood and plant material inside, for a building mostly made of synthetic marble and ceramic to go up so enthusiastically. Or perhaps a dedicated arsonist like Lah knows a trick or two.
rows.translation: 黄铜大门后，被焚毁的庄园宅邸仍断断续续冒着烟。如今屋顶已经塌陷，火势大多燃尽，但火焰仍在底部舔舐，热浪与刺鼻浓烟令人难以忍受。这栋建筑主要由合成大理石与陶瓷建成，却烧得如此猛烈，里面一定存放了大量老式木材与植物材料。又或许，拉这样的专业纵火犯确实掌握一两种诀窍。
rows.raw: "Beyond the brass gates, the gutted manor house continues to smolder fitfully. The fire has mostly run its course now the roof has fallen in, but flames continue to lap at the base and the heat and acrid smoke is overpowering. There must have been a lot of old fashioned wood and plant material inside, for a building mostly made of synthetic marble and ceramic to go up so enthusiastically. Or perhaps a dedicated arsonist like Lah knows a trick or two."

rows.original: The building was thankfully set away from any trees, so it doesn’t look like the fire isn’t going to spread. The lawn, drive and garden remain surreally flawless.
rows.translation: 幸好这栋建筑远离所有树木，因此火势看起来不会蔓延。草坪、车道与花园仍超现实般完美无瑕。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe building was thankfully set away from any trees, so it doesn’t look like the fire isn’t going to spread. The lawn, drive and garden remain surreally flawless."

rows.original: Soot may blacken the walls, but the closed gate, buzzer and brass plaque remain. “THARE PLANTATION. A Snugglé enterprise”. Beyond it looms the blackened rib cage of the burnt manor house, silent and cold. Native flora is beginning to enthusiastically colonize the once immaculate lawn in front of it.
rows.translation: 烟灰或许熏黑了墙壁，但紧闭的大门、门铃和黄铜铭牌依旧存在。“塔雷种植园。舒适乐旗下企业”。后方矗立着焚毁庄园宅邸那焦黑的肋骨架，寂静而冰冷。本土植物正开始热情占领门前曾经一尘不染的草坪。
rows.raw: "Soot may blacken the walls, but the closed gate, buzzer and brass plaque remain. “THARE PLANTATION. A Snugglé enterprise”. Beyond it looms the blackened rib cage of the burnt manor house, silent and cold. Native flora is beginning to enthusiastically colonize the once immaculate lawn in front of it."

rows.original: Over to the east are the low-lying buildings that once functioned as the inmates’ dormitories. They look relatively untouched by fire; who knows what calls them home now. Probably better not to find out.
rows.translation: 东边是曾经充当囚犯宿舍的低矮建筑。它们似乎基本未受火灾影响；谁知道如今有什么东西把那里当成家。最好还是不要查明。
rows.raw: "\n\nOver to the east are the low-lying buildings that once functioned as the inmates’ dormitories. They look relatively untouched by fire; who knows what calls them home now. Probably better not to find out."

rows.original: Fresh air, blessed next to the mugginess of the jungle, washes over your [pc.skin] in the open expanse of the plantation’s fields.
rows.translation: 种植园田野开阔无垠，清新空气拂过你的[pc.skin]，与丛林的闷热相比简直是上天恩赐。
rows.raw: "Fresh air, blessed next to the mugginess of the jungle, washes over your [pc.skin] in the open expanse of the plantation’s fields."

rows.original: There are humanoid workers out there amongst the regimented crops, clad in khaki coveralls, as well as agri-bots that look like walking climbing frames, but they all ignore you.
rows.translation: 整齐作物之间有一些穿着卡其色连体服的类人工人，还有看起来像会走路的攀爬架一样的农业机器人，但他们全都无视了你。
rows.raw: " There are humanoid workers out there amongst the regimented crops, clad in khaki coveralls, as well as agri-bots that look like walking climbing frames, but they all ignore you."

rows.original: The fields are deserted; the only sounds are the night insects and the distant, slightly terrifying strains of the Mhen’gan jungle.
rows.translation: 田野空无一人；唯一的声音来自夜间昆虫，以及远处曼亘丛林略显恐怖的声响。
rows.raw: " The fields are deserted; the only sounds are the night insects and the distant, slightly terrifying strains of the Mhen’gan jungle."

rows.original: To the east are some low lying buildings which presumably function as dormitories. To the south, behind a tall wall, gate and manicured lawn, lies a multi-tiered white manor house. Its neo-classical design and spotless frontage, nestled within this tropical paradise, speaks only of immense opulence. On the wall next to the gate is a speaker and a brass sign which reads “THARE PLANTATION. A Snugglé enterprise”.
rows.translation: 东边有几栋低矮建筑，大概是宿舍。南边则有一栋多层白色庄园宅邸，坐落在高墙、大门与精心修剪的草坪之后。它采用新古典主义设计，正面一尘不染，静卧于这片热带天堂之中，只透露出无比奢华。大门旁的墙上装有扬声器，还有一块黄铜标牌，上面写着“塔雷种植园。舒适乐旗下企业”。
rows.raw: "To the east are some low lying buildings which presumably function as dormitories. To the south, behind a tall wall, gate and manicured lawn, lies a multi-tiered white manor house. Its neo-classical design and spotless frontage, nestled within this tropical paradise, speaks only of immense opulence. On the wall next to the gate is a speaker and a brass sign which reads “THARE PLANTATION. A Snugglé enterprise”."

rows.original: Snugglé
rows.raw: "Snugglé"

rows.original: Your Codex beeps with relevant information on the corporation.
rows.translation: 你的个人终端发出哔声，显示这家公司的相关信息。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour Codex beeps with relevant information on the corporation."

rows.original: Snugglé
rows.raw: "Snugglé"

rows.original: Speaker
rows.translation: 扬声器
rows.raw: "Speaker"

rows.original: speaker
rows.raw: "speaker"

rows.original: Thare Manor Visit
rows.raw: "Thare Manor Visit"

rows.original: Enter
rows.translation: 进入
rows.raw: "Enter"

rows.original: Enter
rows.translation: 进入
rows.raw: "Enter"

rows.original: You have met Professor Darnock for a meal already. Perhaps you can revisit him later?
rows.translation: 你已经和达诺克教授吃过一顿饭了。也许晚些时候可以再来拜访他？
rows.raw: "You have met Professor Darnock for a meal already. Perhaps you can revisit him later?"

rows.original: Enter
rows.translation: 进入
rows.raw: "Enter"

rows.original: enter
rows.raw: "enter"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: DARNOCK
rows.raw: "DARNOCK"

rows.original: Darnock
rows.translation: 达诺克
rows.raw: "Darnock"

rows.original: You make your excuses.
rows.translation: 你找了个借口告辞。
rows.raw: "You make your excuses."

rows.original: “Of course! Of course,” sighs the old human. “Just like your father, you must hare off into the great unknown at the first opportunity. Until next time, heroic [pc.name] Steele!”
rows.translation: “当然！当然，”年迈的人类叹了口气。“你和你父亲一模一样，一有机会就非得奔向那片伟大的未知世界。下次再会了，英勇的[pc.name]·斯蒂尔！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course! Of course,” sighs the old human. “Just like your father, you must hare off into the great unknown at the first opportunity. Until next time, heroic [pc.name] Steele!”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: THARE FIELDS
rows.raw: "THARE FIELDS"

rows.original: There’s no reason to go traipsing off to the north... for now. Maybe something will come up later?
rows.translation: 现在...还没有理由一路跋涉前往北方。也许以后会发生什么事？
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s no reason to go traipsing off to the north... for now. Maybe something will come up later?"

rows.original: You could force your way northwards, up the banks of the stream, if you wanted to. You think you can see a break in the ironwoods much further above in that direction.
rows.translation: 如果愿意，你可以沿着溪岸强行向北推进。你似乎能看到那个方向更上游的铁木林中有一道缺口。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou could force your way northwards, up the banks of the stream, if you wanted to. You think you can see a break in the ironwoods much further above in that direction."

rows.original: Your
rows.translation: 你的
rows.raw: "Your "

rows.original: [pc.leg] sinks
rows.translation: [pc.leg]陷
rows.raw: "[pc.leg] sinks"

rows.original: [pc.legs] sink
rows.translation: [pc.legs]陷
rows.raw: "[pc.legs] sink"

rows.original: deep into the mounds of faintly luminescent blue moss which bloom in the steep, boggy grounds that surround the chattering, gurgling stream. Intricate floral life flourishes along its banks, the passage of water allowing smaller ferns and flowers space and light that the massive ironwoods all around otherwise deny them. Down to the south the brook continues, intersected by the main path. Further up to the north, beyond the dank, slippery rocks, you can hear a distant roar of water.
rows.translation: 得很深，没入大片泛着微弱蓝光的苔藓之中。这些苔藓生长在潺潺溪流周围陡峭而泥泞的地面上。溪岸边繁茂地生长着结构精巧的花草；水流经过此处，为较小的蕨类与花朵腾出了空间和阳光，而四周高大的铁木原本会把这一切都夺走。小溪向南继续流淌，与主路相交。沿溪流继续向北，越过湿滑阴冷的岩石，你能听见远处传来的水流轰鸣。
rows.raw: " deep into the mounds of faintly luminescent blue moss which bloom in the steep, boggy grounds that surround the chattering, gurgling stream. Intricate floral life flourishes along its banks, the passage of water allowing smaller ferns and flowers space and light that the massive ironwoods all around otherwise deny them. Down to the south the brook continues, intersected by the main path. Further up to the north, beyond the dank, slippery rocks, you can hear a distant roar of water."

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: Heart pounding and sweat on your brow despite the cool spray of the stream, you clamber up the steep, dank banks, any worry you have about damaging the plant-life swiftly superseded by your need for good handholds upon the slippery rocks. At least there’s no chance of losing your way - the roar of water gets closer and closer. You blink in sudden sunlight as you emerge in a break of tree cover upon a mossy plateau. Finally, you have a clear view of what lies ahead.
rows.translation: 尽管溪水飞沫清凉，你仍然心跳如鼓、额头冒汗，沿着陡峭湿滑的河岸向上攀爬。你原本还担心会伤到这些植物，但在湿滑岩石间寻找可靠落手点的迫切需要很快压过了这种顾虑。至少你不可能迷路 - 水流的轰鸣声越来越近。你登上一片长满苔藓的高地，脱离树冠遮蔽时，突如其来的阳光让你眨了眨眼。终于，你能清楚看见前方有什么了。
rows.raw: "Heart pounding and sweat on your brow despite the cool spray of the stream, you clamber up the steep, dank banks, any worry you have about damaging the plant-life swiftly superseded by your need for good handholds upon the slippery rocks. At least there’s no chance of losing your way - the roar of water gets closer and closer. You blink in sudden sunlight as you emerge in a break of tree cover upon a mossy plateau. Finally, you have a clear view of what lies ahead."

rows.original: Above you a big waterfall comes thundering down from many feet above into a deep pool. The vast, ceaseless power of it throws up writhing veils of white vapor that breathe blessings on your hot [pc.skinFurScales]. It is shouldered by sheer, red rock cliffs that climb out of the jungle both to the east and west. The more you take it in the more daunting the prospect is - without going many miles out of your way, the only method of getting at the highlands above will be to clamber up the layered, craggy rock face alongside the waterfall.
rows.translation: 你上方，一道大瀑布从数十英尺高处轰鸣而下，落入深潭。它那浩瀚无尽的力量激起翻涌的白色水雾，为你灼热的[pc.skinFurScales]送来阵阵恩泽。瀑布东西两侧耸立着陡峭的红色岩壁，从丛林中拔地而起。你看得越久，越觉得眼前的路令人望而生畏 - 除非愿意绕行许多英里，否则要抵达上方高地，就只能沿着瀑布旁层叠崎岖的岩壁向上攀爬。
rows.raw: "\n\nAbove you a big waterfall comes thundering down from many feet above into a deep pool. The vast, ceaseless power of it throws up writhing veils of white vapor that breathe blessings on your hot [pc.skinFurScales]. It is shouldered by sheer, red rock cliffs that climb out of the jungle both to the east and west. The more you take it in the more daunting the prospect is - without going many miles out of your way, the only method of getting at the highlands above will be to clamber up the layered, craggy rock face alongside the waterfall."

rows.original: “So, you finally made it!” says a harsh, buzzing voice, from above and behind you. You whirl around. A rangy, carapace-clad figure is lounging in a nearby tree. He is perhaps taller and better built than your average zil, his gleaming black limbs rounded with nimble, wiry muscle, a thin, meandering scar across one eye. In one hand a large, smooth rock attached to a fibrous rope dangles.
rows.translation: “你终于到了！”一个刺耳的嗡鸣声从你身后上方响起。你猛然转身。附近一棵树上懒散地倚着一个身形修长、身披甲壳的人影。他也许比普通兹尔更高大健壮，闪亮的黑色四肢上隆起灵活而精悍的肌肉，一道细长蜿蜒的伤疤划过一只眼睛。他一只手中垂着一块绑在纤维绳索上的光滑大石头。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, you finally made it!” says a harsh, buzzing voice, from above and behind you. You whirl around. A rangy, carapace-clad figure is lounging in a nearby tree. He is perhaps taller and better built than your average zil, his gleaming black limbs rounded with nimble, wiry muscle, a thin, meandering scar across one eye. In one hand a large, smooth rock attached to a fibrous rope dangles."

rows.original: “I hope your intention was not to approach our village stealthily,” he goes on, carelessly twirling his rope club as he eyes you. “We heard you banging and crashing through the trees from miles away. We smelt you not long after.” He breathes in, long and deep. “My brother’s scent is upon you. Not surprising; he, like you, is a pawn of the land-stealers. Yes... I smell the weakness, the submissiveness, the excitement at being bent over and put in his rightful place. Or is that just you? Perhaps this is the natural scent of pawns.” Anger and lust cloud over the insouciance on his long, brooding face. “I shall happily see to such desires, land-stealer puppet!”
rows.translation: “我希望你不是打算悄悄接近我们的村庄，”他继续说道，打量着你，漫不经心地甩动绳锤。“隔着几英里，我们都能听到你在树林里撞得砰砰作响。没过多久，我们也闻到了你的气味。”他缓慢而深沉地吸了一口气。“你身上有我兄弟的气味。并不奇怪；他和你一样，都是那些夺地者的走狗。没错...我闻得到那份软弱、顺从，还有被他按倒、摆回自己应有位置时的兴奋。又或者那只是你的味道？也许走狗天生就是这种气味。”愤怒与欲望蒙上他那张修长阴郁的脸，遮去了先前的漫不经心。“我很乐意满足这种欲望，夺地者的傀儡！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I hope your intention was not to approach our village stealthily,” he goes on, carelessly twirling his rope club as he eyes you. “We heard you banging and crashing through the trees from miles away. We smelt you not long after.” He breathes in, long and deep. “My brother’s scent is upon you. Not surprising; he, like you, is a pawn of the land-stealers. Yes... I smell the weakness, the submissiveness, the excitement at being bent over and put in his rightful place. Or is that just you? Perhaps this is the natural scent of pawns.” Anger and lust cloud over the insouciance on his long, brooding face. “I shall happily see to such desires, land-stealer puppet!”"

rows.translation: 透明双翼一阵闪动，漆黑紧实的肌肉随之流转，他已落到地面，一边逼近你，一边将武器抡出凶狠的弧线。

rows.original: You are on the open, mossy plateau at the bottom of the waterfall. It comes thundering down from many feet above into a deep pool. The vast, ceaseless power of it throws up writhing veils of white vapor that breathe blessings on your hot [pc.skinFurScales]. It is shouldered by sheer, red rock cliffs that climb out of the jungle both to the east and west. The more you take it in the more daunting the prospect is - without going many miles out of your way, the only method of getting at the highlands above that you can immediately see is to clamber up the layered, multitudinous rock face beside the waterfall.
rows.translation: 你身处瀑布底部开阔而长满苔藓的高地上。瀑布从数十英尺高处轰鸣而下，落入深潭。它那浩瀚无尽的力量激起翻涌的白色水雾，为你灼热的[pc.skinFurScales]送来阵阵恩泽。瀑布东西两侧耸立着陡峭的红色岩壁，从丛林中拔地而起。你看得越久，越觉得眼前的路令人望而生畏 - 除非愿意绕行许多英里，否则眼下能看到的通往上方高地的唯一道路，就是沿着瀑布旁层层叠叠的岩壁向上攀爬。
rows.raw: "You are on the open, mossy plateau at the bottom of the waterfall. It comes thundering down from many feet above into a deep pool. The vast, ceaseless power of it throws up writhing veils of white vapor that breathe blessings on your hot [pc.skinFurScales]. It is shouldered by sheer, red rock cliffs that climb out of the jungle both to the east and west. The more you take it in the more daunting the prospect is - without going many miles out of your way, the only method of getting at the highlands above that you can immediately see is to clamber up the layered, multitudinous rock face beside the waterfall."

rows.original: “You return!” says a harsh, buzzing voice from behind you. Kane is in his tree, leg dangling, watching you with an insouciant sneer.
rows.translation: “你回来了！”一个刺耳的嗡鸣声从你身后响起。凯恩正坐在他的树上，一条腿垂在外面，带着漫不经心的冷笑注视着你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You return!” says a harsh, buzzing voice from behind you. Kane is in his tree, leg dangling, watching you with an insouciant sneer."

rows.original: “Was the first set of lumps not enough of a lesson?” the scarred zil asks, swinging his club. “Did I knock you completely silly, and now you cannot find your way back to the feet of your land-stealing masters? Or perhaps you enjoy being put in your place.” His voice lowers to a lustful drone. “Perhaps you cannot get enough of it. Certainly, that is what your scent is telling me. Very well - but do not expect my foreplay to be any more lenient, pawn slut.”
rows.translation: “上次那些肿包还没让你得到足够教训吗？”满身伤疤的基尔挥舞棍棒问道。“难道我把你彻底打傻了，让你现在找不到回到那些夺地者主人脚边的路？还是说，你喜欢被人教训，让自己认清地位？”他的声音压低成充满欲望的嗡鸣。“或许你根本享受不够。至少，你的气味确实是这样告诉我的。很好，不过别指望我的前戏会比上次更加宽容，棋子骚货。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Was the first set of lumps not enough of a lesson?” the scarred zil asks, swinging his club. “Did I knock you completely silly, and now you cannot find your way back to the feet of your land-stealing masters? Or perhaps you enjoy being put in your place.” His voice lowers to a lustful drone. “Perhaps you cannot get enough of it. Certainly, that is what your scent is telling me. Very well - but do not expect my foreplay to be any more lenient, pawn slut.”"

rows.translation: 你试图用[pc.meleeWeapon]把他们扫开...却感觉某样迅捷致命的东西从下巴旁掠过。你惊讶地意识到，峭壁上排列着许多女性基尔，短弓弓弦紧绷，正全神贯注地等待再次朝你放箭。

rows.original: The message is extremely clear. You dive back towards the foot of the waterfall, trailing cheering zil as you go. They break off and whine back to the top of the cliff when you get back beneath the tree cover, and you manage to land safely. Looks like you’ll be climbing after all.
rows.translation: 对方传达的意思再清楚不过。你俯冲回瀑布脚下，一路上身后都跟着欢呼的基尔。等你重新回到树冠遮蔽下方，他们才放弃追赶，尖声嗡鸣着飞回峭壁顶部，而你也成功安全着陆。看来最终还是得亲自爬上去。

rows.raw: "To the immediate west of the foaming waterfall pool the land rises, tufts of scrub growing out of natural steps at the foot of the red rock cliff. If you carefully climb outwards upon them from the waterfall pool, you can work your way around onto the cliff face proper."

rows.original: The angular, chipped rock is fairly level and dry here, high up the variegated cliff face. Going off the bleached wood and tangles of dried-out vegetation straggling the rock here and there, the waterfall probably once ran over this part of the mountain as well before some calamitous shrug of geography changed the river’s course. From this vantage point, you can at last see the top of the falls - a white curtain tumbling down over a sheer ledge thirty feet above - and what you have to do to get to the top. The next stage is the short face just across the withered scrub, or the deadly wet causeway below.
rows.translation: 在这片高耸斑驳的崖壁上，棱角分明、布满缺口的岩石相当平坦干燥。从各处散落的漂白木头与纠缠在岩石间的干枯植被来看，瀑布过去大概也曾流经山体的这一部分，直到某次灾难性的地质变动改变了河道。站在这个位置，你终于能看见瀑布顶端 - 一道白色水幕从三十英尺高的陡峭岩缘倾泻而下 - 以及登顶所需走的路线。下一段路要么是越过枯萎灌木后的那面矮崖，要么是下方那条致命的湿滑通道。

rows.original: Two flickering candles set in alcoves right at the back light the cave, which stretches back about fifteen feet. The walls are covered with ochre palm prints and spindly paintings of winged beings on hunts, defeating serpents, kneeling before indescribable objects and beings... there is a carved table at the back between the two candles, upon which a number of items have been placed - arrowheads, a necklace of small discs, a long, curved fang.

rows.original: You think you can make out the gleaming white of Esbeth in the distance - and the gleaming reflection of spacecraft taking off and coming in. rows.original:
There’s a bulky, cylindrical object stowed here, like a rolled up fence. When you ask them to, two female zil carry it to the cliff and unroll it over the edge; the rope ladder thumps and clatters its way out of view.

The climb down is long and slightly unnerving, but the fibrous rope is strong and it’s a hell of a lot better than doing it with your hands and [pc.feet]. After a short while you are back next to the waterfall pool, and the ladder is being hoisted back out of sight.

When you ask them to, two female zil carry it to the cliff and unroll it over the edge; the rope ladder thumps and clatters its way out of view.\n\nThe climb down is long and slightly unnerving, but the fibrous rope is strong and it’s a hell of a lot better than doing it with your hands and [pc.feet]. You can only focus on one thing - getting down and away from this vertical nightmare, now."

rows.original: You don’t remember much of the next hour - it’s an agonizing descent, one slow finger-hold down after another, that terrible war-like blend of boredom and all-pervading fear. The one blessing is that the zil don’t attack you. Perhaps they sense you no longer present a threat to them, or simply don’t have the stomach to attack you in your current state.
rows.translation: 接下来一个小时的事，你已经记不太清了；那是一段痛苦的下降过程，一次又一次缓慢地向下挪动手指，枯燥和无处不在的恐惧以战争般可怕的方式交织在一起。唯一值得庆幸的是，兹尔没有袭击你。或许他们感觉到你已经不再构成威胁，又或许只是不忍心攻击此刻的你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou don’t remember much of the next hour - it’s an agonizing descent, one slow finger-hold down after another, that terrible war-like blend of boredom and all-pervading fear. The one blessing is that the zil don’t attack you. Perhaps they sense you no longer present a threat to them, or simply don’t have the stomach to attack you in your current state."

rows.original: After altogether too long, you are collapsed in a sweat-soaked heap near the roaring hush of the waterfall pool, waiting for your heartbeat to return to normal and the adrenaline to stop jangling your nerves. Dully you stare up at the towering cliff that has defeated you. You are going to need a long rest, and maybe a rethink, before attempting it again.
rows.translation: 过了实在太久，你终于瘫倒在瀑布水潭震耳欲聋的低啸旁，蜷成一团，浑身被汗水湿透，等待心跳恢复正常，也等待肾上腺素不再搅得神经躁动不安。你麻木地仰望着那座击败了你的高耸悬崖。再次尝试之前，你需要好好休息一番，或许还得重新考虑一下办法。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter altogether too long, you are collapsed in a sweat-soaked heap near the roaring hush of the waterfall pool, waiting for your heartbeat to return to normal and the adrenaline to stop jangling your nerves. Dully you stare up at the towering cliff that has defeated you. You are going to need a long rest, and maybe a rethink, before attempting it again."

rows.original: a hard climb
rows.raw: "a hard climb"

rows.raw: "2 WATERFALL POOL"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You bring your [pc.weapon] up to bear, preparing to give your insectile opponent a swatting... and place your weight on rock that suddenly isn’t there at all. You suck in a huge gulp of air as you find yourself slipping, falling, desperately clawing at the cliff face as you slide off the perch, jutting stone clawing at your chest and face. The callous laughter of the zil rings in your ears as handfuls of dirt come loose in your hands and you find yourself watching the ledge fly away from you... and the only sound is the waterfall and the air in your ears, very loud...
rows.translation: 你举起[pc.weapon]准备迎击，打算把这个昆虫般的对手拍扁……却将体重压在一块突然消失无踪的岩石上。你猛吸一大口气，发现自己正在滑落、坠下，只能绝望地抓挠崖壁；你从栖身处滑脱，凸出的岩石撕扯着你的胸口和脸颊。兹尔冷酷的笑声在耳边回响，你手中的泥土一把把松脱，眼睁睁看着那处岩架离你飞速远去……四周只剩下瀑布声和耳边的风声，震耳欲聋……
rows.raw: "You bring your [pc.weapon] up to bear, preparing to give your insectile opponent a swatting... and place your weight on rock that suddenly isn’t there at all. You suck in a huge gulp of air as you find yourself slipping, falling, desperately clawing at the cliff face as you slide off the perch, jutting stone clawing at your chest and face. The callous laughter of the zil rings in your ears as handfuls of dirt come loose in your hands and you find yourself watching the ledge fly away from you... and the only sound is the waterfall and the air in your ears, very loud..."

rows.raw: "10 TOP OF THE CLIFF"

rows.original: SMACK. You thump hip-first into another sandstone outcrop, narrowly avoiding cracking your chin on it as you recoil. Chest heaving, you fearfully grab onto it, managing to stop yourself from falling any further. You’re alive. Just about. As you get your breath back and more of the world comes back into focus, horrible pain flares in your [pc.legOrLegs] and the wounds on your chest and face begin to sink their teeth into you. You stare hollow-eyed up to where you were only a moment ago, where a smirking zil is just disappearing from view. The only comfort, your imagination lets you know in graphic detail, is that taking a fall like that could have ended a lot worse.
rows.translation: 砰！你臀部先着地，重重撞上另一处砂岩突起，身体弹起时险些磕裂下巴。你胸口剧烈起伏，惊恐地抓紧岩石，总算止住了继续下坠的势头。你还活着。勉强算是。等你喘匀了气，眼前的世界也渐渐恢复清晰，[pc.legOrLegs]中骤然燃起剧痛，胸口和脸上的伤口也开始狠狠折磨你。你双眼空洞地仰望着片刻之前还身处的地方，一个面露讥笑的兹尔刚好从视野中消失。你的想象以无比鲜明的细节提醒你，唯一值得安慰的，就是那样摔下来本可能落得更加凄惨的下场。
rows.raw: "\n\nSMACK. You thump hip-first into another sandstone outcrop, narrowly avoiding cracking your chin on it as you recoil. Chest heaving, you fearfully grab onto it, managing to stop yourself from falling any further. You’re alive. Just about. As you get your breath back and more of the world comes back into focus, horrible pain flares in your [pc.legOrLegs] and the wounds on your chest and face begin to sink their teeth into you. You stare hollow-eyed up to where you were only a moment ago, where a smirking zil is just disappearing from view. The only comfort, your imagination lets you know in graphic detail, is that taking a fall like that could have ended a lot worse."

rows.original: SPLAT. You thump into the moist turf at the bottom of the cliff, narrowly avoiding the deadly rocky outcrop nearby. Chest heaving, you curl into a foetal position and groan. You’re alive. Just about. As you get your breath back and more of the world comes back into focus, horrible pain flares in your [pc.legOrLegs] and the wounds on your chest and face begin to sink their teeth into you. You stare hollow-eyed up to where you were only a moment ago, where a smirking zil is just disappearing from view. The only comfort, your imagination lets you know in graphic detail, is that taking a fall like that could have ended a lot worse.

rows.original: You are up the banks of the river, safely north from the head of the waterfall. There’s a fresh breeze up here quite unlike the oppressive humidity in the jungle below, carrying the scent of something like lavender, oozing honey and the more homely smell of wax. The zil build their homes out of the stuff, as you can clearly see; vaguely tepee-shaped, pale yellow dwellings built around the cedar-like trees and the swift river, as well as wooden platforms and rope bridges in the boughs, crossing the water at various points.
rows.translation: 你身处河岸上游，瀑布源头以北的安全地带。这里吹着清新的微风，与下方丛林中令人窒息的湿热截然不同；风中带着类似薰衣草的香气、渗出的蜂蜜味，以及更有居家气息的蜂蜡味。你可以清楚看到，兹尔正是用这种东西建造家园的：形似圆锥帐篷的淡黄色住所环绕着雪松般的树木和湍急的河流搭建，树枝间还有木制平台和绳桥，在多处横跨水面。
rows.raw: "You are up the banks of the river, safely north from the head of the waterfall. There’s a fresh breeze up here quite unlike the oppressive humidity in the jungle below, carrying the scent of something like lavender, oozing honey and the more homely smell of wax. The zil build their homes out of the stuff, as you can clearly see; vaguely tepee-shaped, pale yellow dwellings built around the cedar-like trees and the swift river, as well as wooden platforms and rope bridges in the boughs, crossing the water at various points."

rows.original: This place is empty now, the wind blowing nothing but memories. Somehow it gives you the creeps a lot more than when it was packed with watching zil.
rows.translation: 如今这里空无一人，风中吹拂的只有回忆。不知为何，比起这里挤满注视着你的兹尔时，这副景象反而更让你毛骨悚然。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis place is empty now, the wind blowing nothing but memories. Somehow it gives you the creeps a lot more than when it was packed with watching zil."

rows.original: From their doorways and platforms the zil watch you with frank but amicable curiosity. No longer a war camp, the infirm and the young have moved back in, lending the village a friendlier, fuller vibe, and there’s a mild buzz of activity and hubbub around you.
rows.translation: 兹尔们从门口和平台上注视着你，目光坦率而友善。这里不再是战营，伤病者和孩子们已经搬了回来，为村庄增添了更加友好、充实的氛围；你周围到处都是轻微的忙碌声与喧闹声。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom their doorways and platforms the zil watch you with frank but amicable curiosity. No longer a war camp, the infirm and the young have moved back in, lending the village a friendlier, fuller vibe, and there’s a mild buzz of activity and hubbub around you."

rows.original: You approached this literal nest of wasps as carefully as you could - however the few zil you see hang off you, watching your approach from doorways and trees with surly, wary black eyes.
rows.translation: 你已经尽可能小心地接近这个名副其实的蜂巢，然而你见到的少数几个兹尔却远远躲着你，从门口和树上用阴沉而戒备的黑眼睛注视着你靠近。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou approached this literal nest of wasps as carefully as you could - however the few zil you see hang off you, watching your approach from doorways and trees with surly, wary black eyes."

rows.original: You recognize the male on the nearest platform by his size and scar. Kane gazes down at you, boot dangling, po-faced. Possibly you’re imagining it, but you think you detect the slightest hint of grudging admiration underneath that overhang of hair.
rows.translation: 你凭体格和伤疤认出了最近平台上的那个男性。凯恩一只靴子悬在空中，板着脸俯视着你。也许只是你的错觉，但你觉得自己从那片垂落的头发下面，察觉到了一丝极其微弱而又不情愿的钦佩。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou recognize the male on the nearest platform by his size and scar. Kane gazes down at you, boot dangling, po-faced. Possibly you’re imagining it, but you think you detect the slightest hint of grudging admiration underneath that overhang of hair."

rows.original: “Quinn will speak with you,” he says. “You can rest here first, if you wish. I would.” He disappears further into the woods without another word.
rows.translation: “奎因会和你谈谈，”他说。“如果愿意，你可以先在这里休息一下。换作是我就会这么做。”说完，他一言不发地消失在树林深处。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Quinn will speak with you,” he says. “You can rest here first, if you wish. I would.” He disappears further into the woods without another word."

rows.original: Ahead the river deviates to the west, thanks to a steep promontory of rock. A wooden ramp leads up it, surrounded by zil wax-homes. To the south the river runs its course to the cliff edge.
rows.translation: 前方的河流因一处陡峭的岩石岬角而折向西方。一条木坡道沿着岬角向上延伸，周围遍布兹尔的蜂蜡住所。河水则向南奔流，直至悬崖边缘。
rows.raw: "\n\nAhead the river deviates to the west, thanks to a steep promontory of rock. A wooden ramp leads up it, surrounded by zil wax-homes. To the south the river runs its course to the cliff edge."

rows.original: RK Lah - Captured
rows.raw: "RK Lah - Captured"

rows.original: The two male zil wordlessly hustle R.K. Lah over to you as you step down the ramp, his thin wrists bound. Time to take the defeated ausar back to the Plantation, you guess.
rows.translation: 你走下坡道时，两名男性兹尔默不作声地将RK·拉推到你面前，他纤细的手腕已被绑住。你猜，是时候把这个落败的奥萨尔带回种植园了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two male zil wordlessly hustle R.K. Lah over to you as you step down the ramp, his thin wrists bound. Time to take the defeated ausar back to the Plantation, you guess."

rows.original: (Key Item Gained: RK Lah - Captured)
rows.translation: （获得关键物品：RK·拉 - 已俘获）
rows.raw: "\n\n(Key Item Gained: RK Lah - Captured)"

rows.original: RK Lah - Captured
rows.raw: "RK Lah - Captured"

rows.original: You blink. You can’t see anything in that particular tree at the edge of the settlement that you’ve come to know so very well. Where has Kane gone?
rows.translation: 你眨了眨眼。在定居点边缘那棵你已经无比熟悉的特殊树木上，你什么也看不见。凯恩去哪里了？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou blink. You can’t see anything in that particular tree at the edge of the settlement that you’ve come to know so very well. Where has Kane gone?"

rows.original: In the foliage of a tree at the very edge of the settlement, you can just about make out a single, dangling black boot. The sort that might be attached to a big male zil, perhaps.
rows.translation: 在定居点最边缘一棵树的枝叶间，你勉强辨认出一只悬垂的黑色靴子。或许正连在某个高大雄性兹尔的脚上。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn the foliage of a tree at the very edge of the settlement, you can just about make out a single, dangling black boot. The sort that might be attached to a big male zil, perhaps."

rows.original: Kane
rows.translation: 凯恩
rows.raw: "Kane"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: You slowly climb up the wooden ramp. The sound of footsteps makes you turn. You’re being followed up it by more than a dozen zil, all armed, all returning your stare with silent animosity. No way out of this now, you guess.
rows.translation: 你缓缓走上木质坡道。脚步声令你回过头。十多个兹尔正跟在后面登上坡道，每个人都全副武装，以沉默的敌意回望你的注视。看来现在已经无路可退了。
rows.raw: "You slowly climb up the wooden ramp. The sound of footsteps makes you turn. You’re being followed up it by more than a dozen zil, all armed, all returning your stare with silent animosity. No way out of this now, you guess."

rows.original: The top of the promontory is flat, sandy and round, surrounded by the fungus-shaped zil homes, and has a circle of stones in the middle. Zil throng its edges, some carrying torches, and like a hive that has detected a predator approaching an angry hum goes up when you step off the ramp. On the opposite side of the natural terrace there is a large chair - easily the most ornate thing you’ve seen of these zil’s handiwork so far, carved with symbols, polished with wax and covered with... well, there’s only one creature you know of that has a pelt and a snakeskin.
rows.translation: 岬角顶部平坦、铺满沙土，呈圆形，周围坐落着蘑菇形状的兹尔房屋，中央则有一圈石头。兹尔们挤满边缘，有些手持火炬；当你走下坡道时，人群中响起愤怒嗡鸣，宛如一个察觉捕食者靠近的蜂巢。天然露台的另一侧摆着一把大椅子 - 这无疑是迄今为止你在兹尔手艺中见过最华丽的物件，上面雕刻符号，以蜂蜡抛光，还覆盖着... 嗯，你只知道一种生物同时拥有毛皮和蛇皮。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe top of the promontory is flat, sandy and round, surrounded by the fungus-shaped zil homes, and has a circle of stones in the middle. Zil throng its edges, some carrying torches, and like a hive that has detected a predator approaching an angry hum goes up when you step off the ramp. On the opposite side of the natural terrace there is a large chair - easily the most ornate thing you’ve seen of these zil’s handiwork so far, carved with symbols, polished with wax and covered with... well, there’s only one creature you know of that has a pelt and a snakeskin."

rows.original: Standing next to the chair is a tall, rangy ausar; seated on top of it is a zil. Aside from her brilliant golden irises there is physically nothing to mark her out as different from any other female zil - clad in black carapace, slightly taller and slimmer than the norm perhaps, long yellow-and-black hair - but the manner in which she sits, still and poised, and the way in which she regards you, calmly and chin in hand, say more than robes and a crown ever could. Compared to the bee-people you’ve met so far, she looks like she’s carved out of ivory.
rows.translation: 椅子旁站着一个高挑瘦长的奥萨尔；椅子上坐着一个兹尔。除明亮的金色虹膜外，她在身体上没有任何特征能将自己与其他雌性兹尔区分开来 - 身披黑色甲壳，或许比平均身材略高、略瘦，留着黄黑相间的长发 - 但她静止而从容的坐姿，以及托着下巴、冷静审视你的方式，远比长袍与王冠更能说明问题。与此前遇到的蜂人相比，她仿佛由象牙雕成。
rows.raw: "\n\nStanding next to the chair is a tall, rangy ausar; seated on top of it is a zil. Aside from her brilliant golden irises there is physically nothing to mark her out as different from any other female zil - clad in black carapace, slightly taller and slimmer than the norm perhaps, long yellow-and-black hair - but the manner in which she sits, still and poised, and the way in which she regards you, calmly and chin in hand, say more than robes and a crown ever could. Compared to the bee-people you’ve met so far, she looks like she’s carved out of ivory."

rows.original: “This would be the land-stealer’s champion, then,” she says placidly. “You said such would come, and so it was true.”
rows.translation: “这么说，这就是偷地贼的勇士，”她平静地说道。“你说过这样的人会来，事实果真如此。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This would be the land-stealer’s champion, then,” she says placidly. “You said such would come, and so it was true.”"

rows.original: “I- I thought they would send - yes, I did say that, and I speak truths!” growls Remi-Kellen Lah. He looks different enough from his mugshots that you didn’t immediately recognize him, and not just because he’s wearing nothing but the tattered remains of his orange jumpsuit bottoms and some sort of cape-like fur around his neck. Weeks in the jungle have browned his skin, leaned his body right down and turned his gray hair into an unruly mop between his wide, pointy ears. Like the zil chieftain though, the crucial difference is not physical. When the ausar moves towards you it is in a jerky manner, his ears and pale eyes twitching this way and that, as if expecting an attack from an unexpected quarter at any instant. He points a long, clawed finger at you like the thrust of a sword.
rows.translation: “我- 我原以为他们会派出 - 对，我确实这样说过，而我所言皆为真理！”雷米-凯伦·拉低吼道。他与通缉照上的模样差异极大，因此你没有立刻认出来；原因不只在于他除橙色连身服裤子的破烂残片和颈间某种斗篷般的毛皮外一丝不挂。在丛林中度过的数周令他的皮肤晒成棕色，身体变得精瘦，灰发也化作一团不驯的蓬草，夹在宽大尖耳之间。不过与兹尔酋长一样，最关键的差异并非身体层面。这个奥萨尔朝你移动时动作抽搐僵硬，耳朵和苍白双眼不断向各个方向跳动，仿佛随时预料会有袭击从意想不到的方位出现。他伸出带爪长指指向你，犹如利剑刺出。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I- I thought they would send - yes, I did say that, and I speak truths!” growls Remi-Kellen Lah. He looks different enough from his mugshots that you didn’t immediately recognize him, and not just because he’s wearing nothing but the tattered remains of his orange jumpsuit bottoms and some sort of cape-like fur around his neck. Weeks in the jungle have browned his skin, leaned his body right down and turned his gray hair into an unruly mop between his wide, pointy ears. Like the zil chieftain though, the crucial difference is not physical. When the ausar moves towards you it is in a jerky manner, his ears and pale eyes twitching this way and that, as if expecting an attack from an unexpected quarter at any instant. He points a long, clawed finger at you like the thrust of a sword."

rows.original: “First the fascists take your land!” There is an approving murmur of “far shist” around the circle. “Then they send their minions to enforce their greed: indoctrinated wage-slaved pawns.” A wondering, rousing buzz of “indo t’chinater wayslay bawns” follows. “And so the unfairness becomes the new rule. You cannot allow this to happen!” Lah balls his fist. “This pawn’s appearance here only tells us that you are winning the battle, that you have the land-stealers rattled. With their attention on you now, we need only one more great demonstration of your fury and bravery to banish them from your lands forever!”
rows.translation: “首先，法西斯夺走你们的土地！”圆环周围响起赞同的“法·西斯特”低语。“随后，他们派爪牙来强制满足自身贪欲：遭到洗脑的工薪奴隶棋子。”众人带着惊叹与振奋，跟着嗡声念出“因多·特奇纳特·维斯雷·鲍恩斯”。“于是，不公便成了新的规则。你们绝不能允许这种事发生！”拉攥紧拳头。“这个棋子出现在这里，只能说明你们正在赢得战斗，偷地贼已经因你们而惶恐不安。既然他们如今把注意力集中在你们身上，我们只需再一次伟大地展示愤怒与勇气，就能把他们永远逐出你们的土地！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“First the fascists take your land!” There is an approving murmur of “far shist” around the circle. “Then they send their minions to enforce their greed: indoctrinated wage-slaved pawns.” A wondering, rousing buzz of “indo t’chinater wayslay bawns” follows. “And so the unfairness becomes the new rule. You cannot allow this to happen!” Lah balls his fist. “This pawn’s appearance here only tells us that you are winning the battle, that you have the land-stealers rattled. With their attention on you now, we need only one more great demonstration of your fury and bravery to banish them from your lands forever!”"

rows.original: “And what are your words concerning the pawn [pc.him]self?” says the zil chieftain calmly, once the wild cheering has died down. Lah stares at you. There’s something of a battle going on, behind those gray eyes.
rows.translation: “那么，关于棋子[pc.him]本人，你又有何言辞？”狂热欢呼平息后，兹尔酋长冷静地问道。拉凝视着你。那双灰色眼睛后方，似乎正进行着一场战斗。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And what are your words concerning the pawn [pc.him]self?” says the zil chieftain calmly, once the wild cheering has died down. Lah stares at you. There’s something of a battle going on, behind those gray eyes."

rows.original: “[pc.HeShe] has heard the truth,” he says at last, almost visibly biting down on what the ausar who has spent the last four weeks living wild wants to say. “If [pc.heShe] is at peace with it, then [pc.heShe] should go in peace, yes. If [pc.heShe] is here to blindly follow [pc.hisHer] orders, then... then.”
rows.translation: “[pc.HeShe]已经听见真理，”他终于说道，几乎肉眼可见地压制着那个在过去四周野外求生的奥萨尔真正想说的话。“如果[pc.heShe]能与真理和平相处，那么[pc.heShe]就该和平离去，对。如果[pc.heShe]来到这里，只为盲目服从[pc.hisHer]命令，那么... 那么。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.HeShe] has heard the truth,” he says at last, almost visibly biting down on what the ausar who has spent the last four weeks living wild wants to say. “If [pc.heShe] is at peace with it, then [pc.heShe] should go in peace, yes. If [pc.heShe] is here to blindly follow [pc.hisHer] orders, then... then.”"

rows.original: “And what say you, stranger?” Quinn says, gaze traveling up you from [pc.feet] to [pc.hair]. There’s a impatient buzz around the circle’s edge, the clink of wood and the dry, meaty sound of spear meeting sand.
rows.translation: “那么你怎么说，陌生人？”奎因问道，目光从[pc.feet]一路扫到[pc.hair]。圆环边缘响起不耐烦的嗡鸣，以及木材碰撞声和长矛刺入沙地时干涩而厚重的声响。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And what say you, stranger?” Quinn says, gaze traveling up you from [pc.feet] to [pc.hair]. There’s a impatient buzz around the circle’s edge, the clink of wood and the dry, meaty sound of spear meeting sand."

rows.original: “I am Quinn!” the chieftain says loudly, eyeing the crowd, and the grumbling immediately dissipates. “These were the words of the word-wolf when he first came, and it is with them we have become more than we were! The language of the star-people have power, and we have steeped ourselves in it! You shall obey me, for I am Quinn!”
rows.translation: “我是奎因！”酋长高声说道，目光扫过人群，抱怨声立刻烟消云散。“言语之狼初次到来时说的就是这些话，正因这些话，我们才得以超越过去！星民的语言拥有力量，而我们已经将自己浸泡其中！你们必须服从我，因为我是奎因！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I am Quinn!” the chieftain says loudly, eyeing the crowd, and the grumbling immediately dissipates. “These were the words of the word-wolf when he first came, and it is with them we have become more than we were! The language of the star-people have power, and we have steeped ourselves in it! You shall obey me, for I am Quinn!”"

rows.original: “Quinn!” The syllable reverberates like a drum roll around the promontory. Beside her, Lah massages his brow with a look of profound despair.
rows.translation: “奎因！”这个音节如鼓点般回荡在岬角周围。她身旁，拉满脸深切绝望地揉着额头。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Quinn!” The syllable reverberates like a drum roll around the promontory. Beside her, Lah massages his brow with a look of profound despair."

rows.original: “Quinn! The ancestor stone - it’s gone! Taken!” she gasps, breasts heaving. She is too out of puff to do anything more but point accusingly.
rows.translation: “奎因！先祖之石 - 不见了！被人拿走了！”她乳房剧烈起伏，气喘吁吁地说道。她上气不接下气，除了指控般伸手指向前方之外什么也做不了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Quinn! The ancestor stone - it’s gone! Taken!” she gasps, breasts heaving. She is too out of puff to do anything more but point accusingly."

rows.original: “KILL [pc.himHer]!” cries the chieftain, fury finally breaking that mask of preternatural calm. The angry buzz grows into a throbbing snarl that presses upon you from every side, the entire throng of warrior zil descends upon you, torches and flint-blades flashing.
rows.translation: “杀了[pc.himHer]！”酋长大喊，愤怒终于击碎了那张超乎常人的平静面具。愤怒嗡鸣膨胀成搏动咆哮，从四面八方向你压来；整群兹尔战士朝你猛扑而下，火炬与燧石刀刃闪烁不止。
rows.raw: "\n\n“KILL [pc.himHer]!” cries the chieftain, fury finally breaking that mask of preternatural calm. The angry buzz grows into a throbbing snarl that presses upon you from every side, the entire throng of warrior zil descends upon you, torches and flint-blades flashing."

rows.original: “[pc.HeShe] speaks falsehoods, put in [pc.his] head by the land-stealers!” says Lah with loud certainty. He again points damningly at you. “I am your word-wolf, and I speak truths! [pc.HeShe] is nothing but a weak, mendacious liar, hoping to steal your truth-speaker away without even a fair fight!”
rows.translation: “[pc.HeShe]口吐谎言，那些都是偷地贼灌进[pc.his]脑袋里的！”拉无比笃定地高声说道，再次带着谴责意味伸手指向你。“我是你们的言语之狼，而我所言皆为真理！[pc.HeShe]不过是个软弱虚伪的骗子，妄图不经公平战斗就偷走你们的真理传述者！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.HeShe] speaks falsehoods, put in [pc.his] head by the land-stealers!” says Lah with loud certainty. He again points damningly at you. “I am your word-wolf, and I speak truths! [pc.HeShe] is nothing but a weak, mendacious liar, hoping to steal your truth-speaker away without even a fair fight!”"

rows.raw: "“I challenge him to battle!” you say, pointing at Lah, loudly enough for the crowd to hear. “If I beat his sorry ass you will give me a fair hearing about this business, as is your custom!”"

Quinn frowns, stroking her chin. “[pc.HeShe] seeks to impose [pc.hisHer] will on you through violence, as is the land-stealer’s way, just in a different way!” the ausar goes on urgently. “You cannot listen to [pc.himHer] - [pc.heShe] speaks lies, I speak truths!”

rows.translation: “很公平，”奎因点头。她一侧嘴角流露出玩味之意，在王座上调整姿势，重新交叠闪亮双腿。“言语之狼，按照我们的习俗，重新证明自己吧。这会令我愉悦。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It is fair,” Quinn nods. Amusement is playing with one corner of her mouth; she rearranges herself on her throne, re-crossing her gleaming legs. “Reassert yourself word-wolf, as is our custom. It will be pleasing to me.”"

rows.original: Lah clutches at the air in total exasperation - and then, with a reluctant huff, descends to the stone circle. The hum around you is now one of excited anticipation, and the crowd of zil close in around you. Several of them gather around Lah, and he emerges from them armed with a short stabbing spear.
rows.translation: 拉彻底恼怒地抓挠空气，随后不情愿地哼了一声，走下石台，进入圆形空地。你周围的嗡鸣如今充满兴奋期待，兹尔人群也朝你们靠拢。几人聚集在拉身边；等他再次现身时，手中已经装备一根用于刺击的短矛。

The hum around you is now one of excited anticipation, and the crowd of zil close in around you. Several of them gather around Lah, and he emerges from them armed with a short stabbing spear."

rows.original: “Lay down your weapons and take off your armor,” he growls, glaring at the sandy ground in front of you. “I know - pigs - have no knowledge of the concept, but this is supposed to be - yes, a fair fight.”

He stalks towards you, pale eyes bulging, claws and teeth bared like the vengeance of some terrible, ancient forest god - and then he collapses in a shivering, coughing heap in front of you, nothing more than a hungry, slightly unhinged ausar.

The zil shuffle out of the way, allowing you to approach the female zil on the chair again. You quickly struggle on your [pc.gear] again and do so. Quinn looks... is impressed the right word? There’s color in her pale cheeks, and she smiles at you with frank, warm pleasure, one hand sliding up a gleaming black thigh. “I do so enjoy watching a hard-fought rut.
