rows.translation: 而且胜者还如此出人意料！”
rows.raw: " A surprise victor, too!”"

rows.original: “You have earned the right to a fair hearing,” she goes on, in slightly cooler tones. “Quinn will listen. Be warned though - you will have to speak better truths than the word-wolf if you are to shake our resolve to destroy the land-stealers. I doubt you can.”
rows.translation: “你已经赢得了接受公正陈情的权利，”她语气稍冷地继续道。“奎因会听你说。不过先警告你；若想动摇我们摧毁夺地者的决心，你就必须讲出比言语之狼更有说服力的真理。我不认为你能做到。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You have earned the right to a fair hearing,” she goes on, in slightly cooler tones. “Quinn will listen. Be warned though - you will have to speak better truths than the word-wolf if you are to shake our resolve to destroy the land-stealers. I doubt you can.”"

rows.original: The zil behind you have quieted, enough for you to hear a shuffling in the sand. Lah clambering back to his feet.
rows.translation: 你身后的兹尔已经安静下来，静得足以让你听见沙地上的窸窣声。是拉正挣扎着重新站起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zil behind you have quieted, enough for you to hear a shuffling in the sand. Lah clambering back to his feet."

rows.original: Disarmed
rows.raw: "Disarmed"

rows.original: Disarmed
rows.raw: "Disarmed"

rows.original: Demand
rows.translation: 要求
rows.raw: "Demand"

rows.original: Demand
rows.translation: 要求
rows.raw: "Demand"

rows.original: Explain that Lah is a fugitive, that you’re taking him back to face the music, and that is where the matter will end.
rows.translation: 解释拉是一名逃犯，你正带他回去接受惩罚，而事情到此便会结束。
rows.raw: "Explain that Lah is a fugitive, that you’re taking him back to face the music, and that is where the matter will end."

rows.original: Diplomacy
rows.translation: 外交
rows.raw: "Diplomacy"

rows.original: Diplomacy
rows.translation: 外交
rows.raw: "Diplomacy"

rows.original: There’s got to be a third way, here. Maybe they could seek a pact with the people of Esbeth, see if they can’t block Snugglé’s plans?
rows.translation: 这里一定还有第三条路。也许他们可以设法与埃斯贝斯的居民缔结协议，看看能否阻止舒适乐的计划？
rows.raw: "There’s got to be a third way, here. Maybe they could seek a pact with the people of Esbeth, see if they can’t block Snugglé’s plans?"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “Gonna have to insist, lady,” you say, meaningfully reaching for your [pc.weapon]. “We settled matters your way. Now Lah is coming with me.”
rows.translation: “恐怕我必须坚持，女士，”你说着，意味深长地伸手去拿你的[pc.weapon]。“我们已经按你的方式解决了问题。现在拉得跟我走。”
rows.raw: "“Gonna have to insist, lady,” you say, meaningfully reaching for your [pc.weapon]. “We settled matters your way. Now Lah is coming with me.”"

rows.original: “Quinn has listened to you fairly, as was demanded,” replies the female zil coldly. “And I have found the word-wolf’s truths ring true - you are nothing but a mindless pawn of the land-stealers. So die.”
rows.translation: “奎因已经按要求公正地听你说完了，”雌性兹尔冷冷答道。“而我发现，言语之狼的真理确实言之有理——你不过是夺地者手中一个没有思想的傀儡。所以去死吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Quinn has listened to you fairly, as was demanded,” replies the female zil coldly. “And I have found the word-wolf’s truths ring true - you are nothing but a mindless pawn of the land-stealers. So die.”"

rows.original: The angry hum becomes an all-encompassing drone as the tribe of zil descend upon you.
rows.translation: 随着兹尔部族朝你俯冲而下，愤怒的嗡鸣化作笼罩一切的轰鸣。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe angry hum becomes an all-encompassing drone as the tribe of zil descend upon you."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: ZIL TRIBE
rows.raw: "ZIL TRIBE"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “That ausar is not a soothsayer, or whatever he’s got you believing,” you say, as levelly as you can. “He’s a dangerous fugitive who’ll say anything to stay out of jail. I’m here to take him back to face justice. Once I have, you won’t be bothered again.”
rows.translation: “那个奥萨不是预言家，也不是他让你们相信的什么人物，”你尽可能平静地说道。“他是个危险的逃犯，为了不坐牢什么话都说得出口。我来这里是要把他带回去接受审判。等我带走他以后，你们就不会再受打扰了。”
rows.raw: "“That ausar is not a soothsayer, or whatever he’s got you believing,” you say, as levelly as you can. “He’s a dangerous fugitive who’ll say anything to stay out of jail. I’m here to take him back to face justice. Once I have, you won’t be bothered again.”"

rows.original: The resumption of the angry humming behind you tells you that this hasn’t gone down well.
rows.translation: 身后再度响起的愤怒嗡鸣告诉你，这番话并没有得到好反应。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe resumption of the angry humming behind you tells you that this hasn’t gone down well."

rows.original: “Told you,” mutters Lah.
rows.translation: “早跟你说了，”拉低声嘟囔道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Told you,” mutters Lah."

rows.original: “Bothered?” replies Quinn, anger flashing on her enlivened face. “Me and mine will remain bothered for as long as strangers steal our land and guard it with their white death stings! Or perhaps you didn’t think our truths worth listening to? Who you call oh-sir has provided us with explanations, a way forward, a direction for our ire. If you cannot do similar then either admit to his truths - or die. There is no because-I-say-so.”
rows.translation: “打扰？”奎因答道，怒火在她神采焕发的脸上一闪而过。“只要外来者还在夺取我们的土地、用他们的白色致命毒刺守卫它，我和我的族人就会一直受到打扰！还是说，你根本不觉得我们的真理值得倾听？你所称的‘噢-瑟’为我们提供了解释、前进的道路，以及怒火的方向。如果你无法做到同样的事，那就承认他的真理——否则就去死。这里容不得‘因为我说了算’。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bothered?” replies Quinn, anger flashing on her enlivened face. “Me and mine will remain bothered for as long as strangers steal our land and guard it with their white death stings! Or perhaps you didn’t think our truths worth listening to? Who you call oh-sir has provided us with explanations, a way forward, a direction for our ire. If you cannot do similar then either admit to his truths - or die. There is no because-I-say-so.”"

rows.original: Insist
rows.translation: 坚持
rows.raw: "Insist"

rows.original: Insist
rows.translation: 坚持
rows.raw: "Insist"

rows.original: You’re taking Lah, whether they like it or not.
rows.translation: 无论他们愿不愿意，你都要带走拉。
rows.raw: "You’re taking Lah, whether they like it or not."

rows.original: Diplomacy
rows.translation: 外交手段
rows.raw: "Diplomacy"

rows.original: Diplomacy
rows.translation: 外交手段
rows.raw: "Diplomacy"

rows.original: There’s got to be a third way, here. Maybe they could seek a pact with the people of Esbeth, see if they can’t block Snugglé’s plans?
rows.translation: 这里肯定还有第三条路。也许他们可以设法与埃斯贝斯的人缔结盟约，看看能否阻止舒适乐的计划？
rows.raw: "There’s got to be a third way, here. Maybe they could seek a pact with the people of Esbeth, see if they can’t block Snugglé’s plans?"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “I’ll offer you real truth, how’s that?” you say, looking Lah dead in the eye. “And the truth is that that guy has been telling you star-people’s words have a lot more power than they actually do.”
rows.translation: “我来告诉你真正的真相，怎么样？”你直视着拉的双眼说道。“真相就是，那家伙一直告诉你们，星际人的话语拥有的力量远比实际大得多。”
rows.raw: "“I’ll offer you real truth, how’s that?” you say, looking Lah dead in the eye. “And the truth is that that guy has been telling you star-people’s words have a lot more power than they actually do.”"

rows.original: “What do you mean?” says Quinn, frowning.
rows.translation: “你是什么意思？”奎因皱眉问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What do you mean?” says Quinn, frowning."

rows.original: “He called you ‘queen’ when he first met you, because he didn’t know the first thing about how Zil reproduce!” Lah looks down at the sand, blushing, and you press on triumphantly. “Just because he called you one doesn’t automatically make you one. I’m telling you this because if you start going around telling star-people you’re Quinn without knowing what it means, they will all laugh at you!”
rows.translation: “他第一次见到你时称你为‘女王’，是因为他对兹尔如何繁衍一无所知！”拉红着脸低头看向沙地，你则乘胜追击。“他这么称呼你，并不意味着你就会自动成为女王。我告诉你这件事，是因为如果你根本不知道它是什么意思，却四处向星际人宣称自己是奎因，他们都会嘲笑你！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“He called you ‘queen’ when he first met you, because he didn’t know the first thing about how Zil reproduce!” Lah looks down at the sand, blushing, and you press on triumphantly. “Just because he called you one doesn’t automatically make you one. I’m telling you this because if you start going around telling star-people you’re Quinn without knowing what it means, they will all laugh at you!”"

rows.original: “Is this true?” The female zil has turned a face of pure venom to the cringing Lah.
rows.translation: “这是真的吗？”雌性兹尔转向畏缩的拉，脸上尽是怨毒。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is this true?” The female zil has turned a face of pure venom to the cringing Lah."

rows.original: “I- it was a mistake,” he mutters. “I don’t even like - I hate monarchies! But once you’d gotten hold of it, I couldn’t - and it made everything so much... easier... because all your tribe listened to you!”
rows.translation: “我-那是个错误，”他嘟囔道。“我甚至不喜欢-我痛恨君主制！可你一旦接受了这个称号，我就没办法-而且这让一切都变得...容易太多了...因为你的整个部族都听你的！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I- it was a mistake,” he mutters. “I don’t even like - I hate monarchies! But once you’d gotten hold of it, I couldn’t - and it made everything so much... easier... because all your tribe listened to you!”"

rows.original: “But if that isn’t true,” Quinn says, face now clouded with pale doubt, “then that means...”
rows.translation: “但如果那不是真的，”奎因说道，此刻苍白的疑虑笼罩了她的脸庞，“那就意味着...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But if that isn’t true,” Quinn says, face now clouded with pale doubt, “then that means...”"

rows.original: “No!” says Lah quickly. “You know everything else I’ve told you is true! You have seen things I have said made flesh! That land-stealer pawn standing right there is just one - one example!”
rows.translation: “不！”拉急忙说道。“你知道我告诉你的其他一切都是真的！你亲眼见过我所说的事化为现实！就站在那里的那个夺地者傀儡只是一个-一个例子！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No!” says Lah quickly. “You know everything else I’ve told you is true! You have seen things I have said made flesh! That land-stealer pawn standing right there is just one - one example!”"

rows.original: But you can see the seeds of doubt have been sown.
rows.translation: 但你看得出来，怀疑的种子已经种下。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut you can see the seeds of doubt have been sown."

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “What your people want more than anything is the freedom of Mhen’ga, right?” you say. “To do in the forest as you please, as you’ve always done.”
rows.translation: “你们的族人最渴望的就是门亨伽的自由，对吧？”你说道。“能像过去一样，在森林中随心所欲地生活。”
rows.raw: "“What your people want more than anything is the freedom of Mhen’ga, right?” you say. “To do in the forest as you please, as you’ve always done.”"

rows.original: “Which is exactly why you must drive the land-stealers away!” rages Lah. “They will enslave you! They will take more of your jungle away!”
rows.translation: “所以你才必须把那些窃地者赶走！”拉赫怒吼道。“他们会奴役你们！他们会夺走更多属于你们的丛林！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Which is exactly why you must drive the land-stealers away!” rages Lah. “They will enslave you! They will take more of your jungle away!”"

rows.original: “You might be able to drive Snugglé away,” you go on patiently, “but all it will mean is that there will be no star-people to stand up for you. Others will come - slavers, pirates, squatters, stripminers. But star-people could be a great boon for you. If you reach out to them, they can protect you. Not just from bad star-people, but the vanae and the naleen, too. No more of your men-folk snatched away in the night. No more
rows.translation: “你们或许能够赶走舒适乐，”你耐心地继续说道，“但那只会意味着，再也没有行星旅者替你们出头。其他人还会到来-奴隶贩子、海盗、擅自占地者、露天采矿者。但行星旅者可以为你们带来莫大的好处。如果你们主动接触，他们就能保护你们。不仅保护你们免受坏行星旅者的伤害，也能抵御瓦奈和纳琳。你们的男性再也不会在夜间被掳走。再也不用
rows.raw: "\n\n“You might be able to drive Snugglé away,” you go on patiently, “but all it will mean is that there will be no star-people to stand up for you. Others will come - slavers, pirates, squatters, stripminers. But star-people could be a great boon for you. If you reach out to them, they can protect you. Not just from bad star-people, but the vanae and the naleen, too. No more of your men-folk snatched away in the night. No more "

rows.original: snake-death
rows.translation: 葬身蛇口
rows.raw: "snake-death"

rows.original: bargaining with snakes beneath your waterfall
rows.translation: 在你们的瀑布下与蛇类讨价还价
rows.raw: "bargaining with snakes beneath your waterfall"

rows.original: . That is what is there to be gained.”
rows.translation: 。这就是你们能够得到的好处。”
rows.raw: ". That is what is there to be gained.”"

rows.original: There’s a sizable murmuring amongst the tribe to this.
rows.translation: 这番话在部落中引起了一阵不小的议论声。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a sizable murmuring amongst the tribe to this."

rows.original: “An interesting offer,” says Quinn at length, steepling her jet fingers. “And what you say about other star-people - that has the ring of truth to it. Drive away another tribe, and you simply invite other enemies to fill their space. I had not thought of this.”
rows.translation: “有趣的提议，”良久之后，奎因将乌黑的手指指尖相抵，说道。“而且你对其他行星旅者的说法-听起来确有道理。赶走一个部落，只会招来其他敌人填补他们留下的空缺。我从未这样想过。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“An interesting offer,” says Quinn at length, steepling her jet fingers. “And what you say about other star-people - that has the ring of truth to it. Drive away another tribe, and you simply invite other enemies to fill their space. I had not thought of this.”"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “You’ll be able to sell your honey for a good price,” you say. “And the stuff just comes out of you, right? With money, you’ll be able to buy things. Homes, and medicine, white stings - your lives will be better. Richer.”
rows.translation: “你们可以把蜂蜜卖个好价钱，”你说道。“而且那东西会自己从你们体内流出来，对吧？有了钱，你们就可以买东西。房屋、药物、白色针剂-你们的生活会变得更好、更富足。”
rows.raw: "“You’ll be able to sell your honey for a good price,” you say. “And the stuff just comes out of you, right? With money, you’ll be able to buy things. Homes, and medicine, white stings - your lives will be better. Richer.”"

rows.original: “Exactly - exactly what I warned you about!” snaps Lah with triumphant contempt. “MONEY. It’s all they can think about. It’s why they are here, grabbing at other people’s belongings so they can produce more of it. And here their servant is, waving it underneath your nose so that you can become a mindless, heartless addict to it too!”
rows.translation: “正是如此-正是我警告过你们的事！”拉赫带着胜利者般的轻蔑厉声说道。“钱。那就是他们满脑子唯一想着的东西。他们来这里，就是为了抢夺别人的财物，好制造出更多的钱。现在，他们的仆从就在你们鼻子底下挥舞着钱，想让你们也变成对它上瘾、没有头脑、没有感情的瘾君子！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Exactly - exactly what I warned you about!” snaps Lah with triumphant contempt. “MONEY. It’s all they can think about. It’s why they are here, grabbing at other people’s belongings so they can produce more of it. And here their servant is, waving it underneath your nose so that you can become a mindless, heartless addict to it too!”"

rows.original: “We have already heard much about this money of yours,” says Quinn coldly. “We have no wish to be enslaved to it as you are.”
rows.translation: “我们已经听过太多关于你们这种钱的事情了，”奎因冷冷地说道。“我们不愿像你们一样遭到它的奴役。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We have already heard much about this money of yours,” says Quinn coldly. “We have no wish to be enslaved to it as you are.”"

rows.original: Dang.
rows.translation: 糟糕。
rows.raw: "\n\nDang."

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “You need to come to some sort of compromise with star-people,” you say. “Show that you are peaceful. If not with Snugglé, then someone. If you just keep attacking whoever, eventually you’ll get soldiers landing here, and things will get ugly.”
rows.translation: “你们需要与行星旅者达成某种妥协，”你说道。“表明你们爱好和平。就算不是和舒适乐，也得找其他人。如果你们继续随意袭击任何来者，迟早会有士兵在这里登陆，到时候场面会变得很难看。”
rows.raw: "“You need to come to some sort of compromise with star-people,” you say. “Show that you are peaceful. If not with Snugglé, then someone. If you just keep attacking whoever, eventually you’ll get soldiers landing here, and things will get ugly.”"

rows.original: “Are you saying that we cannot drive off whoever we choose?” Quinn raises a gleaming black eyebrow at you.
rows.translation: “你是在说，我们不能赶走任何自己想赶走的人？”奎因朝你挑起一边闪亮的黑色眉毛。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Are you saying that we cannot drive off whoever we choose?” Quinn raises a gleaming black eyebrow at you."

rows.original: “...Yes?” you have to reply. “You already know star-people have vastly better tech--”
rows.translation: “...对？”你不得不回答。“你们已经知道，行星旅者拥有先进得多的技术--”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...Yes?” you have to reply. “You already know star-people have vastly better tech--”"

rows.original: “What I know,” the female zil interrupts with an irritated slap on her throne, “is that the land-stealers hide and quiver in their palace from our attacks. That these Esbeth people of yours barely dare set foot outside their homes for fear of us. We are zil! We fight fearlessly and relentlessly, guided now by the star knowledge of the word-wolf! You seek to threaten us, alien, as if we weren’t warriors. Do not do so again.”
rows.translation: “我所知道的，”女性泽尔恼怒地一拍王座，打断了你，“是那些窃地者面对我们的袭击，只敢躲在宫殿里瑟瑟发抖。你们埃斯贝斯的人惧怕我们，几乎不敢踏出家门。我们是泽尔！我们英勇无畏、永不止息地战斗，如今更有言语之狼的行星知识指引！外来者，你想威胁我们，仿佛我们不是战士。别再这样做。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What I know,” the female zil interrupts with an irritated slap on her throne, “is that the land-stealers hide and quiver in their palace from our attacks. That these Esbeth people of yours barely dare set foot outside their homes for fear of us. We are zil! We fight fearlessly and relentlessly, guided now by the star knowledge of the word-wolf! You seek to threaten us, alien, as if we weren’t warriors. Do not do so again.”"

rows.original: There’s a clash of weapons and a loud, buzzing cheer behind you. Lah hasn’t said a word this time, but a glance over your shoulder tells you he’s looking unbearably smug.
rows.translation: 你身后响起武器碰撞声和震耳的嗡鸣欢呼。这一次拉赫一言未发，但你回头一瞥，便发现他脸上那副得意神情简直令人无法忍受。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a clash of weapons and a loud, buzzing cheer behind you. Lah hasn’t said a word this time, but a glance over your shoulder tells you he’s looking unbearably smug."

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “There is a vast universe out there,” you say, pointing at the sky. “Filled with many, many beings of all shapes and sizes. Most of them, however, would be very interested in... liaising with... a race of lithe, energetic bee-people who leak sexy sugar from every tip on their body.”
rows.translation: “外面有一片广袤的宇宙，”你指向天空说道。“里面充满了形形色色、大小各异的无数生物。不过，其中大多数都会很有兴趣与...身材纤细、活力充沛，而且全身每个尖端都会渗出性感糖浆的蜂人种族...交流一番。”
rows.raw: "“There is a vast universe out there,” you say, pointing at the sky. “Filled with many, many beings of all shapes and sizes. Most of them, however, would be very interested in... liaising with... a race of lithe, energetic bee-people who leak sexy sugar from every tip on their body.”"

rows.original: The crowd murmurs, sniggers and giggles. You can already tell this is a potential vote-winner.
rows.translation: 人群低声议论，窃笑嬉闹。你已经看得出来，这番话很可能替你赢得选票。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe crowd murmurs, sniggers and giggles. You can already tell this is a potential vote-winner."

rows.original: “Having fetching, colorful star-people wandering the forest, getting lost, getting stuck in things is - enjoyable, I grant you that,” says Quinn, hand trailing over her puffed-out chestplate.
rows.translation: “让那些迷人、色彩缤纷的行星旅者在森林里四处游荡、迷路、被东西卡住，确实-很有乐趣，这一点我承认，”奎因说道，一只手缓缓抚过她高高隆起的胸甲。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Having fetching, colorful star-people wandering the forest, getting lost, getting stuck in things is - enjoyable, I grant you that,” says Quinn, hand trailing over her puffed-out chestplate."

rows.original: “Then don’t attack them! Encourage more of the enjoyable type to come,” you press. “You can be the leader who stopped the wanderers for good. Or you can be the leader who opened your race’s arms to a whole galaxy of love.”
rows.translation: “那就别攻击他们！鼓励更多有趣的类型前来，”你趁势说道。“你可以成为彻底阻止外来游荡者的领袖。也可以成为向整个银河的爱敞开种族怀抱的领袖。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Then don’t attack them! Encourage more of the enjoyable type to come,” you press. “You can be the leader who stopped the wanderers for good. Or you can be the leader who opened your race’s arms to a whole galaxy of love.”"

rows.original: Quinn says nothing in response, but her golden eyes shine.
rows.translation: 奎因没有回答，但金色双眼闪闪发亮。
rows.raw: "\n\nQuinn says nothing in response, but her golden eyes shine."

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “You could be a great leader of zil,” you say. “Many of your people under your wise leadership. But as long as you are in control of a single tribe, with the same weapons and tools as any of the rest, that can never be. The star-people landing near to you is a great opportunity - to trade honey for the means to unite all of the zil under your leadership.”
rows.translation: “你可以成为兹尔的伟大领袖，”你说道。“让许多同胞接受你的英明领导。但只要你仍只控制一个部族，拥有与其他部族相同的武器和工具，那就永远无法实现。星际人在你们附近降落是个绝佳机会，可以用蜂蜜换取手段，让所有兹尔都统一在你的领导之下。”
rows.raw: "“You could be a great leader of zil,” you say. “Many of your people under your wise leadership. But as long as you are in control of a single tribe, with the same weapons and tools as any of the rest, that can never be. The star-people landing near to you is a great opportunity - to trade honey for the means to unite all of the zil under your leadership.”"

rows.original: “And then, once you’ve ground them under your heel,” groans Lah in doom-laden tones, “you can make the other tribes build you a great, white palace. And you can put them to work in the gardens. And then you can be attacked by--”
rows.translation: “然后，等你把他们全踩在脚下，”拉以充满末日意味的语调呻吟道，“你就能让其他部族替你建造一座宏伟的白色宫殿。还能让他们去花园里干活。接着你就会遭到...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And then, once you’ve ground them under your heel,” groans Lah in doom-laden tones, “you can make the other tribes build you a great, white palace. And you can put them to work in the gardens. And then you can be attacked by--”"

rows.original: “Interesting thought,” says Quinn, motioning for him to be quiet. “So tell me - do you star-people know the language of the zil who live in the fungal swamps, far to the east?”
rows.translation: “有趣的想法，”奎因说道，示意他保持安静。“那么告诉我，星际人懂得居住在遥远东方真菌沼泽里的兹尔语言吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Interesting thought,” says Quinn, motioning for him to be quiet. “So tell me - do you star-people know the language of the zil who live in the fungal swamps, far to the east?”"

rows.original: You have to shrug blankly to this.
rows.translation: 你只能一脸茫然地耸肩回应。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou have to shrug blankly to this."

rows.original: “Do they know the ways and desires of the wailing tribes who defend their hilltops so savagely to the near south? Could they tell us the first thing about the white zil of legend told, who supposedly inhabit lands so far to the north the ground is as hard as ironwood and the sun never sets? No, I think not.” Quinn shifts on her seat, looking at you cannily. “Unity. That is what you call putting weapons in our hands and telling us to march upon our brethren, whom in your ignorance you believe to be exactly like us. No, star-person. Try again.”
rows.translation: “他们了解近南方那些哀嚎部族的习俗与欲望吗？那些部族如此野蛮地守卫着自己的山顶。他们能说出传说中白色兹尔的任何事情吗？据说他们居住在极北之地，那里地面坚硬如铁木，太阳永不落下。不，我想他们不能。”奎因在座位上调整姿势，精明地看着你。“统一。你们就是这样称呼把武器塞进我们手里，命令我们向同胞进军的行为，而你们由于无知，竟以为他们与我们完全相同。不，星际人。再试一次。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Do they know the ways and desires of the wailing tribes who defend their hilltops so savagely to the near south? Could they tell us the first thing about the white zil of legend told, who supposedly inhabit lands so far to the north the ground is as hard as ironwood and the sun never sets? No, I think not.” Quinn shifts on her seat, looking at you cannily. “Unity. That is what you call putting weapons in our hands and telling us to march upon our brethren, whom in your ignorance you believe to be exactly like us. No, star-person. Try again.”"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “Fine,” you sigh. “Attack the plantation all you want. Not gonna start another fight over it.”
rows.translation: “好吧，”你叹息道。“想怎么袭击种植园都随你们。我不会再为此打一架。”
rows.raw: "“Fine,” you sigh. “Attack the plantation all you want. Not gonna start another fight over it.”"

rows.original: Quinn smiles at you broadly, and there’s a hum of appreciation for the land-stealer champion’s tact amongst the ranks. Lah strides back to his place next to the leader’s throne,
rows.translation: 奎因朝你开怀微笑，队伍中也响起赞许的嗡鸣，欣赏偷地贼勇士的圆滑。拉大步走回领袖王座旁的位置，
rows.raw: "\n\nQuinn smiles at you broadly, and there’s a hum of appreciation for the land-stealer champion’s tact amongst the ranks. Lah strides back to his place next to the leader’s throne, "

rows.original: limping only slightly
rows.translation: 步伐只有些许跛拐
rows.raw: "limping only slightly"

rows.original: his boner having dissipated enough for him to do so
rows.translation: ，因为他的勃起已经消退到足以行走的程度
rows.raw: "his boner having dissipated enough for him to do so"

rows.original: “You have heard the land-stealers speak for themselves,” he exults to the crowd. “And you know now they are nothing-words, falsehoods I told you they would mouth! Carry that in your hearts, when we set out to destroy their seat of power for good!”
rows.translation: “你们已经亲耳听见偷地贼为自己辩护，”他兴高采烈地对人群说道。“现在也知道，那些都是虚无之言，正如我告诉过你们的，是他们会吐出的谎言！等我们出发彻底摧毁他们的权力中心时，把这一点牢记心中！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You have heard the land-stealers speak for themselves,” he exults to the crowd. “And you know now they are nothing-words, falsehoods I told you they would mouth! Carry that in your hearts, when we set out to destroy their seat of power for good!”"

rows.original: “Let’s do it now, whilst their champion is away!” shouts one, waving her torch.
rows.translation: “趁他们的勇士不在，现在就动手！”其中一人挥舞火把高喊。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Let’s do it now, whilst their champion is away!” shouts one, waving her torch."

rows.original: “Yes! Burn the far shist’s palace down! Carry the truth to them!” the cry goes up.
rows.translation: “没错！烧掉远方希斯特的宫殿！把真相带给他们！”人群发出呼喊。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes! Burn the far shist’s palace down! Carry the truth to them!” the cry goes up."

rows.original: “I... we should wait until - but no, yes! We shall do it now!” bays Lah, fire in his pale eyes. “Before they even know their time is up!” He grins at you wildly, and then is gone, striding towards the ramp, at the head of an excited mob of zil.
rows.translation: “我...我们应该等到...不，没错！我们现在就动手！”拉嚎叫道，苍白双眼中燃烧着火焰。“赶在他们意识到死期已至之前！”他疯狂地朝你咧嘴一笑，随后便消失了，率领一群兴奋的兹尔暴民大步走向坡道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I... we should wait until - but no, yes! We shall do it now!” bays Lah, fire in his pale eyes. “Before they even know their time is up!” He grins at you wildly, and then is gone, striding towards the ramp, at the head of an excited mob of zil."

rows.original: “What an interesting star-person you are,” says Quinn, continuing to gaze at you appraisingly once they have disappeared towards the waterfall. “You defeat the cliffs and our prophet singlehandedly, and yet in the end you submit to the will of Quinn. A strong, fair, obedient warrior. I have not encountered any other star-people like that.” She idly traces a finger up her bare inner thigh, a small smile on her pointed, delicate face. “It pleases me a great deal that you are a subject of mine. Will you tell me a little more about yourself? Perhaps you can shed light on where the far shists come from? I must admit, the word-wolf is very confusing on this matter.”
rows.translation: “你真是个有趣的星际人，”他们朝瀑布消失后，奎因仍用评估般的目光凝视你。“你单枪匹马战胜悬崖和我们的先知，最终却服从奎因的意志。强壮、公平而顺从的战士。我从未遇见过其他这样的星际人。”她漫不经心地用一根手指沿裸露大腿内侧向上划，尖俏精致的脸上挂着淡淡笑容。“你成为我的臣民，令我十分愉悦。愿意多告诉我一些关于自己的事吗？或许你能解释那些远方希斯特来自何处？我必须承认，言语之狼在这件事上的说法非常混乱。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What an interesting star-person you are,” says Quinn, continuing to gaze at you appraisingly once they have disappeared towards the waterfall. “You defeat the cliffs and our prophet singlehandedly, and yet in the end you submit to the will of Quinn. A strong, fair, obedient warrior. I have not encountered any other star-people like that.” She idly traces a finger up her bare inner thigh, a small smile on her pointed, delicate face. “It pleases me a great deal that you are a subject of mine. Will you tell me a little more about yourself? Perhaps you can shed light on where the far shists come from? I must admit, the word-wolf is very confusing on this matter.”"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “Sorry lady, that isn’t going to happen,” you say, meaningfully reaching for your [pc.weapon]. “Lah is coming with me.”
rows.translation: “抱歉，女士，那是不可能的，”你意味深长地伸手去拿[pc.weapon]。“拉必须跟我走。”
rows.raw: "“Sorry lady, that isn’t going to happen,” you say, meaningfully reaching for your [pc.weapon]. “Lah is coming with me.”"

rows.original: “That’s a shame,” replies Quinn coolly. “I had formed quite a high opinion of you. But it turns out the word-wolf was right about another thing - you follow your orders mindlessly. And so you must die.”
rows.translation: “真遗憾，”奎因冷静地回答。“我本来十分看好你。但事实证明，言语之狼在另一件事上也说对了，你只会盲目服从命令。所以你必须死。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s a shame,” replies Quinn coolly. “I had formed quite a high opinion of you. But it turns out the word-wolf was right about another thing - you follow your orders mindlessly. And so you must die.”"

rows.original: The angry hum becomes an all-encompassing drone as the tribe of zil descend upon you.
rows.translation: 兹尔部族一同扑向你，愤怒嗡鸣化作笼罩一切的轰响。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe angry hum becomes an all-encompassing drone as the tribe of zil descend upon you."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: ZIL TRIBE
rows.raw: "ZIL TRIBE"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: A gesture from Quinn signals the end of your entreatment.
rows.translation: 奎因做出一个手势，示意你的恳求到此结束。
rows.raw: "A gesture from Quinn signals the end of your entreatment."

rows.original: “I have listened to the land-stealer champion’s words,” she says, projecting her clear, sonorous voice so all present can hear it. “Having considered them, I believe the word-wolf’s truths to be deeper. He foresaw many of the things land-stealers would say in their defence, and told us of them. The attacks shall continue.”
rows.translation: “我已经听过偷地贼勇士的言辞，”她说道，清晰洪亮的声音传遍全场，让所有在场者都能听见。“经过考虑，我认为言语之狼的真相比你的言辞更加深刻。他预见了偷地贼为自己辩护时会说的许多话，并事先告诉了我们。袭击将会继续。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I have listened to the land-stealer champion’s words,” she says, projecting her clear, sonorous voice so all present can hear it. “Having considered them, I believe the word-wolf’s truths to be deeper. He foresaw many of the things land-stealers would say in their defence, and told us of them. The attacks shall continue.”"

rows.original: The zil cheer fiercely, clashing their weapons together in syncopation, a primitive gun salute that goes rolling out over the plateau. It’s almost enough to drown out Lah’s ragged sigh of relief.
rows.translation: 兹尔们发出激烈的欢呼，错落有致地互相敲击武器，仿佛一阵原始的礼炮声滚过高地。这声音几乎盖过了拉如释重负的粗重叹息。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zil cheer fiercely, clashing their weapons together in syncopation, a primitive gun salute that goes rolling out over the plateau. It’s almost enough to drown out Lah’s ragged sigh of relief."

rows.original: “What about the land-stealer champion [pc.himHer]self?” growls Kane, once the din has died down.
rows.translation: “那夺地者冠军[pc.himHer]本人呢？”喧嚣平息后，凯恩低吼道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What about the land-stealer champion [pc.himHer]self?” growls Kane, once the din has died down."

rows.original: “[pc.HeShe] followed our ways and behaved honorably, even if [pc.hisHer] arguments rang false in the end,” Quinn replies, gazing at you serenely. “As long as [pc.heShe] accepts my judgment [pc.heShe] can go, and visit us again if [pc.heShe] chooses.”
rows.translation: “即使[pc.hisHer]论点最终听来并不真实，[pc.HeShe]仍遵循了我们的方式，行事也光明磊落，”奎因平静地凝望着你，答道。“只要[pc.heShe]接受我的裁决，[pc.heShe]就可以离开；如果[pc.heShe]愿意，以后也可以再来拜访我们。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.HeShe] followed our ways and behaved honorably, even if [pc.hisHer] arguments rang false in the end,” Quinn replies, gazing at you serenely. “As long as [pc.heShe] accepts my judgment [pc.heShe] can go, and visit us again if [pc.heShe] chooses.”"

rows.original: Accept
rows.translation: 接受
rows.raw: "Accept"

rows.original: Accept
rows.translation: 接受
rows.raw: "Accept"

rows.original: Accept Quinn’s judgment. Let Lah go.
rows.translation: 接受奎因的裁决。放走拉。
rows.raw: "Accept Quinn’s judgment. Let Lah go."

rows.original: Insist
rows.translation: 坚持
rows.raw: "Insist"

rows.original: Insist
rows.translation: 坚持
rows.raw: "Insist"

rows.original: You’re taking Lah back, whether they like it or not.
rows.translation: 不管她们是否愿意，你都要把拉带回去。
rows.raw: "You’re taking Lah back, whether they like it or not."

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: Before you can even move across to him, two male zil have pounced upon Lah, roughly picked him up and got his thin wrists tied with fibrous rope behind his back. He doesn’t resist; the ausar looks eaten from within. They push him down the ramp, hopefully to somewhere you can pick him up from once you’re finished with Quinn.
rows.translation: 你还没来得及走到拉身边，两个男性兹尔就已经扑向他，粗暴地将他提起，用纤维绳索把他细瘦的手腕绑在背后。他没有反抗；这个奥萨尔仿佛已经被内心的痛苦掏空。她们把他推下坡道，希望等你和奎因谈完后，能在某个地方把他带走。
rows.raw: "Before you can even move across to him, two male zil have pounced upon Lah, roughly picked him up and got his thin wrists tied with fibrous rope behind his back. He doesn’t resist; the ausar looks eaten from within. They push him down the ramp, hopefully to somewhere you can pick him up from once you’re finished with Quinn."

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: Looking at the former prophet slumped in the dirt, you realize you don’t really have the stomach to drag him back to the Plantation.
rows.translation: 看着瘫坐在泥土中的前先知，你意识到自己实在狠不下心把他拖回种植园。
rows.raw: "Looking at the former prophet slumped in the dirt, you realize you don’t really have the stomach to drag him back to the Plantation."

rows.original: “Go on, get out of here,” you say gruffly, catching Lah’s eye. “I’m not taking you back to Darnock.”
rows.translation: “走吧，离开这里，”你迎上拉的目光，语气生硬地说道。“我不会把你带回达诺克那里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Go on, get out of here,” you say gruffly, catching Lah’s eye. “I’m not taking you back to Darnock.”"

rows.original: “I- really?” says the ausar in disbelief. He awkwardly clambers to his feet, barely daring to look at you or Quinn. “But- what am I going to do?”
rows.translation: “我-真的吗？”奥萨尔难以置信地说道。他笨拙地爬起身，几乎不敢看你或奎因。“可-可我该怎么办？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I- really?” says the ausar in disbelief. He awkwardly clambers to his feet, barely daring to look at you or Quinn. “But- what am I going to do?”"

rows.original: “Don’t care,” you reply. “Get to Esbeth, change your clothes, hitch a lift to another frontier world and never let me see you again, that’s my advice.”
rows.translation: “我不在乎，”你答道。“去埃斯贝斯，换掉衣服，搭便车前往另一个边境世界，别再让我看见你。这就是我的建议。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t care,” you reply. “Get to Esbeth, change your clothes, hitch a lift to another frontier world and never let me see you again, that’s my advice.”"

rows.original: “Merciful,” Quinn observes, as she watches the ausar hurry off into the jungle. “What are you going to tell the land-stealers?”
rows.translation: “真是仁慈，”奎因看着那个奥萨尔匆匆逃进丛林，评论道。“你打算怎么对那些夺地者交代？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Merciful,” Quinn observes, as she watches the ausar hurry off into the jungle. “What are you going to tell the land-stealers?”"

rows.original: You were just starting to wonder that yourself.
rows.translation: 你自己也才刚开始思考这个问题。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou were just starting to wonder that yourself."

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: The zil leader stands up and opens her arms to the crowd.
rows.translation: 兹尔首领站起身，向众人张开双臂。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zil leader stands up and opens her arms to the crowd."

rows.original: “You have heard my judgment,” she says. “Tell the young and old they may return, we are no longer at war - for now. Tomorrow we shall send a delegation to Esbeth, our displeasure with the land-stealers presented alongside our honey. We shall see what they have to say. I am Quinn!”
rows.translation: “你们已经听见了我的裁决，”她说道。“通知老幼，让他们回来吧，我们不再交战 - 至少目前如此。明天，我们将派遣一个代表团前往埃斯贝斯，把我们的不满与蜂蜜一并呈给那些夺地者。看看他们会怎么说。我是奎因！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You have heard my judgment,” she says. “Tell the young and old they may return, we are no longer at war - for now. Tomorrow we shall send a delegation to Esbeth, our displeasure with the land-stealers presented alongside our honey. We shall see what they have to say. I am Quinn!”"

rows.original: “Quinn!” echoes the crowd. Despite your revelation about the provenance of her name, the svelte female zil still seems to be in total control here - maybe because she continues to wield her authority with such icy coolness. The tribe have dispersed towards the waterfall in moments without protest. She smirks at you once they’ve gone.
rows.translation: “奎因！”人群齐声应和。尽管你揭露了她名字的来历，这个身材苗条的女性兹尔似乎仍完全掌控着这里 - 也许是因为她继续以如此冷静威严的态度行使权力。部族众人没有提出异议，转眼间便朝瀑布散去。等她们都离开后，她朝你得意一笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Quinn!” echoes the crowd. Despite your revelation about the provenance of her name, the svelte female zil still seems to be in total control here - maybe because she continues to wield her authority with such icy coolness. The tribe have dispersed towards the waterfall in moments without protest. She smirks at you once they’ve gone."

rows.original: “Defeater of the cliffs, champion of the circle, and speaker of great wisdom,” she says. “If this strange scheme of yours works, you will be part of our legends for centuries to come, stranger.” She idly traces a finger up the latex-like armor of her inner thigh; there’s plenty of color left in her cheeks from watching your bout with Lah. “Is there anything else you wish to know of Quinn?”
rows.translation: “峭壁的征服者，圆环的冠军，以及伟大智慧的传声者，”她说道。“陌生人，如果你的奇特计划奏效，未来数百年里，我们的传说都会有你的一席之地。”她漫不经心地用一根手指沿着大腿内侧乳胶般的甲壳向上划去；观看你与拉的较量后，她双颊的红晕依旧浓郁。“你还有什么想向奎因了解的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Defeater of the cliffs, champion of the circle, and speaker of great wisdom,” she says. “If this strange scheme of yours works, you will be part of our legends for centuries to come, stranger.” She idly traces a finger up the latex-like armor of her inner thigh; there’s plenty of color left in her cheeks from watching your bout with Lah. “Is there anything else you wish to know of Quinn?”"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: A gesture from Quinn signals the end of your entreatment.
rows.translation: 奎因做了个手势，示意这场恳谈到此结束。
rows.raw: "A gesture from Quinn signals the end of your entreatment."

rows.original: “I have listened to the land-stealer champion,” she says, projecting her clear, sonorous voice so all present can hear it. “Having considered... I believe there is merit to what [pc.he] says. [pc.He] has presented unexpected words that have the ring of truth to them, widening my understanding. We shall relent, and seek alliance with the star-people of Esbeth.”
rows.translation: “我已经听取了夺地者冠军的陈述，”她说道，清晰洪亮的声音传遍全场，让在场所有人都能听见。“经过考虑...我认为[pc.he]说的话确有可取之处。[pc.He]提出了一些出乎意料却听来真实可信的观点，拓宽了我的认知。我们会作出让步，并寻求与埃斯贝斯的星际来客结盟。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I have listened to the land-stealer champion,” she says, projecting her clear, sonorous voice so all present can hear it. “Having considered... I believe there is merit to what [pc.he] says. [pc.He] has presented unexpected words that have the ring of truth to them, widening my understanding. We shall relent, and seek alliance with the star-people of Esbeth.”"

rows.original: “No!” howls Lah, over the murmurings of the crowd. “You don’t understand, the attacks have to continue! You’ve only got a limited opportunity before-”

rows.original: “Alright, look,” you say, as levelly as you can. “I get that what Snugglé is doing is bad. But Lah’s plan is only going to result in more misery for you. Either they’ll send mercs after you, real ones this time, or your whole species is going to be declared savage and dangerous. You’ll get killed in droves. Nobody will protect you from slavers...”
rows.translation: “好吧，听着，”你尽量平静地说道。“我明白舒适乐的所作所为很糟。但拉的计划只会给你们带来更多苦难。他们要么会派佣兵追杀你们，下一次可是真正的佣兵；要么你们整个种族都会被宣布为野蛮而危险的生物。你们会成群结队地死去。没人会保护你们免受奴隶贩子的侵害...”

Either they’ll send mercs after you, real ones this time, or your whole species is going to be declared savage and dangerous. You’ll get killed in droves. Nobody will protect you from slavers...”"

rows.original: “What are you proposing?” returns Quinn, the tone of strained patience echoed back at you.
rows.translation: “你有何提议？”奎因答道，语气中紧绷的耐心原样奉还给你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What are you proposing?” returns Quinn, the tone of strained patience echoed back at you."

rows.original: “You have honey,” you go on quickly. “Star people really like that honey. Trade it with those in Esbeth for food, medicine, material. They aren’t with the land-stealers - if you show you aren’t violent, that you can be friends, they’ll help you. They can protect you against Snugglé, block them from expanding. You can be uplifted - and that is when you really can take the fight to them.”
rows.translation: “你们有蜂蜜，”你迅速继续。“星际人很喜欢那种蜂蜜。拿它和埃斯贝斯的人交换食物、药品和材料。他们和夺地者不是一伙的——只要你们表明自己并不暴力、能够成为朋友，他们就会帮助你们。他们可以保护你们免受舒适乐侵害，阻止其继续扩张。你们可以得到启蒙——到那时，你们才真正有能力向他们开战。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You have honey,” you go on quickly. “Star people really like that honey. Trade it with those in Esbeth for food, medicine, material. They aren’t with the land-stealers - if you show you aren’t violent, that you can be friends, they’ll help you. They can protect you against Snugglé, block them from expanding. You can be uplifted - and that is when you really can take the fight to them.”"

rows.original: “You have heard the land-stealers speak for themselves,” he exults to the crowd. “And you know now they are nothing-words, falsehoods I told you they would mouth! Carry that in your hearts, when we set out to destroy their seat of power for good!”
rows.translation: “你们已经亲耳听见夺地者为自己辩解，”他对人群得意高呼。“现在你们知道，那些全是空洞之言，是我早就说过他们会吐出的谎话！当我们出发去彻底摧毁他们的权力中心时，把这件事牢记心中！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You have heard the land-stealers speak for themselves,” he exults to the crowd. “And you know now they are nothing-words, falsehoods I told you they would mouth! Carry that in your hearts, when we set out to destroy their seat of power for good!”"

rows.original: “Let’s do it now, whilst their champion is away!” shouts one, waving her torch.

rows.raw: "\n\n“Let’s do it now, whilst their champion is away!” shouts one, waving her torch."

rows.original: “Yes! Burn the far shist’s palace down! Carry the truth to them!” the cry goes up.
rows.translation: “对！烧掉远方粪人的宫殿！把真理带给他们！”众人齐声呐喊。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes! Burn the far shist’s palace down! Carry the truth to them!” the cry goes up."

rows.original: “I... we should wait until - but no, yes! We shall do it now!” bays Lah, fire in his pale eyes. “Before they even know their time is up!” He grins at you wildly, and then is gone, striding towards the ramp, at the head of an excited mob of zil.
rows.translation: “我...我们应该等到-不，对！我们现在就动手！”拉咆哮道，苍白双眼中燃着烈火。“赶在他们意识到末日将至以前！”他狂热地朝你咧嘴一笑，随即消失在视野中，走在兴奋的兹尔暴民前方，朝坡道大步而去。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I... we should wait until - but no, yes! We shall do it now!” bays Lah, fire in his pale eyes. “Before they even know their time is up!” He grins at you wildly, and then is gone, striding towards the ramp, at the head of an excited mob of zil."

rows.original: “What an interesting star-person you are,” says Quinn, continuing to gaze at you appraisingly once they have disappeared towards the waterfall. “You defeat the cliffs, demand honorable battle with our prophet, and yet in the end you submit to the will of Quinn. A strong, fair, obedient warrior. I have not encountered any other star-people like that.” She idly traces a finger up her bare inner thigh, a small smile on her pointed, delicate face. “It pleases me a great deal that you are a subject of mine. Will you tell me a little more about yourself? Perhaps you can shed light on where the far shists come from? I must admit, the word-wolf is very confusing on this matter.”
rows.translation: “你真是个有趣的星际人，”他们消失在瀑布方向后，奎因继续以审视的目光凝望你。“你征服峭壁，要求与我们的先知进行荣誉决斗，最终却顺从奎因的意志。强大、公正而服从的战士。我从未遇见过像你这样的星际人。”她漫不经心地用手指划过裸露的大腿内侧，尖俏精致的脸上浮现浅笑。“你是我的臣民，这令我非常愉悦。愿意再多谈谈自己吗？或许你能说明那些远方粪人来自何处？我必须承认，言语之狼在这件事上说得非常混乱。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What an interesting star-person you are,” says Quinn, continuing to gaze at you appraisingly once they have disappeared towards the waterfall. “You defeat the cliffs, demand honorable battle with our prophet, and yet in the end you submit to the will of Quinn. rows.raw: "You grasp the spear’s haft, and the zil melts back into the crowd."

rows.original: Lah paces around the opposite edge of the stone circle like a wounded, hungry wolf, ears flattened, tail twitching. Behind him is the buzzing, shouting mob of warrior zil, torches waving excitedly; beyond them Quinn watches from her seat, a sculpture of relaxed, calm interest.
rows.translation: 拉像一匹受伤而饥饿的狼，在石圈另一侧来回踱步，双耳向后压平，尾巴不住抽动。他身后是由兹尔战士组成、不断嗡鸣呐喊的暴民，火把兴奋地挥舞着；越过他们，可以看到奎因安坐席间，宛如一尊轻松镇定、饶有兴致的雕像。
rows.raw: " Lah paces around the opposite edge of the stone circle like a wounded, hungry wolf, ears flattened, tail twitching. Behind him is the buzzing, shouting mob of warrior zil, torches waving excitedly; beyond them Quinn watches from her seat, a sculpture of relaxed, calm interest."

rows.original: “I- I never intended this,” the ausar says, pale eyes finding yours at last. “Violence against property yes, but not... but I will. Yes. For this I, I will! You will not steal their innocent hearts away from me!”
rows.translation: “我-我从没想过会这样，”奥萨说道，苍白的双眼终于望向你。“破坏财物可以，但不能...可我会的。对。为了这件事，我，我会的！我不会让你从我身边夺走他们纯真的心灵！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I- I never intended this,” the ausar says, pale eyes finding yours at last. “Violence against property yes, but not... but I will. Yes. For this I, I will! You will not steal their innocent hearts away from me!”"

rows.original: It is not of zil custom to change outfits while already in honorable combat!
rows.translation: 兹尔的习俗不允许在已经开始的荣誉战斗中更换服装！
rows.raw: "It is not of zil custom to change outfits while already in honorable combat!"

rows.original: You are unable to wield a different weapon right now--where is your honor?!
rows.translation: 你现在无法使用另一件武器--你的荣誉何在？！
rows.raw: "You are unable to wield a different weapon right now--where is your honor?!"

rows.original: You can’t arm yourself with different weapons--you agreed to an honorable battle, remember?
rows.translation: 你不能用不同的武器武装自己--还记得吗，你答应过要进行一场荣誉之战？
rows.raw: "You can’t arm yourself with different weapons--you agreed to an honorable battle, remember?"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: RK LAH
rows.raw: "RK LAH"

rows.original: Challenge
rows.translation: 挑战
rows.raw: "Challenge"

rows.original: Challenge Lah to a fight, zil-style.
rows.translation: 以兹尔的方式挑战拉决斗。
rows.raw: "Challenge Lah to a fight, zil-style."

rows.original: Fight
rows.translation: 战斗
rows.raw: "Fight"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “I came here to bring an escaped convict to justice,” you say, drawing your [pc.weapon], “and that’s exactly what I intend to do.”
rows.translation: “我来这里是要将一名越狱犯绳之以法，”你一边说，一边拔出[pc.weapon]，“而我正打算这么做。”
rows.raw: "“I came here to bring an escaped convict to justice,” you say, drawing your [pc.weapon], “and that’s exactly what I intend to do.”"

rows.original: “Suffer our wrath then, land-stealer,” Quinn replies coolly. The angry buzz grows into a throbbing snarl that presses upon you from every side, and the entire throng of warrior zil descends on you, torches and flint-blades flashing.
rows.translation: “那就承受我们的怒火吧，夺地者，”奎因冷静地答道。愤怒的嗡鸣化作搏动的咆哮，从四面八方向你压来；整群兹尔战士朝你扑来，火把与燧石刀刃闪烁不止。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Suffer our wrath then, land-stealer,” Quinn replies coolly. The angry buzz grows into a throbbing snarl that presses upon you from every side, and the entire throng of warrior zil descends on you, torches and flint-blades flashing."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: ZIL TRIBE
rows.raw: "ZIL TRIBE"

rows.original: Fight
rows.translation: 战斗
rows.raw: "Fight"

rows.original: Enough nonsense. Scatter this rabble to the wind and take Lah alive.
rows.translation: 胡闹够了。把这群乌合之众打得四散奔逃，再活捉拉。
rows.raw: "Enough nonsense. Scatter this rabble to the wind and take Lah alive."

rows.original: Agree
rows.translation: 同意
rows.raw: "Agree"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “You won’t hear any argument from me that Darnock’s operation sucks,” you say with a shrug. “So I guess if it’s a choice between having to fight you all and that place being shut down... I’m with you.”
rows.translation: “要说达诺克的营生烂透了，我绝不会反驳，”你耸肩说道。“所以，如果只能在跟你们所有人开战和关掉那个地方之间二选一...那我站你们这边。”
rows.raw: "“You won’t hear any argument from me that Darnock’s operation sucks,” you say with a shrug. “So I guess if it’s a choice between having to fight you all and that place being shut down... I’m with you.”"

rows.original: Lah looks completely stunned by this - even Quinn’s eyes widen a little.
rows.translation: 拉显然被这番话彻底惊呆了，就连奎因的眼睛也微微睁大。
rows.raw: "\n\nLah looks completely stunned by this - even Quinn’s eyes widen a little."

rows.original: Before either of them can react though, a female zil comes tearing up the ramp.
rows.translation: 不过，他们还没来得及作出反应，一名雌性兹尔便沿斜坡飞奔而上。
rows.raw: " Before either of them can react though, a female zil comes tearing up the ramp."

rows.original: “Quinn! The ancestor stone - it’s gone! Taken!” she gasps, breasts heaving. She is too out of puff to do anything more but point accusingly.
rows.translation: “奎因！先祖石-不见了！被人拿走了！”她喘息着说道，双乳剧烈起伏。她已经上气不接下气，只能满怀指控地伸手一指。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Quinn! The ancestor stone - it’s gone! Taken!” she gasps, breasts heaving. She is too out of puff to do anything more but point accusingly."

rows.original: “KILL [pc.himHer]!” intones the chieftain, fury finally breaking the mask of preternatural calm. With a wild war-cry that presses upon you from every side, the entire throng of warrior zil descends on you.
rows.translation: “杀了[pc.himHer]！”酋长吟诵般说道，怒火终于击碎了那副超然平静的面具。伴随着从四面八方向你压来的狂野战吼，整群兹尔战士朝你扑来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“KILL [pc.himHer]!” intones the chieftain, fury finally breaking the mask of preternatural calm. With a wild war-cry that presses upon you from every side, the entire throng of warrior zil descends on you."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: ZIL TRIBE
rows.raw: "ZIL TRIBE"

rows.original: The ausar quickly recovers, though.
rows.translation: 不过，奥萨很快便回过神来。
rows.raw: " The ausar quickly recovers, though."

rows.original: “See?!” he exults to the murmuring crowd. “Even the land-stealers’ own minions cannot deny the truth when it is presented to them! Carry that in your hearts, when we set out to destroy their seat of power for good!”
rows.translation: “看见了吗？！”他得意地向低声议论的人群喊道。“即使是夺地者自己的爪牙，面对真理时也无法否认它！当我们出发去彻底摧毁他们的权力中心时，把这一点铭记在心！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“See?!” he exults to the murmuring crowd. “Even the land-stealers’ own minions cannot deny the truth when it is presented to them! Carry that in your hearts, when we set out to destroy their seat of power for good!”"

rows.original: “Let’s do it now, whilst their champion is away!” shouts one, waving her torch.
rows.translation: “趁他们的勇士不在，我们现在就动手！”一名兹尔挥舞火把喊道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Let’s do it now, whilst their champion is away!” shouts one, waving her torch."

rows.original: “Yes! Burn the far shist’s palace down! Carry the truth to them!” the cry goes up.
rows.translation: “没错！烧掉远方粪人的宫殿！把真理带给他们！”呼喊声响彻四周。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes! Burn the far shist’s palace down! Carry the truth to them!” the cry goes up."

rows.original: “I... we should wait until - but no, yes! We shall do it now!” bays Lah, fire in his pale eyes. “Before they even know their time is up!” He grins at you wildly, and then is gone, striding towards the ramp, at the head of an excited mob of zil.
rows.translation: “我...我们应该等到-不，对，没错！我们现在就动手！”拉嚎叫道，苍白的双眼中燃着火焰。“趁他们还不知道自己的末日已经到了！”他朝你狂野一笑，随后便消失在视野中，率领兴奋的兹尔暴民大步走向斜坡。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I... we should wait until - but no, yes! We shall do it now!” bays Lah, fire in his pale eyes. “Before they even know their time is up!” He grins at you wildly, and then is gone, striding towards the ramp, at the head of an excited mob of zil."

rows.original: “What an interesting star-person you are,” says Quinn, continuing to gaze at you appraisingly once they have disappeared towards the waterfall. “You defeat the cliffs singlehandedly, and yet when you get here you submit to the will of Quinn. A strong, fair, obedient warrior. I have not encountered any other star-people like that.” She idly traces a finger up her gleaming inner thigh, a small smile on her pointed, delicate face. “It pleases me a great deal that you are a subject of mine. Will you tell me a little more about yourself? Perhaps you can shed light on where the far shists come from? I must admit, the word-wolf is very confusing on this matter.”
rows.translation: “你真是个有趣的星际人，”众人朝瀑布方向消失后，奎因继续审视着你说道。“你单枪匹马征服悬崖，来到这里后却又服从奎因的意志。强大、公正、顺从的战士。我从未遇到过这样的星际人。”她漫不经心地用一根手指划过闪亮的大腿内侧，尖俏精致的脸上浮现一丝微笑。“你成为我的臣民，让我十分高兴。愿意多告诉我一些关于你的事吗？或许你能说明远方粪人来自哪里？我必须承认，言语之狼在这件事上的说法非常令人困惑。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What an interesting star-person you are,” says Quinn, continuing to gaze at you appraisingly once they have disappeared towards the waterfall. “You defeat the cliffs singlehandedly, and yet when you get here you submit to the will of Quinn. A strong, fair, obedient warrior. I have not encountered any other star-people like that.” She idly traces a finger up her gleaming inner thigh, a small smile on her pointed, delicate face. “It pleases me a great deal that you are a subject of mine. Will you tell me a little more about yourself? Perhaps you can shed light on where the far shists come from? I must admit, the word-wolf is very confusing on this matter.”"

rows.original: Agree
rows.translation: 同意
rows.raw: "Agree"

rows.original: So he’s gone a bit off the rails, but Lah isn’t wrong.
rows.translation: 拉的确有些失控，但他说得并没有错。
rows.raw: "So he’s gone a bit off the rails, but Lah isn’t wrong."

rows.original: PQ_CHIEF_LOCKED
rows.raw: "PQ_CHIEF_LOCKED"

rows.original: Quinn is presently engaged. Perhaps you should come back later?
rows.translation: 奎因现在有事在身。或许你该晚点再来？
rows.raw: "Quinn is presently engaged. Perhaps you should come back later?"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.raw: "Quinn Post-Pregnancy"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: You are on the small plateau that stands at the head of the zil village. The top of the promontory is flat, sandy and round, surrounded by the fungus-shaped zil homes, and has a circle of stones in the middle. On the opposite side of the natural terrace there is the ornate, trophy-laden chieftain’s chair. It’s empty.
rows.translation: 你位于兹尔村庄顶端的小高原上。岬地顶部平坦、遍布沙土且呈圆形，四周环绕着蘑菇形的兹尔居所，中央有一圈石头。天然平台的另一侧摆着酋长那张装饰华丽、挂满战利品的座椅。椅子空无一人。
rows.raw: "You are on the small plateau that stands at the head of the zil village. The top of the promontory is flat, sandy and round, surrounded by the fungus-shaped zil homes, and has a circle of stones in the middle. On the opposite side of the natural terrace there is the ornate, trophy-laden chieftain’s chair. It’s empty."

rows.original: Where is Quinn?
rows.translation: 奎因在哪里？
rows.raw: " Where is Quinn?"

rows.original: Several small zil children run over at your approach, eager to stare at, ask questions of and most importantly play with the honored star-person guest. The place has plenty of bustle; male zil flicker in and out of the air carrying tools, cooking fires are lit, weapons are honed and conversation buzzes. It’s all around the edges, though. Nobody walks through the circle.
rows.translation: 你一走近，几个兹尔小孩便跑了过来，迫不及待地盯着这位尊贵的星际人客人看、向你提问，最重要的是和你玩耍。这里相当热闹；雄性兹尔带着工具在空中飞进飞出，烹饪用的火堆已经点燃，武器正在打磨，交谈声嗡嗡作响。不过，这一切都发生在边缘。没有人走进石圈。
rows.raw: "\n\nSeveral small zil children run over at your approach, eager to stare at, ask questions of and most importantly play with the honored star-person guest. The place has plenty of bustle; male zil flicker in and out of the air carrying tools, cooking fires are lit, weapons are honed and conversation buzzes. It’s all around the edges, though. Nobody walks through the circle."

rows.original: Quinn Post-Pregnancy
rows.raw: "Quinn Post-Pregnancy"

rows.original: Quinn?
rows.translation: 奎因？
rows.raw: "Quinn?"

rows.original: Quinn?
rows.translation: 奎因？
rows.raw: "Quinn?"

rows.original: Ask where the zil leader’s got to.
rows.translation: 询问兹尔首领去了哪里。
rows.raw: "Ask where the zil leader’s got to."

rows.original: intro
rows.raw: "intro"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: intro
rows.raw: "intro"

rows.original: You [pc.move] back around the throne and up the hill towards Quinn’s yurt with a certain amount of trepidation. You flick at the heavy, woven entrance flap and ask if it’s alright to come in.
rows.translation: 你怀着几分忐忑，[pc.move]绕过王座，沿山坡走向奎因的蒙古包。你弹了弹厚重的编织门帘，询问是否可以进来。
rows.raw: "You [pc.move] back around the throne and up the hill towards Quinn’s yurt with a certain amount of trepidation. You flick at the heavy, woven entrance flap and ask if it’s alright to come in."

rows.original: “I told you to leave me alone! I am Q... Starwalker? Oh, starwalker...” the figure on the bed moans, flopping back down into a nest of fur. It’s neither an invitation nor a demand to leave; you decide to step inside. With your eyes adjusting to the gloom, you can see Quinn is curled up in a fetal position, her abdomen and shoulders quivering with gentle sobs.
rows.translation: “我叫你别来烦我！我是奎...星行者？哦，星行者...”床上的身影呻吟着，重新倒进毛皮堆成的窝中。这既不是邀请，也不是赶你离开；你决定走进去。双眼逐渐适应昏暗后，你看见奎因蜷缩成胎儿姿势，腹部和双肩随着轻柔啜泣不断颤抖。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I told you to leave me alone! I am Q... Starwalker? Oh, starwalker...” the figure on the bed moans, flopping back down into a nest of fur. It’s neither an invitation nor a demand to leave; you decide to step inside. With your eyes adjusting to the gloom, you can see Quinn is curled up in a fetal position, her abdomen and shoulders quivering with gentle sobs."

rows.original: “Starwalker...” She turns her eyes to you, awash in golden misery. “My child pains me. It drags downwards, it wants no part of me, because Quinn is just like her mother. She is not generous, and she will not be bountiful!” Her words ascend into a terrible wail. “I do not have her strength. I cannot do that - six and seven stillborn for the sake of a single child. The zpirits know that Quinn is a cruel woman, yes, and cruelty is all they can answer her with. All she can bring into this world is death!” She buries her head back into the furs, heaving with buzzing sobs.
rows.translation: “星行者...”她将浸透金色悲苦的双眼转向你。“我的孩子令我痛苦。它不断向下坠，不愿成为我的一部分，因为奎因和她的母亲一模一样。她不慷慨，也不会丰产！”她的话语上扬成一声凄厉哀号。“我没有她的坚强。我做不到-为了一个孩子而生下六七个死胎。泽灵知道奎因是个残酷的女人，没错，而它们只能以残酷回应她。她能带到这个世界上的只有死亡！”她把头重新埋进毛皮中，身体因嗡鸣般的啜泣不断抽动。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Starwalker...” She turns her eyes to you, awash in golden misery. “My child pains me. It drags downwards, it wants no part of me, because Quinn is just like her mother. She is not generous, and she will not be bountiful!” Her words ascend into a terrible wail. “I do not have her strength. I cannot do that - six and seven stillborn for the sake of a single child. The zpirits know that Quinn is a cruel woman, yes, and cruelty is all they can answer her with. All she can bring into this world is death!” She buries her head back into the furs, heaving with buzzing sobs."

rows.original: Comfort
rows.translation: 陪伴
rows.raw: "Comfort"

rows.original: comfort
rows.raw: "comfort"

rows.original: Comfort
rows.translation: 陪伴
rows.raw: "Comfort"

rows.original: Soothe her, and bring the cuddles.
rows.translation: 安慰她，再送上拥抱。
rows.raw: "Soothe her, and bring the cuddles."

rows.original: Chastise
rows.translation: 训斥
rows.raw: "Chastise"

rows.original: chastise
rows.raw: "chastise"

rows.original: Chastise
rows.translation: 训斥
rows.raw: "Chastise"

rows.original: If you have the measure of Quinn, some tough love is called for here.
rows.translation: 如果你真的了解奎因，此时就该给她一点严厉的关爱。
rows.raw: "If you have the measure of Quinn, some tough love is called for here."

rows.original: Medical?
rows.translation: 医疗？
rows.raw: "Medical?"

rows.original: medical
rows.raw: "medical"

rows.original: Medical?
rows.translation: 医疗？
rows.raw: "Medical?"

rows.original: You do own a state-of-the-art nursery on one of those stars. Might that not be of help?
rows.translation: 你确实在某颗星球上拥有一座最先进的育儿中心。那里或许能帮上忙？
rows.raw: "You do own a state-of-the-art nursery on one of those stars. Might that not be of help?"

rows.original: medical
rows.raw: "medical"

rows.original: Quinn listens, blinking back her tears, as you describe the Nursery you own on Tavros. You could definitely transport her there and get her checked out, maybe in as little time as a day.
rows.translation: 你向奎因介绍自己在塔弗罗斯拥有的育儿中心时，她一边听，一边强忍泪水。你肯定能把她送去那里接受检查，或许只需一天。
rows.raw: "Quinn listens, blinking back her tears, as you describe the Nursery you own on Tavros. You could definitely transport her there and get her checked out, maybe in as little time as a day."

rows.original: She’s still and silent for a time, hand on her belly.
rows.translation: 她一手按着腹部，沉默不动了好一阵子。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe’s still and silent for a time, hand on her belly."

rows.original: “No...” she says doubtfully, and then more firmly. “No. I cannot run from this, flee into the soft arms of starwalker magic. I would no longer be able to call myself Quinn - yes, I would shed that name and become your servant, if I were to entreat the things that are your zpirits. I must stay here and accept this judgment, as terrible as it may be.”
rows.translation: “不...”她迟疑地说道，随后语气变得更加坚定。“不。我不能逃避此事，不能逃进星行者魔法柔软的臂弯。那样我便再也无颜自称奎因——是的，若我乞求那些属于你们的兹灵，我就该舍弃这个名字，成为你的仆人。我必须留在这里接受这场审判，无论它多么可怕。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No...” she says doubtfully, and then more firmly. “No. I cannot run from this, flee into the soft arms of starwalker magic. I would no longer be able to call myself Quinn - yes, I would shed that name and become your servant, if I were to entreat the things that are your zpirits. I must stay here and accept this judgment, as terrible as it may be.”"

rows.original: You have calmed her down a bit just by talking sensibly, although she still looks utterly miserable.
rows.translation: 仅仅是通情达理地与她交谈，你便令她稍微平静了一些，尽管她看起来依然痛苦至极。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou have calmed her down a bit just by talking sensibly, although she still looks utterly miserable."

rows.original: You have soothed her a bit just by talking calmly, although she still looks utterly miserable.
rows.translation: 仅仅是平静地与她交谈，你便稍稍安抚了她，尽管她看起来依然痛苦至极。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou have soothed her a bit just by talking calmly, although she still looks utterly miserable."

rows.original: 12 Zil Village Winnar
rows.raw: "12 Zil Village Winnar"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: chastise
rows.raw: "chastise"

rows.original: You pull up a crude wooden stool by her bed, take her hand, and then lay down some home truths to her. That if her baby is showing, it’s fairly unlikely to miscarry. That she’s probably just suffering some common-or-garden stomach cramps like any pregnant mother, and is throwing histrionics over it. That she chose to be a mother alone, and so can hardly throw a wobbler about not having a shoulder to cry on
rows.translation: 你把一张粗糙的木凳拉到她床边，握住她的手，随后向她讲明几条不太中听的事实。既然已经显怀，她流产的可能性就相当低。她大概只是在经受任何孕妇都可能遇到的寻常腹部痉挛，却为此大惊小怪。她选择了独自做母亲，因此很难因为没有肩膀可供哭泣而大发脾气
rows.raw: "You pull up a crude wooden stool by her bed, take her hand, and then lay down some home truths to her. That if her baby is showing, it’s fairly unlikely to miscarry. That she’s probably just suffering some common-or-garden stomach cramps like any pregnant mother, and is throwing histrionics over it. That she chose to be a mother alone, and so can hardly throw a wobbler about not having a shoulder to cry on"

rows.original: now
rows.translation: ，尤其是现在
rows.raw: " now"

rows.original: . That, finally, she is Quinn, and this whole scheme she cooked up in order to secure her rule is getting more undermined the longer she mopes around in bed
rows.translation: 。最后，她是奎因，而她为了巩固统治想出的整套计划，会随着她继续躺在床上闷闷不乐而愈发受到削弱
rows.raw: ". That, finally, she is Quinn, and this whole scheme she cooked up in order to secure her rule is getting more undermined the longer she mopes around in bed"

rows.original: and leaves her people doubting her
rows.translation: ，也会让她的族人对她产生怀疑
rows.raw: " and leaves her people doubting her"

rows.original: Quinn frowns, and then her expression freezes as you go on, as if she were drawing more and more into herself, frost forming over her pretty features. She is silent for a few moments afterwards, mouthing a few words back to herself.
rows.translation: 奎因皱起眉头；随着你继续说下去，她的表情僵住了，仿佛愈发退缩进自己的内心，漂亮的面容上凝结起寒霜。之后她沉默了片刻，嘴唇无声地重复着几句话。
rows.raw: "\n\nQuinn frowns, and then her expression freezes as you go on, as if she were drawing more and more into herself, frost forming over her pretty features. She is silent for a few moments afterwards, mouthing a few words back to herself."

rows.original: “You are right,” she says, and you’re relieved to hear her familiarly calm tones. She sits herself up and brusquely wipes her drying tears away. “I thought through and carried out my own decisions every step of the way. If I cannot look my judgment firmly in the face, what does that say of me? That I am not Quinn. And I am. I am!” she grits determinedly. “My child shall feel my determination! It will fight!”
rows.translation: “你说得对，”她说道，熟悉的冷静语调令你松了口气。她坐起身，粗鲁地擦掉逐渐干涸的泪水。“每一步都是我自己深思熟虑后作出的决定，也是我亲手执行的。若我无法坚定地直面自己的判断，那说明我是怎样的人？说明我不是奎因。但我就是。我就是！”她坚定地咬牙说道。“我的孩子会感受到我的决心！它会战斗！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You are right,” she says, and you’re relieved to hear her familiarly calm tones. She sits herself up and brusquely wipes her drying tears away. “I thought through and carried out my own decisions every step of the way. If I cannot look my judgment firmly in the face, what does that say of me? That I am not Quinn. And I am. I am!” she grits determinedly. “My child shall feel my determination! It will fight!”"

rows.original: You give her an encouraging squeeze, and then leave her to pick herself up. She emerges into the Chieftain’s Circle a few minutes later, a picture of regal indifference, and receives the clamor of anxious, curious zil with cool explanations and directions.
rows.translation: 你鼓励地捏了捏她，随后留下她自行振作。几分钟后，她走进酋长之环，俨然一副王者般漠然的模样，以冷静的解释和指示回应焦虑而好奇的兹尔发出的喧闹声。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give her an encouraging squeeze, and then leave her to pick herself up. She emerges into the Chieftain’s Circle a few minutes later, a picture of regal indifference, and receives the clamor of anxious, curious zil with cool explanations and directions."

rows.original: Silently you get into her bed, spoon into Quinn from behind (zil abdomens are not helpful when it comes to this, but you manage) and for a little while just hold her, rubbing her swollen belly. She’s tense at first, but slowly relaxes in your grip, her sobs slowly trailing off into snotty sniffs.
rows.translation: 你默默钻进她的床铺，从身后与奎因紧贴着侧卧（兹尔的腹部让这个姿势不太方便，但你还是办到了），随后只是抱了她一会儿，轻抚她隆起的腹部。起初她浑身紧绷，却在你怀中慢慢放松下来，啜泣也逐渐化作带着鼻音的抽噎。
rows.raw: "Silently you get into her bed, spoon into Quinn from behind (zil abdomens are not helpful when it comes to this, but you manage) and for a little while just hold her, rubbing her swollen belly. She’s tense at first, but slowly relaxes in your grip, her sobs slowly trailing off into snotty sniffs."

rows.original: Do you smell something different about her? A particular, horny fragrance, different from the usual zil pheromones, that maybe are only for you? You think perhaps you can.
rows.translation: 你是否闻到她身上有种不同的气味？一种特殊而诱情的芬芳，不同于寻常的兹尔信息素，或许只为你而散发？你觉得自己似乎闻到了。
rows.raw: " Do you smell something different about her? A particular, horny fragrance, different from the usual zil pheromones, that maybe are only for you? You think perhaps you can."

rows.original: When you think she’s calmed down enough, you begin to talk softly into her ear. You tell her if she’s showing, she’s pretty unlikely to miscarry. That she’s probably suffering from stomach cramps, which is entirely normal, as is the anxiety. That there’s nothing weak about reaching out for emotional support, and that maybe the reason she feels this way now is because she’s been deliberately cutting herself off from it.
rows.translation: 当你觉得她已经足够平静，便开始在她耳边轻声说话。你告诉她，既然已经显怀，流产的可能性就很低。她大概只是在经受腹部痉挛，这完全正常，焦虑也是如此。寻求情感支持并不软弱，而她现在之所以有这种感受，或许正是因为她一直在刻意隔绝这种支持。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you think she’s calmed down enough, you begin to talk softly into her ear. You tell her if she’s showing, she’s pretty unlikely to miscarry. That she’s probably suffering from stomach cramps, which is entirely normal, as is the anxiety. That there’s nothing weak about reaching out for emotional support, and that maybe the reason she feels this way now is because she’s been deliberately cutting herself off from it."

rows.original: By the time you’re done her sniffles have entirely run their course, and you think she might even have drifted off in your arms.
rows.translation: 等你说完，她的抽噎已经彻底平息，你觉得她甚至可能已在你怀中睡着。
rows.raw: "\n\nBy the time you’re done her sniffles have entirely run their course, and you think she might even have drifted off in your arms."

rows.original: “Thank you, [pc.name],” she says, lowly. You’re relieved to hear her familiar cool tones returning. “I was... silly. And perhaps I would not have made some of the decisions that I have, if I knew then what I know now.” She draws herself out of your arms, straight-backed and solemn against the bone headboard. “I am Quinn. I will look my judgment in the face, whatever it may be. I will be strong, because... because I know I can rely upon you.”
rows.translation: “谢谢你，[pc.name]，”她低声说道。听见她熟悉的冷静语调恢复，你松了口气。“我刚才...太傻了。或许，如果当时就知道如今知道的这些事，我不会作出某些决定。”她离开你的怀抱，背脊笔直、神情庄重地靠在骨制床头板上。“我是奎因。无论审判结果如何，我都会直面它。我会坚强，因为...因为我知道自己可以依靠你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thank you, [pc.name],” she says, lowly. You’re relieved to hear her familiar cool tones returning. “I was... silly. And perhaps I would not have made some of the decisions that I have, if I knew then what I know now.” She draws herself out of your arms, straight-backed and solemn against the bone headboard. “I am Quinn. I will look my judgment in the face, whatever it may be. I will be strong, because... because I know I can rely upon you.”"

rows.original: You give her another encouraging squeeze, and then leave her to pick herself up. She emerges into the Chieftain’s Circle a few minutes later, a picture of regal indifference, and receives the clamor of anxious, curious zil with cool explanations and directions.

rows.raw: "\n\nYou give her another encouraging squeeze, and then leave her to pick herself up. She emerges into the Chieftain’s Circle a few minutes later, a picture of regal indifference, and receives the clamor of anxious, curious zil with cool explanations and directions."

rows.raw: "\n\n“Our child,” she agrees, taking the warm, black and yellow bundle back into her waiting arms."

rows.original: You feel a warm glow at seeing her so happy, particularly given the depths of misery she came to dwell in during the pregnancy. Perhaps it’s strange that she stuck so firmly to the task of denying the child a father, but could one ask for a more loving, competent, powerfully-placed mother? Probably not on this planet. You hand the warm, black and yellow bundle back into her waiting arms.
rows.translation: 看到她如此幸福，你心中涌起一阵暖意，尤其考虑到她怀孕期间曾陷入何等深重的绝望。她一直坚决不让孩子拥有父亲，或许有些奇怪；但还能找到比她更慈爱、更能干、地位更显赫的母亲吗？至少在这颗星球上大概找不到。你将那团温暖的黑黄色襁褓交回她等待的怀中。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel a warm glow at seeing her so happy, particularly given the depths of misery she came to dwell in during the pregnancy. Perhaps it’s strange that she stuck so firmly to the task of denying the child a father, but could one ask for a more loving, competent, powerfully-placed mother? Probably not on this planet. You hand the warm, black and yellow bundle back into her waiting arms."

rows.original: You spend a little more time with Quinn and her baby, before tiredness sags at her eyes, and a handmaiden slips in to take the child away. You leave her, hair still tangled and sweaty, sleeping peacefully, and [pc.move] back down to the Chieftain’s Circle. She’ll be back on her feet and ordering her minions around in a couple of days, you wouldn’t doubt.
rows.translation: 你又陪了奎因和她的孩子一会儿，直到倦意令她眼皮低垂，一名侍女悄然进来抱走孩子。你离开时，她仍披散着凌乱汗湿的头发，正安详熟睡；你[pc.move]返回酋长石圈。毫无疑问，再过几天她就会重新站起来，对手下发号施令。

rows.original: You are on the small plateau that stands at the head of the zil village.
