rows.original: Several small zil children run over at your approach, eager to stare at, ask questions of and most importantly play with the honored star-person guest. The place has a bustle to it; male zil flicker in and out of the air carrying tools, cooking fires are lit, weapons are honed and conversation buzzes. It’s all around the edges, though. Nobody walks through the circle.
rows.translation: 你一走近，几个兹尔小孩便跑了过来，迫不及待地盯着这位尊贵的星际人客人看、向你提问，最重要的是和你玩耍。这里颇为热闹；雄性兹尔带着工具在空中飞进飞出，烹饪用的火堆已经点燃，武器正在打磨，交谈声嗡嗡作响。不过，这一切都发生在边缘。没有人走进石圈。
rows.raw: "\n\nSeveral small zil children run over at your approach, eager to stare at, ask questions of and most importantly play with the honored star-person guest. The place has a bustle to it; male zil flicker in and out of the air carrying tools, cooking fires are lit, weapons are honed and conversation buzzes. It’s all around the edges, though. Nobody walks through the circle."

rows.original: Quinn
rows.translation: 奎因
rows.raw: "Quinn"

rows.original: Quinn
rows.translation: 奎因
rows.raw: "Quinn"

rows.original: Approach the reclining Queen.
rows.translation: 走近斜倚而坐的女王。
rows.raw: "Approach the reclining Queen."

rows.original: Lah
rows.translation: 拉
rows.raw: "Lah"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “How exactly did you get out of the plantation and wind up here?” you ask. “Darnock seemed pretty surprised that anyone managed it.”
rows.translation: “你究竟是怎么逃出种植园，又来到这里的？”你问道。“达诺克似乎很惊讶居然有人能成功逃脱。”
rows.raw: "“How exactly did you get out of the plantation and wind up here?” you ask. “Darnock seemed pretty surprised that anyone managed it.”"

rows.original: “A few others did it,” replies Lah, strolling slowly around the plateau with you, hands behind back. “You saw yourself they didn’t have walls, just turrets. So if you were willing to risk getting a stun bolt between your shoulderblades - and let me tell you, those things sting fierce for days afterwards - you could always try leaping into the jungle if your group got assigned to the perimeter fields. But if you managed to evade the turrets and the drones, what were you going to do then?”
rows.translation: “还有几个人也成功过，”拉回答道，双手背在身后，陪你缓步绕行高原。“你也亲眼看见了，那里没有围墙，只有炮塔。所以，如果愿意冒着肩胛骨之间挨一发电击弹的风险-我告诉你，那玩意之后能让人刺痛好几天-而你的小组又被分配到外围田地，总可以试着跳进丛林。但就算成功避开炮塔和无人机，之后又能怎么办？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A few others did it,” replies Lah, strolling slowly around the plateau with you, hands behind back. “You saw yourself they didn’t have walls, just turrets. So if you were willing to risk getting a stun bolt between your shoulderblades - and let me tell you, those things sting fierce for days afterwards - you could always try leaping into the jungle if your group got assigned to the perimeter fields. But if you managed to evade the turrets and the drones, what were you going to do then?”"

rows.original: Lah barks with dry laughter, gazing out over the huts and trees to the south west.
rows.translation: 拉干涩地大笑几声，眺望西南方的棚屋与树林。
rows.raw: "\n\nLah barks with dry laughter, gazing out over the huts and trees to the south west."

rows.original: “I remember one kaithrit in my work group - smuggler. Grew up on a jungle world, said Mhen’ga was pussy shit, in her words. Got away in the first week, sprained her ankle doing it, spent a day limping her way to Esbeth, fighting off naleen and worse on the way. What’s waiting for her at the entrance? Their police officer, a riot-mech and a cab back to the plantation. Snugglé knows exactly where you’re going to go, because what else are you going to do? Let the tentacle women enslave you?”
rows.translation: “我记得工作组里有个凯斯瑞特-是个走私犯。她在丛林星球长大，用她自己的话说，门亨伽根本就是娘们儿玩意。第一周她就逃了，途中扭伤脚踝，花了一天一瘸一拐地赶往埃斯贝斯，一路还得击退纳林和更糟的东西。结果入口处等着她的是什么？当地警官、一台防暴机甲，还有一辆送她回种植园的出租车。舒适乐完全知道你会去哪里，因为除此之外你还能怎么办？让触手女奴役你吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I remember one kaithrit in my work group - smuggler. Grew up on a jungle world, said Mhen’ga was pussy shit, in her words. Got away in the first week, sprained her ankle doing it, spent a day limping her way to Esbeth, fighting off naleen and worse on the way. What’s waiting for her at the entrance? Their police officer, a riot-mech and a cab back to the plantation. Snugglé knows exactly where you’re going to go, because what else are you going to do? Let the tentacle women enslave you?”"

rows.original: He rubs his chin, pale eyes lowering to the bustle of the zil village.
rows.translation: 他揉着下巴，苍白的双眼垂向热闹的兹尔村庄。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe rubs his chin, pale eyes lowering to the bustle of the zil village."

rows.original: “So I always knew that if I were going to get out, it would be out. Permanently. I had my beliefs and my education, and that stood me apart from the other prisoners - lowlives and sad-stories mostly, struggled to see beyond their own noses. I knew about Snugglé’s practices, I knew if they were using prison labor it had to be because the natives were restless. It was just a case of connecting up with them. The other prisoners laughed and cheered when I ran for it the first time I got put on the far fields, like they always did. A bit of entertainment to break up the backbreaking monotony of life on that fucking plantation.” Lah’s wiry shoulders rise and fall. “I am so glad you didn’t try and take me back there. I am so glad I will never see any of them again.”
rows.translation: “所以我始终明白，如果真要逃出去，那就必须彻底出去。永远离开。我有自己的信念和所受的教育，这让我和其他囚犯截然不同-他们大多是些底层人和悲惨故事的主角，连自己鼻尖之外的事都看不见。我了解舒适乐的行事方式，也知道他们若在使用监狱劳工，必然是因为原住民并不安分。只需要设法与他们取得联系。第一次被派到远处田地时，我拔腿逃跑，其他囚犯像往常一样又笑又欢呼。那只不过是用来打破那座该死种植园里累断脊梁的单调生活的一点娱乐。”拉精瘦的双肩起伏了一下。“我真高兴你没有试着把我送回那里。我真高兴自己再也不用见到他们任何一个。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So I always knew that if I were going to get out, it would be out. Permanently. I had my beliefs and my education, and that stood me apart from the other prisoners - lowlives and sad-stories mostly, struggled to see beyond their own noses. I knew about Snugglé’s practices, I knew if they were using prison labor it had to be because the natives were restless. It was just a case of connecting up with them. The other prisoners laughed and cheered when I ran for it the first time I got put on the far fields, like they always did. A bit of entertainment to break up the backbreaking monotony of life on that fucking plantation.” Lah’s wiry shoulders rise and fall. “I am so glad you didn’t try and take me back there. I am so glad I will never see any of them again.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “Pretty amazing accomplishment,” you muse. “An alien criminal, not only being welcomed in by zil, but anointed their prophet.”
rows.translation: “真是了不起的成就，”你沉吟道。“一个异星罪犯不仅受到兹尔欢迎，还被尊为他们的先知。”
rows.raw: "“Pretty amazing accomplishment,” you muse. “An alien criminal, not only being welcomed in by zil, but anointed their prophet.”"

rows.original: “It was all - luck,” mutters Lah, ears lowering and cheeks burning. “One thing just fell on top of the other. If I - if I’d planned any of it, I’d never have set myself up as their ‘word-wolf’. I wouldn’t have started this ridiculous ‘Quinn’ thing. It’s totally against what I - how we should interact with natives.”
rows.translation: “这一切都是-运气，”拉嘟囔道，双耳垂下，脸颊发烫。“事情一件接一件地凑到了一起。如果我-如果我事先计划过任何一步，就绝不会把自己塑造成他们的‘言语之狼’。我也不会开始这套荒唐的‘奎因’把戏。这完全违背了我-违背了我们与原住民互动应有的方式。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It was all - luck,” mutters Lah, ears lowering and cheeks burning. “One thing just fell on top of the other. If I - if I’d planned any of it, I’d never have set myself up as their ‘word-wolf’. I wouldn’t have started this ridiculous ‘Quinn’ thing. It’s totally against what I - how we should interact with natives.”"

rows.original: “But there’s no meticulous plan when you’re running through an alien jungle, getting steadily more dehydrated and spooked. The first zil I ran into, I asked her to take me to her leader. And after we - after certain relationships were established - that’s exactly what she did.”
rows.translation: “可当你在异星丛林里奔逃，身体越来越脱水，精神也越来越惊恐时，根本不可能有什么周密计划。我遇见的第一个兹尔，我请她带我去见她的首领。而在我们-在某些关系建立之后-她确实就这么做了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But there’s no meticulous plan when you’re running through an alien jungle, getting steadily more dehydrated and spooked. The first zil I ran into, I asked her to take me to her leader. And after we - after certain relationships were established - that’s exactly what she did.”"

rows.original: Lah sighs in exasperation, rubbing his face and ears.
rows.translation: 拉恼火地叹了口气，揉着脸和耳朵。
rows.raw: "\n\nLah sighs in exasperation, rubbing his face and ears."

rows.original: “Look, I didn’t know how zil babies were made at the time, alright? I didn’t ask to be sent to Mhen’ga. And I just assumed, once I saw the leader was female, that - it was an honest mistake, alright? But she took to being called Quinn like I’d crowned her myself. They seem to think the star-people language has actual power, that they can use it against their oppressors as a weapon. And because I could explain why Snugglé had taken their land away from them, and could show them how to get back at them - as I said. One thing just fell on top of the other.” He flourishes his hands wryly, plucks at his fur cape. “And now this is me. The word-wolf, sayer of truths. Sometimes you don’t get to choose your own destiny.”
rows.translation: “听着，我当时不知道兹尔宝宝是怎么出生的，好吗？我又没有要求被送到门亨伽。而且看到首领是女性后，我只是想当然地认为-那是个无心之失，好吗？但她接受‘奎因’这个称呼时，就像我亲手为她加冕了一样。他们似乎认为星际人的语言拥有真正的力量，能够把它当作武器对付压迫者。而我又能解释舒适乐为何夺走他们的土地，也能教他们如何报复-就像我说的。事情一件接一件地凑到了一起。”他自嘲地挥了挥手，又扯扯自己的毛皮斗篷。“于是我就成了现在这样。言语之狼，真理的宣讲者。有时候，你无法选择自己的命运。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Look, I didn’t know how zil babies were made at the time, alright? I didn’t ask to be sent to Mhen’ga. And I just assumed, once I saw the leader was female, that - it was an honest mistake, alright? But she took to being called Quinn like I’d crowned her myself. They seem to think the star-people language has actual power, that they can use it against their oppressors as a weapon. And because I could explain why Snugglé had taken their land away from them, and could show them how to get back at them - as I said. One thing just fell on top of the other.” He flourishes his hands wryly, plucks at his fur cape. “And now this is me. The word-wolf, sayer of truths. Sometimes you don’t get to choose your own destiny.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “So what’s the plan from here on in?” you ask. “Can these zil go back to farming the plantation land?”
rows.translation: “那么接下来有什么计划？”你问道。“这些兹尔能回去耕种种植园的土地吗？”
rows.raw: "“So what’s the plan from here on in?” you ask. “Can these zil go back to farming the plantation land?”"

rows.original: “Oh no,” says Lah, shaking his head furiously. “No no no. We all need to lie very low for a time, let things settle, see what Snugglé and their U.G.C. lapdogs decide to do next. In fact it may even be wise to relocate, not give them any potential targets at all. I’ve had trouble explaining this to the zil - they think the battle is won, they’re eager to reclaim it before another tribe does. But they do listen. I have been proven right about everything else, after all.”
rows.translation: “哦，不行，”拉说道，猛烈摇头。“不不不。我们所有人都得低调一阵，让事情平息下来，看看舒适乐和他们在UGC的走狗下一步决定怎么做。实际上，迁移或许才是明智之举，不给他们留下任何可攻击的目标。我很难向兹尔解释这一点-他们认为战斗已经获胜，急着在另一个部族抢先之前夺回那里。但他们确实会听。我在其他每件事上毕竟都已经证明自己是对的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh no,” says Lah, shaking his head furiously. “No no no. We all need to lie very low for a time, let things settle, see what Snugglé and their U.G.C. lapdogs decide to do next. In fact it may even be wise to relocate, not give them any potential targets at all. I’ve had trouble explaining this to the zil - they think the battle is won, they’re eager to reclaim it before another tribe does. But they do listen. I have been proven right about everything else, after all.”"

rows.original: The ausar sits down, rubbing his hands rhythmically, eyes slightly glassy.
rows.translation: 奥萨坐了下来，有节奏地搓着双手，双眼微微失神。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe ausar sits down, rubbing his hands rhythmically, eyes slightly glassy."

rows.original: “My expectation is that they will step off. There’s plenty of other planets out there that can be terraformed and exploited after all, no need to waste money on one that’s stood up to them and destroyed their property. Property, right? It’s the most important thing - the key to really hitting capitalist pigs where it hurts. After that --” Lah smiles. “-- I’ve got friends out there. Friends who will be very interested to hear about an independent paradise like this. Once we’ve got dozens of like-minded souls here - that’s when we can really start making things happen. We can build something different. Something of mutual benefit, to natives and outsiders in need alike.”
rows.translation: “我预计他们会就此退让。外面毕竟还有许多其他星球可以改造和开发，没必要继续往一颗敢于反抗并摧毁他们财产的星球上浪费钱。财产，对吧？那才是最重要的东西-也是痛击资本主义猪猡要害的关键。之后--”拉笑了。“--我在外面还有朋友。那些朋友会非常乐意听说这样一个独立的天堂。等这里聚集了几十个志同道合的人-到那时，我们才能真正开始有所作为。我们可以建立一种不同的东西。一种让原住民和有需要的外来者都能互惠互利的东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My expectation is that they will step off. There’s plenty of other planets out there that can be terraformed and exploited after all, no need to waste money on one that’s stood up to them and destroyed their property. Property, right? It’s the most important thing - the key to really hitting capitalist pigs where it hurts. After that --” Lah smiles. “-- I’ve got friends out there. Friends who will be very interested to hear about an independent paradise like this. Once we’ve got dozens of like-minded souls here - that’s when we can really start making things happen. We can build something different. Something of mutual benefit, to natives and outsiders in need alike.”"

rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “It is good to see you return, honored friend!” Lah leaps down from his place by Quinn’s side and shakes your hand vigorously. “Seriously, it’s nice to talk to - talk to someone from the outside world,” he goes on in lower tones. “And for the zil to see starwalkers walking amongst them in peace. What’s - what’s going on? At Esbeth? On the frontier?”
rows.translation: “很高兴看到你回来，尊贵的朋友！”拉从奎因身旁的位置跳下来，用力与你握手。“说真的，能和-能和外面世界的人说话真好，”他压低声音继续说道。“也能让兹尔看到星行者在他们之间和平行走。现在-现在情况怎么样？埃斯贝斯呢？边境呢？”
rows.raw: "“It is good to see you return, honored friend!” Lah leaps down from his place by Quinn’s side and shakes your hand vigorously. “Seriously, it’s nice to talk to - talk to someone from the outside world,” he goes on in lower tones. “And for the zil to see starwalkers walking amongst them in peace. What’s - what’s going on? At Esbeth? On the frontier?”"

rows.original: You give him what fragments of gossip you have, which is hungrily devoured by craning furry ears and wide, gray eyes.
rows.translation: 你把自己知道的零碎传闻告诉了他；那对竖起的毛茸茸耳朵和睁大的灰色双眼如饥似渴地吞下每个字。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give him what fragments of gossip you have, which is hungrily devoured by craning furry ears and wide, gray eyes."

rows.original: “So no U.G.C. intervention seems planned? That is good news, at least. What can I tell you about?”
rows.translation: “所以，UGC似乎没有计划干预？至少这是个好消息。你想问我些什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So no U.G.C. intervention seems planned? That is good news, at least. What can I tell you about?”"

rows.original: The ausar activist’s angry agitation appears adequately abated.
rows.translation: 这名奥萨活动家的愤怒与焦躁似乎已经充分平息。

rows.original: You are on the small plateau that stands at the head of the zil village. The top of the promontory is flat, sandy and round, surrounded by the fungus-shaped zil homes, and has a circle of stones in the middle. On the opposite side of the natural terrace there is the ornate, trophy-laden chieftain’s chair, upon which Quinn lounges. She arches her eyebrows in response to your gaze.
rows.translation: 你位于兹尔村庄顶端的小高原上。岬地顶部平坦、遍布沙土且呈圆形，四周环绕着蘑菇形的兹尔居所，中央有一圈石头。天然平台的另一侧摆着酋长那张装饰华丽、挂满战利品的座椅，奎因正懒洋洋地倚坐其上。察觉你的目光，她扬起眉毛。
rows.raw: "You are on the small plateau that stands at the head of the zil village. The top of the promontory is flat, sandy and round, surrounded by the fungus-shaped zil homes, and has a circle of stones in the middle. On the opposite side of the natural terrace there is the ornate, trophy-laden chieftain’s chair, upon which Quinn lounges. She arches her eyebrows in response to your gaze."

rows.original: Several small zil children run over at your approach, eager to stare at, ask questions of and most importantly play with the honored star-person guest. The place has plenty of bustle; male zil flicker in and out of the air carrying tools, cooking fires are lit, weapons are honed and conversation buzzes. It’s all around the edges, though. Nobody walks through the circle.
rows.translation: 你一走近，几个兹尔小孩便跑了过来，迫不及待地盯着这位尊贵的星际人客人看、向你提问，最重要的是和你玩耍。这里相当热闹；雄性兹尔带着工具在空中飞进飞出，烹饪用的火堆已经点燃，武器正在打磨，交谈声嗡嗡作响。不过，这一切都发生在边缘。没有人走进石圈。
rows.raw: "\n\nSeveral small zil children run over at your approach, eager to stare at, ask questions of and most importantly play with the honored star-person guest. The place has plenty of bustle; male zil flicker in and out of the air carrying tools, cooking fires are lit, weapons are honed and conversation buzzes. It’s all around the edges, though. Nobody walks through the circle."

rows.translation: 奎因

rows.original: Maybe go back and explain what’s happened at the Plantation before speaking to Quinn again.
rows.translation: 也许你该先回去说明种植园发生了什么，再来和奎因交谈。
rows.raw: "Maybe go back and explain what’s happened at the Plantation before speaking to Quinn again."

rows.original: Quinn

rows.raw: "Quinn"

rows.raw: "Quinn"

rows.original: Approach the reclining Queen.
rows.translation: 走近斜倚而坐的女王。
rows.raw: "Approach the reclining Queen."

rows.original: You are on the small plateau that stands at the head of the former zil village. The top of the promontory is flat, sandy and round, surrounded by the fungus-shaped zil homes - although you notice they are beginning to slump into themselves now, like melting ice-cream. The wax probably needs constant maintenance to retain its shape.
rows.translation: 你位于原兹尔村庄顶端的小高原上。岬地顶部平坦、遍布沙土且呈圆形，四周环绕着蘑菇形的兹尔居所-不过你注意到，它们如今已经开始向内塌陷，如同融化的冰淇淋。那些蜡大概需要持续维护才能保持形状。
rows.raw: "You are on the small plateau that stands at the head of the former zil village. The top of the promontory is flat, sandy and round, surrounded by the fungus-shaped zil homes - although you notice they are beginning to slump into themselves now, like melting ice-cream. The wax probably needs constant maintenance to retain its shape."

rows.original: The chieftain’s chair and various bits of crafted material that were once here have been spirited away. The place could have been deserted for years. Presumably Quinn and the rest of her savage clan are still out there somewhere, although you doubt the female zil is still in charge of them after what happened here.
rows.translation: 酋长座椅和曾经摆在这里的各种手工制品都已被悄然搬走。这里看上去仿佛已经荒废多年。奎因和她那野蛮氏族的其余成员大概仍在外面某处，不过经历这里发生的事情后，你怀疑那名雌性兹尔是否还统领着他们。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe chieftain’s chair and various bits of crafted material that were once here have been spirited away. The place could have been deserted for years. Presumably Quinn and the rest of her savage clan are still out there somewhere, although you doubt the female zil is still in charge of them after what happened here."

rows.original: People calling a place ill-fated seems a lot less laughable when you’re stood alone somewhere like this. There’s no reason to linger.
rows.translation: 当你独自站在这种地方时，别人说某地命运不祥，听起来就没那么可笑了。没有必要久留。
rows.raw: "\n\nPeople calling a place ill-fated seems a lot less laughable when you’re stood alone somewhere like this. There’s no reason to linger."

rows.original: You are on the small plateau that stands at the head of the zil village. The top of the promontory is flat, sandy and round, surrounded by the fungus-shaped zil homes, and has a circle of stones in the middle, although it’s badly muddled now. On the opposite side of the natural terrace there is an overturned ornate chair.
rows.translation: 你位于兹尔村庄顶端的小高原上。岬地顶部平坦、遍布沙土且呈圆形，四周环绕着蘑菇形的兹尔居所，中央有一圈石头，不过如今已经凌乱不堪。天然平台的另一侧倒扣着一张装饰华丽的椅子。
rows.raw: "You are on the small plateau that stands at the head of the zil village. The top of the promontory is flat, sandy and round, surrounded by the fungus-shaped zil homes, and has a circle of stones in the middle, although it’s badly muddled now. On the opposite side of the natural terrace there is an overturned ornate chair."

rows.original: Spent torches and broken spears are scattered across the sand like branches after a storm. The place is deserted - although is it the wind that is causing the rustle and whisper in the undergrowth? Perhaps it would be wise not to linger.
rows.translation: 燃尽的火把与折断的长矛散落在沙地上，如同暴风雨过后的树枝。这里空无一人-不过，灌木丛中的沙沙低语真的是风声吗？或许最好不要久留。
rows.raw: "\n\nSpent torches and broken spears are scattered across the sand like branches after a storm. The place is deserted - although is it the wind that is causing the rustle and whisper in the undergrowth? Perhaps it would be wise not to linger."

rows.original: “Do you see, my champion?” She grabs your hand, lays it onto that bump, insists you feel it. “My call to the zpirits has been answered. Quinn has kindled! She was generous, and she is bountiful!” Her face is alive with a wild joy you’ve never seen before; it’s tamped down on when you withdraw your hand, her characteristic composure reasserting itself. Still, you don’t think you’ve ever seen her so happy and proud, the very picture of a munificent matriarch.
rows.translation: “看见了吗，我的勇士？”她抓住你的手，按在那处隆起上，坚持要你亲自感受。“我对泽灵的呼唤得到了回应。奎因怀上了！她很慷慨，而且她会丰产！”她脸上洋溢着你从未见过的狂喜；当你抽回手时，那份喜悦受到压抑，她特有的镇定重新占据上风。即便如此，你觉得自己从未见她如此幸福而骄傲，俨然一位慷慨大度的女家长。

rows.original: When you come to, Penny’s snuggled up next to you and staring deeply into your eyes. “Hey there, [pc.name].” She kisses your nose. “Thanks for that. You rest up as much as you need. I’ll keep watch till you’re ready to go on, okay?”
rows.translation: 你恢复意识时，潘妮正依偎在身旁，深深凝视你的双眼。“嘿，[pc.name]。”她亲了亲你的鼻子。“刚才谢谢你。想休息多久都行。我会替你守着，直到你准备好继续前进，好吗？”
rows.raw: "When you come to, Penny’s snuggled up next to you and staring deeply into your eyes. “Hey there, [pc.name].” She kisses your nose. “Thanks for that. You rest up as much as you need. I’ll keep watch till you’re ready to go on, okay?”"

rows.original: You nod.

rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod."

rows.original: “Oh, and ignore all that stuff I said about settling down and having kids. I think that was just whatever the venus-woman dosed me with.”
rows.translation: “哦，还有，别理会我说的那些安定下来、生孩子之类的话。我想那只是维纳斯女人给我用的东西在作怪。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, and ignore all that stuff I said about settling down and having kids. I think that was just whatever the venus-woman dosed me with.”"

rows.original: Sure.
rows.translation: 当然。
rows.raw: "\n\nSure."

rows.original: Penny grabs you by elbow and forcibly yanks back. “Careful, mate. This mining operation isn’t on the books, and I’d bet credits to cumshots these lawbreaking drillboys are programmed to put an end to nosy explorers.” She scowls.
rows.translation: 潘妮抓住你的手肘，强行把你拽了回来。“小心，伴侣。这场采矿作业没有备案，我敢拿信用点跟射精打赌，这些违法的钻头小子肯定被设定成要让多管闲事的探险者永远闭嘴。”她沉下脸。
rows.raw: "\n\nPenny grabs you by elbow and forcibly yanks back. “Careful, mate. This mining operation isn’t on the books, and I’d bet credits to cumshots these lawbreaking drillboys are programmed to put an end to nosy explorers.” She scowls."

rows.original: You carefully - very carefully - lift up your Codex and edge the corner with the hololens past the crag of rock you and Penny are sheltered behind. A few taps later and you’re treated to an up-close view of the busy machinery.
rows.translation: 你小心地 - 极其小心地 - 举起CODEX终端，将装有全息镜头的一角探出你和潘妮藏身的岩脊。轻点几下后，忙碌机械的近距离画面便呈现在你眼前。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou carefully - very carefully - lift up your Codex and edge the corner with the hololens past the crag of rock you and Penny are sheltered behind. A few taps later and you’re treated to an up-close view of the busy machinery."

rows.original: “Spot any logos?” Penny growls low in the back of her throat. “I’d love to know which low-life scumcorp thought it would be a good idea to skip out on my planet’s taxes. Last I checked we barely had any. Just enough to keep the town running - mostly off mineral claims like this one.”
rows.translation: “看到任何标志了吗？”潘妮从喉咙深处发出低沉的咆哮。“我很想知道是哪家下三滥的垃圾公司觉得逃缴我的星球税款是个好主意。上次查看时，我们几乎没收多少税，刚够维持镇子运转 - 主要就靠这种矿产开采权。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Spot any logos?” Penny growls low in the back of her throat. “I’d love to know which low-life scumcorp thought it would be a good idea to skip out on my planet’s taxes. Last I checked we barely had any. Just enough to keep the town running - mostly off mineral claims like this one.”"

rows.original: One robot turns away, hauling a small fortune in Oxonium ore to the lander. On its back are streaks of faded enamel where somebody went at it with a power sander, not enough to prove anything in court, but enough for you to recognize edges of a design you’ve seen your father scowl at many times: the enormous bolded ‘X’ of the MaxCorp logo. <i>“These are MaxCorp mining robots. Dad always said they’d do anything for a credit, but I didn’t expect them to stoop quite this low.
rows.translation: 一台机器人转过身，将价值不菲的奥克索尼姆矿石运往着陆艇。它背上留有褪色的瓷漆条痕，显然有人用电动砂光机处理过；这不足以在法庭上证明什么，却足以让你认出某个图案的边缘。你曾多次看见父亲对它怒目而视：马克斯公司标志中那个巨大而粗重的‘X’。<i>“这些是马克斯公司的采矿机器人。爸爸总说他们为了信用点什么都肯做，可我没想到他们会堕落到这种地步。
rows.raw: "\n\nOne robot turns away, hauling a small fortune in Oxonium ore to the lander. On its back are streaks of faded enamel where somebody went at it with a power sander, not enough to prove anything in court, but enough for you to recognize edges of a design you’ve seen your father scowl at many times: the enormous bolded ‘X’ of the MaxCorp logo. <i>“These are MaxCorp mining robots. Dad always said they’d do anything for a credit, but I didn’t expect them to stoop quite this low."

pc.isBimbo()

rows.original: Not even good looking ones! They probably used them so they could blame some pirates that bought last season’s model. I mean... who wants old robots?
rows.translation: 甚至都不好看！他们大概特意用了这些，好把责任推给买了上一季型号的海盗。我是说...谁会想要旧机器人？
rows.raw: "Not even good looking ones! They probably used them so they could blame some pirates that bought last season’s model. I mean... who wants old robots?"

rows.original: Plenty strong but not exactly fast or smart. Probably hauled out of storage for plausible deniability. Blame smugglers with surplus ‘bots if they get caught.
rows.translation: 力气足够大，但谈不上敏捷或聪明。大概是为了合理推诿才从仓库里拖出来的。如果被抓，就怪到使用剩余机器人货物的走私者头上。
rows.raw: "Plenty strong but not exactly fast or smart. Probably hauled out of storage for plausible deniability. Blame smugglers with surplus ‘bots if they get caught."

rows.original: Penny scowls. “I could call in peacekeeper reinforcements... but this would become a crime scene. The right to the Oxonium claim would go up for government auction, and a small fry like me would never stand a chance.” Her ears lift upright, and her lip curls in a fearsome smile. “Or we could dish out a little frontier justice. These robots are technically trespassing in a sovereign planet. We scrap ‘em, and there’s nothing MaxCorp can do except write them off as a tax deduction. Then we file a claim ourselves, bring in a legal crew - maybe one through your father’s company - and reap a sizable reward.”
rows.translation: 潘妮沉下脸。“我可以呼叫维和人员增援...但这里会变成犯罪现场。奥克索尼姆矿权会被政府拿去拍卖，像我这样的小人物根本没有胜算。”她竖起双耳，嘴角卷出令人畏惧的笑容。“或者，我们可以伸张一点边疆正义。这些机器人严格来说是在侵犯一个主权星球。我们把它们拆成废铁，马克斯公司除了把损失记作税务抵扣之外什么也做不了。然后我们自己申报矿权，带一支合法团队过来 - 也许可以通过你父亲的公司 - 再收获一大笔回报。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPenny scowls. “I could call in peacekeeper reinforcements... but this would become a crime scene. The right to the Oxonium claim would go up for government auction, and a small fry like me would never stand a chance.” Her ears lift upright, and her lip curls in a fearsome smile. “Or we could dish out a little frontier justice. These robots are technically trespassing in a sovereign planet. We scrap ‘em, and there’s nothing MaxCorp can do except write them off as a tax deduction. Then we file a claim ourselves, bring in a legal crew - maybe one through your father’s company - and reap a sizable reward.”"

rows.original: It’s at that exact moment a wailing klaxon sounds. You risk a look back into the crater in time to see a gold myr scout emerging from a tunnel on the other side. She’s got all four of her arms up in the air, but the mechanical rock-maulers advance all the same.
rows.translation: 恰在此刻，刺耳的警报响起。你冒险回头看向弹坑，正好看见一名金米尔侦察兵从另一侧的隧道里走出。她的四条手臂全都举在空中，但那些机械碎岩机仍照样向前逼近。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s at that exact moment a wailing klaxon sounds. You risk a look back into the crater in time to see a gold myr scout emerging from a tunnel on the other side. She’s got all four of her arms up in the air, but the mechanical rock-maulers advance all the same."

rows.original: “Whoah! Hey... no need to be hostile. I’m just surveying the area for my queen. Let’s just... ah fuck it.” The golden girl yanks a heavy-caliber burst rifle off her back at levels it at the metal menaces. “Come at me, fuck-faces!”
rows.translation: “哇！嘿...没必要这么敌对。我只是在替女王勘察这一地区。咱们就...啊，去他的。”金色姑娘从背上扯下一把大口径点射步枪，瞄准金属威胁。“来啊，操蛋玩意儿们！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Whoah! Hey... no need to be hostile. I’m just surveying the area for my queen. Let’s just... ah fuck it.” The golden girl yanks a heavy-caliber burst rifle off her back at levels it at the metal menaces. “Come at me, fuck-faces!”"

rows.original: If this soldier-myr clears off the robots before you, she could claim the resources for her queen! You suppose you’ll have assist her, if only to prove to Penny that you’re a reliable sort of Rusher.
rows.translation: 如果这个米尔士兵抢在你前面清除机器人，她就能替女王宣称这些资源！看来你只能协助她，哪怕只是为了向潘妮证明自己是个可靠的行星开拓者。
rows.raw: "\n\nIf this soldier-myr clears off the robots before you, she could claim the resources for her queen! You suppose you’ll have assist her, if only to prove to Penny that you’re a reliable sort of Rusher."

rows.raw: "This dinged-up mining robot has seen better days, but its drills are still sharp and its servos strong."

rows.translation: 这个双足工业机械每走一步都发出隆隆声与哐当声，身后拖出一阵火花雨。
rows.raw: "Rumbling and clattering with every step it takes, this piece of bipedal industry trails a shower of sparks."

rows.original: The final ‘bot is perhaps the nicest looking of the three. No wonder it’s the one bearing the remnants of a MaxCorp logo. Despite their differences, they move at the same languid speed with the same implacable force.
rows.translation: 最后一台机器人或许是三台中外观最完好的。难怪只有它还带着马克斯公司的残缺标志。尽管彼此有所不同，它们都以同样迟缓的速度和同样不可阻挡的力量移动。
rows.raw: "The final ‘bot is perhaps the nicest looking of the three. No wonder it’s the one bearing the remnants of a MaxCorp logo. Despite their differences, they move at the same languid speed with the same implacable force."

rows.original: The insectile alien gives her weapon a look-over, working the action and knocking a bit of dirt off the magazine before replying. “Everything checks out. It’s a good thing I bumped into you, or I’d have been more fragged than a red on a landmine.” She shoulders the weapon and offers her lower arms to you and Penny in dual handshakes. “My name’s Onzia, and I’m guessing you’re here about this mineral load?”
rows.translation: 这个昆虫外形的异星人检查了一遍武器，拉动枪机，又敲掉弹匣上的一点泥土，随后才回答。“一切正常。幸好遇见了你，不然我恐怕会像踩上地雷的红军一样被炸成碎片。”她将武器扛上肩，用下面两只手分别与佩妮和你握手。“我叫昂齐娅，我猜你们是为这批矿物来的？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe insectile alien gives her weapon a look-over, working the action and knocking a bit of dirt off the magazine before replying. “Everything checks out. It’s a good thing I bumped into you, or I’d have been more fragged than a red on a landmine.” She shoulders the weapon and offers her lower arms to you and Penny in dual handshakes. “My name’s Onzia, and I’m guessing you’re here about this mineral load?”"

rows.original: Introducing yourselves, you and your foxy lover admit that she’s got the right of it.
rows.translation: 你和狐女爱人作了自我介绍，并承认她猜对了。
rows.raw: "\n\nIntroducing yourselves, you and your foxy lover admit that she’s got the right of it."

rows.original: “Right, well then the way I see it, we all contributed to that bit of ass-kicking, and we all got here around the same time, so a three-way split between my people and you two sounds more than fair.” She smiles happily. “A find like this, even a third of it, is going to do our little settlement a lot of good.”
rows.translation: “好吧，依我看，我们都为刚才那场痛打敌人出了力，而且抵达时间也差不多，所以在我的族人和你们两人之间分成三份，再公平不过了。”她开心地微笑。“像这样的发现，哪怕只有三分之一，也能给我们的小聚居地带来很大帮助。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right, well then the way I see it, we all contributed to that bit of ass-kicking, and we all got here around the same time, so a three-way split between my people and you two sounds more than fair.” She smiles happily. “A find like this, even a third of it, is going to do our little settlement a lot of good.”"

rows.original: While it might be possible to wiggle out of such a deal and claim it all for yourselves, Penny is already nodding her agreement. “Of course! Your people have been a real boon to Esbeth. The town’s really livened up since you arrived, and I know Burt in particular is pleased as a peach to have you around.” She gestures at the smoking heaps behind you. “I’d recommend avoiding off-spec digs like this in the future, though. Your friendly neighborhood peacekeeper isn’t always just around the corner in full riot gear, waiting to help. Sometimes you have to call us first.”
rows.translation: 你们或许有办法摆脱这项协议，将所有收益据为己有，但佩妮已经点头同意。“当然！你的族人为埃斯贝斯带来了真正的好处。你们到来后，镇子活跃了许多；我知道伯特尤其高兴得不得了，很喜欢你们待在这里。”她指向身后冒烟的废铁堆。“不过以后我建议你避开这种不合规的挖掘。你们友善的社区治安官并非总会穿着全套防暴装备，在附近转角等着帮忙。有时候你们得先呼叫我们。”
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile it might be possible to wiggle out of such a deal and claim it all for yourselves, Penny is already nodding her agreement. “Of course! Your people have been a real boon to Esbeth. The town’s really livened up since you arrived, and I know Burt in particular is pleased as a peach to have you around.” She gestures at the smoking heaps behind you. “I’d recommend avoiding off-spec digs like this in the future, though. Your friendly neighborhood peacekeeper isn’t always just around the corner in full riot gear, waiting to help. Sometimes you have to call us first.”"

rows.original: Onzia laughs. “Yeah. I got lucky today. Thanks, Penny - and thanks, [pc.name] too.”
rows.translation: 昂齐娅笑了。“是啊，我今天很幸运。谢谢你，佩妮，也谢谢你，[pc.name]。”
rows.raw: "\n\nOnzia laughs. “Yeah. I got lucky today. Thanks, Penny - and thanks, [pc.name] too.”"

rows.original: You’ll just have to make do with a third of the score this time. Ah well. You smile back.
rows.translation: 这一次，你只能接受三分之一的收获。好吧。你回以微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ll just have to make do with a third of the score this time. Ah well. You smile back."

rows.original: Penny produces a codex. “Now to stake the claim, we’ve got to do a little bit of paperwork...”
rows.translation: 佩妮拿出一台CODEX终端。“现在要登记所有权，我们还得办一点手续...”
rows.raw: "\n\nPenny produces a codex. “Now to stake the claim, we’ve got to do a little bit of paperwork...”"

rows.translation: 办完手续后，昂齐娅向你们道别，沿来路离去。她的触角比你记忆中抬得更高；这个琥珀色士兵沉重的腹部似乎也洋溢着真正的喜悦，在她消失于黑暗中时轻快摆动。
rows.raw: "After completing the paperwork, Onzia says her goodbyes and departs back the way she came. Her antennae ride a bit higher than you remember them being, and the amber soldier’s heavy abdomen seems to bob about with real joy as she vanishes into the dark."

rows.original: “And the best part?” Penny leans close to whisper in your ear, voice low and husky. “We don’t have to walk back through the cave. I can use my peacekeeper overrides to turn that little droneship into our own little shuttle-bus back to Esbeth.”
rows.translation: “还有最棒的部分？”潘妮凑到你耳边低声耳语，嗓音低沉而沙哑。“我们不必再穿过洞穴走回去了。我可以利用维和人员的最高权限，把那艘小型无人机船变成我们返回埃斯贝斯的专属接驳艇。”

rows.original: “I ran into some Zil females and my Grim-R,” she gestures to one of the glowing panels on her sash, “told me that they communicate through dance.” She pauses, her face turning an even brighter shade of pink. “Well, long story short, they laughed--for WAY too long--and I said some things that I probably shouldn’t have.” She frowns, staring at the ground, “Though in my defense, they absolutely WERE trashy, waxy vermin.”
rows.translation: “我遇上了几个雌性兹尔，我的Grim-R，”她指向肩带上一块发光面板，“告诉我她们通过舞蹈交流。”她停顿下来，脸颊变成更加鲜艳的粉红色。“好吧，长话短说，她们笑了起来--而且笑得实在太久了--于是我说了些大概不该说的话。”她皱起眉头盯着地面，“不过我要为自己辩护，她们绝对就是一群低俗的蜡皮害虫。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I ran into some Zil females and my Grim-R,” she gestures to one of the glowing panels on her sash, “told me that they communicate through dance.” She pauses, her face turning an even brighter shade of pink. “Well, long story short, they laughed--for WAY too long--and I said some things that I probably shouldn’t have.” She frowns, staring at the ground, “Though in my defense, they absolutely WERE trashy, waxy vermin.”"

rows.original: “My luck is awful. I ran into those same Zil females from before--or maybe they were looking for me,” she says, making a face. “Either way, they nabbed me before I could do anything, and tied me up to another branch,” she says. “At least I got to insult their mothers this time.”

Two globular breasts protrude from its chest, just above a rounded belly that curves down to a slug-like bottom half. The creature is pink and slightly translucent, reminding you of the rahn you’ve encountered. A red fringe of pseudopods runs from the top of its head and down either side of it’s lower body.
rows.translation: 这个软团生物有着大致呈人形的躯干，长有双臂和各具三根手指的手掌。它仰起脸看你，圆润的口鼻上方生着一双硕大的眼睛。两颗球状乳房从胸前凸出，下面是一个圆鼓鼓的肚子，再往下则过渡成蛞蝓般的下半身。这个生物呈粉红色，略微透明，让你想起曾经遇到的拉恩。从它头顶开始，一圈红色的伪足流苏沿下半身两侧延伸。

rows.original: “It’s a scrapped Xenogen Biotech project. These were supposed to be for custodial uses aboard ships,” Prai explains. “They’re semi-sentient, and they absorb inanimate organics and are pretty indestructible.” She closes her fist around the tiny creature, making it bulge out from between her fingers. When she opens her hand again, the Gemu is back to its original form, making a happy chittering sound.
rows.translation: “这是异源生物科技废弃的项目。它们原本要被用作舰船上的清洁工，”普莱解释道。“它们具有半感知能力，会吸收无生命的有机物，而且几乎无法摧毁。”她握紧拳头，将这个小生物攥在掌中，让它从指缝间鼓出来。她再次张开手时，格姆已经恢复原状，并发出欢快的吱鸣声。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s a scrapped Xenogen Biotech project. These were supposed to be for custodial uses aboard ships,” Prai explains. “They’re semi-sentient, and they absorb inanimate organics and are pretty indestructible.” She closes her fist around the tiny creature, making it bulge out from between her fingers. When she opens her hand again, the Gemu is back to its original form, making a happy chittering sound."

rows.original: Intrigued, you ask why the project was scrapped.
rows.translation: 你被勾起了兴趣，便问这个项目为何遭到废弃。
rows.raw: "\n\nIntrigued, you ask why the project was scrapped."

rows.original: “According to official statements,” Prai says with a roll of her eyes, “Xenogen was working on them for a while, but about four years into the project, JoyCo. caught wind of it and filed for copyright infringement. Turns out JoyCo. had been working on something similar for their Goovolvers. Rather than fight the lawsuit, Xenogen pulled the plug on the project. The poor things are built off of rahn and galotian DNA, but they’re not particularly bright--there were already hundreds of them made.”
rows.translation: “按照官方声明，”普莱翻着白眼说道，“异源生物科技研究了它们一段时间，但项目进行到大约第四年时，欢乐公司听到了风声，以侵犯版权为由提起诉讼。原来欢乐公司一直在为史莱姆左轮研究类似的东西。异源生物科技没有应诉，而是直接叫停了项目。这些可怜的小家伙以拉恩和加洛提亚人的DNA为基础，但算不上特别聪明--当时已经造出了好几百只。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“According to official statements,” Prai says with a roll of her eyes, “Xenogen was working on them for a while, but about four years into the project, JoyCo. caught wind of it and filed for copyright infringement. The poor things are built off of rahn and galotian DNA, but they’re not particularly bright--there were already hundreds of them made.”"

Why would you do that, you jerk?” She stomps her foot, a gesture that’s a little ruined by her new, gravid center of balance. Prai nearly tips over."

rows.original: You offer her a hand, and she refuses it, glaring at you. “All... your fault,” she says, looking incensed. She turns on her heel and stomps off through the jungle, her new belly bouncing with every step.
rows.translation: 你向她伸出手，她却瞪着你拒绝了。“全都...怪你，”她怒气冲冲地说道。她猛然转身，跺着脚走进丛林，新肚子随着每一步不断弹跳。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou offer her a hand, and she refuses it, glaring at you. “All... your fault,” she says, looking incensed. She turns on her heel and stomps off through the jungle, her new belly bouncing with every step."

rows.original: You feel a little guilty, and glance at the pitcher plant. A soft snore indicates that the floral woman is already recouping her energy from reproducing. You shrug and
rows.translation: 你感到有点内疚，转头看向猪笼草。柔和的鼾声说明，花朵女子已经开始恢复繁殖耗费的精力。你耸耸肩，随后
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel a little guilty, and glance at the pitcher plant. A soft snore indicates that the floral woman is already recouping her energy from reproducing. You shrug and "

rows.original: w
rows.translation: 重

rows.original: readjust your [pc.clothes]. W
rows.translation: 新整理好[pc.clothes]。检
rows.raw: "readjust your [pc.clothes]. W"

rows.original: ith a quick check on your gear, you set off through the jungle in your own direction.
rows.translation: 查完装备后，你选择自己的方向，动身穿过丛林。
rows.raw: "ith a quick check on your gear, you set off through the jungle in your own direction."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Wake Plant
rows.translation: 唤醒植物
rows.raw: "Wake Plant"

rows.original: Wake up the plant and watch what happens.
rows.translation: 叫醒这株植物，看看会发生什么。
rows.raw: "Wake up the plant and watch what happens."

rows.original: Help Her Out
rows.translation: 帮助她脱困
rows.raw: "Help Her Out"

rows.original: She looks like she’s having a rough day, helping her out might be a good option.
rows.translation: 她今天看起来过得很艰难，帮助她脱困或许是个不错的选择。
rows.raw: "She looks like she’s having a rough day, helping her out might be a good option."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: Frogapus
rows.raw: "Frogapus"

rows.original: You roll your eyes and leave the hapless kui-tan to the mercies of the plant woman.
rows.translation: 你翻了个白眼，将这个倒霉的奎坦留给植物女人处置。
rows.raw: "You roll your eyes and leave the hapless kui-tan to the mercies of the plant woman."

rows.original: “Sneezes and snakes! Please? Oh, please??? You can’t just leave me here!” she pleads as you walk off. She twists her head to glance at the snoozing pitcher plant. “I don’t even LIKE girls...” she wails behind you.
rows.translation: “喷嚏和蛇啊！求你了？哦，求你了？？？你不能就这么把我丢在这里！”你离开时她不断哀求。她扭头瞥向正在酣睡的猪笼草。“我根本就不喜欢女孩...”她在你身后哭喊。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sneezes and snakes! Please? Oh, please??? You can’t just leave me here!” she pleads as you walk off. She twists her head to glance at the snoozing pitcher plant. “I don’t even LIKE girls...” she wails behind you."

rows.original: You ignore her protests and continue on your way.
rows.translation: 你无视她的抗议，继续赶路。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ignore her protests and continue on your way."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Satellite Hard Drive
rows.raw: "Satellite Hard Drive"

rows.original: undefined
rows.raw: "undefined"

rows.original: function
rows.raw: "function"

rows.original: The Pyrite representative is pacing around outside the entrance to the Esbeth port, talking quietly into a commlink pressed into his shoulder. He’s having a hard time managing all his tech with an arm in a sling, and he seems to be quite manic about his lost toys.
rows.translation: 黄铁矿工业的代表正在埃斯贝斯港入口外来回踱步，对着按在肩头的通讯器低声交谈。他一条手臂吊着绷带，很难同时摆弄身上所有科技设备；丢失的那些玩意儿显然令他焦躁不已。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Pyrite representative is pacing around outside the entrance to the Esbeth port, talking quietly into a commlink pressed into his shoulder. He’s having a hard time managing all his tech with an arm in a sling, and he seems to be quite manic about his lost toys."

rows.original: Pyrite Rep
rows.translation: 黄铁矿代表
rows.raw: "Pyrite Rep"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You approach the kaithrit company man, hard drive in hand. He looks up as you approach, and his concerned scowl evaporates in an instant, replaced by an ear-to-ear grin.
rows.translation: 你手持硬盘走向这名凯斯里特公司职员。他抬头看见你，忧虑的怒容瞬间消失，取而代之的是咧至耳根的笑容。
rows.raw: "You approach the kaithrit company man, hard drive in hand. He looks up as you approach, and his concerned scowl evaporates in an instant, replaced by an ear-to-ear grin."

rows.original: “Never mind. I’ll call you back,” he says into his commpad, tucking it into his arm’s sling. “As for you! I see you’ve had success out there. Thank the One for that. My superiors were breathing down my neck something fierce. May I examine it?”
rows.translation: “没事了。我晚点再打给你，”他对通讯板说道，将其塞进手臂的吊带。“至于你！看来你在外面取得了成功。感谢独一神。我的上司催得我快喘不过气来了。可以让我检查一下吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Never mind. I’ll call you back,” he says into his commpad, tucking it into his arm’s sling. “As for you! I see you’ve had success out there. Thank the One for that. My superiors were breathing down my neck something fierce. May I examine it?”"

rows.original: You hand the device over, and the man (with some awkwardness due to his arm) runs a cable from his datapad to the drive. After a moment of squinting at the screen and muttering to himself, the cat-man gives a satisfied nod and detaches the cable. “Ah, yes, everything’s in order... and just as I thought, there’s evidence of a breach in our security protocols. I’ve had a feeling that satellite didn’t crash on its own!”
rows.translation: 你把设备递过去，这个男人颇为笨拙地用受伤手臂将一条线缆从数据板接到硬盘。盯着屏幕眯眼查看、低声自语片刻后，这名猫人满意地点了点头，拔掉线缆。“啊，对，一切正常...而且正如我所想，这里有证据表明我们的安全协议遭到入侵。我早就觉得那颗卫星不是自己坠毁的！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hand the device over, and the man (with some awkwardness due to his arm) runs a cable from his datapad to the drive. After a moment of squinting at the screen and muttering to himself, the cat-man gives a satisfied nod and detaches the cable. “Ah, yes, everything’s in order... and just as I thought, there’s evidence of a breach in our security protocols. I’ve had a feeling that satellite didn’t crash on its own!”"

rows.original: You nod, telling him about the gryvain woman out in the jungle. She seemed to be responsible.
rows.translation: 你点点头，告诉他丛林里那个格里文女人的事情。她似乎就是罪魁祸首。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, telling him about the gryvain woman out in the jungle. She seemed to be responsible."

rows.original: The man’s smile fades, replaced by a worried grimace. “Well, thank you for this, friend. You’ve done Pyrite - and Port Esbeth - a service. I’ll make sure our I.T. department gets this straight away so we can plug up the leaks. But first...”
rows.translation: 男人的笑容消失了，取而代之的是忧虑的苦相。“好吧，谢谢你，朋友。你帮了黄铁矿工业 - 也帮了埃斯贝斯港 - 一个大忙。我会确保信息技术部门立刻拿到它，好让我们堵住漏洞。但首先...”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe man’s smile fades, replaced by a worried grimace. “Well, thank you for this, friend. You’ve done Pyrite - and Port Esbeth - a service. I’ll make sure our I.T. department gets this straight away so we can plug up the leaks. But first...”"

rows.original: He reaches into one of the small pockets on his jumpsuit and produces a credit chit. “Here’s for your trouble.”
rows.translation: 他将手伸进连身服上的一个小口袋，取出一枚信用点卡。“这是给你的辛苦费。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe reaches into one of the small pockets on his jumpsuit and produces a credit chit. “Here’s for your trouble.”"

rows.original: You take it, swiping it into your Codex as the Pyrite man tucks the drive under his broken arm and starts trotting back into town. A notification pops up on your screen, showing a tidy 2,500 credits have been added to your account. A decent sum for your trouble!
rows.translation: 你接过卡片，在CODEX终端上刷了一下；与此同时，黄铁矿工业的男人将硬盘夹在受伤的手臂下，开始小跑着返回镇里。屏幕弹出通知，显示账户中整整增加了2,500信用点。作为这番辛苦的报酬，数目相当不错！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take it, swiping it into your Codex as the Pyrite man tucks the drive under his broken arm and starts trotting back into town. A notification pops up on your screen, showing a tidy 2,500 credits have been added to your account. A decent sum for your trouble!"

rows.original: Satellite Hard Drive
rows.raw: "Satellite Hard Drive"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Pyrite Rep
rows.translation: 黄铁矿代表
rows.raw: "Pyrite Rep"

rows.original: Turn in the hard drive you recovered from the fallen satellite.
rows.translation: 交出你从坠毁卫星上找回的硬盘。
rows.raw: "Turn in the hard drive you recovered from the fallen satellite."

rows.original: Pyrite Rep
rows.translation: 黄铁矿代表
rows.raw: "Pyrite Rep"

rows.original: Pyrite Rep
rows.translation: 黄铁矿代表
rows.raw: "Pyrite Rep"

rows.original: You should find his missing satellite before talking to him again.
rows.translation: 再次与他交谈前，你应该先找到他丢失的卫星。
rows.raw: "You should find his missing satellite before talking to him again."

rows.original: Satellite
rows.translation: 卫星
rows.raw: "Satellite"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You
rows.translation: 你
rows.raw: "You "

rows.original: slither
rows.translation: 滑行
rows.raw: "slither"

rows.original: scrabble
rows.translation: 手脚并用地爬
rows.raw: "scrabble"

rows.original: down the jagged dirt edge of the crater, sliding a few feet down to where the satellite has come to rest. You can see a big, red logo printed across the scorched steel casing: Pyrite Heavy Industries, LLC. As you approach, your reflection appears across the shattered surface of its solar panels, a million tiny [pc.name]s looking back at you.
rows.translation: 下陨石坑崎岖的泥土边缘，向下滑了几英尺，来到卫星停落的位置。焦黑的钢制外壳上印着一个巨大的红色标志：黄铁矿重工业有限责任公司。你走近时，太阳能板破碎的表面映出你的倒影，成千上万个[pc.name]回望着你。
rows.raw: " down the jagged dirt edge of the crater, sliding a few feet down to where the satellite has come to rest. You can see a big, red logo printed across the scorched steel casing: Pyrite Heavy Industries, LLC. As you approach, your reflection appears across the shattered surface of its solar panels, a million tiny [pc.name]s looking back at you."

rows.original: Hey, good lookin’!
rows.translation: 嘿，长得真不错！
rows.raw: " Hey, good lookin’!"

rows.original: Before you can take a good look around, however, you catch sight of another figure looming up behind you in the mirror, giving you just enough warning to spin around and draw your [pc.weapon].
rows.translation: 然而，你还没来得及仔细查看四周，就从镜面中瞥见另一道人影在身后逼近；这点预警刚好足以让你转过身，拔出[pc.weapon]。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you can take a good look around, however, you catch sight of another figure looming up behind you in the mirror, giving you just enough warning to spin around and draw your [pc.weapon]."

rows.original: Behind you, back at the top of the crater, is a woman with a pair of dark, curling horns on her brow and a quartet of leathery wings at her back. She’s wearing a black leather jacket over a vest of slick, sleek silver armor... and she’s just brought a laser pistol out from the holster at her hip, holding it trained on your chest.
rows.translation: 你的身后，陨石坑顶端站着一个女人，额头生着一对深色卷角，背后则有四片革质翅膀。她在一件光滑流线的银色护甲背心外穿着黑色皮夹克...而且刚从胯侧枪套里拔出一把激光手枪，正对准你的胸口。
rows.raw: "\n\nBehind you, back at the top of the crater, is a woman with a pair of dark, curling horns on her brow and a quartet of leathery wings at her back. She’s wearing a black leather jacket over a vest of slick, sleek silver armor... and she’s just brought a laser pistol out from the holster at her hip, holding it trained on your chest."

rows.original: Gryvain
rows.raw: "Gryvain"

rows.original: Your Codex beeps out that it’s found a gryvain, a core-ward race of winged reptilian humanoids. Little late for that, thanks.
rows.translation: 你的CODEX终端发出提示音，称它发现了一个格里文；那是来自星系核心方向、长着翅膀的爬行类人种族。谢谢，不过这提示来得有点晚了。
rows.raw: " Your Codex beeps out that it’s found a gryvain, a core-ward race of winged reptilian humanoids. Little late for that, thanks."

rows.original: Gryvain
rows.raw: "Gryvain"

rows.original: “What have we got here?” she calls down, flicking a forked tongue out over sharp teeth. “You don’t look like a Pyrite peon. Another wayward Rusher, is it?”
rows.translation: “看看这里有什么？”她朝下方喊道，分叉的舌头掠过尖牙。“你看起来不像黄铁矿工业的苦工。又一个迷路的行星开拓者，是吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What have we got here?” she calls down, flicking a forked tongue out over sharp teeth. “You don’t look like a Pyrite peon. Another wayward Rusher, is it?”"

rows.original: Something like that. “What’s with the gun?”
rows.translation: 差不多吧。“你拿枪是什么意思？”
rows.raw: "\n\nSomething like that. “What’s with the gun?”"

rows.original: She smirks, and a cobalt-blue, scaly tail curls around one of her legs. “Nothing personal, sweet thing, but I’ve been tracking this bit of space junk too long to let some snot-nosed kid ruin it. I’ve got a lot of time and credits riding on what’s inside that thing’s drive.”
rows.translation: 她咧嘴一笑，一条钴蓝色覆鳞尾巴卷住自己的一条腿。“无意冒犯，小甜心，但我追踪这块太空垃圾太久了，可不能让一个乳臭未干的小鬼毁掉一切。我在那东西的硬盘内容上押了大量时间和信用点。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe smirks, and a cobalt-blue, scaly tail curls around one of her legs. “Nothing personal, sweet thing, but I’ve been tracking this bit of space junk too long to let some snot-nosed kid ruin it. I’ve got a lot of time and credits riding on what’s inside that thing’s drive.”"

rows.original: “Wait, that Pyrite guy sent me here, too,” you call up.
rows.translation: “等等，那个黄铁矿工业的人也派我来这里，”你朝上方喊道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wait, that Pyrite guy sent me here, too,” you call up."

rows.original: The dragon-like woman laughs, shaking her head. “Sorry, kid, I’m not working for them. Now step away, eh?”
rows.translation: 这个龙女摇头大笑。“抱歉，小鬼，我可不是替他们办事的。现在退开，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe dragon-like woman laughs, shaking her head. “Sorry, kid, I’m not working for them. Now step away, eh?”"

rows.original: “Sorry, finder’s keepers,” you call up, tightening your grip on your [pc.weapon].
rows.translation: “抱歉，谁找到就归谁，”你朝上方喊道，同时握紧[pc.weapon]。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry, finder’s keepers,” you call up, tightening your grip on your [pc.weapon]."

rows.original: “I’m sorry you feel that way,” the dragon-woman growls, thumbing the charger on her pistol. “Guess we’ll have to do this the old fashioned way...”
rows.translation: “很遗憾你这么想，”龙女低吼着，用拇指拨开手枪的充能开关。“看来我们得用老办法解决了...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m sorry you feel that way,” the dragon-woman growls, thumbing the charger on her pistol. “Guess we’ll have to do this the old fashioned way...”"

rows.original: “Woah, wait, I’ve got nothing to do with this,” you call up, putting your free hand up in a sign on peace.
rows.translation: “哇，等等，我跟这件事毫无关系，”你朝上方喊道，举起空着的手，示意和平。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Woah, wait, I’ve got nothing to do with this,” you call up, putting your free hand up in a sign on peace."

rows.original: “That right? Good, like I said, didn’t take you for a Pyrite goon. Step away from the satellite, let me take the goods, and you and me... we’re good.”
rows.translation: “是吗？很好，就像我说的，你看起来不像黄铁矿工业的打手。离卫星远点，让我拿走里面的东西，那你和我...就相安无事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That right? Good, like I said, didn’t take you for a Pyrite goon. Step away from the satellite, let me take the goods, and you and me... we’re good.”"

rows.original: Fight
rows.translation: 战斗
rows.raw: "Fight"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Get out of here,” you command, pointing to the top of the crater. “Go on!”
rows.translation: “滚出去，”你指向弹坑顶部命令道。“快走！”
rows.raw: "“Get out of here,” you command, pointing to the top of the crater. “Go on!”"

rows.original: The gryvain whimpers and complies, scrambling up the edge and out of sight. You listen until her footfalls are long gone, deep into the jungle, before turning your attention back to the satellite. You find your way to a sealed compartment on its side, hidden under a panel
rows.translation: 这个格里文呜咽着照做，手脚并用地爬上边缘，消失在视野中。你侧耳倾听，直到她的脚步声深入丛林、彻底远去，才重新将注意力转向卫星。你在卫星侧面找到一处密封舱室，藏在一块面板下方
rows.raw: "\n\nThe gryvain whimpers and complies, scrambling up the edge and out of sight. You listen until her footfalls are long gone, deep into the jungle, before turning your attention back to the satellite. You find your way to a sealed compartment on its side, hidden under a panel"

rows.original: right where the kaithrit man told you to look
rows.translation: ，位置正是那个凯斯里特男人告诉你去找的地方
rows.raw: " right where the kaithrit man told you to look"

rows.original: . You
rows.translation: 。你
rows.raw: ". You "

rows.original: dig your fingers into the metal and, with a grunt of effort, rip the already-damaged seal off
rows.translation: 将手指嵌进金属，吃力地闷哼一声，把本就受损的封条扯了下来
rows.raw: "dig your fingers into the metal and, with a grunt of effort, rip the already-damaged seal off"

rows.original: pull out your tools and get to work, slicing through the simple security system keeping it sealed
rows.translation: 取出工具开始动手，切开用于维持密封的简易安保系统
rows.raw: "pull out your tools and get to work, slicing through the simple security system keeping it sealed"

rows.original: . Inside is a single removable piece: a hard drive about the size of your Codex with the Pyrite Industries logo printed on it.
rows.translation: 。里面只有一个可拆卸部件：一块与CODEX终端大小相仿的硬盘，上面印着黄铁矿工业的标志。
rows.raw: ". Inside is a single removable piece: a hard drive about the size of your Codex with the Pyrite Industries logo printed on it."

rows.original: You take the black box and stuff it in your pack.
rows.translation: 你拿起黑匣子，将它塞进背包。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take the black box and stuff it in your pack. "

rows.original: Time to take it back to the Pyrite suit in town.
rows.translation: 该把它带回镇里，交给那个黄铁矿工业的西装男了。
rows.raw: "Time to take it back to the Pyrite suit in town."

rows.original: Maybe somebody’ll pay out for it?
rows.translation: 也许会有人愿意为它付钱？
rows.raw: "Maybe somebody’ll pay out for it?"

rows.original: Satellite Hard Drive
rows.raw: "Satellite Hard Drive"

rows.original: (Key Item Gained: Satellite Hard Drive)
rows.translation: （获得关键物品：卫星硬盘）
rows.raw: "\n\n(Key Item Gained: Satellite Hard Drive)"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: With the defenseless dragon-girl now at your mercy, you decide to have some fun with her. You take a step forward that closes the distance, pushing her onto her back and spreading her legs. Her four wings splay out on the ground behind her, little talons clawing into the dirt, but the moment you have her on her ass, you see the straining bulge in her pants throb greedily, begging for release. You lean down and hook your hands through her belt, yanking her pants down and off with one rough pull. The gryvain woman gasps, and sure enough you’re treated to the sight of a dark blue dick peeking out from a pair of black panties, surrounded by the scales of her lower body.
rows.translation: 如今这个毫无防备的龙女任你摆布，你决定拿她找点乐子。你向前一步拉近距离，将她推倒在地，分开双腿。她的四只翅膀在身后铺展，小小的爪尖抓进泥土；但你刚让她屁股着地，就看见她裤子里紧绷的隆起贪婪搏动，渴求着释放。你俯身将双手勾进她的腰带，粗暴一扯便把裤子拉下脱掉。格里文女人倒吸一口气；果不其然，你得以欣赏一根深蓝鸡巴从黑色内裤中探出的景象，周围环绕着她下半身的鳞片。

rows.original:
Sizzlepod Staves are a native product of Mhen’ga, used by certain tribes of Zil and and Vanae like to defend themselves from sharp-clawed naleen. As the name suggests, the sizzlepod tree gained its alias from the bulbous, acidic nodules that sprout around its branch edges in response to impacts. This defense mechanism effectively dissuades many creatures from consuming the plant yet makes it an invaluable tool to the natives. By treating to the center line of broad branch to prevent nodule growth, a weapon of significant acidic strength can be created, deadly on both ends but safe for the wielder to hold on to.

Early reports indicate that properly treated sizzlepod branches retain their ability to spawn more pods for months - or even longer with exposure to sufficient humidity and nurturing skin oils secreted by terrans and the species most like them.

rows.translation: 你把一只手放在希莉手上。“出什么事了？”
rows.raw: "You put a hand on Syri’s. “What’s wrong?”"

rows.original: “I’m dying of suspense here. What’s up?”
rows.translation: “我都快被悬念急死了。怎么回事？”
rows.raw: "“I’m dying of suspense here. What’s up?”"

rows.original: “Come on, out with it already! You’ve been pent up about this since we left Uveto.”
rows.translation: “来吧，快说出来！从我们离开乌维托起，你就一直为这件事憋着。”
rows.raw: "“Come on, out with it already! You’ve been pent up about this since we left Uveto.”"

rows.original: “I...” she starts, pausing to think for a moment. “I didn’t just come to Uveto for the tournament. I mean, I’m here for that too because otherwise I really am gonna be flat out broke and have to move back in with my parents and that’s going to be real fucking embarrassing but also more importantly...”
rows.translation: “我...”她开口后停顿片刻，思考了一会儿。“我来乌维托不只是为了锦标赛。我的意思是，我确实也为比赛而来，否则我真的会彻底破产，只能搬回去和父母住，那会他妈尴尬死，但还有更重要的是...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I...” she starts, pausing to think for a moment. “I didn’t just come to Uveto for the tournament. I mean, I’m here for that too because otherwise I really am gonna be flat out broke and have to move back in with my parents and that’s going to be real fucking embarrassing but also more importantly...”"

rows.original: Syri stops for breath, shifting her weight on her ass. “I got some information from someone in Akkadi. The company that caused my little accident? I don’t know who it’s from or if it’s even legit, but it looks like it is, and... and it says that Valden is alive.”
rows.translation: 希莉停下来喘气，在屁股上调整重心。“我从阿卡迪的某个人那里得到了一些情报。就是导致我那场小事故的公司？我不知道情报来自谁，甚至不知道是否可靠，但它看起来是真的，而且...而且上面说瓦尔登还活着。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSyri stops for breath, shifting her weight on her ass. “I got some information from someone in Akkadi. The company that caused my little accident? I don’t know who it’s from or if it’s even legit, but it looks like it is, and... and it says that Valden is alive.”"

rows.original: “Valden? The guy whose dick you have now?”
rows.translation: “瓦尔登？就是你现在长着他的鸡巴的那个人？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Valden? The guy whose dick you have now?”"

rows.original: Syri nods. “Yeah. He went through the transporter with me but never came back out. The Akkadi brains behind the project said they had no idea where he’d gone, that he was probably dead, too. But the report I have says he’s been here at their complex on Uveto since the accident! They’ve been lying to me since day one!”
rows.translation: 希莉点点头。“对。他和我一起进入传送器，却再也没有出来。阿卡迪项目背后的那些聪明人说，他们不知道他去了哪里，他大概也死了。但我拿到的报告说，从事故发生起，他一直被关在他们位于乌维托的设施里！他们从第一天起就在骗我！”
rows.raw: "\n\nSyri nods. “Yeah. He went through the transporter with me but never came back out. The Akkadi brains behind the project said they had no idea where he’d gone, that he was probably dead, too. But the report I have says he’s been here at their complex on Uveto since the accident! They’ve been lying to me since day one!”"

rows.original: Assuming this leak is legit, anyway.
rows.translation: 当然，前提是这份泄露情报真的可靠。
rows.raw: "\n\nAssuming this leak is legit, anyway."

rows.original: “I know it’s a big assumption, but if Valden’s really alive... and being held by Akkadi; experimented on... then I can’t just leave him here! I’ve got to save him. I know he’d do the same for me.”
rows.translation: “我知道这个假设很大胆，但如果瓦尔登真的活着...而且被阿卡迪囚禁、拿来做实验...那我就不能把他丢在这里！我必须救他。我知道他也会为我做同样的事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I know it’s a big assumption, but if Valden’s really alive... and being held by Akkadi; experimented on... then I can’t just leave him here! I’ve got to save him. I know he’d do the same for me.”"

rows.original: “So what do you need from me?” you ask her.
rows.translation: “那你需要我做什么？”你问她。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So what do you need from me?” you ask her."

rows.original: The raven-haired ausar grimaces. “And that’s the awkward part. I can’t be the one that breaks into an Akkadi research base. After the accident, the company has my picture, clawprints, DNA, everything on file... there’s no way I could get away with it. No more medical benefits, probably go to jail... probably get some naval intelligence spook shooting me in the back one night.”
rows.translation: 黑发奥萨尔皱起脸。“这就是尴尬的部分。我不能成为闯进阿卡迪研究基地的人。事故发生后，公司把我的照片、爪印、DNA，所有东西都存了档...我绝不可能逃脱追查。医疗福利会没了，大概还会坐牢...也许某晚还会被某个海军情报部门的幽灵特工从背后开枪。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe raven-haired ausar grimaces. “And that’s the awkward part. I can’t be the one that breaks into an Akkadi research base. After the accident, the company has my picture, clawprints, DNA, everything on file... there’s no way I could get away with it. No more medical benefits, probably go to jail... probably get some naval intelligence spook shooting me in the back one night.”"

rows.translation: 你眨眨眼。<i>“所以你想让我
rows.raw: "\n\nYou blink. <i>“So you want me to"

rows.original: take the fall for you?”
rows.translation: 替你背黑锅？”
rows.raw: " take the fall for you?”"

rows.original: “Wha- no! No no no. I’ve got a cunning plan to get somebody else inside, completely undetected. Security will never see a trace of you, and they’ll know for a fact that I was miles away when it happened. It’ll work!”
rows.translation: “什-不！不不不。我有个巧妙计划，可以让别人完全不被发现地进去。安保系统绝不会发现你的任何痕迹，而且他们会确切知道事情发生时我在几英里之外。肯定能成功！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wha- no! No no no. I’ve got a cunning plan to get somebody else inside, completely undetected. Security will never see a trace of you, and they’ll know for a fact that I was miles away when it happened. It’ll work!”"

rows.original: Valden
rows.translation: 瓦尔登
rows.raw: "Valden"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Tell me about Valden.”
rows.translation: “跟我说说瓦尔登。”
rows.raw: "“Tell me about Valden.”"

rows.original: “He was my unit leader back in the service,” Syri answers. “He was a career man, an officer who went through the same school Anno did -- years earlier, obviously -- to get his commission as an engineer. But he never had that ‘smarter-than-the-grunts’ attitude a lot of the other officers had. He was... down to earth. I think he said he’d grown up on a farm, out on one of the kaithrit border colonies, and he was sure rugged enough for it.”
rows.translation: “他是我服役时的小队长，”希莉回答。“他是职业军人，一名军官；为了获得工程师军官任命，他读过与安诺相同的学校 - 显然是早了很多年。但他从来没有其他许多军官那种‘比大头兵聪明’的态度。他很...脚踏实地。我记得他说自己在凯斯里特边境殖民地的一座农场长大，而且他的确足够粗犷强悍。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“He was my unit leader back in the service,” Syri answers. “He was a career man, an officer who went through the same school Anno did -- years earlier, obviously -- to get his commission as an engineer. But he never had that ‘smarter-than-the-grunts’ attitude a lot of the other officers had. He was... down to earth. I think he said he’d grown up on a farm, out on one of the kaithrit border colonies, and he was sure rugged enough for it.”"

rows.original: Syri laughs to herself, shaking her head. “Most hands-on officer I ever had, too. Never shied away from doing the dirty work himself. And when we were in the shit back on Khaleen, cut off and surrounded... we only made it out because Valden kept his cool, lead us through fire and fury like you wouldn’t believe.”
rows.translation: 希莉摇着头自顾自发笑。“他也是我遇过最亲力亲为的军官，从不逃避亲手干脏活。我们当年在卡林陷入绝境、被切断退路并遭到包围时...全靠瓦尔登保持冷静，带着我们穿过烈火与狂怒，场面难以置信，我们才成功脱身。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSyri laughs to herself, shaking her head. “Most hands-on officer I ever had, too. Never shied away from doing the dirty work himself. And when we were in the shit back on Khaleen, cut off and surrounded... we only made it out because Valden kept his cool, lead us through fire and fury like you wouldn’t believe.”"

rows.original: “You know, you’ve never talked about it,” you say, prying gently. “Khaleen, I mean.”
rows.translation: “你知道吗，你从未谈过这件事，”你温和地追问。“我是说卡林。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You know, you’ve never talked about it,” you say, prying gently. “Khaleen, I mean.”"

rows.original: “You’re right,” she answers.
rows.translation: “你说得对，”她回答。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re right,” she answers."

rows.original: Silence follows for a long, long moment. Finally, Syri continues, “I know. It was a shitshow. Hardest few days of my life. But Valden got me through it alive. Got a lot of people through it alive. And those Akkadi bastards repay him by turning him into a god-damn guinea pig! It’s bullshit!”
rows.translation: 漫长、漫长的沉默随之而来。最后，希莉继续说道：“我知道。那是一场彻底的灾难，是我一生中最艰难的几天。但瓦尔登让我活着挺了过来，也让许多人活着挺了过来。结果那些阿卡迪混蛋用把他变成该死的实验品来报答他！简直胡扯！”
rows.raw: "\n\nSilence follows for a long, long moment. Finally, Syri continues, “I know. It was a shitshow. Hardest few days of my life. But Valden got me through it alive. Got a lot of people through it alive. And those Akkadi bastards repay him by turning him into a god-damn guinea pig! It’s bullshit!”"

rows.original: “I’m alive today because of his leadership. If he’s still alive, I’d never forgive myself for not trying to help him.”
rows.translation: “我今天还能活着，是因为他的领导。如果他仍然活着，而我连尝试帮助他都没有，我永远不会原谅自己。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m alive today because of his leadership. If he’s still alive, I’d never forgive myself for not trying to help him.”"

rows.original: Akkadi
rows.translation: 阿卡迪
rows.raw: "Akkadi"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Akkadi is the biggest company in ausar space. They make... everything, from starship to Warp Gates to consumer tech. They used to employ my sister, and they’re the ones that came up with the whole transporter device idea for the Federation fleet.”
rows.translation: “阿卡迪是奥萨尔太空中最大的公司。他们制造...一切东西，从星舰、跃迁门到消费科技。他们曾雇用过我妹妹，也是他们为联邦舰队提出整套传送装置构想。”
rows.raw: "“Akkadi is the biggest company in ausar space. They make... everything, from starship to Warp Gates to consumer tech. They used to employ my sister, and they’re the ones that came up with the whole transporter device idea for the Federation fleet.”"

rows.original: Sounds like a powerful enemy Syri’s trying to make here.
rows.translation: 听起来希莉正试图树立一个强大的敌人。
rows.raw: "\n\nSounds like a powerful enemy Syri’s trying to make here."

rows.original: She leans back and sighs, resting her hands on her knees. “I know. Believe me, I know that better than most. Akkadi likes to put on a cute face in public -- they have little chibi ausar girls in rainbow colors as their mascots and everything -- but they’re one of the most ruthless megacorps out there. I used to think they had to be, they’re keeping the ausar relevant in the galaxy, keeping the Warp Gate network running... but now I’m not so sure. Not if they’re experimenting on our own people.”
rows.translation: 她向后靠去，叹了口气，双手放在膝上。“我知道。相信我，我比大多数人都更清楚。阿卡迪喜欢在公众面前装出可爱的样子 - 他们甚至用彩虹色的Q版奥萨尔小姑娘当吉祥物 - 但他们是外面最冷酷无情的巨型企业之一。我以前觉得他们必须这样；他们让奥萨尔在银河系中保持重要地位，维持跃迁门网络运行...但现在我不确定了。如果他们正拿我们自己人做实验，那就更不确定。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe leans back and sighs, resting her hands on her knees. “I know. Believe me, I know that better than most. Akkadi likes to put on a cute face in public -- they have little chibi ausar girls in rainbow colors as their mascots and everything -- but they’re one of the most ruthless megacorps out there. I used to think they had to be, they’re keeping the ausar relevant in the galaxy, keeping the Warp Gate network running... but now I’m not so sure. Not if they’re experimenting on our own people.”"

rows.original: “Any idea why they’re holding Valden?”
rows.translation: “知道他们为什么囚禁瓦尔登吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Any idea why they’re holding Valden?”"

rows.original: “I’d assume it’s got something to do with the transporter accident,” Syri says. “They kept me locked down in a hospital for weeks afterwards. Of course I needed it, with my insides all scrambled around, but I knew they were studying me too. Trying to see what their little gadget had done to me, how they could profit off what they did to me. Bastards.”
rows.translation: “我猜这与传送器事故有关，”希莉说道。“事后他们把我关在医院好几个星期。当然，我的内脏全被打乱，确实需要治疗，但我知道他们也在研究我。想看看那件小装置对我做了什么，以及怎样从他们对我造成的结果中获利。混蛋。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’d assume it’s got something to do with the transporter accident,” Syri says. “They kept me locked down in a hospital for weeks afterwards. Of course I needed it, with my insides all scrambled around, but I knew they were studying me too. Trying to see what their little gadget had done to me, how they could profit off what they did to me. Bastards.”"

rows.original: Syri grumbles a few more descriptive curses, finally resting her hand on her package and adding, “At least it wasn’t all bad. Turns out having a dick is pretty great. Just wish a tenth of my organs weren’t Valden’s... though he’s got a hell of a liver. Had, I guess.”
rows.translation: 希莉又嘟囔了几句生动的咒骂，最后把手放在胯间那包东西上补充道：“至少不全是坏事。事实证明，长着鸡巴感觉相当不错。只希望我的器官没有十分之一属于瓦尔登...不过他的肝脏真他妈好用。应该说曾经好用吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSyri grumbles a few more descriptive curses, finally resting her hand on her package and adding, “At least it wasn’t all bad. Turns out having a dick is pretty great. Just wish a tenth of my organs weren’t Valden’s... though he’s got a hell of a liver. Had, I guess.”"

rows.original: You nod. “So let’s talk about their operation here on Uveto...”
rows.translation: 你点点头。“那我们谈谈他们在乌维托的设施吧...”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod. “So let’s talk about their operation here on Uveto...”"

rows.original: “Right. Akkadi has a research station way north-east of Irestead, out on the very edge of this huge rift between two glaciers. It’s in the middle of absolutely nowhere. They use it to do their most sensitive research, well away from prying eyes... and any kind of regulation or oversight. The documents I got make it look almost like a blacksite, the kind of place where they dissect the real nasty aliens out there.”
rows.translation: “对。阿卡迪在伊尔斯泰德东北很远的地方有一座研究站，位于两座冰川之间巨大裂谷的最边缘。那里是真正的荒无人烟。他们用它进行最敏感的研究，远离窥探的目光...以及任何形式的监管或监督。我得到的文件让那里看起来几乎像一处秘密设施，专门解剖外面那些真正危险的外星生物。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right. Akkadi has a research station way north-east of Irestead, out on the very edge of this huge rift between two glaciers. It’s in the middle of absolutely nowhere. They use it to do their most sensitive research, well away from prying eyes... and any kind of regulation or oversight. The documents I got make it look almost like a blacksite, the kind of place where they dissect the real nasty aliens out there.”"

rows.original: That doesn’t sound good for Valden...
rows.translation: 听起来瓦尔登的处境不妙...
rows.raw: "\n\nThat doesn’t sound good for Valden..."

rows.translation: 所以阿卡迪到底是怎么回事？他们为什么要这么做？
rows.raw: "So what’s Akkadi’s deal, anyway? Why are they doing this?"

rows.original: Transporter
rows.translation: 传送器
rows.raw: "Transporter"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “What can you tell me about the transporter?”
rows.translation: “你能告诉我多少关于传送器的事？”
rows.raw: "“What can you tell me about the transporter?”"

rows.original: “Why, hopin’ to steal one for Steele Tech?” Syri laughs. “Hell, they might have one there. The one I went through was a prototype. They wanted to use it in a hostage situation involving a member of the royal family, and my unit was apparently the only one close enough to respond in time. Pulled us off a training exercise and everything. It was the first time living people had gone through a man-scale Warp Gate... at least that anybody wanted to talk about after. Considering what happened, I think we were probably the last, too.”
rows.translation: “怎么，想替斯蒂尔科技偷一台？”希莉笑了。“见鬼，那里说不定真有一台。我用过的是原型机。他们想在一起涉及王室成员的人质事件中使用它，而我的小队显然是唯一能及时赶到的队伍。他们甚至把我们从训练演习中临时抽调出来。那是活人第一次穿过人形尺寸的跃迁门...至少是事后还有人愿意谈论的第一次。考虑到发生的事情，我觉得我们大概也是最后一批。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Why, hopin’ to steal one for Steele Tech?” Syri laughs. “Hell, they might have one there. The one I went through was a prototype. They wanted to use it in a hostage situation involving a member of the royal family, and my unit was apparently the only one close enough to respond in time. Pulled us off a training exercise and everything. It was the first time living people had gone through a man-scale Warp Gate... at least that anybody wanted to talk about after. Considering what happened, I think we were probably the last, too.”"

rows.original: “Valden and I were called to spearhead the mission. We were called into this dark chamber in a Akkadi research station, high above the planet. The transporter didn’t look like anything special at the time: it was just a platform surrounded by panels of glass, with a circle of silvery metal on the floor that the nerds made us stand inside. ‘Hands, legs, and tails inside the dimensional shunter at all times’ and all that.”
rows.translation: “瓦尔登和我受命带头执行任务。我们被叫进一座高悬于行星上方的阿卡迪研究站，进入其中一间黑暗舱室。当时那台传送器看起来没什么特别：只是一座被玻璃面板包围的平台，地板上有一圈银色金属，那些书呆子让我们站在里面。还说什么‘手、脚和尾巴必须始终处于维度转移器内部’之类的话。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Valden and I were called to spearhead the mission. We were called into this dark chamber in a Akkadi research station, high above the planet. The transporter didn’t look like anything special at the time: it was just a platform surrounded by panels of glass, with a circle of silvery metal on the floor that the nerds made us stand inside. ‘Hands, legs, and tails inside the dimensional shunter at all times’ and all that.”"

rows.original: You ask, “What happened next?”
rows.translation: 你问道：“接下来发生了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask, “What happened next?”"

rows.original: Syri takes a deep breath. “Well, um, there was a voice from the control room telling us to push all the air out of our lungs. Then there was a bright light, like, blindingly so, from all around us. Then the next thing I knew I was lying on my back in the drop site, feeling like fingers were in there tickling all my insides. It was the weirdest thing I ever felt... at least until I got my first boner.”
rows.translation: 希莉深吸一口气。“嗯，呃，控制室里有个声音叫我们把肺里的空气全部呼出去。然后四面八方亮起强光，亮得，简直让人失明。接下来恢复意识时，我已经仰躺在投送地点，感觉像有手指伸进身体，挠弄所有内脏。那是我体验过最古怪的感觉...至少在我第一次勃起之前是。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSyri takes a deep breath. “Well, um, there was a voice from the control room telling us to push all the air out of our lungs. Then there was a bright light, like, blindingly so, from all around us. Then the next thing I knew I was lying on my back in the drop site, feeling like fingers were in there tickling all my insides. It was the weirdest thing I ever felt... at least until I got my first boner.”"

rows.original: “Did it hurt?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Did it hurt?”"

rows.original: “The boner? Nah,” she laughs. Then, more seriously: “Honestly, no. I couldn’t move or speak for a while, but I wasn’t in pain. It was just... just weird.”
rows.translation: “勃起吗？不疼，”她笑了。随后，她更加认真地说：“说实话，不疼。有一阵子我动不了也说不出话，但并不痛。只是...只是很古怪。”
