rows.raw: "Tell Her"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Let’s get out of the wind,” you tell her, putting a hand on her shoulder.
rows.translation: “我们先离开风口，”你把一只手放在她肩上，对她说道。
rows.raw: "“Let’s get out of the wind,” you tell her, putting a hand on her shoulder."

rows.original: “That doesn’t sound like good news,” she says, frowning.
rows.translation: “听起来可不像好消息，”她皱着眉说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That doesn’t sound like good news,” she says, frowning."

rows.original: No shit. You push Syri back aboard the hovercraft before somebody gets suspicious and make your way back to your hiding place.
rows.translation: 这不是废话吗。你把希莉推回气垫船，以免有人起疑，随后回到自己的藏身处。
rows.raw: "\n\nNo shit. You push Syri back aboard the hovercraft before somebody gets suspicious and make your way back to your hiding place."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: A few hours later, you’ve snuck out of the company landing pad, turned in a resignation by email, and are just sneaking out the back entrance along with Syri when you feel strong, furred hands grab your shoulders. Your companion shoves you up against the wall of the nearest alleyway, pressing her face so close to yours that her breath mists across your nose.
rows.translation: 几小时后，你偷偷溜出公司的停机坪，通过邮件递交辞呈，正和希莉一起从后门悄悄离开时，忽然感觉一双强壮、覆满毛发的手抓住了你的肩膀。你的同伴把你推到最近一条小巷的墙上，将脸凑得离你极近，呼出的白雾拂过你的鼻子。
rows.raw: "A few hours later, you’ve snuck out of the company landing pad, turned in a resignation by email, and are just sneaking out the back entrance along with Syri when you feel strong, furred hands grab your shoulders. Your companion shoves you up against the wall of the nearest alleyway, pressing her face so close to yours that her breath mists across your nose."

rows.original: “Okay! Tell me what happened, [pc.name]. Out with it!” Syri growls. “Come on, I can’t wait any longer!”
rows.translation: “好了！告诉我发生了什么，[pc.name]。快说！”希莉低吼道。“快点，我再也等不下去了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay! Tell me what happened, [pc.name]. Out with it!” Syri growls. “Come on, I can’t wait any longer!”"

rows.original: You
rows.translation: 你
rows.raw: "\n\nYou "

rows.original: push Syri off you
rows.translation: 把希莉从身上推开
rows.raw: "push Syri off you"

rows.original: sigh
rows.translation: 叹息
rows.raw: "sigh"

rows.original: and start your story. “I found Valden...”
rows.translation: 并开始讲述自己的经历。“我找到瓦尔登了...”
rows.raw: " and start your story. “I found Valden...”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You tell Syri the story of what happened in the base. It’s not a pretty story; it’s not the one she wants to hear. But it’s the truth, and when you’re done, Syri’s eyes are misty and her mouth is hanging open in shock. When you finally mention exactly what happened to Valden at the end, she takes a long step back, slumping against the other wall in the alley.
rows.translation: 你向希莉讲述了基地里发生的一切。这不是个美好的故事；也不是她想听到的故事。但这就是事实。等你讲完时，希莉双眼泛着泪光，嘴巴因震惊而微微张开。当你终于详细说起瓦尔登最后的遭遇时，她向后迈了一大步，无力地靠在小巷另一侧的墙上。
rows.raw: "You tell Syri the story of what happened in the base. It’s not a pretty story; it’s not the one she wants to hear. But it’s the truth, and when you’re done, Syri’s eyes are misty and her mouth is hanging open in shock. When you finally mention exactly what happened to Valden at the end, she takes a long step back, slumping against the other wall in the alley."

rows.original: “Oh my fuck,” Syri gasps, covering her mouth. “How... how’s that even possible!? What did those Akkadi nerds do to him?”
rows.translation: “我操，”希莉捂住嘴，倒吸了一口气。“怎... 怎么可能！？那些阿卡迪的书呆子究竟对他做了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh my fuck,” Syri gasps, covering her mouth. “How... how’s that even possible!? What did those Akkadi nerds do to him?”"

rows.original: You can’t even imagine how or why anything related to the accident happened
rows.translation: 你根本想象不出那场事故中的任何事情为何会发生，又是如何发生的
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t even imagine how or why anything related to the accident happened"

rows.original: , though you know somebody who does
rows.translation: ，不过你知道有人了解真相
rows.raw: ", though you know somebody who does"

rows.original: . For the moment, what matters is what happened, and what Syri’s going to do with that information.
rows.translation: 。眼下真正重要的是已经发生的事，以及希莉准备如何处理这些信息。
rows.raw: ". For the moment, what matters is what happened, and what Syri’s going to do with that information."

rows.original: “Fuck if I know!” she howls, running her fingers through her mess of black hair. “Oh, poor Valden.... He was such a good man. He deserved better!”
rows.translation: “我他妈怎么知道！”她嚎叫着，手指插进乱糟糟的黑发。“哦，可怜的瓦尔登.... 他是个那么好的人。他不该遭遇这些！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fuck if I know!” she howls, running her fingers through her mess of black hair. “Oh, poor Valden.... He was such a good man. He deserved better!”"

rows.original: You’re not sure you can speak to that, after what you’ve seen, so you keep silent for now. Syri clenches and unclenches her fists, digging her claws into her fluffy palms. Finally, she barks a curse and slams a fist into the wall beside her, crunching a utility box in on itself.
rows.translation: 根据自己的所见，你不确定能否认同她的说法，于是暂时保持沉默。希莉一遍遍握紧又松开拳头，爪子深陷进毛茸茸的掌心。最后，她大骂一声，一拳砸在身旁的墙上，将一个设备箱砸得向内凹陷。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re not sure you can speak to that, after what you’ve seen, so you keep silent for now. Syri clenches and unclenches her fists, digging her claws into her fluffy palms. Finally, she barks a curse and slams a fist into the wall beside her, crunching a utility box in on itself."

rows.original: “I need a drink,” she proclaims, stomping out of the alley. With a shrug, you follow her.
rows.translation: “我得喝一杯，”她高声宣布，重重踏着步子走出小巷。你耸耸肩，跟了上去。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I need a drink,” she proclaims, stomping out of the alley. With a shrug, you follow her."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: A few minutes later, you’re sitting in the local watering hole (or ice hole, as the case may be), nursing a drink while Syri sits glumly across from you, her good ol’ blue navy coat on and a second beer in her hand, already half-emptied. Her tail is sitting in her lap, occasionally twitching when she steals a glance at you between drinks. She hasn’t said much, more focused on the drink in her hand or the middle distance than on your anemic conversation.
rows.translation: 几分钟后，你坐在当地的酒馆里（或者按这里的情况说，是冰窟里），慢慢喝着一杯酒。希莉闷闷不乐地坐在你对面，穿着她那件熟悉的蓝色海军大衣，手里的第二杯啤酒已经喝掉一半。她把尾巴放在腿上，每逢喝酒的间隙偷瞄你一眼，尾巴便偶尔抽动一下。她没说多少话，比起与你有气无力地交谈，她更专注于手中的酒，或者茫然地盯着远处。
rows.raw: "A few minutes later, you’re sitting in the local watering hole (or ice hole, as the case may be), nursing a drink while Syri sits glumly across from you, her good ol’ blue navy coat on and a second beer in her hand, already half-emptied. Her tail is sitting in her lap, occasionally twitching when she steals a glance at you between drinks. She hasn’t said much, more focused on the drink in her hand or the middle distance than on your anemic conversation."

rows.original: Finally, after a long bout of silence, Syri slams back the last of her drink and belches, drawing a few disapproving looks from nearby tables. She leans back in her seat, arms resting on the headboard behind her, and sighs.
rows.translation: 终于，在长久的沉默之后，希莉仰头灌下最后一口酒，打了个嗝，引得邻桌几人不满地侧目。她向后靠在座位上，双臂搭在身后的椅背上，叹了口气。
rows.raw: "\n\nFinally, after a long bout of silence, Syri slams back the last of her drink and belches, drawing a few disapproving looks from nearby tables. She leans back in her seat, arms resting on the headboard behind her, and sighs."

rows.original: “Dammit. I actually got my hopes up. I should have known better. All these years... I should have looked for him sooner. Fought harder to get answers from those Akkadi bastards. And Anno! She had to have known all along, it was her fucking project! Argh!”
rows.translation: “该死。我居然真的抱起了希望。我早该知道不会有好结果。这么多年了... 我本该早点去找他。本该更拼命地从那些阿卡迪混蛋嘴里逼问出答案。还有安诺！她肯定一直都知道，那他妈就是她的项目！啊！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Dammit. I actually got my hopes up. I should have known better. All these years... I should have looked for him sooner. Fought harder to get answers from those Akkadi bastards. And Anno! She had to have known all along, it was her fucking project! Argh!”"

rows.original: She hangs her head, dark hair falling around her face is messy locks. <i>“I’m sorry, I’m chewing your damn ear off when you’re the only person that’s been straight with me this whole time. Thank the stars for you, [pc.name]. I feel like everyone’s been lying to me for years and years and... and you’re the best thing that’s ever happened to me, you know that? You’re always straight with me
rows.translation: 她垂下脑袋，凌乱的黑发披散在脸庞四周。<i>“抱歉，明明你是这段时间里唯一对我说实话的人，我却还在这里没完没了地烦你。感谢群星让我遇见你，[pc.name]。我感觉所有人都骗了我一年又一年，而... 而你是我这辈子遇到过最美好的事，你知道吗？你总是对我坦诚相待
rows.raw: "\n\nShe hangs her head, dark hair falling around her face is messy locks. <i>“I’m sorry, I’m chewing your damn ear off when you’re the only person that’s been straight with me this whole time. Thank the stars for you, [pc.name]. I feel like everyone’s been lying to me for years and years and... and you’re the best thing that’s ever happened to me, you know that? You’re always straight with me"

rows.original: , even through that shit-eating sense of humor,
rows.translation: ，即使隔着你那副欠揍的幽默感，
rows.raw: ", even through that shit-eating sense of humor,"

rows.original: and now I know beyond a shadow of a doubt that you’ve got my back. Even when nobody else does.”
rows.translation: 而现在我已经毫无疑问地知道，你会支持我。即使其他人都不会。”
rows.raw: " and now I know beyond a shadow of a doubt that you’ve got my back. Even when nobody else does.”"

rows.original: Syri makes herself look up at you and forces a smile. “Knowing what happened to Valden hurts. Knowing that I’ve got you, though... you give me hope, Steele. I...”
rows.translation: 希莉强迫自己抬头看向你，勉强挤出一个微笑。“知道瓦尔登的遭遇让我很痛苦。但知道我还有你... 你给了我希望，斯蒂尔。我...”
rows.raw: "\n\nSyri makes herself look up at you and forces a smile. “Knowing what happened to Valden hurts. Knowing that I’ve got you, though... you give me hope, Steele. I...”"

rows.original: Your companion stands up, circling the table between you and hoisting herself up to sit on it, right in front of you. Her hands fall on your shoulders, tail brushing your arm, and her dark lips smile down at you; genuine and warm.
rows.translation: 你的同伴站起身，绕过你们之间的桌子，又撑起身体坐到桌面上，正好就在你面前。她的双手落在你的肩上，尾巴轻抚你的手臂，深色的双唇向你露出真挚而温暖的微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour companion stands up, circling the table between you and hoisting herself up to sit on it, right in front of you. Her hands fall on your shoulders, tail brushing your arm, and her dark lips smile down at you; genuine and warm."

rows.original: “I love you,” she says quietly, planting a kiss on your brow.
rows.translation: “我爱你，”她轻声说道，在你的额头上吻了一下。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I love you,” she says quietly, planting a kiss on your brow."

rows.original: Before you can process that sudden bomb-drop, Syri hops off the table, shoves her hands in her coat pockets, and marches out the front door.
rows.translation: 你还没来得及消化这枚突如其来的重磅炸弹，希莉便从桌上跳下来，把双手塞进外套口袋，大步走出了前门。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you can process that sudden bomb-drop, Syri hops off the table, shoves her hands in her coat pockets, and marches out the front door."

rows.original: Oh, Syri...
rows.translation: 唉，希莉...
rows.raw: "\n\nOh, Syri..."

rows.original: SIRETTA.UVETO VII.UVI R32
rows.raw: "SIRETTA.UVETO VII.UVI R32"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Tell Her
rows.translation: 告诉她
rows.raw: "Tell Her"

rows.original: Tell Syri an uncomfortable truth...
rows.translation: 告诉希莉一个令人难以接受的事实...
rows.raw: "Tell Syri an uncomfortable truth..."

rows.original: Didn’tFindHim
rows.translation: 没找到他
rows.raw: "Didn’tFindHim"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Sorry, Syri,” you say, putting a hand on her shoulder. “It was a bust. No sign of him.”
rows.translation: “对不起，希莉，”你把一只手放在她肩上说道。“这次扑了个空。没看到他的踪影。”
rows.raw: "“Sorry, Syri,” you say, putting a hand on her shoulder. “It was a bust. No sign of him.”"

rows.original: Syri curses under her breath and slumps her shoulders. “Yeah, I figured it was a prank or some shit. Had to be, right? This whole idea was stupid, I’m sorry I wasted your time. C’mon, let’s get you hidden before somebody realizes you aren’t supposed to be here.”
rows.translation: 希莉低声咒骂着，双肩也垮了下来。“是啊，我就知道这是什么恶作剧之类的破事。肯定是的，对吧？这个想法从头到尾都蠢透了，抱歉浪费了你的时间。来吧，趁别人还没发现你不该出现在这里，先把你藏起来。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSyri curses under her breath and slumps her shoulders. “Yeah, I figured it was a prank or some shit. Had to be, right? This whole idea was stupid, I’m sorry I wasted your time. C’mon, let’s get you hidden before somebody realizes you aren’t supposed to be here.”"

rows.original: You nod and surreptitiously follow her aboard, back into your hiding place.
rows.translation: 你点点头，悄悄跟着她登上飞船，回到你的藏身处。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod and surreptitiously follow her aboard, back into your hiding place."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: A few hours later, you’ve snuck out of the company landing pad, turned in a resignation by email, and escorted your lovely ausar companion back to the local watering hole. Or ice hole, considering the name.
rows.translation: 几小时后，你溜出了公司的停机坪，通过电子邮件递交辞呈，然后护送你可爱的奥萨同伴回到当地的酒馆。考虑到酒馆的名字，也可以说是冰窟。
rows.raw: "A few hours later, you’ve snuck out of the company landing pad, turned in a resignation by email, and escorted your lovely ausar companion back to the local watering hole. Or ice hole, considering the name."

rows.original: Syri’s sitting across from you, her good ol’ blue navy coat on and a second beer in her hand, already half-emptied. Her tail is sitting in her lap, occasionally twitching when she steals a glance at you between drinks. She hasn’t said much, more focused on the drink in her hand or the middle distance than on your anemic conversation.
rows.translation: 希莉坐在你对面，身上穿着那件熟悉的海军蓝外套，手中的第二杯啤酒已经喝掉了一半。她把尾巴搁在腿上，喝酒时偶尔会偷瞄你一眼，每当这时尾巴便会抽动一下。她一直没怎么说话，比起你们有气无力的交谈，她似乎更专注于手里的酒或是远处的某一点。
rows.raw: "\n\nSyri’s sitting across from you, her good ol’ blue navy coat on and a second beer in her hand, already half-emptied. Her tail is sitting in her lap, occasionally twitching when she steals a glance at you between drinks. She hasn’t said much, more focused on the drink in her hand or the middle distance than on your anemic conversation."

rows.original: Finally, after a long bout of silence, Syri slams back the last of her drink and belches, drawing a few disapproving looks from nearby tables. She leans back in her seat, arms resting on the headboard behind her, and sighs.
rows.translation: 终于，在漫长的沉默过后，希莉仰头喝光最后一点酒，又打了个嗝，引得邻桌投来几道不满的目光。她向后靠在座椅上，双臂搭在身后的靠背上，叹了口气。
rows.raw: "\n\nFinally, after a long bout of silence, Syri slams back the last of her drink and belches, drawing a few disapproving looks from nearby tables. She leans back in her seat, arms resting on the headboard behind her, and sighs."

rows.original: “Dammit. I actually got my hopes up. I should have known better. After all these years... of course he’s dead. I just... sometimes I wish it had been me, you know? Valden was such a sweet guy, a good soldier, had a future. And I’m just sort of floating through life still. I’m no better off than when I joined, except I got another trooper’s organs mashed up inside me. And hangin’ off of me.”
rows.translation: “该死。我居然真的抱了希望。我早该明白的。过了这么多年...他当然早就死了。我只是...有时候我真希望当时死的是我，你懂吗？瓦尔登是个那么温柔的人，又是个好士兵，本该前途无量。而我至今仍只是在浑浑噩噩地活着。我并没有比刚入伍时过得更好，只是身体里多塞了一堆从另一个士兵身上搅烂的器官。还有挂在我身上的也是。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Dammit. I actually got my hopes up. I should have known better. After all these years... of course he’s dead. I just... sometimes I wish it had been me, you know? Valden was such a sweet guy, a good soldier, had a future. And I’m just sort of floating through life still. I’m no better off than when I joined, except I got another trooper’s organs mashed up inside me. And hangin’ off of me.”"

rows.original: Syri smacks her fist on the table, hard enough to rattle your drink. Her head hangs down, fringed by messy streams of black hair, ears pinned down against her head. “Sorry. I appreciate you sticking your neck out for me, Steele. I really, really do. I’ve been such a damn careless loner since the accident... it’s so nice having somebody that cares about me. Especially someone like you.”
rows.translation: 希莉一拳砸在桌上，力道大得让你的酒杯都震了一下。她低垂着头，凌乱的黑发如流苏般垂落两侧，双耳紧贴着脑袋。“抱歉。我很感激你为我冒险，斯蒂尔。真的，真的很感激。自从那场事故以后，我一直是个该死的、什么都不在乎的独行侠...如今能有个人关心我，感觉真好。尤其那个人还是你。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSyri smacks her fist on the table, hard enough to rattle your drink. Her head hangs down, fringed by messy streams of black hair, ears pinned down against her head. “Sorry. I appreciate you sticking your neck out for me, Steele. I really, really do. I’ve been such a damn careless loner since the accident... it’s so nice having somebody that cares about me. Especially someone like you.”"

rows.original: The uncharacteristically morose pup forces herself to smile for you, eyes drinking you in for a long, long second. When she’s done, something ticking away in Syri’s head makes her blush, and her tail twitches in her lap.
rows.translation: 这只一反常态、郁郁寡欢的小狗勉强对你露出微笑，目不转睛地凝视了你好一会儿。看够之后，希莉脑海中悄然转动的某个念头令她脸颊泛红，腿上的尾巴也抽动起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe uncharacteristically morose pup forces herself to smile for you, eyes drinking you in for a long, long second. When she’s done, something ticking away in Syri’s head makes her blush, and her tail twitches in her lap."

rows.original: “I love you,” she says quietly.
rows.translation: “我爱你，”她轻声说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I love you,” she says quietly."

rows.original: There’s a silent beat in the conversation, long enough for you to start processing the statement, before Syri stands up, shoves her hands in her coat pockets, and walks right out of the Freezer.
rows.translation: 对话陷入片刻沉默，久得足以让你开始理解这句话，随后希莉站起身，把双手塞进外套口袋，径直走出了冰柜。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a silent beat in the conversation, long enough for you to start processing the statement, before Syri stands up, shoves her hands in her coat pockets, and walks right out of the Freezer."

rows.original: Oh, Syri...
rows.translation: 唉，希莉...
rows.raw: "\n\nOh, Syri..."

rows.original: SIRETTA.UVETO VII.UVI R32
rows.raw: "SIRETTA.UVETO VII.UVI R32"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Didn’t Find Him
rows.translation: 没找到他
rows.raw: "Didn’t Find Him"

rows.original: Tell Syri a comforting lie.
rows.translation: 用一个善意的谎言安慰希莉。
rows.raw: "Tell Syri a comforting lie."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: AKD T14
rows.raw: "AKD T14"

rows.original: Dr. Calnor stumbles onto a knee, gasping for breath. “I’m going to stop you and Valden... one way or another,” he growls, reaching into his lab coat. Before you can stop him, Calnor throws a thumb-sized grenade onto the ground between you. Before you can take cover, the grenade detonates, showering sparks and smoke everywhere!
rows.translation: 卡尔诺博士踉跄着单膝跪地，大口喘息。“我会阻止你和瓦尔登... 不管用什么办法，”他低吼道，同时把手伸进实验服。你还来不及阻止，卡尔诺便将一枚拇指大小的手榴弹扔到你们之间的地面上。你尚未来得及寻找掩护，手榴弹便轰然爆炸，火花与烟雾四处飞散！
rows.raw: "Dr. Calnor stumbles onto a knee, gasping for breath. “I’m going to stop you and Valden... one way or another,” he growls, reaching into his lab coat. Before you can stop him, Calnor throws a thumb-sized grenade onto the ground between you. Before you can take cover, the grenade detonates, showering sparks and smoke everywhere!"

rows.original: You reel back and cover your face, an act of primal instinct in response to unexpected danger. By the time you regain your wits and the smoke clears, Calnor’s gone -- as is some device that had been lying nearby, about the size of your arm.
rows.translation: 你向后踉跄，双手护住脸庞，这是面对突发危险时源自本能的举动。当你恢复神志、烟雾散去时，卡尔诺已经不见了 -- 附近原本放着的某个装置也一并消失，那东西约有你的手臂那么大。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reel back and cover your face, an act of primal instinct in response to unexpected danger. By the time you regain your wits and the smoke clears, Calnor’s gone -- as is some device that had been lying nearby, about the size of your arm."

rows.original: “Damn!” Valden growls over the intercom. “Ah, we’ll get him. Whoever you are, come on up to the Warp Field lab. I’ll drop the security override.”
rows.translation: “该死！”瓦尔登透过对讲机低吼。“啊，我们会抓到他的。不管你是谁，上来曲速场实验室吧。我会解除安全封锁。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Damn!” Valden growls over the intercom. “Ah, we’ll get him. Whoever you are, come on up to the Warp Field lab. I’ll drop the security override.”"

rows.original: Well, guess it’s time to go meet Valden...
rows.translation: 好吧，看来该去见瓦尔登了...
rows.raw:
"

Well, guess it’s time to go meet Valden...

"

rows.original: Calnor grunts, stumbling back against one of the computer banks buzzing away on the walls. A moment later he faints, going limp. You catch him before he can fall face-first on the deck and turn your gaze to Valden.
rows.translation: 卡尔诺闷哼一声，踉跄后退，撞上墙边嗡嗡运转的一组计算机。片刻后，他失去意识，身体瘫软下来。你赶在他脸朝下摔上甲板前接住他，随后将目光转向瓦尔登。
rows.raw: "Calnor grunts, stumbling back against one of the computer banks buzzing away on the walls. A moment later he faints, going limp. You catch him before he can fall face-first on the deck and turn your gaze to Valden."

rows.original: “That’s the stuff!” the exuberant ausar cheers. “Put that bitch in his place. Alright, stranger, drag him over to the central console here and run a wire from it to the implant slot on the back of his neck. I’ll take care of everything else!”
rows.translation: “就是这样！”兴高采烈的奥萨尔欢呼道。“让那个混蛋认清自己的地位。好了，陌生人，把他拖到这里的中央控制台旁，再从控制台接一根线到他后颈的植入物插槽。剩下的全交给我！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s the stuff!” the exuberant ausar cheers. “Put that bitch in his place. Alright, stranger, drag him over to the central console here and run a wire from it to the implant slot on the back of his neck. I’ll take care of everything else!”"

rows.original: Well, you’ve come this far. You drag the unconscious ausar over to the holobank and find a cable spooled up inside the panel. Rolling Calnor over, you brush some hair off of his neck and fine a small metal jack in his spine -- a data tap for implants. It’s quick work to run the cable from the console to the back of Calnor’s neck, plugging Valden into the mind of his captor.
rows.translation: 好吧，你已经走到了这一步。你把昏迷的奥萨尔拖到全息控制台旁，在面板里找到一根卷好的线缆。你将卡尔诺翻过身，拨开他颈后的头发，在脊柱上发现一个小型金属插孔 -- 那是植入物的数据接口。把线缆从控制台接到卡尔诺后颈十分简单，这便将瓦尔登接入了囚禁者的思维。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, you’ve come this far. You drag the unconscious ausar over to the holobank and find a cable spooled up inside the panel. Rolling Calnor over, you brush some hair off of his neck and fine a small metal jack in his spine -- a data tap for implants. It’s quick work to run the cable from the console to the back of Calnor’s neck, plugging Valden into the mind of his captor."

rows.original: “Great work. Now give me just a second here... alright!” Valden says with finality, pushing off the glass wall and floating into the middle of the tank. “I’ve erased all the security data from your little break-in, set a time release so the other Akkadi employees don’t starve to death in the lockdown... maybe stole some corporate secrets while I was at it. Should be good to go. Hot damn I am lookin’ forward to feelin’ flesh again... just feelin’ the air on my cheeks. The cold of the ice winds!”
rows.translation: “干得漂亮。现在给我一秒钟... 好了！”瓦尔登斩钉截铁地说道，从玻璃墙上推开身体，飘到容器中央。“我已经删除了你这次小小闯入留下的所有安保数据，还设置了定时解锁，免得其他阿卡迪员工在封锁中饿死... 也许还顺手偷了些公司机密。应该可以走了。该死，我真盼着重新感受到血肉... 哪怕只是感觉空气拂过脸颊。还有冰风的寒冷！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Great work. Now give me just a second here... alright!” Valden says with finality, pushing off the glass wall and floating into the middle of the tank. “I’ve erased all the security data from your little break-in, set a time release so the other Akkadi employees don’t starve to death in the lockdown... maybe stole some corporate secrets while I was at it. Should be good to go. Hot damn I am lookin’ forward to feelin’ flesh again... just feelin’ the air on my cheeks. The cold of the ice winds!”"

rows.original: Valden laughs, then vanishes.
rows.translation: 瓦尔登笑了起来，随后消失不见。
rows.raw: "\n\nValden laughs, then vanishes."

rows.original: You wait a moment...
rows.translation: 你等待了片刻...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wait a moment..."

rows.original: ... and another...
rows.translation: ... 又等了一会儿...
rows.raw: "\n\n... and another..."

rows.original: ...and another.
rows.translation: ...然后又等了一会儿。
rows.raw: "\n\n...and another."

rows.original: Suddenly, Dr. Calnor spasms, coughing and thrashing until your grab his shoulders and hold him down.
rows.translation: 突然，卡尔诺博士浑身痉挛，又咳又挣扎，直到你抓住他的双肩，把他按住。
rows.raw: "\n\nSuddenly, Dr. Calnor spasms, coughing and thrashing until your grab his shoulders and hold him down."

rows.original: “Fuck! Oh, damn, everything feels like it’s half a size too small... inside and out!” the doctor... Valden, now... says, slowly rising up onto his knees and staring at his hands. “Whew, Calnor put up a fight there. Feel like I’ve got a fever now, but he’s been pushed into backup memory in the implants. Thought about pumping him into the tank, but that’s just cruel. I’ll find an empty droid when we get out of here. Speaking of which...”
rows.translation: “操！哦，该死，一切都感觉小了半号... 无论内外！”博士... 不，现在是瓦尔登... 一边说，一边缓缓跪起，盯着自己的双手。“呼，卡尔诺刚才拼命抵抗。现在感觉像发烧一样，不过他已经被推入植入物的备份记忆。我考虑过把他泵进容器，但那实在太残忍了。等我们离开这里，我会找个空的机器人身体。说到离开...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fuck! Oh, damn, everything feels like it’s half a size too small... inside and out!” the doctor... Valden, now... says, slowly rising up onto his knees and staring at his hands. “Whew, Calnor put up a fight there. Feel like I’ve got a fever now, but he’s been pushed into backup memory in the implants. Thought about pumping him into the tank, but that’s just cruel. I’ll find an empty droid when we get out of here. Speaking of which...”"

rows.original: The former doctor stands, dusts off his lab coat, and turns to you with a hand extended. “I’m Valden. Pleasure. Now what do you say we get out of here before the company headquarters sends people here to figure out what went wrong.”
rows.translation: 曾经的博士站起身，拍去实验服上的灰尘，随后转向你并伸出一只手。“我是瓦尔登。幸会。现在，你觉得我们是不是该在公司总部派人来调查这里出了什么问题之前赶紧离开？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe former doctor stands, dusts off his lab coat, and turns to you with a hand extended. “I’m Valden. Pleasure. Now what do you say we get out of here before the company headquarters sends people here to figure out what went wrong.”"

rows.original: You nod and shake his hand. He’s right -- it’s time to get out while you still can.
rows.translation: 你点点头，与他握手。他说得对 -- 趁现在还能离开，是时候赶紧走了。
rows.raw:
"

You nod and shake his hand. He’s right -- it’s time to get out while you still can.

"

rows.original: A fist-sized data storage containing the personality of your former Siegwulfe
rows.translation: 一个拳头大小的数据存储器，里面保存着你原先那台齐格伍尔夫的性格人格
rows.raw: "A fist-sized data storage containing the personality of your former Siegwulfe"

rows.original: Siegwulfe
rows.raw: "Siegwulfe"

rows.original: , [wulfe.name]
rows.raw: ", [wulfe.name]"

rows.original: Siegwulfe Datacore
rows.raw: "Siegwulfe Datacore"

rows.original: (Key Item Gained: Siegwulfe Datacore -
rows.translation: （获得关键物品：齐格伍尔夫数据核心 -
rows.raw: "\n\n(Key Item Gained: Siegwulfe Datacore - "

rows.original: An Akkadi dropship strapped with laser cannons and god knows what else!
rows.translation: 一艘装满激光炮和天知道还有什么东西的阿卡迪登陆艇！
rows.raw: "An Akkadi dropship strapped with laser cannons and god knows what else!"

rows.original: The sleek blue hovercraft is swaying in the blizzard, melting through the continual snowfall with a pair of vulcan lasers that never seem to stop firing. The craft’s shields are still up, flickering constantly as the screaming wind of the Uvetan pole blasts it, threatening to bear the ship down at any moment.
rows.translation: 流线型蓝色悬浮艇在暴风雪中摇摆，一对仿佛永不停火的火神激光炮熔穿持续不断的降雪。飞行器的护盾依旧开启，在乌维托极地呼啸狂风的冲击下不断闪烁，仿佛随时都会被压落。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe sleek blue hovercraft is swaying in the blizzard, melting through the continual snowfall with a pair of vulcan lasers that never seem to stop firing. The craft’s shields are still up, flickering constantly as the screaming wind of the Uvetan pole blasts it, threatening to bear the ship down at any moment."

rows.original:
An Akkadi dropship strapped with laser cannons and god knows what else!

The sleek blue hovercraft is swaying in the blizzard, melting through the continual snowfall with a pair of vulcan lasers that never seem to stop firing. The craft’s shields are still up, flickering constantly as the screaming wind of the Uvetan pole blasts it, threatening to bear the ship down at any moment.
rows.translation:
一艘装满激光炮和天知道还有什么东西的阿卡迪登陆艇！

流线型蓝色悬浮艇在暴风雪中摇摆，一对仿佛永不停火的火神激光炮熔穿持续不断的降雪。飞行器的护盾依旧开启，在乌维托极地呼啸狂风的冲击下不断闪烁，仿佛随时都会被压落。
rows.raw: "An Akkadi dropship strapped with laser cannons and god knows what else!\n\nThe sleek blue hovercraft is swaying in the blizzard, melting through the continual snowfall with a pair of vulcan lasers that never seem to stop firing. The craft’s shields are still up, flickering constantly as the screaming wind of the Uvetan pole blasts it, threatening to bear the ship down at any moment."

rows.original: DROPSHIP
rows.raw: "DROPSHIP"

rows.original: Dropship
rows.translation: 登陆艇
rows.raw: "Dropship"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: The dropship keeps firing, relentlessly assaulting you with its cannons. The blizzard only makes it worse, howling around you and slamming you with cold, hard ice breaking off from the rooftops. You can’t see, can’t hear, can barely breathe -- and then the lasers find you, ripping into you like a thousand lances of pain.
rows.translation: 登陆艇继续开火，毫不留情地用火炮攻击你。暴风雪让情况更加糟糕，在你周围呼啸，将从屋顶脱落的冰冷坚硬冰块狠狠砸向你。你看不见、听不见，几乎无法呼吸 -- 随后激光命中你，如千支痛苦长矛般撕裂身体。
rows.raw: "The dropship keeps firing, relentlessly assaulting you with its cannons. The blizzard only makes it worse, howling around you and slamming you with cold, hard ice breaking off from the rooftops. You can’t see, can’t hear, can barely breathe -- and then the lasers find you, ripping into you like a thousand lances of pain."

rows.original: You crumple backwards, staring up into the abyss as your vision goes black.
rows.translation: 你向后瘫倒，视野逐渐漆黑，仰望着深渊。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou crumple backwards, staring up into the abyss as your vision goes black."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: With a thunderous CRACK! the dropship’s shields overload, discharging static energy all around it in the storm. Almost the second the shields go down, the dropship lists hard to the side, almost flipping over in the direction of the winds. The vulcan lasers keep firing, spraying red death into the air. The pilot tries to compensate, blasting the hover-engines on full tilt to stabilize the lilting craft -- and failing!
rows.translation: 伴随一声雷鸣般的巨响！登陆艇护盾过载，在风暴中向四周释放静电能量。护盾几乎刚刚消失，登陆艇便猛然向一侧倾斜，差点顺着风向翻覆。火神激光炮仍在开火，将赤红死亡泼洒进空气。驾驶员试图补救，让悬浮引擎全功率运转，以稳定倾斜的飞行器 -- 却失败了！
rows.raw: "With a thunderous CRACK! the dropship’s shields overload, discharging static energy all around it in the storm. Almost the second the shields go down, the dropship lists hard to the side, almost flipping over in the direction of the winds. The vulcan lasers keep firing, spraying red death into the air. The pilot tries to compensate, blasting the hover-engines on full tilt to stabilize the lilting craft -- and failing! "

rows.original: Something explodes, one of the engines maybe, sending gouts of oily black smoke into the air. The dropship lurches to the side and starts falling, descending weightily onto the helipad and crunching onto the tarmac with the shriek of grinding metal. You take a few steps back, making sure you’ve got plenty of room between yourself and the disabled hovership, but luckily it doesn’t explode.
rows.translation: 某样东西爆炸了，也许是其中一台引擎，向空中喷出一股股油腻黑烟。登陆艇猛然侧倾并开始坠落，沉重地降向停机坪，伴着金属摩擦的尖啸撞上柏油地面。你后退几步，确保自己与瘫痪的悬浮艇之间留出足够空间；幸好，它没有爆炸。
rows.raw: "\n\nSomething explodes, one of the engines maybe, sending gouts of oily black smoke into the air. The dropship lurches to the side and starts falling, descending weightily onto the helipad and crunching onto the tarmac with the shriek of grinding metal. You take a few steps back, making sure you’ve got plenty of room between yourself and the disabled hovership, but luckily it doesn’t explode."

rows.original: Instead, the cockpit window blows off and
rows.translation: 相反，驾驶舱窗户炸飞，
rows.raw: "\n\nInstead, the cockpit window blows off and "

rows.original: none other than Commander Schora
rows.translation: 出来的不是别人，正是肖拉指挥官
rows.raw: "none other than Commander Schora"

rows.original: a bronze-skinned dzaan in blue combat armor
rows.translation: 一个身穿蓝色战斗装甲、古铜色皮肤的德赞
rows.raw: "a bronze-skinned dzaan in blue combat armor"

rows.original: clambers out, swearing as she yanks a machine gun out from the pilot’s seat. She locks her eyes on you, a feral scowl on her dark lips.
rows.translation: 爬了出来。她一边咒骂，一边从驾驶座扯出一挺机枪。她将目光锁定在你身上，深色双唇露出野兽般的怒容。
rows.raw: " clambers out, swearing as she yanks a machine gun out from the pilot’s seat. She locks her eyes on you, a feral scowl on her dark lips."

rows.original: Suddenly, she pauses, as if she’s recognizing you for the first time.
rows.translation: 突然，她停了下来，仿佛这才第一次认出你。
rows.raw: "\n\nSuddenly, she pauses, as if she’s recognizing you for the first time."

rows.original: “You! You’re... no way!” she growls, shouldering her gun and fixing you in its sights. “You’re the cunt that caused the lockdown?
rows.translation: “你！你是... 不可能！”她低吼着把枪抵上肩头，用准星锁定你。“造成封锁的混蛋是你？
rows.raw: "\n\n“You! You’re... no way!” she growls, shouldering her gun and fixing you in its sights. “You’re the cunt that caused the lockdown? "

rows.original: I knew you were too good to be true. I knew it! Nobody makes a fool out of me, you sick fuck!”
rows.translation: 我就知道你表现得太好，根本不可能是真的。我早就知道！没人能愚弄我，你这个恶心的混蛋！”
rows.raw: " I knew you were too good to be true. I knew it! Nobody makes a fool out of me, you sick fuck!”"

rows.original: Uh-oh. Looks like taking a gentle hand with the commander here is paying off...
rows.translation: 糟糕。看来温柔对待这位指挥官正在带来回报...
rows.raw:
"

Uh-oh. Looks like taking a gentle hand with the commander here is paying off...

"

rows.original: ” Despite her words, there’s an unmistakable a twitch in Schora’s loins. Looks like she’s happy to see you... or at least, she’s got some pleasant memories from you treating her like a living fucktoy. That’s how she liked it, wasn’t it?
rows.translation: ” 尽管她嘴上这么说，肖拉的胯间却明显抽动了一下。看来她很高兴见到你... 或者至少，她对你把她当成活体泄欲玩具的经历怀有一些愉快回忆。她当时就喜欢那样，不是吗？
rows.raw: "”\n\nDespite her words, there’s an unmistakable a twitch in Schora’s loins. Looks like she’s happy to see you... or at least, she’s got some pleasant memories from you treating her like a living fucktoy. That’s how she liked it, wasn’t it?"

rows.original: Maybe you could apply some of that Steele charm here...
rows.translation: 也许你能在这里施展一下斯蒂尔的魅力...
rows.raw:
"

Maybe you could apply some of that Steele charm here...

"

rows.original: “Whoever you are, you fucked with the wrong corporation,” she growls, shouldering her gun. “I am going to make mincemeat of your ass, motherfucker!”
rows.translation: “不管你是谁，你都惹错公司了，”她把枪抵上肩头，低吼道。“我要把你的屁股打成肉酱，混账东西！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Whoever you are, you fucked with the wrong corporation,” she growls, shouldering her gun. “I am going to make mincemeat of your ass, motherfucker!”"

rows.original: Doesn’t look like she’s willing to talk!
rows.translation: 看来她不愿意谈判！
rows.raw:
"

Doesn’t look like she’s willing to talk!

"

rows.original: Fight!
rows.translation: 战斗！
rows.raw: "Fight!"

rows.original: Flirt!
rows.translation: 调情！
rows.raw: "Flirt!"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You put your hands up in a disarming fashion, enough to make Schora lower her rifle a few degrees at least.
rows.translation: 你以表示无害的姿态举起双手，至少足以让肖拉把步枪放低几度。
rows.raw: "You put your hands up in a disarming fashion, enough to make Schora lower her rifle a few degrees at least."

rows.original: “Come on, Schora,” you say, taking a few steps closer. “Have you really sold your soul to some faceless corporation? A beautiful woman like you ought to be better than this. I’m trying to rescue someone who-”
rows.translation: “别这样，肖拉，”你一边说，一边向前走了几步。“你真的已经把灵魂卖给某个没有面孔的公司了吗？像你这样的美女理应做得更好。我正试图营救一个-”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Come on, Schora,” you say, taking a few steps closer. “Have you really sold your soul to some faceless corporation? A beautiful woman like you ought to be better than this. I’m trying to rescue someone who-”"

rows.original: Schora rolls her eyes. “I know what you’re doing. Look, I thought keeping Valden locked up was shitty too, but he’s legal property of Akkadi. My job is to protect the company and its property!”
rows.translation: 肖拉翻了个白眼。“我知道你在做什么。听着，我也觉得一直关着瓦尔登很恶劣，但他是阿卡迪的合法财产。我的工作就是保护公司及其财产！”
rows.raw: "\n\nSchora rolls her eyes. “I know what you’re doing. Look, I thought keeping Valden locked up was shitty too, but he’s legal property of Akkadi. My job is to protect the company and its property!”"

rows.original: “Even when you know it’s the wrong thing to do?”
rows.translation: “即使你知道这样做是错的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Even when you know it’s the wrong thing to do?”"

rows.original: She falters, finally lowering her weapon the rest of the way. “What... what am I supposed to do, huh? They own me. They own this world!”
rows.translation: 她动摇了，终于彻底放下武器。“我... 我又能怎么办，嗯？他们拥有我。他们拥有这个世界！”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe falters, finally lowering her weapon the rest of the way. “What... what am I supposed to do, huh? They own me. They own this world!”"

rows.original: “There are other worlds than these,” you answer solemnly.
rows.translation: “世上还有别的世界，”你庄重地回答。
rows.raw: "\n\n“There are other worlds than these,” you answer solemnly."

rows.original: “Come on... listen to your heart, Schora,” you plead.
rows.translation: “别这样... 听从自己的内心吧，肖拉，”你恳求道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Come on... listen to your heart, Schora,” you plead."

rows.raw: "You crumple to the ground, breathing hard. One of the robots grabs your [pc.weapon] in a claw and crushes it. The others go after the doctor, grabbing the poor wolf’s arms and legs in their claws and pinning him to the ground."

rows.original: “I told you, old man!” Valden howls triumphantly. “I told you I was going to get out of here! You just had to stand aside... but we both knew it was going to be through you. I just didn’t think it would be literally through you.”
rows.translation: “我早就告诉过你了，老头！”瓦尔登得意地嚎叫。“我说过自己会离开这里！你只要让开就好...但我们都知道，我得穿过你才能出去。只是没想到会是字面意义上穿过你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I told you, old man!” Valden howls triumphantly. “I told you I was going to get out of here! You just had to stand aside... but we both knew it was going to be through you. I just didn’t think it would be literally through you.”"

rows.original: Calnor struggles, trying and failing to free himself from the armadillo-bots’ claws. They are implacable opponents even now, refusing to budge despite the huskar’s great strength. The drone that Valden was inhabiting strides forward with what could best be described as a swagger in its mechanical steps, powering down its face-gun as it does so. A much more insidious weapon makes itself visible a moment later: a long, prehensile cable with an electronic jack at the end. A pair of drones lift Calnor up, ignoring his struggles, and brush the hair on the back of his neck aside. There’s a metal plate over his spine, dull chrome with a series of ports for analog connections... one of which matches Valden’s cable perfectly.
rows.translation: 卡尔诺拼命挣扎，试图摆脱犰狳机器人的钳爪，却徒劳无功。即使面对赫斯卡人的强大力量，它们仍是不可撼动的对手，纹丝不动。瓦尔登寄居的无人机迈步上前，机械步伐中带着一种只能称作趾高气扬的姿态，同时关闭了面部火炮。片刻后，一件阴险得多的武器显露出来：一条末端带有电子插头的细长柔性缆线。两台无人机无视卡尔诺的挣扎，将他抬起来，拨开他的后颈毛发。他的脊柱上覆盖着一块暗淡的铬色金属板，上面排列着一系列模拟连接端口...其中一个与瓦尔登的缆线完美吻合。
rows.raw: "\n\nCalnor struggles, trying and failing to free himself from the armadillo-bots’ claws. They are implacable opponents even now, refusing to budge despite the huskar’s great strength. The drone that Valden was inhabiting strides forward with what could best be described as a swagger in its mechanical steps, powering down its face-gun as it does so. A much more insidious weapon makes itself visible a moment later: a long, prehensile cable with an electronic jack at the end. A pair of drones lift Calnor up, ignoring his struggles, and brush the hair on the back of his neck aside. There’s a metal plate over his spine, dull chrome with a series of ports for analog connections... one of which matches Valden’s cable perfectly."

rows.original: “You won’t get away with this, you psychotic scan!” Calnor growls, just before the cable plugs in. “We’ll find you... find you and-”
rows.translation: “你休想逍遥法外，你这个疯癫的扫描人格！”卡尔诺低吼道，紧接着缆线便插了进去。“我们会找到你...找到你，然后-”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You won’t get away with this, you psychotic scan!” Calnor growls, just before the cable plugs in. “We’ll find you... find you and-”"

rows.original: He’s cut off when the plug slips into him, connecting Valden and Calnor for a long, silent moment. The old grey wolf goes rigid, eyes bulging for a moment, and then goes limp in the drones’ arms. The drone that had held Valden slumps to its knees, and once the connector retracts, Calnor’s eyes snap open.
rows.translation: 插头滑入体内，令瓦尔登与卡尔诺在漫长而寂静的一刻连接起来，也打断了他的话。老灰狼浑身僵直，双眼一度暴突，随后便瘫软在无人机的钳爪中。原本承载瓦尔登的无人机跪倒在地；连接器一收回，卡尔诺便猛然睁开双眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe’s cut off when the plug slips into him, connecting Valden and Calnor for a long, silent moment. The old grey wolf goes rigid, eyes bulging for a moment, and then goes limp in the drones’ arms. The drone that had held Valden slumps to its knees, and once the connector retracts, Calnor’s eyes snap open."

rows.original: “Fuckin’ old bitch,” the doctor growls, shrugging off the grip of the drones. “Off, boys! Your job is done.”
rows.translation: “操他妈的老贱人，”博士低吼着，甩开无人机的钳制。“退下，小子们！你们的任务完成了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fuckin’ old bitch,” the doctor growls, shrugging off the grip of the drones. “Off, boys! Your job is done.”"

rows.original: The drones retreat to the edges of the room, except for the one monitoring you. Calnor walks over to it and squats, putting a hand on the drone’s humped back and staring down at you. “You made the wrong choice, [pc.boyGirl],” he says coldly. “Coulda helped one another.”
rows.translation: 除了监视你的那台以外，无人机全都退到房间边缘。卡尔诺走到它身旁蹲下，一只手搭在无人机隆起的背部，低头盯着你。“你选错了，[pc.boyGirl]，”他冷冷说道。“我们本可以互相帮助。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe drones retreat to the edges of the room, except for the one monitoring you. Calnor walks over to it and squats, putting a hand on the drone’s humped back and staring down at you. “You made the wrong choice, [pc.boyGirl],” he says coldly. “Coulda helped one another.”"

rows.original: He reaches down into your pack and pulls out your Codex, and with it, all of your credentials: access to your ship, your bank accounts, your life. “Captain of a ship, huh?” he murmurs, flicking through the Codex. All your security seems to have vanished at a touch of his fingers. “Oh, sorry about your dad... hmm, what’s this about Syri? Huh. Won’t she be surprised to find out you tried to kill me. Don’t worry, I’ll take good care of her. As for you... goodnight.”
rows.translation: 他伸手探进你的背包，取出CODEX终端，也随之取得了你的所有凭证：你的飞船、银行账户和整个人生的访问权限。“还是一位船长，嗯？”他翻动CODEX终端，低声说道。你的一切安全防护似乎都在他指尖轻触之下烟消云散。“哦，你父亲的事，我很遗憾...嗯，这些关于希莉的内容是怎么回事？哈。要是她发现你试图杀我，肯定会大吃一惊。别担心，我会好好照顾她。至于你...晚安。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe reaches down into your pack and pulls out your Codex, and with it, all of your credentials: access to your ship, your bank accounts, your life. “Captain of a ship, huh?” he murmurs, flicking through the Codex. All your security seems to have vanished at a touch of his fingers. “Oh, sorry about your dad... hmm, what’s this about Syri? Huh. Won’t she be surprised to find out you tried to kill me. Don’t worry, I’ll take good care of her. As for you... goodnight.”"

rows.original: You don’t have time to figure what he means.
rows.translation: 你没有时间弄清他是什么意思。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou don’t have time to figure what he means."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You make your way over to the small crowd of frontier gamers, parting through the group gathered around the current match. Syri’s right in the thick of it, firing a hardlight rifle at some virtual foe one-handed as she gulps an ausar ale. Seeing you approach, she flashes you a grin.
rows.translation: 你走向那小群边疆游戏玩家，从围观当前比赛的人群中挤过。希莉正身处其中，一边大口喝着奥萨尔麦酒，一边单手用硬光步枪射击某个虚拟敌人。看见你走近，她朝你咧嘴一笑。
rows.raw: "You make your way over to the small crowd of frontier gamers, parting through the group gathered around the current match. Syri’s right in the thick of it, firing a hardlight rifle at some virtual foe one-handed as she gulps an ausar ale. Seeing you approach, she flashes you a grin."

rows.translation: “准备好来一场了吗，[pc.name]？”
rows.raw: " “Ready for a match, [pc.name]?”"

rows.raw: " You can see the lust in Syri’s eyes as she looks you over, licking her lips. <i>“It’s your ass on the line, cow"

rows.original: You make your way over to the small crowd that’s circled up around the screens, pushing your way in just in time to see an alien man and woman standing almost shoulder to shoulder, hooked up in holo-bracers and hardlight projectors, furiously playing one of the newest shooter games. The male, a particularly broad-chested Zil, awkwardly maneuvers a projected rifle in his chitin-y, insectile fingers, brow furrowed in concentration; the woman beside him, a buxom xeno with a pair of perky wolf-ears towering over her pale, almost human face, has a cock-sure grin a mile wide, moving with a tactical precision that just screams military.
rows.translation: 你走向围在屏幕旁的一小群人，及时挤进人群，看见一男一女两个异星人几乎肩并肩站着，身上连接着全息臂环与硬光投影仪，正在激烈地玩一款最新的射击游戏。男性是个胸膛格外宽阔的兹尔人，正用覆有甲壳的昆虫手指笨拙地操纵投影步枪，眉头因专注而紧锁；他身旁的女人是个胸部丰满的异星人，一对活泼的狼耳高高耸立在苍白而几乎与人类无异的脸庞上。她露出无比自信的笑容，动作带着一眼便能看出军人身份的战术精准。
rows.raw: "You make your way over to the small crowd that’s circled up around the screens, pushing your way in just in time to see an alien man and woman standing almost shoulder to shoulder, hooked up in holo-bracers and hardlight projectors, furiously playing one of the newest shooter games. The male, a particularly broad-chested Zil, awkwardly maneuvers a projected rifle in his chitin-y, insectile fingers, brow furrowed in concentration; the woman beside him, a buxom xeno with a pair of perky wolf-ears towering over her pale, almost human face, has a cock-sure grin a mile wide, moving with a tactical precision that just screams military."

rows.original: Turning your eyes toward the screen, you’re just in time to see the wasp-man’s character leap from cover and charge into a hail of lasers and bullets; the crowd yells out a deafening cheer as his avatar rifle-butts another player, perfectly mimicking the Zil’s own motions. He thrusts his fist in the air, grabbing a beer from someone and knocking it back in one go. “Not so cocksure now, Syri?”
rows.translation: 你将目光转向屏幕，恰好看见黄蜂男的角色从掩体后一跃而出，冒着激光与子弹的密集火力发起冲锋；他的虚拟形象用枪托击中另一名玩家时，人群爆发出震耳欲聋的欢呼，动作与兹尔本人完全一致。他将拳头举向空中，从别人手里抓过一杯啤酒，一口灌下。“现在没那么自信了吧，希莉？”
rows.raw: "\n\nTurning your eyes toward the screen, you’re just in time to see the wasp-man’s character leap from cover and charge into a hail of lasers and bullets; the crowd yells out a deafening cheer as his avatar rifle-butts another player, perfectly mimicking the Zil’s own motions. He thrusts his fist in the air, grabbing a beer from someone and knocking it back in one go. “Not so cocksure now, Syri?”"

rows.original: Most of the people around you join in, jeering at the ausar woman beside him.
rows.translation: 你身边的大多数人也加入进来，一同嘲弄他身旁的奥萨尔女人。
rows.raw: "\n\nMost of the people around you join in, jeering at the ausar woman beside him."

rows.original: Just as the Zil finishes speaking, the wolf-eared girl gives a predatory grin and squeezes the trigger on her holographic rifle. The Zil’s screen shudders violently and goes blood-red; the player himself cries out as some sort of feedback zaps him, nearly throwing him to the floor.
rows.translation: 兹尔刚说完，狼耳女孩便露出捕食者般的笑容，扣下全息步枪的扳机。兹尔的屏幕剧烈震动，变得一片血红；某种反馈电流击中了玩家本人，令他大叫出声，险些被掀翻在地。
rows.raw: "\n\nJust as the Zil finishes speaking, the wolf-eared girl gives a predatory grin and squeezes the trigger on her holographic rifle. The Zil’s screen shudders violently and goes blood-red; the player himself cries out as some sort of feedback zaps him, nearly throwing him to the floor."

rows.original: There’s a long moment of silence - the entire tavern seems frozen in place - before the crowd around you groans and starts shelling out credit chits. The ausar marksman just keeps on grinning as she ditches the holo-gear, pulling herself up onto the nearest table and grabbing a beer.
rows.translation: 一阵漫长的寂静降临 - 整座酒馆似乎都凝固在原地 - 随后你周围的人群呻吟起来，开始掏出信用筹码。奥萨尔神射手仍在咧嘴笑着；她脱下全息装备，爬上最近的桌子，抓起一杯啤酒。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a long moment of silence - the entire tavern seems frozen in place - before the crowd around you groans and starts shelling out credit chits. The ausar marksman just keeps on grinning as she ditches the holo-gear, pulling herself up onto the nearest table and grabbing a beer."

rows.original: “Better luck next time, Jin,” she laughs, waving gaily as the burly bee stalks out of the tavern quite a few credits shorter.
rows.translation: “下次好运，金，”她笑着说道，愉快地挥了挥手；那个壮硕的蜂人输了不少信用点，怒气冲冲地走出酒馆。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Better luck next time, Jin,” she laughs, waving gaily as the burly bee stalks out of the tavern quite a few credits shorter."

rows.original: “Oh, what’s this? Fresh meat for the grinder?” she laughs, eyeing you. “What do you say, stranger, care to test your skill? One on one matches, three kills to win. Maybe for a little wager...”
rows.translation: “哦，这是什么？送进绞肉机的新鲜肉块？”她打量着你笑道。“怎么样，陌生人，要来试试身手吗？一对一，先拿到三次击杀的人获胜。也许还能下点小赌注...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, what’s this? Fresh meat for the grinder?” she laughs, eyeing you. “What do you say, stranger, care to test your skill? One on one matches, three kills to win. Maybe for a little wager...”"

rows.original: “The name’s Syri. Best shot in this dump - at least as far as video games go, anyway. Well come on then, step on up and grab a rig. Let’s see what you’re made out of...”
rows.translation: “我叫希莉。这里枪法最好的人 - 至少在电子游戏方面是这样。好了，来吧，上前拿一套设备。让我看看你有什么本事...”

rows.original: Nearly an hour passes in the game. The graphics are photo-realistic, the controls tight and precise. Every movement you make is perfectly mirrored in the game. The map is huge, and your character is slow. It’s a maze, and soon you realize it’s less skill in battle, here, than skill at the hunt. Just finding Syri in the ruined city map that the game has you in is challenging, and every time you think you’ve got her, she darts away. Finally, you slay her, putting a bullet between her avatar’s eyes. The audience cheers, and more and more people gather as they realize you’ve got skill.
rows.translation: 游戏进行了将近一个小时。画面如照片般逼真，操作紧凑而精准。你的每一个动作都会在游戏中得到完美映射。地图非常庞大，而角色移动缓慢。这里如同迷宫，你很快意识到，较量的重点与其说是战斗技巧，不如说是狩猎本领。光是在游戏将你置身其中的废墟城市地图里找到希莉就颇具挑战，每次你以为抓住了她，她都会迅速逃开。终于，你杀死了她，一颗子弹射进她虚拟形象的眉心。观众欢呼起来，越来越多的人意识到你身手不凡，纷纷围拢过来。
rows.raw: "Nearly an hour passes in the game. The graphics are photo-realistic, the controls tight and precise. Every movement you make is perfectly mirrored in the game. The map is huge, and your character is slow. It’s a maze, and soon you realize it’s less skill in battle, here, than skill at the hunt. Just finding Syri in the ruined city map that the game has you in is challenging, and every time you think you’ve got her, she darts away. Finally, you slay her, putting a bullet between her avatar’s eyes. The audience cheers, and more and more people gather as they realize you’ve got skill."

rows.original: A moment later, though, your screen blacks out as a grenade blasts near you. The holo-harness buzzes, giving you a nasty jolt that leaves your teeth chattering. Respawn. You move stealthily, creeping across the ruins at a snail’s pace. Shots are exchanged. You both retreat, licking your virtual wounds. You creep forward, cautiously taking the long road around the map, moving at a snail’s pace. Tensions run high; the audience is at the edge of their seats. You think you catch sight of your opponent, moving away from you. You slip into a building, move to higher ground. Looking down the rifle’s scope, you scan the rubble, looking for even the slightest movement.
rows.translation: 然而片刻之后，一枚手榴弹在你附近爆炸，屏幕顿时黑了下来。全息体感带嗡嗡作响，给了你一记猛烈电击，震得你牙齿打颤。重生。你隐秘地行动，以蜗牛般的速度爬过废墟。双方交火，又各自撤退，舔舐虚拟伤口。你谨慎前进，绕着地图走远路，仍以蜗牛般的速度移动。气氛高度紧张，观众们都屏息凝神。你觉得自己瞥见了对手的身影，正背对着你离开。你溜进一栋建筑，占据高处。你透过步枪瞄准镜向下观察，扫视着瓦砾，寻找哪怕最细微的动静。
rows.raw: "\n\nA moment later, though, your screen blacks out as a grenade blasts near you. The holo-harness buzzes, giving you a nasty jolt that leaves your teeth chattering. Respawn. You move stealthily, creeping across the ruins at a snail’s pace. Shots are exchanged. You both retreat, licking your virtual wounds. You creep forward, cautiously taking the long road around the map, moving at a snail’s pace. Tensions run high; the audience is at the edge of their seats. You think you catch sight of your opponent, moving away from you. You slip into a building, move to higher ground. Looking down the rifle’s scope, you scan the rubble, looking for even the slightest movement."

rows.original: Then you see her: crouched behind a burned-out hover car, waiting in ambush for you. You grin as you calmly take aim, putting your crosshair right over the virtual ausar’s avatar before pulling the trigger. Syri yelps as her rig zaps her in time with the bullet blasting her character’s head off.
