rows.original: Syri pumps her fist in the air and drops her tablet on the table. “Fuck yeah, that feels good. And good to see you, too,” she adds, leaning over the table to give you a kiss on the cheek. “So, finally got the time for that talk?”
rows.translation: 希莉向空中挥舞拳头，把平板电脑丢到桌上。“操，爽爆了。见到你也很高兴，”她补充道，探过桌面亲了亲你的脸颊。“所以，你终于有时间谈那件事了？”
rows.raw: "\n\nSyri pumps her fist in the air and drops her tablet on the table. “Fuck yeah, that feels good. And good to see you, too,” she adds, leaning over the table to give you a kiss on the cheek. “So, finally got the time for that talk?”"

rows.original: Yes
rows.translation: 是
rows.raw: "Yes"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Sure,” you tell her. “What’s on your mind?”
rows.translation: “当然，”你告诉她。“你在想什么？”
rows.raw: "“Sure,” you tell her. “What’s on your mind?”"

rows.original: “It would be better if we talk somewhere private,” Syri says, glancing around nervously. “Can we go up to your ship?”
rows.translation: “我们最好找个私密的地方谈，”希莉不安地环顾四周，说道。“能去你的飞船上吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It would be better if we talk somewhere private,” Syri says, glancing around nervously. “Can we go up to your ship?”"

rows.original: It’s a bit of a walk, but that makes her more comfortable, you can’t see why not...
rows.translation: 虽说要走上一段路，但那样能让她更自在，你也想不出有什么理由拒绝...
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s a bit of a walk, but that makes her more comfortable, you can’t see why not..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Yes
rows.translation: 是
rows.raw: "Yes"

rows.original: Let’s have that conversation now.
rows.translation: 现在就谈谈那件事。
rows.raw: "Let’s have that conversation now."

rows.original: Not Yet
rows.translation: 暂时不要
rows.raw: "Not Yet"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Soon,” you say. “I just wanted to stop by.”
rows.translation: “很快，”你说道。“我只是想顺路来看看。”
rows.raw: "“Soon,” you say. “I just wanted to stop by.”"

rows.original: Syri pouts and crosses her arms. “Okay, okay. Just don’t take too long, okay? It’s really important to me.”
rows.translation: 希莉撅起嘴，双臂抱胸。“好吧，好吧。只是别拖得太久，好吗？这对我真的很重要。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSyri pouts and crosses her arms. “Okay, okay. Just don’t take too long, okay? It’s really important to me.”"

rows.original: You share a drink with your lover, making a bit of small talk before you have to head back out.
rows.translation: 你陪恋人喝了一杯，闲聊片刻，随后便不得不重新出发。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou share a drink with your lover, making a bit of small talk before you have to head back out."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Not Yet
rows.translation: 暂时不要
rows.raw: "Not Yet"

rows.original: Soon, Syri.
rows.translation: 很快，希莉。
rows.raw: "Soon, Syri."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Steele! Hey!” Syri calls, waving as you approach. “There you are! I’ve got everything set up with the contractors. Hope you’re ready for a job interview.”
rows.translation: “斯蒂尔！嘿！”你走近时，希莉挥手喊道。“你终于来了！我已经和承包商把一切都安排妥当了。希望你准备好参加工作面试。”
rows.raw: "“Steele! Hey!” Syri calls, waving as you approach. “There you are! I’ve got everything set up with the contractors. Hope you’re ready for a job interview.”"

rows.original: Syri grins and plants her hands on her hips. “So the best way I could figure to get you inside the company’s office was to set up a job interview. It’s an excuse to get inside long enough for me to sneak you into one of the containers we’re taking up to the research complex.”
rows.translation: 希莉咧嘴一笑，双手叉腰。“我能想到让你进入公司办公室的最好办法，就是安排一场工作面试。这样就有借口在里面待得够久，好让我把你偷偷塞进一个准备运往研究设施的集装箱。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSyri grins and plants her hands on her hips. “So the best way I could figure to get you inside the company’s office was to set up a job interview. It’s an excuse to get inside long enough for me to sneak you into one of the containers we’re taking up to the research complex.”"

rows.original: This can only end well. You tell Syri to lead on, falling in behind her sweeping tail as she guides you out into the searing cold of the planet’s surface. It’s a blessedly short walk through the narrow, snow-swept alleys between the squat Irestead homes and businesses west of the government building. Whether it’s for warmth or just companionship, Syri wraps an arm around your waist and pulls you against herself. She gives you a little smile, and you feel her tail curling around your [pc.leg].
rows.translation: 这肯定不会出任何问题。你让希莉带路，跟在她那条横扫摆动的尾巴后面，由她领着你踏入星球表面刺骨的严寒。所幸路程很短，你们穿过政府大楼以西、伊尔斯泰德低矮住宅与商铺之间狭窄而积雪纷飞的小巷。不知是为了取暖，还是单纯想要陪伴，希莉用一只手臂环住你的腰，把你拉到身旁。她朝你微微一笑，你感觉她的尾巴缠上了你的[pc.leg]。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis can only end well. You tell Syri to lead on, falling in behind her sweeping tail as she guides you out into the searing cold of the planet’s surface. It’s a blessedly short walk through the narrow, snow-swept alleys between the squat Irestead homes and businesses west of the government building. Whether it’s for warmth or just companionship, Syri wraps an arm around your waist and pulls you against herself. She gives you a little smile, and you feel her tail curling around your [pc.leg]."

rows.original: The contractor’s office is only a few blocks away, but
rows.translation: 承包商的办公室离这里只有几个街区，但
rows.raw: "\n\nThe contractor’s office is only a few blocks away, but "

rows.original: even with your heat belt
rows.translation: 即使戴着隔热腰带，
rows.raw: "even with your heat belt "

rows.original: you’re shivering all the same by the time you arrive at the steps leading up to a square, one-floor office. A flickering holographic sign reading ‘Haskarn’s Industrial Innovations, LLC’ sits above the door, alongside an animated image of a flexing, bearded huskar male with a hardhat and a toolbox in both hands.
rows.translation: 等你抵达通往一栋方正单层办公室的台阶时，还是冷得瑟瑟发抖。门上方悬着一块闪烁的全息招牌，写着‘哈斯卡恩工业创新有限责任公司’，旁边还有一幅动画图像：一名留着胡须、戴着安全帽的赫斯卡男性正鼓起肌肉，两只手各拿着一只工具箱。
rows.raw: "you’re shivering all the same by the time you arrive at the steps leading up to a square, one-floor office. A flickering holographic sign reading ‘Haskarn’s Industrial Innovations, LLC’ sits above the door, alongside an animated image of a flexing, bearded huskar male with a hardhat and a toolbox in both hands."

rows.original: Syri swipes an ID card across a reader next to the sliding glass-pane doors and ushers the both of you inside.
rows.translation: 希莉在滑动玻璃门旁的读卡器上刷过一张身份卡，引着你们俩走了进去。
rows.raw: "\n\n Syri swipes an ID card across a reader next to the sliding glass-pane doors and ushers the both of you inside."

rows.original: SIRETTA.SyriQuestUveto.AKD C21
rows.raw: "SIRETTA.SyriQuestUveto.AKD C21"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: There’s a dozen huskar inside, a mix of men and women all with hefty figures and ashen fur. They’re dressed in heavy winter gear and strapped with toolbelts and hardhats, just like the man pictured outside. Must be Syri’s coworkers, getting ready for the day’s work. Some of them look up and nod at Syri or give you questioning glances, but nobody says anything to either of you: they’re too engrossed in their own conversations, laughing and teasing while they prep for the trip outside.
rows.translation: 里面有十几个赫斯卡，男女都有，个个身材魁梧，长着灰白色毛发。他们穿着厚重的冬装，系着工具腰带，戴着安全帽，与外面照片中的男人一模一样。肯定是希莉的同事，正在为一天的工作做准备。其中一些人抬头朝希莉点点头，或向你投来疑惑的目光，但没人对你们说什么：他们都太专注于彼此的交谈，一边为外出做准备，一边有说有笑地互相打趣。
rows.raw: "There’s a dozen huskar inside, a mix of men and women all with hefty figures and ashen fur. They’re dressed in heavy winter gear and strapped with toolbelts and hardhats, just like the man pictured outside. Must be Syri’s coworkers, getting ready for the day’s work. Some of them look up and nod at Syri or give you questioning glances, but nobody says anything to either of you: they’re too engrossed in their own conversations, laughing and teasing while they prep for the trip outside."

rows.original: “C’mon, sapient resources is just over here,” Syri says, leading you down a hall off of the main entrance. At the end is another glass door, this time frosted over so that only vague shapes and shadows are visible on the other side.
rows.translation: “来吧，智慧生物资源部就在这边，”希莉说着，领你穿过主入口旁的一条走廊。尽头还有一扇玻璃门，但这次玻璃经过了磨砂处理，只能看见另一侧模糊的形状与影子。
rows.raw: "\n\n“C’mon, sapient resources is just over here,” Syri says, leading you down a hall off of the main entrance. At the end is another glass door, this time frosted over so that only vague shapes and shadows are visible on the other side."

rows.original: Your beautiful guide raps her fluffy knuckles on the metal frame, and is quickly answered by a voice from inside: “Come in!”
rows.translation: 你美丽的向导用毛茸茸的指节敲了敲金属门框，里面很快传来回应：“请进！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYour beautiful guide raps her fluffy knuckles on the metal frame, and is quickly answered by a voice from inside: “Come in!”"

rows.original: Syri slides the door open and gives you a gentle push into a small, warmly decorated little office with a comfortable-looking stuffed couch facing a desk that covered in little toys, smiling dolls, and a big bowl of candy. Sitting behind it is a particularly husky huskar woman, all plump curves and soft, plush pale flesh wrapped up in a white shirt that’s been buttoned down almost halfway to make room for the massive rack of cleavage all but spilling out. A bright pink tie plunges down into the abyss between her breasts, drawing your attention up to a mane of silver-gray fur around her neck, beneath a rosy-cheeked face that’s smiling wide at you.
rows.translation: 希莉滑开门，轻轻推了你一把，把你送进一间温馨装饰的小办公室。里面有张看起来十分舒适的软沙发，正对着一张桌子；桌面上摆满小玩具、微笑的玩偶，还有一大碗糖果。桌后坐着一名格外壮硕的赫斯卡女人，丰满的曲线与柔软丰腴的浅色肉体都裹在一件白衬衫里。为了容纳几乎要喷薄而出的硕大乳沟，衬衫纽扣解开了将近一半。一条亮粉色领带垂入双乳之间的深渊，将你的视线向上引至她颈边银灰色的鬃毛，以及那张双颊红润、正对你灿烂微笑的脸。
rows.raw: "\n\nSyri slides the door open and gives you a gentle push into a small, warmly decorated little office with a comfortable-looking stuffed couch facing a desk that covered in little toys, smiling dolls, and a big bowl of candy. Sitting behind it is a particularly husky huskar woman, all plump curves and soft, plush pale flesh wrapped up in a white shirt that’s been buttoned down almost halfway to make room for the massive rack of cleavage all but spilling out. A bright pink tie plunges down into the abyss between her breasts, drawing your attention up to a mane of silver-gray fur around her neck, beneath a rosy-cheeked face that’s smiling wide at you."

rows.original: “Hello Ms. Dorna!” the huskar chirps cheerfully, deactivating a small holoterminal and folding her hands on her desk. “And you must be [pc.name]. Welcome to Haskarn’s Industrial Innovations. I’m Myrra, and I heard you were looking for a job.”
rows.translation: “多尔娜女士，你好！”赫斯卡女人欢快地说道，同时关闭一台小型全息终端，将双手交叠放在桌上。“你一定就是[pc.name]。欢迎来到哈斯卡恩工业创新公司。我叫米拉，听说你正在找工作。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hello Ms. Dorna!” the huskar chirps cheerfully, deactivating a small holoterminal and folding her hands on her desk. “And you must be [pc.name]. Welcome to Haskarn’s Industrial Innovations. I’m Myrra, and I heard you were looking for a job.”"

rows.original: <i>“Uh, yeah, sure. Why not?
rows.translation: <i>“呃，好啊，当然。为什么不呢？
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Uh, yeah, sure. Why not?"

rows.original: <i>“Sure, whatever,
rows.translation: <i>“当然，随便吧，
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Sure, whatever,"

rows.original: <i>“Yes ma’am,
rows.translation: <i>“是的，女士，
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Yes ma’am,"

rows.original: ” you say,
rows.translation: ”你说道，
rows.raw: "” you say, "

rows.original: swinging yourself onto the couch across from her.
rows.translation: 纵身坐到她对面的沙发上。
rows.raw: "swinging yourself onto the couch across from her."

rows.original: planting yourself on the ground across the desk.
rows.translation: 在桌子对面的地面上站定。
rows.raw: "planting yourself on the ground across the desk."

rows.original: Syri takes a seat behind you, reclining back with her legs crossed and trying to look relaxed. She almost does a good job of it, save for the occasional nervous glance.
rows.translation: 希莉在你身后坐下，跷起双腿向后靠去，努力装出放松的样子。若不是偶尔紧张地瞥上一眼，她几乎就装成功了。
rows.raw: " Syri takes a seat behind you, reclining back with her legs crossed and trying to look relaxed. She almost does a good job of it, save for the occasional nervous glance."

rows.original: Myrra smiles and taps a button on her desk, bringing up another holodisplay. “We’re just gonna do a short lil’ interview. Don’t worry about a thing, darlin’, I just need to know a lil’ bit about you and your qualifications before we put you to work. Ms. Dorna here’s vouched for you, after all, so I won’t give you too much trouble. Though she didn’t mention you were so cute!”
rows.translation: 米拉微笑着按下桌上的一个按钮，调出另一块全息显示屏。“我们只进行一次简短的小面试。别担心，亲爱的，我只需要稍微了解一下你和你的资历，就可以安排你工作了。毕竟这里的多尔娜女士已经为你担保，所以我不会给你添太多麻烦。不过她可没提过你这么可爱！”
rows.raw: "\n\nMyrra smiles and taps a button on her desk, bringing up another holodisplay. “We’re just gonna do a short lil’ interview. Don’t worry about a thing, darlin’, I just need to know a lil’ bit about you and your qualifications before we put you to work. Ms. Dorna here’s vouched for you, after all, so I won’t give you too much trouble. Though she didn’t mention you were so cute!”"

rows.original: The huskar giggles and brings up a form on her terminal. “Okay. First up: what’s your experience with heavy machinery?”
rows.translation: 赫斯卡女人咯咯一笑，在终端上调出一张表格。“好了。第一个问题：你有多少操作重型机械的经验？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe huskar giggles and brings up a form on her terminal. “Okay. First up: what’s your experience with heavy machinery?”"

rows.original: “I like, handle big tools all the time!”
rows.translation: “我可是经常摆弄大型工具的！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I like, handle big tools all the time!”"

rows.original: “I pack big, heavy tools every day, baby.”
rows.translation: “宝贝，我每天都带着又大又重的工具。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I pack big, heavy tools every day, baby.”"

rows.original: You quickly run down all the various machines and industrial equipment you’re certified with. It’s a long list.
rows.translation: 你迅速列举了自己拥有操作资格的各种机械与工业设备。清单相当长。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou quickly run down all the various machines and industrial equipment you’re certified with. It’s a long list."

rows.original: “Uh, lots?” you lie.
rows.translation: “呃，很多？”你撒谎道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uh, lots?” you lie."

rows.original: “Great!” Myrra chirps. “Have you ever worked in extreme climates before? As you can probably tell, working out in the Uvetan glaciers is pretty risky business without training and experience.”
rows.translation: “太好了！”米拉欢快地说。“你以前在极端气候中工作过吗？你大概也看得出来，要是没有训练和经验，在乌维托的冰川上工作可是件相当危险的事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Great!” Myrra chirps. “Have you ever worked in extreme climates before? As you can probably tell, working out in the Uvetan glaciers is pretty risky business without training and experience.”"

rows.original: “Oh, I like risky business!” you giggle.
rows.translation: “哦，我喜欢冒险！”你咯咯笑道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, I like risky business!” you giggle."

rows.original: “I’ve got plenty of experience, baby.”
rows.translation: “人家可是经验丰富，宝贝。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ve got plenty of experience, baby.”"

rows.original: You spend a moment describing some of the places you’ve had to adventure so far -- that might not be construction experience, but you’ve been in all sorts of conditions.
rows.translation: 你花了片刻描述自己迄今冒险去过的一些地方 -- 那或许算不上施工经验，但你经历过各种各样的环境。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou spend a moment describing some of the places you’ve had to adventure so far -- that might not be construction experience, but you’ve been in all sorts of conditions."

rows.original: Myrra nods, typing. “Okay, that’s good to hear. Um, let’s see, I guess we’ll give you a pass on the qualifications. Now let’s talk about your career here at Haskarn’s!”
rows.translation: 米拉点点头，一边打字。“好的，很高兴听你这么说。嗯，让我看看，我想我们可以放宽你的资历要求。现在来谈谈你在哈斯卡恩这里的职业生涯吧！”
rows.raw: "\n\nMyrra nods, typing. “Okay, that’s good to hear. Um, let’s see, I guess we’ll give you a pass on the qualifications. Now let’s talk about your career here at Haskarn’s!”"

rows.original: The perky huskar scoots forward in her chair, a gesture that makes those massive sweater-puppies quake under her blouse. She must have caught your inevitable glances that way, because she smiles demurely and wags her tail. “So... where do you see yourself in 5 years, [pc.name]?”
rows.translation: 活泼的赫斯卡在椅子上向前挪了挪，这个动作让她衬衫下那对硕大的毛衣奶子一阵颤动。她肯定注意到了你无可避免地投去的目光，因为她矜持地微笑着，摇了摇尾巴。“那么... [pc.name]，你觉得5年后的自己会是什么样？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe perky huskar scoots forward in her chair, a gesture that makes those massive sweater-puppies quake under her blouse. She must have caught your inevitable glances that way, because she smiles demurely and wags her tail. “So... where do you see yourself in 5 years, [pc.name]?”"

rows.original: With your face between those tits would sure be nice...
rows.translation: 要是能把脸埋在那对奶子中间，肯定很不错...
rows.raw: "\n\nWith your face between those tits would sure be nice..."

rows.original: There’s some places you’d like to be...
rows.translation: 你确实有几个想去的位置...
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s some places you’d like to be..."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Some time, a little more hands-on interviewing, and one completed application later...
rows.translation: 一段时间、一次更注重动手实践的面试，以及一份填写完成的申请表之后...
rows.raw: "Some time, a little more hands-on interviewing, and one completed application later..."

rows.original: “Alrighty,” Myrra sighs, wiping a little sweat off her brow. “That’s all taken care of. Consider yourself employed. If you want to go down to the landing pad, you can ask your shift supervisor about starting today. Otherwise, we’ll see you at the start of the week, [pc.name]. And as for you, Ms. Dorna... I’ll see you in my office when you get back from your shift.”
rows.translation: “好啦，”米拉叹息着，擦去额头上的一点汗水。“全都处理好了。你现在已经被录用了。如果你想去停机坪，可以问问轮班主管今天能否开始工作。否则，我们周初见，[pc.name]。至于你，多尔娜女士... 等你下班回来后，到我的办公室来见我。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alrighty,” Myrra sighs, wiping a little sweat off her brow. “That’s all taken care of. Consider yourself employed. If you want to go down to the landing pad, you can ask your shift supervisor about starting today. Otherwise, we’ll see you at the start of the week, [pc.name]. And as for you, Ms. Dorna... I’ll see you in my office when you get back from your shift.”"

rows.original: Syri grins. “Yes ma’am.”
rows.translation: 希莉咧嘴一笑。“是，女士。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSyri grins. “Yes ma’am.”"

rows.original: The two of you stagger out of the H.R. office, still adjusting your clothes and gear.
rows.translation: 你们两人踉跄着走出H.R.办公室，仍在整理自己的衣服与装备。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of you stagger out of the H.R. office, still adjusting your clothes and gear."

rows.original: “Well that went better than expected,” your lover laughs, running a hand through the tangled mess her raven hair’s become. “Ah man, I need to take you places more often. You’re a fun magnet... and a smoking hot intergalactic sex symbol who’s absolutely irresistible to all us ausar girls.”
rows.translation: “这可比预想中顺利，”你的情人笑着说道，一只手梳过已经乱成一团的乌黑头发。“啊，天哪，我以后得更常带你去各种地方。你简直是乐子的磁铁... 还是个性感火辣、让我们所有奥萨尔姑娘都无法抗拒的星际性爱偶像。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well that went better than expected,” your lover laughs, running a hand through the tangled mess her raven hair’s become. “Ah man, I need to take you places more often. You’re a fun magnet... and a smoking hot intergalactic sex symbol who’s absolutely irresistible to all us ausar girls.”"

rows.original: She’s laughing, but at the rate you’re going...
rows.translation: 她是在开玩笑，但照你现在这个势头...
rows.raw: "\n\nShe’s laughing, but at the rate you’re going..."

rows.original: Syri puts an arm around your shoulders and leads you deeper into the building. “The hovercraft bay is just down here. Now I need you to make yourself scarce pretty much as soon as we get inside. Myrra put you in the system, so we won’t be triggering any biometric alarms... but it’ll be better if nobody notices you come in, and never come out, y’know?”
rows.translation: 希莉搂住你的肩膀，领着你继续深入建筑内部。“气垫船机库就在这边。我们一进去，你基本上就得马上藏起来。米拉已经把你录进系统，所以我们不会触发生物识别警报... 不过最好还是别让任何人注意到你进去了，却始终没出来，明白吧？”
rows.raw: "Syri puts an arm around your shoulders and leads you deeper into the building. “The hovercraft bay is just down here. Now I need you to make yourself scarce pretty much as soon as we get inside. Myrra put you in the system, so we won’t be triggering any biometric alarms... but it’ll be better if nobody notices you come in, and never come out, y’know?”"

rows.original: You nod.
rows.translation: 你点点头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod."

rows.original: “Alright! Let’s get out there, then.”
rows.translation: “好！那我们出发吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright! Let’s get out there, then.”"

rows.original: AKD C23
rows.raw: "AKD C23"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: The room Syri leads you to next is a massive subterranean hangar at the bottom of a flight of stairs. A heavy-duty cargo hovercraft is parked in the middle with doors folded up under its wings, revealing a cargo bay stuffed full of crates and containers. Most of the workers you saw on your way in have migrated down to the launch pad, helping to load the hovercraft up in preparation for the day’s work.
rows.translation: 希莉接着带你来到的房间，是一座位于一段楼梯底部的巨型地下机库。一艘重型货运气垫船停在中央，舱门折叠在两翼下方，露出塞满板条箱和集装箱的货舱。你进来时看到的大多数工人都已经转移到发射平台，正帮忙装载气垫船，为当天的工作做准备。
rows.raw: "The room Syri leads you to next is a massive subterranean hangar at the bottom of a flight of stairs. A heavy-duty cargo hovercraft is parked in the middle with doors folded up under its wings, revealing a cargo bay stuffed full of crates and containers. Most of the workers you saw on your way in have migrated down to the launch pad, helping to load the hovercraft up in preparation for the day’s work."

rows.original: A particularly muscular, bearded huskar is snapping orders between glances at a dataslate in his gold-furred hands. Must be the supervisor you were told about... and who you need to avoid for Syri’s half-baked plan to work.
rows.translation: 一个肌肉格外发达、蓄着胡须的赫斯卡，一边扫视金色毛掌中的数据板，一边大声下达命令。那肯定就是你听说过的主管... 而若要让希莉那不成熟的计划奏效，你必须避开他。
rows.raw: "\n\nA particularly muscular, bearded huskar is snapping orders between glances at a dataslate in his gold-furred hands. Must be the supervisor you were told about... and who you need to avoid for Syri’s half-baked plan to work."

rows.original: Wondering how you let yourself be talked into this (and not for the first time), you duck out from behind Syri and into the shadows behind one of the containers waiting to go aboard.
rows.translation: 你纳闷自己怎么又一次被说动来干这种事，随后从希莉身后闪开，躲进一只等待装船的集装箱后方阴影里。
rows.raw: "\n\nWondering how you let yourself be talked into this (and not for the first time), you duck out from behind Syri and into the shadows behind one of the containers waiting to go aboard."

rows.original: While you make yourself scarce, Syri saunters up to her super with a smile and a wag of her tail. “Hey boss! What’s the good word?”
rows.translation: 趁你藏起身形时，希莉面带微笑、摇着尾巴，悠然走向她的主管。“嘿，老板！有什么好消息？”
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile you make yourself scarce, Syri saunters up to her super with a smile and a wag of her tail. “Hey boss! What’s the good word?”"

rows.original: “Syri, glad you could join us,” the blonde huskar says, clapping her shoulder. “Where’s our newest recruit? I thought [pc.heShe]’d be joining us.”
rows.translation: “希莉，很高兴你能加入我们，”金发赫斯卡人拍着她的肩膀说道。“我们的新成员呢？我还以为[pc.heShe]会和我们一起去。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Syri, glad you could join us,” the blonde huskar says, clapping her shoulder. “Where’s our newest recruit? I thought [pc.heShe]’d be joining us.”"

rows.original: “Nah,” Syri lies. “[pc.HeShe]’s just taking a look around the facility before heading home. I think [pc.heShe] said [pc.heShe]’d like to start working at week’s start. Keep things simple on the payroll.”
rows.translation: “没呢，”希莉撒谎道。“[pc.HeShe]只是先参观一下设施，然后就回家。我记得[pc.heShe]说过，[pc.heShe]想等下周开始时再来上班。这样发工资也简单点。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nah,” Syri lies. “[pc.HeShe]’s just taking a look around the facility before heading home. I think [pc.heShe] said [pc.heShe]’d like to start working at week’s start. Keep things simple on the payroll.”"

rows.original: The supervisor laughs heartily. “I like [pc.himHer] already! Alright, go help Auder move that fabricator aboard, eh?”
rows.translation: 主管爽朗地笑了起来。“我已经开始喜欢[pc.himHer]了！好了，去帮奥德把那台制造机搬上船，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe supervisor laughs heartily. “I like [pc.himHer] already! Alright, go help Auder move that fabricator aboard, eh?”"

rows.original: The two move off towards the other side of the hangar, giving you a few moments with nobody looking to decide what you’re going to do about disappearing...
rows.translation: 两人朝机库另一边走去，暂时没人看着你，让你有片刻时间决定该怎么神不知鬼不觉地消失...
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two move off towards the other side of the hangar, giving you a few moments with nobody looking to decide what you’re going to do about disappearing..."

rows.original: There’s several containers all around the place, but most of them are magnetically locked.
rows.translation: 这里到处都有货柜，但其中大多数都被磁力锁锁住了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s several containers all around the place, but most of them are magnetically locked."

rows.original: SIRETTA.SyriQuestUveto.AKD C25
rows.raw: "SIRETTA.SyriQuestUveto.AKD C25"

rows.original: Stealth Field Generator
rows.raw: "Stealth Field Generator"

rows.original: Stealth Field
rows.translation: 隐形场
rows.raw: "Stealth Field"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Well, this’ll be easy. You click on your stealth field generator and shimmer out of sight, blending into the shadows. While you’re hidden from view, you quickly make your way across the hangar and duck into the cargo hold underneath the hovercraft’s main fuselage. The next few minutes are spent being very quiet as you’re all but entombed behind other crates and containers, boxing you in until you have to curl up on yourself to fit.
rows.translation: 这下简单了。你启动隐形场发生器，身影一阵闪烁后消失不见，融入阴影之中。趁自己隐匿无踪，你迅速穿过机库，钻进悬浮艇主船身下方的货舱。接下来的几分钟里，你只能屏息静气；其他板条箱和货柜几乎把你活埋在后面，将你挤在狭小空间里，逼得你不得不蜷缩身体才能容身。
rows.raw: "Well, this’ll be easy. You click on your stealth field generator and shimmer out of sight, blending into the shadows. While you’re hidden from view, you quickly make your way across the hangar and duck into the cargo hold underneath the hovercraft’s main fuselage. The next few minutes are spent being very quiet as you’re all but entombed behind other crates and containers, boxing you in until you have to curl up on yourself to fit."

rows.original: But you’ve gone undetected! You let out a long-held breath and press your eye to one of the gaps between the containers, watching the remaining workers file aboard. They have the luxury of a warm trip inside the passenger deck, and seem all too happy to get inside. You count Syri among their number, trying to act natural. The supervisor is the last man aboard, reaching up to pull down the bay doors.
rows.translation: 不过你没有被发现！你吐出憋了许久的一口气，把眼睛凑到货柜间的一道缝隙前，看着剩余的工人鱼贯登船。他们有幸可以待在温暖的客舱里度过旅程，看起来也都迫不及待地想进去。你看到希莉也混在其中，努力表现得若无其事。主管是最后一个登船的人，他伸手准备拉下货舱门。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut you’ve gone undetected! You let out a long-held breath and press your eye to one of the gaps between the containers, watching the remaining workers file aboard. They have the luxury of a warm trip inside the passenger deck, and seem all too happy to get inside. You count Syri among their number, trying to act natural. The supervisor is the last man aboard, reaching up to pull down the bay doors."

rows.original: Just as he’s about to close up, though, you hear a woman’s voice from outside: “Hold up!”
rows.translation: 可就在他即将关门时，你听见外面传来一个女人的声音：“等一下！”
rows.raw: "\n\nJust as he’s about to close up, though, you hear a woman’s voice from outside: “Hold up!”"

rows.original: It’s a strong, booming voice. Loud and commanding. The blonde huskar pauses mid-motion, giving time for the speaker to step aboard. She’s a tall, full-figured woman zipped up in a skin-tight blue Akkadi jumpsuit that flatters her ample curves in all the right ways. T
rows.translation: 那声音洪亮有力，威严十足。金发赫斯卡人的动作停在半途，让说话者有时间登船。她身材高挑而丰满，穿着一件紧身蓝色阿卡迪连体服，恰到好处地勾勒出她丰腴的曲线。这
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s a strong, booming voice. Loud and commanding. The blonde huskar pauses mid-motion, giving time for the speaker to step aboard. She’s a tall, full-figured woman zipped up in a skin-tight blue Akkadi jumpsuit that flatters her ample curves in all the right ways. T"

rows.original: he woman’s also got a pair of sweeping black horns growing from her brow, as well as bronzed skin and dark red eyes.
rows.translation: 个女人的额头还长着一对向后弯曲的黑角，皮肤呈古铜色，双眼则是暗红色。
rows.raw: "he woman’s also got a pair of sweeping black horns growing from her brow, as well as bronzed skin and dark red eyes."

rows.original: “Room for one more?” the woman asks, hefting a bulging rucksack on her shoulder.
rows.translation: “还能再坐一个人吗？”女人问道，同时把鼓鼓囊囊的帆布背包扛到肩上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Room for one more?” the woman asks, hefting a bulging rucksack on her shoulder."

rows.original: “Of course, Commander,” the huskar man answers, stepping out of her way. “Climb aboard! Enjoy your vacation?”
rows.translation: “当然可以，指挥官，”赫斯卡男人回答道，侧身给她让路。“上来吧！假期过得愉快吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course, Commander,” the huskar man answers, stepping out of her way. “Climb aboard! Enjoy your vacation?”"

rows.original: The woman laughs. “It’s hard not to enjoy a week at a Heloith resort! After all those massages and all the pool time, I feel more loose and limber than I have in years.”
rows.translation: 女人笑了起来。“在海洛伊斯的度假村待上一周，想过得不开心都难！做了那么多次按摩，又在泳池里泡了那么久，我感觉身体比过去几年里的任何时候都更加放松灵活。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman laughs. “It’s hard not to enjoy a week at a Heloith resort! After all those massages and all the pool time, I feel more loose and limber than I have in years.”"

rows.original: “Oh, is that all that’s put a spring in your step?” he teases, pulling the door closed behind the ‘commander.’
rows.translation: “哦，让你这么神采奕奕的就只有这些吗？”他打趣道，随手关上那位‘指挥官’身后的舱门。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, is that all that’s put a spring in your step?” he teases, pulling the door closed behind the ‘commander.’"

rows.original: She grins and chunks her duffle bag down on the deck. “Well, all the handsome tourists treating me like a piece of the local meat didn’t hurt, either. Perks of being half-dzaan!”
rows.translation: 她咧嘴一笑，把旅行袋重重扔到甲板上。“嗯，那些英俊的游客把我当成本地的一块鲜肉，也确实让人挺开心。身为半个德赞人的好处！”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe grins and chunks her duffle bag down on the deck. “Well, all the handsome tourists treating me like a piece of the local meat didn’t hurt, either. Perks of being half-dzaan!”"

rows.original: That seems to trigger some kind of in-joke, and both the commander and supervisor laugh on their way up the stairs to the passenger deck. Now that everyone’s out of earshot, you sigh and sit down, feeling the deck start to rumble underneath you. It isn’t much longer before the temperature starts to drop, and you can feel the hovercraft start zooming through the stormy Uvetan skies...
rows.translation: 这似乎触发了某个只有他们才懂的笑点，指挥官与主管走上通往客舱的楼梯时都笑了起来。现在所有人都已离开听力范围，你叹了口气坐下来，感觉身下的甲板开始震动。没过多久，气温便开始下降，你也能感觉到悬浮艇正在乌维托风暴肆虐的天空中疾驰...
rows.raw: "\n\nThat seems to trigger some kind of in-joke, and both the commander and supervisor laugh on their way up the stairs to the passenger deck. Now that everyone’s out of earshot, you sigh and sit down, feeling the deck start to rumble underneath you. It isn’t much longer before the temperature starts to drop, and you can feel the hovercraft start zooming through the stormy Uvetan skies..."

rows.raw: "SIRETTA.SyriQuestUvetoHovercraft.AKD C27"

rows.translation: 你蹲到其中一把电子锁旁，开始摆弄起来。所有人的注意力转向你之前，你只有几秒钟可以动手 -- 足够完成
rows.raw: "You crouch down next to one of the electronic locks and start fiddling around. You’ve only got a few seconds to work before everyone’s attention turns to you -- enough for "

rows.translation: 次重新接线。
rows.raw: " rewires."

rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: It takes you the barest few seconds to penetrate the lock’s security, and you’re just able to scarper inside the container and close the door behind you before anyone comes back your way. Letting out a sigh of relief, you look around your new surroundings: you’ve got a few feet of room to move around, wedged between the metal doors and several pallets full of metal plates all strapped together.
rows.translation: 你只花了短短几秒便突破门锁的安全系统，赶在有人返回附近之前溜进货柜，并关上身后的门。你如释重负地叹了口气，环顾新的藏身处：金属门与几托盘捆扎在一起的金属板之间，留有几英尺的活动空间。
rows.raw: "It takes you the barest few seconds to penetrate the lock’s security, and you’re just able to scarper inside the container and close the door behind you before anyone comes back your way. Letting out a sigh of relief, you look around your new surroundings: you’ve got a few feet of room to move around, wedged between the metal doors and several pallets full of metal plates all strapped together."

rows.original: You’re about to sit down when you hear several footfalls pass by outside. Must be the crew coming aboard. Once they’ve retreated out of earshot, and you feel the hovercraft start to rumble under your [pc.feet]. You risk the chance to slide the container door open a hair’s breadth. Peeking out, you’re treated to the sight of the supervisor, apparently the last man aboard, reaching up to pull down the bay doors.
rows.translation: 你正要坐下，便听见几阵脚步声从外面经过。一定是船员们正在登车。等他们退到听不见的地方，悬浮艇也开始在你的[pc.feet]下方隆隆震动。你冒险将货柜门推开一道头发丝宽的缝隙。向外窥视，只见主管似乎是最后一个登车的人，正伸手准备拉下货舱门。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re about to sit down when you hear several footfalls pass by outside. Must be the crew coming aboard. Once they’ve retreated out of earshot, and you feel the hovercraft start to rumble under your [pc.feet]. You risk the chance to slide the container door open a hair’s breadth. Peeking out, you’re treated to the sight of the supervisor, apparently the last man aboard, reaching up to pull down the bay doors."

rows.original: Just as he’s about to close up, though, you hear a woman’s voice from outside: “Hold up!”
rows.translation: 然而，就在他即将关门时，你听见外面传来一个女人的声音：“等一下！”
rows.raw: "\n\nJust as he’s about to close up, though, you hear a woman’s voice from outside: “Hold up!”"

rows.original: It’s a strong, booming voice. Loud and commanding. The blonde huskar pauses mid-motion, giving time for the speaker to step aboard. She’s a tall, full-figured woman zipped up in a skin-tight blue Akkadi jumpsuit that flatters her ample curves in all the right ways. Though she’s got the perky pointed ears, the woman’s also got a pair of sweeping black horns growing from her brow, as well as bronzed skin and dark red eyes. Definitely not a huskar... looks more like a dzaan. Maybe a halfbreed?
rows.translation: 那声音强劲洪亮，充满威严。金发赫斯卡的动作停在半途，让说话者有时间登上悬浮艇。她是个身材高挑、体态丰满的女人，穿着一件紧身蓝色阿卡迪连身服，恰到好处地衬托出丰腴曲线。她虽然长着挺翘的尖耳朵，额头却还生有一对向后弯曲的黑角，皮肤呈古铜色，双眼则是暗红色。肯定不是赫斯卡...看起来更像德赞。也许是混血儿？
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s a strong, booming voice. Loud and commanding. The blonde huskar pauses mid-motion, giving time for the speaker to step aboard. She’s a tall, full-figured woman zipped up in a skin-tight blue Akkadi jumpsuit that flatters her ample curves in all the right ways. Though she’s got the perky pointed ears, the woman’s also got a pair of sweeping black horns growing from her brow, as well as bronzed skin and dark red eyes. Definitely not a huskar... looks more like a dzaan. Maybe a halfbreed?"

rows.original: “Room for one more?” the woman asks, hefting a bulging rucksack on her shoulder.
rows.translation: “还能再挤下一个人吗？”女人将鼓鼓囊囊的帆布背包扛上肩头，开口问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Room for one more?” the woman asks, hefting a bulging rucksack on her shoulder."

rows.original: “Of course, Commander,” the huskar man answers, stepping out of her way. “Climb aboard! Enjoy your vacation?”
rows.translation: “当然可以，指挥官，”赫斯卡男人回答着让到一旁。“请上车！假期过得开心吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course, Commander,” the huskar man answers, stepping out of her way. “Climb aboard! Enjoy your vacation?”"

rows.original: The woman laughs. “It’s hard not to enjoy a week at a Heloith resort! After all those massages and all the pool time, I feel more loose and limber than I have in years.”
rows.translation: 女人笑了。“在海洛伊斯的度假村住上一星期，想不开心都难！享受了那么多按摩，又泡了那么久的泳池，我感觉身体比这些年来任何时候都更加放松灵活。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman laughs. “It’s hard not to enjoy a week at a Heloith resort! After all those massages and all the pool time, I feel more loose and limber than I have in years.”"

rows.original: “Oh, is that all that’s put a spring in your step?” he teases, pulling the door closed behind the ‘commander.’
rows.translation: “哦，只有这些事情让你步履轻快吗？”他调侃着将门拉上，把那位‘指挥官’关在车内。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, is that all that’s put a spring in your step?” he teases, pulling the door closed behind the ‘commander.’"

rows.original: She grins and chunks her duffle bag down on the deck. “Well, all the handsome tourists treating me like a piece of the local meat didn’t hurt, either. Perks of being half-dzaan!”
rows.translation: 她咧嘴一笑，将旅行袋砰地扔到甲板上。“嗯，那些英俊游客把我当成本地鲜肉享用，感觉也不坏。身为半德赞人的福利！”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe grins and chunks her duffle bag down on the deck. “Well, all the handsome tourists treating me like a piece of the local meat didn’t hurt, either. Perks of being half-dzaan!”"

rows.original: That seems to trigger some kind of in-joke, and both the commander and supervisor laugh on their way up the stairs to the passenger deck. Now that everyone’s out of earshot, you sigh and sit down, feeling the deck rumble as the hovercraft takes off. When they’re gone, the ship seals and the deck rumbles under your [pc.feet], finally lifting off."

rows.original: “Sure,” you say, following the huskar out of the hangar. About halfway down the entrance hallway, you realize that there’s nobody around and no security cameras in this particular stretch. Too bad for this guy. You give him a quick smack on the back of the head, catching his body before he can collapse in a big, noisy pile of ausar man-meat. There’s a janitorial closet nearby, just big enough for you to toss him into, tied up and gagged with some spare rags.
rows.translation: “当然，”你说道，跟着赫斯卡人离开机库。沿入口走廊行至一半时，你发现这一段恰好四下无人，也没有安全摄像头。这家伙真倒霉。你迅速拍击他的后脑，在这大块奥萨尔男人倒地发出巨响前接住他的身体。附近有间清洁用品柜，空间刚好够你把他扔进去，再用几块备用破布将他捆住并堵上嘴。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure,” you say, following the huskar out of the hangar. About halfway down the entrance hallway, you realize that there’s nobody around and no security cameras in this particular stretch. Too bad for this guy. You give him a quick smack on the back of the head, catching his body before he can collapse in a big, noisy pile of ausar man-meat. There’s a janitorial closet nearby, just big enough for you to toss him into, tied up and gagged with some spare rags."

rows.original: Once he’s secured, you head back the hangar. Looks like in your absence, everybody’s boarded the craft, leaving you with plenty of time to get aboard and find somewhere to hide. The hovercraft waits a good little while, apparently for the super to return, but eventually you feel the deck shudder under your [pc.feet] as it lifts off. Work waits for no man.
rows.translation: 把他安置妥当后，你返回机库。看来在你离开期间，所有人都已经登上飞行器，留给你充足的时间上船并找地方藏身。气垫船等了相当一会儿，显然是在等主管回来；但最终，你感觉[pc.feet]下的甲板随着升空而震颤起来。工作可不等人。
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce he’s secured, you head back the hangar. Looks like in your absence, everybody’s boarded the craft, leaving you with plenty of time to get aboard and find somewhere to hide. The hovercraft waits a good little while, apparently for the super to return, but eventually you feel the deck shudder under your [pc.feet] as it lifts off. Work waits for no man."

rows.original: The journey to the Akkadi base is miserable beyond words. Shortly after takeoff, all the heat drains out of the cargo hold, leaving you to freeze your ass off in the Uvetan cold. You can barely feel your body, and you’re trembling uncontrollably.
rows.translation: 前往阿卡迪基地的旅程苦不堪言。起飞后不久，货舱里的热量便全部流失，把你留在乌维托的严寒中冻得屁股生疼。你几乎感觉不到自己的身体，只能无法控制地不停发抖。
rows.raw: "The journey to the Akkadi base is miserable beyond words. Shortly after takeoff, all the heat drains out of the cargo hold, leaving you to freeze your ass off in the Uvetan cold. You can barely feel your body, and you’re trembling uncontrollably."

rows.original: The journey is boring, spent playing around on your Codex between bouts of paranoia, listening for footsteps that never come.
rows.translation: 这段旅程十分无聊；你时而疑神疑鬼地竖耳倾听始终没有响起的脚步声，时而摆弄CODEX终端打发时间。
rows.raw: "The journey is boring, spent playing around on your Codex between bouts of paranoia, listening for footsteps that never come."

rows.original: Eventually, the ship shudders, coming to a halt and slowly lowering to the ground. When it lands, you’re jostled awake and alert, just in time to hear the construction crew start filing down from above. You get as quiet as you can, peering out from your hidey-hole as the pack of huskar gather at the door. It opens with a rush of frigid air and blinding light, making even the extra fluffy ausar shudder and complain. Still, they start filing out until only Syri is left aboard.
rows.translation: 最终，飞船一阵震颤，停下并缓缓降至地面。着陆时的摇晃让你惊醒过来，及时听见施工人员开始从上方鱼贯而下。你尽可能保持安静，从藏身处向外窥视，看着一群赫斯卡聚集在门边。舱门开启，寒风与刺目强光一同涌入，令毛发格外蓬松的奥萨尔人都颤抖抱怨起来。尽管如此，他们仍陆续走出船舱，直到船上只剩希莉。
rows.raw: "\n\nEventually, the ship shudders, coming to a halt and slowly lowering to the ground. When it lands, you’re jostled awake and alert, just in time to hear the construction crew start filing down from above. You get as quiet as you can, peering out from your hidey-hole as the pack of huskar gather at the door. It opens with a rush of frigid air and blinding light, making even the extra fluffy ausar shudder and complain. Still, they start filing out until only Syri is left aboard."

rows.original: When she’s sure nobody’s watching, she quickly comes over to where you’re hiding and whispers, “Okay. Just chill out in there for a bit. I’ll call you when I’m about to cut the power. You’re only going to have a few seconds to bolt into the facility. You’ll have to run across the skeleton of the bridge, then go straight through the big doors. Try not to enjoy the warmth in there too much, okay?”
rows.translation: 确认没人看着后，她迅速来到你的藏身之处，低声说道：“好了。你先在那里冷静地待一会儿。我准备切断电源时会联系你。你只有几秒钟时间冲进设施。你得跑过桥梁骨架，然后径直穿过那扇大门。进去后别太贪恋里面的温暖，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen she’s sure nobody’s watching, she quickly comes over to where you’re hiding and whispers, “Okay. Just chill out in there for a bit. I’ll call you when I’m about to cut the power. You’re only going to have a few seconds to bolt into the facility. You’ll have to run across the skeleton of the bridge, then go straight through the big doors. Try not to enjoy the warmth in there too much, okay?”"

rows.original: And what’s she going to be doing while you’re snooping around inside?
rows.translation: 那么，当你在里面四处窥探时，她要做什么？
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd what’s she going to be doing while you’re snooping around inside?"

rows.original: “I’m gonna be causing as much of a distraction as possible,” she laughs. “I’ll try and keep the power off as long as I can... but if you see any security stations, a little sabotage from inside would be a good plan.”
rows.translation: “我会尽可能制造大动静来吸引注意力，”她笑道。“我会尽量让电力中断得久一些... 不过如果你看见任何安保站，从内部稍微破坏一下会是个好主意。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m gonna be causing as much of a distraction as possible,” she laughs. “I’ll try and keep the power off as long as I can... but if you see any security stations, a little sabotage from inside would be a good plan.”"

rows.original: Guess it’s go time. You extricate yourself from your hiding place, running up to the cargo bay door and pressing your shoulder into the shadows there. From here, you have a brief, momentary overlook of the Akkadi base. It sits atop both sides of the great glacial rift, two large black buildings leaning out over the seemingly-bottomless canyon of ice. A long, spindly bridge connects the two halves of the complex, barely more than a flat plane of metal suspended by cables. Looks like it’s still under construction... as is the building you’re parked on, it looks like. You can see a big crane looming over it, whirring along with an armful of metal beams that are headed for a quarter of the far side that’s still skeletal and exposed to the elements.
rows.translation: 看来行动时间到了。你从藏身之处钻出来，跑到货舱门边，将肩膀抵进那里的阴影中。从这里，你可以短暂地俯瞰阿卡迪基地。基地横跨巨大冰川裂谷的两侧，两座黑色大楼向外伸展，悬在仿佛深不见底的冰之峡谷上方。一座细长的桥梁连接着设施的两部分，几乎只是一块由缆索悬挂的平坦金属板。看来这里仍在施工... 你所在的这栋建筑似乎也是如此。你能看见一台巨型起重机耸立在上方，正嗡嗡作响地运送满满一吊臂的金属梁；它们将被送往远端仍只剩骨架、暴露在恶劣天气中的一角。
rows.raw: "\n\nGuess it’s go time. You extricate yourself from your hiding place, running up to the cargo bay door and pressing your shoulder into the shadows there. From here, you have a brief, momentary overlook of the Akkadi base. It sits atop both sides of the great glacial rift, two large black buildings leaning out over the seemingly-bottomless canyon of ice. A long, spindly bridge connects the two halves of the complex, barely more than a flat plane of metal suspended by cables. Looks like it’s still under construction... as is the building you’re parked on, it looks like. You can see a big crane looming over it, whirring along with an armful of metal beams that are headed for a quarter of the far side that’s still skeletal and exposed to the elements."

rows.original: You’re staring right at the crane when the power cuts. It shudders, cargo wobbling, as it’s suddenly brought to a total stop. You hear yelling from below as the lights, shields, and heat cut out, leaving the workers temporarily blind and freezing in the frigid winds.
rows.translation: 电力中断时，你正盯着那台起重机。它猛地一震，货物摇摆不定，整台机器骤然彻底停下。随着照明、护盾和供暖全部关闭，你听见下方传来叫喊声，工人们顿时陷入黑暗，在刺骨寒风中受冻。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re staring right at the crane when the power cuts. It shudders, cargo wobbling, as it’s suddenly brought to a total stop. You hear yelling from below as the lights, shields, and heat cut out, leaving the workers temporarily blind and freezing in the frigid winds."

rows.original: You duck out of the hovercraft and book it down to the bridge, keeping to cover behind construction equipment and snowbanks until you’re able to slide down the maintenance ladder from the hoverpad down to the same level as the bridge. You dash across, as quick as you dare considering how thin the bridge is, and how hard the wind blows through the ice canyon. And it is blowing, strong enough to nearly blow you overboard to an icy death.
rows.translation: 你溜出气垫船，飞奔向桥梁，借助施工设备和雪堆遮掩身形，直到能够沿维护梯从气垫平台滑到与桥梁相同的高度。你快速冲过桥面；考虑到桥梁有多么狭窄，以及狂风在冰谷间刮得多么猛烈，你只能尽自己敢用的最快速度前进。风确实在狂刮，强劲到几乎能把你吹下桥，让你葬身冰窟。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou duck out of the hovercraft and book it down to the bridge, keeping to cover behind construction equipment and snowbanks until you’re able to slide down the maintenance ladder from the hoverpad down to the same level as the bridge. You dash across, as quick as you dare considering how thin the bridge is, and how hard the wind blows through the ice canyon. And it is blowing, strong enough to nearly blow you overboard to an icy death."

rows.original: And then you’re across, hugging the big metal security door on the other end. From here, you can’t even see the other side of the bridge anymore -- the wind’s picked up something fierce, blowing snow and ice like a haze all around you. Whatever Syri did, it seems to have let loose the storm!

rows.raw: "\n\nAnd then you’re across, hugging the big metal security door on the other end. From here, you can’t even see the other side of the bridge anymore -- the wind’s picked up something fierce, blowing snow and ice like a haze all around you. Whatever Syri did, it seems to have let loose the storm! "
