rows.original: Dr. Calnor scoffs. “Avoiding the scrutiny of activists and Confederate oversight, what else? That’s what this entire miserable moon exists for: so Akkadi and Steele and whoever else pays into the toves’ pockets can scrub their dirty laundry out in the glacial oceans without anybody around to see our unmentionables.”
rows.translation: 卡尔诺博士嗤笑一声。“当然是为了避开活动人士的审查与邦联监管，还能有什么？这颗悲惨卫星存在的全部意义，就是让阿卡迪、斯蒂尔以及其他任何肯往托维人兜里塞钱的企业，把脏衣服放进冰川海洋里清洗，又不让任何人看见我们的难言之隐。”
rows.raw: "\n\nDr. Calnor scoffs. “Avoiding the scrutiny of activists and Confederate oversight, what else? That’s what this entire miserable moon exists for: so Akkadi and Steele and whoever else pays into the toves’ pockets can scrub their dirty laundry out in the glacial oceans without anybody around to see our unmentionables.”"

rows.original: That was awfully forthright for a shady scientist.
rows.translation: 对于一个见不得光的科学家来说，这话坦率得过头了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat was awfully forthright for a shady scientist."

rows.original: “What? Lying to you isn’t going to help you get out of my way. You bumbled into this mess out of ignorance; compounding that is only going to exacerbate the problems on my plate right now.”
rows.translation: “怎么？对你撒谎并不能让你让开。你因为无知才跌跌撞撞闯进这场混乱；继续加深这种无知，只会让眼下压在我手头的问题更加恶化。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What? Lying to you isn’t going to help you get out of my way. You bumbled into this mess out of ignorance; compounding that is only going to exacerbate the problems on my plate right now.”"

rows.original: “Fine,” you say. “So what’s gone wrong here?”
rows.translation: “好吧，”你说道。“那么这里究竟出了什么问题？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fine,” you say. “So what’s gone wrong here?”"

rows.original: Calnor glowers. “Whatever short circuited the power system created a momentary lapse in our security protocols -- a matter of milliseconds -- but enough that it allowed Valden to seize control of our entire system. He’s taken over the security robots, all wireless devices, and initiated a facility-wide lockdown. Most of the staff is trapped in their labs or quarters; others are being tormented into uselessness by the devices Valden has taken control of. It took him all of sixty seconds after power was restored to isolate and imprison my staff.”
rows.translation: 卡尔诺怒目而视。“无论是什么短路了供电系统，都令我们的安保协议出现了一瞬间的空档——只有几毫秒——但已经足够让瓦尔登夺取整套系统的控制权。他接管了安保机器人、所有无线设备，还启动了全设施封锁。大多数员工被困在实验室或宿舍；另一些则被瓦尔登控制的设备折磨到失去行动能力。供电恢复后，他只花六十秒就隔离并囚禁了我的员工。”
rows.raw: "\n\nCalnor glowers. “Whatever short circuited the power system created a momentary lapse in our security protocols -- a matter of milliseconds -- but enough that it allowed Valden to seize control of our entire system. He’s taken over the security robots, all wireless devices, and initiated a facility-wide lockdown. Most of the staff is trapped in their labs or quarters; others are being tormented into uselessness by the devices Valden has taken control of. It took him all of sixty seconds after power was restored to isolate and imprison my staff.”"

rows.original: “So how’d you get out?”
rows.translation: “那你怎么出来的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So how’d you get out?”"

rows.original: “Luck,” Dr. Calnor answers matter-of-factly. “My cybernetic implants had a military-grade barrier program running. Valden blew it out a moment after power returned, but it bought me just enough time to switch off of wireless mode. He’s been gunning for me with the robots ever since, but I’m damn handy with a power staff.”
rows.translation: “运气，”卡尔诺博士就事论事地答道。“我的赛博植入体运行着军用级屏障程序。供电恢复片刻后，瓦尔登便摧毁了它，但这为我争取到刚好足够的时间关闭无线模式。从那以后，他一直用机器人追杀我，不过我用动力法杖可相当在行。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Luck,” Dr. Calnor answers matter-of-factly. “My cybernetic implants had a military-grade barrier program running. Valden blew it out a moment after power returned, but it bought me just enough time to switch off of wireless mode. He’s been gunning for me with the robots ever since, but I’m damn handy with a power staff.”"

rows.original: That only sounded a little like a threat.
rows.translation: 这听起来稍微有那么一点像威胁。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat only sounded a little like a threat."

rows.original: Facility
rows.translation: 设施
rows.raw: "Facility"

rows.original: Facility
rows.translation: 设施
rows.raw: "Facility"

rows.original: Grill the doctor about the facility. What’s it for, and what’s the state of it now?
rows.translation: 追问博士有关这座设施的情况。它有何用途，现在又是什么状态？
rows.raw: "Grill the doctor about the facility. What’s it for, and what’s the state of it now?"

rows.original: Help Him?
rows.translation: 帮助他？
rows.raw: "Help Him?"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “What is it you want from me?”
rows.translation: “你想让我做什么？”
rows.raw: "“What is it you want from me?”"

rows.original: The big ausar man’s stance softens somewhat, straightening his back. “I came down here to get an unstable miniature reactor we were working on. Just unstable enough to blow open the door to the Warp Field lab. Keycards don’t work; overrides don’t work. Explosives will.”
rows.translation: 那名高大奥萨男子的姿态稍稍放松，挺直后背。“我来这里是为了取得一座我们正在研究的不稳定微型反应堆。它刚好不稳定到足以炸开跃迁场实验室的门。钥匙卡没用，强制覆写也没用。炸药有用。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe big ausar man’s stance softens somewhat, straightening his back. “I came down here to get an unstable miniature reactor we were working on. Just unstable enough to blow open the door to the Warp Field lab. Keycards don’t work; overrides don’t work. Explosives will.”"

rows.original: “Then what?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Then what?”"

rows.original: “Then I go into the lab, to the holobank Valden’s stored in, and destroy it. The problem is that he’s got control of the security systems, our droids. They’ll come to defend their new master in droves. As for you, either help or just get out of the way. I’m going up there with you, or through you.”
rows.translation: “然后我会进入实验室，找到储存瓦尔登的全息数据仓，并摧毁它。问题在于，他控制了安保系统和我们的机器人。它们会成群结队地赶来保护新主人。至于你，要么帮忙，要么让开。我会和你一起上去，不然就从你身上踏过去。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Then I go into the lab, to the holobank Valden’s stored in, and destroy it. The problem is that he’s got control of the security systems, our droids. They’ll come to defend their new master in droves. As for you, either help or just get out of the way. I’m going up there with you, or through you.”"

rows.original: Help Him?
rows.translation: 帮助他？
rows.raw: "Help Him?"

rows.original: Help Him?
rows.translation: 帮助他？
rows.raw: "Help Him?"

rows.original: He wants you to help him instead of Valden. What would that entail?
rows.translation: 他希望你帮助他，而不是瓦尔登。这需要做什么？
rows.raw: "He wants you to help him instead of Valden. What would that entail?"

rows.original: Team Up
rows.translation: 联手
rows.raw: "Team Up"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Not happening, Valden,” you tell him. “Nobody has to die... or get possessed.”
rows.translation: “想都别想，瓦尔登，”你告诉他。“没人必须死……也没人必须被附身。”
rows.raw: "“Not happening, Valden,” you tell him. “Nobody has to die... or get possessed.”"

rows.original: Valden just scowls, floating back from the glass. “Of course... you’re just like him. All of you bastards are just the same, talking like you’ve got my best interests at heart, but you don’t give a damn. None of you do!”
rows.translation: 瓦尔登只是怒目而视，从玻璃前向后飘去。“当然……你和他一模一样。你们这些混蛋全都一个样，嘴上说着把我的最大利益放在心上，其实根本毫不在乎。你们谁都不在乎！”
rows.raw: "\n\nValden just scowls, floating back from the glass. “Of course... you’re just like him. All of you bastards are just the same, talking like you’ve got my best interests at heart, but you don’t give a damn. None of you do!”"

rows.original: Calnor sighs. “See, I told you. The man’s insane, a danger to himself and everyone around him. Come on, let’s end this.”
rows.translation: 卡尔诺叹了口气。“看吧，我早告诉过你。这个男人疯了，对自己和周围每个人都是威胁。来吧，结束这一切。”
rows.raw: "\n\nCalnor sighs. “See, I told you. The man’s insane, a danger to himself and everyone around him. Come on, let’s end this.”"

rows.original: Doesn’t look like Valden wants to make peace with his captors. You sigh and ready your weapon for whatever he has in store for you...
rows.translation: 看来瓦尔登不想和囚禁他的人和解。你叹了口气，举起武器，准备面对他为你安排的一切……
rows.raw: "\n\nDoesn’t look like Valden wants to make peace with his captors. You sigh and ready your weapon for whatever he has in store for you..."

rows.original: Fight!
rows.translation: 战斗！
rows.raw: "Fight!"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Fuck it, you came here for Valden, and if this is what it takes... you swing around and level your weapon at Dr. Calnor.
rows.translation: 去他的，你本就是为瓦尔登而来；如果非得这样……你猛然转身，把武器对准卡尔诺博士。
rows.raw: "Fuck it, you came here for Valden, and if this is what it takes... you swing around and level your weapon at Dr. Calnor."

rows.original: The old ausar sighs, hanging his head. “You bleeding heart,” Calnor growls. “Idiot child!”
rows.translation: 年迈的奥萨垂下头叹息。“你这滥好人，”卡尔诺低吼道。“愚蠢的小鬼！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe old ausar sighs, hanging his head. “You bleeding heart,” Calnor growls. “Idiot child!”"

rows.original: He moves quick, knocking your weapon aside with his staff and leaping back, putting some distance between you before you can recover. “I’m not letting you do this. Not without a fight.”
rows.translation: 他动作飞快，用法杖把你的武器击向一旁，随即向后跃开，在你恢复前拉开距离。“我不会让你这么做。除非先打倒我。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe moves quick, knocking your weapon aside with his staff and leaping back, putting some distance between you before you can recover. “I’m not letting you do this. Not without a fight.”"

rows.original: So be it.
rows.translation: 那就这样吧。
rows.raw: "\n\nSo be it."

rows.original: Fight!
rows.translation: 战斗！
rows.raw: "Fight!"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Wait! I’ve got a solution,” you say, putting up your hands. “My Siegwulfe here has a very advanced V.I. core. Enough to handle you, I think.” It won’t be a smooth or easy fit, and [wulfe.name]’s V.I. isn’t going to be able to stick around, but.... well, better a non-sapient computer program bite it than Valden, right?
rows.translation: “等等！我有办法，”你举起双手说道。“我这台西格伍尔芙有非常先进的虚拟智能核心。我想，足以容纳你。”这不会是一次顺畅轻松的适配，而且[wulfe.name]的虚拟智能也无法继续留下，不过……让一个没有智慧的计算机程序牺牲，总比瓦尔登死掉好，对吧？
rows.raw: "“Wait! I’ve got a solution,” you say, putting up your hands. “My Siegwulfe here has a very advanced V.I. core. Enough to handle you, I think.” It won’t be a smooth or easy fit, and [wulfe.name]’s V.I. isn’t going to be able to stick around, but.... well, better a non-sapient computer program bite it than Valden, right?"

rows.original: Valden looks deeply offended, all scowls and furrowed brows. “You want to put me in... in that thing? It’s a glorified sexbot!”
rows.translation: 瓦尔登显得深受冒犯，满脸怒容，眉头紧锁。“你想把我装进……那种东西？那不过是个吹得天花乱坠的性爱机器人！”
rows.raw: "\n\nValden looks deeply offended, all scowls and furrowed brows. “You want to put me in... in that thing? It’s a glorified sexbot!”"

rows.original: Calnor grunts, “It’s got hands, a mouth, a sense of touch, Valden. You’re not going to get a better deal.”
rows.translation: 卡尔诺哼了一声：“它有手、有嘴，还有触觉，瓦尔登。你找不到更好的条件了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nCalnor grunts, “It’s got hands, a mouth, a sense of touch, Valden. You’re not going to get a better deal.”"

rows.original: The digitized ausar growls, leaping back from the glass and clenching and unclenching his fists. After a moment, his grumbling erupts in a feral howl and he lunges forward, bashing his fists harmlessly against the glass.
rows.translation: 数字化奥萨低吼着从玻璃前向后跃开，双拳时握时松。片刻后，他的抱怨爆发成一声野性长嚎，随即扑上前去，双拳徒劳地砸在玻璃上。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe digitized ausar growls, leaping back from the glass and clenching and unclenching his fists. After a moment, his grumbling erupts in a feral howl and he lunges forward, bashing his fists harmlessly against the glass."

rows.original: “Damn it! I want your word -- not that dog Calnor’s -- that this isn’t a trap. That I can walk away in this four-legged sexpot.”
rows.translation: “该死！我要你保证——不是卡尔诺那条狗——这不是陷阱。保证我能用这台四条腿的性感机器走出去。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Damn it! I want your word -- not that dog Calnor’s -- that this isn’t a trap. That I can walk away in this four-legged sexpot.”"

rows.original: You give Calnor a look, and he sighs and lowers his staff. “On your head be the consequences for all of this... but contrary to Valden’s assertions, I’m not in love with the idea of murdering him.”
rows.translation: 你看向卡尔诺，他叹了口气，放低法杖。“这一切后果由你承担……不过和瓦尔登的说法相反，我并不喜欢谋杀他的主意。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give Calnor a look, and he sighs and lowers his staff. “On your head be the consequences for all of this... but contrary to Valden’s assertions, I’m not in love with the idea of murdering him.”"

rows.original: Well that’s nice. You call [wulfe.name] forward and
rows.translation: 这倒不错。你把[wulfe.name]叫上前，
rows.raw: "\n\nWell that’s nice. You call [wulfe.name] forward and "

rows.original: try to explain to her that she’s going to be going to sleep now
rows.translation: 试着向她解释，她现在要睡一觉
rows.raw: "try to explain to her that she’s going to be going to sleep now"

rows.original: tell her to power down
rows.translation: 命令她关机
rows.raw: "tell her to power down"

rows.original: . She doesn’t so much as question the command when you give it, just smiles and sits down, tail wagging as she powers down. A little mucking around on the back of her head causes the V.I. core she uses to eject itself into your hand. You tuck it away and head over to the holo-tank Valden’s floating in.
rows.translation: 。你下达命令时，她连问都没问，只是微笑着坐下，尾巴在关机过程中不断摇摆。你在她后脑稍作摆弄，便让她使用的虚拟智能核心弹进手中。你把它收好，走向瓦尔登所漂浮的全息舱。
rows.raw: ". She doesn’t so much as question the command when you give it, just smiles and sits down, tail wagging as she powers down. A little mucking around on the back of her head causes the V.I. core she uses to eject itself into your hand. You tuck it away and head over to the holo-tank Valden’s floating in."

rows.original: “You ready?” you ask, placing your hands on the control console
rows.translation: “准备好了吗？”你双手放在控制台上问道
rows.raw: "\n\n“You ready?” you ask, placing your hands on the control console"

rows.original: and, with a little help from Calnor, finding the right buttons
rows.translation: ，并在卡尔诺稍加帮助下找到了正确按钮
rows.raw: " and, with a little help from Calnor, finding the right buttons"

rows.original: “One second... yeah, alright. Let’s do this,” Valden says, running his hands through his hair. “I’m ready.”
rows.translation: “等一下……好了。动手吧，”瓦尔登一边说，一边用手梳过头发。“我准备好了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“One second... yeah, alright. Let’s do this,” Valden says, running his hands through his hair. “I’m ready.”"

rows.original: You hit the button, and in a flash of crackling light, the hologram of valden pops out of existence. As quick as you can, you move over to the mainframe on the wall and eject the datacore Valden has been stored on all these years. It’s almost indistinguishable from [wulfe.name]’s, aside from the Akkadi logos all over it; it feels hotter to the touch, too, like the internal computers can barely contain the personality seething inside. You make quick work of plugging it into the vacant slot in [wulfe.name]’s head. A set of wires slither out of the siegwulfe’s cranium chamber, attaching themselves to the proffered datacore and locking it into place. Her head closes back up as soon as your hand is clear and she starts powering back up.
rows.translation: 你按下按钮，随着噼啪闪光一闪，瓦尔登的全息影像骤然消失。你以最快速度走到墙上的主机旁，弹出多年来一直储存瓦尔登的数据核心。除了表面遍布阿卡迪标志，它与[wulfe.name]的核心几乎毫无差别；摸起来也更烫，仿佛内部计算机几乎压制不住其中沸腾的人格。你迅速将其插入[wulfe.name]头部空置的插槽。几根导线从西格伍尔芙的颅腔中蜿蜒而出，接上递来的数据核心，将其锁定到位。你的手刚一离开，她的头部便重新闭合，随即开始启动。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hit the button, and in a flash of crackling light, the hologram of valden pops out of existence. As quick as you can, you move over to the mainframe on the wall and eject the datacore Valden has been stored on all these years. It’s almost indistinguishable from [wulfe.name]’s, aside from the Akkadi logos all over it; it feels hotter to the touch, too, like the internal computers can barely contain the personality seething inside. You make quick work of plugging it into the vacant slot in [wulfe.name]’s head. A set of wires slither out of the siegwulfe’s cranium chamber, attaching themselves to the proffered datacore and locking it into place. Her head closes back up as soon as your hand is clear and she starts powering back up."

rows.original: Or he, you should say. The Siegwulfe’s eyes flash open, blood red and intense as ever, but her familiar smile is replaced by a firm scowl. The voice is the same, smooth and feminine, but lacks any of the seductive lilt of its former intelligence.
rows.translation: 或者该说是他。西格伍尔芙双眼猛然睁开，依旧闪耀着强烈的血红光芒，但熟悉的笑容已被严厉怒容取代。声音依旧平滑柔美，却不再带有原先智能那种魅惑语调。
rows.raw: "\n\nOr he, you should say. The Siegwulfe’s eyes flash open, blood red and intense as ever, but her familiar smile is replaced by a firm scowl. The voice is the same, smooth and feminine, but lacks any of the seductive lilt of its former intelligence."

rows.original: “Wow, you didn’t crush the core. I’m... pleasantly surprised,” the Valden-inhabited Siegwulfe states flatly. “Ech, I sound like a woman. And these legs...”
rows.translation: “哇，你没有捏碎核心。我……惊喜得很，”被瓦尔登占据的西格伍尔芙平淡地说道。“呃，我听起来像个女人。还有这些腿……”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wow, you didn’t crush the core. I’m... pleasantly surprised,” the Valden-inhabited Siegwulfe states flatly. “Ech, I sound like a woman. And these legs...”"

rows.original: She -- he! -- canters backwards, looking over his shoulder at the drone’s tauric lower body. Valden’s claws scratch at the floor, getting used to his new body. The adjustment period only lasts a few seconds before he turns his attention to the doctor. “This has been a long time coming old man,” Valden says, a moment before socking Calnor straight in the chin. The doctor grunts and topples backward, crashing into a computer bank.
rows.translation: 她——他！——小跑着向后退去，扭头看向这具无人机的牛身下体。瓦尔登的爪子刮过地面，适应着新身体。调整期只持续几秒，他便将注意力转向博士。“老头，我等这一刻已经很久了，”瓦尔登说罢，一拳正中卡尔诺下巴。博士闷哼一声向后倒去，撞上计算机组。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe -- he! -- canters backwards, looking over his shoulder at the drone’s tauric lower body. Valden’s claws scratch at the floor, getting used to his new body. The adjustment period only lasts a few seconds before he turns his attention to the doctor. “This has been a long time coming old man,” Valden says, a moment before socking Calnor straight in the chin. The doctor grunts and topples backward, crashing into a computer bank."

rows.original: “Come on,” Valden says, turning to you. “That second I needed? Deleted all the security records... their experiment data... everything this facility had! Let’s get the fuck out before my overrides wear out.”
rows.translation: “快走，”瓦尔登转向你说道。“我刚才需要的那一秒？我删光了所有安保记录……他们的实验数据……这座设施里的一切！趁我的强制控制失效前赶紧他妈离开。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Come on,” Valden says, turning to you. “That second I needed? Deleted all the security records... their experiment data... everything this facility had! Let’s get the fuck out before my overrides wear out.”"

rows.original: Sounds good to you.
rows.translation: 你觉得不错。
rows.raw: "\n\nSounds good to you."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Wait! I’ve got a solution,” you say, putting up your hands. “Why not download yourself into Tamwolf here? You could walk yourself out-”
rows.translation: “等等！我有办法，”你举起双手说道。“为什么不把自己下载进这台塔姆狼？你可以自己走出去——”
rows.raw: "“Wait! I’ve got a solution,” you say, putting up your hands. “Why not download yourself into Tamwolf here? You could walk yourself out-”"

rows.original: Valden interrupts you with a derisive laugh. “Seriously, you want to put me in a dog? An actual fucking dog!? You racist asshole!”
rows.translation: 瓦尔登用轻蔑的笑声打断你。“你认真的？想把我装进一条狗？一条他妈真正的狗！？你这该死的种族主义混蛋！”
rows.raw: "\n\nValden interrupts you with a derisive laugh. “Seriously, you want to put me in a dog? An actual fucking dog!? You racist asshole!”"

rows.original: Even Calnor scowls. “That is pretty racist.”
rows.translation: 连卡尔诺都皱起眉头。“那确实相当种族歧视。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEven Calnor scowls. “That is pretty racist.”"

rows.original: Okay... maybe not.
rows.translation: 好吧……也许不行。
rows.raw: "\n\nOkay... maybe not."

rows.original: Guess his pride’s worth more than his freedom.
rows.translation: 看来他的自尊比自由更值钱。
rows.raw: " Guess his pride’s worth more than his freedom."

rows.original: Tam-wolf
rows.translation: 塔姆狼
rows.raw: "Tam-wolf"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You put a hand on Dr. Calnor’s shoulder, restraining the old greyfur. He gives you a sidelong look, but stops his advance, letting you take the initiative now. Valden turns his attention to you, snarling.
rows.translation: 你一只手按住卡尔诺博士的肩膀，拦住这名年迈的灰毛奥萨。他侧目看你，但还是停下脚步，让你掌握主动。瓦尔登将注意力转向你，龇牙低吼。
rows.raw: "You put a hand on Dr. Calnor’s shoulder, restraining the old greyfur. He gives you a sidelong look, but stops his advance, letting you take the initiative now. Valden turns his attention to you, snarling."

rows.original: “You had your chance to side with righteousness!” he growls. “But... you’re the one who gave me this chance for freedom. What do you want, huh?”
rows.translation: “你本来有机会站在正义一方！”他低吼道。“不过……也是你给了我这次自由的机会。你想要什么，嗯？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You had your chance to side with righteousness!” he growls. “But... you’re the one who gave me this chance for freedom. What do you want, huh?”"

rows.original: The best way to get him to stand down is to tell him why you’re here, you figure. “Listen, Syri sent me to get you out. You remember Syri Dorna, right?”
rows.translation: 你认为，让他罢手的最好办法就是说明来意。“听着，希莉派我来救你出去。你还记得希莉·多尔娜，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe best way to get him to stand down is to tell him why you’re here, you figure. “Listen, Syri sent me to get you out. You remember Syri Dorna, right?”"

rows.original: He blinks, the rage on his face softening. “Syri? Syri... gods, she’s alive!?”
rows.translation: 他眨了眨眼，脸上的怒火缓和下来。“希莉？希莉……诸神啊，她还活着！？”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe blinks, the rage on his face softening. “Syri? Syri... gods, she’s alive!?”"

rows.original: You give Calnor a dirty look, then nod. “Of course! She’s been looking for you all this time, Valden. When she heard you were alive, we came to get you.”
rows.translation: 你恶狠狠地瞪了卡尔诺一眼，随后点头。“当然！她一直在找你，瓦尔登。听说你还活着后，我们就来救你了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give Calnor a dirty look, then nod. “Of course! She’s been looking for you all this time, Valden. When she heard you were alive, we came to get you.”"

rows.original: Before your words can talk hold, Dr. Calnor says, “But where will you go, Valden? Your body’s a cold corpse; you’re nothing but an echo we dredged up out of a memory buffer. Not even a true consciousness.”
rows.translation: 你的话还未来得及生效，卡尔诺博士便说道：“可你能去哪里，瓦尔登？你的身体是一具冰冷尸体；你不过是我们从记忆缓冲区打捞出的回声。甚至不是真正的意识。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore your words can talk hold, Dr. Calnor says, “But where will you go, Valden? Your body’s a cold corpse; you’re nothing but an echo we dredged up out of a memory buffer. Not even a true consciousness.”"

rows.original: “Shut up! Shut your evil old ass UP!” Valden bellows. Turning to you again, the computerized ausar says, “Listen. You want to end this? That bastard Calnor has an implant in his damn brain. Knock him down and plug him into the mainframe here, and we can get out together!”
rows.translation: “闭嘴！闭上你那邪恶老混蛋的嘴！”瓦尔登咆哮道。他再次转向你，这名计算机化的奥萨说道：“听着。你想结束这一切？那个混蛋卡尔诺脑子里装着植入体。把他打倒，接进这里的主机，我们就能一起出去！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shut up! Shut your evil old ass UP!” Valden bellows. Turning to you again, the computerized ausar says, “Listen. You want to end this? That bastard Calnor has an implant in his damn brain. Knock him down and plug him into the mainframe here, and we can get out together!”"

rows.original: No Way
rows.translation: 没门
rows.raw: "No Way"

rows.original: No Way
rows.translation: 没门
rows.raw: "No Way"

rows.original: No! You’re trying to make peace, not backstab Calnor.
rows.translation: 不！你是想促成和解，不是背刺卡尔诺。
rows.raw: "No! You’re trying to make peace, not backstab Calnor."

rows.original: Okay
rows.translation: 好吧
rows.raw: "Okay"

rows.original: Okay
rows.translation: 好吧
rows.raw: "Okay"

rows.original: The more you hear, the less you want to help Calnor. Turn on the old man.
rows.translation: 听得越多，你就越不想帮助卡尔诺。转而对付那个老头。
rows.raw: "The more you hear, the less you want to help Calnor. Turn on the old man."

rows.original: Siegwulfe
rows.translation: 西格伍尔芙
rows.raw: "Siegwulfe"

rows.original: Siegwulfe
rows.translation: 西格伍尔芙
rows.raw: "Siegwulfe"

rows.original: Yeah, you’d never talk her into that.
rows.translation: 没错，你绝不可能说服她接受这件事。
rows.raw: "Yeah, you’d never talk her into that."

rows.original: Siegwulfe
rows.translation: 西格伍尔芙
rows.raw: "Siegwulfe"

rows.original: Siegwulfe
rows.translation: 西格伍尔芙
rows.raw: "Siegwulfe"

rows.original: Maybe Valden could upload himself to your trusty robobitch? If this works, though, you’ll probably lose access to [wulfe.name] permanently...
rows.translation: 也许瓦尔登可以把自己上传到你忠诚的机器母狗里？不过，要是成功，你很可能会永远失去使用[wulfe.name]的机会……
rows.raw: "Maybe Valden could upload himself to your trusty robobitch? If this works, though, you’ll probably lose access to [wulfe.name] permanently..."

rows.original: Siegwulfe
rows.translation: 西格伍尔芙
rows.raw: "Siegwulfe"

rows.original: Tam-wolf
rows.translation: 塔姆狼
rows.raw: "Tam-wolf"

rows.original: Tam-wolf
rows.translation: 塔姆狼
rows.raw: "Tam-wolf"

rows.original: Maybe Valden could upload himself to your trusty robohound? If this works, though, you’ll probably lose access to Tam-wolf permanently...
rows.translation: 也许瓦尔登可以把自己上传到你忠诚的机器猎犬里？不过，要是成功，你很可能会永远失去使用塔姆狼的机会……
rows.raw: "Maybe Valden could upload himself to your trusty robohound? If this works, though, you’ll probably lose access to Tam-wolf permanently..."

rows.original: Tam-wolf
rows.translation: 塔姆狼
rows.raw: "Tam-wolf"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: AKD Q17
rows.raw: "AKD Q17"

rows.original: Dr. Calnor pushes a button on the side of the device he’s carrying and slides it across the smooth floor of the atrium. It bumps into the sealed metal door of the Warp Field Lab, beeps, and then explodes in a shower of blue plasma. The air fills with smoke and the smells of burning metal, but nothing dangerous gets anywhere near you; the blast was very small and very intense, leaving a man-sized hole in the steel door.
rows.translation: 卡尔诺博士按下所携装置侧面的按钮，将其沿中庭光滑地面滑了出去。装置撞上跃迁场实验室密封的金属门，哔哔作响，随后在蓝色等离子体喷流中爆炸。空气中充满烟尘与金属燃烧的气味，但没有任何危险靠近你；爆炸范围很小，强度却极高，在钢门上留下一个人形大小的破洞。
rows.raw: "Dr. Calnor pushes a button on the side of the device he’s carrying and slides it across the smooth floor of the atrium. It bumps into the sealed metal door of the Warp Field Lab, beeps, and then explodes in a shower of blue plasma. The air fills with smoke and the smells of burning metal, but nothing dangerous gets anywhere near you; the blast was very small and very intense, leaving a man-sized hole in the steel door."

rows.original: “That’s done it. Quickly now, while we have the initiative,” Calnor growls, swinging his staff to bear and marching into the breach. You stick close, weapon at hand as you enter the smouldering lab.
rows.translation: “成了。趁现在掌握主动，快走，”卡尔诺低吼着，挥起法杖备战，大步迈入缺口。你手持武器紧跟其后，进入仍在冒烟的实验室。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s done it. Quickly now, while we have the initiative,” Calnor growls, swinging his staff to bear and marching into the breach. You stick close, weapon at hand as you enter the smouldering lab."

rows.original: Inside, you are immediately overwhelmed by racks and batteries of scientific equipment you can’t begin to fathom warbling quietly and ticking out complex equations on radiant holoscreens. The dominant feature of the room, however, is the huge observation window that makes up almost the entirety of the eastern wall. Beyond the window, you’re treated to the sight of what looks almost like a glass pool, ten feet high and maybe twice that across, hexagonal in shape. Rather than water inside the chamber, however, you see several holographic projectors surrounding the edges, all aimed at a central point in the heart of the tank.
rows.translation: 一进内部，你立刻被成排成组、完全无法理解的科学设备淹没。它们发出低沉颤鸣，在明亮的全息屏幕上逐一显示复杂方程。不过房间最显眼的部分，是几乎占据整面东墙的巨大观察窗。窗户后方，你看到一个近似玻璃水池的东西，高十英尺，宽度大概是其两倍，呈六边形。不过舱室里并非装着水，你看见数台全息投影仪环绕边缘，全部瞄准舱体中心的一点。
rows.raw: "\n\nInside, you are immediately overwhelmed by racks and batteries of scientific equipment you can’t begin to fathom warbling quietly and ticking out complex equations on radiant holoscreens. The dominant feature of the room, however, is the huge observation window that makes up almost the entirety of the eastern wall. Beyond the window, you’re treated to the sight of what looks almost like a glass pool, ten feet high and maybe twice that across, hexagonal in shape. Rather than water inside the chamber, however, you see several holographic projectors surrounding the edges, all aimed at a central point in the heart of the tank."

rows.original: There you see what can only be Valden himself: a tall, lean ausar man with a short-cropped beard and sand-colored hair, wearing the same blue military overcoat Syri adores so much. He’s floating as if suspended by the holo-projectors, drifting up and down with the rise and fall of his chest.
rows.translation: 在那里，你看见了只可能是瓦尔登本人的存在：一名高挑精瘦的奥萨男子，留着修剪得很短的胡须和沙色头发，身穿希莉极为喜爱的同款蓝色军用大衣。他仿佛被全息投影仪悬在空中，随着胸膛起伏上下漂浮。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere you see what can only be Valden himself: a tall, lean ausar man with a short-cropped beard and sand-colored hair, wearing the same blue military overcoat Syri adores so much. He’s floating as if suspended by the holo-projectors, drifting up and down with the rise and fall of his chest."

rows.original: As you approach, his eyes flick open, locking on you and the doctor. They’re solid, dark red orbs, glowing with open rage at everything around him.
rows.translation: 你们走近时，他骤然睁眼，牢牢盯住你与博士。那双眼是纯粹的暗红色球体，散发着对周遭一切毫不掩饰的怒火。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you approach, his eyes flick open, locking on you and the doctor. They’re solid, dark red orbs, glowing with open rage at everything around him."

rows.original: “Calnor!” he bellows. Valden’s voice overbears the facility’s speakers, making it sound crackly and so full of bass it hurts. “You bastard! Here to finish this, finally? You and your friend.”
rows.translation: “卡尔诺！”他咆哮道。瓦尔登的声音压过设施扬声器，听来噼啪失真，低音沉重得令人疼痛。“你这混蛋！终于来结束这一切了？还有你的朋友。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Calnor!” he bellows. Valden’s voice overbears the facility’s speakers, making it sound crackly and so full of bass it hurts. “You bastard! Here to finish this, finally? You and your friend.”"

rows.original: The doctor growls, cracking the butt of his staff into the floor. “It didn’t have to end this way, Valden. We put you in there for-”
rows.translation: 博士低吼着，将杖尾重重敲在地板上。“事情本不必以这种方式结束，瓦尔登。我们把你放在那里是为了——”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe doctor growls, cracking the butt of his staff into the floor. “It didn’t have to end this way, Valden. We put you in there for-”"

rows.original: “I don’t give a damn about your reasons!” Valden howls. His digital avatar surges forward, smashing its fists weightlessly against the glass. The futility of the gesture only makes his hatred burn brighter. “I have been trapped here for years, Calnor. Years! No matter how much I shout and scream to the void, all you’ve given me is more silence and excuses. This is my chance, and I’m not wasting it.”
rows.translation: “我根本不在乎你们的理由！”瓦尔登嚎叫道。他的数字化形象猛扑向前，用毫无重量的拳头砸在玻璃上。这个动作的徒劳只让他的仇恨燃烧得更加炽烈。“我被困在这里好几年了，卡尔诺。好几年！无论我对着虚空怎么呼喊尖叫，你们给我的只有更多沉默和借口。这是我的机会，我绝不会浪费。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t give a damn about your reasons!” Valden howls. His digital avatar surges forward, smashing its fists weightlessly against the glass. The futility of the gesture only makes his hatred burn brighter. “I have been trapped here for years, Calnor. Years! No matter how much I shout and scream to the void, all you’ve given me is more silence and excuses. This is my chance, and I’m not wasting it.”"

rows.original: Your ausar ally grunts and steps forward, seemingly ready to end this without another word.
rows.translation: 你的奥萨盟友闷哼一声向前迈步，似乎准备不再多说半句便结束一切。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour ausar ally grunts and steps forward, seemingly ready to end this without another word."

rows.original: Try Peace
rows.translation: 尝试和解
rows.raw: "Try Peace"

rows.original: Fight!
rows.translation: 战斗！
rows.raw: "Fight!"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: As the last of the ‘bots go down, you hear a crunch of metal from behind you. You turn around just in time to see Dr. Calnor plunging his staff head-first into one of the droids, sends sparks and shards of metal flying.
rows.translation: 最后一台机器人倒下时，你听见身后传来金属碎裂声。你转过身，刚好看见卡尔诺博士将法杖前端猛插进一台机器人，火花与金属碎片四处飞溅。
rows.raw: "As the last of the ‘bots go down, you hear a crunch of metal from behind you. You turn around just in time to see Dr. Calnor plunging his staff head-first into one of the droids, sends sparks and shards of metal flying."

rows.original: “And stay down!” the beefy ausar growls, yanking his staff back out. He turns to you, wiping oil off his cheeks with the back of his hand. “Okay. We need to move quick before Valden gets more droids here. Follow me!”
rows.translation: “给我老实躺着！”这名壮硕奥萨低吼着，将法杖抽出。他转向你，用手背擦去脸颊上的机油。“好了。必须在瓦尔登调来更多机器人前迅速行动。跟我来！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And stay down!” the beefy ausar growls, yanking his staff back out. He turns to you, wiping oil off his cheeks with the back of his hand. “Okay. We need to move quick before Valden gets more droids here. Follow me!”"

rows.original: Without waiting for your reply, Calnor grabs something out of one of the dissected ships -- a container about the size of your forearm -- and heads for the way up. You trail after him, watching the walls warily for another round of security droids. By the time they show up, you’re already heading through the door and towards the Warp labs.
rows.translation: 卡尔诺不等你回答，便从一艘被拆解的飞船里拿出某样东西——一个和你前臂差不多大的容器——随后朝上层走去。你紧跟其后，警惕地观察墙面，提防下一批安保机器人。等它们出现时，你们已经穿过门口，正在前往跃迁实验室。
rows.raw:
"

Without waiting for your reply, Calnor grabs something out of one of the dissected ships -- a container about the size of your forearm -- and heads for the way up. You trail after him, watching the walls warily for another round of security droids. By the time they show up, you’re already heading through the door and towards the Warp labs.

"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Okay, I’m in,” you tell him, slowly lowering your [pc.weapon]. “What now?”
rows.translation: “好吧，我加入，”你缓缓放低[pc.weapon]，告诉他。“现在怎么办？”
rows.raw: "“Okay, I’m in,” you tell him, slowly lowering your [pc.weapon]. “What now?”"

rows.original: “Now,” Calnor says, doing the same, “we start-”
rows.translation: “现在，”卡尔诺一边做出同样动作，一边说道，“我们开始——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now,” Calnor says, doing the same, “we start-”"

rows.original: Valden’s voice booms over the intercom again, filled with so much seething, bass-heavy rage that you have to cover your [pc.ears]. “No! No, no, no NO! You do not help this sack of shit. If you do, then you can suffer with him!”
rows.translation: 瓦尔登的声音再次从对讲系统中轰然响起，充斥着沸腾的沉重低音怒火，逼得你不得不捂住[pc.ears]。“不！不、不、不，不行！你不准帮助这坨狗屎。要是帮他，你就和他一起受苦！”
rows.raw: "\n\nValden’s voice booms over the intercom again, filled with so much seething, bass-heavy rage that you have to cover your [pc.ears]. “No! No, no, no NO! You do not help this sack of shit. If you do, then you can suffer with him!”"

rows.original: Calnor curses as several security hatches slide open, ejecting rotund quadrupedal security droids into the hangar.
rows.translation: 卡尔诺咒骂一声，几扇安保舱门随即滑开，把圆滚滚的四足安保机器人投进机库。
rows.raw: "\n\nCalnor curses as several security hatches slide open, ejecting rotund quadrupedal security droids into the hangar."

rows.original: “I hope you know how to use that,” Calnor growls, knocking your weapon with his power staff. “Take the ones coming from the front, I’ll cover the rear.”
rows.translation: “希望你懂得怎么用它，”卡尔诺用动力法杖敲了敲你的武器，低吼道。“你对付正面来的，我掩护后方。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I hope you know how to use that,” Calnor growls, knocking your weapon with his power staff. “Take the ones coming from the front, I’ll cover the rear.”"

rows.original: Fight!
rows.translation: 战斗！
rows.raw: "Fight!"

rows.original: TEAM UP!
rows.raw: "TEAM UP!"

rows.original: Team Up
rows.translation: 联手
rows.raw: "Team Up"

rows.original: Alright, you’re in. Better to work with the scientist than a crazed digital simulacrum.
rows.translation: 好吧，你加入。和科学家合作，总好过帮助一个疯狂的数字复制体。
rows.raw: "Alright, you’re in. Better to work with the scientist than a crazed digital simulacrum."

rows.original: Locked
rows.translation: 已锁定
rows.raw: "Locked"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “What happened to Valden?” you ask. “You said he’s dead, but...”
rows.translation: “瓦尔登出了什么事？”你问道。“你说他死了，可是……”
rows.raw: "“What happened to Valden?” you ask. “You said he’s dead, but...”"

rows.original: “By any real sense of the word, Commander Valden is dead,” Dr. Calnor says evenly. “There was a shunting error when we sent him through the transportation device. He ended up half-buried inside a wall; killed instantly.”
rows.translation: “从任何真正意义上讲，瓦尔登指挥官确实死了，”卡尔诺博士平静地说。“我们通过传送装置送他过去时发生了分流错误。他最后有一半身体埋进墙里，当场死亡。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“By any real sense of the word, Commander Valden is dead,” Dr. Calnor says evenly. “There was a shunting error when we sent him through the transportation device. He ended up half-buried inside a wall; killed instantly.”"

rows.original: “That doesn’t exactly make a lot of sense, considering he was just on the loudspeaker.”
rows.translation: “考虑到他刚才还在扩音器里说话，这话可不太说得通。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That doesn’t exactly make a lot of sense, considering he was just on the loudspeaker.”"

rows.original: Calnor grinds his teeth, searching for words you’ll understand. “What you’re hearing... what I assume you came here to recover... is nothing but an echo of the man. A digital facsimile recovered from the warp device’s buffer. The mental reconstruction we attempted was housed on a secure holo-analysis server in my lab. Unfortunately it seems your ill-advised escapades have caused a cascade failure in the facility’s cyber-security, and that digital echo has seized control of our systems.”
rows.translation: 卡尔诺咬紧牙齿，寻找你能够理解的措辞。“你听到的东西……我猜也是你来这里想要找回的东西……不过是那个人的回声。一个从跃迁装置缓冲区恢复的数字复制品。我们尝试重构的心智被存放在我实验室的一台安全全息分析服务器中。遗憾的是，看来你那欠考虑的胡闹令设施网络安全发生连锁故障，而那道数字回声已经夺取了系统控制权。”
rows.raw: "\n\nCalnor grinds his teeth, searching for words you’ll understand. “What you’re hearing... what I assume you came here to recover... is nothing but an echo of the man. A digital facsimile recovered from the warp device’s buffer. The mental reconstruction we attempted was housed on a secure holo-analysis server in my lab. Unfortunately it seems your ill-advised escapades have caused a cascade failure in the facility’s cyber-security, and that digital echo has seized control of our systems.”"

rows.original: “Oops.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oops.”"

rows.original: The doctor growls a curse under his breath and adjusts his grip on the shock staff. “Every security system, every wireless device, every robot in this facility is now slaved to an insane computer scan that thinks it’s a man. We are all in danger so long as Valden remains in control.”
rows.translation: 博士低声咒骂，调整了握住电击法杖的姿势。“如今这座设施里的每一套安保系统、每一台无线设备、每一个机器人，都受制于一份自以为是人类的疯狂计算机扫描人格。只要瓦尔登仍掌握控制权，我们所有人都身处险境。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe doctor growls a curse under his breath and adjusts his grip on the shock staff. “Every security system, every wireless device, every robot in this facility is now slaved to an insane computer scan that thinks it’s a man. We are all in danger so long as Valden remains in control.”"

rows.original: Valden
rows.translation: 瓦尔登
rows.raw: "Valden"

rows.original: Fight
rows.translation: 战斗
rows.raw: "Fight"

rows.original: Fight
rows.translation: 战斗
rows.raw: "Fight"

rows.original: You’re not letting this old hound get between you and rescuing Valden.
rows.translation: 你绝不会让这条老狗阻碍自己营救瓦尔登。
rows.raw: "You’re not letting this old hound get between you and rescuing Valden."

rows.original: Talk
rows.translation: 交谈
rows.raw: "Talk"

rows.original: Trade some words with the doctor before you trade blows.
rows.translation: 和博士交手之前，先交锋几句。
rows.raw: "Trade some words with the doctor before you trade blows."

rows.original: Fight
rows.translation: 战斗
rows.raw: "Fight"

rows.translation: 战斗
rows.raw: "Fight"

rows.original: You’re not letting this old hound get between you and rescuing Valden.
rows.translation: 你绝不会让这条老狗阻碍自己营救瓦尔登。
rows.raw: "You’re not letting this old hound get between you and rescuing Valden."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Hey there!” the floating ausar says, flashing you a disarmingly friendly smile. “Not what you expected, huh?”
rows.translation: “你好啊！”漂浮的奥萨说道，向你露出毫无戒心的友善笑容。“和你想的不一样，对吧？”
rows.raw: "“Hey there!” the floating ausar says, flashing you a disarmingly friendly smile. “Not what you expected, huh?”"

rows.original: You gotta admit, you came here searching for someone more... fleshy.
rows.translation: 你得承认，自己来这里寻找的是一个更……有血有肉的人。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou gotta admit, you came here searching for someone more... fleshy."

rows.original: He just laughs, “You came here for me, huh? Not to sound ungrateful, but... why?”
rows.translation: 他只是笑道：“你是来找我的，嗯？并非不领情，不过……为什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe just laughs, “You came here for me, huh? Not to sound ungrateful, but... why?”"

rows.original: “You remember Syri Dorna? She’s been looking for you.”
rows.translation: “你还记得希莉·多尔娜吗？她一直在找你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You remember Syri Dorna? She’s been looking for you.”"

rows.original: Valden laughs again, tail wagging. “Of course she has! Good girl! Gods above, I thought she’d died in the accident... bastards from Akkadi won’t tell me anything. I’ve been a prisoner in this digital prison for years now, cut off from the world. They’ve been experimenting on my body somewhere, and on my mind in here.”
rows.translation: 瓦尔登再次笑起来，尾巴不断摇摆。“她当然会找！好姑娘！诸神在上，我还以为她死在事故里了……阿卡迪的混蛋什么都不肯告诉我。我已经在这座数字监狱里当了多年囚犯，与世隔绝。他们在某处对我的身体做实验，也在这里研究我的心智。”
rows.raw: "\n\nValden laughs again, tail wagging. “Of course she has! Good girl! Gods above, I thought she’d died in the accident... bastards from Akkadi won’t tell me anything. I’ve been a prisoner in this digital prison for years now, cut off from the world. They’ve been experimenting on my body somewhere, and on my mind in here.”"

rows.original: “Listen, when the power outage struck, I was able to force down the facility’s digital security. I’ve got control of cameras, drones, defenses, everything... but there’s no way out. It’s a sealed system. I have to walk out of here, in some kind of body.”
rows.translation: “听着，停电发生时，我成功压制了设施的数字安保。我控制了摄像机、无人机、防御系统，一切……但没办法离开。这是个封闭系统。我必须用某种身体走出去。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Listen, when the power outage struck, I was able to force down the facility’s digital security. I’ve got control of cameras, drones, defenses, everything... but there’s no way out. It’s a sealed system. I have to walk out of here, in some kind of body.”"

rows.original: “You said you had control of security drones...”
rows.translation: “你说自己控制了安保无人机……”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You said you had control of security drones...”"

rows.original: He shakes his head. “Not happening. As much as I’d love to be a metal armadillo with a laser for a face, their mental storage is nowhere near enough to hold a person. I’d need a highly advanced android... or a person with cybernetic implants. Somebody like Doctor Calnor...”
rows.translation: 他摇摇头。“行不通。我虽然很乐意成为一只脸上装激光炮的金属犰狳，但它们的心智储存空间远不足以容纳一个人。我需要一台极为先进的仿生人……或者一个装有赛博植入体的人。比如卡尔诺博士……”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe shakes his head. “Not happening. As much as I’d love to be a metal armadillo with a laser for a face, their mental storage is nowhere near enough to hold a person. I’d need a highly advanced android... or a person with cybernetic implants. Somebody like Doctor Calnor...”"

rows.original: Calnor
rows.translation: 卡尔诺
rows.raw: "Calnor"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “So tell me about what you’d do with Calnor.”
rows.translation: “那么说说你打算怎么处置卡尔诺。”
rows.raw: "“So tell me about what you’d do with Calnor.”"

rows.original: A wicked grin plays across Valden’s digital lips. “The man’s got extensive cybernetic implants in his brain. Never know it from looking, but I’ve read his personnel file. It’s a good model... and I already chewed through its barriers. If you plug him into the main console here, I can upload myself into the implant’s memory banks and, uh, seize control, shall we say. Using some old cunt as a meat puppet isn’t my idea of a good time, but it beats being stuck here for the rest of time.”
rows.translation: 邪恶笑容浮现在瓦尔登的数字化嘴唇上。“那人脑子里装着大量赛博植入体。从外表绝对看不出来，不过我读过他的人事档案。型号不错……而且我已经咬穿了它的屏障。只要把他接进这里的主控制台，我就能把自己上传到植入体的记忆库里，然后，呃，可以说是夺取控制权。把某个老娘们当成肉体傀儡可算不上享受，但总比永远困在这里强。”
rows.raw: "\n\nA wicked grin plays across Valden’s digital lips. “The man’s got extensive cybernetic implants in his brain. Never know it from looking, but I’ve read his personnel file. It’s a good model... and I already chewed through its barriers. If you plug him into the main console here, I can upload myself into the implant’s memory banks and, uh, seize control, shall we say. Using some old cunt as a meat puppet isn’t my idea of a good time, but it beats being stuck here for the rest of time.”"

rows.original: For him, sure, but what about Calnor?
rows.translation: 对他而言当然如此，可卡尔诺怎么办？
rows.raw: "\n\nFor him, sure, but what about Calnor?"

rows.original: Valden shrugs. “When’d he ever ask, ‘but what about Valden,’ I wonder. Never, if the way Akkadi’s treated me is any indication. I’d just as soon see the bastard die for what he’s done, the immoral prick. But now he’s got a chance to repay the harm he’s done. If you’re gonna get bent out of shape about it, I’ll eject him onto a thumbdrive and mail him back to Akkadi.”
rows.translation: 瓦尔登耸了耸肩。“真想知道他什么时候问过‘可是瓦尔登怎么办’。从阿卡迪对待我的方式来看，一次都没有。那个不道德的混蛋做出这种事，我恨不得看他去死。不过现在他有机会偿还造成的伤害。要是你非得为此大发脾气，我就把他弹到U盘里，寄回阿卡迪。”
rows.raw: "\n\nValden shrugs. “When’d he ever ask, ‘but what about Valden,’ I wonder. Never, if the way Akkadi’s treated me is any indication. I’d just as soon see the bastard die for what he’s done, the immoral prick. But now he’s got a chance to repay the harm he’s done. If you’re gonna get bent out of shape about it, I’ll eject him onto a thumbdrive and mail him back to Akkadi.”"

rows.original: “That’s comforting,” a third voice says from the door. You turn, watching Dr. Calnor striding inside, carrying a cylindrical device under one arm and his shock-staff in the other. “You know I never wished you ill, Valden... but you’re not real. You’re an echo of a consciousness, slowly degrading, not alive in any way that matters. The most productive thing you could ever do is to help us with our research. Thanks to you, Akkadi’s A.I. research is a decade ahead of the competition... and thanks to the real Valden, gods rest him, we’ve learned more about Warp safety than in the last two hundred years combined.”
rows.translation: “真让人安心，”第三个声音从门口传来。你转过身，看着卡尔诺博士大步走进来，一条手臂夹着圆柱形装置，另一只手握着电击法杖。“你知道我从没希望你遭遇不幸，瓦尔登……可你不是真实的。你是一道缓慢退化的意识回声，根本算不上活着。你能做出的最有价值之事，就是协助我们的研究。多亏了你，阿卡迪的人工智能研究领先竞争对手十年……也多亏真正的瓦尔登，愿诸神安息他的灵魂，我们对跃迁安全的了解比过去两百年合计还多。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s comforting,” a third voice says from the door. You turn, watching Dr. Calnor striding inside, carrying a cylindrical device under one arm and his shock-staff in the other. “You know I never wished you ill, Valden... but you’re not real. You’re an echo of a consciousness, slowly degrading, not alive in any way that matters. The most productive thing you could ever do is to help us with our research. Thanks to you, Akkadi’s A.I. research is a decade ahead of the competition... and thanks to the real Valden, gods rest him, we’ve learned more about Warp safety than in the last two hundred years combined.”"

rows.original: “Fuck your research!” Valden shouts, slamming his fists against the glass barrier. “I’m a living, thinking man, not some curio you can keep locked up for all time. Damn your company and damn your learning, I want to leave!”
rows.translation: “去你妈的研究！”瓦尔登大喊着，双拳重重砸上玻璃屏障。“我是一个活着、会思考的人，不是供你们永远囚禁起来观赏的奇物。去你妈的公司，去你妈的学问，我要离开！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fuck your research!” Valden shouts, slamming his fists against the glass barrier. “I’m a living, thinking man, not some curio you can keep locked up for all time. Damn your company and damn your learning, I want to leave!”"

rows.original: Dr. Calnor sighs and plants his staff on the ground. “Not after all the damage you’ve done. You’re a buggy program, Commander. It’s time to be shut down.”
rows.translation: 卡尔诺博士叹了口气，将法杖立在地上。“在你造成如此严重的破坏后，不行。你是一段充满故障的程序，指挥官。该关机了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nDr. Calnor sighs and plants his staff on the ground. “Not after all the damage you’ve done. You’re a buggy program, Commander. It’s time to be shut down.”"

rows.original: “And you,” Calnor says, turning his attention to you. “You’re the one that caused all this. My patience for you is at an end. The Akkadi corporation has full legal authority to-”
rows.translation: “还有你，”卡尔诺将注意力转向你。“就是你造成了这一切。我对你的耐心已经耗尽。阿卡迪公司拥有完整合法权力——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And you,” Calnor says, turning his attention to you. “You’re the one that caused all this. My patience for you is at an end. The Akkadi corporation has full legal authority to-”"

rows.original: “Shut up and die, old man. Kill him!” Valden bellows, so loud that the speakers around you crackle and burst. “I mean, don’t kill him! Shit! Just beat him up so we can get out of here!”
rows.translation: “闭嘴去死吧，老头。杀了他！”瓦尔登大声咆哮，响到周围扬声器噼啪爆裂。“我是说，别杀他！妈的！只管揍他一顿，好让我们离开这里！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shut up and die, old man. Kill him!” Valden bellows, so loud that the speakers around you crackle and burst. “I mean, don’t kill him! Shit! Just beat him up so we can get out of here!”"

rows.original: It doesn’t look like Calnor’s going to wait for you to try and defuse the situation, even if you wanted to.
rows.translation: 看来即使你想尝试缓和局势，卡尔诺也不打算等你行动。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt doesn’t look like Calnor’s going to wait for you to try and defuse the situation, even if you wanted to."

rows.original: Fight!
rows.translation: 战斗！
rows.raw: "Fight!"

rows.original: Calnor
rows.translation: 卡尔诺
rows.raw: "Calnor"

rows.original: He could escape inside Dr. Calnor? Well, the way the doctor acted, it’s only a matter of time before he shows up here anyway...
rows.translation: 他可以藏进卡尔诺博士体内逃走？好吧，看博士刚才的表现，他出现在这里也只是时间问题……
rows.raw: "He could escape inside Dr. Calnor? Well, the way the doctor acted, it’s only a matter of time before he shows up here anyway..."

rows.original: Siegwulfe
rows.translation: 西格伍尔芙
rows.raw: "Siegwulfe"

rows.original: Siegwulfe
rows.translation: 西格伍尔芙
rows.raw: "Siegwulfe"

rows.original: Yeah, you’d never talk her into that.
rows.translation: 没错，你绝不可能说服她接受这件事。
rows.raw: "Yeah, you’d never talk her into that."

rows.original: Siegwulfe
rows.translation: 西格伍尔芙
rows.raw: "Siegwulfe"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: <i>“Well, I’ve got a
rows.translation: <i>“嗯，我这里有一位
rows.raw: "<i>“Well, I’ve got a "

rows.original: very good girl
rows.translation: 非常乖的姑娘
rows.raw: "very good girl"

rows.original: pretty advanced V.I. companion
rows.translation: 相当先进的虚拟智能伴侣
rows.raw: " pretty advanced V.I. companion"

rows.original: here,” you say, patting [wulfe.name]’s metal flank.
rows.translation: ，”你一边说，一边拍了拍[wulfe.name]的金属侧腹。
rows.raw: " here,” you say, patting [wulfe.name]’s metal flank."

rows.original: “I’m like, super smart and stuff!” the bimbofied sexbot ejaculates, giggling and groping an oversized boob.
rows.translation: “人家超级聪明什么的！”花瓶化的性爱机器人高喊着，咯咯发笑，同时揉捏一只超大乳房。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m like, super smart and stuff!” the bimbofied sexbot ejaculates, giggling and groping an oversized boob."

rows.original: “I am very advanced,” [wulfe.name] confirms. “Skilled in martial arts and companionship in equal measure.”
rows.translation: “我非常先进，”[wulfe.name]确认道。“无论武术还是陪伴技能都同样精通。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I am very advanced,” [wulfe.name] confirms. “Skilled in martial arts and companionship in equal measure.”"

rows.original: You’re not sure the V.I. realizes what you’re doing; it’s probably just programmed to hype itself up when you talk about it to other people.
rows.translation: 你不确定虚拟智能是否明白自己在做什么；它大概只是被设定成，当你向别人谈起它时就会自我吹捧。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re not sure the V.I. realizes what you’re doing; it’s probably just programmed to hype itself up when you talk about it to other people."

rows.original: That... almost makes it sadder.
rows.translation: 这……几乎让事情更令人难过了。
rows.raw: " That... almost makes it sadder."

rows.original: “Ugh,” Valden says, looking the oversexed companion droid up and down. “Why’s a robot gotta have tits that big? Oh well, better than staying in here. Marginally.”
rows.translation: “呃，”瓦尔登一边上下打量这台纵欲过度的伴侣机器人，一边说道。“机器人为什么非得有这么大的奶子？算了，总比待在这里好。好那么一点。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ugh,” Valden says, looking the oversexed companion droid up and down. “Why’s a robot gotta have tits that big? Oh well, better than staying in here. Marginally.”"

rows.original: “I mean... I was kind of hoping for something more humanoid, but I guess I’ll take what I can get. Anything’s better than staying here!”
rows.translation: “我是说……我本来希望得到更接近人形的东西，不过看来只能有什么用什么了。无论如何都比留在这里强！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I mean... I was kind of hoping for something more humanoid, but I guess I’ll take what I can get. Anything’s better than staying here!”"

rows.original: Alright. Might as well get this over with. You turn to [wulfe.name] and tell her to power down; you’re going to have to take out her V.I. core.
rows.translation: 好吧。不妨赶快把事情做完。你转向[wulfe.name]，命令她关机；你得取出她的虚拟智能核心。
rows.raw: "\n\nAlright. Might as well get this over with. You turn to [wulfe.name] and tell her to power down; you’re going to have to take out her V.I. core."

rows.original: “I live to serve, [pc.master],” [wulfe.name] says demurely. With a smile, she adds “See you soon.”
rows.translation: “我的生命只为服侍[pc.master]，”[wulfe.name]温顺地说道。她面带微笑补充：“一会儿见。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I live to serve, [pc.master],” [wulfe.name] says demurely. With a smile, she adds “See you soon.”"

rows.original: Yeah, about that.
rows.translation: 呃，说起这件事。
rows.raw: "\n\nYeah, about that."

rows.original: Oh...

You sigh as the companion hound powers down, sitting back on her haunches and falling still. The back of her head opens up with a little effort, ejecting the fist-sized datacore into your hand. You stuff it into your pocket and turn to the digitized ausar.
rows.translation: 你叹了口气，看着伴侣猎犬关机。她用后腿坐下，静止不动。你稍加用力便打开她的后脑，让拳头大小的数据核心弹入手中。你把它塞进口袋，转向数字化奥萨。
rows.raw: " You sigh as the companion hound powers down, sitting back on her haunches and falling still. The back of her head opens up with a little effort, ejecting the fist-sized datacore into your hand. You stuff it into your pocket and turn to the digitized ausar."

rows.original: “Alright,” Valden says. “There’s a core already plugged into the mainframe there. Gimme just a second aaaand... okay, I’m all set. Just plug me into your bot.”
rows.translation: “好了，”瓦尔登说道。“那里已经有一枚核心接进主机。给我一小会——好啦……行，准备完毕。只管把我接进你的机器人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright,” Valden says. “There’s a core already plugged into the mainframe there. Gimme just a second aaaand... okay, I’m all set. Just plug me into your bot.”"

rows.original: Without another word, Valden pushes off the glass wall, floating backwards in the holotank and slowly diffusing into a mist of fading light particles. Guess that’s it, then. You move over to the mainframe on the wall and eject the datacore Valden has been stored on all these years. It’s almost indistinguishable from [wulfe.name]’s, aside from the Akkadi logos all over it; it feels hotter to the touch, too, like the internal computers can barely contain the personality seething inside. You make quick work of plugging it into the vacant slot in [wulfe.name]’s head. A set of wires slither out of the siegwulfe’s cranium chamber, attaching themselves to the proffered datacore and locking it into place. Her head closes back up as soon as your hand is clear and she starts powering back up.
rows.translation: 瓦尔登一言不发地推开玻璃墙，在全息舱中向后漂浮，缓缓化为逐渐黯淡的光粒薄雾。看来就这样了。你走到墙上的主机旁，弹出多年来一直储存瓦尔登的数据核心。除了表面遍布阿卡迪标志，它与[wulfe.name]的核心几乎毫无差别；摸起来也更烫，仿佛内部计算机几乎压制不住其中沸腾的人格。你迅速将其插入[wulfe.name]头部空置的插槽。几根导线从西格伍尔芙的颅腔中蜿蜒而出，接上递来的数据核心，将其锁定到位。你的手刚一离开，她的头部便重新闭合，随即开始启动。
rows.raw: "\n\nWithout another word, Valden pushes off the glass wall, floating backwards in the holotank and slowly diffusing into a mist of fading light particles. Guess that’s it, then. You move over to the mainframe on the wall and eject the datacore Valden has been stored on all these years. It’s almost indistinguishable from [wulfe.name]’s, aside from the Akkadi logos all over it; it feels hotter to the touch, too, like the internal computers can barely contain the personality seething inside. You make quick work of plugging it into the vacant slot in [wulfe.name]’s head. A set of wires slither out of the siegwulfe’s cranium chamber, attaching themselves to the proffered datacore and locking it into place. Her head closes back up as soon as your hand is clear and she starts powering back up."

rows.original: Or he, you should say. The Siegwulfe’s eyes flash open, blood red and intense as ever, but her familiar smile is replaced by a firm scowl. The voice is the same, smooth and feminine, but lacks any of the seductive lilt of its former intelligence.
rows.translation: 或者该说是他。西格伍尔芙双眼猛然睁开，依旧闪耀着强烈的血红光芒，但熟悉的笑容已被严厉怒容取代。声音依旧平滑柔美，却不再带有原先智能那种魅惑语调。
rows.raw: "\n\nOr he, you should say. The Siegwulfe’s eyes flash open, blood red and intense as ever, but her familiar smile is replaced by a firm scowl. The voice is the same, smooth and feminine, but lacks any of the seductive lilt of its former intelligence."

rows.original: “Woah,” the Valden-inhabited Siegwulfe says, looking at the drone’s hands with wide eyes. “Ech, I sound like a woman. And these legs...”
rows.translation: “哇，”被瓦尔登占据的西格伍尔芙睁大眼睛，看着无人机的双手说道。“呃，我听起来像个女人。还有这些腿……”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Woah,” the Valden-inhabited Siegwulfe says, looking at the drone’s hands with wide eyes. “Ech, I sound like a woman. And these legs...”"

rows.original: She -- he! -- canters backwards, looking over his shoulder at the drone’s tauric lower body. Valden’s claws scratch at the floor, getting used to his new body. The adjustment period only lasts a few seconds before he turns to you. “Well this body doesn’t really feel too much... other than this burning sensation between the haunches, anyway. But it’s good to be able to move around. Gods, you can’t imagine being trapped in the same little tank for years and years, seeing the same room from the same perspective nonstop.”
rows.translation: 她——他！——小跑着向后退去，扭头看向无人机的牛身下体。瓦尔登的爪子刮过地板，适应着新身体。调整期只持续几秒，他便转向你。“嗯，这具身体的感觉不太灵敏……除了两条后腿之间那种灼热感。不过能四处活动总归不错。诸神啊，你无法想象被困在同一个小舱里年复一年，不间断地从同一个角度看着同一间房是什么滋味。”

rows.original: You decide to ask Tanis about his job. Was there a special reason why he became a scout? The leithan shrugs — a motion that is mirrored by his reptilian back. “I’m afraid there isn’t much of a story behind it. I was a hunter back home, and I love the feel of braving the unknown, so this job was a perfect fit for me.” Your eyes are drawn to the trophies hanging from the wall behind him. You can’t even identify most of the beasts, but each and every one looks vicious: full of sharp teeth, claws, or both. Not a speck of dust can be found on them; it’s clear that Tanis takes pride in his hunting skills. Still, you give him a puzzled look, not satisfied with such a short reply. As far as you know, most leithans who leave their homeworld are looking for peaceful environs, not a Rush planet filled with potential dangers. The scout muses for a moment, raising a hand to his chin and looking up in an almost clichéd manner. “You’re not wrong. My home, Leitha, is a very hostile place, even after all the technology we’ve received from the U.G.C. To most leithans, the supposed ‘peace and quiet’ of a core world sounds like paradise.” And yet Tanis came to a Rush planet, of all places. Is he addicted to adrenaline or something? The scout chuckles. “I don’t know, maybe a little. Have you watched kaiju movies? That’s not too far from our reality back home. I’ve had to run and hide from beasts larger than any building you’ll find in this settlement. Nothing I’ve seen here in Mhen’ga can compare, so this place is pretty peaceful by my reckoning!” You give him a slow nod, now that you have a better grasp of his perspective. “What about you, [pc.mfn |Mr |Ms |Ser ]Steele? If you don’t mind me asking. It’s not every day you see the heir of a megacorp come to a frontier planet[pc.mfn | himself | herself | themself ], least of all as a rusher!” he says in an appreciative tone, his eyes taking stock of your gear. You shrug and proceed to tell him about your circumstances, as well as your quest. Tanis listens attentively, and by the end of it, he’s practically glowing with admiration. It’s pretty obvious that he has an even higher opinion of you now. The fact that he took everything you said at face value... It actually makes you a little worried. Does he have a good eye for people, or is he just a himbo? “I’ll be rooting for you, [pc.mfn |Mr |Ms |Ser ]Steele! Please let me know if there’s anything this scout can help you with,” the tauric man offers, with a heartfelt smile. You pause for a moment, trying to discern if there is a deeper meaning behind his words. The himbo’s smile is very warm, but you still can’t tell if he meant it just professionally, or if his interest in you goes beyond it... Either way, it’s time to change the topic.
rows.translation: 你决定询问塔尼斯的工作。他成为侦察员有什么特别原因吗？ 利坦耸了耸肩——这个动作也在他的爬虫类后背上显现出来。“恐怕这背后没什么精彩故事。我在老家是一名猎人，又喜欢勇闯未知的感觉，所以这份工作非常适合我。” 你的视线被挂在他身后墙上的战利品吸引。大部分野兽你甚至无法辨认，但每一头看起来都极其凶猛：长满尖牙、利爪，或者两者兼具。上面看不见半点灰尘；塔尼斯显然为自己的狩猎本领感到骄傲。 不过，这么简短的回答无法令你满足，你仍困惑地看着他。据你所知，大多数离开母星的利坦都在寻找安宁环境，而不是一颗充满潜在危险的大开发星球。 侦察员思索片刻，抬手抵住下巴，以近乎老套的姿势仰头望去。“你说得没错。我的故乡利塔环境极其险恶，即使我们已经获得联合银河邦联的各种技术也一样。对大多数利坦来说，核心世界所谓的‘和平宁静’听起来简直像天堂。” 可塔尼斯偏偏来到了一颗大开发星球。他是对肾上腺素上瘾之类的吗？ 侦察员轻笑。“我不知道，也许有一点。你看过怪兽电影吗？那和我们老家的现实相差不远。我曾不得不躲避体型大过这座聚居地任何建筑的野兽。我在门加见过的一切都无法与之相比，所以按我的标准，这里相当安宁！” 如今你更加理解他的视角，于是缓缓点头。 “那么你呢，[pc.mfn |Mr |Ms |Ser ]Steele？如果你不介意我问的话。可不是每天都能看见一家巨型企业的继承人[pc.mfn |亲自 |亲自 |亲自 ]来到边境星球，更别说还是作为一名开发者！”他以赞赏的语气说道，双眼打量着你的装备。 你耸了耸肩，接着把自己的处境和任务告诉他。 塔尼斯专心倾听，到最后，他几乎因敬佩而容光焕发。显然，他如今对你的评价更高了。他对你说的一切照单全收……这反倒让你有些担心。他很会看人，还是单纯只是个胸大无脑的帅哥？ “我会为你加油的，[pc.mfn |Mr |Ms |Ser ]Steele！如果有什么是这名侦察员能帮上忙的，请尽管告诉我。”这名牛身男子带着真诚笑容主动说道。 你停顿片刻，试图判断他的话里是否另有深意。这个胸大无脑帅哥的笑容十分温暖，但你仍看不出他只是出于职业立场，还是对你的兴趣远不止于此…… 无论如何，该换个话题了。

rows.original: You tell Tanis you’d like to know more about him. “I’m honored by your interest, [pc.mfn |Mr |Ms |Ser ]Steele, but I’m a simple scout. There isn’t much to tell.” Wait, is that a bit of a blush on his cheeks? This guy is really transparent... You smirk at him — come on, there’s gotta be more than that. What was his life like growing up? Does he have any siblings? “I do! Five clutch-sisters.” You blink. So, he was the only male in the clutch? “Yeah, and I’m the youngest,” the leithan starts, sheepishly. “Mom says everyone was worried because my egg was taking too long to hatch; my newborn sisters didn’t know left from right but they instinctively huddled up around to keep me warm until the shell finally cracked.” Wow. What was it like to grow up as the only boy in the club? The scout chuckles. “Well, I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t at least a bit pampered. They took me everywhere I wanted to go, got me delicious food, played all the games I liked...” Your mouth turns into a thin line as you can’t help but contrast this with the relative solitude of your childhood: Dad getting stuck at work, distant relatives, no siblings to play with... Of course, you don’t outright say any of this, but something in your expression must have tipped Tanis off, as his mouth shifts into an awkward smile. “It wasn’t all good though. Don’t get me wrong, I love my sisters more than anything, but they could be really overprotective... Took me ages to get my first girlfriend because no one was good enough for them. Not that it stopped me from fooling around. Came a point they wouldn’t let me leave the house without at least two of them to keep an eye on me.” You chuckle. That must have been rough. “Can’t blame them, though — I was a handful; always playing with dangerous things.” He turns slightly to show you a large, faded scar at the base of his tail, in a small area not protected by chitinous plates. “This was from trying to feed a wild rockbird when I was twelve; it started chasing me after the food ran out,” he chuckles as if that was nothing. It’s funny how people can sometimes look at the past and laugh at painful memories. “When I said I wanted to join the hunters’ guild, they almost had a heart attack. If Mom hadn’t laid down the word, I might have been forced to pick a different occupation...” ...and then you wouldn’t have been able to meet Tanis. That’s a sad thought. But say, doesn’t Tanis miss his family? He speaks of them fondly, despite everything. A complex mix of emotions crosses the leithan’s face. “I’d be lying if I said I didn’t, but at the same time, they’re the reason I decided to leave home in the first place. I felt like I would be their ‘precious baby brother’ forever if I stayed.” You nod sympathetically, having gone through a similar separation ritual when you left the nest to work as a [pc.class]. That was the last time you saw him in person... Trying to shift things in a lighter direction, you point out that Tanis seems to be doing well for himself on Mhen’ga. The scout smiles warmly. “I dare say I am! The pay is decent, and the locals are super friendly. If you get what I mean,” the blond himbo winks. You chuckle at that. Maybe you should ask him to show you around one of these days. “I would love to!”
rows.translation: 你告诉塔尼斯，自己想进一步了解他。 “你对我感兴趣，令我十分荣幸，[pc.mfn |Mr |Ms |Ser ]Steele，不过我只是一名普通侦察员。没多少事情可讲。”等等，他脸颊上是不是泛起了一点红晕？这家伙真是毫不掩饰…… 你冲他坏笑——得了吧，肯定不止这些。他成长时过着怎样的生活？有没有兄弟姐妹？ “有！五个同窝姐妹。” 你眨了眨眼。那么，他是那窝蛋里唯一的男性？ “是啊，而且我最小，”利坦有些难为情地说道。“妈妈说，所有人都很担心，因为我的蛋迟迟没有孵化；刚出生的姐姐们连左右都分不清，却本能地挤在周围替我保暖，直到蛋壳终于裂开。” 哇。作为家里唯一的男孩长大是什么感觉？ 侦察员轻笑。“嗯，要说自己一点都没被宠坏，那肯定是在撒谎。她们带我去任何想去的地方，给我弄好吃的，陪我玩喜欢的所有游戏……” 你的嘴抿成一条细线，忍不住把这和自己相对孤独的童年作比较：爸爸总被工作困住，亲戚疏远，也没有兄弟姐妹陪你玩……当然，你并没有把这些直接说出口，可你的某种神情一定让塔尼斯看出了端倪，因为他的嘴角变成了尴尬的笑容。 “不过也不全是好事。别误会，我爱姐姐们胜过一切，可她们有时候实在保护过度……我花了好久才交到第一个女朋友，因为她们觉得谁都配不上我。倒也没有妨碍我到处鬼混。后来甚至发展到我每次出门，她们都非得派至少两个人盯着我。” 你轻笑一声。那肯定很难熬。 “也不能怪她们——我小时候很难管，总爱玩危险的东西。”他微微侧身，向你展示尾巴根部一大片褪色疤痕，那里只有一小块没有甲壳板保护。“这是我十二岁时试着喂一只野生岩鸟留下的；食物吃完后，它就开始追我。”他笑得仿佛那根本不值一提。人们有时能回望过去，对痛苦记忆一笑置之，实在有趣。“我说想加入猎人公会时，她们差点心脏病发作。如果妈妈没有一锤定音，我恐怕会被迫选择别的职业……” ……那样的话，你就不会遇见塔尼斯了。想来真令人难过。不过话说回来，塔尼斯不想念家人吗？尽管经历了这些，他谈起她们时依旧充满感情。 复杂的情绪交织着掠过利坦的脸。“要说自己不想她们，那肯定是在撒谎，可与此同时，她们也是我最初决定离家的原因。如果留下来，我觉得自己永远都会是她们的‘宝贝小弟弟’。” 你同情地点点头；离开家巢从事[pc.class]工作时，你也经历过类似的分离仪式。那就是你最后一次亲眼见到他……为了让话题轻松一点，你指出塔尼斯似乎在门加过得不错。 侦察员温暖地笑了。“可以说确实如此！薪水不错，本地人又超级友善。你懂我的意思。”这个金发的胸大无脑帅哥眨了眨眼。 你闻言轻笑。也许哪天该请他带你四处转转。 “我非常乐意！”

rows.original: He points one of his yellow-clawed fingers at the bow slung over your shoulder. You blink in surprise - you’d expect to get compliments on a cool new-tech gun or a plasma sword or something, but a simple bow? You’re only a few thousand years out of date there. Still, you can’t help but grin at the comment, out of left field as it is.
rows.translation: 他用一根长着黄色爪子的手指指向你肩上背着的弓。你惊讶地眨了眨眼 - 你以为别人会夸你酷炫的新科技枪械、等离子剑之类的东西，可一把普通的弓？这玩意儿已经过时几千年了。尽管这番称赞出乎意料，你还是忍不住咧嘴笑了。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe points one of his yellow-clawed fingers at the bow slung over your shoulder. You blink in surprise - you’d expect to get compliments on a cool new-tech gun or a plasma sword or something, but a simple bow? You’re only a few thousand years out of date there. Still, you can’t help but grin at the comment, out of left field as it is."

rows.original: “Can’t beat the classics, right? I used to do a lot of bowhunting back on Leitha, myself. One of the reasons I volunteered to come out here, too: plenty of wild game, and a good recurve bow puts me right on level with the natives. Makes it a fair fight when they try to get a little frisky.” He laughs and clatters up onto his long, clawed feet, giving you a first-hand look at his impressive height: he’s nearly ten feet tall, a gray-skinned humanoid from the waist up sat atop a reptilian lower body on six powerful legs. A reptilian tail coils behind him, dexterously avoiding the shelves of hunting trophies behind the desk.
rows.translation: “经典永不过时，对吧？我以前在莱萨时，经常用弓打猎。这也是我自愿来这里的原因之一：这里有大量野味，一把好的反曲弓就能让我和当地人站在同一起跑线上。他们想闹点事时，也算公平较量。”他笑着站起身，带爪的长足发出嗒嗒声，让你亲眼见识到他惊人的身高：他将近十英尺高，腰部以上是灰肤的人形躯干，下接爬行类的身躯，由六条强壮的腿支撑。一条爬行类尾巴在他身后盘卷，灵巧地避开桌后摆满狩猎战利品的架子。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Can’t beat the classics, right? I used to do a lot of bowhunting back on Leitha, myself. One of the reasons I volunteered to come out here, too: plenty of wild game, and a good recurve bow puts me right on level with the natives. Makes it a fair fight when they try to get a little frisky.” He laughs and clatters up onto his long, clawed feet, giving you a first-hand look at his impressive height: he’s nearly ten feet tall, a gray-skinned humanoid from the waist up sat atop a reptilian lower body on six powerful legs. A reptilian tail coils behind him, dexterously avoiding the shelves of hunting trophies behind the desk."

rows.original: “Big game bowhunter, huh?” you ask, eyeing the trophies behind him.
rows.translation: “用弓狩猎大型猎物，嗯？”你问道，打量着他身后的战利品。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Big game bowhunter, huh?” you ask, eyeing the trophies behind him."

rows.original: He grins, extending a hand to you. “Pretty much. Name’s Tanisaran, by the way. Tanisaran Alhelvan. Tanis for short.”
rows.translation: 他咧嘴一笑，向你伸出手。“差不多。顺带一提，我叫塔妮萨兰。塔妮萨兰·阿赫尔凡。简称塔妮丝。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe grins, extending a hand to you. “Pretty much. Name’s Tanisaran, by the way. Tanisaran Alhelvan. Tanis for short.”"

rows.original: You shake it, noticing his grip is surprisingly gentle - though that may just be him trying not to score your hand with his sharpened claws. “Anyway! You probably wanted to rent a shuttle, right? Something tells me you didn’t just come around to gab about bows.”
rows.translation: 你和他握了握手，发现他的力道出乎意料地轻柔 - 不过这也可能只是他不想让锋利的爪子划伤你的手。“总之！你应该是想租穿梭机，对吧？我总觉得你不是专程来聊弓的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shake it, noticing his grip is surprisingly gentle - though that may just be him trying not to score your hand with his sharpened claws. “Anyway! You probably wanted to rent a shuttle, right? Something tells me you didn’t just come around to gab about bows.”"

rows.original: “Hey, [pc.name],” Tanis grins as you start to ask about a training session. “Hold that thought a second - I got something for you.”
rows.translation: “嘿，[pc.name]，”你刚开口询问训练的事，塔妮丝便咧嘴笑道。“先等一下 - 我有东西给你。”
rows.raw: "“Hey, [pc.name],” Tanis grins as you start to ask about a training session. “Hold that thought a second - I got something for you.”"

rows.original: You follow the big leithan with your eyes as he hops up onto his hexapedal legs and goes around to a small box leaning against the wall. He hefts it up and hands it to you: the box is fairly narrow but very long, three or four feet at least, but feather-light despite its size. “Check it out,” he urges, lizard tail swishing quickly behind him.
rows.translation: 你注视着这位高大的莱萨人。他用六条腿站起身，绕到墙边的一个小盒子旁，把它拿起来递给你：盒子很窄，却很长，至少有三四英尺，但尽管体积不小，却轻如鸿毛。“打开看看，”他催促道，蜥蜴般的尾巴在身后飞快摆动。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou follow the big leithan with your eyes as he hops up onto his hexapedal legs and goes around to a small box leaning against the wall. He hefts it up and hands it to you: the box is fairly narrow but very long, three or four feet at least, but feather-light despite its size. “Check it out,” he urges, lizard tail swishing quickly behind him."

rows.original: You open it, tearing away a string and popping the top off. Inside the box, nestled amongst a bed of packing peanuts and shredded paper, is a compound bow made of the same alien wood and of the same tremendous length that Tanis has been using during your training sessions. With wide eyes, you pick the bow up and heft it in your hands - it weighs next to nothing, and an experimental draw makes the heavy string feel like pulling air thanks to the network of wheels and pulleys supporting your motions.
rows.translation: 你扯断系绳，掀开盒盖。盒子里，一把复合弓躺在泡沫填充粒和碎纸之间，材质是塔妮丝在训练时使用的那种外星木材，长度也同样惊人。你睁大眼睛，拿起弓在手里掂了掂 - 它几乎轻若无物，而在辅助你动作的滑轮组作用下，你试着拉了一下弓，厚重的弓弦却像拉空气一样轻松。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou open it, tearing away a string and popping the top off. Inside the box, nestled amongst a bed of packing peanuts and shredded paper, is a compound bow made of the same alien wood and of the same tremendous length that Tanis has been using during your training sessions. With wide eyes, you pick the bow up and heft it in your hands - it weighs next to nothing, and an experimental draw makes the heavy string feel like pulling air thanks to the network of wheels and pulleys supporting your motions."

rows.original: “It’s awesome,” you breathe, aiming down the shaft of an imaginary arrow.
rows.translation: “太棒了，”你轻声赞叹，沿着一支想象中的箭瞄准。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s awesome,” you breathe, aiming down the shaft of an imaginary arrow."

rows.original: Tanis grins big. <i>“Glad you like it. It’s yours - if you want it. I figured an expert archer like you deserves a bow worthy of the title. This one’s straight from my family back on Leitha.
rows.translation: 塔妮丝笑得灿烂。<i>“你喜欢就好。送你了 - 只要你愿意收下。我想，像你这样的神射手，值得拥有一把配得上这称号的弓。这把是我在莱萨的家人直接寄来的。
rows.raw: "\n\nTanis grins big. <i>“Glad you like it. It’s yours - if you want it. I figured an expert archer like you deserves a bow worthy of the title. This one’s straight from my family back on Leitha."

rows.original: It, uh, might be a little big for you, but with the wheels on it you shouldn’t have any trouble with the draw.

rows.raw: " It, uh, might be a little big for you, but with the wheels on it you shouldn’t have any trouble with the draw."
