rows.original: He fishes around beneath his desk for a moment, pulling a towering bow out from under it. It’s not quite like your bow: bigger, though proportional to his size, and made of a material you can’t quite place. Some alien wood, you’d imagine, though the way he hefts it around makes you think it’s much heavier than any bow you’ve ever seen before. He waves you over around the counter to a small back door that leads you out to the edge of the Mhen’gan jungle.
rows.translation: 他在桌下摸索片刻，从下面抽出一张高大的弓。它和你的弓不太一样：尺寸更大，不过与他的体型相称，材质你也认不出来。你猜是某种外星木材，不过从他挥动它的样子来看，它恐怕比你见过的任何弓都沉得多。他招手让你绕过柜台，来到一扇小后门前，带你走到门加丛林的边缘。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe fishes around beneath his desk for a moment, pulling a towering bow out from under it. It’s not quite like your bow: bigger, though proportional to his size, and made of a material you can’t quite place. Some alien wood, you’d imagine, though the way he hefts it around makes you think it’s much heavier than any bow you’ve ever seen before. He waves you over around the counter to a small back door that leads you out to the edge of the Mhen’gan jungle."

rows.original: “So, no formal training, right?” Tanis says, less a question and more an amused statement of fact. When you nod, he chuckles. “Don’t worry about it. Most people don’t. Bowmanship’s kind of a lost art these days, you know. Some of us leithans keep up the old art: nowhere in the galaxy has game like Leitha, though you have to be ready to be prey as much as predator on our homeworld. A strong, silent shot will get you further than the big bang of a rifle when there’s monsters the size of houses eager to eat you. If you can bring down a kill without drawing unwanted attention, well, you can’t do much better than a bow.”
rows.translation: “所以，没受过正式训练，对吧？”塔妮丝说道，这更像是在饶有兴味地陈述事实，而非提问。你点头时，他轻笑起来。“别担心。大多数人都没学过。如今弓术也算是种失传的技艺了，你知道的。我们有些莱萨人还保留着这门古老手艺：银河系里没有哪里的猎物能比得上莱萨，不过在我们母星，你既得做好当猎手的准备，也得做好当猎物的准备。当房子那么大的怪物虎视眈眈地想吃掉你时，强劲无声的一箭可比步枪轰的一声管用。要是你想放倒猎物，又不引来多余的注意，那就几乎没什么比弓更合适了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, no formal training, right?” Tanis says, less a question and more an amused statement of fact. When you nod, he chuckles. “Don’t worry about it. Most people don’t. Bowmanship’s kind of a lost art these days, you know. Some of us leithans keep up the old art: nowhere in the galaxy has game like Leitha, though you have to be ready to be prey as much as predator on our homeworld. A strong, silent shot will get you further than the big bang of a rifle when there’s monsters the size of houses eager to eat you. If you can bring down a kill without drawing unwanted attention, well, you can’t do much better than a bow.”"

rows.original: As if for emphasis, Tanis pulls an arrow from his back and, in one swift motion, nocks and looses it into the side of a nearby tree. A muted twang echoes as the bowstring snaps home, but you have to admit he’s right: the shot’s an order of magnitude quieter than a gunshot.
rows.translation: 仿佛为了强调这点，塔妮丝从背后抽出一支箭，迅捷地搭弦射出，钉入附近一棵树的侧面。弓弦回弹时发出一声低沉的嗡鸣，但你不得不承认他说得对：这一箭的声音比枪声小了整整一个量级。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs if for emphasis, Tanis pulls an arrow from his back and, in one swift motion, nocks and looses it into the side of a nearby tree. A muted twang echoes as the bowstring snaps home, but you have to admit he’s right: the shot’s an order of magnitude quieter than a gunshot."

rows.original: Never mind that it’s not hard to get a suppressor for a gun. You’re here to learn, not be pedantic.
rows.translation: 先不提给枪弄个消音器也不难。你是来学习的，不是来抬杠的。
rows.raw: " Never mind that it’s not hard to get a suppressor for a gun. You’re here to learn, not be pedantic."

rows.original: “So yeah!” he grins, resting his hands on the top of his bow. “My family’s been handing down these shooting techniques for centuries. I can show you the quick and dirty rundown of the basics today, but if you wanna get really good with this,” he says, reaching over to run a finger along the curve of your bow. “It’ll take some time and dedication, you know.”
rows.translation: “所以就是这样！”他咧嘴笑着，双手搭在弓的顶端。“我家的这些射术已经传承了几百年。今天我可以先粗略教你些基础，不过要是你想把这个玩得真正出神入化，”他说着，伸手用一根手指沿着你弓的弧线划过。“那就得投入些时间和心血了，你懂的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So yeah!” he grins, resting his hands on the top of his bow. “My family’s been handing down these shooting techniques for centuries. I can show you the quick and dirty rundown of the basics today, but if you wanna get really good with this,” he says, reaching over to run a finger along the curve of your bow. “It’ll take some time and dedication, you know.”"

rows.original: You nod.
rows.translation: 你点点头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod."

rows.original: “Cool! Yeah, alright, so come over here and let’s start talking about stance.”
rows.translation: “好极了！嗯，行，那过来吧，我们先聊聊站姿。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Cool! Yeah, alright, so come over here and let’s start talking about stance.”"

rows.original: Tanis waves you over, and for the next several minutes you’re treated to an expert study in planting your [pc.feet] a certain way.
rows.translation: 塔妮丝招手让你过去，接下来的几分钟里，你接受了一番专业指导，学习如何以特定方式摆放[pc.feet]。
rows.raw: "\n\nTanis waves you over, and for the next several minutes you’re treated to an expert study in planting your [pc.feet] a certain way."

rows.original: Tanis certainly seems to be experienced with teaching humanoids, as he seems to know your lower body just as well as you do. He’s quickly got you standing like a shining example of an archer.
rows.translation: 塔妮丝显然很有教导人形生物的经验，因为他对你下半身的了解似乎不亚于你自己。他很快就让你摆出了堪称射手典范的站姿。
rows.raw: " Tanis certainly seems to be experienced with teaching humanoids, as he seems to know your lower body just as well as you do. He’s quickly got you standing like a shining example of an archer."

rows.original: Your alien lower body seems to get in the way a bit, since you’ve got no proper feet to place. Tanis spends as much time trying to figure your body out as he does instructing you. Eventually, though, he finds a stance that he thinks will work for you, though it’s a bit awkward to hold for more than a few moments. “Gotta build up those abdominal muscles!” he declares, using a hand to straighten your back out.
rows.translation: 你的异形下半身似乎有些碍事，毕竟你没有能好好摆放的双脚。塔妮丝花在研究你身体上的时间，和指导你的时间一样多。不过最后，他还是找到了一种自认为适合你的姿势，尽管维持稍久一些就有点别扭。“得练练这些腹肌！”他宣布道，伸手把你的背扶直。
rows.raw: " Your alien lower body seems to get in the way a bit, since you’ve got no proper feet to place. Tanis spends as much time trying to figure your body out as he does instructing you. Eventually, though, he finds a stance that he thinks will work for you, though it’s a bit awkward to hold for more than a few moments. “Gotta build up those abdominal muscles!” he declares, using a hand to straighten your back out."

rows.original: Tanis is an experienced teacher, of that you have no doubt. He circles your tauric body with a serpent-like grace, using his bow like a staff to shove your legs into proper form. You suck in a sharp breath when his hand is suddenly on your back, forcing you to sit up straight as an arrow.
rows.translation: 塔妮丝是个经验丰富的老师，这一点你毫不怀疑。他如蛇般优雅地绕着你半人马型的身体走动，把弓当作长杖，将你的腿推到正确的位置。他的手忽然搭上你的背，迫使你坐得笔直，你不由得猛吸一口气。
rows.raw: " Tanis is an experienced teacher, of that you have no doubt. He circles your tauric body with a serpent-like grace, using his bow like a staff to shove your legs into proper form. You suck in a sharp breath when his hand is suddenly on your back, forcing you to sit up straight as an arrow."

rows.original: <i>“There we go, much better. Just hold that pose for a minute. Pretty different from just shooting a gun, right? It’s all about the stance, trust me. Well, that and a lot of hand-eye coordination.
rows.translation: <i>“好了，这样好多了。保持这个姿势一分钟。和开枪完全不一样，对吧？关键在姿势，相信我。当然，还得有很好的手眼协调能力。
rows.raw: " <i>“There we go, much better. Just hold that pose for a minute. Pretty different from just shooting a gun, right? It’s all about the stance, trust me. Well, that and a lot of hand-eye coordination."

rows.original: But I think you’ve got that covered.
rows.translation: 不过我觉得这方面你没问题。
rows.raw: " But I think you’ve got that covered."

rows.original: But we’ll work on that. No worries.
rows.translation: 不过我们会练的。别担心。
rows.raw: " But we’ll work on that. No worries."

rows.original: You dutifully follow Tanis’s direction, following the shirtless centaur with your eyes as he sidles up beside you and draws back another arrow. He guides you through it, correcting slight imperfections in your draw and the way you hold your arrows. All the while, he’s nothing but positive, all smiles and bright eyes even as he’s correcting the same silly mistake for the third time.
rows.translation: 你认真听从塔妮丝的指导，目光追随着这位赤裸上身的半人马，看他侧身来到你身旁，再次搭箭拉弓。他引导你完成动作，纠正你拉弓和握箭时的细微错误。整个过程中他始终充满鼓励，就算第三次纠正同一个傻错误时，也依旧笑容满面、目光明亮。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou dutifully follow Tanis’s direction, following the shirtless centaur with your eyes as he sidles up beside you and draws back another arrow. He guides you through it, correcting slight imperfections in your draw and the way you hold your arrows. All the while, he’s nothing but positive, all smiles and bright eyes even as he’s correcting the same silly mistake for the third time."

rows.original: Finally, you’re ready to take your first actual shot of the session. Tanis plants a guiding hand on your shoulder, pressing in close enough that he’s practically looking down the shaft of your arrow with you. He points out a low-hanging purple fruit on a nearby tree and gives the word to bring it down.
rows.translation: 终于，你准备射出这堂课的第一箭。塔妮丝把手搭在你的肩上引导你，靠得如此之近，几乎和你一起沿着箭杆瞄准。他指向附近树上一颗低垂的紫色果实，示意你把它射下来。
rows.raw: "\n\nFinally, you’re ready to take your first actual shot of the session. Tanis plants a guiding hand on your shoulder, pressing in close enough that he’s practically looking down the shaft of your arrow with you. He points out a low-hanging purple fruit on a nearby tree and gives the word to bring it down."

rows.original: You draw back, breathe out, and let fly. The arrow sinks into the fruit with explosive force, splattering it all over the forest floor. You pump a victorious fist in the air, and are rewarded with a slap on the back from your tauric teacher.
rows.translation: 你拉弓，吐气，放箭。箭矢带着爆炸般的力量扎进果实，将果肉溅得满地都是。你胜利地向空中挥拳，而你的半人马老师也在你背上拍了一掌，作为嘉奖。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou draw back, breathe out, and let fly. The arrow sinks into the fruit with explosive force, splattering it all over the forest floor. You pump a victorious fist in the air, and are rewarded with a slap on the back from your tauric teacher."

rows.original: “Haha! Awesome work. You’re a natural, [pc.name].”
rows.translation: “哈哈！干得漂亮。你真是天生的射手，[pc.name]。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Haha! Awesome work. You’re a natural, [pc.name].”"

rows.original: You let loose, and watch with a sinking heart as the arrow sails wide, barely nicking your target before hammering into the tree’s bark. With a sigh, you slump your shoulders and plant your bow in the dirt.
rows.translation: 你松弦放箭，随即心头一沉，看着箭矢偏离轨迹，只擦到目标一点，便重重钉进树皮里。你叹了口气，垂下肩膀，把弓支在泥地上。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou let loose, and watch with a sinking heart as the arrow sails wide, barely nicking your target before hammering into the tree’s bark. With a sigh, you slump your shoulders and plant your bow in the dirt."

rows.original: “Hey, don’t give up,” Tanis laughs, squeezing your shoulder. “That was damn close. We’ll get you there, don’t you doubt it.”
rows.translation: “嘿，别放弃，”塔妮丝笑着捏了捏你的肩膀。“就差那么一点了。我们会让你练成的，别怀疑。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, don’t give up,” Tanis laughs, squeezing your shoulder. “That was damn close. We’ll get you there, don’t you doubt it.”"

rows.original: Easy for him to say.
rows.translation: 他说得倒轻巧。
rows.raw: "\n\nEasy for him to say."

rows.original: “Alright, let’s call it here for now,” Tanis says, stretching enough to audibly crack his back. “Can’t just leave the shop abandoned all day, after all. You’ve got the basics down, I think, but we can pick it up again if you want to really dig into it. Especially if you want to use that bow of yours for self defense. Some might say that’s a suboptimal choice compared to, say, a laser pistol or a plasma caster, but a bow like this is a real tack-driver. A more precise weapon from a more noble time, you know.”
rows.translation: “好了，暂时就到这儿吧，”塔妮丝说着伸了个懒腰，背部发出清晰的咔响。“毕竟也不能一整天都让店里没人看着。我觉得你已经掌握基础了，不过要是你想深入学学，我们还可以接着练。尤其是你想用这张弓自卫的话。有些人会说，比起激光手枪或者等离子发射器，这不算理想选择，不过这样的弓可真是指哪打哪。它是来自更高贵时代的精准武器，你懂的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright, let’s call it here for now,” Tanis says, stretching enough to audibly crack his back. “Can’t just leave the shop abandoned all day, after all. You’ve got the basics down, I think, but we can pick it up again if you want to really dig into it. Especially if you want to use that bow of yours for self defense. Some might say that’s a suboptimal choice compared to, say, a laser pistol or a plasma caster, but a bow like this is a real tack-driver. A more precise weapon from a more noble time, you know.”"

rows.original: Giving you another pat on the shoulder, Tanis grabs his arrows off the ground and starts heading back inside. You follow close behind, feeling more confident about your archery skills for having trained with him.
rows.translation: 塔妮丝又拍了拍你的肩膀，从地上捡起箭，开始往屋里走。你紧随其后，经过这次训练，对自己的弓术更有信心了。
rows.raw: "\n\nGiving you another pat on the shoulder, Tanis grabs his arrows off the ground and starts heading back inside. You follow close behind, feeling more confident about your archery skills for having trained with him."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: aim
rows.raw: "aim"

rows.original: “Hey, Tanis,” you say, leaning over the leithan’s desk. “Think you could spare a few minutes to do some bow practice?”
rows.translation: “嘿，塔妮丝，”你俯身靠在莱萨人的桌前说道。“能抽几分钟陪我练练弓吗？”
rows.raw: "“Hey, Tanis,” you say, leaning over the leithan’s desk. “Think you could spare a few minutes to do some bow practice?”"

rows.original: “I dunno,” he laughs, looking around the otherwise empty office. “There’s this big line behind you. I’d hate to keep them all waiting.”
rows.translation: “这可不好说，”他笑着环顾空无一人的办公室。“你后面还排着长队呢。我可不想让大家久等。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I dunno,” he laughs, looking around the otherwise empty office. “There’s this big line behind you. I’d hate to keep them all waiting.”"

rows.original: You give him a look, and he grins and laughs. “Alright, alright, if you’re gonna twist my arm. C’mon out back, and let’s set some targets up.”
rows.translation: 你给了他一个眼神，他便咧嘴大笑起来。“好吧，好吧，既然你非要逼我。来后面吧，我们摆些靶子。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give him a look, and he grins and laughs. “Alright, alright, if you’re gonna twist my arm. C’mon out back, and let’s set some targets up.”"

rows.original: He hops up from behind the desk, onto his six black-scaled legs, and grabs the compound bow he was using last time from underneath. With it, Tanis pulls out several paper shooter’s targets rolled up with a rubber band, and tucks them under his bare arm. You follow him outside once he’s collected his gear, and spend a few minutes tacking up the targets to the sides of the trees closest to the edge of the back lot.
rows.translation: 他从桌后跃起，站在六条覆着黑鳞的腿上，又从桌下拿出上次用的复合弓。随后，塔妮丝拿出几张用橡皮筋捆成卷的射击纸靶，夹在裸露的臂弯里。等他收拾好装备，你便跟他走出去，花了几分钟，把靶子钉在后院边缘最近的几棵树上。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe hops up from behind the desk, onto his six black-scaled legs, and grabs the compound bow he was using last time from underneath. With it, Tanis pulls out several paper shooter’s targets rolled up with a rubber band, and tucks them under his bare arm. You follow him outside once he’s collected his gear, and spend a few minutes tacking up the targets to the sides of the trees closest to the edge of the back lot."

rows.original: “Cool!” he announces when you’ve got a good selection of targets up, ranging from black silhouettes to images of terrifying alien abominations attacking particularly buxom leithan girls... you’re not sure those are actually meant to be used as targets, but hey. “Alright, remember what I taught you about stance? Let’s get you standing like a marks
rows.translation: “棒极了！”你们挂好各式各样的靶子后，他宣布道。靶上既有黑色人形轮廓，也有恐怖外星怪物袭击格外丰腴的莱萨女孩的图案...你不太确定后者真的该拿来当靶子，不过随它吧。“好了，还记得我教你的站姿吗？先让你站得像个神
rows.raw: "\n\n“Cool!” he announces when you’ve got a good selection of targets up, ranging from black silhouettes to images of terrifying alien abominations attacking particularly buxom leithan girls... you’re not sure those are actually meant to be used as targets, but hey. “Alright, remember what I taught you about stance? Let’s get you standing like a marks"

rows.original: wo
rows.translation: 女
rows.raw: "wo"

rows.original: man, and we’ll get started.”
rows.translation: 射手，然后我们就开始。”
rows.raw: "man, and we’ll get started.”"

rows.original: You do as Tanis tells you, resuming the shooter’s stance he taught you during your first session. He quickly corrects a few small errors, making sure you’re standing perfectly before you bring your bow to bear on the closest target.
rows.translation: 你照塔妮丝说的去做，摆出他第一堂课教你的射击姿势。他迅速纠正了几个小错误，确保你站姿完美后，才让你举弓瞄准最近的靶子。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou do as Tanis tells you, resuming the shooter’s stance he taught you during your first session. He quickly corrects a few small errors, making sure you’re standing perfectly before you bring your bow to bear on the closest target."

rows.original: “Looks good. Now let’s just warm up first, get the blood flowing.”
rows.translation: “看起来不错。先热热身，让血流起来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Looks good. Now let’s just warm up first, get the blood flowing.”"

rows.original: Under Tanis’s supervision, you take several well-placed shots at the target, getting into the groove of quickly drawing, aiming, and letting fly in fluid motions. When you’ve turned the first target into a porcupine of feathered shafts, Tanis moves you onto the next, putting you through simple drills, then more complex ones, gently correcting every mistake until you’re landing every shot in the center ring.
rows.translation: 在塔妮丝的指导下，你稳稳地向靶子射出数箭，逐渐掌握了快速拉弓、瞄准、放箭的流畅节奏。当第一块靶子被插满羽箭、变成一只豪猪后，塔妮丝让你转向下一块，带你先做简单练习，再做更复杂的练习，耐心纠正每一个错误，直到你箭箭都命中靶心。
rows.raw: "\n\nUnder Tanis’s supervision, you take several well-placed shots at the target, getting into the groove of quickly drawing, aiming, and letting fly in fluid motions. When you’ve turned the first target into a porcupine of feathered shafts, Tanis moves you onto the next, putting you through simple drills, then more complex ones, gently correcting every mistake until you’re landing every shot in the center ring."

rows.original: “Gettin’ pretty badass with that bow!” Tanis laughs, giving you a friendly thump on the shoulder. “See, you don’t need fancy head’s up displays and holographic sights to be a sharpshooter. It’s all about the skill and dedication, right?”
rows.translation: “你这弓使得越来越厉害了！”塔妮丝笑着，友好地在你肩上捶了一下。“瞧，成为神射手并不需要花哨的抬头显示器和全息瞄具。靠的就是技巧和专注，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Gettin’ pretty badass with that bow!” Tanis laughs, giving you a friendly thump on the shoulder. “See, you don’t need fancy head’s up displays and holographic sights to be a sharpshooter. It’s all about the skill and dedication, right?”"

rows.original: You nod in agreement - you really feel like you’re starting to get the hang of this.
rows.translation: 你赞同地点头——你确实觉得自己开始掌握诀窍了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod in agreement - you really feel like you’re starting to get the hang of this."

rows.original: Then again, you almost wish you weren’t - the way Tanis presses his chest to your back when he adjusts your stance, the sight of his rippling muscles tensing as he draws his own bow back... yum.
rows.translation: 不过转念一想，你又几乎希望自己还没学会——塔妮丝调整你的姿势时，胸膛贴着你的背；他拉开自己的弓时，起伏的肌肉绷紧...真诱人。
rows.raw: " Then again, you almost wish you weren’t - the way Tanis presses his chest to your back when he adjusts your stance, the sight of his rippling muscles tensing as he draws his own bow back... yum."

rows.original: “Keep practicing like this, and I might have to take you hunting sometime,” Tanis laughs, watching you plant another arrow into a tentacle-monster target. “See how you do against some of the real monsters back on Leitha.
rows.translation: “照这样练下去，我恐怕得找机会带你去打猎了，”塔妮丝看着你又一箭钉进触手怪靶子，笑着说道。“看看你对上莱萨母星上那些真正的怪物表现如何。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Keep practicing like this, and I might have to take you hunting sometime,” Tanis laughs, watching you plant another arrow into a tentacle-monster target. “See how you do against some of the real monsters back on Leitha."

rows.original: I think you’d do pretty well.
rows.translation: 我觉得你能干得相当漂亮。
rows.raw: " I think you’d do pretty well."

rows.original: Well, maybe with a little more experience, anyway.
rows.translation: 嗯，不过也许还得再积累些经验。
rows.raw: " Well, maybe with a little more experience, anyway."

rows.original: The two of you do a few more short drills, but fatigue is starting to set in, slowing your movements until Tanis calls for a break. “Alright, I think that’s enough for today. Good job, [pc.name]. You’re really improving!”
rows.translation: 你们又做了几轮简短练习，但疲劳开始袭来，让你的动作逐渐迟缓，塔妮丝于是叫停休息。“好了，我觉得今天够了。干得好，[pc.name]。你确实在进步！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of you do a few more short drills, but fatigue is starting to set in, slowing your movements until Tanis calls for a break. “Alright, I think that’s enough for today. Good job, [pc.name]. You’re really improving!”"

rows.original: You give him a grin and sling your bow over your back, following the towering ‘taur back into the scout office.
rows.translation: 你冲他咧嘴一笑，把弓背到背上，跟着高大的半人马回到侦察办公室。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give him a grin and sling your bow over your back, following the towering ‘taur back into the scout office."

rows.original: You can’t help but look at that big, muscular ass all the way in.
rows.translation: 一路走进去，你都忍不住盯着他那硕大结实的屁股。
rows.raw: " You can’t help but look at that big, muscular ass all the way in."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: aim
rows.raw: "aim"

rows.original: “Still think you could learn a thing or two from me?” Tanis says, recognizing the familiar look in your eye. “I think you’ve got the basics pretty much nailed down, you know.
rows.translation: “还觉得能从我这儿学到点东西？”塔妮丝认出你眼中熟悉的神情，说道。“我觉得基础你已经掌握得很扎实了，你知道的。
rows.raw: "“Still think you could learn a thing or two from me?” Tanis says, recognizing the familiar look in your eye. “I think you’ve got the basics pretty much nailed down, you know."

rows.original: You’re a pretty accomplished hunter on your own, I bet.
rows.translation: 我敢说，你自己也已经是个相当出色的猎手了。
rows.raw: " You’re a pretty accomplished hunter on your own, I bet."

rows.original: If you really want to improve, you’ve got to go out there and put these skills to the test.
rows.translation: 要真想进步，你得出去实际检验这些本事。
rows.raw: " If you really want to improve, you’ve got to go out there and put these skills to the test."

rows.original: After a moment’s thought, though, Tanis chuckles and says “Fine, fine, if only for the camaraderie of it. I’ve enjoyed our training sessions, you know. It’s been more fun than I’d have thought, passing the family tradition on.”
rows.translation: 不过略加思索后，塔妮丝便轻笑着说：“好吧，好吧，就当是朋友之间聚聚。我挺喜欢咱们一起训练的，你知道吗。把家传技艺传给别人，比我想象中还有意思。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a moment’s thought, though, Tanis chuckles and says “Fine, fine, if only for the camaraderie of it. I’ve enjoyed our training sessions, you know. It’s been more fun than I’d have thought, passing the family tradition on.”"

rows.original: “So let’s go,” you say, nodding towards to the door. Tanis grins and grabs his bow, along with several targets, and leads you out into the back lot. The two of you go through the usual drill, tacking targets to trees and stretching out your muscles with a few practice shots.
rows.translation: “那就走吧，”你朝门口点头说道。塔妮丝咧嘴一笑，拿起弓和几张靶子，带你来到后院。你们照常开始练习，把靶子钉在树上，再试射几箭活动筋骨。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So let’s go,” you say, nodding towards to the door. Tanis grins and grabs his bow, along with several targets, and leads you out into the back lot. The two of you go through the usual drill, tacking targets to trees and stretching out your muscles with a few practice shots."

rows.original: When the warm-up’s done, though, Tanis doesn’t start you on the same drills as your first few sessions. Instead, the towering leithan hunter rolls his shoulders and pulls a strange arrow off of his back, tipped with something blinking and clearly electronic. You cock an eyebrow and, at Tanis’s beckoning, step back. He flashes you a grin, nocks the arrow, and lets fly at a tree near the back of the lot.
rows.translation: 不过热身结束后，塔妮丝没有让你像前几堂课那样继续训练。这位高大的莱萨猎手转了转肩膀，从背上抽出一支奇怪的箭，箭头上装着某种闪烁着的东西，显然是电子装置。你挑起眉毛，在塔妮丝示意下退开。他冲你咧嘴一笑，搭箭上弦，朝后院深处的一棵树射去。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen the warm-up’s done, though, Tanis doesn’t start you on the same drills as your first few sessions. Instead, the towering leithan hunter rolls his shoulders and pulls a strange arrow off of his back, tipped with something blinking and clearly electronic. You cock an eyebrow and, at Tanis’s beckoning, step back. He flashes you a grin, nocks the arrow, and lets fly at a tree near the back of the lot."

rows.original: The arrow slams home, quivering audibly as it sticks into the bark of the tree. A moment passes, and then a deafening roar blasts through the woods, kicking up leaves and grass in a explosive bubble.
rows.translation: 箭矢狠狠钉进树皮，颤动得嗡嗡作响。片刻后，一声震耳欲聋的轰鸣炸响林间，爆炸般扩散的气浪卷起了树叶和草屑。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe arrow slams home, quivering audibly as it sticks into the bark of the tree. A moment passes, and then a deafening roar blasts through the woods, kicking up leaves and grass in a explosive bubble."

rows.original: You cover your eyes, gasping as the shockwave rolls over you. The first thing you hear, once you’re able to again, is Tanis laughing hysterically. “I guess I should have said, uh, ‘fire in the hole’ or something, right?”
rows.translation: 你捂住眼睛，冲击波扫过身体时，不由得倒吸一口气。等听力恢复，你最先听到的就是塔妮丝歇斯底里的大笑。“看来我该先喊句，呃，‘当心爆炸’之类的，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou cover your eyes, gasping as the shockwave rolls over you. The first thing you hear, once you’re able to again, is Tanis laughing hysterically. “I guess I should have said, uh, ‘fire in the hole’ or something, right?”"

rows.original: “Trick arrows are the key to keeping bow hunting relevant today,” he says. “I made these myself - concussive arrows. Sends a shockwave that’ll stun just about anything, even most robots. Give you time to plunge a few more arrows, or a good blade, into whatever’s trying to fight you. Here, take a few to test out. I’ll show you how to make ‘em later.”
rows.translation: “特种箭矢是让弓猎在今天仍有用武之地的关键，”他说。“这些是我自己做的——震荡箭。能释放冲击波，震晕几乎任何东西，连大多数机器人也不例外。给你时间往对手身上再补几箭，或者捅上几刀。来，拿几支试试。以后我教你怎么做。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Trick arrows are the key to keeping bow hunting relevant today,” he says. “I made these myself - concussive arrows. Sends a shockwave that’ll stun just about anything, even most robots. Give you time to plunge a few more arrows, or a good blade, into whatever’s trying to fight you. Here, take a few to test out. I’ll show you how to make ‘em later.”"

rows.original: A quiver of arrows is shoved into your hand, and you strap them on.
rows.translation: 他把一筒箭塞进你手里，你把它绑在身上。
rows.raw: "\n\nA quiver of arrows is shoved into your hand, and you strap them on."

rows.original: “You’ve got your own, I presume?” he says, brushing leaves off his bare shoulders. “I did show you how to make ‘em, right?”
rows.translation: “我猜你带着自己的吧？”他说着，掸掉裸露肩膀上的树叶。“我教过你怎么做了，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’ve got your own, I presume?” he says, brushing leaves off his bare shoulders. “I did show you how to make ‘em, right?”"

rows.original: You draw one of your special leithan arrows and nock it, aiming at the same tree Tanis just shot - it looks completely unharmed, for all the force just brought against it. You aim and let fly, sending another beeping arrow to slam home into the gray bark. It detonates a moment later, blasting the targets you’d tacked up off the trees - and setting off a cacophony of howling animals, screeching birds, and a car alarm from inside the shop’s lot.
rows.translation: 你抽出一支特制莱萨箭，搭上弓弦，瞄准塔妮丝刚射中的那棵树——尽管刚才遭受那般猛击，它看起来依旧毫发无损。你瞄准放箭，让又一支嘀嘀作响的箭钉进灰色树皮。片刻后它便引爆，把你们钉好的靶子全都从树上震落——还引来了动物的嗥叫、鸟儿的尖啼，以及店铺院内的汽车警报，交织成一片喧嚣。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou draw one of your special leithan arrows and nock it, aiming at the same tree Tanis just shot - it looks completely unharmed, for all the force just brought against it. You aim and let fly, sending another beeping arrow to slam home into the gray bark. It detonates a moment later, blasting the targets you’d tacked up off the trees - and setting off a cacophony of howling animals, screeching birds, and a car alarm from inside the shop’s lot."

rows.original: “Whew, that was loaded a little heavy!” Tanis laughs, clapping you on the shoulder, almost hard enough to stagger you. “Good shot, though. Now, the trick is to stun your target, then use the opportunity to hit it as many times as possible while it’s staggered - or to get the hell away, if you’re in a bad spot. Opening with a concussion shot can save your life if you’re ambushed while wounded or exhausted. So, let’s see you do some quick follow-up shots.”
rows.translation: “呼，这支装药有点猛！”塔妮丝笑着在你肩上拍了一掌，力道几乎让你踉跄。“不过射得好。诀窍就是震晕目标，然后趁它还没缓过来，能打多少下就打多少下——或者，局势不妙时赶紧逃命。如果你在受伤或筋疲力尽时遭到伏击，先来一发冲击射击就能救命。好了，让我看看你快速追射几箭。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Whew, that was loaded a little heavy!” Tanis laughs, clapping you on the shoulder, almost hard enough to stagger you. “Good shot, though. Now, the trick is to stun your target, then use the opportunity to hit it as many times as possible while it’s staggered - or to get the hell away, if you’re in a bad spot. Opening with a concussion shot can save your life if you’re ambushed while wounded or exhausted. So, let’s see you do some quick follow-up shots.”"

rows.original: You give Tanis a nod, and let fly with a concussive arrow, blasting one of the few remaining targets left standing. The moment the arrow detonates, you draw one of your mundane arrows, nock, and let fly as close to the first point of impact as you can. In what feels like the span of a heartbeat, you hammer three more arrows where the first hand landed.
rows.translation: 你朝塔妮丝点点头，射出一支震荡箭，炸中为数不多还立着的靶子之一。箭头刚一引爆，你就抽出普通箭矢，搭弦放箭，尽可能射向第一箭的落点。仿佛只过了一个心跳，你就接连把另外三支箭钉在第一箭命中的位置。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give Tanis a nod, and let fly with a concussive arrow, blasting one of the few remaining targets left standing. The moment the arrow detonates, you draw one of your mundane arrows, nock, and let fly as close to the first point of impact as you can. In what feels like the span of a heartbeat, you hammer three more arrows where the first hand landed."

rows.original: “Quick as a cunt-snake,” Tanis says as you lower your bow. “I think you’ve got the idea. Now let’s drive it home, [pc.name]...”
rows.translation: “快得像条穴蛇，”你放下弓时，塔妮丝说道。“看来你明白了。现在我们好好巩固一下，[pc.name]...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Quick as a cunt-snake,” Tanis says as you lower your bow. “I think you’ve got the idea. Now let’s drive it home, [pc.name]...”"

rows.original: The rest of your session is spent in quick-shot drills and testing out different mixes of concussive arrows. Tanis works you hard - harder than he ever has before - leaving you panting and sweaty by the time he finally calls it. Your muscles ache from drawing your bow so many times... but it’s a good pain, one you earned through hard work, and growing skill. Tanis smiles at you, an arm around your shoulder to guide you back inside.
rows.translation: 这堂课剩下的时间，都花在速射训练和测试不同配方的震荡箭上。塔妮丝练你练得很狠——比以往任何时候都狠——等他终于叫停时，你已经汗流浃背、气喘吁吁。多次拉弓让你的肌肉酸痛...但这是令人满足的痛楚，来自辛勤练习和不断增长的技艺。塔妮丝微笑着搂住你的肩膀，带你回屋。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe rest of your session is spent in quick-shot drills and testing out different mixes of concussive arrows. Tanis works you hard - harder than he ever has before - leaving you panting and sweaty by the time he finally calls it. Your muscles ache from drawing your bow so many times... but it’s a good pain, one you earned through hard work, and growing skill. Tanis smiles at you, an arm around your shoulder to guide you back inside."

rows.original: “Let’s take a break... and maybe get you a shower,” he chuckles. “Good work out there, [pc.name]. You’re getting damn good with a bow
rows.translation: “休息一下吧...也许你还该洗个澡，”他轻笑着。“刚才干得漂亮，[pc.name]。你的弓术已经相当厉害了
rows.raw: "\n\n“Let’s take a break... and maybe get you a shower,” he chuckles. “Good work out there, [pc.name]. You’re getting damn good with a bow"

rows.raw: "leithan"

rows.original: - maybe there’s a little leithan in you!
rows.translation: ——也许你也有点莱萨人的血统！
rows.raw: " - maybe there’s a little leithan in you!"

rows.original: . I think the leithan part of you’s really taking off!
rows.translation: 。看来你体内的莱萨天赋真的开始发挥作用了！
rows.raw: ". I think the leithan part of you’s really taking off!"

rows.original: Man, it feels good to be passing along the family skills. Maybe I ought to open an archery school some time.
rows.translation: 老天，能把家传本事传下去真好。也许哪天我该开个弓术学校。
rows.raw: " Man, it feels good to be passing along the family skills. Maybe I ought to open an archery school some time."

rows.original: After you get inside, Tanis grabs a data slate off his desk. “Oh, hey, hold up a second [pc.name]. Lemme give you something. What’s your e-mail address?”
rows.translation: 进屋后，塔妮丝从桌上拿起一块数据板。“噢，嘿，等一下，[pc.name]。我给你点东西。你的电子邮箱地址是什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter you get inside, Tanis grabs a data slate off his desk. “Oh, hey, hold up a second [pc.name]. Lemme give you something. What’s your e-mail address?”"

rows.original: You tell it to him, and after he hits a few keys on his pad, your Codex beeps out that it’s received a new message. “Cool. So, those are the plans to make concussive arrows like the ones we were just using. If you’ve got some technical expertise, or a couple hours to dick around on the extranet, you should be able to fix some up for yourself.”
rows.translation: 你告诉他地址，他在数据板上按了几下，你的CODEX终端便鸣响提示收到新消息。“好了。这是制作咱们刚才用的那种震荡箭的设计图。只要你有点技术基础，或者花几个小时在外联网里折腾一下，应该就能自己做出几支。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell it to him, and after he hits a few keys on his pad, your Codex beeps out that it’s received a new message. “Cool. So, those are the plans to make concussive arrows like the ones we were just using. If you’ve got some technical expertise, or a couple hours to dick around on the extranet, you should be able to fix some up for yourself.”"

rows.original: “Wow, thanks,” you say, pocketing your Codex after a quick look. The plans seem simple enough.
rows.translation: “哇，谢谢，”你匆匆看了一眼，把CODEX终端收进口袋，说道。设计图看起来挺简单的。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wow, thanks,” you say, pocketing your Codex after a quick look. The plans seem simple enough."

rows.original: He grins. “Any time, man. Let me know how they work out for you!”
rows.translation: 他咧嘴一笑。“随时乐意帮忙，伙计。用起来如何记得告诉我！”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe grins. “Any time, man. Let me know how they work out for you!”"

rows.original: (Perk Gained: Concussive Shot - Grants the ability to fire explosive-tipped arrows when equipped with a bow in combat. The arrows have a chance to stun for 1 to 2 combat rounds. Requires a bow-type weapon.)
rows.translation: (获得专长：冲击射击 - 在战斗中装备弓时，可以发射爆炸箭头的箭矢。箭矢有几率使目标眩晕1至2个战斗回合。需要弓类武器。)
rows.raw: "\n\n(Perk Gained: Concussive Shot - Grants the ability to fire explosive-tipped arrows when equipped with a bow in combat. The arrows have a chance to stun for 1 to 2 combat rounds. Requires a bow-type weapon.)"

rows.original: You approach the local Scout Authority representative and awkwardly ask him if he would happen to know someone who can make taur-specific installations on a ship.
rows.translation: 你走向当地侦察管理局代表，有些尴尬地问他，是否碰巧认识能在飞船上安装半人马型专用设备的人。
rows.raw: "You approach the local Scout Authority representative and awkwardly ask him if he would happen to know someone who can make taur-specific installations on a ship."

rows.original: “Say what, [pc.sir]?” he asks with a raised eyebrow.
rows.translation: “您说什么，[pc.sir]？”他挑起眉问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Say what, [pc.sir]?” he asks with a raised eyebrow."

rows.original: “Well, there’s someone I’d like to invite to move in with me, but she’s a deertaur with, uhh, special needs. And my ship doesn’t have the necessary ‘equipment’ to keep her satisfied,” you elaborate, hoping he’ll catch your meaning.
rows.translation: “嗯，我想邀请一个人搬来和我住，不过她是鹿人马，有些，呃，特殊需求。而我的飞船上没有能满足她的必要‘设备’，”你进一步解释，希望他能明白你的意思。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, there’s someone I’d like to invite to move in with me, but she’s a deertaur with, uhh, special needs. And my ship doesn’t have the necessary ‘equipment’ to keep her satisfied,” you elaborate, hoping he’ll catch your meaning."

rows.original: As the leithan listens to your story, a knowing smirk forms on his lips. “Oh, the cute deertaur that roams the jungle. I’ve seen her a couple of times.”
rows.translation: 莱萨人听你讲述时，嘴角浮现出心领神会的笑意。“噢，那个在丛林里闲逛的可爱鹿人马。我见过她几次。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAs the leithan listens to your story, a knowing smirk forms on his lips. “Oh, the cute deertaur that roams the jungle. I’ve seen her a couple of times.”"

rows.original: Considering how horny she always is, you find it hard not to imagine her making passes at someone as hunky as Tanis. So, before the topic can derail into TMI, you explain that, since Tanis has a tauric body too, you thought maybe he might know someone who could provide that sort of equipment.
rows.translation: 考虑到她总是那么饥渴，你很难不想象她勾搭塔妮丝这样的壮汉的样子。因此，在话题偏向过于私密的细节之前，你解释说，既然塔妮丝也有半人马型身体，你想他也许认识能提供那种设备的人。
rows.raw: "\n\nConsidering how horny she always is, you find it hard not to imagine her making passes at someone as hunky as Tanis. So, before the topic can derail into TMI, you explain that, since Tanis has a tauric body too, you thought maybe he might know someone who could provide that sort of equipment."

rows.original: “Well, aren’t you a lucky one? I just happen to have some I’m not using.”
rows.translation: “哟，你可真走运！我正好有些闲置的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, aren’t you a lucky one? I just happen to have some I’m not using.”"

rows.original: “That sounds convenient,” you say skeptically.
rows.translation: “这可真巧，”你半信半疑地说。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That sounds convenient,” you say skeptically."

rows.original: He shrugs. “Ever since I took this job, I haven’t really needed it anymore. The locals see my ‘size’ and are more than happy to lend a hand, if you catch my drift. It’s just collecting dust in my room, so I could be convinced to part with it.”
rows.translation: 他耸耸肩。“自从接下这份工作，我就不太用得上它了。当地人一看到我的‘尺寸’，就很乐意伸出援手，你懂我的意思吧。现在它在我房间里也只是积灰，所以给个合适的条件，我可以转让。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe shrugs. “Ever since I took this job, I haven’t really needed it anymore. The locals see my ‘size’ and are more than happy to lend a hand, if you catch my drift. It’s just collecting dust in my room, so I could be convinced to part with it.”"

rows.original: “How much?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“How much?”"

rows.original: The leithan cups his chin in thought for a moment. <i>“I’m guessing I would have to carry it to your ship and install it myself, since no-one else ‘round these parts would know how. Does
rows.translation: 莱萨人托着下巴思索片刻。<i>“我想还得我亲自把它搬上你的船，给你装好，毕竟这附近没别人懂这个。

rows.original: “Thank you very much, [pc.sir]. Gonna get someone to cover my shift, and then I’ll be there before you can nock an arrow.”
rows.translation: “非常感谢，[pc.sir]。我去找个人替班，您搭支箭的工夫，我就到了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thank you very much, [pc.sir]. Gonna get someone to cover my shift, and then I’ll be there before you can nock an arrow.”"

rows.original: The leithan arrives some time later with a large cart holding several pieces of equipment, among which you can identify harnesses, restraints, leg-lockers and other pieces whose purpose is... less clear. Everything is in surprisingly good state, practically new. You decide to lend him a hand, and in just three hours your ship has everything the deertaur might need.
rows.translation: 一段时间后，莱萨人推着一辆大车到来，上面装着好几件设备，你能认出其中有吊带、束缚具、锁腿器，还有些用途...不太明了的东西。所有设备的状况都好得出奇，简直跟新的一样。你决定帮他一把，仅仅三个小时后，你的飞船上就备齐了那位鹿人马可能需要的一切。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe leithan arrives some time later with a large cart holding several pieces of equipment, among which you can identify harnesses, restraints, leg-lockers and other pieces whose purpose is... less clear. Everything is in surprisingly good state, practically new. You decide to lend him a hand, and in just three hours your ship has everything the deertaur might need."

rows.original:
Esbeth’s scout is a full-blooded leithan, measuring almost 10 ft (3 meters) in height and sporting a rather athletic physique, albeit on the slender side. Elfin ears jut out at the sides of his head, complemented by a pair of long, antennae-like ears covered in dark, chitinous scales that sprout right above his brow. His face itself is quite attractive by human standards, with a fairly masculine profile and just a hint of androgyny. Sky-blue eyes and golden-blond hair complete the handsome package.
	
	The lizard-taur’s humanoid half has light-gray skin and a fairly standard pair of arms, while the tauric half is covered in darker scales and has six reptilian legs, capped with yellow claws. A thick, lizard-like tail drags behind him, though it appears to be more dexterous than one might expect, judging from how it deftly avoids random objects in the cluttered office.
	
	Like natural armor, large plates of glossy, chitin-like material provide an additional layer of protection to much of his lower body, as well as his tail, hands, forearms and the sides of his human torso — the latter plates appearing almost like a lewd half-corset, if you choose to look at it that way.
	
	Bioluminescent yellow light shines faintly through the gaps between his plates, giving the leithan an even more offworldly look, but you’d be hard-pressed to deny that it’s[pc.mfn
		| cool as fuck
		| strangely alluring
		| strangely alluring
	]. Like any leithan, the exterior chitin-like armor can glow as a whole when he experiences strong emotions — or extreme sexual ecstasy.
rows.translation:
埃斯贝斯的斥候是一名纯血莱萨人，身高接近10英尺（3米），体格相当健美，只是略显纤瘦。精灵般的耳朵从头部两侧伸出，眉毛正上方还长着一对修长如触角的耳朵，覆着深色甲壳鳞片。以人类标准看，他的脸颇有魅力，轮廓相当阳刚，又带着一丝雌雄莫辨的美感。天蓝色眼睛与金黄色头发，让这副英俊外貌更加完美。
	
	这位蜥蜴人马的人形上半身有着浅灰色皮肤和一双相当普通的手臂，半人马型的下半身则覆着深色鳞片，长有六条爬行类的腿，末端带着黄色利爪。一条粗壮的蜥蜴状尾巴拖在身后，不过从它灵巧避开杂乱办公室内各种物品的表现来看，它比想象中还要灵活。
	
	大片光滑发亮、类似甲壳的物质如同天然盔甲，为他下半身的大部分区域，以及尾巴、手、前臂和人形躯干两侧提供了额外保护——如果你愿意这样看，躯干两侧的甲片简直像一件淫荡的半截束身衣。
	
	微弱的黄色生物荧光从甲片间隙透出，让这位莱萨人显得更加异星风情十足，但你很难否认那[pc.mfn
		| 简直酷毙了
		| 有种奇异的诱惑力
		| 有种奇异的诱惑力
	]。和所有莱萨人一样，当他情绪激动——或陷入极致性快感时——外层甲壳般的盔甲能整个亮起。

rows.original: A metal, tangerine-sized, navy-blue sphere, the Haywire Grenade is a small-scale EMP generator that burns itself out on use. Where most EMP weapons aim to completely destroy the electronic, kinetic barrier or robotic capabilities of an enemy, the Haywire’s ingeniously small and directed detonation instead aims to disable them, usually weakening any biological component in the process. This makes it a favored side-arm amongst riot police, pirates and any other groups seeking to take foes and their equipment whole.
rows.translation: 失控手雷是一颗橘子大小的海军蓝金属球，本质上是使用后就会自毁的小型电磁脉冲发生器。大多数电磁脉冲武器旨在彻底摧毁敌人的电子设备、动能屏障或机器战斗能力，而失控手雷巧妙的小范围定向爆破则旨在使其失效，通常也会同时削弱生物部分。因此，它深受防暴警察、海盗，以及其他希望将敌人和装备完整拿下的团体喜爱。

rows.original: . The band of strange, pale raiders look up at you with a mixture of resentment and arousal, feathers quivering submissively. “We did not realize this was your reservation, [pc.mf|sir|madam],” says the one that addressed you previously, shakily using the ship to get to his feet. I met him once or twice at soirees, and he was exactly as you’d imagine - generous and terribly flamboyant. He had to be introduced to me each time, because of course each time he was something completely different! Forever experimenting with the latest gene-mods, that was Victor.
rows.translation: “我听说过他，”达诺克微笑着纠正道。“以我的社交圈子，再加上为舒适乐工作，要没听说过亲爱的维克托和斯蒂尔科技，可就难了。我在晚会上见过他一两次，他与你想象中完全一样——慷慨，而且张扬得不得了。每次都得有人重新向我介绍他，因为他每次当然都完全变了个样！永远在尝试最新的基因改造，那就是维克托。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I knew of him,” Darnock corrects with a small smile. “In the circles I move in, and working for Snugglé, it was difficult not to know of dear Victor, and Steele Tech. I met him once or twice at soirees, and he was exactly as you’d imagine - generous and terribly flamboyant. He had to be introduced to me each time, because of course each time he was something completely different! Forever experimenting with the latest gene-mods, that was Victor."

rows.original: ” He nods knowingly at you. “I can see you’re already staunchly carrying that particular family torch, as well.
rows.translation: ”他心领神会地对你点点头。“我看得出来，你也已经坚定地接过了家族这方面的传统。
rows.raw: "” He nods knowingly at you. “I can see you’re already staunchly carrying that particular family torch, as well."

rows.original: Yes! He truly embodied the spirit of entrepreneurialism. A paragon of humanity’s progress amongst the stars, for many. Many!”
rows.translation: 是啊！他真正体现了创业精神。在许多人眼中，他是人类在群星间不断进步的典范。许多人！”
rows.raw: " Yes! He truly embodied the spirit of entrepreneurialism. A paragon of humanity’s progress amongst the stars, for many. Many!”"

rows.original: There’s a meaningful pause.
rows.translation: 一阵意味深长的沉默。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a meaningful pause."

rows.original: “But you weren’t friends?” you prod.
rows.translation: “可你们不是朋友？”你追问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“But you weren’t friends?” you prod."

rows.original: “Well,” Darnock grimaces, “We, ah, had our differences. Same circles but not the same inner circles, d’you see? He was such a libertine, whereas I...” he gestures behind you. Turning, you see a large, wooden letter “O” hanging on the wall.
rows.translation: “这个嘛，”达诺克露出难色，“我们，啊，有些分歧。同属一个圈子，却不在同一个核心圈里，你明白吧？他是个十足的放荡之徒，而我……”他朝你身后示意。你转过头，看见墙上挂着一个巨大的木制字母“O”。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well,” Darnock grimaces, “We, ah, had our differences. Same circles but not the same inner circles, d’you see? He was such a libertine, whereas I...” he gestures behind you. Turning, you see a large, wooden letter “O” hanging on the wall."

rows.original: “I feel a sense of duty about what we humans are doing out here on the frontier,” the professor goes on, nestling back into his armchair. “Which reaches beyond profit margins and indulging oneself. Revealing the universal light and compassion of the One to newly discovered native species - that is a hard, but truly just and beautiful goal. But that is my own path,” he smiles at you, “and you have yours. Your father advanced humanity’s profile through his own efforts, and that furthers the goal of the One. That is how I think of it.”
rows.translation: “对于我们人类在边疆的所作所为，我怀有一种责任感，”教授接着说，重新舒适地靠进扶手椅。“这种责任超越了利润和自我享乐。向新发现的本土物种揭示唯一神普世的光明与慈悲——这是个艰难，却真正正义而美好的目标。但这是我自己的道路，”他对你微笑，“而你有你的道路。你父亲靠自己的努力提升了人类的声望，这也推动了唯一神的事业。我就是这样看待此事的。”

Revealing the universal light and compassion of the One to newly discovered native species - that is a hard, but truly just and beautiful goal. But that is my own path,” he smiles at you, “and you have yours. Your father advanced humanity’s profile through his own efforts, and that furthers the goal of the One. That is how I think of it.”"

rows.original: “What exactly are you doing here?” you ask.
rows.translation: “你在这里究竟做些什么？”你问。
rows.raw: "“What exactly are you doing here?” you ask."

rows.original: “Research that could well culminate in what you sit down at breakfast to in the near future, dear [pc.boy]!” Darnock exults, evidently delighted you’ve asked this question. “I’m sure you know of Snugglé - they had a hand in producing most of the things you ate over the past week, most likely. A planet with such an embarrassment of floral riches as Mhen’ga is of huge interest to such a company - we are here testing a range of native plants’ suitability to mass produce. The meal you are in the process of demolishing is merely a taster of the fruits of our labor so far.”
rows.translation: “这里的研究成果，很可能在不久的将来就会出现在你的早餐桌上，我亲爱的[pc.boy]！”达诺克兴高采烈地说，显然很高兴你问了这个问题。“你一定听说过舒适乐——你过去一周吃下的大多数东西，多半都有他们参与生产。像门加这样植物资源丰富得令人应接不暇的星球，对这样一家公司来说极具吸引力——我们在这里测试各种本土植物是否适合大规模生产。你正在大快朵颐的这顿饭，只是我们迄今劳动成果的一次小小试吃。”

A planet with such an embarrassment of floral riches as Mhen’ga is of huge interest to such a company - we are here testing a range of native plants’ suitability to mass produce. The meal you are in the process of demolishing is merely a taster of the fruits of our labor so far.”"

rows.original: He waves excitedly at the serried crops beyond the veranda.
rows.translation: 他兴奋地朝游廊外排列整齐的作物挥了挥手。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe waves excitedly at the serried crops beyond the veranda."

rows.original: “Out there we grow every type of plant that has so far been discovered to be non-toxic and edible within this planet’s immense biome - and of course, there are many, many still to be discovered. So many tests that have to be run before a specimen can even be provisionally put forward as a potential crop, though; how does it react in a farmed environment? Will it flourish in another planet’s soil? What are its effects on other plants around it? Is something that is edible to a human poisonous to a leithan? We test that, and many other things, in the east wing of the manor.”
rows.translation: “在外面，我们种植了迄今为止在这颗星球庞大的生物群系中发现的所有无毒、可食用的植物——当然，还有很多很多等待发现。不过，一株植物哪怕只是暂时被列为潜在作物，也得先经过这么多测试：它在人工栽培环境中的反应如何？能否在其他星球的土壤里茁壮生长？会对周围其他植物产生什么影响？人类能吃的东西，会不会对莱萨人有毒？我们在庄园东翼测试这些，还有许多其他问题。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Out there we grow every type of plant that has so far been discovered to be non-toxic and edible within this planet’s immense biome - and of course, there are many, many still to be discovered. So many tests that have to be run before a specimen can even be provisionally put forward as a potential crop, though; how does it react in a farmed environment? Will it flourish in another planet’s soil? What are its effects on other plants around it? Is something that is edible to a human poisonous to a leithan? We test that, and many other things, in the east wing of the manor.”"

rows.original: “And how are things going?” you say, toying with some green mush that tastes a bit like hummus.
rows.translation: “进展如何？”你问道，拨弄着一种味道有点像鹰嘴豆泥的绿色糊状物。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And how are things going?” you say, toying with some green mush that tastes a bit like hummus."

rows.original: “Very well,” replies the old human enthusiastically. “We’ve identified 17 contenders for crop status already. Maybe only 2 or 3 of them are truly ideal but even so - that’s remarkable for a newly discovered planet. So much so Snugglé have expressed serious interest into turning Mhen’ga into an agri-world. Whether that can happen is dependent on other factors, though.” He sighs, twisting his water glass around and around.
rows.translation: “非常顺利，”老人热情地回答。“我们已经确定了17种有潜力的农作物。其中真正理想的可能只有两三种，但即便如此——对于一颗刚发现的星球而言也很了不起。这让舒适乐对把门加变成农业星球表现出了浓厚兴趣。不过能否实现，还取决于其他因素。”他叹了口气，反复转动着水杯。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Very well,” replies the old human enthusiastically. “We’ve identified 17 contenders for crop status already. Maybe only 2 or 3 of them are truly ideal but even so - that’s remarkable for a newly discovered planet. So much so Snugglé have expressed serious interest into turning Mhen’ga into an agri-world. Whether that can happen is dependent on other factors, though.” He sighs, twisting his water glass around and around."

rows.original: “Rather less encouraging factors.”
rows.translation: “远不那么乐观的因素。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Rather less encouraging factors.”"

rows.original: “My original plan, when I began overseeing construction of Thare, was to use purely native labor. Snugglé encourages that, you know - organically source your workforce, get them involved and used to your structures before any shrill sandal-wearers muddle them up with talk of unions and tribunals and so on. I believed in that from a personal perspective, as it would have provided me with an ideal opportunity to reach out to these savage innocents, talk to them about their salvation. The link between hard, honest work and holy Oneness - you can only teach that through practice.”
rows.translation: “我最初开始监督塔雷的建设时，原本打算完全雇用本地劳工。舒适乐鼓励这样做，你知道——就地招募劳动力，让他们先参与进来、适应你的组织架构，免得那些穿凉鞋的大嗓门用工会和仲裁庭之类的说辞把他们搞糊涂。我个人也支持这一点，因为那能给我一个理想的机会，去接触这些野蛮而天真的人，和他们谈谈自己的救赎。辛勤诚实的劳动与神圣的归一之间的联系——只有实践才能教会。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My original plan, when I began overseeing construction of Thare, was to use purely native labor. Snugglé encourages that, you know - organically source your workforce, get them involved and used to your structures before any shrill sandal-wearers muddle them up with talk of unions and tribunals and so on. I believed in that from a personal perspective, as it would have provided me with an ideal opportunity to reach out to these savage innocents, talk to them about their salvation. The link between hard, honest work and holy Oneness - you can only teach that through practice.”"

rows.original: He sighs and gazes at the softly illuminated tablecloth.
rows.translation: 他叹息着，凝视柔光照耀下的桌布。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe sighs and gazes at the softly illuminated tablecloth."

rows.original: “Pure naivety on my part. Pure naivety! As a rule, the natives of Mhen’ga - be they winged, serpentine or tentacled - do not take readily to the virtues of honest labor and modesty. They are a feckless and lazy bunch, and would rather wallow in their own aboriginal ignorance, sleeping and rutting their short lives away. Only a very few zil have the correct mindset and have seen the light - like good, kind Able here. I gave him a name appropriate for an early son of this dawning world.”
rows.translation: “完全是我的天真。太天真了！总的来说，门加的土著——无论是有翼的、蛇形的还是长触手的——都不太愿意接受诚实劳动与谦逊的美德。他们是一群懒惰无能的家伙，宁愿沉溺于原始的无知，把短暂的一生耗费在睡觉和交配上。只有极少数兹尔具备正确的心态、看见了光明——就像这里善良懂事的艾布尔。我给他取了一个适合这个初生世界早期之子的名字。”

Only a very few zil have the correct mindset and have seen the light - like good, kind Able here. I gave him a name appropriate for an early son of this dawning world.”"

rows.original: “I would like to chase more rigorous tactics with them, but alas, the current planetary administration has chosen to shackle us with suffocating rules and regulations. Make no mistake though, my young friend,” the professor growls, determination steeling his pale blue eyes, “it is a situation that will change. The zil and their fellows will be brought into the present millennium. Whether it be mercifully through the kind light of the One God, or brutally by uncaring market forces, that is their own choice to make.”
rows.translation: “我希望对他们采取更严厉的策略，可惜，现任行星政府选择用令人窒息的条条框框束缚我们。不过别误会，我年轻的朋友，”教授低声说道，淡蓝色的眼睛里满是坚定，“这种情况会改变的。兹尔和他们的同类将被带进当今这个千年。是仁慈地沐浴唯一神的慈爱光辉，还是被冷漠的市场力量粗暴地拖进去，由他们自己选择。”

rows.original: “They didn’t get a choice, dear [pc.name],” says Darnock, considering the distant workers with a fond, paternal smile. “And they must understand their posting not as an imposition, but a grand opportunity: to prove they are capable of obedience and a hard, honest day’s work to future employers. Snugglé works closely with the U.G.C. legal system to secure laborers for out-of-the-way installations like this, where locals cannot be sourced for whatever reason. It’s a win-win for all concerned: the burden on our over-taxed prisons is eased, Snugglé gets access to near-free labor, and the prisoners themselves receive valuable experience and a commendation on their CV for when they are released.”
rows.translation: “他们没有选择，亲爱的[pc.name]，”达诺克望着远处的工人，露出慈父般亲切的微笑。“而且他们必须明白，这份差事不是强加的负担，而是一个大好机会：向未来的雇主证明自己服从命令、能踏实苦干一整天。在无法出于种种原因招募本地人的偏远设施，舒适乐会与银河联合邦联司法系统密切合作，获取劳工。这对所有相关方都是双赢：不堪重负的监狱减轻了负担，舒适乐获得了几乎免费的劳动力，而囚犯自己也得到了宝贵的经验，以及获释时能写进履历的一份嘉奖。”

rows.original: “Ah,” says Darnock, dabbing his lips with his napkin, looking rather discomfited by your question. “Yes. Well, that was all rather unfortunate. As I said before and after you brought Remi back into the fold, it was very much my intention to keep him on here at Thare, bend every effort towards reforming him. He is not stupid, or evil, in my estimation - just horribly misguided. Think of the good he could do if his relentless energies and intelligence was turned to higher purpose!”
rows.translation: “啊，”达诺克用餐巾擦擦嘴，你的问题似乎让他颇感不自在。“是的。唉，那整件事实在很不幸。你把雷米带回正途之前和之后，我都说过，我真心打算把他留在塔雷，竭尽全力改造他。在我看来，他既不愚蠢，也不邪恶——只是被严重误导了。想想看，若把他那无穷的精力和才智投入更崇高的事业，他能做多少好事！”

rows.original: “However. The U.G.C. legal system did not see eye to eye with me on the matter, once I’d filed my report. They take a very thin view of prisoners who not only attempt escape at minimum security facilities, but then incite violent revolt against it. So he was taken off my hands and moved to an, ahem, decidedly not minimum security facility. Many years added on to his sentence as well, of course.”

They seem transfixed, meekly obeying the imperious point of a soldier’s thin finger. The dirge appears to be coming from the ship itself; the gleaming hull vibrates with its sombre, tingling chords. The figures themselves are bare around the face and neck, and move with an easy, light-footed grace despite their tight-fitting armor. They have black, pupil-less eyes, as well as long, pale, androgynous appearances and a ruff of small, diaphanous, moth-like feathers around their necks. They are talking amongst themselves, but something seems wrong with your translation set because you only seem to be able to understand them in bursts, like a struggling radio. “...this area... ...no more... ...the rendezvous, then...” Their ruffs shimmer from time to time, catching your eye and teasing them with their rapidly moving colors. They unsettle and fascinate at the same time. The way they appear depthless from particular angles makes you think there’s something hidden just out of sight within their fans, and if you look closer you’ll be able to see it... ]

rows.raw: "Fearless"

rows.original: You remember these bastards quite clearly. They won’t get away so easily this time! Without a second thought you stride into the clearing, [pc.rangedWeapon] in hand. The tarratch tense up when they see you - but relax when one of them flutters his ruff in your direction and laughs, lowering his weapon. “Ah... I know dregs when I taste them,” he says, a thin sneer on his pointed, white face. “How are you feeling, courageous rue collar? Confident and bulging with righteous rage, I am thinking? Fearless, you might say.” There’s a ripple of urbane laughter from the other tarratch. The leader puts his hand on his hip as he smirkingly considers you. “You are poor fare in your current state, friend. Run along and replenish your thoughts, regrow those delicious, savage impulses of yours. Then we might consider plucking you afresh.”
rows.translation: 你清楚记得这些混蛋。这回它们可别想轻易逃掉！你毫不犹豫，手持[pc.rangedWeapon]大步走进空地。塔拉特看见你时绷紧身体——但其中一个朝你抖动颈羽，笑着放下武器，其他人也放松下来。 “啊...一尝就知道是残渣，”它说，苍白尖脸上挂着淡淡冷笑。“感觉如何，勇敢的悔领者？我想，是自信满满、充斥正义怒火吧？也可以说，无所畏惧。”其他塔拉特泛起一阵文雅的笑声。首领一手叉腰，坏笑着打量你。“以你目前的状态，朋友，你算不上好菜。快走吧，补充思想，重新长出那些美味、野蛮的冲动。到那时，我们或许会考虑再次采摘你。”

rows.original:
They are right about one thing - you fear nothing, particularly not a bunch of effete, bug-cunt slavers who made the mistake of messing with you!

				You charge forward, snarling with rage, intent on planting your forehead straight through the tarratch leader’s arrogant visage. He steps to one side at the last moment and upends you with a swift, judicious flick of his long leg. You knock your head against a tree and are momentarily stunned, the jungle and the tittering of tarratch swimming together.
rows.translation:
它们有一点说对了——你什么都不怕，尤其不怕一群娘娘腔、长着虫逼、错在招惹你的奴隶贩子！

				你愤怒咆哮着冲上前，要把额头直接撞穿塔拉特首领傲慢的脸。它在最后一刻侧身，长腿迅速而精准地一扫，将你掀翻。你的头撞上树，一时晕眩，丛林与塔拉特的窃笑声混成一团。

And then do stop bothering us.” By the time you’ve clambered back to your [pc.footOrFeet] they have taken off, replete with their native takings. You shout expletives at the sky. You’ll get them next time!

rows.original: All of your instincts tell you to attack the tarratch, that there is nothing to fear - but some muffled piece of context stays you. Perhaps - perhaps if they beat you recently, it would be better to leave off attacking right now until you’ve grown stronger? Yes. That makes sense. A tactical retreat. Laden with all of the menace you feel bubbling within you, you tell them that you’ll get them later. “Whatever you say, rue collar,” the tarratch sighs with measured indifference. “You and yours are always good company when your minds are rich and full.” He turns back to his shipment of natives, and you stomp back into the jungle, planning satisfyingly dire revenges.
rows.translation: 你所有本能都在催你攻击塔拉特，告诉你没什么可怕——但一段模糊的背景认知阻止了你。或许——或许既然它们最近打败过你，最好先别攻击，等变强再说？对。这很合理。战术撤退。你带着心中翻腾的全部威胁，告诉它们以后会收拾它们。 “随你怎么说，悔领者，”塔拉特带着克制的冷漠叹息。“你们的头脑丰富饱满时，你和你的同类总是很好的伙伴。”它转向那批土著货物，你则跺着脚返回丛林，盘算令人满足的可怕报复。

rows.original: It’s the tarratch again. Clearly what they are doing is wrong - and didn’t you resolve last time to try and defuse this situation through peaceful dialogue? You are all reasonable beings, after all. Feeling nothing but goodwill and empathy, you walk into the clearing, hands in the air. The tarratch tense up when they see you - but relax when one of them flutters his ruff in your direction and laughs, lowering his weapon. “Ah... I know dregs when I taste them,” he says, a thin sneer on his pointed, white face. “How are you feeling, pacifist rue collar? A little pool of tranquility, I am thinking. You know, the therapeutic industries absolutely hate us. We do what they charge an arm and a leg for, for free!” There’s a ripple of urbane laughter from the other tarratch. The leader puts his hand on his hip as he smirkingly considers you. “You are poor fare in your current state, friend. Run along and replenish your thoughts, regrow those delicious, savage impulses of yours. Then we might consider plucking you afresh.”
rows.translation: 又是塔拉特。它们的所作所为显然不对——而你上次不是已经决定，要试着通过和平对话化解局面吗？毕竟，你们都是讲道理的生物。满怀善意与共情，你举着双手走进空地。塔拉特看见你时绷紧身体——但其中一个朝你抖动颈羽，笑着放下武器，其他人也放松下来。 “啊...一尝就知道是残渣，”它说，苍白尖脸上挂着淡淡冷笑。“感觉如何，和平主义的悔领者？我想，是一小潭宁静吧。你知道，心理治疗行业简直恨死我们了。它们收费贵得要命才能做到的事，我们免费就办到了！”其他塔拉特泛起一阵文雅的笑声。首领一手叉腰，坏笑着打量你。“以你目前的状态，朋友，你算不上好菜。快走吧，补充思想，重新长出那些美味、野蛮的冲动。到那时，我们或许会考虑再次采摘你。”

rows.original:
Nothing they have said has shaken your conviction that the tarratch can be shown the error of their ways through constructive dialogue. You smile at him serenely and say you only wish to talk with them. Have they considered that there are other lines of work available that don’t involve slavery? They all seem like intelligent chaps and ladies, surely they could easily... 
		
			Impatiently the tarratch leader steps forward and delivers a brutal blow to the side of your head with his rifle butt, sending you reeling to the ground. You are momentarily stunned, the jungle and the tittering of tarratch swimming together.
rows.translation:
它们说的一切，都没能动摇你的信念：建设性对话能让塔拉特认识到自己行为的错误。你平静地微笑，告诉它你只是想谈谈。它们考虑过不涉及奴隶买卖的其他职业吗？它们看起来都是聪明的先生女士，肯定轻易就能... 
		
			塔拉特首领不耐烦地上前，用枪托狠狠砸在你头侧，将你打得踉跄倒地。你一时晕眩，丛林与塔拉特的窃笑声混成一团。

rows.original: “That’s my considered counter-argument,” a pitying voice floats down to you. “Go home and collect your wits, rue collar. And then do stop bothering us.” By the time you’ve risen they have taken off, replete with their native takings. You sigh sadly - evidently your debating skills just weren’t good enough. Well, there’s always next time.

rows.original: You press the button on the comms unit. There’s no response. You’re debating pressing it again when an approaching thrum of huge insect wings draws your attention. From the manor grounds a male zil flies, dipping out of the air to land elegantly behind the gate.
rows.translation: 你按下通讯器按钮。无人回应。正犹豫要不要再按一次，巨型虫翼逐渐接近的嗡鸣吸引了你的注意。一名雄性兹尔从庄园里飞来，自空中俯降，优雅地落在大门后。
rows.raw: "You press the button on the comms unit. There’s no response. You’re debating pressing it again when an approaching thrum of huge insect wings draws your attention. From the manor grounds a male zil flies, dipping out of the air to land elegantly behind the gate."

rows.original: “Welcome to Thare Plantation,” he says, slowly and clearly. You realize he’s speaking in Galactic Standard rather than his own tongue, and is doing so with pride. He is dressed in white servant robes that are pretty tight on him. “Do you have an appointment?”
rows.translation: “欢迎来到塔雷种植园，”他缓慢清晰地说。你意识到他用的是银河通用语，而非母语，并且为此自豪。他穿着白色仆袍，十分贴身。“您有预约吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Welcome to Thare Plantation,” he says, slowly and clearly. You realize he’s speaking in Galactic Standard rather than his own tongue, and is doing so with pride. He is dressed in white servant robes that are pretty tight on him. “Do you have an appointment?”"

rows.original: “No,” you reply. “Just interested as to what’s going on here.”
rows.translation: “没有，”你答道。“只是想知道这里在做什么。”
rows.raw: "“No,” you reply. “Just interested as to what’s going on here.”"

rows.original: “Yep,” you reply. “Got a package here for a...” You examine the invisible box in your hands. “Dr. Livingstone?”
rows.translation: “有啊，”你答道。“这里有个包裹，送给一位...”你查看手中无形的盒子。“利文斯通博士？”
rows.raw: "“Yep,” you reply. “Got a package here for a...” You examine the invisible box in your hands. “Dr. Livingstone?”"

rows.original: “Obviously not,” you deadpan.
rows.translation: “显然没有，”你面无表情地说。
rows.raw: "“Obviously not,” you deadpan."

rows.original: “I will have to check with the master,” the zil replies, after a slow blink. “If you would be so kind as to wait--”
rows.translation: “我得向主人确认一下，”兹尔缓缓眨眼后回答。“烦请您稍等--”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I will have to check with the master,” the zil replies, after a slow blink. “If you would be so kind as to wait--”"

rows.original: “Oh, let them in, Able!” A genial-looking, stocky white-haired man dressed in pale khaki has come down the steps of the manor and is striding down the drive. “A lost, lone traveler in from the wilds, and you’re demanding to see their credentials? Come inside, my young friend!”
rows.translation: “哦，让客人进来，艾布尔！”一个面貌和善、身材敦实的白发男人，穿着浅卡其色衣服，已走下庄园台阶，大步沿车道走来。“一个迷路的旅人孤身从荒野而来，你却要查人家的证件？进来吧，我年轻的朋友！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, let them in, Able!” A genial-looking, stocky white-haired man dressed in pale khaki has come down the steps of the manor and is striding down the drive. “A lost, lone traveler in from the wilds, and you’re demanding to see their credentials? Come inside, my young friend!”"

rows.original: The gate slides silently open, and you find your hand enveloped by the walnut grip of the smiling old human.
rows.translation: 大门无声滑开，你的手被微笑的老人类用胡桃木般结实的手掌握住。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe gate slides silently open, and you find your hand enveloped by the walnut grip of the smiling old human."

rows.original: “Professor Shep Darnock, director and chief researcher of Thare Plantation, for my sins,” he says in his well-pronounced, affable tone. “Who do I have the pleasure of?”
rows.translation: “谢普·达诺克教授，塔雷种植园的主管兼首席研究员，算是我自讨苦吃吧，”他口齿清晰、和蔼地说道。“有幸认识哪位？”

rows.original: The zil certainly does, to an almost embarrassing degree. The honeyed smell of his pheromones coils into your nostrils as he sets out your cutlery. He’s barely pulled out your chair and fanned out your napkin for you when a generously sized meal for two arrives, borne on china by unsmiling kaithrit similarly dressed in tight, white servant robes emblazoned with the Snugglé logo.
rows.translation: 兹尔确实如此，几乎殷勤得令人尴尬。他摆好餐具时，蜜糖般的费洛蒙气味钻进你的鼻孔。他刚替你拉开椅子、展开餐巾，一顿分量丰盛的双人餐便到了，由板着脸的凯斯里特用瓷盘端来，它们同样穿着紧身白仆袍，上面印着舒适乐标志。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zil certainly does, to an almost embarrassing degree. The honeyed smell of his pheromones coils into your nostrils as he sets out your cutlery. He’s barely pulled out your chair and fanned out your napkin for you when a generously sized meal for two arrives, borne on china by unsmiling kaithrit similarly dressed in tight, white servant robes emblazoned with the Snugglé logo."

rows.original: The food is... interesting. You really aren’t sure about the salty pear-like things, but once you get used to it, the orange fungi that tastes like herbed ham is actually quite nice. Darnock watches you tuck in with lively, smiling eyes.
rows.translation: 食物...很有意思。你对咸味的梨形东西实在拿不准，但习惯之后，那尝起来像香草火腿的橙色菌类其实相当不错。达诺克用活泼含笑的眼睛看着你大快朵颐。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe food is... interesting. You really aren’t sure about the salty pear-like things, but once you get used to it, the orange fungi that tastes like herbed ham is actually quite nice. Darnock watches you tuck in with lively, smiling eyes."

rows.original: “So, what brings you to our little paradise?” he asks. “Looking to follow in your father’s footsteps, I imagine.”
rows.translation: “那么，什么风把你吹到我们的小天堂来了？”他问。“我想是要追随父亲的脚步吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, what brings you to our little paradise?” he asks. “Looking to follow in your father’s footsteps, I imagine.”"

rows.original: “Something like that,” you reply cautiously. “I don’t suppose you saw or heard anything falling out of the sky around here recently?”
rows.translation: “差不多吧，”你谨慎地答道。“不知道你最近有没有看见或听见什么东西从天上落到这附近？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Something like that,” you reply cautiously. “I don’t suppose you saw or heard anything falling out of the sky around here recently?”"

rows.original: The professor’s weathered brow crinkles in thought.
rows.translation: 教授饱经风霜的额头因思索而皱起。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe professor’s weathered brow crinkles in thought."

rows.original: “Do you know, there was a terrific bang to the east of here a couple of weeks ago,” he offers slowly. “I put it down to those naughty vanae savages causing more mischief for Xenogen, but perhaps--? You must be careful if you venture further south and east though, [pc.name]. The tree maidens are beasts.”
rows.translation: “你知道吗，几周前这儿以东确实传来一声巨响，”他慢慢说道。“我以为是那些调皮的瓦奈野人又在给异源生物科技捣乱，不过也许--？但如果你继续往南、往东，你务必小心，[pc.name]。那些树上少女简直是野兽。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Do you know, there was a terrific bang to the east of here a couple of weeks ago,” he offers slowly. “I put it down to those naughty vanae savages causing more mischief for Xenogen, but perhaps--? You must be careful if you venture further south and east though, [pc.name]. The tree maidens are beasts.”"

rows.original: “I just like visiting Mhen’ga,” you reply easily.
rows.translation: “我只是喜欢来门加逛逛，”你轻松地答道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I just like visiting Mhen’ga,” you reply easily."

rows.original: “Isn’t it a spectacular place!” The professor leans forward eagerly. “A veritable Garden of Eden, filled with such living wonders to discover and explore. Just being here is treat enough - being able to conduct the research I am, and guide the souls under my tutelage: a dream come true.”
rows.translation: “这地方多么壮观啊！”教授热切地前倾身体。“简直是伊甸园，满是值得发现、探索的生命奇迹。光待在这里就足够美妙——还能开展我这样的研究，指引门下的灵魂：真是美梦成真。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Isn’t it a spectacular place!” The professor leans forward eagerly. “A veritable Garden of Eden, filled with such living wonders to discover and explore. Just being here is treat enough - being able to conduct the research I am, and guide the souls under my tutelage: a dream come true.”"

rows.original: He sighs happily, looking out over the lush fields.
rows.translation: 他望着葱郁田野，幸福地叹息。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe sighs happily, looking out over the lush fields."

rows.original: You ponder what to ask him in turn.
rows.translation: 你思索接下来该问他什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ponder what to ask him in turn."

rows.original: enter
rows.raw: "enter"

rows.original: You press the button on the comms unit. Nobody responds. That probably isn’t a major shock given the time of day, however it does mean you’re going to have to either rest here or brave the jungle night.
rows.translation: 你按下通讯器按钮。无人回应。考虑到此刻的时间，这或许并不奇怪，但也意味着你只能在此休息，或冒险穿越夜间丛林。
rows.raw: "You press the button on the comms unit. Nobody responds. That probably isn’t a major shock given the time of day, however it does mean you’re going to have to either rest here or brave the jungle night."

rows.translation: 你按下通讯器按钮，片刻后，兹尔翅膀逐渐接近的嗡鸣从庄园传来。艾布尔
rows.raw: "You press the button on the comms unit, and a moment later the thrum of approaching zil wings comes from the manor. Able"

rows.translation: ，为你打开大门。

rows.original: “Our young friend returns!” beams Professor Darnock, coming down the steps as you approach the palatial grandeur of the manor. “Come, come. I shall have some
rows.translation: “我们年轻的朋友回来了！”你走近宫殿般宏伟的庄园，达诺克教授笑容满面地走下台阶。“来，来。我会让人送些
rows.raw: "\n\n“Our young friend returns!” beams Professor Darnock, coming down the steps as you approach the palatial grandeur of the manor. “Come, come. I shall have some"

rows.translation: 早餐

rows.translation: 到露台上。”

rows.raw: "ThyvaraCampCooldown"
