rows.raw: "Armored Woman"

rows.original: Thyvara
rows.raw: "Thyvara"

rows.original: Thyvara’s sitting at a booth, sharing a story with some other rushers. As she finishes up and spots you, she nods and raises her flask in your direction.
rows.translation: 赛瓦拉坐在卡座里，给其他几位淘星者讲故事。她讲完后看见你，点了点头，朝你举起酒壶。
rows.raw: "\n\nThyvara’s sitting at a booth, sharing a story with some other rushers. As she finishes up and spots you, she nods and raises her flask in your direction."

rows.original: You spot a woman talking loudly among a small group of rushers. She’s covered in heavy looking armor with a rifle slung across her back.
rows.translation: 你看到一个女人在一小群淘星者中大声说话。她全身覆着看上去很沉重的盔甲，背上斜挂着一支步枪。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou spot a woman talking loudly among a small group of rushers. She’s covered in heavy looking armor with a rifle slung across her back."

rows.original: You approach the rushers as the woman’s getting to the end of her story. From what you catch it was about some hunting trip in the jungle.
rows.translation: 你走近那些淘星者，女人的故事已接近尾声。从听见的部分判断，讲的似乎是一次丛林狩猎。
rows.raw: "You approach the rushers as the woman’s getting to the end of her story. From what you catch it was about some hunting trip in the jungle."

rows.original: The dark green, spiky armor you can see covering most of her body is actually insectile chitin, and seems to frame her breasts and ass quite flatteringly, though both are covered by leather cups and straps that seem to make up her actual clothing. Her dark skin shows around the straps. She spots you approaching as the crowd disperses, her bright, blue eyes having an odd four-pointed star shaped pupil and dark brown sclera. Her cheeks are also covered in the same chitin as the rest of her body. She smiles at your approach, raising the metal flask in her hand as a greeting.
rows.translation: 覆盖她大半身体的深绿色带刺盔甲，其实是昆虫般的几丁质，似乎将乳房与臀部衬托得颇为诱人，不过两者都由皮革罩杯和束带遮着，那些才像是她真正的衣服。束带间露出深色肌肤。人群散去时，她发现你走来；明亮蓝眼睛的瞳孔是奇异的四角星形，巩膜则为深褐色。脸颊也和身体其他部位一样，覆盖着几丁质。她朝走近的你微笑，举起手中的金属酒壶致意。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe dark green, spiky armor you can see covering most of her body is actually insectile chitin, and seems to frame her breasts and ass quite flatteringly, though both are covered by leather cups and straps that seem to make up her actual clothing. Her dark skin shows around the straps. She spots you approaching as the crowd disperses, her bright, blue eyes having an odd four-pointed star shaped pupil and dark brown sclera. Her cheeks are also covered in the same chitin as the rest of her body. She smiles at your approach, raising the metal flask in her hand as a greeting."

rows.original: “Just missed story time, I’m afraid. But I could still go for a bit of a chat. I guess introductions are needed, first.” She reaches out with her empty hand, which you take in a firm handshake. Her chitin is surprisingly smooth.
rows.translation: “恐怕刚好错过故事时间。不过我还想聊聊。想来先得互相介绍一下。”她伸出空着的手，你握住，有力地摇了摇。她的几丁质出乎意料地光滑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Just missed story time, I’m afraid. But I could still go for a bit of a chat. I guess introductions are needed, first.” She reaches out with her empty hand, which you take in a firm handshake. Her chitin is surprisingly smooth."

rows.original: “Thyvara Rosanvond. Soon to be local hunting expert.” You offer your name.
rows.translation: “赛瓦拉·罗桑冯德。即将成为本地狩猎专家。”你报上自己的名字。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thyvara Rosanvond. Soon to be local hunting expert.” You offer your name."

rows.original: “[pc.name], [pc.class]. Nice to meet you.” She nods and takes a swig from her flask, the light catching her short, green hair and highlighting the odd streak of purple.
rows.translation: “[pc.name]，[pc.class]。很高兴认识你。”她点头，仰头喝了一口酒，光线照亮她绿色短发，凸显其中奇异的紫色条纹。
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name], [pc.class]. Nice to meet you.” She nods and takes a swig from her flask, the light catching her short, green hair and highlighting the odd streak of purple."

rows.original: “So, what brings you out on the Rush, Steele?”
rows.translation: “那么，是什么让你加入淘星潮，斯蒂尔？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, what brings you out on the Rush, Steele?”"

rows.original: Fortune
rows.translation: 财富
rows.raw: "Fortune"

rows.original: You go into the details of your search for your father’s probes, which hold the fortune that belongs to you. She smiles at the small tale, and chuckles when you mention your cousin.
rows.translation: 你详细讲述寻找父亲探测器的经历，其中藏着本该属于你的财富。她微笑着听这段小故事，听到你提及表亲时轻笑起来。
rows.raw: "You go into the details of your search for your father’s probes, which hold the fortune that belongs to you. She smiles at the small tale, and chuckles when you mention your cousin."

rows.original: “Wow. I know a lot of people come out here to strike it rich, but I don’t think many have that kind of guarantee for it. Not surprised someone who caught wind of it’d be hunting it down too.” She smiles at the suspicious look you give her.
rows.translation: “哇。我知道很多人到这儿来发财，不过有这种保证的人应该不多。听到风声的人也来追着找，倒不奇怪。”你怀疑地看着她，她微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wow. I know a lot of people come out here to strike it rich, but I don’t think many have that kind of guarantee for it. Not surprised someone who caught wind of it’d be hunting it down too.” She smiles at the suspicious look you give her."

rows.original: “Don’t worry, I’m not about to go chasin’ your treasure. Old hunting party would kill me for thinkin’ o’ ripping off a nice [pc.guyGirl] like you anyway.” She looks deep into her flask for a moment before perking up again.
rows.translation: “别担心，我可不打算追你的宝藏。再说，我要是想坑你这么好的[pc.guyGirl]，以前的狩猎队还不得宰了我。”她盯着酒壶深处看了一会儿，随即又振作起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t worry, I’m not about to go chasin’ your treasure. Old hunting party would kill me for thinkin’ o’ ripping off a nice [pc.guyGirl] like you anyway.” She looks deep into her flask for a moment before perking up again."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Fortune
rows.translation: 财富
rows.raw: "Fortune"

rows.original: Tell her about your father’s fortune, and the stipulations tied to it.
rows.translation: 告诉她你父亲的财富，以及继承它所附带的条件。
rows.raw: "Tell her about your father’s fortune, and the stipulations tied to it."

rows.original: Adventure
rows.translation: 冒险
rows.raw: "Adventure"

rows.original: Explaining why you’re out in the frontier, you tell her about your father’s fortune, but the real reason you’re out here is to live out an adventure among the stars. She nods along happily with your explanation, then gives you a bright smile.
rows.translation: 解释自己为何来到边境时，你告诉她父亲的财富，不过你到这里的真正原因，是想在群星间经历一场冒险。她高兴地随着你的解释点头，然后露出灿烂笑容。
rows.raw: "Explaining why you’re out in the frontier, you tell her about your father’s fortune, but the real reason you’re out here is to live out an adventure among the stars. She nods along happily with your explanation, then gives you a bright smile."

rows.original: “That sounds a lot like me. Out here on the wild frontier, no big megacities, no spacers cramming every nook of a planet, and miles of fresh, untapped wilderness to run wild in. Some of the critters don’t even taste half bad.” She puts a hand on a horned skull sitting next to her. “Wouldn’t recommend one of these though, bastards have hide thicker than bark and they taste like old boots when you cook ‘em up.” She looks pensive for a moment.
rows.translation: “听起来和我很像。在这狂野边境，没有庞大的超级都市，没有把星球每个角落都塞满的太空人，只有绵延数英里、崭新而未经开发的荒野，任你撒野。有些小怪物味道还挺不错。”她把手放在身边一颗长角的头骨上。“不过不推荐这种，混蛋玩意儿皮比树皮还厚，煮熟了吃起来也像旧靴子。”她沉思片刻。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That sounds a lot like me. Out here on the wild frontier, no big megacities, no spacers cramming every nook of a planet, and miles of fresh, untapped wilderness to run wild in. Some of the critters don’t even taste half bad.” She puts a hand on a horned skull sitting next to her. “Wouldn’t recommend one of these though, bastards have hide thicker than bark and they taste like old boots when you cook ‘em up.” She looks pensive for a moment."

rows.original: “Maybe I should send some off to the matriarch and see if she likes it....” She mutters quietly, then looks back at you.
rows.translation: “也许该给女家长寄点，看看她喜不喜欢....”她低声咕哝，然后重新看向你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maybe I should send some off to the matriarch and see if she likes it....” She mutters quietly, then looks back at you."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Adventure
rows.translation: 冒险
rows.raw: "Adventure"

rows.original: You’re out to have some fun and live a little.
rows.translation: 你出来是为了找些乐子，好好享受生活。
rows.raw: "You’re out to have some fun and live a little."

rows.original: Sex
rows.translation: 性爱
rows.raw: "Sex"

rows.original: You let her know that you’re after some exotic species, since you’ve already checked out all the known species through the extranet. She raises an eyebrow, before muttering quietly to herself.
rows.translation: 你告诉她，自己想找些新奇物种，因为所有已知物种你都通过星际网络看过了。她挑起眉，随后低声自言自语。
rows.raw: "You let her know that you’re after some exotic species, since you’ve already checked out all the known species through the extranet. She raises an eyebrow, before muttering quietly to herself."

rows.original: <i>“Well, you gotta be careful out here. Sexy aliens aside, there are some nasty critters out there in the frontier too.
rows.translation: <i>“嗯，在这儿可得小心。除了性感外星人，边境也有不少恶心的小怪物。
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Well, you gotta be careful out here. Sexy aliens aside, there are some nasty critters out there in the frontier too. "

rows.original: You
rows.translation: 你
rows.raw: "You"

rows.original: A little thing like you
rows.translation: 像你这样的小家伙
rows.raw: "A little thing like you"

rows.original: could get yourself in serious trouble out there, most beasties are after more than a good lay.”
rows.translation: 在外头可能惹上大麻烦，多数野兽想要的可不只是爽上一回。”
rows.raw: " could get yourself in serious trouble out there, most beasties are after more than a good lay.”"

rows.original: “Surely nothing would want to hurt a cute little thing like me out there? What could resist this face?” You make the best puppy dog expression possible.
rows.translation: “外面肯定没有东西舍得伤害我这么可爱的小家伙吧？谁能抗拒这张脸？”你尽力摆出无辜小狗般的表情。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Surely nothing would want to hurt a cute little thing like me out there? What could resist this face?” You make the best puppy dog expression possible."

rows.original: “Anything tries to take a bite out of me, and it’s getting a faceful of pain.”
rows.translation: “什么东西敢咬我，我就让它满脸都是痛苦。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anything tries to take a bite out of me, and it’s getting a faceful of pain.”"

rows.original: Thyvara just sighs and chuckles, giving you an easy smile.
rows.translation: 赛瓦拉只是叹息、轻笑，给你一个轻松的微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nThyvara just sighs and chuckles, giving you an easy smile."

rows.original: You explain that you’re after a few good lays from some of the exotic life out in the Rush before they become too everyday. Nothing quite like
rows.translation: 你解释说，自己想在淘星潮中的新奇生命变得太常见之前，先享受几场美妙性爱。没有什么比
rows.raw: "You explain that you’re after a few good lays from some of the exotic life out in the Rush before they become too everyday. Nothing quite like "

rows.original: sticking your dick in
rows.translation: 把阴茎插进
rows.raw: "sticking your dick in"

rows.original: getting eaten out by
rows.translation: 让对方舔弄自己的阴户，对方是
rows.raw: "getting eaten out by"

rows.original: getting some pleasure from
rows.translation: 从对方那里得到快感，对方是
rows.raw: "getting some pleasure from"

rows.original: a new, unknown alien species. Thyvara gives you long, examining look, before shrugging.
rows.translation: 一个全新、未知的外星物种更棒了。赛瓦拉久久审视你，随后耸肩。
rows.raw: " a new, unknown alien species. Thyvara gives you long, examining look, before shrugging."

rows.original: “Well, I can’t say I haven’t had a round in the jungle with one of the locals before. Word of caution? Look out for those tree girls - Vanae I think it was - they like to milk people dry,” she gives a shy smile, and her plated cheeks seem to blush around the chitin, “may or may not have had one show interest. And let me tell ya, when you’ve got an abdomen with nothing but a reproductive system in it, they like to get in deep.” You look behind her, not noticing an abdomen until her back wiggles slightly.
rows.translation: “嗯，我也不能说没和丛林里的本地人来过一场。要提醒你一句？小心那些树上女孩——我记得叫瓦奈——她们喜欢把人榨干，”她羞涩一笑，甲片覆盖的脸颊似乎在几丁质周围泛红，“也许曾经有一个对我感兴趣，也许没有。告诉你，要是你的腹部里面全是生殖系统，她们就喜欢钻得很深。”你朝她身后看去，直到她后背轻轻扭动，才发现那节腹部。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, I can’t say I haven’t had a round in the jungle with one of the locals before. Word of caution? Look out for those tree girls - Vanae I think it was - they like to milk people dry,” she gives a shy smile, and her plated cheeks seem to blush around the chitin, “may or may not have had one show interest. And let me tell ya, when you’ve got an abdomen with nothing but a reproductive system in it, they like to get in deep.” You look behind her, not noticing an abdomen until her back wiggles slightly."

rows.original: “What’s the matter, never seen a girl who could keep it up before?” She slyly smiles before taking another swig of her flask, letting her gaze linger on the metallic container.
rows.translation: “怎么，没见过能一直撑着的女孩？”她狡黠地微笑，又喝了一口酒，视线停留在金属容器上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What’s the matter, never seen a girl who could keep it up before?” She slyly smiles before taking another swig of her flask, letting her gaze linger on the metallic container."

rows.original: “Some of my old hunting partners used to hunt the local sapiens as much as the local critters, truth be told, if you catch my drift.” She looks back up at you, winks, and smiles.
rows.translation: “说实话，我以前有些猎伴追逐本地智慧生物的劲头，不比追野兽小，你懂我的意思。”她重新抬眼看你，眨眼一笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Some of my old hunting partners used to hunt the local sapiens as much as the local critters, truth be told, if you catch my drift.” She looks back up at you, winks, and smiles."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Sex
rows.translation: 性爱
rows.raw: "Sex"

rows.original: You’re after some exotic tails to chase before it all gets commonplace.
rows.translation: 你想趁一切还没变得稀松平常，先追逐些新奇的艳遇。
rows.raw: "You’re after some exotic tails to chase before it all gets commonplace."

rows.original: As you approach Thyvara you can’t help but notice the large skull sitting next to her stool, almost large enough to be its own seat, if it weren’t jutting with a half-dozen horns. When you take a seat you notice she’s actually drinking from a glass.
rows.translation: 走近赛瓦拉时，你忍不住注意到她凳子旁边的大头骨，要不是上面伸着六根角，几乎都能单独当座椅。坐下后，你发现她这次用的是玻璃杯。
rows.raw: "As you approach Thyvara you can’t help but notice the large skull sitting next to her stool, almost large enough to be its own seat, if it weren’t jutting with a half-dozen horns. When you take a seat you notice she’s actually drinking from a glass."

rows.original: “[pc.name]! Look at what I got!” She kicks the skull with a back toe “Pretty scary, innit?” You can’t help but notice the slight slur to her words.
rows.translation: “[pc.name]！看看我弄到了什么！”她用后脚趾踢踢头骨，“挺吓人的，是不是？”你不禁注意到她说话有点含糊。
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name]! Look at what I got!” She kicks the skull with a back toe “Pretty scary, innit?” You can’t help but notice the slight slur to her words."

rows.original: “Hope you left some drinks for me.” She beams, throwing an arm around you and laughing.
rows.translation: “希望你给我留了点酒。”她笑逐颜开，伸一只胳膊搂住你，大笑起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hope you left some drinks for me.” She beams, throwing an arm around you and laughing."

rows.original: “‘Course I bloody saved one for you! Couldn’t celebrate without both of us having a drink!” She downs the rest of her glass.
rows.translation: “他妈的当然给你留了！咱俩不都喝上一杯，怎么庆祝！”她喝光杯里剩下的酒。
rows.raw: "\n\n“‘Course I bloody saved one for you! Couldn’t celebrate without both of us having a drink!” She downs the rest of her glass."

rows.original: “Uh... yeah. Are you... drunk?” She grins wide and throws her empty arm around you.
rows.translation: “呃...是啊。你...喝醉了？”她咧嘴大笑，用空着的胳膊搂住你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uh... yeah. Are you... drunk?” She grins wide and throws her empty arm around you."

rows.original: “You’re damn right I’m drunk!” She lets go of you, finishing off her glass “Figured I should celebrate after such a good kill. Got a nice credit stash for the hide too...” she sways for a moment before righting herself.
rows.translation: “他妈的没错，我醉了！”她松开你，喝干杯中的酒，“猎到这么好的东西，当然得庆祝。那张皮还卖了一大笔信用点呢...”她摇晃片刻，才重新稳住。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re damn right I’m drunk!” She lets go of you, finishing off her glass “Figured I should celebrate after such a good kill. Got a nice credit stash for the hide too...” she sways for a moment before righting herself."

rows.original: “Ey, Burt! Another round for me and my friend here!” Burt wanders over and pours two more drinks, and hands them to you.
rows.translation: “喂，伯特！给我和这位朋友再来一轮！”伯特走过来，又倒了两杯酒，递给你们。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ey, Burt! Another round for me and my friend here!” Burt wanders over and pours two more drinks, and hands them to you."

rows.original: “That’s your last one, Thyv.” The matisar nods dismissively, drinking down half the glass before slamming it into the table.
rows.translation: “最后一杯了，赛芙。”马蒂萨尔满不在乎地点头，一口喝掉半杯，再砰地将杯子砸在桌上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s your last one, Thyv.” The matisar nods dismissively, drinking down half the glass before slamming it into the table."

rows.original: “I... wanted to say something to you... what was it....” She thinks for a moment before snapping her fingers. “That was it! Wanted to thank you for asking about my party! Felt good to get all that off of my chest.” She leans in and plants a kiss on your cheek “Really meant a lot to me.” She leans heavily on you, leaning in close.
rows.translation: “我...想跟你说点什么...是什么来着....”她想了一会儿，随后打个响指。“对了！想谢谢你问起我的队伍！把那些话说出来，心里舒服多了。”她凑近，在你脸颊上亲了一口，“这对我真的很重要。”她沉沉地靠在你身上，贴近你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I... wanted to say something to you... what was it....” She thinks for a moment before snapping her fingers. “That was it! Wanted to thank you for asking about my party! Felt good to get all that off of my chest.” She leans in and plants a kiss on your cheek “Really meant a lot to me.” She leans heavily on you, leaning in close."

rows.original: “Don’t suppose you’d walk a girl home, Cap? It’s awful dangerous out there for someone in my state. I could get taken advantage of!” She puts on the most convincing fearful face her inebriated mind can, before bursting into laughter again.
rows.translation: “不知你愿不愿意送姑娘回家，船长？我这样在外面可危险极了。可能会被人占便宜！”她尽力用醉醺醺的脑袋摆出最逼真的害怕表情，接着又爆发大笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t suppose you’d walk a girl home, Cap? It’s awful dangerous out there for someone in my state. I could get taken advantage of!” She puts on the most convincing fearful face her inebriated mind can, before bursting into laughter again."

rows.original: “Alright. Where do you live?” She brightens at your acceptance.
rows.translation: “好吧。你住哪儿？”见你答应，她顿时眉开眼笑。
rows.raw: "“Alright. Where do you live?” She brightens at your acceptance."

rows.original: “Not far. You’ll be surprised to know I’ve got a house in town.” She seems very proud of this, polishing her knuckles against her chest. As she stands she stumbles into you, forcing you to catch her or be bowled over.
rows.translation: “不远。说出来你可能吃惊，我在镇上有房子。”她似乎十分自豪，将指关节在胸口蹭亮。起身时，她踉跄撞向你，逼得你要么接住她，要么被撞倒。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not far. You’ll be surprised to know I’ve got a house in town.” She seems very proud of this, polishing her knuckles against her chest. As she stands she stumbles into you, forcing you to catch her or be bowled over."

rows.original: As she straightens out she gives a quick “thanks” before hanging an arm across your shoulder and leading the two of you out into the street. The blissfully short walk is full of Thyvara’s drunken chatter.
rows.translation: 她站直后迅速说了声“谢了”，然后将一条胳膊搭上你的肩，带着你们俩走到街上。这段短得令人庆幸的路，充满赛瓦拉醉醺醺的闲聊。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs she straightens out she gives a quick “thanks” before hanging an arm across your shoulder and leading the two of you out into the street. The blissfully short walk is full of Thyvara’s drunken chatter."

rows.translation: [pc.manWoman]帮我回家。嘿，我想他们知道我仍在全力以赴、努力让他们骄傲，应该会高兴吧。”她微笑着仰望天空。
rows.raw: " [pc.manWoman] to help me home. Heh, I feel like they’d be happy, knowing I’m still giving my all to make them proud.” She looks up at the sky with a smile."

rows.original: “Most matisar are nomadic did ya you know that? Hell, way I hear it the moment our kind could get a ship to take them we were offworld and fighting in the very same Rush we got found in.” She laughs, before pointing towards one of the many prefab buildings.
rows.translation: “多数马蒂萨尔都过游牧生活，你知道吗？妈的，听说我们这族一能搭船，就立刻离开母星，在发现我们的同一波淘星潮里打起仗来了。”她笑着，指向众多预制建筑中的一栋。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Most matisar are nomadic did ya you know that? Hell, way I hear it the moment our kind could get a ship to take them we were offworld and fighting in the very same Rush we got found in.” She laughs, before pointing towards one of the many prefab buildings."

rows.original: “This here’s my place. Care to come in?” You open the door and help the woman into her house. The main room’s very well furnished. While the only actual furniture is a couch and a table, there’s an assortment of horns and tusks across the table and hanging from a wall, framed by colorful pelts hung up alongside them. There’s a small pile of books, a data-slate and a framed photo of what appears to be Thyvara’s family, standing in front of a large beast.
rows.translation: “这里就是我家。想进来吗？”你打开门，扶她进屋。主室布置得很漂亮。虽然真正的家具只有沙发和桌子，但桌上摆着、墙上挂着各式角与獠牙，旁边悬着五彩皮毛作衬。有一小摞书、一块数据板，以及一张装框照片，似乎是赛瓦拉的家人站在一头巨兽前。
rows.raw: "\n\n“This here’s my place. Care to come in?” You open the door and help the woman into her house. The main room’s very well furnished. While the only actual furniture is a couch and a table, there’s an assortment of horns and tusks across the table and hanging from a wall, framed by colorful pelts hung up alongside them. There’s a small pile of books, a data-slate and a framed photo of what appears to be Thyvara’s family, standing in front of a large beast."

rows.original: “Home...” she mutters, looking across the trophies she’s gathered. She pulls away from you and wanders to the couch, flopping into it with a satisfied sigh. She pats the cushion next to her for you to sit down.
rows.translation: “家...”她望着积攒的战利品喃喃道。她离开你的搀扶，走向沙发，满足地叹息着扑坐上去。她拍了拍旁边的坐垫，让你坐下。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Home...” she mutters, looking across the trophies she’s gathered. She pulls away from you and wanders to the couch, flopping into it with a satisfied sigh. She pats the cushion next to her for you to sit down."

rows.original: “So, this is my home. Every bone, every pelt, every wall. Mine... just mine....” She seems to deflate a little, before completely slumping down with an exhausted huff.
rows.translation: “那么，这就是我家。每根骨头，每张皮，每面墙。我的...只有我一个人的....”她似乎有些泄气，随后疲惫地呼出一口气，彻底瘫下。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, this is my home. Every bone, every pelt, every wall. Mine... just mine....” She seems to deflate a little, before completely slumping down with an exhausted huff."

rows.original: “I told you matisar didn’t do well alone, yeah?” she looks at you and you nod “Well, we’re kinda never meant to be alone. We’re born into our party, and we leave when we find a partner to start our own.” She leans back and stares at the roof “I know I’m just another rusher with nowhere to be, running around without a thought for tomorrow, but... would you mind staying the night?” She turns to you, her expression begging you to say yes.
rows.translation: “我跟你说过，马蒂萨尔不擅长独处，对吧？”她看着你，你点头，“嗯，我们算是从来就不该独处。我们生在自己的队伍里，等找到伴侣、要组建自己的队伍时才离开。”她后仰，盯着屋顶，“我知道我只是又一个无处可去、不想明天、四处乱跑的淘星者，不过...你愿意留下过夜吗？”她转向你，表情恳求你答应。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I told you matisar didn’t do well alone, yeah?” she looks at you and you nod “Well, we’re kinda never meant to be alone. We’re born into our party, and we leave when we find a partner to start our own.” She leans back and stares at the roof “I know I’m just another rusher with nowhere to be, running around without a thought for tomorrow, but... would you mind staying the night?” She turns to you, her expression begging you to say yes."

rows.original: Yes
rows.translation: 是
rows.raw: "Yes"

rows.original: You nod, and she breaks out into one of those wide grins. “Thank you!” She squeals, throwing herself at you. Between her weight and inebriated sense of strength she manages to pin you against the couch, snuggling into you. When you get her attention it’s as she’s crushing the breath from your lungs with her hug.
rows.translation: 你点头，她立刻绽开那种大大的笑容。“谢谢！”她尖叫着扑向你。她的体重加上醉后失准的力道，让她成功将你压在沙发上，依偎进怀里。你引起她注意时，她的拥抱正把你肺里的气都挤出来。
rows.raw: "You nod, and she breaks out into one of those wide grins. “Thank you!” She squeals, throwing herself at you. Between her weight and inebriated sense of strength she manages to pin you against the couch, snuggling into you. When you get her attention it’s as she’s crushing the breath from your lungs with her hug."

rows.original: “Oh, sorry. Come on, I’ll show you to my room.” She pulls the both of you off of the couch and towards a door on the far wall. The bedroom is quite sparse compared to the main, furnished only with a bed, which is covered in several fur blankets.
rows.translation: “哦，抱歉。来，我带你去卧室。”她把你们俩拉下沙发，走向远墙上的一扇门。相比主室，卧室相当简陋，只摆着一张床，上面盖了好几条皮毛毯。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, sorry. Come on, I’ll show you to my room.” She pulls the both of you off of the couch and towards a door on the far wall. The bedroom is quite sparse compared to the main, furnished only with a bed, which is covered in several fur blankets."

rows.original: Letting go she flops onto her front on the furs. She wriggles slightly before sighing and undoing a strap on her back. As the buckle comes undone a foot-long abdomen falls to rest between her legs, the end covered by a separate leather cover.
rows.translation: 她松手，正面扑倒在皮毛上。稍稍扭动后，她叹口气，解开背上的一条束带。搭扣打开，一节一英尺长的腹部落在双腿之间，末端罩着单独的皮套。
rows.raw: "\n\nLetting go she flops onto her front on the furs. She wriggles slightly before sighing and undoing a strap on her back. As the buckle comes undone a foot-long abdomen falls to rest between her legs, the end covered by a separate leather cover."

rows.original: “Ahhh, that feels good....” She sighs, rolling over to look at you, happy smile on her face.
rows.translation: “啊啊，舒服多了....”她叹息，翻身看你，脸上挂着幸福微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ahhh, that feels good....” She sighs, rolling over to look at you, happy smile on her face."

rows.original: “Oh, did you...” she blushes as a thought comes to mind “did you... want some of that too?” Her expression is curious, and you can feel her abdomen moving slowly between the two of you.
rows.translation: “哦，你是不是...”她想到什么，脸红起来，“你是不是...也想要点那个？”她神情好奇，你能感觉到那节腹部在你们之间慢慢蠕动。

rows.raw: "“Sorry, it was just an accident.” She looks at you for several moments, before nodding."

rows.original: “Okay. G’night [pc.name].” With that she snuggles into you, then grows still, her breathing steadying until she’s asleep. Following along, you wrap your arms around her and soon drift off into your own sleep.
rows.translation: “好吧。晚安，[pc.name]。”说完，她依偎进你怀里，随后不再动弹，呼吸渐渐平稳，直到睡着。你也搂住她，不久便沉入自己的梦乡。

rows.original: “Okay, um... just hold on.” You stop stroking as she begins shuffling around. Soon there’s the snap of a clasp coming undone, and you see her rise from the bed. As she does she shirks the leather harness that covers her breasts and crotch, throwing it off to the side.

rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay, um... just hold on.” You stop stroking as she begins shuffling around. Soon there’s the snap of a clasp coming undone, and you see her rise from the bed. As she does she shirks the leather harness that covers her breasts and crotch, throwing it off to the side."

rows.original: Next she reaches back, fumbling about at the base of her abdomen. You spot the clasp she’s going for and reach out to grab it, easily undoing it for her. She goes stiff at your touch, but relaxes once you get the buckle open. She turns her head to smile at you.
rows.translation: 接着她伸手到背后，在腹部根部摸索。你看见她想解的搭扣，伸手轻易替她解开。你的触碰令她僵住，但你打开搭扣后，她又放松了。她转头朝你微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nNext she reaches back, fumbling about at the base of her abdomen. You spot the clasp she’s going for and reach out to grab it, easily undoing it for her. She goes stiff at your touch, but relaxes once you get the buckle open. She turns her head to smile at you."

rows.original: “Thanks” she whispers, before sliding another harness off of her back end. This reveals the opening set at the tip of her abdomen, a soft looking slit, the interior of which is a shade darker than her dark skin. You touch it experimentally, finding it exceptionally soft, much to Thyvara’s apparent pleasure. Before you can get too into it, she pulls her abdomen away, looking at you with lust filled eyes.
rows.translation: “谢谢”她轻声说，又从后端褪下另一副束具。腹部末端的开口就此露出，是一道看上去很柔软的裂缝，内侧颜色比她本就深色的肌肤更深一层。你试探地触碰，发现柔软得出奇，显然让赛瓦拉十分舒服。还没等你太过投入，她便收回腹部，用充满情欲的眼睛看你。

rows.original: “Too long for a young Matisar like me. But I don’t have the funds to get offworld, was hoping to trade for a way off, but with the way most rushers barter I’d be lucky to get thrown on a ship as cargo.” She takes another swig of her flask, only to find the container empty. rows.raw: "\n\n“I... may have been kicked out of my old hunting party, and Matisar aren’t great at dealing with this whole ‘loneliness’ thing.” She makes dramatic air quotes, “So, if you’ll come see me every now and again, maybe swap a story or two, I’d really appreciate it.”"

rows.raw: "“I want to know a bit more about you.” She raises an eyebrow, before putting her flask onto the bar."

rows.original: “That’s a little vague, [pc.name]. Got anything more particular?” She leans back slightly as you think.

rows.original: “Almost sixteen standard terran. Matisar are mature by twelve. Still find it funny that everyone operates on terran time.” She looks you up and down, “You don’t exactly look too world weary yourself, [pc.name].” You thank her for the compliment, giving her your own age.
rows.translation: “快满十六个标准地球年了。马蒂萨尔人十二岁就算成年。所有人都按地球时间计时，我到现在还是觉得挺有意思。”她上下打量着你，“你看起来也不像是饱经沧桑的人啊，[pc.name]。”你谢过她的夸奖，也告诉了她自己的年龄。

rows.original: “So... what are you into?” You ask, earning a wide grin.
rows.translation: “那么...你平时喜欢做什么？”你问道，换来她咧嘴一笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So... what are you into?” You ask, earning a wide grin."

rows.original: “Oh, you’re going to regret that.” She chuckles, clearing her throat and taking a deep breath.
rows.translation: “哦，你会后悔问这个的。”她轻笑一声，清了清嗓子，深吸一口气。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, you’re going to regret that.” She chuckles, clearing her throat and taking a deep breath."

rows.original: “So, first and foremost, I like hunting. As a matisar, it’s kinda in my blood. I’m a traditionalist. Not as much as Tanis, but enough that I don’t care for all the flash of lasers and the cheap pop of an assault. Hunting is an art, and I’ll be damned if I don’t do my best work out there.” She takes a sip of her drink before continuing.
rows.translation: “那么，首先也是最重要的，我喜欢狩猎。身为马蒂萨尔人，这大概流淌在我的血液里。我是个传统派。虽然没塔妮丝那么传统，但也足以让我不喜欢激光四处闪烁的炫技，也不喜欢突击武器那种廉价的砰响。狩猎是一门艺术，而我在外面绝对会拿出自己最好的本事。”她喝了一口饮料，然后继续说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, first and foremost, I like hunting. As a matisar, it’s kinda in my blood. I’m a traditionalist. Not as much as Tanis, but enough that I don’t care for all the flash of lasers and the cheap pop of an assault. Hunting is an art, and I’ll be damned if I don’t do my best work out there.” She takes a sip of her drink before continuing."

rows.original: “When I get out there, just me, my gear and my speeder, I just zone out, or in? Bah, whatever. I just hit my stride, out there in the jungle, and it feels like I can do anything.”
rows.translation: “等我到了野外，只有我、装备和飞行摩托时，我就会完全忘我，或者说全神贯注？呸，随便啦。总之，我一进入状态，在丛林里就感觉自己无所不能。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“When I get out there, just me, my gear and my speeder, I just zone out, or in? Bah, whatever. I just hit my stride, out there in the jungle, and it feels like I can do anything.”"

rows.original: “On top of that, I like to cook, whenever I get something new, my first impulse is a little taste test.” she chuckles nervously to herself “Gotten myself in more than one spot of trouble doing that too. Word of advice? Don’t eat any yellow, horned beetles you find. Bastards send you on one hell of a trip.” That sounds... helpful. And more than a little reckless. Bringing the subject up you ask.
rows.translation: “除此之外，我还喜欢烹饪。每次弄到什么新东西，我的第一反应就是尝上一小口。”她有些紧张地低声笑了笑，“我也因此惹上过不止一次麻烦。给你个建议？看到黄色带角的甲虫，千万别吃。那些混蛋能让你产生一场要命的幻觉之旅。”听起来...挺有帮助。也鲁莽得不止一点。你提起这件事，问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“On top of that, I like to cook, whenever I get something new, my first impulse is a little taste test.” she chuckles nervously to herself “Gotten myself in more than one spot of trouble doing that too. Word of advice? Don’t eat any yellow, horned beetles you find. Bastards send you on one hell of a trip.” That sounds... helpful. And more than a little reckless. Bringing the subject up you ask."

rows.original: “Isn’t that a bit dangerous?” She smiles and nods.
rows.translation: “那不是有点危险吗？”她笑着点点头。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Isn’t that a bit dangerous?” She smiles and nods."

rows.original: “Incredibly, which is why I’ve started getting local opinions about things before I try them. I’ve gotten in with a couple zil and a naleen or two who let me know when whatever I’ve caught’s gonna leave me in a bad way.”
rows.translation: “危险极了，所以我现在尝试东西前，会先问问当地人的意见。我跟几个兹尔人和一两个纳林人混熟了，他们会告诉我，抓到的东西会不会让我落得很惨。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Incredibly, which is why I’ve started getting local opinions about things before I try them. I’ve gotten in with a couple zil and a naleen or two who let me know when whatever I’ve caught’s gonna leave me in a bad way.”"

rows.original: “Sounds helpful.”
rows.translation: “听起来挺有帮助。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sounds helpful.”"

rows.original: “It is, like my matriarch always said, ‘nothing better than a local to tell you what’s safe.’” She looks into her flask for a moment, before sighing.
rows.translation: “确实，就像我的女族长总说的，‘要判断什么东西安全，没有谁比当地人更可靠。’”她盯着酒壶看了一会儿，然后叹了口气。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It is, like my matriarch always said, ‘nothing better than a local to tell you what’s safe.’” She looks into her flask for a moment, before sighing."

rows.original: “Other than that, I just like stories. Telling them, hearing them, anything. I prefer the ones that involve fighting, especially when there’s a twist in the works. Nothing quite like waiting for the finish and then BAM!” she punches one hand into the other “Everything I was waiting for gets thrown out the window.” She sighs happily, taking a long draught of her flask wiping some of the creamy drink from her lips. She looks back at you with a smile.
rows.translation: “除此之外，我就是喜欢故事。讲故事、听故事，什么都喜欢。我更喜欢有战斗的故事，尤其是其中暗藏转折的那种。没有什么比等到结局，然后砰的一声！”她用一只手捶向另一只手，“我先前期待的一切全被推翻了。”她开心地叹了口气，仰头从酒壶里喝了一大口，又擦去嘴唇上沾着的一些乳白色饮料。她微笑着重新看向你。

Nothing quite like waiting for the finish and then BAM!” she punches one hand into the other “Everything I was waiting for gets thrown out the window.” She sighs happily, taking a long draught of her flask wiping some of the creamy drink from her lips. She looks back at you with a smile."

rows.original: “So, got any good tales for me?”
rows.translation: “那么，有什么好故事能讲给我听吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, got any good tales for me?”"

rows.original: Her
rows.raw: "Her"

rows.original: Her
rows.translation: 她
rows.raw: "Her"

rows.original: Get to know a bit about the young hunter.
rows.translation: 多了解一下这位年轻猎手。
rows.raw: "Get to know a bit about the young hunter."

rows.original: Weapons
rows.translation: 武器
rows.raw: "Weapons"

rows.original: Thinking of how to bring it up, you decide to just ask her “Why such old gear?” Thyvara looks at you, before smiling and putting a hand on the axe at her waist.
rows.translation: 你琢磨着该怎么开口，最后决定直接问她：“为什么要用这么老旧的装备？”赛瓦拉看向你，随后笑了笑，将一只手搭在腰间的斧头上。
rows.raw: "Thinking of how to bring it up, you decide to just ask her “Why such old gear?” Thyvara looks at you, before smiling and putting a hand on the axe at her waist."

rows.original: “It’s not old. It’s classical.” She says “And it’s... something I can get a bit lost on. If you don’t mind me talking your ear off?” You shake your head.
rows.translation: “它们不老旧。它们是经典。”她说道，“而且这...是个我一说起来就容易忘乎所以的话题。你不介意我唠叨个没完吧？”你摇了摇头。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s not old. It’s classical.” She says “And it’s... something I can get a bit lost on. If you don’t mind me talking your ear off?” You shake your head."

rows.original: “I’ve got time.” She smiles and takes a drink from her flask, before grabbing another from her pack.
rows.translation: “我有时间。”她笑着喝了一口酒壶里的饮料，随后又从背包里拿出一壶。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ve got time.” She smiles and takes a drink from her flask, before grabbing another from her pack."

rows.original: “Well, guess I’ll start with where I got them from. Matisar tradition was kind of important in my party, so we only got weapons from other Matisar colonies. I got the axe for my fifth birthday, rifle for my eighth. Honestly, I could’ve gotten a fancy laser or a semi-auto, but I’m a sucker for the classics. Guess the usual term’s ‘old fashioned’?” She caresses the barrel of her rifle fondly.
rows.translation: “嗯，我想先从它们的来历说起。我们狩猎队很重视马蒂萨尔传统，所以只从其他马蒂萨尔殖民地获取武器。五岁生日时我得到了这把斧头，八岁时得到了步枪。说实话，我本可以弄一把花哨的激光枪或半自动武器，但我就是迷恋经典。通常应该叫‘老派’吧？”她疼爱地抚摸着步枪的枪管。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, guess I’ll start with where I got them from. Matisar tradition was kind of important in my party, so we only got weapons from other Matisar colonies. I got the axe for my fifth birthday, rifle for my eighth. Honestly, I could’ve gotten a fancy laser or a semi-auto, but I’m a sucker for the classics. Guess the usual term’s ‘old fashioned’?” She caresses the barrel of her rifle fondly."

rows.original: “Then, when I started actually using these babies out in the field? There’s nothing like the kick of a solid matisar rifle in your hands. That crack as it sends a hardened round through some giant spider monster’s chitin? Mmm...” she shudders at a fond memory “it’s probably a bad thing to get excited about, but that’s just me. These weapons have served me for as long as I can remember, they’re a part of me, and I’d never dump them for anything.” She pulls her gun up and starts tapping each part, listing them off as she goes.
rows.translation: “然后，等我开始真的带着这些宝贝上战场？没有什么能比得上结实的马蒂萨尔步枪在手中产生的后坐力。硬化弹丸射穿某种巨型蜘蛛怪的甲壳时，那一声脆响？嗯...”她因这段美好回忆而颤抖，“为这种事兴奋大概不是什么好事，但我就是这样。这些武器从我有记忆以来就一直陪伴着我，它们是我的一部分，无论用什么我都绝不会抛弃它们。”她举起枪，开始逐个敲点各个部件，一边点一边报出名称。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Then, when I started actually using these babies out in the field? There’s nothing like the kick of a solid matisar rifle in your hands. That crack as it sends a hardened round through some giant spider monster’s chitin? Mmm...” she shudders at a fond memory “it’s probably a bad thing to get excited about, but that’s just me. These weapons have served me for as long as I can remember, they’re a part of me, and I’d never dump them for anything.” She pulls her gun up and starts tapping each part, listing them off as she goes."

rows.original: “Ironoak stock, lacquered with Meronian wax for waterproofing and extra durability. Refined meteoric steel chamber and barrel for that little celestial touch. And advanced alloy internals which don’t wear for decades, centuries if cared for right. I know where every part sits, high tension points that need more maintenance, and even the optimal temperature for firing.” She puts the rifle down and pulls the axe from her belt.
rows.translation: “铁橡木枪托，涂有梅洛尼亚蜡，既能防水，又能增强耐用性。精炼陨铁制成的膛室和枪管，增添一丝天外韵味。还有先进合金内构件，几十年都不会磨损，保养得当甚至能用上数百年。我知道每个部件的位置，哪些高应力点需要更多维护，甚至还知道开火的最佳温度。”她放下步枪，从腰带上抽出斧头。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ironoak stock, lacquered with Meronian wax for waterproofing and extra durability. Refined meteoric steel chamber and barrel for that little celestial touch. And advanced alloy internals which don’t wear for decades, centuries if cared for right. I know where every part sits, high tension points that need more maintenance, and even the optimal temperature for firing.” She puts the rifle down and pulls the axe from her belt."

rows.original: “I know every dent, chip and fault in my axe’s head, and can find the balance point blindfolded. I know exactly where to hold it to get the pressure where I need it and I can get the edge under any armor I’ve found.” She looks at you with a wide smile on her face at her own knowledge.
rows.translation: “斧头上的每一处凹痕、缺口和瑕疵我都一清二楚，蒙着眼也能找到平衡点。我确切地知道该握在哪里，才能把力道施加到需要的位置，也知道怎样让斧刃钻进我见过的任何护甲之下。”她因自己的知识而满脸灿烂笑容地看着你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I know every dent, chip and fault in my axe’s head, and can find the balance point blindfolded. I know exactly where to hold it to get the pressure where I need it and I can get the edge under any armor I’ve found.” She looks at you with a wide smile on her face at her own knowledge."

rows.original: “That’s... impressive.” Is all you can come with. She blushes a little before putting the axe away.
rows.translation: “这...真厉害。”你只能想到这句话。她微微脸红，随后收起斧头。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s... impressive.” Is all you can come with. She blushes a little before putting the axe away."

rows.original: “Sorry. Like I said, I tend to get a little lost talking about them. It’s just... I know every part of my weapons, how it fits, what it does, even how to make a replacement. You just, you can’t get that with modern weapons. You can learn what parts do what, how to change them, even how to get aftermarket stuff on, but how many can actually make a circuit board for a high-powered laser rifle? Or put together a railgun’s charging coils?” She gets a distant look with a fond smile.
rows.translation: “抱歉。就像我说的，我谈起它们时往往会有点忘乎所以。只是...我了解武器的每一个部件，知道它怎样安装、有什么作用，甚至知道如何制作替代品。现代武器就是没法让你做到这些。你可以了解哪些部件有什么作用、怎么更换，甚至怎么装上改装零件，可又有多少人真能制作高功率激光步枪的电路板？或者组装轨道炮的充能线圈？”她面带温柔的微笑，目光飘向远方。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry. Like I said, I tend to get a little lost talking about them. It’s just... I know every part of my weapons, how it fits, what it does, even how to make a replacement. You just, you can’t get that with modern weapons. You can learn what parts do what, how to change them, even how to get aftermarket stuff on, but how many can actually make a circuit board for a high-powered laser rifle? Or put together a railgun’s charging coils?” She gets a distant look with a fond smile."

rows.original: <i>“It might be old-fashioned, but I don’t just want to know why what I’m using works, I want to know how each part talks to every other part. I want to know, if something goes wrong, why it happened, how I can stop it happening again, and what parts are responsible.
rows.translation: <i>“这或许很老派，但我不只想知道手里的东西为什么能运作，我还想知道每个部件如何与其他部件配合。我想知道，如果出了问题，原因是什么，怎样防止它再次发生，又是哪些部件造成的。
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“It might be old-fashioned, but I don’t just want to know why what I’m using works, I want to know how each part talks to every other part. I want to know, if something goes wrong, why it happened, how I can stop it happening again, and what parts are responsible. "

rows.original: You know?
rows.translation: 你懂吧？
rows.raw: "You know?"

rows.original: Yeah
rows.translation: 好啊
rows.raw: "Yeah"

rows.original: “Yeah, I get you.” You tell her with a smile. Her grin widens until you swear it’ll reach her cheek plates.
rows.translation: “嗯，我懂你的意思。”你笑着告诉她。她的笑容越咧越大，你甚至觉得快要碰到她的颊板了。
rows.raw: "“Yeah, I get you.” You tell her with a smile. Her grin widens until you swear it’ll reach her cheek plates."

rows.original: “Thanks for understanding, most people are just happy to use something so long as it works, and take it to a mechanic when it doesn’t. I was taught to be responsible for my own equipment, so that’s what I’m doing.”
rows.translation: “谢谢你能理解。大多数人只要东西能用就很满意，坏了便拿给机械师修。我从小受到的教导是，自己的装备要由自己负责，所以我就是这么做的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thanks for understanding, most people are just happy to use something so long as it works, and take it to a mechanic when it doesn’t. I was taught to be responsible for my own equipment, so that’s what I’m doing.”"

rows.original: “So, anything else you want to know?”
rows.translation: “那么，你还有什么想知道的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, anything else you want to know?”"

rows.original: Weapons
rows.raw: "Weapons"

rows.original: Yeah
rows.translation: 好啊
rows.raw: "Yeah"

rows.original: You can get behind the idea of knowing what the things you use actually are made of.
rows.translation: 你能理解弄清自己所用之物究竟由什么构成的想法。
rows.raw: "You can get behind the idea of knowing what the things you use actually are made of."

rows.original: Nah
rows.translation: 算了
rows.raw: "Nah"

rows.original: “Not really. If it works, it works right? Can always get it fixed or get a new one.” Her smile dwindles and she sighs.
rows.translation: “不太能。能用不就行了吗？坏了总能修好，或者换个新的。”她的笑容逐渐消失，叹了口气。
rows.raw: "“Not really. If it works, it works right? Can always get it fixed or get a new one.” Her smile dwindles and she sighs."

rows.original: “Well, like I said, it’s an old-fashioned view. But, these are a part of me, and I’d rather be a lost wanderer than get them replaced.”
rows.translation: “好吧，就像我说的，这是一种老派观点。但它们是我的一部分，比起换掉它们，我宁愿成为迷失的漂泊者。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, like I said, it’s an old-fashioned view. But, these are a part of me, and I’d rather be a lost wanderer than get them replaced.”"

rows.original: “So, anything else you want to know?”
rows.translation: “那么，你还有什么想知道的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, anything else you want to know?”"

rows.original: Weapons
rows.raw: "Weapons"

rows.original: Nah
rows.translation: 算了
rows.raw: "Nah"

rows.original: If it works, why need to know every inch of it?
rows.translation: 既然能用，为什么还非得了解它的每一寸？
rows.raw: "If it works, why need to know every inch of it?"

rows.original: Weapons
rows.translation: 武器
rows.raw: "Weapons"

rows.original: Ask about her antique-looking weapons.
rows.translation: 问问她那些看起来古色古香的武器。
rows.raw: "Ask about her antique-looking weapons."

rows.original: Family
rows.translation: 家庭
rows.raw: "Family"

rows.original: She sighs heavily as you try to broach the subject again.
rows.translation: 你试着再次提起这个话题，她重重地叹了口气。
rows.raw: "She sighs heavily as you try to broach the subject again."

rows.original: “Alright, alright. So... maybe I didn’t give you the whole story.” She takes a long drink before putting the cap on her canister and gently placing it in her bag.
rows.translation: “好吧，好吧。所以...也许我没把事情全都告诉你。”她喝了一大口，才盖上水壶的盖子，轻轻放进包里。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright, alright. So... maybe I didn’t give you the whole story.” She takes a long drink before putting the cap on her canister and gently placing it in her bag."

rows.original: “So, this is going to be a bit of a story. And these,” she gestures to her fans, “still have a part in the situation.”
rows.translation: “这说来话长。而这些，”她示意了一下自己的鳍扇，“也和这件事有关。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, this is going to be a bit of a story. And these,” she gestures to her fans, “still have a part in the situation.”"

rows.original: “Alright, let’s start with the beginning. We were out in the wilderness of a primal world. You know the type, lots of really mean nasties, no known sentients. We were hoping to get a good story and some solid trophies. Truth was we weren’t ready to find them.”
rows.translation: “好吧，咱们从头说起。当时我们在一颗原始星球的荒野上。你知道那种地方，到处都是凶恶的怪物，没有已知的智慧生物。我们想收获一个好故事，再弄些像样的战利品。事实上，我们根本没做好遇上它们的准备。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright, let’s start with the beginning. We were out in the wilderness of a primal world. You know the type, lots of really mean nasties, no known sentients. We were hoping to get a good story and some solid trophies. Truth was we weren’t ready to find them.”"

rows.original: “We touched down and managed some good kills in the first few days. But then we got lax, thought we were good enough to handle whatever the planet threw at us. That was when we found them, or, I guess they found us....” She goes silent for a few minutes, and you could swear you see tears growing in her eyes.
rows.translation: “我们着陆后，头几天猎到了不少好猎物。可后来我们松懈了，觉得自己足够厉害，能应付这颗星球上的任何东西。就在那时，我们发现了它们，或者说，我想是它们发现了我们....”她沉默了几分钟，你几乎可以肯定自己看到她眼中泛起了泪水。
rows.raw: "\n\n“We touched down and managed some good kills in the first few days. But then we got lax, thought we were good enough to handle whatever the planet threw at us. That was when we found them, or, I guess they found us....” She goes silent for a few minutes, and you could swear you see tears growing in her eyes."

rows.original: “I’m still not sure what they were. Some kind of ambush predator. They weren’t that tough, but there was a dozen of them, and they moved like lightning.” She pulls out her tablet and brings up a picture.
rows.translation: “我到现在也不清楚它们是什么。某种伏击型掠食者。它们并没有多强壮，但足有十几只，行动快如闪电。”她拿出平板，调出一张照片。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m still not sure what they were. Some kind of ambush predator. They weren’t that tough, but there was a dozen of them, and they moved like lightning.” She pulls out her tablet and brings up a picture."

rows.original: The image shows a creature the size of a large dog, with black chitin, ten spindly legs and a pair of long, sharp fangs like a spider. All this is topped off by a set of eight eyes, all placed across the body. It looks like a nightmare come to life.
rows.translation: 照片里的生物有大型犬那么大，披着黑色甲壳，长着十条细长的腿，还有一对蜘蛛般又长又尖的毒牙。再加上遍布全身的八只眼睛，简直像是活生生的噩梦。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe image shows a creature the size of a large dog, with black chitin, ten spindly legs and a pair of long, sharp fangs like a spider. All this is topped off by a set of eight eyes, all placed across the body. It looks like a nightmare come to life."

rows.original: “Those things are smart. If they had arms I wouldn’t be surprised if they developed weapons and got inducted into galactic civilisation. As it is, they’re just smart ambush predators. We killed a few of them during the day and they scattered. We thought they scattered out of fear, but the bloody things were waiting for us to lower our guard.”
rows.translation: “那些东西很聪明。要是它们有手臂，就算造出了武器、加入了银河文明，我也不会意外。不过现在，它们只是聪明的伏击型掠食者。白天我们杀了几只，剩下的就四散逃开了。我们以为它们是吓跑的，可那些该死的东西是在等我们放松警惕。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Those things are smart. If they had arms I wouldn’t be surprised if they developed weapons and got inducted into galactic civilisation. As it is, they’re just smart ambush predators. We killed a few of them during the day and they scattered. We thought they scattered out of fear, but the bloody things were waiting for us to lower our guard.”"

rows.original: “We got back to our ship and started carving up our kills. They snuck in through the flush vents, broke out into one of the common rooms. They killed Nasia before we even knew what was happening. I’ll save you the gory details on what those things did to us.” Her fans flutter, and you find your eyes drawn to the somewhat tattered one.
rows.translation: “我们回到飞船上，开始分割猎物。它们从排放口溜进来，闯进了一间公共休息室。我们还没弄清发生了什么，娜西亚就被它们杀了。那些东西对我们干了什么，我就不跟你讲那些血淋淋的细节了。”她的鳍扇颤动着，你的目光不由得落在那片有些残破的鳍扇上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“We got back to our ship and started carving up our kills. They snuck in through the flush vents, broke out into one of the common rooms. They killed Nasia before we even knew what was happening. I’ll save you the gory details on what those things did to us.” Her fans flutter, and you find your eyes drawn to the somewhat tattered one."

rows.original: “We landed with twelve good, strong matisar. We left with eight. It might not sound that bad, only losing four people in an ambush. But they were our party, our kin, and one of them was preparing to split off and start their own party. Their own family, as most would say.” Her eyes go distant for a few moments.
rows.translation: “着陆时，我们有十二个身强体壮的马蒂萨尔人。离开时只剩八个。听起来也许没那么糟，一场伏击只死了四个人。但他们是我们的狩猎队，是我们的亲人，其中一个还正准备独立出去，组建自己的狩猎队。用大多数人的话说，就是自己的家庭。”她的眼神恍惚了片刻。
rows.raw: "\n\n“We landed with twelve good, strong matisar. We left with eight. It might not sound that bad, only losing four people in an ambush. But they were our party, our kin, and one of them was preparing to split off and start their own party. Their own family, as most would say.” Her eyes go distant for a few moments."

rows.original: “Everyone was sad, and angry, and looking for a reason why it happened. Guess who got to be the lucky outlet?” she sighs heavily before lifting her head to stare at the roof “Worst part of it was, I believed it. I thought it was my fault, that somehow I hadn’t been observant enough, even when everyone else didn’t notice, either.”
rows.translation: “大家都很难过，也很愤怒，都想找个原因解释这一切。猜猜谁有幸成了他们的出气筒？”她重重地叹了口气，随后抬起头，盯着屋顶“最糟的是，我信了。我觉得那是我的错，觉得一定是我不够警觉，尽管其他人也都没察觉。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Everyone was sad, and angry, and looking for a reason why it happened. Guess who got to be the lucky outlet?” she sighs heavily before lifting her head to stare at the roof “Worst part of it was, I believed it. I thought it was my fault, that somehow I hadn’t been observant enough, even when everyone else didn’t notice, either.”"

rows.original: “It was a few weeks before we landed on Mhen’ga, and everyone had apologised to me at least once. Hell, Taror even hugged me. But I still thought I needed to become a better hunter. So, I jumped ship when we were heading offworld. I lied, by the way, about not being in contact with them? They’re hunting off on a spinaran colony world. I can’t go back to them, not now. I need to prove to myself that I can support myself just fine.” She takes a few minutes, before sighing and standing up.
rows.translation: “几周后，我们才在门加着陆，那之前每个人都至少向我道过一次歉。见鬼，塔罗尔甚至还抱了我。但我还是觉得自己需要成为更好的猎人。所以，我们准备离开这颗星球时，我偷偷下了船。对了，之前说我没和他们联系，那是骗你的。他们正在一颗斯皮纳兰殖民星上打猎。我不能回到他们身边，至少现在不行。我需要向自己证明，我完全能自食其力。”她缓了几分钟，才叹了口气站起身。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It was a few weeks before we landed on Mhen’ga, and everyone had apologised to me at least once. Hell, Taror even hugged me. But I still thought I needed to become a better hunter. So, I jumped ship when we were heading offworld. I lied, by the way, about not being in contact with them? They’re hunting off on a spinaran colony world. I can’t go back to them, not now. I need to prove to myself that I can support myself just fine.” She takes a few minutes, before sighing and standing up."

rows.original: “Guess I’d better get back to that whole thing. See ya soon, [pc.name]. Probably.” With that she grabs her bag and rifle and steps out the door.
rows.translation: “我想还是该回去继续努力了。回头见，[pc.name]。大概吧。”说完，她拿起背包和步枪，走出了门。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Guess I’d better get back to that whole thing. See ya soon, [pc.name]. Probably.” With that she grabs her bag and rifle and steps out the door."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You broach the topic of her family, and she immediately loses some of her energy.
rows.translation: 你提起她的家人，她立刻没了几分精神。
rows.raw: "You broach the topic of her family, and she immediately loses some of her energy."

rows.original: “You... you want to know about my party?” She mutters.
rows.translation: “你...你想知道我的狩猎队？”她低声说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You... you want to know about my party?” She mutters."

rows.original: “I want to know about your family. What were they like?” She sighs and looks up at you.
rows.translation: “我想了解你的家人。他们是什么样的人？”她叹了口气，抬头看着你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I want to know about your family. What were they like?” She sighs and looks up at you."

rows.original: “Sorry, a matisar’s family is called a party. Mine, specifically, was the Daehintors Hunting Party. We’re pretty traditionalist, not as closed minded as some, but we liked to keep to the old ways of things.”
rows.translation: “抱歉，马蒂萨尔人的家庭叫作狩猎队。具体来说，我的家叫戴辛托斯狩猎队。我们相当传统，虽然不像有些人那么思想闭塞，但我们喜欢遵循老规矩。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry, a matisar’s family is called a party. Mine, specifically, was the Daehintors Hunting Party. We’re pretty traditionalist, not as closed minded as some, but we liked to keep to the old ways of things.”"

rows.original: “It wasn’t bad, growing up. I had four sisters and two brothers, and we never really had any trouble providing for ourselves, and I had fun playing with my siblings.” She takes a slow drink of her canister, popping the cap back on and grabbing another from her pack.
rows.translation: “小时候过得还不错。我有四个姐妹、两个兄弟，大家一直都能自给自足，没遇上什么困难，和兄弟姐妹一起玩也很开心。”她慢慢喝了一口水壶里的饮料，扣好盖子，又从背包里拿出另一壶。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It wasn’t bad, growing up. I had four sisters and two brothers, and we never really had any trouble providing for ourselves, and I had fun playing with my siblings.” She takes a slow drink of her canister, popping the cap back on and grabbing another from her pack."

rows.original: “So, where are they now?” She shrugs, sighing heavily.
rows.translation: “那他们现在在哪儿？”她耸耸肩，重重地叹了口气。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, where are they now?” She shrugs, sighing heavily."

rows.original: “Don’t know. Haven’t spoken to them in... three, four months now?” She just looks at her latest metal flask “Most matisar... tend to keep away from the likes of me.” You raise an eyebrow.
rows.translation: “不知道。已经...三四个月没和他们说过话了吧？”她只是看着刚拿出来的金属酒壶“大多数马蒂萨尔人...都不愿和我这种人来往。”你挑起一边眉毛。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t know. Haven’t spoken to them in... three, four months now?” She just looks at her latest metal flask “Most matisar... tend to keep away from the likes of me.” You raise an eyebrow."

rows.original: “Why?” She looks at you, then smiles. She shifts herself a little, before two ridges on her back start to expand, lifting from around her shoulders and bending into a slight curve. As they extend they reveal two bleach white membranes, you notice the left one’s slightly tattered.
rows.translation: “为什么？”她看着你，随后笑了笑。她稍稍挪动身子，背上的两道隆起开始展开，从肩膀周围抬起，弯成微微的弧形。随着它们伸展，两片惨白的薄膜显露出来，你注意到左边那片有些残破。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Why?” She looks at you, then smiles. She shifts herself a little, before two ridges on her back start to expand, lifting from around her shoulders and bending into a slight curve. As they extend they reveal two bleach white membranes, you notice the left one’s slightly tattered."

rows.original: “We see our fans as a window into the Wanderer, kind of the matisar equivalent to a soul, and as you can see, mine are blank.”
rows.translation: “我们把鳍扇看作通向漂泊者的窗口，漂泊者差不多就相当于马蒂萨尔人的灵魂。你也看到了，我的鳍扇一片空白。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We see our fans as a window into the Wanderer, kind of the matisar equivalent to a soul, and as you can see, mine are blank.”"

rows.original: “And that’s... bad?” Her lip curls up slightly, baring teeth in a very unfriendly expression.
rows.translation: “这样...不好吗？”她的嘴唇微微翘起，露出牙齿，神情十分不友善。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And that’s... bad?” Her lip curls up slightly, baring teeth in a very unfriendly expression."

rows.original: “Bad? BAD?!” Her entire body shudders “It means I’m nothing. No one! I spent my life trying to be something to my family. To prove I’m not just a waste of time but...” she starts taking deep shuddering breaths, her shaking calming slightly.
rows.translation: “不好？不好？！”她浑身颤抖起来“这意味着我什么都不是。什么都不是！我一辈子都在努力，想让家人觉得我有点价值。想证明在我身上花时间并非徒劳，可是...”她开始深深地吸气，气息颤抖，身体的抖动稍稍平复了些。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bad? BAD?!” Her entire body shudders “It means I’m nothing. No one! I spent my life trying to be something to my family. To prove I’m not just a waste of time but...” she starts taking deep shuddering breaths, her shaking calming slightly."

rows.original: “I told you my family were traditionalists, and they can be open minded, but as far as they were concerned I’m a blank. There’s no Wanderer in me.” Not sure what to do you pat her on the shoulder, and the act seems to pay off, as she wraps a hand around you in return.
rows.translation: “我告诉过你，我的家人很传统，他们也能开明些，但在他们看来，我就是一片空白。我体内没有漂泊者。”你不知道该怎么办，便拍了拍她的肩膀，这似乎起了作用，她也伸出一只手臂搂住你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I told you my family were traditionalists, and they can be open minded, but as far as they were concerned I’m a blank. There’s no Wanderer in me.” Not sure what to do you pat her on the shoulder, and the act seems to pay off, as she wraps a hand around you in return."

rows.original: “Thanks. It... thanks.” You sit like that for a while, before she recomposes herself.
rows.translation: “谢谢。这...谢谢。”你们就这样坐了一会儿，她才重新收拾好情绪。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thanks. It... thanks.” You sit like that for a while, before she recomposes herself."

rows.original: “I’m going to prove them wrong. I have to prove I have what it takes. I’ll hunt the biggest damned monsters out there until everyone realises I’m not a waste. That I can hunt as well as the rest of them.” She goes silent for a few moments, eyeing her drink with a sombre look.
rows.translation: “我要证明他们错了。我必须证明自己有那个本事。我要去猎杀那些最大最可怕的怪物，直到所有人都明白，我不是废物。我的狩猎本领能和他们任何人一样好。”她沉默了片刻，神情黯然地看着自己的饮料。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m going to prove them wrong. I have to prove I have what it takes. I’ll hunt the biggest damned monsters out there until everyone realises I’m not a waste. That I can hunt as well as the rest of them.” She goes silent for a few moments, eyeing her drink with a sombre look."
