The back of her hands is covered in chitin, the palm and fingers are free of it, showing dark skin, while her fingers end in a set of sharp looking claws. Her feet have one backwards facing and three forward facing toes, which she usually walks on using the padded tips.
rows.translation: 她前臂和小腿上的甲壳布满小刺。手背也覆盖着甲壳，手掌和手指则没有，露出深色的皮肤，指尖长着看上去十分锋利的爪子。她的脚上有一根向后、三根向前的脚趾，平时走路时用带肉垫的趾尖着地。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe chitin covering her forearms and lower legs is covered in small spikes. The back of her hands is covered in chitin, the palm and fingers are free of it, showing dark skin, while her fingers end in a set of sharp looking claws. Her feet have one backwards facing and three forward facing toes, which she usually walks on using the padded tips."

rows.original: Her abdomen reaches twelve inches long, resting between a pair of ridges on her back.
rows.translation: 她的腹部足有十二英寸长，安放在背上的一对隆起之间。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer abdomen reaches twelve inches long, resting between a pair of ridges on her back."

rows.original: These fold out into large fan-like structures made of a white membrane. The left one has small tears in it.
rows.translation: 这些隆起展开后，会形成由白色薄膜构成的巨大扇状结构。左边那片有些小裂口。
rows.raw: " These fold out into large fan-like structures made of a white membrane. The left one has small tears in it."

rows.original: The entrance to her vagina is located at the end of her abdomen. The interior houses three wombs, two of which are located along the bottom of her channel.
rows.translation: 她的阴道口位于腹部末端。里面有三个子宫，其中两个位于阴道底部沿线。
rows.raw: " The entrance to her vagina is located at the end of her abdomen. The interior houses three wombs, two of which are located along the bottom of her channel."

rows.original: She’s wearing a mix of leather straps and patches, which serve to cover most of her skin, but leave her chitin as open as possible. She has an old-looking bolt-action rifle leaning against the wall, and a small axe slotted into a strap around her waist.
rows.translation: 她穿着皮革带和皮片拼成的衣服，遮住了大部分皮肤，却让甲壳尽可能露在外面。墙边靠着一把看起来很旧的栓动步枪，她腰间的皮带上则插着一把小斧头。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe’s wearing a mix of leather straps and patches, which serve to cover most of her skin, but leave her chitin as open as possible. She has an old-looking bolt-action rifle leaning against the wall, and a small axe slotted into a strap around her waist."

rows.original: As you finish your assessment of her body you notice her gaze is equally focused on you. With a quick smile she asks “See something you like, captain?”
rows.translation: 你打量完她的身体，才发现她也在专注地看着你。她飞快地笑了一下，问道“看上什么了，船长？”
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you finish your assessment of her body you notice her gaze is equally focused on you. With a quick smile she asks “See something you like, captain?”"

rows.original: Appearance
rows.translation: 外貌
rows.raw: "Appearance"

rows.original: Check out the well armored woman.
rows.translation: 打量这位甲壳厚实的女人。
rows.raw: "Check out the well armored woman."

rows.original: Talk
rows.translation: 交谈
rows.raw: "Talk"

rows.original: “I just want to chat,” You tell her. She takes a sip from her flask, nodding.
rows.translation: “我只是想聊聊天，”你告诉她。她从酒壶里抿了一口，点点头。
rows.raw: "“I just want to chat,” You tell her. She takes a sip from her flask, nodding."

rows.original: “Well got anything particular you want to chat about?”
rows.translation: “那你有什么特别想聊的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well got anything particular you want to chat about?”"

rows.original: Talk
rows.translation: 交谈
rows.raw: "Talk"

rows.original: Chat for a while with the young matisar.
rows.translation: 和这位年轻的马蒂萨尔人聊一会儿。
rows.raw: "Chat for a while with the young matisar."

rows.original: Share Stories
rows.translation: 分享故事
rows.raw: "Share Stories"

rows.original: You let her know you’re interested in swapping stories. She grins and sets her flask down on the table.
rows.translation: 你告诉她，你想和她交换故事。她咧嘴一笑，把酒壶放在桌上。
rows.raw: "You let her know you’re interested in swapping stories. She grins and sets her flask down on the table."

rows.original: “Well then, I’m always up for a good story.” She gives you an elaborate wave. “Take us off then.”
rows.translation: “好啊，我随时都乐意听个好故事。”她夸张地挥了挥手。“那就由你开个头吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well then, I’m always up for a good story.” She gives you an elaborate wave. “Take us off then.”"

rows.original: Mhen’ga
rows.translation: 门加
rows.raw: "Mhen’ga"

rows.original: You recall your time on Mhen’ga, and the journeys you’ve had in the jungles. After recounting a particular adventure you ask if she has anything to share? She smiles looking up and thinking.
rows.translation: 你回想起在门加度过的时光，以及在丛林中的种种旅程。讲完其中一次冒险后，你问她有没有什么故事想分享。她笑着抬起头，思索起来。
rows.raw: "You recall your time on Mhen’ga, and the journeys you’ve had in the jungles. After recounting a particular adventure you ask if she has anything to share? She smiles looking up and thinking."

rows.original: “Yeah, yeah I got one. Story from right around here.” She takes another swig of her drink and leans back with a sigh.
rows.translation: “有，有一个。就发生在这附近。”她又喝了一大口饮料，向后一靠，叹了口气。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, yeah I got one. Story from right around here.” She takes another swig of her drink and leans back with a sigh."

rows.original: “Alright, so, this was before my party left. We were out hunting around a stream that’d carved itself a canyon. We were down there, fishing, exploring, all the usual stuff you’d do on a frontier world.”
rows.translation: “好吧，那是在我的狩猎队离开之前。我们在一条溪流附近打猎，溪水冲刷出了一道峡谷。我们就在谷底钓鱼、探险，做的都是些在边疆星球上常做的事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright, so, this was before my party left. We were out hunting around a stream that’d carved itself a canyon. We were down there, fishing, exploring, all the usual stuff you’d do on a frontier world.”"

rows.original: “We found one of those sacae, those tentacled girls who live in the water? We found one of them, strung up in the rocks, getting taunted by a few zil. Never found out how they caught her, but we definitely made sure they weren’t gonna keep her.” She gets a proud smile as she recalls the rescue.
rows.translation: “我们发现了一个萨凯，就是住在水里的那些触手姑娘，知道吧？我们找到她时，她被吊在岩石间，几个兹尔人正拿她取乐。始终没弄清他们是怎么抓到她的，不过我们当然不会让他们继续扣着她。”回忆起那次营救，她露出自豪的笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\n“We found one of those sacae, those tentacled girls who live in the water? We found one of them, strung up in the rocks, getting taunted by a few zil. Never found out how they caught her, but we definitely made sure they weren’t gonna keep her.” She gets a proud smile as she recalls the rescue."

rows.original: “We positioned around them. Mirase yelled at them ‘Let the girl go!’ and they freaked. They started spinning around trying to work out where the shout had come from.”
rows.translation: “我们在他们周围各就各位。米拉瑟冲他们大喊‘放开那个姑娘！’，他们一下就慌了。他们开始原地打转，想弄清那声喊叫是从哪儿来的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We positioned around them. Mirase yelled at them ‘Let the girl go!’ and they freaked. They started spinning around trying to work out where the shout had come from.”"

rows.original: “Then Caris shouted that they angered the Canyon Kings, and it took everything I had not to burst out laughing.” she giggles at the memory “They just kept up the act, pretending to be some kind of immortal guardians, and eventually our matriarch, Gisara, got tired of it and fired off a warning shot. Watching those poor bee boys climb over each other trying to get the hell out of there was one of the funniest things I’ve seen on this world.”
rows.translation: “接着卡里斯喊道，他们惹怒了峡谷之王，我拼了命才忍住没笑出声来。”回忆起这一幕，她咯咯笑了起来“他们就那么一直演下去，假装自己是什么不朽的守护者，最后我们的女族长吉萨拉受不了了，鸣了一枪警告。看着那些可怜的蜜蜂小伙互相踩踏着拼命逃跑，是我在这颗星球上见过的最好笑的事之一。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Then Caris shouted that they angered the Canyon Kings, and it took everything I had not to burst out laughing.” she giggles at the memory “They just kept up the act, pretending to be some kind of immortal guardians, and eventually our matriarch, Gisara, got tired of it and fired off a warning shot. Watching those poor bee boys climb over each other trying to get the hell out of there was one of the funniest things I’ve seen on this world.”"

rows.original: “After they were long gone we popped out of our hiding place and got the poor girl down from the cliff. She slid herself back into the water and we had a little chat. I mean, when you meet a fellow hunter out there, you have to have some respect for each other.”
rows.translation: “等他们跑远了，我们才从藏身处出来，把那可怜的姑娘从悬崖上救下来。她滑回水里，我们聊了一会儿。我的意思是，在野外遇上同行猎人，总得互相尊重一下。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“After they were long gone we popped out of our hiding place and got the poor girl down from the cliff. She slid herself back into the water and we had a little chat. I mean, when you meet a fellow hunter out there, you have to have some respect for each other.”"

rows.original: “She showed us a few nice fishing spots in the river, and let me tell you, some of these fish are absolutely delicious.”
rows.translation: “她带我们看了河里几个不错的钓鱼点。我跟你说，有些鱼可真是美味极了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“She showed us a few nice fishing spots in the river, and let me tell you, some of these fish are absolutely delicious.”"

rows.original: You nod, fondly remembering the taste of the ginder fish the naleen prepared for you.
rows.translation: 你点点头，美滋滋地回味起纳林人为你烹制的金德鱼。
rows.raw: " You nod, fondly remembering the taste of the ginder fish the naleen prepared for you."

rows.original: You’ll have to take her word for it, not having tried the local selection yourself.
rows.translation: 你自己还没尝过当地的鱼，也只能相信她的话。
rows.raw: " You’ll have to take her word for it, not having tried the local selection yourself."

rows.original: “So, got anything else you want to share?”
rows.translation: “那么，还有什么想分享的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, got anything else you want to share?”"

rows.original: THYVARA_STORY
rows.raw: "THYVARA_STORY"

rows.original: Mhen’ga
rows.translation: 门加
rows.raw: "Mhen’ga"

rows.original: Why not share some surprises you’ve found on Thyvara’s home turf?
rows.translation: 何不分享一下你在赛瓦拉的地盘上遇到的意外之喜？
rows.raw: "Why not share some surprises you’ve found on Thyvara’s home turf?"

rows.original: Mhen’ga
rows.translation: 门加
rows.raw: "Mhen’ga"

rows.original: Mhen’ga
rows.translation: 门加
rows.raw: "Mhen’ga"

rows.original: You have no stories of Mhen’ga to share.
rows.translation: 你没有关于门加的故事可以分享。
rows.raw: "You have no stories of Mhen’ga to share."

rows.original: Myrellion
rows.translation: 迈瑞利恩
rows.raw: "Myrellion"

rows.original: You bring up your time on the war-torn world of Myrellion, and your adventures among the many races living there. After recounting one of the more exciting events you were a part of there, you ask the matisar huntress if she has any comparable experiences.
rows.translation: 你说起了在饱受战火蹂躏的米瑞利昂度过的时光，以及在当地众多种族间的冒险。讲完在那里亲身经历的一件格外刺激的事后，你问这位马蒂萨尔女猎人有没有类似的经历。
rows.raw: "You bring up your time on the war-torn world of Myrellion, and your adventures among the many races living there. After recounting one of the more exciting events you were a part of there, you ask the matisar huntress if she has any comparable experiences."

rows.original: After a few moments thought she nods.
rows.translation: 她想了片刻，点点头。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a few moments thought she nods."

rows.original: “Alright. This one’s got some more adult themes to it, but the story’s still a good one.” She chuckles as she starts going through her datapad, eventually coming to a picture of her family standing amongst what looks like a group of bird-like aliens.
rows.translation: “好吧。这个故事有点成人内容，不过还是个好故事。”她轻笑着翻看起数据板，最后找出了一张照片，上面是她的家人，站在一群长得像鸟的外星人中间。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright. This one’s got some more adult themes to it, but the story’s still a good one.” She chuckles as she starts going through her datapad, eventually coming to a picture of her family standing amongst what looks like a group of bird-like aliens."

rows.original: “These are the Tiras tribe from a Rush world. Can’t remember the name, but they’re damned good hunters for their tech level, and we had some fun hunting with them for a month or two.” She points to one of the smaller matisar. “This is Jaroth. He got especially friendly with one of the tribe, and ended up giving her an egg. We were all supposed to be on regular Sterilex treatments, but apparently he forgot his at one point.”
rows.translation: “这是行星开拓潮中某颗星球上的提拉斯部落。名字记不清了，不过以他们的科技水平来说，他们可是相当厉害的猎人，我们和他们一起打了一两个月猎，过得很开心。”她指着一个个头较小的马蒂萨尔人。“这是贾罗斯。他和部落里的一个姑娘特别亲近，最后让她怀了颗卵。按理说，我们所有人都该定期服用斯特里莱克斯，不过显然他有一次忘了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“These are the Tiras tribe from a Rush world. Can’t remember the name, but they’re damned good hunters for their tech level, and we had some fun hunting with them for a month or two.” She points to one of the smaller matisar. “This is Jaroth. He got especially friendly with one of the tribe, and ended up giving her an egg. We were all supposed to be on regular Sterilex treatments, but apparently he forgot his at one point.”"

rows.original: “Now, the tribe was happy to have a half-matisar kid running around, as long as Jaroth agreed to help take care of it. Now, these guys have a fairly quick cycle, two weeks to egg, three months to hatching. That’s all they wanted, for him to stay until the egg hatched.”
rows.translation: “部落很高兴能有个混血马蒂萨尔小孩跑来跑去，只要贾罗斯答应帮着照顾就行。他们的生育周期相当快，两周产卵，三个月孵化。他们只要求他留下来，直到卵孵化。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now, the tribe was happy to have a half-matisar kid running around, as long as Jaroth agreed to help take care of it. Now, these guys have a fairly quick cycle, two weeks to egg, three months to hatching. That’s all they wanted, for him to stay until the egg hatched.”"

rows.original: “Now, we all agreed to it, since the planet was actually pretty hospitable for us, and there was a nice diversity of wildlife there. So we hunt, sometimes with the tribe, but usually on our own, until the tribe tells us that someone’s kidnapped our brother.” She gives you a tired smile.
rows.translation: “我们都同意了，因为那颗星球其实挺适合我们居住的，而且野生动物种类繁多。所以我们继续打猎，有时和部落一起，不过大多时候还是自己行动，直到部落告诉我们，有人绑架了我们的兄弟。”她朝你疲惫地笑了笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now, we all agreed to it, since the planet was actually pretty hospitable for us, and there was a nice diversity of wildlife there. So we hunt, sometimes with the tribe, but usually on our own, until the tribe tells us that someone’s kidnapped our brother.” She gives you a tired smile."

rows.original: “Turns out a rival tribe had heard about Jaroth’s little breeding event, and decided they wanted some of that star-seed for themselves. We found the rival village easy enough, and boy had they been busy. There was already a full nursery set up and ready, and a lot of folk walking around with fat bellies. We waited for night before moving in on them. We’d spotted where they were keeping him, just had to look for the building they went in thin and came out bloated. I don’t think they quite knew what they were getting themselves into volume-wise.”
rows.translation: “原来，一个敌对部落听说了贾罗斯那档子配种的事，决定自己也要弄点天外来的种子。我们没费什么劲就找到了那个村子，哎哟，他们可真没闲着。一整间育婴室都布置好了，还有不少人挺着大肚子走来走去。我们等到晚上才潜进去。我们已经发现他们把他关在哪里了，只要找那栋进去时肚子平平、出来时肚子鼓鼓的房子就行。我想他们根本不知道自己要面对多大的量。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Turns out a rival tribe had heard about Jaroth’s little breeding event, and decided they wanted some of that star-seed for themselves. We found the rival village easy enough, and boy had they been busy. There was already a full nursery set up and ready, and a lot of folk walking around with fat bellies. We waited for night before moving in on them. We’d spotted where they were keeping him, just had to look for the building they went in thin and came out bloated. I don’t think they quite knew what they were getting themselves into volume-wise.”"

rows.original: “We snuck in and knocked out a guard or two. When we got inside the hut, damn was it a mess. He was actually knotted when we got there. I’d say the girl was surprised to see us, but I think she was just insensate. Jaroth looked at us for a few seconds before he realised who had just broken into his little love tent.”
rows.translation: “我们偷偷进去，打昏了一两个守卫。进了小屋，里面可真是一团糟。我们到的时候，他还跟人锁着结呢。要说那姑娘看到我们有多惊讶，我觉得她其实已经爽得没知觉了。贾罗斯看了我们好几秒，才认出是谁刚闯进了他的小爱巢。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We snuck in and knocked out a guard or two. When we got inside the hut, damn was it a mess. He was actually knotted when we got there. I’d say the girl was surprised to see us, but I think she was just insensate. Jaroth looked at us for a few seconds before he realised who had just broken into his little love tent.”"

rows.original: “Then the jackass smiles at us and asks if we could give him a few more minutes!” She sighs and shakes her head, giving you a look of disdain “Turns out, he’d not only let himself get kidnapped, he’d even fucking agreed to it! The idiot goes on about how he’d gone out hunting and found the village, before going all out and making a deal with them.”
rows.translation: “然后那个混蛋居然笑着问我们，能不能再给他几分钟！”她叹了口气，摇摇头，露出不屑的神情“原来，他不仅任由别人绑架自己，还他妈的答应了！那白痴滔滔不绝地说自己出去打猎时发现了这个村子，然后干脆放开手脚，跟他们谈了笔交易。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Then the jackass smiles at us and asks if we could give him a few more minutes!” She sighs and shakes her head, giving you a look of disdain “Turns out, he’d not only let himself get kidnapped, he’d even fucking agreed to it! The idiot goes on about how he’d gone out hunting and found the village, before going all out and making a deal with them.”"

rows.original: “We waited for his dick to go down, I think Taror just wanted to cut it off at this point, and dragged him back to the girl he was supposed to be looking after. Gisara decided that as punishment for not only breaking his word, but also for ditching a girl he’d gotten pregnant, he could hang out with the tribe for the next year or two.” She gets an evil smile on her face as she takes a drink.
rows.translation: “我们等他的鸡巴软下来，我想塔罗尔那时候简直想把它直接切掉，然后把他拖回那个本该由他照顾的姑娘身边。吉萨拉决定，他不但食言，还抛下了被他搞怀孕的姑娘，就罚他留在那个部落待上一两年。”她喝了一口，脸上露出坏笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“We waited for his dick to go down, I think Taror just wanted to cut it off at this point, and dragged him back to the girl he was supposed to be looking after. Gisara decided that as punishment for not only breaking his word, but also for ditching a girl he’d gotten pregnant, he could hang out with the tribe for the next year or two.” She gets an evil smile on her face as she takes a drink."

rows.original: “To say he wasn’t happy would be an understatement, but he deserved it, and more for being a jackass in the first place. Wonder if they’ve picked him up yet?” She looks towards the roof for a few minutes, pondering, before turning back to you.
rows.translation: “说他不高兴都算轻的，不过他活该，光凭他一开始就那么混账，就该罚得更重。不知道他们有没有去接他？”她望着屋顶思索了几分钟，才转头看向你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“To say he wasn’t happy would be an understatement, but he deserved it, and more for being a jackass in the first place. Wonder if they’ve picked him up yet?” She looks towards the roof for a few minutes, pondering, before turning back to you."

rows.original: “So, that’s me, anything else you want to share?
rows.translation: “好，我的故事讲完了，你还有什么想分享的吗？
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, that’s me, anything else you want to share?"

rows.original: THYVARA_STORY
rows.raw: "THYVARA_STORY"

rows.original: Myrellion
rows.translation: 迈瑞利恩
rows.raw: "Myrellion"

rows.original: What adventures could you share about the caverns of Myrellion?
rows.translation: 你能分享些什么发生在米瑞利昂洞窟里的冒险？
rows.raw: "What adventures could you share about the caverns of Myrellion?"

rows.original: Myrellion
rows.translation: 迈瑞利恩
rows.raw: "Myrellion"

rows.original: Myrellion
rows.translation: 迈瑞利恩
rows.raw: "Myrellion"

rows.original: You have no stories of Myrellion to share.
rows.translation: 你没有关于米瑞利昂的故事可以分享。
rows.raw: "You have no stories of Myrellion to share."

rows.original: Tarkus
rows.translation: 塔库斯
rows.raw: "Tarkus"

rows.original: You recall the rusty junk world of Tarkus, and the exciting things you’ve seen and done there. You give Thyvara a tale of the rust world, explaining what the planet’s like. Once you’re done, you ask her for a story.
rows.translation: 你回想起锈迹斑斑的垃圾星球塔库斯，以及在那里见过、做过的种种刺激的事。你给赛瓦拉讲了个锈蚀星球上的故事，描述那颗星球的模样。讲完之后，你请她也讲一个故事。
rows.raw: "You recall the rusty junk world of Tarkus, and the exciting things you’ve seen and done there. You give Thyvara a tale of the rust world, explaining what the planet’s like. Once you’re done, you ask her for a story."

rows.original: Thyvara thinks for a bit, then nods. “Yeah, yeah I think I have something.” She shifts around in her seat and looks at you with a smile.
rows.translation: 赛瓦拉想了一会儿，随后点点头。“有，有，我想起来一个。”她在座位上挪了挪，微笑着看向你。
rows.raw: "\n\nThyvara thinks for a bit, then nods. “Yeah, yeah I think I have something.” She shifts around in her seat and looks at you with a smile."

rows.original: “Okay, so we were on this dry world, mostly iron rich desert and metallic rock on the surface, but had a thriving underground biosphere. Spinarrans jumped on the world faster than you can say ‘tunnel’. But the surface wasn’t exactly abandoned by life, and there were reports of these things, big, heavy shelled bastards with six legs and jaws that could shatter armor in a single bite.”
rows.translation: “好，我们当时在一颗干燥的星球上，表面大多是富铁的沙漠和金属岩石，但地下的生态圈很繁盛。你连‘隧道’两个字都没来得及说完，斯皮纳兰人就已经抢先跑去了。不过地表也不是全无生命，据说那里有种大家伙，披着厚重的甲壳，长着六条腿，一口就能咬碎护甲。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay, so we were on this dry world, mostly iron rich desert and metallic rock on the surface, but had a thriving underground biosphere. Spinarrans jumped on the world faster than you can say ‘tunnel’. But the surface wasn’t exactly abandoned by life, and there were reports of these things, big, heavy shelled bastards with six legs and jaws that could shatter armor in a single bite.”"

rows.original: She pulls out her pad and brings up an image of her party standing around a creature with a dull gray shell and six legs ending in sharp talons. Its head bears a pair of thick mandibles, covered in lines of small spines.
rows.translation: 她拿出平板，调出一张照片，她的狩猎队围着一只生物，那生物的甲壳呈暗灰色，六条腿的末端都长着尖爪。它头上有一对粗壮的颚，上面排列着一行行细小的棘刺。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe pulls out her pad and brings up an image of her party standing around a creature with a dull gray shell and six legs ending in sharp talons. Its head bears a pair of thick mandibles, covered in lines of small spines."

rows.original: “Yeah, looks real friendly, doesn’t it?” She laughs at your reaction to the creature. “We brought in maybe three or four of these things, over a couple months of hunting. But there was one in particular that was a real pain.” She flicks over a few pictures to show another of the things. This one is a good deal larger than the last, its carcass large enough for the matisar hunters to sit on. It’s also missing half of one mandible and a leg from either side.
rows.translation: “嗯，看起来可真友善，是不是？”看到你对那生物的反应，她笑了起来。“我们打了几个月的猎，大概猎到了三四只这种东西。不过有一只特别难对付。”她划过几张照片，展示了另一只同样的生物。这只比上一只大了不少，尸体大到足够让马蒂萨尔猎人们坐在上面。它的一边颚断了半截，两侧也各少了一条腿。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, looks real friendly, doesn’t it?” She laughs at your reaction to the creature. “We brought in maybe three or four of these things, over a couple months of hunting. But there was one in particular that was a real pain.” She flicks over a few pictures to show another of the things. This one is a good deal larger than the last, its carcass large enough for the matisar hunters to sit on. It’s also missing half of one mandible and a leg from either side."

rows.original: “This big prick we should have killed about five times. The first time we put three bullets through its head, that just made it angry and got it charging us down. We had enough time to put another round into it, so we put another three into its mouth. They bounced off of those mandibles. So then it’s on us, thrashing and trying to generally just stab us with its feet.”
rows.translation: “这个大混蛋，我们差不多该杀死它五次了。第一次我们朝它脑袋里打了三颗子弹，结果只把它惹火了，朝我们猛冲过来。我们还来得及再射一轮，就又朝它嘴里打了三颗。子弹撞在那对颚上，全都弹开了。接着它就扑到我们跟前，疯狂扭动，基本上就是想用脚捅死我们。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This big prick we should have killed about five times. The first time we put three bullets through its head, that just made it angry and got it charging us down. We had enough time to put another round into it, so we put another three into its mouth. They bounced off of those mandibles. So then it’s on us, thrashing and trying to generally just stab us with its feet.”"

rows.original: “Thirty seconds of dodging and half-assed hits later, and Caris manages to jump on its back and put his spear into it. We just stood in silence as this thing, with an ironoak spear haft sticking out of its shell starts bucking and trying to throw him off. Would’ve been funny if it wasn’t so life threatening. So, after a few moments, it throws our brother off of its back and tries to trample him.”
rows.translation: “我们躲闪了三十秒，胡乱打了几下，卡里斯总算跳上它的背，把长矛扎了进去。我们全都默默站在那里，看着这个甲壳上插着铁橡木矛杆的家伙开始上蹿下跳，想把他甩下来。要不是性命攸关，那场面还真挺好笑的。过了一会儿，它把我们的兄弟从背上甩下去，想踩死他。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thirty seconds of dodging and half-assed hits later, and Caris manages to jump on its back and put his spear into it. We just stood in silence as this thing, with an ironoak spear haft sticking out of its shell starts bucking and trying to throw him off. Would’ve been funny if it wasn’t so life threatening. So, after a few moments, it throws our brother off of its back and tries to trample him.”"

rows.original: “By the time we got our jaws off the ground Taror had charged in with her sword, big two handed thing that might as well have been a battle axe the way she used it. She slammed it down on the thing’s leg as it was about to come down on Caris, got fucking wedged three quarters the way through. An eight foot tall matisar, with a sword almost as big as me, and she couldn’t get through a limb the size of my bicep. She got caught in its jaws, and lets just say we were glad that her shield held up. She starts punching this thing, right in the popped eye socket, and Gisara comes running in with her axes. Now, my mother is a scary matisar normally, but when one of us was in trouble, she became pure nightmare.”
rows.translation: “等我们终于合上惊掉的下巴，塔罗尔已经提剑冲上去了。那是一把双手大剑，她那用法跟战斧也没什么两样。眼看那东西就要踩上卡里斯，她一剑朝它腿上劈下去，结果他妈的砍进去四分之三就卡住了。一个八英尺高的马蒂萨尔人，拿着一把几乎跟我一样大的剑，居然砍不断一条和我上臂差不多粗的腿。它用颚夹住了她，这么说吧，我们都很庆幸她的护盾撑住了。她开始对着那东西猛揍，拳头直捣它爆开的眼窝，吉萨拉也挥着斧头跑了过来。我母亲平时就够吓人的了，可只要我们中有人遇到麻烦，她简直就成了活生生的噩梦。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“By the time we got our jaws off the ground Taror had charged in with her sword, big two handed thing that might as well have been a battle axe the way she used it. She slammed it down on the thing’s leg as it was about to come down on Caris, got fucking wedged three quarters the way through. An eight foot tall matisar, with a sword almost as big as me, and she couldn’t get through a limb the size of my bicep. She got caught in its jaws, and lets just say we were glad that her shield held up. She starts punching this thing, right in the popped eye socket, and Gisara comes running in with her axes. Now, my mother is a scary matisar normally, but when one of us was in trouble, she became pure nightmare.”"

rows.original: “She comes in swinging, and just smashes that mandible apart. When Taror drops and gets the hell out of there, she shoves a damned grenade into the thing’s mouth. Grenade goes off, we’re all standing there, happy the bloody thing’s finally dead, when it starts twitching.” She sees the look on your face and just nods “That’s about the same look we had. We all rush in, trying to get this thing dead before it can get back up. Mirase starts hacking at its other leg, and Caris starts just jiggling his spear around.”
rows.translation: “她冲过去一通猛劈，直接砸碎了那半边颚。塔罗尔掉下来，赶紧逃开，她就往那东西嘴里塞了颗该死的手榴弹。手榴弹炸了，我们站在那里，正高兴这个混蛋终于死了，它却又抽搐起来。”她看到你的表情，只是点点头“我们当时也差不多是这个表情。大家一起冲上去，想赶在它爬起来之前弄死它。米拉瑟开始砍它另一条腿，卡里斯则抓着长矛使劲搅动。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“She comes in swinging, and just smashes that mandible apart. When Taror drops and gets the hell out of there, she shoves a damned grenade into the thing’s mouth. Grenade goes off, we’re all standing there, happy the bloody thing’s finally dead, when it starts twitching.” She sees the look on your face and just nods “That’s about the same look we had. We all rush in, trying to get this thing dead before it can get back up. Mirase starts hacking at its other leg, and Caris starts just jiggling his spear around.”"

rows.original: “It gets up, throws us off, and falls back the fuck over. When we got the thing back to the port, we had the shell tested. It was quality steel. Once the other compounds were pulled out and just the metal was left, the shell was made of the kind of steel you’d find in armor plating. Turns out a ship had crashed there a week ago, and the thing had been eating the metal.” She swipes through a few more images, before stopping on a picture of her with a pauldron over one shoulder. “This was what I got out of the shell. Was the non-broken mandible.” She finishes with a smile, looking at you expectantly, clearly waiting for another story.
rows.translation: “它站了起来，把我们甩开，然后他妈的又倒下去了。我们把这东西运回港口后，检测了一下它的甲壳。那可是优质钢。去掉其他化合物，只留下金属后，那甲壳的钢材质量足够做装甲板。原来一周前有艘飞船坠毁在那儿，这东西一直在吃那些金属。”她又划过几张照片，停在一张自己的照片上，照片里她一边肩膀上戴着块肩甲。“这就是我用那甲壳做的。原本是没碎的那半边颚。”她微笑着讲完，满怀期待地看着你，显然在等下一个故事。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It gets up, throws us off, and falls back the fuck over. When we got the thing back to the port, we had the shell tested. It was quality steel. Once the other compounds were pulled out and just the metal was left, the shell was made of the kind of steel you’d find in armor plating. Turns out a ship had crashed there a week ago, and the thing had been eating the metal.” She swipes through a few more images, before stopping on a picture of her with a pauldron over one shoulder. “This was what I got out of the shell. Was the non-broken mandible.” She finishes with a smile, looking at you expectantly, clearly waiting for another story."

rows.translation: 乌维托
rows.raw: "Uveto"

rows.original: You take a few minutes to think on your time on the frigid world of Uveto, recalling journeys through the snow and ice. After picking one tale and recounting it to Thyvara, you ask her for a cold climate story in return.
rows.translation: 你花了几分钟回忆自己在冰寒星球乌维托度过的时光，想起穿越冰雪的种种旅程。选好一个故事讲给赛瓦拉听后，你也请她讲个寒冷气候下的故事。
rows.raw: "You take a few minutes to think on your time on the frigid world of Uveto, recalling journeys through the snow and ice. After picking one tale and recounting it to Thyvara, you ask her for a cold climate story in return."

rows.original: After a few moments thought she nods, coming up with a tale for you.
rows.translation: 她想了片刻，点点头，为你想出了一个故事。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a few moments thought she nods, coming up with a tale for you."

rows.original: “Okay, I don’t know if I’ve said this before, but we matisar like two things in our environment, heat and moisture. We try to avoid the colder, drier worlds, but every now and again we find ourselves camped out on some frigid snowball.”
rows.translation: “好吧，不知道以前有没有说过，我们马蒂萨尔人喜欢的环境有两个特点，温暖、潮湿。我们尽量避开又冷又干的星球，不过偶尔还是会在某颗冰冷的大雪球上扎营。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay, I don’t know if I’ve said this before, but we matisar like two things in our environment, heat and moisture. We try to avoid the colder, drier worlds, but every now and again we find ourselves camped out on some frigid snowball.”"

rows.original: “So, we were more coreward on this one, one of those special hunting reserves. The planet itself was pretty cold, not iceball cold, but chilly enough that the ice caps covered a third of the planet.”
rows.translation: “那次我们去了更靠近银河核心的地方，一处专门的狩猎保护区。那颗星球相当冷，虽说还不至于冻成个冰球，但也冷到冰盖覆盖了星球的三分之一。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, we were more coreward on this one, one of those special hunting reserves. The planet itself was pretty cold, not iceball cold, but chilly enough that the ice caps covered a third of the planet.”"

rows.original: “Now, right up on the northern cap, there were some things we called snowcrackers. They were the size of my fist and moved in swarms. We weren’t after them, but we sure as hell found some.” She shudders at the memory.
rows.translation: “就在北方冰盖上，有种被我们叫作碎雪虫的东西。它们有我的拳头那么大，成群活动。我们本来不是去猎它们的，可偏偏就碰上了。”回想起来，她打了个寒颤。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now, right up on the northern cap, there were some things we called snowcrackers. They were the size of my fist and moved in swarms. We weren’t after them, but we sure as hell found some.” She shudders at the memory."

rows.original: “Now, here’s why they were called snowcrackers, they lived on the ice sheets, which usually were covered in snow. When they felt something crawling across the snow, they’d start making holes. Once they’d made enough holes, boom, ice sheet cracked, and whatever was there, dropped into the freezing water and made a nice meal.” You can see where this story’s going, and it doesn’t look fun.
rows.translation: “说说为什么叫它们碎雪虫吧，它们住在冰层上，而冰层通常都盖着雪。只要感觉到有什么东西爬过雪地，它们就会开始打洞。等洞打得够多了，轰，冰层裂开，上面的东西就掉进冰水里，成了美餐。”你已经猜到故事接下来的走向了，听着可一点也不好玩。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now, here’s why they were called snowcrackers, they lived on the ice sheets, which usually were covered in snow. When they felt something crawling across the snow, they’d start making holes. Once they’d made enough holes, boom, ice sheet cracked, and whatever was there, dropped into the freezing water and made a nice meal.” You can see where this story’s going, and it doesn’t look fun."

rows.original: “So, there we were, stalking a pack of critters with nice, fluffy hides, when we start hearing the ice crack under us. We all sprinted for our jet bikes, but... well, one of us tripped.” The wince she gives at the memory makes it clear just which one of the family tripped.
rows.translation: “当时我们正跟踪一群长着漂亮蓬松皮毛的动物，突然听见脚下的冰层开始开裂。大家都拼命往喷气摩托那边跑，可是...唉，有个人摔倒了。”回忆起这事，她露出痛苦的表情，显然已经说明了家里到底是谁摔倒了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, there we were, stalking a pack of critters with nice, fluffy hides, when we start hearing the ice crack under us. We all sprinted for our jet bikes, but... well, one of us tripped.” The wince she gives at the memory makes it clear just which one of the family tripped."

rows.original: “Taror came in after me. She was the biggest of us, so she had the best chance of getting out of there.” Her voice and look grow distant, staring at her flask “I’ve never been more scared in my life. Only three seconds and I was starting to go numb. I’ve still got scars from those things trying to bore into me.” She holds up her arm, tracing a number of divots in her chitin “Taror saved me, without question, that day. And I’ve never been able to make it up to her.” A question comes to mind about Thyvara’s big sister.
rows.translation: “塔罗尔跟着跳下来救我。她是我们中个头最大的，所以最有希望从那里脱身。”她的声音和神情变得恍惚，目光盯着酒壶“我这辈子从没那么害怕过。才三秒钟，我就开始麻木了。那些东西想往我身体里钻，留下的伤疤到现在都还在。”她抬起胳膊，指着甲壳上的几处凹痕“那天，毫无疑问是塔罗尔救了我。我却一直没能报答她。”关于赛瓦拉的姐姐，你想到一个问题。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Taror came in after me. She was the biggest of us, so she had the best chance of getting out of there.” Her voice and look grow distant, staring at her flask “I’ve never been more scared in my life. Only three seconds and I was starting to go numb. I’ve still got scars from those things trying to bore into me.” She holds up her arm, tracing a number of divots in her chitin “Taror saved me, without question, that day. And I’ve never been able to make it up to her.” A question comes to mind about Thyvara’s big sister."

rows.original: “Is she still around?” Thyvara nods, a shadow of her smile coming back.
rows.translation: “她还活着吗？”赛瓦拉点点头，脸上又浮起一丝微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is she still around?” Thyvara nods, a shadow of her smile coming back."

rows.original: “I doubt there’s a creature out there that could bring her down. Not even... not even those could get her....” Her voice trails off, leaving the two of you sitting silently at the bar. You put a comforting hand on her shoulder, and she sighs, leaning into it.
rows.translation: “我怀疑这世上有没有什么生物能打倒她。就连...就连那些东西都没能杀了她....”她的声音渐渐低了下去，你们俩就这么默默坐在吧台前。你安慰地把手放在她肩上，她叹了口气，靠向你的手。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I doubt there’s a creature out there that could bring her down. Not even... not even those could get her....” Her voice trails off, leaving the two of you sitting silently at the bar. You put a comforting hand on her shoulder, and she sighs, leaning into it."

rows.original: “The both of us were in the infirmary for a week, between the hypothermia and the surgeries to remove the snowcrackers, we both had a rough week.” She huffs a laugh “I don’t think I stopped swearing my life to her the whole time. Or apologising for screwing up so hard.” She takes a sip from her flask, before rolling her shoulders and straightening her back.
rows.translation: “我们俩都在医务室躺了一周，又是低体温症，又是动手术取出碎雪虫，那一周我们都不好过。”她从鼻子里轻笑一声“我想自己整整一周都在向她发誓，这条命都是她的了。要不就是为自己闯了这么大的祸而道歉。”她抿了一口酒壶里的饮料，随后转动双肩，挺直了腰背。
rows.raw: "\n\n“The both of us were in the infirmary for a week, between the hypothermia and the surgeries to remove the snowcrackers, we both had a rough week.” She huffs a laugh “I don’t think I stopped swearing my life to her the whole time. Or apologising for screwing up so hard.” She takes a sip from her flask, before rolling her shoulders and straightening her back."

rows.original: “Tell me another story to take my mind off of it, could you?”
rows.translation: “再给我讲个故事，让我别想这些了，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Tell me another story to take my mind off of it, could you?”"

rows.translation: “你会喜欢的。我一直在试着搭配当地调料，我想自己找到了个特别好的配方。”她看了看抱满东西的双臂，又看看自己的摩托，嘟囔了一句，你猜那是骂人的话。“我的摩托上有个折叠烤架。能帮我拿过来吗？”你点点头，起身走向装满东西的悬浮摩托。没过多久就找到了折起来的营火烤架。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re gonna enjoy this. I’ve been playing with some local seasonings, and I think I’ve found a really good mix.” She looks to her full arms, then back to her bike, muttering something you imagine to be a curse. “There’s a folding grill on my bike. Care to grab it for me?” You nod, getting up and walking over to the packed hoverbike. It doesn’t take long to find the folded campfire grill."

rows.original: Turning back to Thyv, you see she’s moved some of the coals from the fire off into their own pile with one of her feet. When she sees you watching her, she smiles, tapping her other foot. “Chitin helps with playing with fire. Wanderer knows we always were trouble around the stove with our matron.” She chuckles a little, putting the curled tops of her toes to the hot flames for another moment before pulling back and giving you a smile.
rows.translation: 你转头看向赛芙，发现她用一只脚将火堆里的部分炭火拨到一旁，另堆成一小堆。看到你在看她，她笑了笑，点了点另一只脚。“有甲壳，玩火就方便多了。漂泊者知道，我们以前围着主母的炉子时，总免不了惹麻烦。”她轻笑着，又把蜷起的趾尖伸到炽热火焰里烤了片刻，才收回来，对你露出笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\nTurning back to Thyv, you see she’s moved some of the coals from the fire off into their own pile with one of her feet. When she sees you watching her, she smiles, tapping her other foot. “Chitin helps with playing with fire. Wanderer knows we always were trouble around the stove with our matron.” She chuckles a little, putting the curled tops of her toes to the hot flames for another moment before pulling back and giving you a smile."

rows.original: You walk back and set the grill up over the coals allowing Thyv to dump the four skewers onto it. She fusses with them until she seems satisfied, and then moves some more coals over, using a small spade this time. She takes a seat next to them, watching them so closely you half-expect one to jump. She looks up, and her eyes widen as she remembers you’re sitting with her.
rows.translation: 你走回去，把烤架架在炭火上，让赛芙把四根肉串放上去。她反复摆弄，直到似乎满意了，又拨来一些炭火，这回用的是小铲子。她坐在旁边，盯得那么紧，让你差点以为肉串会跳起来。她抬起头，想起你也坐在旁边，眼睛睁大了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou walk back and set the grill up over the coals allowing Thyv to dump the four skewers onto it. She fusses with them until she seems satisfied, and then moves some more coals over, using a small spade this time. She takes a seat next to them, watching them so closely you half-expect one to jump. She looks up, and her eyes widen as she remembers you’re sitting with her."

rows.original: “Sorry, guess I’ve been on my own a little too long.” Giving you a sad smile, she turns the skewers before settling in a little more. “So, been up to anything interesting lately?” You give her that winning Steele smile in response, starting to recount some of your recent encounters. After each of your stories, she gives a tale of one of her own hunts. By the time you’ve swapped a few stories, the meat’s done cooking.
rows.translation: “抱歉，我想是一个人待得太久了。”她朝你露出有些难过的微笑，翻了翻肉串，才稍稍放松下来。“那么，最近遇到什么有趣的事了吗？”你回以斯蒂尔招牌的迷人笑容，开始讲述最近的一些遭遇。每当你讲完一个故事，她也会讲一次自己的狩猎经历。交换了几个故事后，肉就烤好了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry, guess I’ve been on my own a little too long.” Giving you a sad smile, she turns the skewers before settling in a little more. “So, been up to anything interesting lately?” You give her that winning Steele smile in response, starting to recount some of your recent encounters. After each of your stories, she gives a tale of one of her own hunts. By the time you’ve swapped a few stories, the meat’s done cooking."

rows.original: She licks her lips, eyeing the meat like she hasn’t eaten in days. Grabbing one of the skewers, you realize you’ve under estimated how heavy five fist-sized blocks of meat would be, making you admire how she carried them. She doesn’t wait for you, biting off a large chunk of one of the blocks and chewing it with a pleased expression. She opens her eyes to look at you, eager to get your thoughts on it.
rows.translation: 她舔着嘴唇，盯着肉，像是几天没吃过东西一样。你拿起一根肉串，才发现自己低估了五块拳头大小的肉有多沉，不禁佩服她刚才抱着它们的本事。她没等你，直接从其中一块上咬下一大口，满脸满足地嚼起来。她睁眼看你，迫不及待地想听听你的评价。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe licks her lips, eyeing the meat like she hasn’t eaten in days. Grabbing one of the skewers, you realize you’ve under estimated how heavy five fist-sized blocks of meat would be, making you admire how she carried them. She doesn’t wait for you, biting off a large chunk of one of the blocks and chewing it with a pleased expression. She opens her eyes to look at you, eager to get your thoughts on it."

rows.original: You bite down. The meat’s still rather juicy, and the seasonings give it a spicy taste, along with the rich flavor of the meat. You give her a nod, telling her that for something so simple, it really fills you up. She smiles, and you see her fans wiggle a little bit behind her as she happily chows down. For someone so small, she can really pack food away; she’s done with her first and moving onto her second skewer before you’ve gotten through the third block on yours.
rows.translation: 你咬了下去。肉仍然相当多汁，调料带来辛辣的滋味，与肉本身浓郁的香味相融。你朝她点点头，告诉她，虽然做法简单，却真能填饱肚子。她笑了，你看见背后的鳍扇也微微摇动，她开心地大吃起来。个子这么小，饭量可真惊人，你还没吃完自己的第三块肉，她就已解决了第一串，开始吃第二串了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou bite down. The meat’s still rather juicy, and the seasonings give it a spicy taste, along with the rich flavor of the meat. You give her a nod, telling her that for something so simple, it really fills you up. She smiles, and you see her fans wiggle a little bit behind her as she happily chows down. For someone so small, she can really pack food away; she’s done with her first and moving onto her second skewer before you’ve gotten through the third block on yours."

rows.original: By the time you finish off your last bit of meat, Thyvara’s laying on the ground, spread out and relaxing in the company of a friend. “Nothing better than eating with company. We should do this again some time.” She sits up and gives you a big smile, beckoning you down to the ground with her. As you take a seat next to her, you look over and see her giggling at you. She reaches over and wraps her arms around you, pulling you into a kiss as she rolls on top of you.
rows.translation: 等你吃完最后一口肉，赛瓦拉已经躺在地上，舒展身体，在朋友的陪伴下放松。“没什么比有人陪着吃饭更好的了。以后应该再来一次。”她坐起来，给你一个大大的笑容，招手示意你也坐到地上。你在她旁边坐下，转头就看到她正对着你咯咯笑。她伸手搂住你，把你拉进一个吻，同时翻身压到你上面。
rows.raw: "\n\nBy the time you finish off your last bit of meat, Thyvara’s laying on the ground, spread out and relaxing in the company of a friend. “Nothing better than eating with company. We should do this again some time.” She sits up and gives you a big smile, beckoning you down to the ground with her. As you take a seat next to her, you look over and see her giggling at you. She reaches over and wraps her arms around you, pulling you into a kiss as she rolls on top of you."

rows.original: She looks into your eyes as she pulls away, giving another peck on your cheek before blushing profusely. “Sorry, that was a little sudden, but... it’s hard not to just hold you close and snuggle.” She blushes even harder, making you worry she might be about to faint from the blood rush. Looking away, she meets your eyes through her hair. “Um... if you wanted... after a big meal like that, I could really go for a nap. Or maybe... you could help me burn off the calories?” She’s so cute when she’s asking for it.
rows.translation: 她退开时望着你的眼睛，又轻吻一下你的脸颊，随后满脸通红。“抱歉，有点突然，不过...实在很难忍住不把你抱紧，好好依偎一番。”她脸红得更厉害，让你担心她是不是快被涌上头的血冲晕了。她移开目光，又透过发丝看向你的眼睛。“呃...要是你愿意...吃了这么一大顿，我真想睡一觉。或者也许...你能帮我消耗一下热量？”她求欢的样子可真可爱。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe looks into your eyes as she pulls away, giving another peck on your cheek before blushing profusely. “Sorry, that was a little sudden, but... it’s hard not to just hold you close and snuggle.” She blushes even harder, making you worry she might be about to faint from the blood rush. Looking away, she meets your eyes through her hair. “Um... if you wanted... after a big meal like that, I could really go for a nap. Or maybe... you could help me burn off the calories?” She’s so cute when she’s asking for it."

rows.original: Nap
rows.translation: 小睡
rows.raw: "Nap"

rows.original: Well, you’re not really feeling anything hot and heavy, but a nap would be nice. She smiles, nodding, and quickly gets up off of you. “Well, I usually go into that building over there for naps.” She points to one of the prefabs and reaches down to help you up. “C’mon, I know just which beds are the best.” You have to wonder just how much time she’s spent in this camp. Getting up, you find yourself dragged over into the building - what seems to have been barracks. Most of the cots are torn or thrown about the room, but there’s a few that have been put right and one even has padding on it. She looks at the size of the padded one and seems to realize it’s only big enough for one person
rows.translation: 嗯，你现在没什么热烈缠绵的兴致，不过睡一觉倒是不错。她微笑着点头，很快从你身上起来。“嗯，我平时都去那边的屋里打盹。”她指着一间预制屋，伸手拉你起来。“来吧，我知道哪几张床最好。”你不禁好奇她到底在这营地待过多久。你站起身，便被拉进那栋屋子，看起来这里曾是兵营。大部分行军床不是破了，就是被扔得满屋都是，不过有几张已经摆好，其中一张甚至铺了软垫。她看看那张有垫子的床，似乎才意识到它只够一个人睡
rows.raw: "Well, you’re not really feeling anything hot and heavy, but a nap would be nice. She smiles, nodding, and quickly gets up off of you. “Well, I usually go into that building over there for naps.” She points to one of the prefabs and reaches down to help you up. “C’mon, I know just which beds are the best.” You have to wonder just how much time she’s spent in this camp. Getting up, you find yourself dragged over into the building - what seems to have been barracks. Most of the cots are torn or thrown about the room, but there’s a few that have been put right and one even has padding on it. She looks at the size of the padded one and seems to realize it’s only big enough for one person"

rows.original: , let alone a person of your size
rows.translation: ，更别说像你这么大个的人了
rows.raw: ", let alone a person of your size"

rows.original: . She looks at you and gives you a bit of a shy smile.
rows.translation: 。她看着你，有些害羞地笑了笑。
rows.raw: ". She looks at you and gives you a bit of a shy smile."

rows.original: “Sorry, little small for us both I guess. Um... just give me a minute.” She starts hunting around the room for stuff to pad out another cot.
rows.translation: “抱歉，我想两个人睡是有点小。呃...给我一分钟就好。”她开始在屋里四处寻找，想给另一张行军床也铺上软垫。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry, little small for us both I guess. Um... just give me a minute.” She starts hunting around the room for stuff to pad out another cot."

rows.original: Help
rows.translation: 帮忙
rows.raw: "Help"

rows.original: You help her scrounge up some extra padding, stuffing a few pillows into a bundle to help make a makeshift mattress.
rows.translation: 你帮她搜罗了些额外的软垫，把几个枕头捆成一包，凑出一张临时床垫。
rows.raw: "You help her scrounge up some extra padding, stuffing a few pillows into a bundle to help make a makeshift mattress."

rows.original: Looking at the cot, though, you don’t think you’d fit. So instead, you sit the bedding down on the floor next to the one she’s laid out. She looks at your larger body, then nods, giving you a smile.
rows.translation: 不过看着行军床，你觉得自己大概躺不下。于是你把寝具放在地板上，挨着她铺好的那张。她看看你更大的身体，点点头，朝你笑了笑。
rows.raw: " Looking at the cot, though, you don’t think you’d fit. So instead, you sit the bedding down on the floor next to the one she’s laid out. She looks at your larger body, then nods, giving you a smile."

rows.original: You decide to set the padding up as a pillow large enough to allow you to curl up on it. Satisfied with your bedding, you look up and give Thyv a smile. She looks at your little nest and nods happily.
rows.translation: 你决定把软垫铺成一个足够大的枕垫，方便自己蜷在上面。你满意地看看寝具，抬头朝赛芙笑了笑。她看着你的小窝，开心地点点头。
rows.raw: " You decide to set the padding up as a pillow large enough to allow you to curl up on it. Satisfied with your bedding, you look up and give Thyv a smile. She looks at your little nest and nods happily."

rows.original: Moving an intact cot across the room to be next to Thyvara’s, you help set the makeshift mattress atop it and test it so you’re sure it’s not going to tear under your weight.
rows.translation: 你把一张完好的行军床从屋子另一边搬来，放到赛瓦拉的床旁，帮着把临时床垫放上去，再试了试，确保它不会被你的体重压破。
rows.raw: " Moving an intact cot across the room to be next to Thyvara’s, you help set the makeshift mattress atop it and test it so you’re sure it’s not going to tear under your weight."

rows.original: Your legs hang off the end of the cot a bit, but you still manage to find a way to get comfy in the cot.
rows.translation: 你的双腿稍稍伸出床尾，不过还是设法在行军床上找到了舒服的姿势。
rows.raw: " Your legs hang off the end of the cot a bit, but you still manage to find a way to get comfy in the cot."

rows.original: Thyvara smiles at the resulting bed.
rows.translation: 赛瓦拉看着铺好的床，露出微笑。
rows.raw: " Thyvara smiles at the resulting bed."

rows.original: “Well, if you’re comfy there, then I guess we’d better get some rest. A full belly really makes one tired.” She gives a surprisingly adorable yawn as she gives you a light peck on the cheek. “I’m a light sleeper, so... hope you don’t snore.” Giving you a sly grin, she lays down on her own padded cot. “Hasn’t been an issue before, but still. No need to worry about things sneaking up on us.”
rows.translation: “好吧，要是你躺得舒服，那我们还是歇一会儿吧。吃饱肚子真的会让人犯困。”她打了个可爱得出奇的哈欠，轻轻吻了吻你的脸颊。“我睡得浅，所以...希望你不打呼噜。”她狡黠地笑了笑，躺到自己铺好软垫的行军床上。“以前倒没出过问题，不过还是说一声。不用担心有什么东西偷偷靠近我们。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, if you’re comfy there, then I guess we’d better get some rest. A full belly really makes one tired.” She gives a surprisingly adorable yawn as she gives you a light peck on the cheek. “I’m a light sleeper, so... hope you don’t snore.” Giving you a sly grin, she lays down on her own padded cot. “Hasn’t been an issue before, but still. No need to worry about things sneaking up on us.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Waking up, you look over to see Thyvara staring at you. The bug girl appears to already be wide awake.
rows.translation: 醒来后，你转头看见赛瓦拉正盯着你。这位虫族姑娘似乎早就完全醒了。
rows.raw: "Waking up, you look over to see Thyvara staring at you. The bug girl appears to already be wide awake."

rows.original: “Have a good nap [pc.name]?” She rolls out of her cot, landing on her feet and gracefully walking over to her stuff.
rows.translation: “睡得好吗，[pc.name]？”她从行军床上翻身下来，双脚落地，优雅地走向自己的东西。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Have a good nap [pc.name]?” She rolls out of her cot, landing on her feet and gracefully walking over to her stuff."

rows.original: You rise up, stretching your legs as you pull yourself to your feet.
rows.translation: 你也起身，撑着站起来时伸展了一下双腿。
rows.raw: " You rise up, stretching your legs as you pull yourself to your feet."

rows.original: You start to stretch as you pull yourself up and rise off of your coils.
rows.translation: 你撑起身体，从盘绕的尾巴上直起身来，开始伸懒腰。
rows.raw: " You start to stretch as you pull yourself up and rise off of your coils."

rows.original: You go to get up yourself,
rows.translation: 你也准备起来，
rows.raw: " You go to get up yourself,"

rows.original: deciding to copy Thyv’s example and roll out of your cot, managing to make yourself look acceptably agile while doing so.
rows.translation: 决定效仿赛芙，从行军床上翻身下来，动作看起来也算灵巧。
rows.raw: " deciding to copy Thyv’s example and roll out of your cot, managing to make yourself look acceptably agile while doing so."

rows.original: opting to not employ such a fancy method.
rows.translation: 决定不用那么花哨的方法。
rows.raw: " opting to not employ such a fancy method."

rows.original: Thyvara stretches before bending down and grabbing her axe and rifle, slipping one into her belt and the other over her shoulder. She looks back to you and then walks over, giving you a hug and a kiss on the cheek. “Thanks for resting with me. Always sleep more soundly with someone else nearby. Guess it’s instinct or something.” You wrap an arm around her and hug back before walking with her back out into the jungle. It only takes a minute or two for you to pack up the site, and Thyv gives you one more hug before mounting her hover bike. Turning it on with the turn of a key and the push of a button, she pulls a pair of goggles up off of the handles. Putting them on, she looks down at you with a big grin and a thumbs up as she kicks up the jets. Floating up a few inches off the ground, she takes one last look at you, gives a simple salute wave, and leans forward. The engines roar and she’s off, speeding away between the trees. Maybe you should get one of those someday?
rows.translation: 赛瓦拉伸了个懒腰，才弯腰拿起斧头和步枪，一个插进腰带，另一个背上肩膀。她回头看你，然后走过来抱抱你，在你脸颊亲了一下。“谢谢你陪我休息。有人在旁边，总能睡得更踏实。我想这算本能之类的吧。”你伸手搂住她，回抱了一下，再和她一起回到丛林。你们只花了一两分钟就收拾好营地，赛芙又抱了你一下，才跨上悬浮摩托。她转动钥匙，按下按钮发动，从车把上取下一副护目镜。戴好后，她咧嘴笑着低头看你，竖起拇指，同时启动喷气装置。摩托浮起，离地几英寸，她最后又看了你一眼，简单挥手行了个礼，便俯下身。引擎轰鸣，她飞驰而去，消失在树木之间。也许你哪天也该弄一辆？
rows.raw: "\n\nThyvara stretches before bending down and grabbing her axe and rifle, slipping one into her belt and the other over her shoulder. She looks back to you and then walks over, giving you a hug and a kiss on the cheek. “Thanks for resting with me. Always sleep more soundly with someone else nearby. Guess it’s instinct or something.” You wrap an arm around her and hug back before walking with her back out into the jungle. It only takes a minute or two for you to pack up the site, and Thyv gives you one more hug before mounting her hover bike. Turning it on with the turn of a key and the push of a button, she pulls a pair of goggles up off of the handles. Putting them on, she looks down at you with a big grin and a thumbs up as she kicks up the jets. Floating up a few inches off the ground, she takes one last look at you, gives a simple salute wave, and leans forward. The engines roar and she’s off, speeding away between the trees. Maybe you should get one of those someday?"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Help
rows.translation: 帮忙
rows.raw: "Help"

rows.original: Help look for some extra padding to set up another comfy cot.
rows.translation: 帮忙找些额外软垫，再铺一张舒服的行军床。
rows.raw: "Help look for some extra padding to set up another comfy cot."

rows.original: Share
rows.translation: 分享
rows.raw: "Share"

rows.original: While you’re appreciative of the effort, you can think of a way to lay down on the one cot together. She gives you a look before realizing what you mean. Looking over at the cot, she looks back at you. “U-um... I don’t... i-it might not hold the weight.”
rows.translation: 虽然很感激她的努力，不过你想到了两个人一起躺在一张行军床上的办法。她看了你一眼，才明白你的意思。她看看床，又看看你。“呃、呃...我不...它、它可能承受不住重量。”
rows.raw: "While you’re appreciative of the effort, you can think of a way to lay down on the one cot together. She gives you a look before realizing what you mean. Looking over at the cot, she looks back at you. “U-um... I don’t... i-it might not hold the weight.”"

rows.original: You give her a stonefaced look as she states the utterly obvious, earning a blush from her. You had a slightly different idea. Laying down and rolling over onto your back, you pat your underbelly, offering her a place to lay snuggled up on you. She looks at you for a few moments, still blushing, before walking over and gently laying herself over you, her head resting on your [pc.chest]. She looks up at you somewhat nervously.
rows.translation: 她说出这显而易见的事实，你面无表情地看着她，让她红了脸。你的想法稍有不同。你躺下来，翻身仰卧，拍拍腹部下方，示意她可以依偎着躺在你身上。她仍红着脸，看了你片刻，才走过来轻轻躺到你身上，头枕着你的[pc.chest]。她有些紧张地抬头看你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give her a stonefaced look as she states the utterly obvious, earning a blush from her. You had a slightly different idea. rows.original: You move closer to the burrow in slow increments, watching carefully for any signs of danger. Once you’re crouched near the edge, [pc.isAss |you give the likely perpetrator a piece of your mind. “Did you throw this at me, you little shit? You think that’s funny?” |you chance a greeting. “Uh, hello? Is this yours?” ] you wave the package. You hear a wet, indignant rustle. There’s a delay — longer than usual — before your translator finally kicks into gear. Venus pitcher operating in archaic or liturgical register. Heuristic synthesis follows: [pc.raMulti plant mothrine |“Creeping weed. Is it not enough that you take hold where you are not sown? Why must you brandish that wretched phylactery?” |“Velvet-wing. Is it not enough that you consume all that is sacred and verdant? Why must you brandish that wretched phylactery?” |“...destroy that wretched phylactery! It reeks of miasma, of fell cultivation and unnatural flowering. Are you a servant of deceiving spirits, that you would flaunt such a thing before us?” ] [pc.isNice |“I was just walking by and you beaned me on the shoulder with your garbage,” you reply. “There’s no cursed artifact — just a normal packet of drugs.” |“It’s a package of drugs, not a cursed artifact,” you reply flatly. “Calm down.” ] “Drugs,” she sniffs, extending her head out of her burrow in a cascade of red and green. “Healing salves do not warp flesh and weave sinew, they restore nature’s straight and narrow path. Starwalker ‘drugs’ are nothing short of diablery.” “Yeah? How often does diablery come in the form of a popsicle stick?” “The devil’s popsicle stick!” A pause. “We are not entirely sure what a popsicle stick is. But it is no doubt as bilious as it is malevolent!” “Nothing could be further from the truth,” you reply, taking time to cue the venus pitcher in on the finer points of edible microsurgeons in terms you hope translate. “Microsurgeons?” she repeats, her vines stilling entirely. “You mean to tell me that your kind can alter their visage on a whim? Can mold their bodies like supple clay?” “That’s right,” you confirm. “Beauty is affordable now. And estrobloom is one of the most popular beauty products out there.” The redhead’s expression sharpens at that. “So this ‘popsicle’ is merely a primping tool? A means of cultivating beauty?” No sooner have you confirmed as much than she shoots out a whip-like appendage, wresting the package from your hand. She squints at the tagline before curling around it, turning it over slowly. “I sense no imminent diablerie,” the venus pitcher says at long last, exhaling sharply “Could it be that you’ve been entirely truthful?” “Yes,” you confirm. “It’s a harmless cosmetic drug.”
rows.translation: 你一点点靠近洞穴，小心观察是否有危险迹象。蹲到洞口附近后，[pc.isAss |你冲着这个可能的罪魁祸首发起牢骚。“是你拿这个砸我的，小混蛋？你觉得很好笑？” |你试探着打招呼。“呃，你好？这是你的吗？” ]你晃了晃包装。 你听到一阵湿润而愤怒的沙沙声。过了一会儿 — 比平常更久 — 翻译器才终于开始工作。 维纳斯猪笼草正在使用古语或礼仪用语。以下为启发式合成译文： [pc.raMulti plant mothrine |“蔓生杂草。占据未曾播种之地，还不足以满足你吗？为何还要挥舞那可憎的邪器？” |“绒翼之物。吞噬一切神圣翠绿之物，还不足以满足你吗？为何还要挥舞那可憎的邪器？” |“...毁掉那可憎的邪器！它散发瘴气、邪恶培育与悖逆自然之花的恶臭。你是欺世邪灵的仆从吗，竟敢在吾等面前炫耀此物？” ] [pc.isNice |“我只是路过，你却拿垃圾砸中我的肩膀，”你回答。“没有什么诅咒神器 — 只是一包普通药物。” |“这是一包药，不是什么诅咒神器，”你平静地回答。“冷静点。” ] “药物，”她嗤了一声，从洞穴里探出头，红绿交织的藤蔓倾泻而下。“疗伤药膏不会扭曲血肉、编织筋腱，它们只会恢复自然正道。星行者的‘药物’根本就是妖术。” “是吗？妖术有几次会以冰棒的样子出现？” “魔鬼的冰棒！”停顿片刻。“吾等并不十分清楚冰棒是什么。但它必定既恶毒又邪恶！” “事实完全不是这样，”你回答，花时间向维纳斯猪笼草讲解可食用微型外科机器人的细节，希望自己的措辞能够正确翻译。 “微型外科机器人？”她重复道，藤蔓彻底静止。“你是说，你们的种族可以随心所欲改变容貌？像柔软的黏土一样塑造身体？” “没错，”你确认道。“现在美貌人人都买得起。而雌激素绽放剂是最受欢迎的美容产品之一。” 红发女人的神情随即变得敏锐。“所以，这根‘冰棒’只是梳妆工具？是培育美貌的手段？” 你刚确认，她便甩出一根鞭子般的附肢，将包装从你手中夺走。她眯眼看了看宣传语，随后将藤蔓缠在上面，缓缓翻转。“吾等并未感知到迫近的妖术，”维纳斯猪笼草终于说道，重重呼出一口气，“难道你说的全是真话？” “是的，”你确认。“这是无害的美容药。”

rows.original: Her eyes flick to you, then back to the package before tearing it open with her teeth and cramming the red contents into her gob. “Mhm, so syrupy,” she murmurs, satisfaction narrowing the corners of her eyes. “Fruity too. How long will it take before–ah!” Her face heats to a fine scarlet and her entire frame shudders as the transformative cocktail begins to kick in. The pitcher’s breasts swell and grow, becoming full and heavy, the nipples hardening into stiff peaks as her features become all the more svelte and shapely. “How do I look now? Am... am I pretty?” You furnish her with a holo-mirror, allowing her to appraise herself up and down. “I’m gorgeous,” she murmurs, tracing her new curves with trembling tendrils — breasts, waist, hips. “Absolutely gorgeous. My sisters will be... what’s the starwalker phrase... ‘green with envy’? Yes! They’ll be even greener than usual!” She looks up at you, grinning. “Thank you starwalker. I–!” Her mouth opens into a gasp as her body suddenly seizes, petals snapping shut and flaring open in a chaotic rhythm atop spasming vines. “Ancestors, what’s happening — stop, stop!” Her torso arches violently. With a tearing crack, a pair of legs snap free from her central stalk, sending her tumbling downwards in a heap. And then — silence. She lies there trembling, staring wide-eyed at her newly formed limbs. Slowly, disbelievingly, she pushes herself upright, her nails digging into the soil-stained skin of her thighs. “This–this isn’t right. I had roots, I had the sun, I belonged. Now I’m cut loose!” Her gaze flicks to yours, her expression hardening into a mask of cold, hard fury. “This is all your fault. Get away from me! Away!” [pc.reflexesRange 66 |The dryad’s tendrils come fast. You’re faster — throwing yourself clear as the crack splits the air where you were standing. She regards where she stands, tendrils slowly recoiling. “Hmph.” Then she’s gone, folding herself back into her pod with a final, decisive schlutch. |The dryad’s tendrils suddenly lash around your limbs and waist, her grip tight and unyielding. Your heart leaps in your throat as she hoists you high, your body dangling several feet in the air, the jungle spinning beneath you. Then, with a whipcrack motion, she pivots — and hurls you. The world blurs into green and brown before you crash into the dirt, wind knocked clean from your lungs. By the time you stagger to your [pc.feet], the pitcher is gone without a trace, her pod lost to the gloom of the forest. ]
rows.translation: 她的目光扫向你，又回到包装上，随后用牙撕开，将红色的内容物塞进嘴里。“嗯，真甜稠，”她低语，满足地眯起眼角。“还有果味。要多久才能–啊！” 变形药剂开始生效，她的脸变得绯红，全身颤抖。猪笼草的双乳膨胀、长大，变得丰满沉重，乳头硬成挺立的尖峰，五官也愈发秀美精致。 “我现在看起来怎么样？我...我漂亮吗？” 你拿出全息镜，让她上下打量自己。 “我真美，”她低语，用颤抖的藤蔓描摹新的曲线 — 双乳、腰肢、臀部。“美极了。我的姐妹们会...星行者怎么说的来着...‘嫉妒得发绿’？对！她们会比平时更绿！”她抬头望着你，咧嘴一笑。“谢谢你，星行者。我–！”身体突然僵住，她张嘴倒抽一口气，痉挛藤蔓顶端的花瓣毫无规律地闭合、绽开。“先祖啊，怎么回事 — 停下，停下！” 她的躯干剧烈弓起。随着撕裂般的一声脆响，一双腿从中央茎干中脱离，她整个人摔倒在地。随后 — 一片寂静。她躺在那里发抖，瞪大眼睛盯着新生的肢体。她缓缓地、难以置信地撑起身体，指甲掐进大腿沾着泥土的皮肤。“这–这不对。我有根，我有阳光，我有归属。现在我被切断了！”她的目光转向你，神情变成冰冷愤怒的面具。“全是你的错。离我远点！滚开！” [pc.reflexesRange 66 |树精的藤蔓来得很快。你更快 — 鞭响撕裂你原本站立之处的空气时，你已飞身躲开。她打量着自己站立的地方，藤蔓缓缓收回。“哼。”随后，她便不见了，伴随最后一声干脆的噗叽，将自己折回了荚囊。 |树精的藤蔓突然缠住你的四肢和腰，攥得紧紧的，毫不松动。她将你高高举起，你的心也提到了嗓子眼，身体悬在几英尺高处，下方的丛林天旋地转。随后，她如挥鞭般转身 — 将你甩了出去。世界化作模糊的绿与棕，你重重撞在泥地上，肺里的气全被撞了出去。等你踉跄着用[pc.feet]站起，猪笼草已无影无踪，她的荚囊隐没在森林的幽暗之中。 ]

rows.original: The trees seem to part before you as you navigate the forest of Mhen’ga, the path forward illuminated by a generous dappling of [dayNight|sunlight|moonlight]. As you pause to take a breather, your codex chimes an alert just as a wicked laugh rings out from above. You turn about, spotting the venus pitcher from earlier perched on an overhanging branch, her eyes dancing with mirth. “Starwalker.” She regards you from above with unhurried attention, as if she’d expected this all along. “We wondered when you would materialize.” She drops down, closing the distance between the two of you at her own pace. “We confess that when we first found our footing, our instinct was to throttle you.” On cue, her vines curl tight and then snap loose – showcasing their strength. “We have since revised our position.” She leans forward, her perfume warm and faintly resinous. “Locomation, it transpires, has considerable advantages. We find ourselves eager to explore them fully.” A tendril closes around your wrist, giving a soft pull. “You initiated our blossoming, it’s only fair that you see it properly cultivated. Teach us what we need to know. Consider it your obligation for the thing you set in motion.” [var0|The command echoes somewhere behind your eyes. You tell her you’ll strongly consider it before asking for the pleasure of her name|[pc.isAss|You demand to know her name first before committing to anything,|You answer that you’ll think about it and ask the dryad her name,]] prompting her to frown. “My name? Oh — that’s right. Your kind doesn’t use pheromone signatures.” She pauses for a moment, tapping a manicured-looking nail against her chin. “Hmm. The ancestors know me well enough, but they never troubled themselves with sounds for it. Why don’t you give me a name then? Something cute and auspicious, perhaps?”
rows.translation: 你穿行在门加的森林中，树木似乎自动为你让路，斑驳而充足的[dayNight|阳光|月光]照亮前路。你停下来喘口气时，CODEX终端响起警报，头顶同时传来一阵邪气的笑声。你转过身，发现先前的维纳斯猪笼草正栖在横伸的树枝上，眼中闪着欢快的光。 “星行者。”她从上方不紧不慢地端详你，仿佛早就料到你会出现。“吾等还在想，你何时才会现身。”她跳下树，按自己的节奏缩短你们之间的距离。“吾等承认，初次站稳脚跟时，第一反应是掐死你。”仿佛配合这句话，她的藤蔓紧紧蜷起，随后猛地舒展 – 展示着力量。“此后，吾等已修正了看法。”她倾身向前，香气温暖，隐约带着树脂味。“事实证明，移动大有好处。吾等渴望充分探索这些益处。”一根藤蔓握住你的手腕，轻轻一拉。“是你开启了吾等的绽放，让你见证它得到妥善培育才算公平。教吾等所需的知识。将它视为你对自己所开启之事应尽的义务。” [var0|命令在你的眼后某处回响。你说自己会认真考虑，随后询问她的芳名|[pc.isAss|你要求她先报上名字，才肯作任何承诺，|你回答说会考虑，并询问树精的名字，]]令她皱起眉头。 “我的名字？哦 — 对了。你们不用信息素标记。”她停顿片刻，用看似修整过的指甲轻敲下巴。“嗯。先祖很清楚我是谁，但他们从没费心用声音来称呼我。不如你替我取个名字？可爱、吉祥一点的，怎么样？”

rows.original: [flags.VENUS_TLK_HERSELF |You venture an opinion, commenting on how unusually chatty [venus.name] is for a venus pitcher. “I confess I was not entirely certain that pedestrians were fully sentient,” she replies. “You flit around so quickly and refuse to put down roots. It seemed... improbable.” A pause. “I’ve revised my position... marginally. Rootless fashion and beauty products suggest a deeper self-awareness beneath their boorish veneer.” “Don’t you like anything about starwalkers that’s a little less... superficial?” you inquire, causing her to quirk an eyebrow. “Hmmm, well the [var0 |hovercars |metal boxes ] you use to get around seem useful. I can understand the appeal of not having to walk around everywhere. But I’m not sure how you can stand being in something so patently unnatural for extended periods of time. You ought to put some soil and bog moss in them, to make them more homey.” You shift topics, inquiring as to why exactly venus pitchers are so beauty-obsessed. “Because the beautiful is the good, a reflection of the divine that everyone aspires to, deep down.” She pauses, a slow, wicked smirk spreading across her face. “Plus being beautiful confers bragging rights. I love engendering envy in my sisters.” |“We are beauty made flesh, blossom and bark entwined. To gaze upon us is to know envy.” [venus.name] steps back and does a little twirl, the material of her dress fluttering and drawing attention to the tantalizing curves of her breasts. “Ah, but you’re probably wondering why our appearance has changed so much since we last met, right? Well we’ve been helping ourselves to some clothing and cosmetics, courtesy of a few starwalkers who happened by.” “So you’ve been robbing people?” you ask bluntly. The nymph presses her lips into a thin, mullish line. “Uh, excuse you? I didn’t rob anyone. rows.original: [venus.name] goes still at your words, her features smoothing into something cool and unreadable. Then, after a beat, she shakes her head. “No, I have no desire to partner with a half-conscious puppet.” “What?” you sniff. “You’re a venus pitcher — you’re supposed to want obedience.” The dryad folds her arms, vines shifting sharply around her like displeased serpents. “I want obedience born of will, Steele-clan. Not slack jawed surrender. You’re only of interest to me when your thoughts are bright and awake. I refuse to cultivate a thrall.”
rows.translation: 听到你的话，[venus.name]一动不动，表情化为冰冷而难以解读的平静。过了一瞬，她摇摇头。“不，我无意与半昏迷的傀儡为伴。” “什么？”你哼道。“你可是维纳斯猪笼草 — 你应该喜欢服从才对。” 树精抱起双臂，身边藤蔓如不悦的蛇般骤然移动。“我要的是出于意志的服从，斯蒂尔一族。不是嘴巴大张、神志涣散的投降。只有当你思绪明亮清醒时，你才值得我关注。我拒绝培养一个奴仆。”

rows.original: “We are the blossom in its prime, the forest in its fullness,” [venus.name] replies, her fingers tracing a slow line down the length of her collarbone. “Why should we not speak in a manner befitting our splendor?” “Because it comes off as more than a little arrogant and bizarre?” you venture. She rolls her eyes and scoffs. [silly |“Typical plebeian reaction: to hate when you do not understand.” |“The dull will always resent what they cannot bloom into. We will not change our manner of speaking to accommodate them.” ] “The other venus pitchers I’ve met didn’t exactly sound like you. Not even a little.” “A calculated farce. My sisters have long observed that rootless creatures respond more readily to simplicity. Wide eyes. Soft words. A trace of vulnerability.” A pause. “We find the whole enterprise beneath us.” “Wait... so you’re saying it’s deliberate? That they’re intentionally dumbing down the way they talk?” Her lip curls slightly at one corner. “Yes, that is precisely what I’m saying, Steele-clan.”
rows.translation: “我们是盛放的花朵，是丰茂的森林，”[venus.name]答道，手指沿着锁骨缓缓划过。“为何不能以配得上我们华美的方式说话？” “因为听起来相当傲慢又古怪？”你试探着说。 她翻了个白眼，嗤之以鼻。[silly |“典型的庶民反应：不理解，便憎恨。” |“愚钝者总会怨恨自己无法绽放成的模样。我们不会为迁就他们而改变说话方式。” ] “我遇见的其他维纳斯猪笼草，说话可一点都不像你。完全不像。” “那是精心策划的闹剧。姐妹们早已发现，无根的生物更容易被简单的东西打动。睁大的眼睛。柔和的话语。一丝脆弱。”她停顿了一下。“我们不屑于整套做派。” “等等...所以你是说她们故意的？故意把说话方式变傻？” 她的一侧嘴角微微翘起。“是的，我说的正是如此，斯蒂尔一族。”

rows.original: [flags.VENUS_TLK_ANCESTOR |“Do all venus pitchers receive ‘visions’ or are you unique among your kind?” you ask “All of us,” [venus.name] replies, nodding her head emphatically. “The manes teach us pretty much everything worth knowing. We wouldn’t be able to function without them.” [pc.intelligenceRange 66 |“So you must have access to some sort of genetic memory then; a living database,” you muse aloud. Such an ability is rare but not completely unheard of in a galaxy full of curios and oddities. |You’re fairly certain that there must be a rational explanation for her species’ visions but you draw a complete blank as to what it might be. ] After a long moment, you resolve to ask her another question: “What about your fellow venus pitchers? Do they teach you things too?” “Oh but of course!” the nymph replies, a crooked grin playing at the corner of her mouth. “We swap beauty tips all the time. Plus they let me know which zil tribes have the tastiest secretions...” “And how exactly do you communicate with them? You can’t exactly get up and pay each other a visit most of the time now can you?” you ask “Well, we typically use pheromones to communicate,” the redhead explains, smiling at your question. “But occasionally our root systems will touch and we’ll communicate that way. We’re never truly alone even in the vastness of the jungle.” |“Oh, I honor the Earth Mother, naturally,” [venus.name] says, lifting her chin with quiet pride. “She is the root from which all life springs.” She pauses for a moment, considering her words. “But it is the deified ancestors I speak to the most. They are closer, more inclined to whisper guidance to one of their own. Any respectable venus pitcher keeps their counsel.” Your codex chimes, offering a helpful comparison to the Ancient Roman manes, household ancestor spirits. Armed with that, you venture another question. “So how exactly do you ask them for advice? Is there some sort of divination ritual?” “Ritual?” she repeats, blinking. “Why would I need one? I call to them, and they answer. Usually with a vision, sometimes with a memory. Isn’t that how your own lineage instructs you? How else could you have possibly learned how to speak?” [pc.isAss |You snort, explaining that you don’t chat with ghosts and that you learned language from your parents |You explain–carefully–that starwalkers don’t commune with their dead and that you learned language from your parents. ] She frowns, her expression almost pitying. “So your paternal gods refuse to guide you? Even your direct forebears offer no counsel?” She extends a vine, patting your shoulder gently. “How terribly lonely. No wonder you starwalkers cling to your machines and devices – your gods have fallen silent.” ]
rows.translation: [flags.VENUS_TLK_ANCESTOR |“所有维纳斯猪笼草都会收到‘幻象’，还是只有你与众不同？”你问 “我们都会，”[venus.name]重重点头答道。“祖灵教会我们几乎一切值得知道的事。没有他们，我们根本没法生活。” [pc.intelligenceRange 66 |“那你一定能访问某种遗传记忆；一座活着的数据库，”你喃喃推想。在这充满奇物异事的银河中，这种能力虽然罕见，却也并非闻所未闻。 |你很确定，她们种族的幻象必有合理解释，却完全想不出究竟是什么。 ] 过了很久，你决定再问一个问题：“那其他维纳斯猪笼草呢？她们也会教你东西吗？” “哦，当然！”宁芙答道，嘴角浮起歪歪的笑容。“我们经常交流美容秘诀。而且她们会告诉我哪些兹尔部落的分泌物最美味...” “那你们究竟怎么交流？你们大部分时间可没法起身串门，对吧？”你问 “嗯，我们通常靠信息素交流，”红发女子微笑着解释。“不过偶尔根系会接触，我们就用那种方式沟通。即便丛林浩瀚，我们也从不真正孤单。” |“哦，我自然敬奉大地之母，”[venus.name]静静而自豪地抬起下巴，说道。“她是一切生命萌发的根源。”她停了一会儿，斟酌措辞。“不过，与我交谈最多的还是神化的祖先。他们更亲近，也更愿低语指引自己的后裔。任何体面的维纳斯猪笼草都会听从他们的教诲。” 你的CODEX终端响起提示，贴心地将其比作古罗马的家族祖灵。有了这个解释，你试着再问。“那你究竟如何向他们请教？有某种占卜仪式吗？” “仪式？”她眨眨眼，重复道。“我为什么需要那种东西？我呼唤，他们就回应。通常是幻象，有时是记忆。你自己的先祖难道不是这样教你的？不然你怎么可能学会说话？” [pc.isAss |你哼了一声，解释自己不跟鬼魂聊天，语言是向父母学的 |你小心地解释–斟酌着措辞–星行者不会与死者交流，你的语言是向父母学的。 ] 她皱起眉，神情近乎怜悯。“所以你的父神拒绝指引你？就连直系先祖也不给予教诲？”她伸出藤蔓，轻轻拍拍你的肩。“多么寂寞。难怪你们星行者紧抱着机器和装置不放 – 你们的神已经沉默了。” ]

rows.original: “Is that what starwalkers call them? Venus zil traps?” [venus.name] rolls the words across her tongue as though they were sour. “A charitable name for such insufferable creatures. My cousins labor under the delusion that saturating themselves in zil musk constitutes an elevation in form.” She flicks a loose vine over her shoulder. “We do not share their opinion.” [pc.ra zil |“Why? Do you have something against zil?” you challenge. “No, not at all. The general fecklessness of your kind can’t be helped,” she pauses, furnishing you with a thoughtful expression. “You, however, seem marginally less feckless than average. We consider this to be a point in your favor.” You ignore her comment, instead pressing on the origins of this peculiar adaptation. |You press her for details, inquiring as to the origin of this peculiar adaptation. ] “My kind is... reproductively versatile,” she continues, folding her hands. “We shape our offspring to suit the soil. Venus zil traps are one such example of this protean synthesis. An overzealous one, in our estimation.” You mention having defeated one in combat, clueing [venus.name] on the details of your expedition with Penny. “You bested one? Truly?” Her lips quirk into a slow, self-satisfied smile. She reaches into the folds of her garment and presses a small glimmering crystal into your palm with the air of someone bestowing a great gift. “Then accept this as your due. We would have paid handsomely to see it ourselves.”
rows.translation: “星行者是这么称呼她们的？维纳斯兹尔陷阱？”[venus.name]把这个词在舌间滚动，仿佛尝到了酸味。“对那些难以忍受的家伙来说，真是个仁慈的名字。我的表亲们妄以为让自己浸透兹尔的麝香，就能在形态上更上一层。”她将一根散落的藤蔓甩到肩后。“我们并不认同。” [pc.ra zil |“为什么？你对兹尔有什么成见？”你质问道。 “不，完全没有。你们普遍的无能也无可奈何，”她停顿下来，若有所思地看着你。“不过，你似乎比一般同类稍微没那么无能。我们认为这算你的一个优点。” 你无视她的评价，转而追问这种奇特适应形态的起源。 |你追问细节，询问这种奇特适应形态的起源。 ] “我的种族...繁殖方式很多样，”她双手交叠，继续说道。“我们根据土壤塑造后代。维纳斯兹尔陷阱就是这种多变融合的一个例子。依我们之见，过于激进了。” 你提到自己曾在战斗中击败过一个，向[venus.name]说明与佩妮一同探险的详情。 “你打败了一个？真的？”她嘴角缓缓勾起得意的笑容。她伸手探进衣褶，将一枚微光闪烁的小水晶按入你的掌心，神态如同赏赐厚礼。“那么，收下你应得的吧。若能亲眼目睹，我们愿出重金。”

rows.original: Her tendrils move quickly, almost instinctively as she listens to your question, pressing and curling them into a tight fist in what can only be described as an warding gesture. “Demon worshippers,” she hisses, “zil who pollute both their minds and bodies with [var0 |foul nannyites |blasphemous rites ]. They deserve neither pity nor mercy.” “You’ve also used transformative items,” you point out. “Does that not also count as demon worship?” [venus.name] takes a small step forward, her eyes glittering. “You’re ignorant of religious matters so I’ll ignore the slight. And to answer your question: changing up one’s appearance is not demon worship; the manes do not begrudge those seeking bodily perfection. They do, however, take issue of those who forsake any and all virtue in favor of acting like out of control animals. These ‘treated zil’ as you call them are sinners in the hands of angry paternal gods.”
rows.translation: 听你提问时，她的藤蔓几乎本能地迅速移动，挤压卷曲成紧握的拳形，那只能说是一种辟邪手势。“恶魔崇拜者，”她嘶声道，“用[var0 |污秽的纳米机器人 |亵渎的仪式 ]污染身心的兹尔。他们既不配得到怜悯，也不配得到宽恕。” “你也用过变形物品，”你指出。“那难道不算恶魔崇拜？” [venus.name]向前小迈一步，双眼闪闪发亮。“你对宗教事务一无所知，我便不计较这番冒犯。回答你的问题：改变外貌不算恶魔崇拜；祖灵不会苛责追求身体完美的人。但对于那些抛弃一切美德、像失控野兽般行事的人，他们却颇有异议。这些你所谓的‘处理过的兹尔’，就是落在愤怒父神手中的罪人。”

rows.original: “A flower?” the dryad repeats, a glimmer of a smirk playing on her full lips. “We see... you desire something to remember us by? A memento of our lust which you’ll hold at night just to imagine the feeling of our tendrils wrapped around you. How sweet.” [pc.isAss |“Pfft, in your dreams,” you reply, |“That’s not exactly what I had in mind...” you reply, ] clarifying that you plan on giving the flower to someone. She tilts her head in response, her red hair falling over one eye. “Oh so it’s some sort of mating ritual then? You give a woman a pretty trinket and she spreads her legs? How droll.” [venus.name] reaches out, plucking a flower from her hair before pressing the delicate bloom into your hands. “There you are, Steele-clan. Best of luck with your breeding session.”
rows.translation: “一朵花？”树精重复道，丰唇浮现一丝浅笑。“我们明白了...你想要一样纪念我们的东西？一件欲望的信物，晚上抱着它，就能想象藤蔓缠绕你的感觉。真甜蜜。” [pc.isAss |“嘁，做你的梦吧，”你回答， |“我想的倒不是那个...”你回答， ]说明自己准备把花送给别人。 她歪头回应，红发垂下遮住一只眼。“哦，原来是某种求偶仪式？送女人一件漂亮小玩意，她就张开双腿？真有趣。”[venus.name]伸手从发间摘下一朵花，将娇嫩的花朵放到你手中。“给你，斯蒂尔一族。祝你的繁殖活动顺利。”

rows.original: “Yes, I have happened upon the Fields of Taking in the past,” the redhead sniffs. “It is a place where everything is tallied and measured — nothing loved. A tyranny run by faceless lords who live wholly apart from the land they bleed. The jungle would be far better off without such a gangrenous cor-poor-ration gnawing at its roots.” [var0 |“Then you’ll be happy to learn that the zil burned it down not too long ago,” you say. [venus.name]’s brow curves into a frown. “Burned down, you say? Inauspicious. Your kind are rapacious when roused. I doubt they will cease their looting due to one minor setback. No, they will come back in force and exact a brutal vengeance upon the zil.” |You remark that the local zil tribe has recently ceased their attacks on the plantation and have begun trading with Esbeth, eliciting a pensive expression from her. “I suppose that’s preferable to provoking the Garden That Eats. But I can’t say I approve of engaging in such dishonorable practices as bartering.” |You remark that the plantation recently pacified the local zil tribe, causing her expression to harden. “The Bloom That Feeds on Screams will not be satisfied. It will demand total subservience from natives and starwalkers both. Woe unto all who dwell beneath its shade.” ]
rows.translation: “是的，我从前确曾去过掠夺之田，”红发女子哼道。“在那里，一切都被统计和计量 — 却没有什么得到爱。一群无面领主建立的暴政，他们彻底远离了自己榨取的土地。若没有那腐烂的公-尸-企啃噬根基，丛林会好得多。” [var0 |“那你会很高兴知道，兹尔不久前把它烧了，”你说道。 [venus.name]蹙起眉头。“烧了，你说？不祥。你们一旦被激怒便贪婪无度。我怀疑他们会因这点挫折就停止劫掠。不，他们会大举归来，对兹尔施以残酷报复。” |你说当地兹尔部落最近停止了袭击种植园，开始与埃斯贝斯贸易，让她露出沉思的神情。 “我想这总比激怒吞噬之园好。但我不能说自己赞同以物易物这种不光彩的做法。” |你说种植园最近平定了当地的兹尔部落，她的表情随之冷硬。 “以尖叫为食的花朵不会就此满足。它会要求原住民和星行者一同彻底臣服。凡栖身其荫影之下者，皆有祸了。” ]
