“商业不过是欺诈的另一个说法。真正的财富来自土地。来自吸取水分的根，来自养育丛林的土壤。你们大多似乎不懂这个基本真理。” ] [pc.isAss |“听着，[silly |嬉皮士， ] 生产商品时，我们就在创造价值，”你厉声道，尽力让她明白，世间一切并非都始于森林、终于森林。 |“因为我们相信，塑造事物时就在创造价值，”你耐心解释，尽力让她明白，世间一切并非都始于森林、终于森林。 ] [venus.name]双臂抱胸，下唇微微噘起。“这个星行者观念，我实在无法赞同。你们那些虚幻的数字和机器，让你们忘了真正重要的东西。” |“到目前为止，你对族人的宗教信仰一直说得很少，”[venus.name]说道，眉间浮起浅浅的折痕。“给我讲讲。” “有些人信一个神，有些信许多神。有些根本不信神，”你解释，尽量概述银河各类信仰体系。 “有些人不信神...？”宁芙缓缓重复。“完全不信？怎么可能？他们憎恨诸神吗？” “嗯，并非如此。有些人认为，不需要灵体或神明，也能解释一切，”你澄清道。 红发女子轻笑，声音尖锐得古怪。“就像树苗一边饮着晨光，一边宣布太阳不存在。” “他们会说太阳是真的，神却只是故事。” “故事？”[venus.name]向前倾身，背后藤蔓明显不安地起伏。“风在根间低语，祖先借树叶的沙沙声说话 — 你说那不过是寓言？” “许多人会这样理解。” “那他们就是聋子。听不见维系自身的脉动。否认神圣，就像否认肺中的呼吸。他们或许不称呼诸神的名字，但每次吃饭、喝水、呼吸，仍然是在向神下跪。”她停顿一下。“他们的世界一定很孤独。” |“我发现你们许多习俗都涉及身体接触，”[venus.name]说道。“拥抱、亲吻、牵手...这些举动究竟什么时候才适合做？” 你解释，这些举动通常留给爱人、家人等亲密的人，但不同文化也有不同标准，她随之露出柔和而沉思的表情。 “这跟维纳斯猪笼草很不同，我们更重视信息素和舞蹈。不过我能理解，对那些无可救药地深陷社交仪式与自欺的行者而言，摸来摸去确有一定吸引力。” |你提出再教她一些东西，[venus.name]眼中闪过盘算。“我很乐意继续接受你的教导，斯蒂尔一族，不过首先...我有个请求。” [venus.highSubmission |她目光直钻你的双眼，存在感如实体力量般压迫着你。“我想去埃斯贝斯。能给我某种往返城市的安全通行证吗？我会非常感激。” |她深吸一口气，为即将说的话鼓起勇气。“我想去埃斯贝斯。你能不能...给我某种往返城市的安全通行证？如果可以，我就欠你一个人情... ] ]
rows.raw: " [var0 |[venus.name] presses her hands beneath her chin, shoulders tucked close as though trying to contain herself as you offer to teach her about the wider universe. “Oh yes! Can you start by unraveling the mystery of starwalker magic to me? How exactly have you managed to obtain such powerful boons from heaven?” “Well, about that...” you take the time to clue her in on the very basics of science and technology, doing your best to emphasize that all of it has a rational basis. “I see,” replies, tapping a long finger against her lips. “So science is basically how starwalkers elucidate divine truths about the world. I can see the utility of it.” “You can? You don’t see any sort of contradiction between faith and reason?” you ask, cocking an eyebrow. “None whatsoever. Faith is intrinsically rational since the divine manes are supreme reason. Starwalker science is just another language for the same truth.” |[venus.name]’s lips twitch upwards into a grin as you offer to tutor her once again. “Could you start off by explaining who exactly is this ‘Steele-Tech’ I’ve heard so much about? Are they a relative of yours?” “It’s a corporation founded by my father,” you reply, hastening to explain to her that corporations are groups of people who pool resources, organize labor, and produce goods or services. The dryad arches a dainty eyebrow in response. “So it’s a way of organizing slaves? The zil occasionally compel their captives to work in such a manner.” “We don’t use [silly |student athletes,” |slaves,” ] you clarify. “Everyone who works at Steele Tech does so by choice.” “By choice? You mean they choose to sell themselves everyday? That sounds more pitiable than slavery. At least a slave knows who owns them.” [pc.nmh |“Being an employee is nowhere near as bad as being a slave,” you begin gently, doing your best to impress upon her the horrors of galactic slavery. |“Maybe I ought to drop you off with some slavers and see how you like it then,” you scoff, taking the time to lecture her on the horrors of galactic slavery. |[pc.hasSlaves |“Yeah? Maybe I ought to collar you right now then,” you scoff, taking time to lecture her on the horrors of galactic slavery. |“Maybe I ought to drop you off with some slavers and see how you like it then,” you scoff, taking the time to lecture her on the horrors of galactic slavery. ] ] Color drains from [venus.name]’s cheeks in a slow tide as she listens to your words. “How monstrous! I knew the rootless were depraved but what you just described is beyond barbaric. I can see how being an employee, as you call it, is far more preferable.” |“I have been mulling over your words regarding corpoor-rations and employees since our last session together,” [venus.name] remarks, watching you intently. “And I find your culture’s preoccupation with merchants, peddlers and other such scoundrels to be rather odd.” [pc.intelligenceRange 66 |You recall from your studies that disdain for merchants is a common feature of primitive agrarian societies and reply accordingly. “I’m guessing you don’t respect wealth that doesn’t come from the land?” “I–yes.” She blinks at you, momentarily caught off guard. “Real wealth comes from the land. From roots that draw water, from soil that feeds the jungle. Most of your kind doesn’t seem to understand this basic truth.” |You tilt your head. “And why is that? Commerce is the lifeblood of the universe.” “Commerce is just another word for trickery. Real wealth comes from the land. From roots that draw water, from soil that feeds the jungle. Most of your kind doesn’t seem to understand this basic truth.” ] [pc.isAss |“Listen,[silly | hippie, ] we create worth when we produce commodities,” you snap, doing your best to impress upon her that not everything begins and ends in a forest. |“That’s because we believe we create worth when we shape things,” you explain patiently, doing your best to impress upon her that not everything begins and ends in a forest. ] [venus.name] folds her arms against her chest, pushing her lower lip out slightly. “This is one starwalker idea I simply can’t get behind. All those phantom numbers and machines of yours have made you forget what really matters.” |“You’ve been rather reticent about the religious beliefs of your people thus far,” [venus.name] remarks, a faint crease forming between her brow. “Enlighten me.” “Some worship a single god. Others worship many. Some don’t worship at all,” you explain, doing your best to provide a rough schema of galactic belief systems. “Some don’t worship...?” the nymph repeats slowly. “At all? How can this be? Are they god-haters?” “Well, not exactly. Some people think everything can be explained without spirits or divinity,” you clarify. The red head chuckles, the sound oddly sharp. “Like a sapling declaring that the sun doesn’t exist while it drinks the morning light.” “They’d say the sun is real, but the gods are just stories.” “Stories?” [venus.name] leans forward, the vines at her back rippling with visible agitation. “When the wind whispers through my roots, when ancestors speak in the rustle of leaves — do you call that mere allegory?” “That’s how many would frame it.” “Then they are deaf. Deaf to the pulse that sustains them. To deny the divine is like denying the breath in one’s lungs. They may not name the gods, but they kneel to them all the same, every time they eat, drink, or breathe.” A pause. “How lonely their world must be.” |“I have observed that many of your customs have physical components,” [venus.name] remarks. “Hugs, kisses, hand holding... just when exactly are these gestures appropriate?” You explain that such gestures are typically reserved for intimates like lovers and family members but that different cultures have different standards, prompting her to adopt a soft, pensive expression. “This is all quite different from venus pitchers, we place far more importance on pheromones and dancing. But I can see why being all touchy-feely has a certain appeal for pedestrians hopelessly mired in social ritual and self-deception.” |[venus.name]’s eyes gleam with calculation as you offer to teach her some more. “I would be happy to receive more of your tutelage, Steele-clan, but first... I have a request.” [venus.highSubmission |Her gaze bores into yours, her presence bearing down on you like a physical force. “I want to visit Esbeth. Could you give me some sort of writ of safe-conduct to and from the city? I’d be most grateful if you did.” |She takes a deep breath, steeling herself for what she’s about to say. “I want to visit Esbeth. Could you... give me some sort of writ of safe-conduct to and from the city? I’d be in your debt if you did... ] ] "

rows.original: [flags.VENUS_APT |You push past the heavy door and into [venus.name]’s drawing room – warm, wet and redolent. The venus pitcher herself sits stiff-backed and motionless atop a velvet divan near the center of the room, her legs folded into a precise lotus as her hands rest lightly upon her knees. [var0 |“My, my... the prodigal blossom returns at last,” she chides. “I was beginning to suspect you’d been plucked.” |“You bear pitcher seedlings.” Her eyes move over your [pc.belly], measuring. “How thoroughly you’ve acquainted yourself with my kind.” |“Beloved,” |“[pc.name],” ] she murmurs, her words unfolding slowly like petals in warm air. “How kind of you to pay us a visit.” |You rap smartly on the heavy wooden door to the residence. It creaks open almost immediately, spilling out a lush floral scent as [venus.name] steps into view. “Perfect timing as always, Steele-clan!” she beams. “I was just about to send for you.” Her vines slip around your wrists, dragging you inside before you can so much as get a word in edgewise. The interior of her dwelling feels less like a home and more like a negotiation between forest and architecture: rows of vines and flowering herbs sprawl upwards through lattices of polished steel as a hissing misting system bathes plants and furniture alike in a cool fog. “Welcome to my new abode,” [venus.name] purrs, guiding you to a plush divan. “Feel free to bask in its sumptuousness.” “How [pc.isAss |the hell |exactly ] did you manage to come by this place?” you inquire. “By purchasing it. I used the funds I obtained from ransoming–ahem, gallantly rescuing several starwalkers from the dastardly clutches of my sisters. It’s only fitting that I be so richly rewarded for my public service, no?” ]

rows.original: Her tendrils cup your chin, tilting your head to look at her as she brushes your cheek with a pebbled vine-tip. “It was divine providence that we crossed paths with each other, my little flower.” She leans in, close enough that her floral perfume drowns your breath — heady and almost sweet. “I felt it the moment I first laid eyes upon you,” she murmurs. “A resonance... a call and answer. As though your spirit had brushed mine long before your body did.” Another vine traces the line of your throat, cool and deliberate, almost reverent. “Tell me, Steele-clan... when you dream, do you hear the roots whisper our names?” Her smile widens, serene and unsettling. “I do.”

rows.original: “Ah, so you desire to keep things sweet and ephemeral between us? To deny the current of fate that thrust us together?” [venus.name] leans forward, brushing her lips against yours in a teasing, fleeting kiss. “Very well. I’ll allow it. For now, we drift. No vows. No roots. Only pleasure.”

rows.original: Her breath hitches–sharp and sudden–as your words strike home. “A... nutjob?” She repeats, voice thin and strangely quiet. Her eyes, once bright with mirth, dull into something glassy, hollow, unreadable. “Is that how you truly feel about me, Steele-clan?” She straightens slowly, and every vine around her draws taut with a sound like cords pulling through wet earth. “Then let us end this farce before it rots.” With a flick of her wrist, her tendrils uncoil and slam into your midsection. The impact steals your breath and sends you stumbling backward. Before you can regain your footing, two more vines lash out, sweeping your legs and hurling you through the doorway. You land hard outside, the world spinning, gravel biting into your palms. Behind you, the dryad’s voice drifts out — thin, brittle, utterly done “Do not return.” The door slams shut.

rows.original: As your eyes flutter open, you find the spot beside you empty, the divan sheets wrinkled and messy. It takes a moment for you to spot [venus.name] standing on the other side of the room, misting her vines in front of a mirror and humming a soft, lilting melody. Her eyes lock with yours in the reflection and she turns slowly, favoring you with a broad, knowing grin. “Good morning, little blossom,” she murmurs, a tendril extending to lazily stroke your [pc.hair]. “Sleep well?” You mumble something affirmative as you sit up, and she shepherds you toward her low table. Breakfast is a simple affair — fresh fruit, warm bread, and a cup of something floral and faintly effervescent she insists will ’steady your spirit.’ “Well then. The day awaits you, Steele-clan.” A vine coils around your wrist for a moment — warm and supple — before slipping away. “Do return soon. I dislike watching the door for too long.” You gather your [pc.gear] and step outside, her gaze following you until the door shuts.

You spot an old man by the side of a road, his cloak soaked and tangled. Your gaze moves over his face — the eyes first, then the mouth. It’s your Uncle Maximilian. His fingers stretch towards you before falling, smacking limply against the wet cobblestone.
	
	You hear the chariot before you see it — bronze-rimmed wheels rattling as they hit the road. Your cousin stands in the cab with the reins wrapped twice around [rival.hisHer] fists, hair loose and streaming. [rival.HeShe]’s grinning. You look away, studying an uneven cobblestone instead. Blood pools in the cracks.

rows.original: The next room is empty, save for a sagging leather recliner. You actually recognize it as one of your father’s favorites. The arm rests are cracked and pale where the surface has worn through. A holo projector protrudes from the ceiling, aimed at the empty space in front of the chair. With nothing else to do, you seat yourself. The corner of his desiccated lips quirk. “To the strongest.”

rows.original: The first thing you register is the smell of damp earth and blooming vines. Then you see it — two emerald eyes boring into yours. “Steele-clan.” [venus.name] murmurs, pressing a nodule-studded tendril to your forehead. “Are you unwell? You tossed and turned in your slumber like a sapling that can’t decide which way the wind is blowing.” “I’m fine,” you croak. “I just... had a rough night.” The dryad nods sagely. “I see. You received portents from the Root-Dreamer while lost in her drowsy halls.” Her tendril squeezes your shoulder gently. [silly |“They say it’s the gryvain blood that flows through the veins of every Steele. You see more than lesser persons |“She sends difficult visions to those with difficult roots. ] Whatever you endured tonight has already done its work. There is little use in carrying it into the morning.” She shepherds you toward her low table already laden with food. Breakfast is a simple affair — fresh fruit, warm bread, and a cup of something floral and faintly effervescent she insists will ‘steady your spirit.’ “Well then. The day awaits you, Steele-clan.” A vine coils around your wrist for a moment — warm and supple — before slipping away. “Do return soon. I dislike watching the door for too long.”
rows.translation: 你最先察觉的是湿土与盛放藤蔓的气味。随后你看见了 — 一双翠绿的眼睛正直勾勾盯着你。 “斯蒂尔一族。”[venus.name]低语，将一根布满结节的藤蔓按在你的额头上。“你不舒服吗？睡觉时翻来覆去，就像不知道风往哪吹的小树苗。” “我没事，”你嘶哑地回答。“只是...昨晚过得不太好。” 树精睿智地点点头。“明白了。你迷失在根之梦者令人昏沉的殿堂时，收到了她的预兆。”她用藤蔓轻轻捏了捏你的肩。[silly |“据说每位斯蒂尔血管里都流淌着格里文 的血。你比平庸之人看得更多 |“她会给根系复杂的人送去难解的幻象。 ] 无论今夜经历了什么，它都已经发挥了作用。再把它带进清晨，也没什么用处。” 她把你带到早已摆好食物的矮桌旁。早餐很简单 — 新鲜水果、温热面包，还有一杯带着花香、微微冒泡的东西，她坚持说它能‘安定你的精神。’ “好了。新的一天正等着你，斯蒂尔一族。”一根藤蔓短暂缠住你的手腕 — 温暖柔韧 — 随后滑开。“记得早点回来。我不喜欢盯着门等太久。”

rows.original: You approach the nursedroid a little hesitantly, but before you can utter a single word, she smoothly bounds up off the bed and onto the balls of her feet, feet that actually appear to wear delicate white boots. Those alabaster garments merge seamlessly into the pink of her artificially smooth, perfect skin. The rest of her is trimmed in equally white clothing, though you can’t see a single seam anywhere. It appears to have been sewn or built directly on her.
rows.translation: 你略显迟疑地走向护士机器人，还没来得及开口，她便流畅地从床上跃起，脚尖着地，那双脚看上去竟穿着精致的白靴。雪白的衣物与她那人工打造、光滑完美的粉色肌肤无缝相连。她身上其他地方也穿着同样洁白的衣物，可你找不到任何接缝。它们似乎直接缝制或构建在她身上。

It appears to have been sewn or built directly on her."

rows.original: “Hello, [pc.race], I have not been assigned a designation, so you may refer to me by my model class, V-Ko. I have been placed here to dispense medical procedures for a reasonable, profit-ensuring price,” the nursedroid, V-Ko states. She smiles, luxurious, synthetic pigtails bobbing behind her. “I am certified in the care and treatment of over five thousand races for one million sixty thousand forty-five diseases and counting.” The white crosses in her eyes blink blue momentarily. “Database updated. Fifteen thousand new treatments added.” V-Ko tilts her head to the side robotically. “I can sell you medical supplies, examine you for diseases, or heal any injuries in a short amount of time. How may I assist you, citizen?”
rows.translation: “你好，[pc.race]，我还没有被指定名称，你可以用我的型号V-Ko称呼我。我被安置在这里，以合理且能确保利润的价格提供医疗服务，”护士机器人V-Ko说道。她微笑着，华美的合成双马尾在身后摇晃。“我获得了为五千余个种族护理和治疗一百零六万零四十五种疾病的认证，而且数量还在增加。”她眼中的白色十字短暂闪成蓝色。“数据库已更新。新增一万五千种治疗方法。”V-Ko机械地歪了歪头。“我可以出售医疗用品、为你检查疾病，或在短时间内治愈任何伤势。公民，你需要什么帮助？”

rows.original: You do your best to relax as the droid fusses with your injuries. Her deft hands move around your wounded flesh with practiced ease. rows.original: Pressing her mechanical digit’s tips near to your hurts, she coos, “This will only take a moment.” Her words are chased by a blast of frigid mist against your wounds, so cold that your teeth chatter. She repeats the process at the site of every injury, and you do your best to let her work as swiftly as possible.

rows.original: “Well, we altered an existing game that normally needs a group of people so it can function with just a game leader and a single player - altered difficulty and such, the ability to play more than one character. It is quite fun, if I do say so myself!”
rows.translation: “嗯，我们改编了一款现有的、通常需要一群人玩的游戏，让它只需要一名主持人和一名玩家就能进行 - 调整难度之类的，还能扮演不止一个角色。如果让我自己说，那可相当有趣！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, we altered an existing game that normally needs a group of people so it can function with just a game leader and a single player - altered difficulty and such, the ability to play more than one character. It is quite fun, if I do say so myself!”"

rows.original: You ask him what the game’s called, at least, and if the two of you could play it.
rows.translation: 你问他，这游戏究竟叫什么名字，以及你们两个能不能一起玩。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask him what the game’s called, at least, and if the two of you could play it."

rows.original: “Oh, well we renamed it, we called our version Caves and Cryptids! And... I do not see why we could not play.” he remarks, sticking a hand into his pocket and fishing out a set of bright green dice, the same color as his eyes.
rows.translation: “哦，嗯，我们给它改了名字，我们的版本叫《洞穴与奇异生物》！而且...我想不出我们有什么不能玩的理由。”他说着，把手伸进口袋，掏出一套亮绿色的骰子，颜色和他的眼睛一样。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, well we renamed it, we called our version Caves and Cryptids! And... I do not see why we could not play.” he remarks, sticking a hand into his pocket and fishing out a set of bright green dice, the same color as his eyes."

rows.translation: “我？”他停顿了一下。“嗯...我是个仿生人，身上有狐狸的部位，我，呃...”

rows.raw: " unit you love. <i>“"

rows.original: And, ah, yes, I am technically a medical and companion android.”
rows.translation: 而且，啊，对，严格说来，我是个医疗兼伴侣仿生人。”
rows.raw: "And, ah, yes, I am technically a medical and companion android.”"

rows.original: That’s interesting. You ask him what he likes doing, wanting to know more about him.
rows.translation: 这倒有意思。你想多了解他一些，便问他喜欢做什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s interesting. You ask him what he likes doing, wanting to know more about him."

rows.original: “Hm. That is not a question I am used to, most people do not think I can actively like or dislike things,” he says, before a gentle smile creeps up onto his face. “I suppose I enjoy exploring, there is always a sense of satisfaction in being the first to have been recorded reaching somewhere. That and sewing, but there is much less to talk about there.”
rows.translation: “嗯。我不太习惯这种问题，大多数人不认为我能主动喜欢或讨厌什么，”他说，随后脸上渐渐浮现出温柔的笑容。“我想我喜欢探索，成为记录中第一个抵达某个地方的人，总会带来一种满足感。还有缝纫，不过这方面能说的就少得多了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hm. That is not a question I am used to, most people do not think I can actively like or dislike things,” he says, before a gentle smile creeps up onto his face. “I suppose I enjoy exploring, there is always a sense of satisfaction in being the first to have been recorded reaching somewhere. That and sewing, but there is much less to talk about there.”"

rows.original: Okay, you can’t hold back on this question any more, just why does he never use contractions?
rows.translation: 好了，你再也忍不住想问这个问题了，他为什么从来不用缩写形式？
rows.raw: "\n\nOkay, you can’t hold back on this question any more, just why does he never use contractions?"

rows.original: The absolute shit eating grin that spreads across his face is inhumanly wide, and it takes a while for it to fade enough for him to actually speak. “It pisses people off!”
rows.translation: 他脸上露出无比欠揍的笑容，咧得宽到非人的地步，过了好一会儿才收敛到能开口说话。“因为这样能气死人！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe absolute shit eating grin that spreads across his face is inhumanly wide, and it takes a while for it to fade enough for him to actually speak. “It pisses people off!”"

rows.original: Well. That answers that question.
rows.translation: 好吧。这个问题算是有答案了。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell. That answers that question."

rows.translation: 门加
rows.raw: "Mhen’ga"

rows.original: GothPastel
rows.raw: "GothPastel"

rows.original: You ask why he’s on Mhen’ga, of all places.
rows.translation: 你问他为什么偏偏来了门加。
rows.raw: "You ask why he’s on Mhen’ga, of all places."

rows.original: He hums, like he’s trying to think of what to say for a moment, before finally speaking. “My master gets very sick. Frequently he is unable to so much as leave his bed.”
rows.translation: 他轻哼一声，似乎一时在思考该怎么说，最后才开口。“我的主人病得很重。他常常连下床都做不到。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe hums, like he’s trying to think of what to say for a moment, before finally speaking. “My master gets very sick. Frequently he is unable to so much as leave his bed.”"

rows.original: You’re not quite sure how this ties into why he’s here though, so you press further.
rows.translation: 不过，你不太明白这和他为什么来这里有什么关系，于是继续追问。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re not quite sure how this ties into why he’s here though, so you press further."

rows.original: “The Planet Rush. He has always, always wanted to explore the frontier. We were supposed to go together as he had been feeling so much better over the months before, but then he got worse than he ever had been before. His parents cancelled the trip, but, well, he still wanted to see all of this, so I was sent alone.”
rows.translation: “行星开拓潮。他一直、一直都想探索边疆。本来我们应该一起来的，因为之前几个月他的身体好了很多，但后来他的病情恶化到了前所未有的地步。他的父母取消了行程，可是，嗯，他还是想看看这一切，所以我就独自被派来了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The Planet Rush. He has always, always wanted to explore the frontier. We were supposed to go together as he had been feeling so much better over the months before, but then he got worse than he ever had been before. His parents cancelled the trip, but, well, he still wanted to see all of this, so I was sent alone.”"

rows.original: That makes sense, you guess.
rows.translation: 你觉得这倒说得通。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat makes sense, you guess."

rows.original: “Mhen’ga is not my first stop and it probably will not be the last. There are so many specimens I want to gather for him...” There’s an almost sad note in his voice, you guess it’s just not the same without his owner here.
rows.translation: “门加不是我的第一站，大概也不会是最后一站。我想给他收集的标本实在太多了...”他的声音里带着近乎悲伤的意味，你猜，主人不在身边，终究还是不一样。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mhen’ga is not my first stop and it probably will not be the last. There are so many specimens I want to gather for him...” There’s an almost sad note in his voice, you guess it’s just not the same without his owner here."

rows.original: Mhen’ga
rows.translation: 门加
rows.raw: "Mhen’ga"

rows.original: Master?
rows.translation: 主人？
rows.raw: "Master?"

rows.original: GothPastel
rows.raw: "GothPastel"

rows.original: You ask him about the man he keeps referring to as his ‘master’.
rows.translation: 你问起那个被他一直称为‘主人’的男人。
rows.raw: "You ask him about the man he keeps referring to as his ‘master’."

rows.original: “My master is a relatively wealthy Terran human, but he is plagued by a very serious immune condition that doesn’t seem to respond to any treatment that has been attempted thus far.” His shoulders sag a little, the trademark grin fading as he sighs. “He probably will not live very long.”
rows.translation: “我的主人是个比较富有的地球人，但他患有一种非常严重的免疫疾病，迄今尝试过的所有治疗似乎都对它毫无作用。”他的肩膀略微垮下，叹息时，那标志性的笑容也消退了。“他大概活不了太久。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My master is a relatively wealthy Terran human, but he is plagued by a very serious immune condition that doesn’t seem to respond to any treatment that has been attempted thus far.” His shoulders sag a little, the trademark grin fading as he sighs. “He probably will not live very long.”"

rows.original: That’s quite the bombshell, and the android looks upset, so you try to steer him towards another topic, asking him what he does.
rows.translation: 这消息着实令人震惊，而仿生人看起来很难过，于是你试着换个话题，问他主人是做什么的。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s quite the bombshell, and the android looks upset, so you try to steer him towards another topic, asking him what he does."

rows.original: “Well, with his condition he is not employed, but he has quite the interest in robotics! The amount of times he has tried to take me apart is bordering on ridiculous.” Considering that he’s laughing as he says it though, it looks like he doesn’t actually mind. “He sells the odd patent though, despite the fortune his parents make, he prefers not to feel indebted to them.”
rows.translation: “嗯，由于身体状况，他没有工作，不过他对机器人技术可是兴趣十足！他试图把我拆开的次数多得简直离谱。”不过，考虑到他说这话时还在笑，看起来他其实并不介意。“但他偶尔会卖些专利，虽然父母赚了大钱，他还是不喜欢觉得自己欠他们的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, with his condition he is not employed, but he has quite the interest in robotics! The amount of times he has tried to take me apart is bordering on ridiculous.” Considering that he’s laughing as he says it though, it looks like he doesn’t actually mind. “He sells the odd patent though, despite the fortune his parents make, he prefers not to feel indebted to them.”"

rows.original: What’s he like?
rows.translation: 他是个什么样的人？
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat’s he like?"

rows.original: You’ve really asked the golden question here, as Yoma absolutely beams. “I fucking love him, [pc.name]. This is not just because I was made specifically for him, he is simply the most exemplary member of the human race I have ever met. He has such a genuine kindness about him, he is just... wonderful.”
rows.translation: 你这回可算问到点子上了，因为尤玛简直笑得容光焕发。“我他妈爱死他了，[pc.name]。这不只是因为我是专门为他制造的，他简直就是我见过的最杰出的人类。他的善良那么真诚，他实在是...太美好了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve really asked the golden question here, as Yoma absolutely beams. “I fucking love him, [pc.name]. This is not just because I was made specifically for him, he is simply the most exemplary member of the human race I have ever met. rows.raw: "\n\nHe’s pleasantly warm, pushed up against you as he is, and even after you’ve finished your drink, you stay there, chattering away. "

rows.original: Eventually though, after polishing up a
rows.translation: 不过，最终，在讲完一个
rows.raw: "\n\nEventually though, after polishing up a "

rows.translation: 极度夸张的

rows.original: story about something embarrassing that your cousin did on one of [rival.hisHer] rare visits, you realize that you’ve been here easily an hour and it’s probably time you head out. Yoma doesn’t remove his arm from you
rows.translation: 故事，说的是你那位表亲在[rival.hisHer]某次难得来访时做的尴尬事之后，你意识到自己在这里待了肯定有一个小时，大概该出发了。尤玛没有松开搂着你的手臂
rows.raw: "story about something embarrassing that your cousin did on one of [rival.hisHer] rare visits, you realize that you’ve been here easily an hour and it’s probably time you head out. Yoma doesn’t remove his arm from you "

rows.original: though he does move it up to be around your shoulders now
rows.translation: 不过他现在把手臂往上挪，改为搂着你的肩膀
rows.raw: "though he does move it up to be around your shoulders now "

rows.original: as you stroll through Tavros Station, still talking idly.
rows.translation: 你们漫步穿过塔夫罗斯站时，仍在随意地聊着天。
rows.raw: "as you stroll through Tavros Station, still talking idly."

rows.original: After you’re quite certain you’ve walked off that hot chocolate, you start moving towards your ship again, not ignoring the little circles that Yoma’s been rubbing into your flesh and the grin that hints he’d like a little more than a quiet ride home.
rows.translation: 等你确信那杯热巧克力已经消化得差不多了，便再次朝飞船走去，没忽略尤玛一直在你肌肤上画的小圈，以及那副暗示他想要的不只是安静返航的笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter you’re quite certain you’ve walked off that hot chocolate, you start moving towards your ship again, not ignoring the little circles that Yoma’s been rubbing into your flesh and the grin that hints he’d like a little more than a quiet ride home."

rows.original: It doesn’t take long for the two of you to step into Bunny’s Buns & Confectionary. The usual near-garish flashing lights are as obnoxious as ever, the music at least toned down to a thankfully much higher quality version of the sort of stuff that the elevator earlier was playing.
rows.translation: 没过多久，你们俩就走进了兔女郎面包甜品店。平日里那几乎艳俗的闪光灯还是一样恼人，不过谢天谢地，音乐至少柔和了一些，是先前电梯里那类曲子的高品质版本。
rows.raw: "It doesn’t take long for the two of you to step into Bunny’s Buns & Confectionary. The usual near-garish flashing lights are as obnoxious as ever, the music at least toned down to a thankfully much higher quality version of the sort of stuff that the elevator earlier was playing."

rows.original: “Hey sweeties,” croons

rows.original: Ilaria
rows.translation: 伊拉莉娅
rows.raw: "Ilaria"

rows.original: the bunny girl that bounces up to you from behind the counter - Ilaria, according to her name tag
rows.translation: 从柜台后蹦跳着来到你面前的兔女郎 - 按照名牌，她叫伊拉莉娅
rows.raw: "the bunny girl that bounces up to you from behind the counter - Ilaria, according to her name tag"

rows.original: . “Can I get you anything?”
rows.translation: 。“想来点什么？”
rows.raw: ". “Can I get you anything?”"

rows.original: Yoma speaks up before you can. “We will take a hot chocolate!”
rows.translation: 你还没开口，尤玛就先说道：“我们要一杯热巧克力！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYoma speaks up before you can. “We will take a hot chocolate!”"

rows.original: Is he not having anything?
rows.translation: 他不吃点什么吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nIs he not having anything?"

rows.original: “Ah, no - I was not programmed to taste in anything but the vaguest terms. I would hate to waste our charming hostess’s talents.” The last line is accompanied with his signature wide grin in Ilaria’s direction.
rows.translation: “啊，不用 - 我的程序只能让我以最模糊的方式感知味道。我可不想浪费我们这位迷人女主人的手艺。”最后一句话伴随着他朝伊拉莉娅露出的招牌式大笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, no - I was not programmed to taste in anything but the vaguest terms. I would hate to waste our charming hostess’s talents.” The last line is accompanied with his signature wide grin in Ilaria’s direction."

rows.original: She laughs, and turns to you. “So, you want cream on that?”
rows.translation: 她笑了，转向你。“那么，要加奶油吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe laughs, and turns to you. “So, you want cream on that?”"

rows.original: Well, do you?
rows.translation: 那么，要加吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, do you?"

rows.original: picked out a simple outfit to wear
rows.translation: 挑好一身简单的衣服穿上
rows.raw: "picked out a simple outfit to wear"

rows.original: straightened out your [pc.clothes]
rows.translation: 整理好自己的[pc.clothes]
rows.raw: "straightened out your [pc.clothes]"

rows.original: , Yoma is already waiting for you in the hangar. He’s still wearing his signature red, but this time it takes the form of a cozy looking poncho. Combined with cream leggings and black jackboots, it’s a fetching look.
rows.translation: ，尤玛已经在机库里等你了。他还是穿着标志性的红色，不过这次是一件看起来很舒适的披风式斗篷。配上奶油色打底裤和黑色长筒靴，十分惹眼。
rows.raw: ", Yoma is already waiting for you in the hangar. He’s still wearing his signature red, but this time it takes the form of a cozy looking poncho. Combined with cream leggings and black jackboots, it’s a fetching look."

rows.original: You cross over to him, laughing quietly as he now seems to be pretending that he wasn’t just watching for you to come out.
rows.translation: 你走向他，轻轻笑了起来，因为他这会儿似乎正假装自己刚才没有一直盯着等你出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou cross over to him, laughing quietly as he now seems to be pretending that he wasn’t just watching for you to come out."

rows.original: “Took you long enough,” he murmurs as you draw close.
rows.translation: “你可真够久的，”你走近时，他低声说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Took you long enough,” he murmurs as you draw close."

rows.original: You joke around, asking if he missed you already.
rows.translation: 你开玩笑地问，他是不是已经想你了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou joke around, asking if he missed you already."

rows.original: “No! No, of course not. Are you ready?” he asks. You nod, extending a hand out to him. The android stares at you blankly for a moment, but soon takes it. His hand is surprisingly warm - not the usual cool of a synthetic.
rows.translation: “没有！没有，当然没有。你准备好了吗？”他问。你点点头，向他伸出一只手。仿生人茫然地看了你片刻，但很快便握住了。出乎意料，他的手很温暖 - 没有人造生命通常的冰凉。
rows.raw: "\n\n“No! No, of course not. Are you ready?” he asks. You nod, extending a hand out to him. The android stares at you blankly for a moment, but soon takes it. His hand is surprisingly warm - not the usual cool of a synthetic."

rows.original: “Miniature thermal generators under the synthetic flesh of my palms.” Yoma explains, seeming to have noticed your surprise. “My master’s idea - it feels more natural, does it not? Come on though, we did not come all the way out here to stand around.” He takes off, gently tugging you behind him. More natural, huh? Next he’ll be telling you he’s going to be getting a heartbeat.
rows.translation: “我掌心的人造皮肉下装着微型热能发生器。”尤玛解释道，似乎注意到了你的惊讶。“我主人的主意 - 感觉更自然，不是吗？不过，走吧，我们大老远来这里可不是为了站着。”他动身了，轻轻拉着你跟上。更自然，嗯？接下来他就该告诉你，他要装个心跳了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Miniature thermal generators under the synthetic flesh of my palms.” Yoma explains, seeming to have noticed your surprise. “My master’s idea - it feels more natural, does it not? Come on though, we did not come all the way out here to stand around.” He takes off, gently tugging you behind him. More natural, huh? Next he’ll be telling you he’s going to be getting a heartbeat."

rows.original: “Oh, we experimented with that.” He says, and you snort - you were only joking!
rows.translation: “哦，我们试过那个。”他说，你嗤笑一声 - 你只是在开玩笑！
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, we experimented with that.” He says, and you snort - you were only joking! "

rows.original: “No, really, we did. It was... Too far into what you would call the uncanny valley though. Master removed the feature after about a week. I was quite relieved - it used a lot of processing power trying to analyze whether to pick up or slow down the pace in response to every single stimulus...” He seems to have calmed down a bit, happily chattering away to you.
rows.translation: “不，真的，我们试过。不过那...太接近你们所谓的恐怖谷了。大约一周后，主人就移除了这个功能。我倒是很松了口气 - 为了响应每一种刺激，都要分析该加快还是减慢心率，实在占用了很多运算能力...”他似乎放松了一些，开心地和你聊个不停。
rows.raw: "\n\n“No, really, we did. It was... Too far into what you would call the uncanny valley though. Master removed the feature after about a week. I was quite relieved - it used a lot of processing power trying to analyze whether to pick up or slow down the pace in response to every single stimulus...” He seems to have calmed down a bit, happily chattering away to you."

rows.original: It’s not long before the two of you are in the elevator and he’s punching in for the residential deck. The elevator’s music is as aggravating as usual - greeting the two of you with odd, tinny versions of Ausar pop and some Terran ballad that sounds old enough to have been popular when your father was a child - not that it stops Yoma prodding you into at least humming along to the ones the both of you recognize.
rows.translation: 没过多久，你们俩便进了电梯，他按下居住甲板的按钮。电梯音乐还是一如既往地烦人 - 迎接你们的是音质单薄、古怪的奥萨尔流行乐版本，还有某首地球民谣，听起来古老到足以在你父亲小时候就流行过 - 不过，这并不妨碍尤玛撺掇你，至少跟着那些你们俩都听过的曲子哼上几句。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s not long before the two of you are in the elevator and he’s punching in for the residential deck. The elevator’s music is as aggravating as usual - greeting the two of you with odd, tinny versions of Ausar pop and some Terran ballad that sounds old enough to have been popular when your father was a child - not that it stops Yoma prodding you into at least humming along to the ones the both of you recognize."

rows.original: LIFT: MERCHANT DECK
rows.raw: "LIFT: MERCHANT DECK"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: GothPastel
rows.raw: "GothPastel"

rows.original: You tell Yoma that you’d love to. He blinks for a moment, but once he’s done processing your agreement he grins, straightening up and pushing himself away from the bar.
rows.translation: 你告诉尤玛，你很乐意。他眨了眨眼，不过等处理完你的同意后，便咧嘴笑起来，挺直身体，从吧台边起身。
rows.raw: "You tell Yoma that you’d love to. He blinks for a moment, but once he’s done processing your agreement he grins, straightening up and pushing himself away from the bar."

rows.original: “There is a nice little café on Tavros I have heard of - we could take your ship?” He doesn’t really wait for an answer, picking up a small bag you hadn’t noticed next to him and burying his free hand into a pocket of his shorts as he walks for the door, leaving you to hurriedly follow after. He seems almost on edge as he passes through Esbeth - perhaps not used to venturing far outside the jungle here - only settling down once you enter the spaceport building. You ask him about it as you checkout with
rows.translation: “我听说塔夫罗斯站有一家不错的小咖啡馆 - 我们可以坐你的船去？”他没怎么等你回答，就拿起身旁一个你先前没注意到的小包，空着的手插进短裤口袋，朝门口走去，让你只好赶紧跟上。穿过埃斯贝斯时，他似乎几乎一直紧绷着 - 也许是不习惯离开这里的丛林太远 - 直到进入太空港大楼才放松下来。你在办理离港手续时问起这事，接待你的是
rows.raw: "\n\n“There is a nice little café on Tavros I have heard of - we could take your ship?” He doesn’t really wait for an answer, picking up a small bag you hadn’t noticed next to him and burying his free hand into a pocket of his shorts as he walks for the door, leaving you to hurriedly follow after. He seems almost on edge as he passes through Esbeth - perhaps not used to venturing far outside the jungle here - only settling down once you enter the spaceport building. You ask him about it as you checkout with "

rows.original: and just plain check out
rows.translation: 而且还顺便打量着
rows.raw: "and just plain check out "

rows.original: Flahne, heading out to the elevator that’ll take you back up to your ship.
rows.translation: 弗兰，随后走向通往飞船的电梯。
rows.raw: "Flahne, heading out to the elevator that’ll take you back up to your ship."

rows.original: “I am simply not familiar with the area, [pc.name]. It was not my destination either, so no need to dawdle,” he states, his tone not particularly welcoming further questioning. It doesn’t take too long for you to take the elevator up to the platform your ship is docked at, and Yoma rocks back onto the heels of his feet as he looks at it, whistling lowly. For a while, it looks like he’s examining it, tracing a hand along its paintwork with an expression of curiosity painted across his features - ears and tail flicking about, as if making observations of his own.
rows.translation: “我只是不熟悉这个地方，[pc.name]。这里也不是我的目的地，所以没必要磨蹭，”他说，语气并不怎么欢迎进一步追问。没过多久，你们便乘电梯来到飞船停靠的平台，尤玛看着它，身体后仰，将重心移到脚跟上，低低地吹了声口哨。有一阵子，他似乎在检查它，一只手沿着漆面滑动，脸上满是好奇 - 耳朵和尾巴晃个不停，仿佛在自行观察。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I am simply not familiar with the area, [pc.name]. It was not my destination either, so no need to dawdle,” he states, his tone not particularly welcoming further questioning. It doesn’t take too long for you to take the elevator up to the platform your ship is docked at, and Yoma rocks back onto the heels of his feet as he looks at it, whistling lowly. For a while, it looks like he’s examining it, tracing a hand along its paintwork with an expression of curiosity painted across his features - ears and tail flicking about, as if making observations of his own."

rows.original: “Nice ship, [pc.name]!” is the eventual verdict, the android turning back to look at you. “I like a [pc.manWoman] who treats their machines well.” You don’t doubt that for a moment.
rows.translation: “好船，[pc.name]！”仿生人最终给出评价，转身看着你。“我喜欢善待机械的[pc.manWoman]。”对此，你毫不怀疑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nice ship, [pc.name]!” is the eventual verdict, the android turning back to look at you. “I like a [pc.manWoman] who treats their machines well.” You don’t doubt that for a moment."

rows.original: A moment of final admiration
rows.translation: 最后又欣赏了片刻
rows.raw: "\n\nA moment of final admiration "

rows.original: and a confirmation that yes, this is the same ship your father used for the Rush he took part in,

rows.raw: "and a confirmation that yes, this is the same ship your father used for the Rush he took part in, "

rows.original: later and you ask if he’d like to come inside. There’s no need to ask twice - as soon as the words are out of your mouth he brushes past you into the ship.
rows.translation: 之后，你问他要不要进去。根本不用问第二次 - 话音刚落，他便从你身边擦过，进了船。
rows.raw: "later and you ask if he’d like to come inside. There’s no need to ask twice - as soon as the words are out of your mouth he brushes past you into the ship."

rows.original: It’s not long before
rows.translation: 没过多久，
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s not long before "

rows.translation: 你就听见他向船员介绍自己，
rows.raw: "you hear him introducing himself to your crew,"

rows.original: though his introduction to [bess.name] sounds a little steely,
rows.translation: 不过，向[bess.name]介绍自己时，他的语气听起来有些生硬，
rows.raw: " though his introduction to [bess.name] sounds a little steely,"

rows.original: excitedly explaining that he’s stealing you away for a date, then
rows.translation: 兴奋地解释说他要把你偷走去约会，随后
rows.raw: " excitedly explaining that he’s stealing you away for a date, then "

rows.original: he calls back to you, letting you know he’s going to be getting changed into something more festive and he’ll join you once you’ve landed.
rows.translation: 他朝你喊话，说要换一身更有节日气氛的衣服，等你着陆后就会来找你。
rows.raw: "he calls back to you, letting you know he’s going to be getting changed into something more festive and he’ll join you once you’ve landed."

rows.original: Time to set a course for Tavros.
rows.translation: 该设定前往塔夫罗斯站的航线了。
rows.raw: "\n\nTime to set a course for Tavros."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: GothPastel
rows.raw: "GothPastel"

rows.original: You tell Yoma that you’d really rather not.
rows.translation: 你告诉尤玛，你真的不太想去。
rows.raw: "You tell Yoma that you’d really rather not."

rows.original: His ears droop, a disappointed expression spreading onto his face, but he nods. “That is fine, [pc.name]. I will be off, then.” He flashes you a faint smile as he straightens himself up and leaves, perhaps trying to show that he doesn’t hold anything against you.
rows.translation: 他的耳朵垂了下来，脸上浮现出失望的神情，不过他点了点头。“没关系，[pc.name]。那我就走了。”他挺直身体离开时，向你露出一个浅浅的微笑，或许是想表明他并不怨你。
rows.raw: "\n\nHis ears droop, a disappointed expression spreading onto his face, but he nods. “That is fine, [pc.name]. I will be off, then.” He flashes you a faint smile as he straightens himself up and leaves, perhaps trying to show that he doesn’t hold anything against you."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Yes
rows.translation: 是
rows.raw: "Yes"

rows.original: Later
rows.translation: 稍后
rows.raw: "Later"

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 否
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 否
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: WARNING: This will lock you out of a good deal of future content.
rows.translation: 警告：这将会使你无法体验相当一部分后续内容。
rows.raw: "WARNING: This will lock you out of a good deal of future content."

rows.original: GothPastel
rows.raw: "GothPastel"

rows.original: You saunter up to the android, having a good idea of what he’s here for. He grins as he spots you heading his way, swinging up a bag you’d barely noticed from the floor, and stands to excited attention. Another date?
rows.translation: 你悠然走向仿生人，已经大致猜到他为何而来。他看见你朝他走去，便咧嘴笑起来，从地上拎起一个你几乎没注意到的包，兴奋地站得笔直。又一次约会？
rows.raw: "You saunter up to the android, having a good idea of what he’s here for. He grins as he spots you heading his way, swinging up a bag you’d barely noticed from the floor, and stands to excited attention. Another date?"

rows.original: “Of course!” he chirps, “A little different from last time, though - a little more casual. I thought we could find somewhere nicer to play.” Play? Oh - of course - Caves and Cryptids again. Where does he feel like taking you?
rows.translation: “当然！”他轻快地说道，“不过和上次有点不同 - 更随意一些。我想我们可以找个更好的地方玩。”玩？哦 - 当然 - 又是《洞穴与奇异生物》。他想带你去哪儿？
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course!” he chirps, “A little different from last time, though - a little more casual. I thought we could find somewhere nicer to play.” Play? Oh - of course - Caves and Cryptids again. Where does he feel like taking you?"

rows.original: “I was thinking of somewhere a bit brighter, less humid - less chance of getting jumped by bug people. I took a look at the coordinates you have picked up the last time I was on your ship - and New Texas seems friendly enough.”
rows.translation: “我想找个更明亮、不那么潮湿的地方 - 被虫人扑倒的机会也少些。上次在你船上时，我看过你收集到的坐标 - 新德克萨斯看起来足够友好。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I was thinking of somewhere a bit brighter, less humid - less chance of getting jumped by bug people. I took a look at the coordinates you have picked up the last time I was on your ship - and New Texas seems friendly enough.”"

rows.original: Unable to help yourself, you let out a small snort of laughter.
rows.translation: 你忍不住，轻轻嗤笑了一声。
rows.raw: "\n\nUnable to help yourself, you let out a small snort of laughter."

rows.original: It’s his turn to laugh, of course. “Now, now - it is not jumping if they ask first - and I did say it in reference to the Zil, anyway.” Well, he’s not wrong.
rows.translation: 当然，这回轮到他笑了。“哎呀，哎呀 - 如果先问过，就不算扑倒 - 再说，我说的本来也是兹尔。”好吧，他说得倒没错。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s his turn to laugh, of course. “Now, now - it is not jumping if they ask first - and I did say it in reference to the Zil, anyway.” Well, he’s not wrong."

rows.original: He laughs again before speaking. “Well, do you feel up to it?”
rows.translation: 他又笑了一声，才开口。“那么，你想去吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe laughs again before speaking. “Well, do you feel up to it?”"

rows.original: You approach the android again, and he perks up, picking his bag up off from the floor.
rows.translation: 你再次走近仿生人，他精神一振，从地上拿起包。
rows.raw: "You approach the android again, and he perks up, picking his bag up off from the floor."

rows.original: “Have you reconsidered, [pc.name]?”
rows.translation: “你改变主意了吗，[pc.name]？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Have you reconsidered, [pc.name]?”"

rows.original: Well, have you? Do you want to go?
rows.translation: 那么，你改主意了吗？你想去吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, have you? Do you want to go?"

rows.original: GothPastel
rows.raw: "GothPastel"

rows.original: About two hours later, you find yourselves taking a break - you’re lazily sprawled out, head in Yoma’s lap with his fingers
rows.translation: 大约两小时后，你们开始休息 - 你懒洋洋地摊开身体，头枕在尤玛腿上，他的手指
rows.raw: "About two hours later, you find yourselves taking a break - you’re lazily sprawled out, head in Yoma’s lap with his fingers "

rows.original: stroking through your hair.
rows.translation: 梳抚着你的头发。
rows.raw: "stroking through your hair."

rows.original: gently tapping a rhythm against your bare scalp.
rows.translation: 在你光裸的头皮上轻轻敲着节拍。
rows.raw: "gently tapping a rhythm against your bare scalp."

rows.original: Eventually, you start dozing off, only to catch the end of a murmured sentence.
rows.translation: 最终，你开始打盹，却只听见一句低语的末尾。
rows.raw: "\n\nEventually, you start dozing off, only to catch the end of a murmured sentence."

rows.original: “...Missed this...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...Missed this...”"

rows.original: Hm?
rows.translation: 嗯？
rows.raw: "\n\nHm?"

rows.original: There’s an undignified squeak from above you, and you look up to see Yoma plastering a hand over his mouth.
rows.translation: 你头顶传来一声有失体面的尖叫，你抬头看去，只见尤玛一只手死死捂住嘴。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s an undignified squeak from above you, and you look up to see Yoma plastering a hand over his mouth."

rows.original: Oh, now that’s quite the sign of embarrassment.
rows.translation: 哦，这可真是不好意思的明显迹象。
rows.raw: "\n\nOh, now that’s quite the sign of embarrassment."

rows.original: “Apologies, [pc.name] - talking to oneself is not a solely organic habit. I suppose I will have to admit to sentiment.”
rows.translation: “抱歉，[pc.name] - 自言自语可不只是有机生命的习惯。我想我得承认自己有些感伤了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Apologies, [pc.name] - talking to oneself is not a solely organic habit. I suppose I will have to admit to sentiment.”"

rows.original: He pauses, taking a long breath that you know is only for - probably unintended - dramatic effect.
rows.translation: 他停顿下来，深深吸了一口气，你知道那只是为了 - 大概并非有意的 - 戏剧效果。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe pauses, taking a long breath that you know is only for - probably unintended - dramatic effect."

rows.original: “I miss my master - like a hole in my, and please excuse the turn of phrase, heart. But having you here? Being close to you? I think that it is at least going some of the way to patching it.”
rows.translation: “我想念我的主人 - 就像我的，请原谅这个说法，心里缺了一块。不过，有你在这里？和你亲近？我想这至少多少能把它补起来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I miss my master - like a hole in my, and please excuse the turn of phrase, heart. But having you here? Being close to you? I think that it is at least going some of the way to patching it.”"

rows.original: You don’t know what to say, and choose the more tactful approach of propping yourself up a little better, showing off that you’re paying attention.
rows.translation: 你不知道该说什么，便选择了更体贴的做法，稍稍撑起身体，表明你在认真听。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou don’t know what to say, and choose the more tactful approach of propping yourself up a little better, showing off that you’re paying attention."

rows.original: “Ah, to get to the point... [pc.name], I love Xinyi, my master... but I think that I love you too.”
rows.translation: “啊，直接说吧...[pc.name]，我爱欣怡，我的主人...不过我想，我也爱你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, to get to the point... [pc.name], I love Xinyi, my master... but I think that I love you too.”"

rows.original: Just as you’re about to respond, the two of you are interrupted by the sound of rustling, growing closer and closer, faster and faster, before whatever it is bursts through the treeline - a blur of blue spikes and white fangs.
rows.translation: 就在你准备回应时，一阵窸窣声打断了你们，越来越近，越来越快，随后不知什么东西冲出林线 - 化作一道蓝色尖刺与白色獠牙的残影。
rows.raw: "\n\nJust as you’re about to respond, the two of you are interrupted by the sound of rustling, growing closer and closer, faster and faster, before whatever it is bursts through the treeline - a blur of blue spikes and white fangs."

rows.original: Shit.
rows.translation: 妈的。
rows.raw: "\n\nShit."

rows.original: There’s no time to think, and unarmed as you are, no way to fight. You grab Yoma’s hand, tugging him to his feet and run. He barely has time to scoop up his belongings, but manage it he does, and the two of you are off.
rows.translation: 没有时间思考，而手无寸铁的你也无力战斗。你抓住尤玛的手，将他拽起来，转身就跑。他几乎没时间收拾东西，不过还是成功拿上了，你们俩就此狂奔。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s no time to think, and unarmed as you are, no way to fight. You grab Yoma’s hand, tugging him to his feet and run. He barely has time to scoop up his belongings, but manage it he does, and the two of you are off."

rows.original: You daren’t stop, not even to catch your breath - these things eat silicone, credits, anything. If they catch you, maybe you’ll be fine - but Yoma? Yoma won’t be.
rows.translation: 你不敢停下，哪怕只是喘口气 - 这些东西会吃硅胶、信用点，什么都吃。如果被它们抓到，也许你不会有事 - 可尤玛呢？尤玛会有事。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou daren’t stop, not even to catch your breath - these things eat silicone, credits, anything. If they catch you, maybe you’ll be fine - but Yoma? Yoma won’t be."

rows.original: You can’t have that. Even when he stumbles you don’t stop, just scooping him up and throwing him over your shoulder
rows.translation: 你不能让那种事发生。即使他绊倒，你也没有停下，只是将他一把抱起，扛到肩上
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t have that. Even when he stumbles you don’t stop, just scooping him up and throwing him over your shoulder"

joinAfter.expression:
pc.tallness <= 60
                                  ? ", not caring at all about how ridiculous you’ll look when you make it back to the townstead"
                                  : ""

rows.original: , not caring at all about how ridiculous you’ll look when you make it back to the townstead
rows.translation: ，完全不在乎回到镇上时自己看起来会有多滑稽
rows.raw: ", not caring at all about how ridiculous you’ll look when you make it back to the townstead"

rows.original: After what seems like an age, you collapse out of the fields, lungs burning and sweat dripping from every pore. You hear gunshots as
rows.translation: 仿佛过了一辈子，你终于冲出田野，瘫倒在地，肺部火烧火燎，汗水从每个毛孔滴落。枪声响起，
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter what seems like an age, you collapse out of the fields, lungs burning and sweat dripping from every pore. You hear gunshots as "

rows.original: Cameron
rows.translation: 卡梅伦
rows.raw: "Cameron"

rows.original: the farmhand
rows.translation: 农场工人
rows.raw: "the farmhand"

rows.original: takes potshots at the varmint chasing you, and the sigh of relief as it scarpers.
rows.translation: 朝追着你的害兽开枪，而等它逃窜时，你听见了一声如释重负的叹息。
rows.raw: " takes potshots at the varmint chasing you, and the sigh of relief as it scarpers."

rows.original: Yoma sits up before you, crying a desperately relieved thanks to anybody who will listen, before you stagger to your feet.
rows.translation: 尤玛在你面前坐起，向所有愿意听的人急切地喊着感谢，庆幸得几乎要哭出来，随后你才摇摇晃晃站起身。
rows.raw: "\n\nYoma sits up before you, crying a desperately relieved thanks to anybody who will listen, before you stagger to your feet."

rows.original: Stumbling back through customs and onto your ship seems to take eons, but the moment you’ve set a course back for Mhen’ga the almost deadly encounter begins to take its toll, and you can do nothing else but press a clumsy kiss to your android lover’s lips as he leads you back to your quarters.
rows.translation: 踉跄着经过海关、回到飞船上，似乎花了无穷久，不过等你设好返回门加的航线，那场险些致命的遭遇便开始显露影响。尤玛带你回舱室时，你只能笨拙地吻上这位仿生人恋人的嘴唇。
rows.raw: "\n\nStumbling back through customs and onto your ship seems to take eons, but the moment you’ve set a course back for Mhen’ga the almost deadly encounter begins to take its toll, and you can do nothing else but press a clumsy kiss to your android lover’s lips as he leads you back to your quarters."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: GothPastel
rows.raw: "GothPastel"

rows.original: Some time later, you’ve managed to calm down enough to actually start what you came here to do, Yoma’s signature bright green dice spinning the sunlight beautifully as he tumbles them out, before digging back through his pocket for something.
rows.translation: 过了一阵，你们总算平静到可以开始此行真正要做的事，尤玛将标志性的亮绿色骰子掷出，骰子旋转时美丽地折射着阳光，随后他又在口袋里翻找着什么。
rows.raw: "Some time later, you’ve managed to calm down enough to actually start what you came here to do, Yoma’s signature bright green dice spinning the sunlight beautifully as he tumbles them out, before digging back through his pocket for something."

rows.original: Just as you’re about to ask, Yoma’s hands clasp around yours, pressing something cool and metallic into them.
rows.translation: 就在你准备开口问时，尤玛的双手握住你的手，将某种冰凉的金属物件塞进掌心。
rows.raw: "\n\nJust as you’re about to ask, Yoma’s hands clasp around yours, pressing something cool and metallic into them."

rows.original: Oh wow.
rows.translation: 哦，哇哦。
rows.raw: "\n\nOh wow."

rows.original: These can’t have been cheap - silvery metal dice inlaid with softly pulsing [pc.eyeColor] numbers. Each one feels heavy, yet perfectly weighted in your hands, the corners sharp enough to get neat spins, but not to an extent that risks causing injury on being picked up by the edge.
rows.translation: 这些肯定不便宜 - 银色金属骰子上镶着[pc.eyeColor]的数字，正柔和地一明一暗。每一枚握在手里都沉甸甸的，但配重完美，棱角锋利得足以漂亮地旋转，却又不至于在捏着边缘拿起时有划伤的风险。
rows.raw: "\n\nThese can’t have been cheap - silvery metal dice inlaid with softly pulsing [pc.eyeColor] numbers. Each one feels heavy, yet perfectly weighted in your hands, the corners sharp enough to get neat spins, but not to an extent that risks causing injury on being picked up by the edge."

rows.original: “It was getting a little bit awkward, swapping my dice forward and back between the two of us, so I bought you your own set.”
rows.translation: “我们俩把我的骰子换来换去，已经有点不方便了，所以我给你买了一套自己的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It was getting a little bit awkward, swapping my dice forward and back between the two of us, so I bought you your own set.”"

rows.original: For a moment, his faux-fur seems to fluff up a little in apparent embarrassment.
rows.translation: 一时间，他的人造毛似乎蓬起了一点，显然有些不好意思。
rows.raw: "\n\nFor a moment, his faux-fur seems to fluff up a little in apparent embarrassment."

rows.original: “I hope you do not mind that I went a little overboard on the quality for an unsolicited gift, but you really have come to be a great source of comfort to me so far from home, and I wanted to repay some of that fact.”
rows.translation: “这是我自作主张送的礼物，希望你不会介意我在品质上有点用力过猛，不过离家这么远，你真的给了我很多慰藉，我想多少回报一些。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I hope you do not mind that I went a little overboard on the quality for an unsolicited gift, but you really have come to be a great source of comfort to me so far from home, and I wanted to repay some of that fact.”"

rows.original: You’re honestly not sure how to respond, but you thank him, giving his hands a reassuring squeeze.
rows.translation: 说实话，你不知道该怎么回应，不过你还是向他道谢，安抚地轻握他的双手。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re honestly not sure how to respond, but you thank him, giving his hands a reassuring squeeze."

rows.original: Soon enough, you’re settled down and playing. You can’t help but notice the gentle smile that never seems to leave the android’s face - far removed from the teeth baring grin you’ve grown accustomed to, but no less genuine. It’s obvious that he’s enjoying himself... Perhaps today is a good opportunity to get him talking about more personal matters?
rows.translation: 很快，你们便安顿下来开始游戏。你忍不住注意到，仿生人脸上似乎始终带着温柔的微笑 - 与你已经习惯的露齿大笑相去甚远，却同样真诚。显然他玩得很开心...也许今天正是让他谈谈更多私事的好机会？
rows.raw: "\n\nSoon enough, you’re settled down and playing. You can’t help but notice the gentle smile that never seems to leave the android’s face - far removed from the teeth baring grin you’ve grown accustomed to, but no less genuine. It’s obvious that he’s enjoying himself... Perhaps today is a good opportunity to get him talking about more personal matters?"

rows.original: (Key Item Gained: Personalized Dice Set)
rows.translation: （获得关键物品：定制骰子套装）
rows.raw: "\n\n(Key Item Gained: Personalized Dice Set)"

rows.original: Personalised Dice Set
rows.raw: "Personalised Dice Set"

rows.original: A gift from Yoma - they’re metal, with
rows.translation: 尤玛送的礼物 - 金属骰子，上面有
rows.raw: "A gift from Yoma - they’re metal, with "

rows.original: numbers.
rows.translation: 数字。
rows.raw: " numbers."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: GothPastel
rows.raw: "GothPastel"

rows.original: It’s sunny as ever on New Texas, and you blink owlishly at the sudden change of lighting as you step outside, Yoma laughing softly and waiting for you to adjust before taking one of your hands in his.
rows.translation: 新德克萨斯还是一如既往地阳光灿烂，你走到外面，面对骤然变化的光线，像猫头鹰一样眨着眼。尤玛轻笑着，等你适应后才牵起你的一只手。
rows.raw: "It’s sunny as ever on New Texas, and you blink owlishly at the sudden change of lighting as you step outside, Yoma laughing softly and waiting for you to adjust before taking one of your hands in his."

rows.original: “Come on, [pc.name], I want to see the fields - they still employ older agricultural methods here.” You’re not entirely sure why he’s so fascinated, but go along with it anyway, letting him pull you away from the main settlement, and out into the fields of New Texas.
rows.translation: “来吧，[pc.name]，我想看看农田 - 这里仍在使用比较古老的农业方法。”你不太确定他为什么如此着迷，不过还是顺着他，任他拉着你离开主要聚居区，走进新德克萨斯的田野。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Come on, [pc.name], I want to see the fields - they still employ older agricultural methods here.” You’re not entirely sure why he’s so fascinated, but go along with it anyway, letting him pull you away from the main settlement, and out into the fields of New Texas. "

rows.original: Soon, you both find yourselves weaving your way through orchards and fields, growing a multitude of crops in a multitude of sizes, until Yoma eventually settles at the border between an orchard that seems to be growing something akin to pomegranates
rows.translation: 很快，你们便穿行在果园和田地之间，里面种着种类繁多、大小各异的作物，最终尤玛在一片果园与麦田的交界处停下，果园里似乎种着某种类似石榴的东西
rows.raw: "\n\nSoon, you both find yourselves weaving your way through orchards and fields, growing a multitude of crops in a multitude of sizes, until Yoma eventually settles at the border between an orchard that seems to be growing something akin to pomegranates"

joinAfter.expression:
flags.PC_UPBRINGING === GLOBAL.UPBRINGING_BOOKWORM
                              ? ", though you know from your more eclectic range of studies that the trees tower much too tall to be quite natural,"
                              : ""

rows.original: , though you know from your more eclectic range of studies that the trees tower much too tall to be quite natural,
rows.translation: ，不过凭借你涉猎广泛的学识，你知道那些树高得过头，不可能如此自然生长，
rows.raw: ", though you know from your more eclectic range of studies that the trees tower much too tall to be quite natural,"

rows.original: and a field of freshly threshed wheat.
rows.translation: 而旁边是刚刚脱粒过的麦田。
rows.raw: " and a field of freshly threshed wheat."

rows.original: It’s pleasantly shaded where you sit down, but far brighter than the jungle you’re normally situated in together, allowing you both to see each other much more clearly in the natural light. With all of this, it’s possible to admire just how remarkable Yoma’s craftsmanship is...
rows.translation: 你们坐下的地方有宜人的树荫，却比平常一起待的丛林明亮得多，让你们在自然光下都能更清楚地看见彼此。在这样的条件下，你终于能欣赏尤玛的制造工艺是多么出色...
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s pleasantly shaded where you sit down, but far brighter than the jungle you’re normally situated in together, allowing you both to see each other much more clearly in the natural light. With all of this, it’s possible to admire just how remarkable Yoma’s craftsmanship is..."

rows.original: Huh. You don’t actually know what company made him, and absently, you pose the question.
rows.translation: 哈。你其实不知道是哪家公司制造了他，于是随口问了出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nHuh. You don’t actually know what company made him, and absently, you pose the question."

rows.original: “Now, do not laugh,” he starts, and you give him a curious look. “...And do not give me that look, either.” Okay, okay, you’ll stop.
rows.translation: “先说好，不许笑，”他开口道，你好奇地看了他一眼。“...也不许用那种眼神看我。”好吧，好吧，你不看了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now, do not laugh,” he starts, and you give him a curious look. “...And do not give me that look, either.” Okay, okay, you’ll stop."

rows.original: “KihaCorp. In semi-partnership with JoyCo at first, just for the medical angle, but KihaCorp broke that off to spearhead their own medical programme. Not that you would be able to tell they have one - it has not really taken off at all. But that is beside the point.”
rows.translation: “基哈公司。起初和欢乐公司有些合作，只是为了医疗方面，不过基哈公司后来终止合作，转而主导自己的医疗项目。倒不是说你能看出来他们有这种项目 - 它根本没发展起来。不过这不是重点。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“KihaCorp. In semi-partnership with JoyCo at first, just for the medical angle, but KihaCorp broke that off to spearhead their own medical programme. Not that you would be able to tell they have one - it has not really taken off at all. But that is beside the point.”"

rows.original: Well then. He’s certainly not quite what you’d expect from a KihaCorp model - certainly, he’s not one of there ‘Tsundere’ styled lines - though then again, the occasional stubbornness you’ve noticed over small things does fit.
rows.translation: 好吧。他确实和你想象中的基哈公司型号不太一样 - 肯定不是他们那种‘傲娇’风格的产品线 - 不过话说回来，你注意到他偶尔会在小事上固执，这倒挺符合。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell then. He’s certainly not quite what you’d expect from a KihaCorp model - certainly, he’s not one of there ‘Tsundere’ styled lines - though then again, the occasional stubbornness you’ve noticed over small things does fit."

rows.original: ...You can’t help but imagine a situation with him acting like said line though, you’ve seen enough holovids.
rows.translation: ...不过你还是忍不住想象他像那条产品线一样行事的情景，你看的全息影片已经够多了。
rows.raw: "\n\n...You can’t help but imagine a situation with him acting like said line though, you’ve seen enough holovids."

rows.original: “I told you not to laugh!”
rows.translation: “我说了不许笑！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I told you not to laugh!”"

rows.original: Oh Void, he even looks flustered enough, and your laughter doubles, causing him to let out an undignified squawk - and that just creates a vicious cycle.
rows.translation: 哦，虚空啊，他看起来甚至都足够慌乱，你笑得更厉害了，惹得他发出一声有失体面的怪叫 - 这就形成了恶性循环。
rows.raw: "\n\nOh Void, he even looks flustered enough, and your laughter doubles, causing him to let out an undignified squawk - and that just creates a vicious cycle."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Customs
rows.translation: 海关
rows.raw: "Customs"

rows.original: GothPastel
rows.raw: "GothPastel"

rows.original: Customs is a slightly longer affair than you’re used to, as Yoma seems to have some trouble with the no weapons policy.
rows.translation: 过海关比你习惯的稍微久了些，因为尤玛似乎在禁武规定上遇到了些麻烦。
rows.raw: "Customs is a slightly longer affair than you’re used to, as Yoma seems to have some trouble with the no weapons policy."

rows.original: Just as you’re wandering over to see if you can help, he flexes his wrists in a strange and frankly uncomfortable looking way. There’s a quiet shnik, and you watch as a second set of nails - wicked sharp and dark metal - slip out over his current ones.
rows.translation: 就在你走过去想看看能否帮忙时，他以一种古怪且说实话看着不太舒服的方式活动手腕。轻轻一声铮，你看见第二套指甲 - 锋利得吓人，呈深色金属质地 - 从他原本的指甲上方滑了出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nJust as you’re wandering over to see if you can help, he flexes his wrists in a strange and frankly uncomfortable looking way. There’s a quiet shnik, and you watch as a second set of nails - wicked sharp and dark metal - slip out over his current ones."

rows.original: For a moment, you nearly panic, before Yoma pushes hard just behind each claw, popping them out one by one, much to the border agent he’s dealing with’s evident approval. You have little time to more than quirk a questioning eyebrow at him before he speaks.
rows.translation: 一时间，你几乎慌了，不过尤玛用力按在每根爪子后方，将它们逐一弹出，那位接待他的边检人员显然对此很满意。你刚来得及朝他疑惑地挑挑眉，他便开口了。
rows.raw: "\n\nFor a moment, you nearly panic, before Yoma pushes hard just behind each claw, popping them out one by one, much to the border agent he’s dealing with’s evident approval. You have little time to more than quirk a questioning eyebrow at him before he speaks."

rows.original: <i>“I am not a combat model, but
rows.translation: <i>“我不是战斗型号，不过
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“I am not a combat model, but "

joinAfter.expression:
isSillyModeEnabled()
                            ? "it is dangerous to go alone"
                            : "it would be foolish to go about unprotected"

rows.original: it is dangerous to go alone
rows.translation: 独自行动很危险

rows.translation: 你格外小心地确认加热腰带正输出足够的能量，让自己暖烘烘的，而且没有任何一寸裸露肌肤留在力场范围之外，随后你
rows.raw: " Once you’re done taking extra care to make sure that your heat belt is pushing out enough energy to keep you positively toasty and not a single inch of your bare flesh is left exposed and out of its field, y"

rows.translation: 走下飞船
rows.raw: "ou step down from your ship"

rows.original: , barely noticing Yoma’s offered hand.
rows.translation: ，几乎没注意到尤玛伸出的手。
rows.raw: ", barely noticing Yoma’s offered hand."

rows.original: , graciously
rows.translation: ，优雅地
rows.raw: ", graciously"

rows.original: taking Yoma’s extended hand to help steady the descent.
rows.translation: 握住尤玛伸出的手，帮助自己稳稳走下去。
rows.raw: " taking Yoma’s extended hand to help steady the descent."

rows.original: The android himself still looks slightly ridiculous, bundled up as he is, but you’re certainly not worried about him freezing over - so you suppose it’s a small sacrifice. It certainly doesn’t impede his movement like you thought it would either, as he’s soon tugging you towards the space elevator that you can see towards the other end of the low orbit station.
rows.translation: 仿生人自己裹得严严实实，看起来还是有点滑稽，不过你肯定不担心他会冻僵 - 所以你想，这点牺牲不算什么。而且这套衣服显然也没有像你以为的那样妨碍行动，因为他很快便拉着你走向太空电梯，你能看见它就在这座低轨空间站的另一头。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe android himself still looks slightly ridiculous, bundled up as he is, but you’re certainly not worried about him freezing over - so you suppose it’s a small sacrifice. It certainly doesn’t impede his movement like you thought it would either, as he’s soon tugging you towards the space elevator that you can see towards the other end of the low orbit station."

rows.original: The two of you manage to squirrel yourself away into a corner of the thing, Yoma hopping up onto one of many RhenWorld branded boxes, and you join him. Your android companion leans into you, letting out a pleased noise as you wrap one arm around his waist whilst the other reaches for your codex, giving the weather a quick check.
rows.translation: 你们俩设法溜到电梯的一处角落，尤玛跳上一只箱子，这里有许多印着雷恩世界标志的箱子，你也坐到他旁边。仿生人伴侣靠着你，你一只手臂搂住他的腰，另一只手拿出CODEX终端，快速查看天气，他发出一声满足的轻哼。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of you manage to squirrel yourself away into a corner of the thing, Yoma hopping up onto one of many RhenWorld branded boxes, and you join him. Your android companion leans into you, letting out a pleased noise as you wrap one arm around his waist whilst the other reaches for your codex, giving the weather a quick check."

rows.original: Yep, you’ll be fine for a good few hours yet, there’ll be no need to find somewhere to camp out in Irestead when you get down there... In about forty five minutes. As you’re trying to think of something simple to chat about on the way down, you’re cut off.
rows.translation: 没错，接下来好几个小时都没问题，到了地面后，你们无需在伊尔斯泰德找地方扎营...大约还要四十五分钟。你正试着想个简单的话题，供下降途中闲聊，却被打断了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYep, you’ll be fine for a good few hours yet, there’ll be no need to find somewhere to camp out in Irestead when you get down there... In about forty five minutes. As you’re trying to think of something simple to chat about on the way down, you’re cut off."

rows.original: “You know, [pc.name], we are going to be here for a while. How about some fun while we wait?” It doesn’t take a genius to figure out what he means, but
rows.translation: “你知道，[pc.name]，我们得在这里待上一阵。等着的时候，找点乐子怎么样？”不需要天才也能明白他的意思，不过
rows.raw: "\n\n“You know, [pc.name], we are going to be here for a while. How about some fun while we wait?” It doesn’t take a genius to figure out what he means, but"

rows.raw: "... Okay, you forgot what your objection was going to be with how hot the idea is."

rows.original: isn’t he worried about getting caught? You’re sure as hell past the point of caring, but is he?
rows.translation: 他不担心被抓到吗？你肯定早就不在乎了，不过他也一样吗？
rows.raw: " isn’t he worried about getting caught? You’re sure as hell past the point of caring, but is he?"

rows.original: ... wow ! The idea of having sex just out of view of who knows how many people really is kinda hot - but isn’t he worried about getting caught?
rows.translation: ...哇哦！躲在不知多少人的视线之外做爱，这主意确实挺火辣 - 不过他不担心被抓到吗？
rows.raw: "... wow ! The idea of having sex just out of view of who knows how many people really is kinda hot - but isn’t he worried about getting caught?"

rows.original: void! There are people here - you might be out of plain view, but so public? Really?

rows.raw: " void! There are people here - you might be out of plain view, but so public? Really?"

rows.original: “Do not worry, I checked for cameras on the way in. I just need you to keep it down. Are you up for it?” he asks,
rows.translation: “别担心，我进来时检查过摄像头了。只要你小声点就行。你愿意吗？”他问道，
rows.raw: "\n\n“Do not worry, I checked for cameras on the way in. I just need you to keep it down. Are you up for it?” he asks, "

rows.translation: 让你因为视频大概不会传到外网上而有点失望。
rows.raw: "disappointing you a little with the fact that videos probably won’t end up on the extranet."

rows.translation: 打消了你对视频可能传到外网上的任何担忧。
rows.raw: "quelling any fears you might have had of videos ending up on the extranet."

rows.raw: "GothPastel"

rows.original: Properly equipped and ready to go, you find yourself taking the android’s unoccupied hand and leading him out of and away from the bar. He laughs, picking up the pace so he can walk alongside you,
rows.translation: 装备妥当、准备出发后，你握住仿生人空闲的那只手，带着他走出并远离酒吧。他笑起来，加快步伐，好与你并肩而行，
rows.raw: "Properly equipped and ready to go, you find yourself taking the android’s unoccupied hand and leading him out of and away from the bar. He laughs, picking up the pace so he can walk alongside you, "

rows.original: pulling you close enough for you to lean into his chest
rows.translation: 把你拉近，让你能靠着他的胸膛
rows.raw: "pulling you close enough for you to lean into his chest"

rows.original: leaning his head on your shoulder
rows.translation: 将头靠在你的肩上
rows.raw: "leaning his head on your shoulder"

rows.original: leaning into your chest
rows.translation: 依偎着你的胸膛
rows.raw: "leaning into your chest"

rows.translation: 一路走着。
rows.raw: " as you go."

rows.original: It’s an easy, comfortable walk to your ship, spent in companionable silence, and Yoma vanishes off into your quarters to change as you set a course for Uveto.
rows.translation: 你们在友好的沉默中轻松舒适地走回飞船，你设定前往乌维托的航线时，尤玛便消失在你的舱室里，去换衣服了。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s an easy, comfortable walk to your ship, spent in companionable silence, and Yoma vanishes off into your quarters to change as you set a course for Uveto."

rows.original: A few minutes later, he emerges back into the cockpit, and you can’t muffle a laugh when you see him - decked out in a currently unbuttoned thick, red, padded coat that extends down to his knees and long, sole-studded snow boots, both lined with white synthetic fur.
rows.translation: 几分钟后，他回到驾驶舱，你看见他便忍不住笑了 - 他穿着一件厚厚的红色夹棉大衣，长及膝盖，现在还没扣上，脚上是鞋底带钉的长筒雪靴，两者都衬着白色人造毛。
rows.raw: "\n\nA few minutes later, he emerges back into the cockpit, and you can’t muffle a laugh when you see him - decked out in a currently unbuttoned thick, red, padded coat that extends down to his knees and long, sole-studded snow boots, both lined with white synthetic fur."

joinAfter.expression: pc.isBimbo() ? "“Aren’t you gonna get too warm?”" : "“Are you sure you won’t overheat in all that? I don’t want to have to carry you again.”"

rows.original: “Aren’t you gonna get too warm?”
rows.translation: “你不会太热吗？”

rows.translation: “你确定穿这么多不会过热？我可不想再扛你一次。”
rows.raw: "“Are you sure you won’t overheat in all that? I don’t want to have to carry you again.”"

rows.raw: ", a look of concern plastered across your face"

rows.original: . He laughs, walking across the room to sit with you, letting the coat drape off his shoulders a little to reveal the ribbed black turtleneck underneath it.
rows.translation: 。他笑着穿过房间，坐到你身边，让大衣从肩上稍稍滑下，露出里面黑色的罗纹高领衫。
rows.raw: ". He laughs, walking across the room to sit with you, letting the coat drape off his shoulders a little to reveal the ribbed black turtleneck underneath it."

rows.original: “No such luck, [pc.name], you will not get rid of me that easily. I cool off just fine, the fennec ears are not for a simple show, but the last thing I am sure either of us want is my joints freezing solid!” There’s no stopping your next snort of laughter, imagining a frozen Yoma-sicle left out there on the tundra.
rows.translation: “没那么走运，[pc.name]，你可没那么容易甩掉我。我散热很好，耳廓狐耳朵又不只是摆设，不过我确信我们谁都不想让我的关节冻得结结实实！”你想象着一根冻成冰棍的尤玛被留在苔原上，忍不住又嗤笑出声。
rows.raw: "\n\n“No such luck, [pc.name], you will not get rid of me that easily. I cool off just fine, the fennec ears are not for a simple show, but the last thing I am sure either of us want is my joints freezing solid!” There’s no stopping your next snort of laughter, imagining a frozen Yoma-sicle left out there on the tundra."

rows.original: “Now then! I will have you know I would use the very last of my processing power to send an email direct to your codex. A very, very angry email,” he huffs, but his tail swishes in amusement all the same.
rows.translation: “听好了！我得让你知道，我会用最后一点运算能力，直接给你的CODEX终端发邮件。一封非常、非常愤怒的邮件，”他哼道，不过尾巴还是愉快地摇摆着。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now then! I will have you know I would use the very last of my processing power to send an email direct to your codex. A very, very angry email,” he huffs, but his tail swishes in amusement all the same."

rows.original: The horror! Can he really do that, though?
rows.translation: 太可怕了！不过，他真的能做到吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nThe horror! Can he really do that, though?"

rows.original: “Of course, watch.” He pauses for a moment, before his eyes flash a slightly brighter green, and your codex pops up with an email alert...
rows.translation: “当然，看着。”他停顿片刻，眼中随后闪过稍亮一些的绿光，你的CODEX终端便弹出邮件提醒...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course, watch.” He pauses for a moment, before his eyes flash a slightly brighter green, and your codex pops up with an email alert..."

rows.original: Lo and behold, you’ve received an email from one ‘Yoma.Jin@JinSystems.ltd’, including absolutely no subject line
rows.translation: 瞧瞧，你收到了一封来自‘Yoma.Jin@JinSystems.ltd’的邮件，完全没有主题行
rows.raw: "\n\nLo and behold, you’ve received an email from one ‘Yoma.Jin@JinSystems.ltd’, including absolutely no subject line"

rows.raw: " to your disgust"

rows.raw: ", and a main body consisting of a few "

rows.translation: 各种沙漠狐狸的。gif动图。你笑着朝他翻了个白眼，将邮件存进某处归档，随后提出一个简单的问题。“金？”
rows.raw: ".gif files of various desert foxes. You laugh, rolling your eyes at him and stashing it in an archive somewhere, before posing a simple question. “Jin?”"

rows.original: Yoma’s ears twitch and you just about recognize a flush on his features. “Master Xinyi’s surname... He suggested I use it for my, um, email address as the system did not like it being left blank.”
rows.translation: 尤玛的耳朵抖了抖，你几乎能辨认出他脸上的红晕。“欣怡主人的姓...他建议我把它用在我的，嗯，电子邮箱地址里，因为系统不接受空白。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYoma’s ears twitch and you just about recognize a flush on his features. “Master Xinyi’s surname... He suggested I use it for my, um, email address as the system did not like it being left blank.”"

rows.original: The next bit is muffled as he tugs his coat back up, subconsciously burying his face into it.
rows.translation: 接下来的话有些含糊，因为他将大衣重新拉好，下意识地把脸埋了进去。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe next bit is muffled as he tugs his coat back up, subconsciously burying his face into it."

rows.original: “I use it for paperwork too... It feels nice.”
rows.translation: “我填文件也用这个姓...感觉很好。”
