rows.original: The rest of your journey back to Mhen’ga is uninterrupted - mostly, that is - as Yoma slinks into the cockpit with you the moment he’s finished cleaning up, watching you handle the controls with your usual ease
rows.translation: 返回门加的剩余航程没受打扰 - 至少大部分如此 - 因为尤玛刚清理完，就溜进驾驶舱陪你，看你像平常一样轻松操作控制器
rows.raw: "The rest of your journey back to Mhen’ga is uninterrupted - mostly, that is - as Yoma slinks into the cockpit with you the moment he’s finished cleaning up, watching you handle the controls with your usual ease"

rows.original: rather impressed, as he makes a point of noting, that you remain unbothered by the somewhat antiquated controls.
rows.translation: 他特意指出，你对这些有些过时的控制器毫不介意，让他相当佩服。
rows.raw: " rather impressed, as he makes a point of noting, that you remain unbothered by the somewhat antiquated controls."

rows.original: There aren’t any distractions other than that, and you’re soon touching down. You walk your android companion as far as the bar before the two of you say your goodbyes.
rows.translation: 除此之外，再没什么分心的事，你们很快便着陆。你送仿生人伴侣一直走到酒吧前，随后互道再见。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere aren’t any distractions other than that, and you’re soon touching down. You walk your android companion as far as the bar before the two of you say your goodbyes."

rows.original: Yoma gets a few metres away from you before he spins back, running back up to you and stumbling a little over his feet - though you catch him before he trips over.
rows.translation: 尤玛离开几米后，突然转身跑回来，脚下踉跄了一下 - 不过你在他摔倒前扶住了他。
rows.raw: "\n\nYoma gets a few metres away from you before he spins back, running back up to you and stumbling a little over his feet - though you catch him before he trips over."

rows.original: “Sorry, sorry - I almost forgot! I had an absolutely lovely night, [pc.name], and I would certainly not object to a similar event in the future,” he says, trademark beam back on his face once he’s recovered from nearly tripping.
rows.translation: “抱歉，抱歉 - 我差点忘了！今晚真是美妙极了，[pc.name]，以后如果还有类似的活动，我绝对不会反对，”他说，等从险些绊倒中恢复过来，脸上又露出了标志性的灿烂笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry, sorry - I almost forgot! I had an absolutely lovely night, [pc.name], and I would certainly not object to a similar event in the future,” he says, trademark beam back on his face once he’s recovered from nearly tripping."

rows.original: You’re about to respond in turn when you’re cut off, Yoma
rows.translation: 你正要回应，却被打断了，尤玛
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re about to respond in turn when you’re cut off, Yoma "

rows.original: You spend a moment just looking at the zil, taking in her pregnant form. She’s got a modest baby bump at the moment, definitely noticeable, but she can’t be too far along. Her breasts seem to strain against the chitin plates covering them, looking a bit cramped. While the zil seems able to comfortably keep her breasts covered for now, you have to wonder if that will hold true as her breasts continue to grow...
rows.translation: 你花了片刻打量兹尔，欣赏她怀孕的身体。她现在的孕肚还不算大，肯定能看出来，但孕期应该还不太长。双乳似乎挤压着覆盖它们的甲片，显得有些局促。虽然兹尔目前似乎还能舒适地遮住乳房，你却不禁怀疑，随着乳房继续增大，是否还能如此...
rows.raw: "You spend a moment just looking at the zil, taking in her pregnant form. She’s got a modest baby bump at the moment, definitely noticeable, but she can’t be too far along. Her breasts seem to strain against the chitin plates covering them, looking a bit cramped. While the zil seems able to comfortably keep her breasts covered for now, you have to wonder if that will hold true as her breasts continue to grow..."

rows.original: You spend a moment just looking at the zil, taking in her pregnant form. Her stomach is looking quite gravid, and the smooth chitin plates around her abs and waist that normally fit snugly together are separated by large patches of bare yellow skin, having been forced apart to make room for her growing young. She seems instinctively defensive of her pregnant belly, rarely allowing one of her hands to not be in constant contact with it.
rows.translation: 你花了片刻打量兹尔，欣赏她怀孕的身体。腹部已经明显隆起，平常紧密贴合腹肌与腰部的光滑甲片之间，露出了大片黄色肌肤；它们被撑开，为成长中的幼儿腾出空间。她似乎本能地保护着孕肚，几乎时刻都有一只手贴在上面。
rows.raw: "You spend a moment just looking at the zil, taking in her pregnant form. Her stomach is looking quite gravid, and the smooth chitin plates around her abs and waist that normally fit snugly together are separated by large patches of bare yellow skin, having been forced apart to make room for her growing young. She seems instinctively defensive of her pregnant belly, rarely allowing one of her hands to not be in constant contact with it."

rows.original: Her breasts, too, are noticeably bigger, with the most obvious indication being that the zil seems unable to cover them with her natural armor. They have grown to the point where she is forced to expose them constantly, but you’re hardly complaining about the view. Drops of golden honey regularly slip from her puffy black nipples, a clear sign that she’s lactating heavily.
rows.translation: 她的乳房也明显变大，最显著的迹象就是，兹尔似乎已无法用天然护甲遮住它们。它们长得如此之大，迫使她始终袒露双乳，不过你对这景色当然毫无怨言。金色蜂蜜不断从肿胀的黑色乳头滴落，清楚表明她的泌乳量很大。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer breasts, too, are noticeably bigger, with the most obvious indication being that the zil seems unable to cover them with her natural armor. They have grown to the point where she is forced to expose them constantly, but you’re hardly complaining about the view. Drops of golden honey regularly slip from her puffy black nipples, a clear sign that she’s lactating heavily."

rows.original: You spend a moment just looking at the zil, taking in her pregnant form. She has reached the point in her pregnancy where her belly has grown so large that it’s truly impressive she manages walk around and function relatively normally. The zil is very, very pregnant, and her hands almost seem glued to the sides of her enormously gravid stomach, rubbing it gently, if not a bit anxiously. She is surely bound to give birth very soon.
rows.translation: 你花了片刻打量兹尔，欣赏她怀孕的身体。孕期已发展到肚子大得惊人的阶段，她居然还能走动、较正常地活动，实在令人佩服。兹尔的孕相非常、非常明显，双手几乎像粘在硕大的孕肚两侧，轻轻抚摸，多少带着些焦虑。她肯定很快就要生了。
rows.raw: "You spend a moment just looking at the zil, taking in her pregnant form. She has reached the point in her pregnancy where her belly has grown so large that it’s truly impressive she manages walk around and function relatively normally. The zil is very, very pregnant, and her hands almost seem glued to the sides of her enormously gravid stomach, rubbing it gently, if not a bit anxiously. She is surely bound to give birth very soon."

rows.original: Like her stomach, her breasts have grown significantly as well, clearly much larger than they were before. The zil has no hope of covering them with her chitinous armor in their current state, and has obviously given up trying. They leak honey incessantly, and large drops of sweet golden nectar fall to the ground even when the expectant mother does little more than shift her weight from one foot to the other.
rows.translation: 如同肚子，她的乳房也显著增大，分明比以前大得多。以如今的大小，兹尔根本不可能用甲壳护甲遮住，显然已经放弃尝试。蜂蜜不停渗出，即使这位准妈妈只是把重心从一只脚换到另一只脚，大滴香甜的金色蜜汁也会落向地面。
rows.raw: "\n\nLike her stomach, her breasts have grown significantly as well, clearly much larger than they were before. The zil has no hope of covering them with her chitinous armor in their current state, and has obviously given up trying. They leak honey incessantly, and large drops of sweet golden nectar fall to the ground even when the expectant mother does little more than shift her weight from one foot to the other."

rows.original: The zil tilts her head in confusion at your perceived inaction, then notices how intently you’re checking her out. She smiles and cocks her hips seductively, playfully running her hands along her body like some kind of pregnant alien pin-up model. You have to admit, it’s pretty hot.
rows.translation: 兹尔困惑地歪头，不明白你为何无所行动，随后注意到你正专心打量她。她笑着撩人地侧起臀胯，双手调皮地沿身体游走，仿佛某种怀孕的外星海报女郎。你不得不承认，确实很性感。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zil tilts her head in confusion at your perceived inaction, then notices how intently you’re checking her out. She smiles and cocks her hips seductively, playfully running her hands along her body like some kind of pregnant alien pin-up model. You have to admit, it’s pretty hot."

rows.original: The zil smiles. “So, did you have anything else in mind?”
rows.translation: 兹尔微笑。“那么，你还想做些什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zil smiles. “So, did you have anything else in mind?”"

rows.original: You take a moment to pull yourself together, saying that you just want to talk to her for now.
rows.translation: 你花了片刻收拾心情，说暂时只想和她聊聊。
rows.raw: "You take a moment to pull yourself together, saying that you just want to talk to her for now."

rows.original: “You want to... talk?” she asks, “Just talk? Not what I expected, but intriguing all the same. What do you want to talk about?”
rows.translation: “你想...聊天？”她问，“只是聊天？虽然出乎意料，但同样让人好奇。你想聊什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You want to... talk?” she asks, “Just talk? Not what I expected, but intriguing all the same. What do you want to talk about?”"

rows.translation: 安全
rows.raw: "Safety"

rows.original: MistyBirb
rows.raw: "MistyBirb"

rows.original: You cross your arms and purse your lips, asking the zil why she’s wandering around the jungle while pregnant.
rows.translation: 你交叉双臂，抿起嘴唇，问兹尔为何怀着孕还在丛林里四处走动。
rows.raw: "You cross your arms and purse your lips, asking the zil why she’s wandering around the jungle while pregnant."

rows.original: She looks a bit indignant at your question, and narrows her eyes. “I am still capable of supporting my village and my fellow zil. Just because I’m pregnant doesn’t mean there are fewer mouths to feed. Quite the opposite, really. Foraging is not a strenuous task, and this is zil territory. I am as safe here as I am in my village.”
rows.translation: 她对你的问题显得有些愤愤不平，眯起双眼。“我依然能养活村庄和其他兹尔。怀孕不代表要吃饭的嘴变少了。恰恰相反。采集不是繁重的活，而且这里是兹尔的领地。我在这里和在村庄里一样安全。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe looks a bit indignant at your question, and narrows her eyes. “I am still capable of supporting my village and my fellow zil. Just because I’m pregnant doesn’t mean there are fewer mouths to feed. Quite the opposite, really. Foraging is not a strenuous task, and this is zil territory. I am as safe here as I am in my village.”"

rows.original: You don’t answer her directly, but the skeptical look on your face is apparently more than enough to prompt the zil to keep going.
rows.translation: 你没有直接回答，但脸上怀疑的神色显然已足以促使兹尔继续解释。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou don’t answer her directly, but the skeptical look on your face is apparently more than enough to prompt the zil to keep going."

rows.original: “You don’t understand, you’re an offworlder. I was born and raised here. This is my home, and I know how to avoid danger. A zil does not live long enough to have children in the first place if they do not learn such things.”
rows.translation: “你不明白，你是外星人。我在这里出生长大。这里是我的家，我知道如何避开危险。兹尔要是不懂这些，根本活不到生孩子的时候。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You don’t understand, you’re an offworlder. I was born and raised here. This is my home, and I know how to avoid danger. A zil does not live long enough to have children in the first place if they do not learn such things.”"

rows.original: The alien speaks with a prideful ferocity, and you raise a hand to calm her down. You apologize, telling her that you did not intend to upset her, only to make sure she was alright.
rows.translation: 外星女人说话时带着骄傲的狠劲，你抬手让她冷静下来。你道歉，告诉她自己并非想惹她生气，只想确认她安好。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe alien speaks with a prideful ferocity, and you raise a hand to calm her down. You apologize, telling her that you did not intend to upset her, only to make sure she was alright."

rows.original: The zil relaxes her stance, then smiles sheepishly. “Your concern, while unnecessary, is still touching. Thank you. You offworlders are more compassionate than I expected.”
rows.translation: 兹尔放松姿势，随后腼腆地笑了。“你的关心虽然没必要，还是很感人。谢谢。你们外星人比我想象中更有同情心。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zil relaxes her stance, then smiles sheepishly. “Your concern, while unnecessary, is still touching. Thank you. You offworlders are more compassionate than I expected.”"

rows.translation: 气味
rows.raw: "Scent"

rows.original: MistyBirb
rows.raw: "MistyBirb"

rows.original: You inhale deeply through your nose, getting such a concentrated hit of pheromones that you actually feel a bit dizzy. Shaking your head, you ask the zil about her powerful scent, and why it seems so much stronger and more attractive than before.
rows.translation: 你用鼻子深深吸气，吸入的信息素浓度如此之高，竟感到有点眩晕。你摇摇头，询问兹尔这强烈的气味，以及为何它似乎比以前更浓、更诱人。
rows.raw: "You inhale deeply through your nose, getting such a concentrated hit of pheromones that you actually feel a bit dizzy. Shaking your head, you ask the zil about her powerful scent, and why it seems so much stronger and more attractive than before."

rows.original: The alien woman chuckles. “Because you are my mate. My scent has taken on some of your traits, tuned itself to your senses, because it is your children that grow inside me. You have marked me in a way that only a virile mate can, and what you’re experiencing is an extension of that.”
rows.translation: 外星女人轻笑。“因为你是我的伴侣。我的气味带上了你的部分特征，调整得契合你的感官，因为体内成长着你的孩子。你以只有强健伴侣才能做到的方式在我身上留下印记，你的感受正是它的延伸。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe alien woman chuckles. “Because you are my mate. My scent has taken on some of your traits, tuned itself to your senses, because it is your children that grow inside me. You have marked me in a way that only a virile mate can, and what you’re experiencing is an extension of that.”"

rows.original: “To be perfectly honest,” she adds, “I am affected by your scent as well, though yours is not nearly as strong as the pheromones of a pure-blooded zil. Still, I know you are my mate from scent alone, and it is...” She pauses and shuts her eyes for a moment, her antennae twitching. “Arousing, to say the least.” The zil slides her hands along her hips, eyeing you seductively. “Perhaps we could explore these sensations together, hmm?”
rows.translation: “说实话，”她补充道，“我也会受到你气味的影响，尽管你的气味远没有纯血兹尔的信息素浓烈。不过，光凭气味，我就知道你是我的伴侣，而且那种感觉...”她停顿片刻，闭上眼，触角微微颤动。“至少可以说，很令人兴奋。”兹尔双手沿着臀胯滑动，诱惑地看着你。“也许我们可以一起探索这些感觉，嗯？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“To be perfectly honest,” she adds, “I am affected by your scent as well, though yours is not nearly as strong as the pheromones of a pure-blooded zil. Still, I know you are my mate from scent alone, and it is...” She pauses and shuts her eyes for a moment, her antennae twitching. “Arousing, to say the least.” The zil slides her hands along her hips, eyeing you seductively. “Perhaps we could explore these sensations together, hmm?”"

rows.original: You grin. That doesn’t sound like a bad idea.
rows.translation: 你咧嘴笑了。听起来倒是个好主意。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou grin. That doesn’t sound like a bad idea."

rows.original: Birth
rows.translation: 分娩
rows.raw: "Birth"

rows.original: MistyBirb
rows.raw: "MistyBirb"

rows.original: You ask her how far along she is, and if she expects the children to arrive anytime soon.
rows.translation: 你问她怀孕多久了，是否觉得孩子很快就会出生。
rows.raw: "You ask her how far along she is, and if she expects the children to arrive anytime soon."

rows.original: “No, not for quite some time,” she replies, idly rubbing her belly, “Several months more, at least, but there is a chance that the union of our two species may result in a pregnancy that progresses differently than I expect. I feel all is going well, though. My instincts say that everything will be just fine.” She says that last sentence with a warm smile on her face, looking down at her baby bump with motherly pride.
rows.translation: “不，还早呢，”她回答，漫不经心地揉着肚子，“至少还要几个月，不过，我们两个物种结合，也可能让孕期的进展与预想不同。但我感觉一切顺利。本能告诉我，一切都会很好。”说最后一句话时，她脸上带着温暖的微笑，低头望着小小的孕肚，满是身为母亲的骄傲。
rows.raw: "\n\n“No, not for quite some time,” she replies, idly rubbing her belly, “Several months more, at least, but there is a chance that the union of our two species may result in a pregnancy that progresses differently than I expect. I feel all is going well, though. My instincts say that everything will be just fine.” She says that last sentence with a warm smile on her face, looking down at her baby bump with motherly pride."

rows.original: The zil smirks. “Well, as you can see, they’re growing fast, but I believe there is still a fair amount of time before they arrive. Weeks, if not months. Zil are never born alone, you see, so we females grow to accommodate not just one child, but two, or sometimes even three. I believe it will be quite apparent when they are ready to greet the world.” The alien woman looks positively joyful as she speaks, rubbing both hands along her pregnant belly and smiling broadly.
rows.translation: 兹尔坏笑。“好吧，你也看到了，他们长得很快，但我觉得距离出生还有不少时间。即使不是几个月，也得几周。要知道，兹尔从来不会只生一个，所以我们女性长大的肚子容纳的不只是一个孩子，而是两个，有时甚至三个。我相信，等他们准备好迎接世界时，会十分明显。”外星女人说话时显得欣喜无比，双手抚摸孕肚，笑容灿烂。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zil smirks. “Well, as you can see, they’re growing fast, but I believe there is still a fair amount of time before they arrive. Weeks, if not months. Zil are never born alone, you see, so we females grow to accommodate not just one child, but two, or sometimes even three. I believe it will be quite apparent when they are ready to greet the world.” The alien woman looks positively joyful as she speaks, rubbing both hands along her pregnant belly and smiling broadly."

rows.original: The zil takes a deep breath, then lets out a chuckle. “Soon, I hope. Very soon. They’re beginning to make life rather difficult for their mother, what with their constant kicking and shifting around, not to mention how heavy they’ve become. But it is a burden all mothers bear, for the sake of their children. I shall manage, but I eagerly await their arrival. Not only to ease my aching body, but to finally hold them in my arms...”
rows.translation: 兹尔深吸一口气，然后轻笑。“希望快了。很快。他们开始让妈妈过得相当辛苦，不停踢腿、挪动，更别提变得这么沉。不过，为了孩子，所有母亲都要承受这份重担。我能应付，但我热切盼望他们到来。不只是为了让酸痛的身体轻松些，也为了终于能把他们抱在怀里...”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zil takes a deep breath, then lets out a chuckle. “Soon, I hope. Very soon. They’re beginning to make life rather difficult for their mother, what with their constant kicking and shifting around, not to mention how heavy they’ve become. But it is a burden all mothers bear, for the sake of their children. I shall manage, but I eagerly await their arrival. Not only to ease my aching body, but to finally hold them in my arms...”"

rows.original: The zil suddenly seems very emotional, averting her eyes and nervously fiddling with her hair. “If you... wanted to be there for their birth,” she says quietly, “I would recommend staying nearby for the next several days. It’s up to you, of course...”
rows.translation: 兹尔忽然显得情绪激动，移开目光，紧张地拨弄头发。“如果你...想在他们出生时在场，”她轻声说，“我建议接下来几天待在附近。当然，由你决定...”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zil suddenly seems very emotional, averting her eyes and nervously fiddling with her hair. “If you... wanted to be there for their birth,” she says quietly, “I would recommend staying nearby for the next several days. It’s up to you, of course...”"

rows.original: You look at the pregnant alien for a moment, then sigh and take a step back. Even with your pheromone-induced arousal, you’re not in the mood for sex. For whatever reason, you desire something much simpler.
rows.translation: 你望了怀孕的外星女人片刻，随后叹气，退后一步。尽管信息素让你兴奋，你却没有性爱的心情。不知为何，你想要的远比这简单。
rows.raw: "You look at the pregnant alien for a moment, then sigh and take a step back. Even with your pheromone-induced arousal, you’re not in the mood for sex. For whatever reason, you desire something much simpler."

rows.original: “Is something wrong?” she asks.
rows.translation: “有什么不对吗？”她问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is something wrong?” she asks."

rows.original: With a smile, you tell her that nothing is wrong, but that you’d like to simply pass some time, maybe just sit down and relax for a while.
rows.translation: 你微笑着告诉她，一切都好，只是想消磨一会儿时间，也许坐下来放松片刻。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith a smile, you tell her that nothing is wrong, but that you’d like to simply pass some time, maybe just sit down and relax for a while."

rows.original: The zil looks skeptical. “You want to... sit here?”
rows.translation: 兹尔看起来有些怀疑。“你想...坐在这里？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zil looks skeptical. “You want to... sit here?”"

rows.original: You laugh and grab her hand, leading her over to a nearby tree. Lowering yourself to the ground and sitting against it, you invite her to do the same. The zil gives you a curious smile before carefully easing herself down and sitting beside you. She’s clearly a bit awkward about it, at least until you wrap an arm around her shoulder and bring her in close.
rows.translation: 你笑着牵起她的手，将她带到附近一棵树下。你坐到地上，靠着树，邀请她一起坐下。兹尔好奇地笑了笑，小心翼翼地慢慢坐到你身边。她显然有些局促，至少直到你伸臂搂住肩膀，将她拉近。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou laugh and grab her hand, leading her over to a nearby tree. Lowering yourself to the ground and sitting against it, you invite her to do the same. The zil gives you a curious smile before carefully easing herself down and sitting beside you. She’s clearly a bit awkward about it, at least until you wrap an arm around her shoulder and bring her in close. "

rows.original: “Is this some kind of mating ritual among your people?” she asks.
rows.translation: “这是你们族人的某种求偶仪式吗？”她问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is this some kind of mating ritual among your people?” she asks."

rows.original: You’re caught off-guard by her question and laugh. “Sometimes, maybe? Mostly it’s just a nice way to spend time together.”
rows.translation: 她的问题让你猝不及防，你笑了。“有时候，也许吧？大多时候，这只是一起度过时光的好办法。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re caught off-guard by her question and laugh. “Sometimes, maybe? Mostly it’s just a nice way to spend time together.”"

rows.original: You bask in a warm combination of pride and happiness, settling against the wall of the hut beside the happy new mother. Every other zil nearby seems quite happy themselves, and you look outside to see a similar joy shared by the slowly-dispersing crowd.
rows.translation: 骄傲与幸福交织成暖流，你靠着小屋墙壁，在快乐的新妈妈身旁坐下。附近其他兹尔似乎也都喜气洋洋，你向屋外看去，只见正在缓缓散去的人群同样分享着这份喜悦。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou bask in a warm combination of pride and happiness, settling against the wall of the hut beside the happy new mother. Every other zil nearby seems quite happy themselves, and you look outside to see a similar joy shared by the slowly-dispersing crowd."

rows.original: Several minutes of peaceful silence pass, before your mate clears her throat to get your attention. You turn to face her, noticing that she’s wearing a conflicted expression. Instinctively, you ask her if something is wrong.
rows.translation: 几分钟宁静无言的时光过去后，你的伴侣清了清嗓子，引起你的注意。你转头面对她，发现她神情矛盾。你本能地问她是否出了什么问题。
rows.raw: "\n\nSeveral minutes of peaceful silence pass, before your mate clears her throat to get your attention. You turn to face her, noticing that she’s wearing a conflicted expression. Instinctively, you ask her if something is wrong."

rows.original: “I have been anticipating this moment for many months,” she says, giving a rueful smile, “But now, I am paralyzed with uncertainty.”
rows.translation: “我期待这一刻已有许多个月，”她苦笑着说，“可如今，我却因犹豫不决而动弹不得。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I have been anticipating this moment for many months,” she says, giving a rueful smile, “But now, I am paralyzed with uncertainty.”"

rows.original: You tilt your head and ask her to elaborate.
rows.translation: 你歪着头，请她说得更详细些。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tilt your head and ask her to elaborate."

rows.original: She is quiet for several seconds, before speaking in a hushed tone. “Can you take our children away from here? Is there a way you could raise them to be like you and the other offworlders?”
rows.translation: 她沉默数秒，随后压低声音开口。“你能把我们的孩子带离这里吗？你能不能把他们养大，让他们变得像你和其他外星人一样？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe is quiet for several seconds, before speaking in a hushed tone. “Can you take our children away from here? Is there a way you could raise them to be like you and the other offworlders?”"

rows.original: You look down at the infant in your arms, a proud smile spreading across your face. “Yes,” you answer.
rows.translation: 你低头看向怀中的婴儿，脸上浮现自豪的笑容。“可以，”你答道。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look down at the infant in your arms, a proud smile spreading across your face. “Yes,” you answer."

rows.original: The zil sighs with immense relief. “Thank you. Our world was dangerous enough in the past, but the arrival of so many offworlders makes me even more uncertain about the future of the zil. I do not want to worry about my children’s future. I want them to live safe, happy lives, and I believe that you are better suited to giving them that than I. And... If it is you that raises them, maybe they will one day be able to return to Mhen’ga, to see their mother...” She looks down at her newborn child with tears in her eyes and a bittersweet expression, but quickly reigns in her emotions and collects herself. “Where will you take them?” she asks.
rows.translation: 兹尔如释重负地长叹一声。“我们的世界过去就已经足够危险，如今这么多外星人的到来，更令我无法确定兹尔的未来。我不想整日担忧孩子们的将来。我希望他们能够平安、幸福地生活，而我相信你比我更有能力给他们这样的生活。而且...如果由你抚养他们，也许有朝一日，他们还能回到曼加，看看自己的母亲...”她低头望着新生的孩子，眼含泪水，神情苦乐参半，却很快控制住情绪，重新镇定下来。“你会把他们带到哪里？”她问。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zil sighs with immense relief. “Thank you. Our world was dangerous enough in the past, but the arrival of so many offworlders makes me even more uncertain about the future of the zil. I do not want to worry about my children’s future. I want them to live safe, happy lives, and I believe that you are better suited to giving them that than I. And... If it is you that raises them, maybe they will one day be able to return to Mhen’ga, to see their mother...” She looks down at her newborn child with tears in her eyes and a bittersweet expression, but quickly reigns in her emotions and collects herself. “Where will you take them?” she asks."

rows.original: You tell her of the nursery your father created for you, going into detail about the cutting-edge caretaking technologies it contains. There are many terms you use that she obviously does not understand, and you do your best to explain how the children will be cared for and educated in ways she is able to comprehend. When you finish, her eyes are wide with wonder, and any doubts she had long gone.
rows.translation: 你向她介绍父亲为你建立的育儿室，详细说明其中搭载的尖端育儿科技。你用了许多她显然听不懂的术语，于是尽力用她能够理解的方式解释孩子们将如何得到照料与教育。等你说完时，她惊奇地睁大双眼，先前的疑虑早已烟消云散。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her of the nursery your father created for you, going into detail about the cutting-edge caretaking technologies it contains. There are many terms you use that she obviously does not understand, and you do your best to explain how the children will be cared for and educated in ways she is able to comprehend. When you finish, her eyes are wide with wonder, and any doubts she had long gone."

rows.original: “Normally I would not believe such fantastical claims,” she says, “But I have seen what you and others like you are capable of. To think that such things were possible...” Her face once again takes on a look of concern, but only for a moment. She shakes it off, and then suddenly pulls herself to her feet, still cradling her baby. “So, how are we to get them to this nursery you speak of?”
rows.translation: “通常我不会相信如此奇幻的说法，”她说道，“但我亲眼见过你和其他同类的本领。没想到这种事情竟然真的可能...”她脸上再度浮现担忧，却只持续了一瞬。她甩开忧虑，忽然抱着婴儿站起身。“那么，我们要怎样把他们送到你所说的育儿室？”

You turn to take the other baby, and your zil mate freezes for a moment. She takes a deep breath, stepping past you and placing the child inside the probe herself. You nod your head and back away, more than happy to give her as much time as she needs.

rows.original: She looks at her children for a while, smiling, as a crowd of curious onlookers gathers around the probe. Eventually, the heavy-hearted mother steps away from the probe and lets you send it on its way, the other zil gasping in awe as it shoots into the sky and disappears.
rows.translation: 她注视着孩子们良久，面带微笑，而一群好奇的旁观者也围到探测器旁。最终，心情沉重的母亲离开探测器，让你将它送上旅途。探测器冲上天空并消失无踪时，其他兹尔惊叹地倒吸一口气。

rows.original: From there, it’s just a matter of saying goodbye. You spend a little more time among the zil, rather enamored with their surprising hospitality, before eventually bidding them farewell. You begin your trek back, looking over your shoulder one last time as you near the edge of the village. You see your mate watching you depart, and she gives you a wave, which you reciprocate before heading back out into the jungle.
rows.translation: 接下来只剩下道别。你又在兹尔村落停留了一阵，颇为沉醉于他们出人意料的好客，最终才向众人告辞。你踏上返程，在接近村庄边缘时最后一次回头。你看见伴侣正目送你离开，她向你挥手，你也挥手回应，随后重新走入丛林。

rows.original: “I- I think you should take them,” the zil finally speaks up, causing you to turn towards him, only to see a somewhat distressed look on his face, “This jungle... it’s dangerous, my people don’t live very long because of it. I’ve seen Esbeth though, and the technology you offworlders have, so I- I think they’d be much safer, and happier, somewhere like that.”
rows.translation: “我——我想你该带走他们，”兹尔终于开口，让你转头望向他，却看见他脸上有些忧愁，“这片丛林...很危险，我的族人因此都活不长。不过我见过埃斯贝斯，也见过你们外星人的科技，所以我——我想，在那样的地方，他们会安全得多，也快乐得多。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I- I think you should take them,” the zil finally speaks up, causing you to turn towards him, only to see a somewhat distressed look on his face, “This jungle... it’s dangerous, my people don’t live very long because of it. I’ve seen Esbeth though, and the technology you offworlders have, so I- I think they’d be much safer, and happier, somewhere like that.”"

rows.original: You contemplate that for a moment, and it all makes sense. Nothing about the zil’s tone or words makes it seem like he’s trying to shirk responsibility. No, he’s being completely genuine. Giving him a nod in response, you carefully pull out your Codex and tap the screen a few times, calling a drone to collect your children and take them to the nursery your dad had built.
rows.translation: 你思考片刻，觉得这完全说得通。兹尔的语气和言辞丝毫不像在推卸责任。相反，他无比真诚。你点头回应，小心取出CODEX终端，在屏幕上点了几下，呼叫一架无人机来接孩子们，把他们送到父亲为你建造的育婴室。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou contemplate that for a moment, and it all makes sense. Nothing about the zil’s tone or words makes it seem like he’s trying to shirk responsibility. No, he’s being completely genuine. Giving him a nod in response, you carefully pull out your Codex and tap the screen a few times, calling a drone to collect your children and take them to the nursery your dad had built."

rows.original: You spend just a little while longer in the company of your mate and your children before the probes arrive, startling more than a few villagers as they fly their way to your tent and present a small space for you to put your children.
rows.translation: 你又陪着伴侣和孩子们待了一小会儿，探测器便到了。它们飞向你的帐篷，让不少村民吓了一跳，随后敞开一个小空间，供你安置孩子们。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou spend just a little while longer in the company of your mate and your children before the probes arrive, startling more than a few villagers as they fly their way to your tent and present a small space for you to put your children."

rows.original: “Th- these will keep our children safe?” the zil boy asks, seeming a bit nervous at the sight of all that cold, unfeeling metal.
rows.translation: “这——这些东西会保护我们的孩子？”兹尔男孩问道，面对那些冰冷无情的金属，显得有些紧张。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Th- these will keep our children safe?” the zil boy asks, seeming a bit nervous at the sight of all that cold, unfeeling metal."

rows.original: You tell him they’re specially made to transport your newborns safely to a high-tech nursery in another system.
rows.translation: 你告诉他，它们专门负责将你的新生儿安全送到另一个星系的高科技育婴室。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell him they’re specially made to transport your newborns safely to a high-tech nursery in another system."

rows.original: “Oh, alright then...” he says, standing up with one of your half-breed babies in his arms and walking towards a probe, “Sh- should I just put them in here?”
rows.translation: “哦，那好吧...”他说着，抱着你们的一个混血宝宝站起身，走向一架探测器，“我——我把他们放进去就行了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, alright then...” he says, standing up with one of your half-breed babies in his arms and walking towards a probe, “Sh- should I just put them in here?”"

rows.original: After you give him a nod, the zil carefully puts his child into the cushioned, life supported compartment, lingering a few moments before stepping back, allowing the pod to close. Then, like that, they’re off with your precious bundles en-route to Tavros, leaving you and your mate alone.
rows.translation: 得到你点头后，兹尔小心地将孩子放进配有软垫和生命维持系统的舱室，逗留片刻才退后，让舱门关闭。就这样，它们带着你珍爱的宝宝们启程前往塔夫罗斯站，留下你和伴侣独处。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter you give him a nod, the zil carefully puts his child into the cushioned, life supported compartment, lingering a few moments before stepping back, allowing the pod to close. Then, like that, they’re off with your precious bundles en-route to Tavros, leaving you and your mate alone."

rows.original: He breathes a long sigh, before turning to you again. “It will be nice knowing they’re safe out there,” he says, “but, I... I hope one day I will see them again, and their mother.” With that, he smiles at you, “But I think it might be time for you to leave... as much as I wish you could stay, no doubt the rest of the tribe is getting antsy with an outsider around for so long.”
rows.translation: 他长叹一声，再次转向你。“知道他们在外面能平平安安的，真好，”他说，“不过，我...我希望有一天还能再见到他们，还有他们的母亲。”说完，他朝你微笑，“但我想你也该走了...虽然我很希望你留下，可外人待了这么久，其他族人肯定已经有些不安了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe breathes a long sigh, before turning to you again. “It will be nice knowing they’re safe out there,” he says, “but, I... I hope one day I will see them again, and their mother.” With that, he smiles at you, “But I think it might be time for you to leave... as much as I wish you could stay, no doubt the rest of the tribe is getting antsy with an outsider around for so long.”"

rows.raw: "\n\nThe bee-boy walks his way to the tent’s flap and opens it to invite you out, <i>“"

rows.original: After you spend a little bit more time making sure your babies are in good health and well-fed, you pull out your Codex and tap the screen a few times; before you can say “Steele Tech,” a drone prepared to carry your children to your personal nursery arrives. They seem to have no trouble getting into or out of your ship, docking with the nearest airlock. You carefully place your newborns inside the cushioned, life-supported compartment, giving them each a long, warm hug before letting them go. Once you’ve said your goodbyes, the drone closes itself and detach safely from your ship before flying off, en-route to Tavros.
rows.translation: 你又花了些时间，确认宝宝们身体健康、吃饱喝足后，便取出CODEX终端，在屏幕上点了几下；还没等你说出“斯蒂尔科技”，一架准备送孩子们前往你私人育婴室的无人机便到了。它们进出你的飞船似乎毫无困难，直接与最近的气闸对接。你小心地将新生儿放进配有软垫和生命维持系统的舱室，松手前给了每个宝宝一个温暖而悠长的拥抱。道别完毕后，无人机关闭舱门，安全地脱离你的飞船，随后飞向塔夫罗斯站。

rows.original: A small, curvaceous drone is hovering here. There’s a ‘Property of U.G.C. Peacekeepers’ sticker on it. The bot has an hourglass shape, thick around the anti-grav jets on the base, narrowing at waist level, and widening again at the wobbling, gel-state battery orbs at the top. When you approach, the drone projects a holographic alert symbol and intones in a clearly mechanical voice: “Peacekeeper Inoue has posted the following safety advisory: beyond this point, the southern area of jungle is classified as a level four threat and is to be avoided if at all possible.” You have to assume Penny just used whatever robot was close at hand for the safety alert, because a message drone has no business being this thick.
rows.translation: 一架小巧而曲线玲珑的无人机悬浮在这里。上面贴着一张‘联合银河邦联维和部队财产’的标签。机器人呈沙漏形，底部反重力喷口处较宽，在腰部收窄，顶部摇晃的凝胶态电池球处又变宽。你靠近时，无人机投射出全息警告符号，用明显机械化的声音说道：“井上维和官发布了以下安全通告：从此处往南的丛林区域被列为四级威胁，应尽可能避免进入。” 你只能认为佩妮是随手使用了附近的机器人发布安全警报，因为信息无人机实在没必要如此丰满。
rows.raw: " A small, curvaceous drone is hovering here. There’s a ‘Property of U.G.C. Peacekeepers’ sticker on it. The bot has an hourglass shape, thick around the anti-grav jets on the base, narrowing at waist level, and widening again at the wobbling, gel-state battery orbs at the top. When you approach, the drone projects a holographic alert symbol and intones in a clearly mechanical voice: “Peacekeeper Inoue has posted the following safety advisory: beyond this point, the southern area of jungle is classified as a level four threat and is to be avoided if at all possible.” You have to assume Penny just used whatever robot was close at hand for the safety alert, because a message drone has no business being this thick."

rows.original: The gentle glow of the nearby message drone flickers to an urgent brightness as it detects someone nearby. You can’t help but notice the anti-grav jets on its base are struggling to keep it aloft and the sloshing, greenish orbs on its front look somewhat diminished. Smaller, almost. The hovering gynoid’s holoprojector flickers to life even as the digital marquee stretched across its chest lets you know the torso-bot is in need of servicing. “Notice: This drone’s gel-state battery orbs are in need of refilling. A nominal credit will be dispensed for your sufficiently kinetic cooperation in recharging this unit. Please manipulate in an oscillating fashion at your earliest convenience.”
rows.translation: 附近的信息无人机检测到有人靠近，柔和光芒顿时闪成急迫的亮光。你不难注意到，底部反重力喷口正艰难维持悬浮，而前方晃动的淡绿色球体似乎有所缩小。看起来更小了。这个悬浮女机器人启动全息投影仪，横跨胸前的数字跑马灯同时告诉你，躯干机器人需要维护。 “通知：本无人机的凝胶态电池球需要补充。若您能以充分的动能合作为本单元充电，将发放少量信用点。请尽快以往复振荡方式进行操作。”
rows.raw: "The gentle glow of the nearby message drone flickers to an urgent brightness as it detects someone nearby. You can’t help but notice the anti-grav jets on its base are struggling to keep it aloft and the sloshing, greenish orbs on its front look somewhat diminished. Smaller, almost. The hovering gynoid’s holoprojector flickers to life even as the digital marquee stretched across its chest lets you know the torso-bot is in need of servicing.\n\n\t\t“Notice: This drone’s gel-state battery orbs are in need of refilling. A nominal credit will be dispensed for your sufficiently kinetic cooperation in recharging this unit. Please manipulate in an oscillating fashion at your earliest convenience.”"

rows.original:
Manipulate? Kinetic charging? You can’t help but think a simple wooden sign would’ve been easier - and wouldn’t need batteries. But... it’s hard to deny that the lewdly proportioned drone is a better eye-catch than a simple signpost. You figure you’ll at least give it a look.
			
			The floating hourglass is roughly average proportions for a normal terran - other than its lack of limbs or a head. You press a palm against the amber projector at its peak, to find the little gem-like glass is both warm and tingly against your [pc.skin]. You push down a bit and let go. The hoverjets bounce it right back up, like it’s sitting on an invisible spring. You put both hands on the machine and push down, nearly to the ground, and - sure enough - it bounces right back up into the air, wobbling up and down.

			And nothing wobbles quite so much as the glowing orbs on the drone’s frontside. The bouncy batteries behave far less like the lightbulbs they resemble and far more like gelatin - jiggling up and down with even the smallest of your touches. Surprisingly, the light inside them seems to glow a little bit brighter with every recoil. You’re not quite sure, but it looks like the fuel cells are even a bit bigger too...

			You guess that’s what they meant by ‘kinetic’ participation: you’re supposed to jiggle this drone until its bouncing breasts fill back up!
rows.translation:
操作？动能充电？你忍不住觉得，一块普通木牌会简单得多——而且不需要电池。不过...不得不承认，这架比例淫荡的无人机比普通路牌更引人注目。你决定至少仔细看看。
			
			这只悬浮沙漏的比例大致相当于普通泰伦人——只不过没有四肢和脑袋。你用手掌按住顶端琥珀色投影器，发现这块如宝石般的小玻璃贴着[pc.skin]时既温暖又酥麻。你稍稍向下按压，然后松手。悬浮喷口立刻让它弹回上方，仿佛坐在隐形弹簧上。你双手按住机器，一直压到接近地面，然后——果然——它又弹回空中，上下摇晃。

			无人机正面的发光球体摇晃得最为厉害。这些弹性电池远不像外形相似的灯泡，反倒更像明胶——即使最轻微的触碰，也会让它们上下颤动。令人惊讶的是，每次回弹似乎都会让内部光芒稍微变亮。你无法确定，但燃料电池似乎也变大了一点...

			你猜这就是它所说的‘动能’参与：你得不断摇晃无人机，直到那对弹跳乳房重新充满！

"Manipulate? Kinetic charging? You can’t help but think a simple wooden sign would’ve been easier - and wouldn’t need batteries. But... it’s hard to deny that the lewdly proportioned drone is a better eye-catch than a simple signpost. You figure you’ll at least give it a look.

You press a palm against the amber projector at its peak, to find the little gem-like glass is both warm and tingly against your [pc.skin]. You push down a bit and let go. The hoverjets bounce it right back up, like it’s sitting on an invisible spring. You put both hands on the machine and push down, nearly to the ground, and - sure enough - it bounces right back up into the air, wobbling up and down.

			And nothing wobbles quite so much as the glowing orbs on the drone’s frontside. The bouncy batteries behave far less like the lightbulbs they resemble and far more like gelatin - jiggling up and down with even the smallest of your touches. Surprisingly, the light inside them seems to glow a little bit brighter with every recoil. You’re not quite sure, but it looks like the fuel cells are even a bit bigger too...

			You guess that’s what they meant by ‘kinetic’ participation: you’re supposed to jiggle this drone until its bouncing breasts fill back up!"

rows.original: Seems like the locals haven’t been keeping up with the titty-bot’s regular recharges. You press down on her amber holoscreen projector, enjoying the warm tingles it sends through your hand and arm for a moment before releasing your grip. Sure enough, the anti-grav bounces her right back up into the air. Her gel-state ‘batteries’ wobble and jiggle like a giddy galotian, bouncing with decidedly intentional lewdness.
rows.translation: 看来当地人没有按时为乳房机器人充电。你按下她琥珀色的全息屏幕投影器，享受它传遍手掌与手臂的温暖酥麻片刻，然后松开。果然，反重力系统立刻让她重新弹回空中。凝胶态‘电池’如同兴奋的加洛提安般摇摆颤动，弹跳动作带着显然刻意的淫荡意味。
rows.raw: "Seems like the locals haven’t been keeping up with the titty-bot’s regular recharges. You press down on her amber holoscreen projector, enjoying the warm tingles it sends through your hand and arm for a moment before releasing your grip. Sure enough, the anti-grav bounces her right back up into the air. Her gel-state ‘batteries’ wobble and jiggle like a giddy galotian, bouncing with decidedly intentional lewdness."

You spend several minutes dragging the mutilated bodies out of the camp and dump them into a ditch not far away. Best you can do under the circumstances."

rows.original: You clear out one of the tents and bunker down to sleep
rows.translation: 你清理出一顶帐篷，安顿下来睡觉
rows.raw: "\n\nYou clear out one of the tents and bunker down to sleep"

rows.original: The camp is still clear enough, and the smell’s not so bad anymore. You crawl into one of the tents and bunker down to sleep
rows.translation: 营地仍然足够干净，气味也不再那么糟糕。你爬进一顶帐篷，安顿下来睡觉
rows.raw: "The camp is still clear enough, and the smell’s not so bad anymore. You crawl into one of the tents and bunker down to sleep"

rows.original: for about
rows.translation: 大约
rows.raw: " for about "

rows.original: hours.
rows.translation: 小时。
rows.raw: " hours."

rows.original: Vanae
rows.raw: "Vanae"

rows.original: You’re awoken by a low, deep mechanical barking outside your tent, full of enough bass to make your [pc.ears] rattle. You grab your [pc.gear] and stumble out of the tent, wiping the sleep from your eyes. Tam-wolf is standing outside in a low, threatening posture, his steel ears low against his head. A vanae is standing just a short way away, held at bay by your robotic guard dog. Still, it doesn’t look like she’s backing off... you’ll have to fight her!
rows.translation: 帐篷外传来低沉浑厚的机械吠叫，充足的低音震得[pc.ears]发颤，将你惊醒。你抓起[pc.gear]，跌跌撞撞地走出帐篷，揉去眼中的睡意。塔姆狼正以低伏而充满威胁的姿势站在外面，钢铁耳朵紧贴脑袋。一名瓦娜站在不远处，被你的机器护卫犬阻挡在外。不过她似乎并没有退让...你必须和她战斗！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re awoken by a low, deep mechanical barking outside your tent, full of enough bass to make your [pc.ears] rattle. You grab your [pc.gear] and stumble out of the tent, wiping the sleep from your eyes. Tam-wolf is standing outside in a low, threatening posture, his steel ears low against his head. A vanae is standing just a short way away, held at bay by your robotic guard dog. Still, it doesn’t look like she’s backing off... you’ll have to fight her!"

rows.original: You’re awoken by a high, shrill warcry. Your eyes snap open, just as a throwing spear slams into the dirt beside your bedroll, tearing through the tent. You scramble to your [pc.feet], grabbing your equipment as your assailer leaps into view. You’ve been ambushed by a vanae!
rows.translation: 一声高亢尖锐的战吼将你惊醒。你猛然睁眼，恰好一根投矛刺穿帐篷，扎进铺盖旁的泥土。你抓起装备，急忙站到[pc.feet]上，而袭击者也跃入视野。一名瓦娜伏击了你！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re awoken by a high, shrill warcry. Your eyes snap open, just as a throwing spear slams into the dirt beside your bedroll, tearing through the tent. You scramble to your [pc.feet], grabbing your equipment as your assailer leaps into view. You’ve been ambushed by a vanae!"

rows.original: Vanae Huntress
rows.translation: 瓦娜女猎手
rows.raw: "Vanae Huntress"

rows.original: VANAE_HUNTRESS
rows.raw: "VANAE_HUNTRESS"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: SALVAGED VANAE CAMP
rows.raw: "SALVAGED VANAE CAMP"

rows.original: SALVAGED VANAE CAMP
rows.raw: "SALVAGED VANAE CAMP"

rows.original: SALVAGED VANAE CAMP
rows.raw: "SALVAGED VANAE CAMP"

rows.original: As you pick through the abandoned research camp, you spot something useful among the wreckage of what looks to be a burned-out hoverloader: a mid-range communications array, new in box. While not particularly valuable, and much too heavy to carry around with you, this array could easily cut through the jungle and send a signal back to Esbeth. You break it out of the box and boot it up. The array makes a happy chirping sound, announcing more loudly than you’d like that it is a top of the line Xenogen product brought to you courtesy of some dead, highly advanced race Xenogen looted whose name you’re not sure you could replicate. With the comms array set up, you could probably call for retrieval from Esbeth now.
rows.translation: 你在废弃研究营地中翻找时，发现一辆似乎烧毁的悬浮装载车残骸里有件有用的东西：一套装在新箱中的中程通讯阵列。它并不特别值钱，而且重得根本无法随身携带，但这个阵列可以轻易穿透丛林，把信号送回埃斯贝斯。你将它拆箱并启动。阵列发出欢快的啁啾声，以比你希望的更大音量宣布：这是异源生物科技的顶级产品，由某个已灭亡的高度发达种族慷慨提供；异源生物科技洗劫过他们，而那个名字你甚至不确定自己能否复述。 通讯阵列架设完毕后，你现在大概可以呼叫埃斯贝斯前来接应。
rows.raw: "As you pick through the abandoned research camp, you spot something useful among the wreckage of what looks to be a burned-out hoverloader: a mid-range communications array, new in box. While not particularly valuable, and much too heavy to carry around with you, this array could easily cut through the jungle and send a signal back to Esbeth. You break it out of the box and boot it up. The array makes a happy chirping sound, announcing more loudly than you’d like that it is a top of the line Xenogen product brought to you courtesy of some dead, highly advanced race Xenogen looted whose name you’re not sure you could replicate.\n\nWith the comms array set up, you could probably call for retrieval from Esbeth now."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: SALVAGED VANAE CAMP
rows.raw: "SALVAGED VANAE CAMP"

rows.original: You find something of interest stashed in one of the many storage containers scattered around the camp. Gingerly lifting the lid of a heavily damaged container, you discover a set of some kind of augmented armor.
rows.translation: 你在营地四处散落的众多储物箱中发现了一件有趣的东西。你小心抬起一个严重损坏容器的盖子，发现一套某种增强护甲。
rows.raw: "You find something of interest stashed in one of the many storage containers scattered around the camp. Gingerly lifting the lid of a heavily damaged container, you discover a set of some kind of augmented armor. "

rows.original: You take the augmented armor you found from one of the storage containers at the camp.
rows.translation: 你拿走了在营地一个储物箱中发现的增强护甲。
rows.raw: "You take the augmented armor you found from one of the storage containers at the camp."

rows.original: SALVAGED VANAE CAMP
rows.raw: "SALVAGED VANAE CAMP"

rows.original: Unable to carry the suit with you, you put it back where you found it.
rows.translation: 你无法随身携带这套护甲，只好把它放回原处。
rows.raw: "Unable to carry the suit with you, you put it back where you found it."

rows.original: SALVAGED VANAE CAMP
rows.raw: "SALVAGED VANAE CAMP"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The mist is incredibly thick here, obscuring almost everything around you. Every noise seems sharper and more imposing as you crunch blindly about, occasionally knocking into a tree or branch. Your
rows.translation: 这里的雾气浓得难以置信，几乎遮蔽周围的一切。你在看不见路的情况下踩着枯枝落叶前进，偶尔撞上树木或枝杈，每种声音都显得更加尖锐、更具压迫感。你的
rows.raw: "The mist is incredibly thick here, obscuring almost everything around you. Every noise seems sharper and more imposing as you crunch blindly about, occasionally knocking into a tree or branch. Your"

rows.original: [pc.armor] is
rows.translation: [pc.armor]
rows.raw: " [pc.armor] is"

rows.original: [pc.skinFurScales]
rows.raw: " [pc.skinFurScales]"

rows.original: are
rows.translation: 都
rows.raw: " are"

rows.original: is
rows.translation: 已经
rows.raw: " is"

rows.original:
damp from all the moisture in the air. Things are getting quite chilly.

You can hear a river to the west, which means you probably can’t proceed that way. Everywhere else seems fine, you think...
rows.translation:
被空气中的水汽打湿。天气变得相当寒冷。

你能听见西面有河流声，这意味着那边大概无法通行。其他方向似乎都没问题，你想...
rows.raw: " damp from all the moisture in the air. Things are getting quite chilly.\n\nYou can hear a river to the west, which means you probably can’t proceed that way. Everywhere else seems fine, you think..."

rows.original: As you approach the former Pump-king’s castle, you see several very official-looking UGC barricades around every entrance, complete with a few officers on patrol. Seems they’re still picking the place apart, or they just plain don’t want randoms wandering in. You’d better get going before they see you loitering about, on that note.
rows.translation: 当你接近前南瓜王的城堡时，看到每个入口周围都设有几道非常正式的联合银河邦联路障，还有几名官员巡逻。看来他们仍在拆解研究此地，或者只是不愿让闲杂人等随便闯入。说到这里，你最好在他们发现你逗留之前赶快离开。
rows.raw: "As you approach the former Pump-king’s castle, you see several very official-looking UGC barricades around every entrance, complete with a few officers on patrol. Seems they’re still picking the place apart, or they just plain don’t want randoms wandering in. You’d better get going before they see you loitering about, on that note."

rows.original: This must be the Pump-king’s lair. A small castle made of logs lashed together with sturdy ropes rises out of the jungle before you, ringed first by a moat, then a deep, wide ditch lined with uneven rows of tan wooden spikes covered in some dark substance... Are those flies? Oh, that’s disgusting. That does not look like something you want to fall into. At least the water in the moat looks clean... and empty aside from the clear water filling it. There are a few areas where the logs have begun to be ringed on the outside of the moat with thick stones joined by cement, indicating that the ruler of this castle does not plan to rely on wood forever.
rows.translation: 这里一定就是南瓜王的巢穴。一座用结实绳索捆扎原木建成的小城堡矗立在眼前丛林中，外围先是一圈护城河，再是一条又深又宽的壕沟，里面排列着参差不齐的棕褐色木刺，表面沾着某种黑色物质...那些是苍蝇吗？哦，真恶心。这绝对不是你想跌进去的地方。至少护城河里的水看起来很干净...除了清澈河水外，也空无一物。护城河外侧有几处原木建筑已经开始加筑用水泥连接的厚重石块，表明这座城堡的统治者并不打算永远依赖木材。
rows.raw: "This must be the Pump-king’s lair. A small castle made of logs lashed together with sturdy ropes rises out of the jungle before you, ringed first by a moat, then a deep, wide ditch lined with uneven rows of tan wooden spikes covered in some dark substance... Are those flies? Oh, that’s disgusting. That does not look like something you want to fall into. At least the water in the moat looks clean... and empty aside from the clear water filling it. There are a few areas where the logs have begun to be ringed on the outside of the moat with thick stones joined by cement, indicating that the ruler of this castle does not plan to rely on wood forever."

rows.original: There are about a dozen zil workers here, using primitive tools and carts to lug building equipment around the work site. Looking up to see you, they drop their tools and flee while the gate guards level their weapons at you.
rows.translation: 这里有大约十二名兹尔工人，使用原始工具和推车，在工地周围搬运建筑设备。他们抬头看见你后扔下工具逃跑，而大门守卫则举起武器对准你。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere are about a dozen zil workers here, using primitive tools and carts to lug building equipment around the work site. Looking up to see you, they drop their tools and flee while the gate guards level their weapons at you."

rows.original: Zil
rows.raw: "Zil"

rows.original: Fight!
rows.translation: 战斗！
rows.raw: "Fight!"

rows.original: You go down in a hail of laser fire!
rows.translation: 你倒在如雨的激光火力中！
rows.raw: "You go down in a hail of laser fire!"

rows.original: ZIL GUARDS
rows.raw: "ZIL GUARDS"

rows.original: The guards lie unconscious where you left them, in various uncomfortable positions in front of the gates. A small group of zil workers are carefully tending their wounds, but they run back into the jungle when they see you. Building tools lie scattered around the premises in random places, wherever the zil workers left them when they fled your initial approach.
rows.translation: 守卫们昏迷地躺在你先前留下他们的地方，以各种不舒服的姿势倒在大门前。一小群兹尔工人正小心照料伤口，但看到你后便逃回丛林。建筑工具散落在四周各处，都是兹尔工人在你最初靠近、仓皇逃跑时丢下的。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe guards lie unconscious where you left them, in various uncomfortable positions in front of the gates. A small group of zil workers are carefully tending their wounds, but they run back into the jungle when they see you. Building tools lie scattered around the premises in random places, wherever the zil workers left them when they fled your initial approach."

rows.original: The passage stretches before you, metal jack o’ lanterns lining the walls, lit torches shining spookily from their eyes and open, jagged mouths. You feel eyes on your back, but every time you turn around all you see is the empty hallway.
rows.translation: 通道在你面前延伸，金属南瓜灯沿墙排列，点燃的火炬从眼睛和张开的锯齿嘴巴中投出诡异光芒。你感觉背后有目光注视，可每次转身，只能看到空荡的走廊。
rows.raw: "The passage stretches before you, metal jack o’ lanterns lining the walls, lit torches shining spookily from their eyes and open, jagged mouths. You feel eyes on your back, but every time you turn around all you see is the empty hallway."

rows.original: PUMPKING_EAST_PASSAGE
rows.raw: "PUMPKING_EAST_PASSAGE"

rows.original: The eastern doorway is locked. You’ll have to find a key to get inside.
rows.translation: 东侧门被锁住了。你得找到钥匙才能进去。
rows.raw: " The eastern doorway is locked. You’ll have to find a key to get inside."

rows.original: You unlock the door to the east.
rows.translation: 你打开了东侧门锁。
rows.raw: " You unlock the door to the east."

rows.original: The eastern door is unlocked.
rows.translation: 东侧门已经解锁。
rows.raw: " The eastern door is unlocked."

rows.original: The main room of the castle is actually rather impressive considering the speed this place must have been thrown together with. The ceiling is high and you can see the beginnings of carvings in the walls, a series of monsters and fantasy beasts left half-done as the warning of your attack spread.
rows.translation: 考虑到这里必然是匆忙搭建而成，城堡主厅实际上相当令人印象深刻。天花板很高，墙上已经出现雕刻雏形；那是一系列尚未完工的怪物与奇幻野兽，因为你来袭的警报传开而被半途搁置。
rows.raw: "The main room of the castle is actually rather impressive considering the speed this place must have been thrown together with. The ceiling is high and you can see the beginnings of carvings in the walls, a series of monsters and fantasy beasts left half-done as the warning of your attack spread."

rows.original: The dungeon is pretty much exactly what you’d expect a dungeon to be; dank and depressing. There are four cells here, each of them... empty? Where is Penny? And why are the locks shaped like pumpkins? What is it with pumpkins in this place?
rows.translation: 地牢几乎和你预想中的地牢一模一样：潮湿阴冷、令人沮丧。这里有四间牢房，每一间都...空着？佩妮在哪里？还有，为什么锁被做成南瓜形状？这里的人到底有多迷恋南瓜？
rows.raw: "The dungeon is pretty much exactly what you’d expect a dungeon to be; dank and depressing. There are four cells here, each of them... empty? Where is Penny? And why are the locks shaped like pumpkins? What is it with pumpkins in this place?"

rows.original: The throne room is lined with orange and black banners, zil guards standing at ease up and down the walls. These must be the cream of the first zil warriors to graduate from Johr’s training. They look at you warily as you enter, ready to snap into action but so far not doing so. Meanwhile the Pump-king, sitting on her wooden throne at the far end of the hall, waves you over. It seems she wants to... talk?
rows.translation: 王座厅两侧悬挂橙黑相间的旗帜，兹尔守卫沿墙轻松站立。他们一定是首批从约尔训练中毕业的兹尔战士精锐。你进门时，他们警惕地望着你，随时准备行动，但目前还没有出手。与此同时，南瓜王坐在大厅尽头的木制王座上，招手让你过去。看来她想...谈谈？
rows.raw: "The throne room is lined with orange and black banners, zil guards standing at ease up and down the walls. These must be the cream of the first zil warriors to graduate from Johr’s training. They look at you warily as you enter, ready to snap into action but so far not doing so. Meanwhile the Pump-king, sitting on her wooden throne at the far end of the hall, waves you over. It seems she wants to... talk?"

rows.original: Pump-King
rows.translation: 南瓜王
rows.raw: "Pump-King"

rows.original: Pump-King
rows.translation: 南瓜王
rows.raw: "Pump-King"

rows.original: It seems the pump-king wants to talk, oddly. Maybe you should? Of course, this is likely to end violently no matter what you do, so resting is probably also a valid option.
rows.translation: 奇怪的是，南瓜王似乎想谈谈。也许你应该过去？当然，无论你做什么，这都很可能以暴力收场，因此先休息或许也是合理选择。
rows.raw: "It seems the pump-king wants to talk, oddly. Maybe you should? Of course, this is likely to end violently no matter what you do, so resting is probably also a valid option."

rows.original: This room consists of two large sections; on one side is a large, open area with a floor and walls covered in safety mats. Racks of quarterstaves, roughly carved rifles with floppy rubber bayonets and other training weapons line the walls as well. On the other side the walls are covered in... rather expensive-looking blast plating, actually. This was obvious before, but whoever is doing this has some serious financial power. There are targets set up on the far side of the wall, though the place is almost completely cleared of weapons. Still, maybe you can find some if you rummage around.
rows.translation: 这个房间分成两个大区；一侧是宽敞的开放场地，地面和墙壁都铺着安全垫。墙边还摆着武器架，上面放着长棍、装有柔软橡胶刺刀的粗制步枪，以及其他训练武器。另一侧的墙上覆盖着……实际上是看起来相当昂贵的防爆装甲板。这一点之前就很明显，但幕后主使确实财力雄厚。远处墙边设置了标靶，不过这里的武器几乎都被搬空了。话虽如此，四处翻找一下也许还能找到几件。
rows.raw: "This room consists of two large sections; on one side is a large, open area with a floor and walls covered in safety mats. Racks of quarterstaves, roughly carved rifles with floppy rubber bayonets and other training weapons line the walls as well. On the other side the walls are covered in... rather expensive-looking blast plating, actually. This was obvious before, but whoever is doing this has some serious financial power. There are targets set up on the far side of the wall, though the place is almost completely cleared of weapons. Still, maybe you can find some if you rummage around."

rows.original: JOHR
rows.raw: "JOHR"

rows.original: Johr
rows.translation: 约尔
rows.raw: "Johr"

rows.original: There is a lean, muscular human man watching a small group of tired-looking zil dueling with quarterstaves and barking commands and advice at them. He turns smartly to face you as you enter the room, green eyes flashing dangerously. “Name’s Johr,” he drawls, raising his weapon, “of course, the knowledge is purely academic for you, seeing as you’re not going to live long enough to use it.”
rows.translation: 一个精瘦结实的人类男人正在看一小群满脸疲惫的兹尔用长棍对练，并向他们厉声发号施令，给予指点。你走进房间时，他利落地转身面对你，绿色眼睛闪着危险的光。“我叫约尔，”他拖长语调说道，举起武器，“当然，对你来说，知道这个名字也没什么实际意义，毕竟你活不到能用上它的时候。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThere is a lean, muscular human man watching a small group of tired-looking zil dueling with quarterstaves and barking commands and advice at them. He turns smartly to face you as you enter the room, green eyes flashing dangerously. “Name’s Johr,” he drawls, raising his weapon, “of course, the knowledge is purely academic for you, seeing as you’re not going to live long enough to use it.”"

rows.original: Zil
rows.raw: "Zil"

rows.original: Fight!
rows.translation: 战斗！
rows.raw: "Fight!"

rows.original: JOHR
rows.raw: "JOHR"

rows.original: Johr’s zil trainees are still recovering from their defeat, the bee-men huddled in a corner while the least wounded among them wearily applies bandages and salves to their wounds.
rows.translation: 约尔的兹尔学徒仍未从败北中恢复过来。这些蜂人蜷缩在角落里，其中伤势最轻的一个正疲惫地为其他人的伤口包扎、敷药。
rows.raw: "\n\nJohr’s zil trainees are still recovering from their defeat, the bee-men huddled in a corner while the least wounded among them wearily applies bandages and salves to their wounds."

rows.original: A pair of human colonists are standing in an alleyway nearby, haggling with a busty gold myr woman who’s got a box of wine bottles tucked under one arm. A sign in crude English indicates she’s selling Honey Wine... or honey, straight from the tap.
rows.translation: 两个人类殖民者站在附近的小巷里，与一位丰乳金米尔女人讨价还价。她一只胳膊下夹着一箱酒瓶。一个用粗糙英语写的牌子表明，她出售蜂蜜酒……或者直接从源头供应的蜂蜜。
rows.raw: "\n\nA pair of human colonists are standing in an alleyway nearby, haggling with a busty gold myr woman who’s got a box of wine bottles tucked under one arm. A sign in crude English indicates she’s selling Honey Wine... or honey, straight from the tap. "

rows.original: A service which a third colonist is currently enjoying, nestled into her tits with a pair of her arms wrapped around him.
rows.translation: 第三位殖民者此刻正享受着后一种服务。他依偎在她的双乳间，她用其中一对手臂搂着他。
rows.raw: "A service which a third colonist is currently enjoying, nestled into her tits with a pair of her arms wrapped around him."

rows.original: Several gold myr with toolbelts around their supple waists are going about some minor repairs to the electrical wire connecting the various buildings of Esbeth, chatting and giggling gaily amongst themselves while their four arms busily make adjustments and repairs to the grid.
rows.translation: 几位金米尔柔软的腰间系着工具带，正在对连接埃斯贝斯各栋建筑的电线进行小修小补。她们一边愉快地聊天嬉笑，四条手臂一边忙着调整、修理电网。
rows.raw: "\n\nSeveral gold myr with toolbelts around their supple waists are going about some minor repairs to the electrical wire connecting the various buildings of Esbeth, chatting and giggling gaily amongst themselves while their four arms busily make adjustments and repairs to the grid."

rows.original: A gold myr with the bottom half of a naleen is slithering around, burdened by bags of shopping from one of the Esbeth stores. Looks like somebody’s gotten in the naleen nip... but she’s making the most of it, and the other colonists sure seem to like the view of plump, naked myr butt protruding behind her.
rows.translation: 一位下半身变成纳林模样的金米尔正蜿蜒前行，身上挂满从埃斯贝斯一家商店买来的大包小包。看来有人碰了纳林猫薄荷……不过她倒是乐在其中，其他殖民者似乎也很喜欢欣赏她身后露出的丰满裸臀。
rows.raw: "\n\nA gold myr with the bottom half of a naleen is slithering around, burdened by bags of shopping from one of the Esbeth stores. Looks like somebody’s gotten in the naleen nip... but she’s making the most of it, and the other colonists sure seem to like the view of plump, naked myr butt protruding behind her."

rows.original: You fly to Mhen’ga
rows.translation: 你飞往门加
rows.raw: "You fly to Mhen’ga"

rows.original: and step out of your ship.
rows.translation: ，走下飞船。
rows.raw: " and step out of your ship."

rows.original: MHENGA
rows.raw: "MHENGA"

rows.original: Mhen’ga
rows.translation: 门加
rows.raw: "Mhen’ga"

rows.original: “Alright. I’ll upload the coordinates to one of the transports. Just swipe your credit stick here and head out back.”
rows.translation: “好。我会把坐标上传到一辆运输车上。在这里刷一下你的信用棒，然后到后面去。”
rows.raw: "“Alright. I’ll upload the coordinates to one of the transports. Just swipe your credit stick here and head out back.”"

rows.original: You do so, transferring your payment to the Scout Authority and walking out into the back lot behind the structure. Several small hover-cars are arrayed there, all jungle-patterned and manned by simplistic drone pilots. One of them hails you with a wave of its mechanical arm. You slip into the car, and a moment later you’re on your way, zipping across the jungle of Mhen’ga.
rows.translation: 你照做，将费用转给侦察管理局，随后走到建筑后方的空地上。那里停着几辆小型悬浮车，全部涂着丛林迷彩，由简易无人机驾驶。其中一架挥动机械臂向你招呼。你钻进车里，片刻之后便已出发，飞速掠过门加的丛林。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou do so, transferring your payment to the Scout Authority and walking out into the back lot behind the structure. Several small hover-cars are arrayed there, all jungle-patterned and manned by simplistic drone pilots. One of them hails you with a wave of its mechanical arm. You slip into the car, and a moment later you’re on your way, zipping across the jungle of Mhen’ga."

rows.original: Not long after, you arrive at the camp, and disembark into the jungle. The hover-car zips away a minute later, leaving you behind.
rows.translation: 不久后，你抵达营地，下车走进丛林。一分钟后，悬浮车飞驰离去，将你留在这里。
rows.raw: "\n\nNot long after, you arrive at the camp, and disembark into the jungle. The hover-car zips away a minute later, leaving you behind."

rows.original: ABANDONED CAMP
rows.raw: "ABANDONED CAMP"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “I... could?” Tanis frowns at your question. “Can’t say I know where you’re talking about, it can’t be a popular destination. On the other hand, if it’s a fair distance from the Xenogen camp, there’d be some sense in it. Tell you what - if you stump up 750 credits for a comms relay and set it up at this waterfall of yours, I’ll mark it on the map for our drivers.”
rows.translation: “我……可以？”塔妮丝听到你的问题，皱起眉头。“我可不知道你说的地方在哪，那里肯定不是什么热门去处。不过，如果离异源生物科技营地够远，设个站点也有道理。这样吧，你出750信用点买个通讯中继器，在你说的瀑布那儿架好，我就把它标进司机的地图里。”
rows.raw: "“I... could?” Tanis frowns at your question. “Can’t say I know where you’re talking about, it can’t be a popular destination. On the other hand, if it’s a fair distance from the Xenogen camp, there’d be some sense in it. Tell you what - if you stump up 750 credits for a comms relay and set it up at this waterfall of yours, I’ll mark it on the map for our drivers.”"

rows.raw: "Buy"

rows.original: Nonesuch

rows.original: You hand him a chit, and after a rummage around in the back the leithan returns with a bulky drone-like device.
rows.translation: 你递给他一张付款凭条。这位莱萨人在后面翻找一番，带着一个笨重的、类似无人机的装置回来了。
rows.raw: "You hand him a chit, and after a rummage around in the back the leithan returns with a bulky drone-like device."

rows.original: “Stick it in the ground and press the button on the bottom once you’ve got it where you want it,” Tanis says. “You should be able to summon taxis straight away. We’re that good!”
rows.translation: “到了你想放的地方，就把它插进地里，再按一下底部的按钮，”塔妮丝说。“然后你应该立刻就能叫出租车了。我们就是这么高效！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Stick it in the ground and press the button on the bottom once you’ve got it where you want it,” Tanis says. “You should be able to summon taxis straight away. We’re that good!”"

rows.original: You have attained a Mhen’ga Comms Relay.
rows.translation: 你获得了门加通讯中继器。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou have attained a Mhen’ga Comms Relay."

rows.original: Mhen’ga Comms Relay
rows.raw: "Mhen’ga Comms Relay"

rows.original: The comms relay the U.G.C. Scout Authority on Mhen’ga gave you. As long as you set it up in the right place, it’ll act as a beacon for taxis.
rows.translation: 门加联合银河邦联侦察管理局给你的通讯中继器。只要把它安置在正确的地方，它就能充当出租车的导航信标。
rows.raw: "The comms relay the U.G.C. Scout Authority on Mhen’ga gave you. As long as you set it up in the right place, it’ll act as a beacon for taxis."

rows.original: Ship Hangar
rows.raw: "Ship Hangar"

rows.original: Though dubbed a hangar, this suspended platform is little more than an exposed landing pad. It’s a hexagonal, steelcrete plate, one of dozens that ring the central elevator spire. Blinking lights ring the edges to guide you when taking off or landing, and to keep other ships from clipping the platform when seeking their own. An elevator door hangs open to the south, waiting for you to press the button that will take you back to the ground, while your ship remains parked here, ready to be entered.
rows.translation: 这里虽然被称作机库，但这座悬空平台其实只是一处露天停机坪。它是一块六边形钢凝土板，也是环绕中央电梯尖塔的数十个平台之一。边缘一圈闪烁的灯光会在你起降时提供指引，也提醒其他寻找停机位的飞船避开平台。南面的电梯门敞开着，等你按下返回地面的按钮，而你的飞船仍停在这里，随时可以登上去。
rows.raw: "Though dubbed a hangar, this suspended platform is little more than an exposed landing pad. It’s a hexagonal, steelcrete plate, one of dozens that ring the central elevator spire. Blinking lights ring the edges to guide you when taking off or landing, and to keep other ships from clipping the platform when seeking their own. An elevator door hangs open to the south, waiting for you to press the button that will take you back to the ground, while your ship remains parked here, ready to be entered."

rows.original: SPACEPORT ELEVATOR
rows.raw: "SPACEPORT ELEVATOR"

rows.original: Spaceport Elevator
rows.raw: "Spaceport Elevator"

rows.original: A standard self-assembling cargo elevator towers overhead, connected to dozens of landing pads covered with brilliantly flashing lights. The supporting girders are stamped with the logo of Pyrite Heavy Industries, the subgroup of Pyrite Industries that handles the largest constructions. The whole thing still gleams like new, even in an environment so damp that the metal is sweating drops of condensation. The doors to the elevator are open; all you need to do is push the button to go back to your ship. Fences and the wall of a building to the east keep you penned in this area, but a doorway marked “Customs” to the east could be entered if you wish to explore.
rows.translation: 一座标准的自组装货运电梯高耸入空，与数十个灯光闪耀的停机坪相连。支撑梁上印着黄铁矿重工的标志，这是黄铁矿工业旗下负责超大型建筑的分部。整个结构仍亮洁如新，尽管此地潮湿得连金属表面都凝出了水珠。电梯门开着，你只需按下按钮就能回到飞船。围栏与东边一栋建筑的墙壁将你圈在这片区域，不过如果你想去探索，也可以进入东面那扇标着“海关”的门。
rows.raw: "A standard self-assembling cargo elevator towers overhead, connected to dozens of landing pads covered with brilliantly flashing lights. The supporting girders are stamped with the logo of Pyrite Heavy Industries, the subgroup of Pyrite Industries that handles the largest constructions. The whole thing still gleams like new, even in an environment so damp that the metal is sweating drops of condensation. The doors to the elevator are open; all you need to do is push the button to go back to your ship. Fences and the wall of a building to the east keep you penned in this area, but a doorway marked “Customs” to the east could be entered if you wish to explore."

rows.original: CUSTOMS OFFICE
rows.raw: "CUSTOMS OFFICE"

rows.original: Customs Office
rows.raw: "Customs Office"

rows.original: This office is one of many set up around the spaceport to process customs both coming and going. Other identical rooms can be spotted through doorways to the north, but they appear to be closed down or currently occupied. A single, large desk sits on the east side of the room, kept fairly tidy aside from a mug filled with lollipops and candy. A name placard proclaims the desk’s owner to be Flahne. A doorway to the west opens out back into the jungle at the base of an elevator. The door to the south is labeled ‘Out to Esbeth.’
rows.translation: 这间办公室是太空港周围众多处理出入境海关事务的办公室之一。通过北面的门口能看到其他相同的房间，不过它们似乎已经关闭，或是正在使用。房间东侧摆着一张大办公桌，除了一个装满棒棒糖和糖果的杯子，桌面收拾得相当整齐。桌上的姓名牌表明主人叫弗兰。西面的门通向电梯底部、丛林之中的空地。南面的门标着“前往埃斯贝斯”。
rows.raw: "This office is one of many set up around the spaceport to process customs both coming and going. Other identical rooms can be spotted through doorways to the north, but they appear to be closed down or currently occupied. A single, large desk sits on the east side of the room, kept fairly tidy aside from a mug filled with lollipops and candy. A name placard proclaims the desk’s owner to be Flahne. A doorway to the west opens out back into the jungle at the base of an elevator. The door to the south is labeled ‘Out to Esbeth.’"

rows.original: ESBETH'S NORTH PATH
rows.raw: "ESBETH'S NORTH PATH"

rows.original: Esbeth’s North Path
rows.raw: "Esbeth’s North Path"

rows.original: This small jungle town, Esbeth, doesn’t even have proper roads. There’s a hard-packed path underfoot, still blackened in places from when some kind of torch was used to burn away the omnipresent overgrowth. Prefabricated buildings have sprung up on all sides of this east-west path, though the one to the north is the biggest and most secure looking by far. A sign marking it as the “Office of Customs and Governance” hangs above the entrance, letting you know exactly what it is.
rows.translation: 这座名为埃斯贝斯的丛林小镇连条像样的道路都没有。脚下是一条夯实的土路，有些地方仍留着焦黑痕迹，显然曾有人用某种喷火工具烧掉无处不在的杂草藤蔓。预制建筑沿这条东西向小路拔地而起，其中北面那栋远比其他建筑更大，看起来也更坚固。入口上方挂着“海关与行政办公室”的招牌，清楚说明了它的用途。

A sign marking it as the “Office of Customs and Governance” hangs above the entrance, letting you know exactly what it is."

rows.raw: "NORTHWEST ESBETH"

rows.original: Northwest Esbeth
rows.raw: "Northwest Esbeth"

rows.original: Turning 90 degrees, the hard-packed path that serves as Esbeth’s only road hooks south and east from here, marking the northwest-most portion of town. A secure, barbed-wire-topped fence blocks off the north, though you can see the space port’s cargo elevator stretching skyward on the other side. Farther to the northwest, you can see a series of towers with cannons mounted atop them, swiveling this way and that as they eye the burned-back jungle for danger.
rows.translation: 埃斯贝斯唯一的道路是一条夯实的土路，在这里转过90度，分别伸向南方和东方，这里也是镇子的最西北角。北面被一道顶部拉着铁丝网的坚固围栏挡住，不过你能看到围栏另一侧直入天空的太空港货运电梯。更远的西北方有一排塔楼，顶上的火炮转来转去，监视着被烧退的丛林，搜寻危险。
rows.raw: "Turning 90 degrees, the hard-packed path that serves as Esbeth’s only road hooks south and east from here, marking the northwest-most portion of town. A secure, barbed-wire-topped fence blocks off the north, though you can see the space port’s cargo elevator stretching skyward on the other side. Farther to the northwest, you can see a series of towers with cannons mounted atop them, swiveling this way and that as they eye the burned-back jungle for danger."

rows.original: WEST ESBETH 1
rows.raw: "WEST ESBETH 1"

rows.original: West Esbeth
rows.raw: "West Esbeth"

rows.original: GOLD MYR EMBASSY
rows.raw: "GOLD MYR EMBASSY"

rows.original: The western side of Esbeth is barely more than the tamped down path you now tread. Self-assembling, pre-fabricated houses have been set up here and there by the settlers brave enough to try their luck on a new, untested planet. Thus far, Mhen’ga has not sent its jungles in to claim the small town, but that doesn’t mean it won’t. The path bends farther to the north and continues straight on to the south.
rows.translation: 埃斯贝斯的西侧几乎只有你脚下这条压实的小路。敢于到这颗未经探索的新星球碰运气的定居者，在各处搭起了自组装预制房屋。到目前为止，门加还没有派出它的丛林来吞没这座小镇，但这并不代表以后也不会。小路向北弯去，向南则笔直延伸。

Thus far, Mhen’ga has not sent its jungles in to claim the small town, but that doesn’t mean it won’t. The path bends farther to the north and continues straight on to the south. "

rows.original: To the east you see one of the many pre-fabricated buildings in the colony, somewhat out of place among the shacks and more nondescript buildings. A pair of industrial stacks spewing out harmless wafts of steam denotes use, while the colorful and somewhat stretched sign up front states their purpose: “Crazy Carl’s Crude Cylinder Collection Cache”. The crude neon outline of a handgun helps you fill in the blanks.
rows.translation: 东面有一栋殖民地常见的预制建筑，夹在棚屋与其他不起眼的房屋之间，显得有些格格不入。两根工业烟囱冒着无害的蒸汽，说明那里正在营业，而门前色彩鲜艳、字样略显拉长的招牌标明了用途：“疯卡尔粗制枪械收藏仓”。一幅粗糙的霓虹手枪轮廓帮你弄清了它究竟是做什么的。

rows.original: The western building has been opened up, and a pair of gold myr women are standing outside with rifles slung over their shoulders. A sign above the door in clear, crisp English says “Embassy of the Gilden Republics, Mhen’ga.”
rows.translation: 西面的建筑已经开放，两位金米尔女人肩上挎着步枪站在外面。门上的招牌用清晰工整的英语写着“吉尔登共和国驻门加大使馆”。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe western building has been opened up, and a pair of gold myr women are standing outside with rifles slung over their shoulders. A sign above the door in clear, crisp English says “Embassy of the Gilden Republics, Mhen’ga.”"

rows.original: The western building is closed and locked, for now.
rows.translation: 西面的建筑暂时关门上锁了。
rows.raw: "The western building is closed and locked, for now."

rows.original: WEST ESBETH 2
rows.raw: "WEST ESBETH 2"

rows.original: West Esbeth
rows.raw: "West Esbeth"

rows.original: The western path continues north and south along the western edge of town. You can see guard towers rising to the west, mounted with automated guns. The ground here is scorched black; whenever they cleared the jungle, they obviously burned this part a bit too long. You can still smell the charred carbon hanging in the air.
rows.translation: 西侧小路沿着镇子的西缘向南北延伸。西面耸立着装有自动机枪的哨塔。这里的地面焦黑一片；清理丛林时，他们显然把这一带烧得有点过头。你仍能闻到空气中弥漫的焦炭气味。
rows.raw: "The western path continues north and south along the western edge of town. You can see guard towers rising to the west, mounted with automated guns. The ground here is scorched black; whenever they cleared the jungle, they obviously burned this part a bit too long. You can still smell the charred carbon hanging in the air."

rows.original: Southwest Esbeth
rows.raw: "Southwest Esbeth"

rows.original: Here, Esbeth’s single road bends north and east, wrapping around this corner of the town. There isn’t much to see here, just some locked domiciles to the south and west and the same guard towers that ring the rest of the settlement. Distantly, you can make out the spaceport that towers over the north side of the town and your ship perched high on its landing pad.
rows.translation: 在这里，埃斯贝斯唯一的道路转向北方和东方，绕过镇子的这一角。这里没什么可看的，只有南面和西面几栋上锁的住宅，以及与定居点其他地方相同的哨塔。远处能看见镇子北侧高耸的太空港，还有你的飞船，高高停在停机坪上。

There isn’t much to see here, just some locked domiciles to the south and west and the same guard towers that ring the rest of the settlement. rows.original: The southern portion of Esbeth’s lone, circular road stretches east and west from here. To the west, it curls up to the north in a 90 degree bend. The scent of sweet alien flowers graces your nose here, a pleasant distraction from the aroma of charred-away vegetation and freshly installed plumbing that plagues most of this place. You can see the trees in the distance, dark and foreboding but undoubtedly full of life and riches. To the south is what looks like a small, rambling junkyard, overflowing with spaceship and auto scrap. There is a flat-roofed stone hut buried in the detritus - a wooden sign bolted onto the front declares it to be “The Art of Scrapyard Maintenance”. The ‘O’ is a painted Yin-Yang symbol.
rows.translation: 埃斯贝斯唯一那条环形道路的南段从这里向东西两边延伸。西边的道路在一个90度弯处转向北方。这里能闻到外星花朵的甜香，令人愉悦地暂时忘记此地大部分区域弥漫的焦植物味和新装管道的气味。远处的树木阴暗而不祥，但其中无疑充满生命与财富。南面看起来是一处杂乱的小型废料场，堆满飞船和汽车的废件。废料中藏着一间平顶石屋，正面用螺栓固定的木牌上写着“废料场养护的艺术”。其中的“O”被画成了阴阳图案。
rows.raw: "The southern portion of Esbeth’s lone, circular road stretches east and west from here. To the west, it curls up to the north in a 90 degree bend. The scent of sweet alien flowers graces your nose here, a pleasant distraction from the aroma of charred-away vegetation and freshly installed plumbing that plagues most of this place. You can see the trees in the distance, dark and foreboding but undoubtedly full of life and riches. To the south is what looks like a small, rambling junkyard, overflowing with spaceship and auto scrap. There is a flat-roofed stone hut buried in the detritus - a wooden sign bolted onto the front declares it to be “The Art of Scrapyard Maintenance”. The ‘O’ is a painted Yin-Yang symbol."

rows.raw: "South Esbeth"

rows.original: Traffic on these hard-packed paths is light the whole way around the small town of Esbeth. No matter where you are, you usually don’t see more than a few people. Most of them appear to be townsfolk on the way to some errand or in the process of improving a ramshackle abode, but every now and again you see someone who is out hunting and prospecting like yourself, kitted out for a fight and looking at everything with sharp eyes. The building to the north is a monolithic looking thing labeled ‘Xenogen Biotech.’ A large doorway to the north provides access, and the road goes on to the east and west.
rows.translation: 绕着埃斯贝斯小镇的这些夯实土路上，行人一直不多。无论走到哪里，通常都只能见到几个人。大部分似乎是正在办事的居民，或是在修缮摇摇欲坠的住所，但偶尔也能看见和你一样出来狩猎、勘探的人。他们全副武装，目光锐利地扫视一切。北面的建筑看起来如同巨大的整块石碑，上面标着“异源生物科技”。北面一扇大门可供出入，道路则向东西两边继续延伸。

The building to the north is a monolithic looking thing labeled ‘Xenogen Biotech.’ A large doorway to the north provides access, and the road goes on to the east and west."
