rows.original: A gust of pollen tickles a sneeze out of your nose as you traverse the southern edge of the town of Esbeth. To the north is an obvious U.G.C. Peacekeeper office building, while to the south is a U.G.C. Scout Authority transport station. The minor structures to the north and south are simple and plain, guarded with closed, locked doors that make it obvious there’s nothing to be done inside. Townspeople give you respectful nods as they pass but otherwise want nothing to do with you. While the road goes east and west, just east of here it doglegs north.
rows.translation: 沿埃斯贝斯南缘行走时，一阵花粉吹来，痒得你打了个喷嚏。北面显然是联合银河邦联维和部队的办公楼，南面则是联合银河邦联侦察管理局的运输站。南北两侧的小建筑简单朴素，门都关着、锁着，显然没有什么值得进去做的事。路过的镇民会礼貌地点头，除此之外便不想与你有任何瓜葛。道路向东西延伸，但就在不远的东面拐向北方。

rows.original: The office of the U.G.C. Scout Authority is a cramped, cluttered office full of maps, vehicle parts, and hunting trophies. You duck and weave through the office until you arrive at the front desk, which is manned by a sturdily-built tauric man whose lower body is plated with black scales. He gives you a friendly nod as you approach
rows.translation: 联合银河邦联侦察管理局的办公室狭小凌乱，堆满地图、车辆零件和狩猎战利品。你一路低头侧身穿过办公室，来到前台。柜台后是一位体格壮硕的半人马形男子，下半身覆盖着黑色鳞片。见你走近，他友好地点点头

He gives you a friendly nod as you approach"

rows.original: The packed earth of Esbeth’s only path veers north and west away from you on its circuit of the town. To the southeast, you can see a simple tower built of plain girders that supports an automated turret. It swivels this way and that, a silent sentinel that protects the town from whatever horrors lurk in the jungle. There are blessedly few craters around the burned-out periphery, indicating that they haven’t had to fire all that often, thankfully.
rows.translation: 埃斯贝斯唯一那条夯实土路在此向北和向西转去，继续绕镇延伸。东南面可见一座由普通钢梁搭成的简易塔楼，上面架着自动炮塔。炮塔不断转动，如同沉默的哨兵，保护小镇免受丛林中潜藏的恐怖威胁。令人欣慰的是，被烧焦的边缘地带很少有弹坑，说明它们幸好不怎么需要开火。

rows.original:
There are few people around this area of town and even fewer houses. Perhaps this is due to this place’s proximity to the town’s eastern exit. Just to the north, a path splits off to the east towards the jungle. Now and again, you can see individuals like yourself venturing out to brave the dangers and discover what treasures they can. Watchtowers guard the town’s safekeeping, and the jungle has been burnt back far enough to give the autoguns on top of them a good sight line. You suppose this town is about as safe a place as you can find in the untamed wilderness.

There is a small shack to the east painted pure, alabaster white. The door has a crimson cross, the universal symbol for medical aid, glued to it. It must be what passes for a hospital on this planet.
rows.translation:
镇上这一带人很少，房屋更少。也许是因为这里离镇子的东出口很近。就在北边，一条小路从大路向东分出，通往丛林。你不时能看见和你一样的人出发去面对危险，发掘可能存在的宝藏。哨塔守卫着镇子的安宁，丛林也已被烧退得足够远，给塔上的自动机枪留出了良好的射界。你觉得，在这片未经驯服的荒野中，这座镇子已经算相当安全的地方了。

东面有一间刷成纯粹雪白色的小棚屋。门上贴着深红色十字，这是医疗救助的通用标志。它想必就是这颗星球上的医院了。

The door has a crimson cross, the universal symbol for medical aid, glued to it. It must be what passes for a hospital on this planet."

rows.original: The entrance to Esbeth is positioned just to the east of here. It is only an entrance in name, however. The town has no proper walls just yet, just a set of towers providing overwatch against the ever-growing foliage. The entrance is a narrow, barely-trod path that disappears into the trees to the east. Midway towards the forest, there’s a small sign staked, though you’re still too far away to read it. Esbeth’s circuitous path continues north and south from here, following the edge of the town.
rows.translation: 埃斯贝斯的入口就在东边不远处。不过，这只是名义上的入口。镇子还没有像样的围墙，只有一组塔楼，警戒着不断生长的植被。入口是一条少有人走的狭窄小径，向东隐没在树林中。通往森林的半路插着一块小牌子，不过你还离得太远，看不清上面的字。埃斯贝斯环形的小路从这里沿镇子边缘向南北延伸。

rows.original: Esbeth’s single road twists to the south and west here, spoking out in straight lines that run in those directions.
rows.translation: 埃斯贝斯唯一的道路在这里转向南方和西方，分别笔直地通往这两个方向。
rows.raw: "Esbeth’s single road twists to the south and west here, spoking out in straight lines that run in those directions."

rows.original: The path here is as barren and burned-out as everywhere else in town, but the houses on either side are fresh and new, though a few places show signs of rust already. To the south, you can see the eastern exit of town splitting off from the roadway. There are occasionally other adventurers, like you, on their way, but they pay you no mind.
rows.translation: 这里的小路和镇上其他地方一样光秃焦黑，但两旁的房屋崭新鲜亮，尽管少数地方已经露出锈迹。南面可以看见镇子的东出口从道路上分出去。偶尔有与你一样的冒险者路过，不过他们没有理会你。
rows.raw: " The path here is as barren and burned-out as everywhere else in town, but the houses on either side are fresh and new, though a few places show signs of rust already. To the south, you can see the eastern exit of town splitting off from the roadway. There are occasionally other adventurers, like you, on their way, but they pay you no mind."

rows.original: The soft-jade facade of [flags.VENUS_APT|[venus.name]'s home|one particular residence] immediately draws your attention from the dull procession of prefabs lining the main path. A perfume wafts from it - floral and faintly honeyed.
rows.translation: [flags.VENUS_APT|[venus.name]'s home|one particular residence]柔和的玉绿色外墙立刻吸引了你的注意，让你不再看主路两旁单调的预制房屋。那里飘来一阵芳香，花香里带着淡淡蜜意。
rows.raw: " The soft-jade facade of [flags.VENUS_APT|[venus.name]'s home|one particular residence] immediately draws your attention from the dull procession of prefabs lining the main path. A perfume wafts from it - floral and faintly honeyed."

rows.original: NORTH ESBETH 1
rows.raw: "NORTH ESBETH 1"

rows.original: North Esbeth
rows.raw: "North Esbeth"

rows.original: Prefabricated structures line this busy road to the north and south. It’s busier here than it is much further east, most likely due to the mead hall that lies northwest of here. The other buildings all appear to be residences, with closed, locked doors. Either their owners are out and about or they don’t wish to be disturbed by a random explorer. A guard tower can be seen to the northeast, looming over the city to provide protection.
rows.translation: 预制建筑排列在这条繁忙道路的南北两侧。这里比更东边热闹，多半是因为西北方那家蜜酒馆。其他建筑似乎都是住宅，门都关着、锁着。主人要么外出了，要么不愿被随便路过的探险者打扰。东北面可以看到一座哨塔，俯瞰城镇，提供保护。
rows.raw: "Prefabricated structures line this busy road to the north and south. It’s busier here than it is much further east, most likely due to the mead hall that lies northwest of here. The other buildings all appear to be residences, with closed, locked doors. Either their owners are out and about or they don’t wish to be disturbed by a random explorer. A guard tower can be seen to the northeast, looming over the city to provide protection."

rows.original: North Esbeth
rows.raw: "North Esbeth"

rows.original: The simple path you tread upon heads straight to the east and west from here. Foot traffic is high here, either because of the customs building to the northwest or the bar to the north. Closer inspection reveals the northern building to actually be a mead hall of some description - “Burt’s Badass Mead Hall” it says on the sign. This building actually integrates some wood from the jungle into its construction, contrasting quite noticeably with its neighbors.
rows.translation: 你脚下这条简易小路从这里笔直向东西两边延伸。这里行人很多，可能是因为西北的海关大楼，也可能是因为北面的酒吧。仔细一看，北面那栋建筑其实是某种蜜酒馆，招牌上写着“伯特的霸气蜜酒馆”。这栋建筑还用上了一些丛林里的木材，与邻近房屋形成鲜明对比。
rows.raw: "The simple path you tread upon heads straight to the east and west from here. Foot traffic is high here, either because of the customs building to the northwest or the bar to the north. Closer inspection reveals the northern building to actually be a mead hall of some description - “Burt’s Badass Mead Hall” it says on the sign. This building actually integrates some wood from the jungle into its construction, contrasting quite noticeably with its neighbors."

rows.raw: "Burt’s Badass Mead Hall"

rows.original: A cloud of smoky inhalants hangs around the rafters of this high-ceilinged chamber to lend this place an air of mystery. The obnoxious music playing from an illuminated audio system in the corner along with the noisy beeps of a gaming system dispel that notion immediately. A huge bar lies against the western wall, shining dully in the artificial lighting. It’s obviously the most well-maintained and cared for object in the entire establishment. A doorway to the south leads back out onto the streets of Mhen’ga.
rows.translation: 一团烟雾缭绕在这间高顶厅堂的椽梁间，给这里添了几分神秘气息。角落里发光的音响播放着刺耳的音乐，游戏机也在嘈杂地哔哔作响，立刻把这份神秘驱散了。巨大的吧台靠着西墙，在人工灯光下泛着暗淡光泽。它显然是整间店里维护得最好、最受爱护的东西。南面一道门通回门加的街道。

A huge bar lies against the western wall, shining dully in the artificial lighting. It’s obviously the most well-maintained and cared for object in the entire establishment. A doorway to the south leads back out onto the streets of Mhen’ga."

rows.translation: 你注意到，几位金米尔如今也成了蜜酒馆的顾客，空气中弥漫着浓郁的蜂蜜香气。

rows.original: This secluded area of the bar is mostly empty. The few people bothering to hang out back here don’t seem to have any interest in communicating, leaving you with only the darkness for company. Empty tables abound, but the better-lit hall to the south looks infinitely more companionable.
rows.translation: 酒吧这个偏僻区域大多空着。少数愿意待在后面的人似乎都没兴趣交谈，只留下黑暗陪伴你。空桌随处都是，不过南面灯光更好的大厅看起来要友善热闹得多。
rows.raw: "This secluded area of the bar is mostly empty. The few people bothering to hang out back here don’t seem to have any interest in communicating, leaving you with only the darkness for company. Empty tables abound, but the better-lit hall to the south looks infinitely more companionable."

rows.original: BURT'S BACK END
rows.raw: "BURT'S BACK END"

rows.original: A bunny-girl is back here with another patron, too busy to pay any attention to you.
rows.translation: 一位兔女郎正和另一位客人待在后面，忙得顾不上理你。
rows.raw: "\n\nA bunny-girl is back here with another patron, too busy to pay any attention to you."

rows.original: XXX
rows.raw: "XXX"

rows.original: EAST ESBETH EXIT
rows.raw: "EAST ESBETH EXIT"

rows.original: East Esbeth Exit
rows.raw: "East Esbeth Exit"

rows.original: This scorched path is half as wide as the ones in the town of Esbeth. Grass is already growing back along the edges of it. Jutting up alongside, a single sign post warns: Danger! Do not enter the jungle unarmed. Native creatures are proven to be both hostile and extremely sexual. Huge trees loom up to the east where the burn-out ends, swallowing the path as it winds between them. If you go east, you’ll be in the jungle. The town of Esbeth lies a short walk to the west.
rows.translation: 这条焦黑小路只有埃斯贝斯镇上道路的一半宽，边缘已经重新长出青草。旁边竖着一根孤零零的路牌，警告道：危险！切勿在未携带武器的情况下进入丛林。已证实当地生物具有敌意，且性欲极强。东面，烧灼过的地带尽头耸立着参天巨树，小路在树间蜿蜒，被它们吞没。往东走，你就会进入丛林。往西走不远便是埃斯贝斯镇。
rows.raw: "This scorched path is half as wide as the ones in the town of Esbeth. Grass is already growing back along the edges of it. Jutting up alongside, a single sign post warns: Danger! Do not enter the jungle unarmed. Native creatures are proven to be both hostile and extremely sexual. Huge trees loom up to the east where the burn-out ends, swallowing the path as it winds between them. If you go east, you’ll be in the jungle. The town of Esbeth lies a short walk to the west."

rows.original: EAST ESBETH EXIT
rows.raw: "EAST ESBETH EXIT"

rows.original: JUNGLE EDGE
rows.raw: "JUNGLE EDGE"

rows.original: Jungle Edge
rows.raw: "Jungle Edge"

rows.original: The shadows of alien trees shroud you in darkness here, though your eyes soon adjust. To the west, the path is obviously man-made, running straight through the gates into town. But here, it curves to the south, while a footpath meets it from the east. Both twist and turn out of sight, perhaps routing around the huge trees, some of which are well over ten feet thick. Foreign howls, birdcalls, and rustling vegetation keep your nerves on end. This is not a safe place.
rows.translation: 外星树木的阴影将你笼罩在黑暗中，不过你的眼睛很快便适应了。西面的小路显然由人工修建，笔直穿过镇门。但到了这里，它转向南方，同时一条东来的小径也汇入其中。两条路都曲折地消失在视野外，也许是在绕过那些巨树，其中有些树干直径远超过十英尺。陌生的嚎叫、鸟鸣和植物摩擦的沙沙声让你的神经持续紧绷。这里不安全。
rows.raw: "The shadows of alien trees shroud you in darkness here, though your eyes soon adjust. To the west, the path is obviously man-made, running straight through the gates into town. But here, it curves to the south, while a footpath meets it from the east. Both twist and turn out of sight, perhaps routing around the huge trees, some of which are well over ten feet thick. Foreign howls, birdcalls, and rustling vegetation keep your nerves on end. This is not a safe place."

rows.original: FERNGROWTH PATH 1
rows.raw: "FERNGROWTH PATH 1"

rows.original: Ferngrowth Path
rows.raw: "Ferngrowth Path"

rows.original: Stepping carefully through the brush, you do your best to stay on the trail. The foliage is so thick that if you were to leave it, you’d be lost in no time. Huge, alien ferns gird the sides of the path, and you can see that something has been cutting them back to keep the path clear. Whether other adventurers from Esbeth are responsible or some of the locals is unclear. The air is humid and hot, not oppressively so. The path winds northward, deeper into the jungle, and west, back towards the open air around Esbeth.
rows.translation: 你小心穿过灌木，尽量留在小径上。植被如此茂密，一旦离开道路，你很快就会迷路。几乎与你等高的巨型外星蕨类簇拥着道路两旁，看得出有什么东西一直在修剪它们，让小路保持畅通。不清楚这是埃斯贝斯的其他冒险者所为，还是某些当地居民做的。空气湿热，但还没到令人难受的地步。小路向北蜿蜒，深入丛林，向西则通回埃斯贝斯周围的开阔地带。
rows.raw: "Stepping carefully through the brush, you do your best to stay on the trail. The foliage is so thick that if you were to leave it, you’d be lost in no time. Huge, alien ferns gird the sides of the path, and you can see that something has been cutting them back to keep the path clear. Whether other adventurers from Esbeth are responsible or some of the locals is unclear. The air is humid and hot, not oppressively so. The path winds northward, deeper into the jungle, and west, back towards the open air around Esbeth."

rows.original: FERNGROWTH PATH 2
rows.raw: "FERNGROWTH PATH 2"

rows.original: Ferngrowth Path
rows.raw: "Ferngrowth Path"

rows.original: The air here is thick with pollen, nearly bringing a sneeze to your nose as you look about. Dozens of gigantic trees stretch toward the sky, so high that you’re not even sure how high they reach. You’d need some decent equipment to even begin to hazard a guess. Ferns nearly as tall as you have grown up on all sides. The path itself is narrow and packed hard by traffic, unlike the soft earth alongside it.
rows.translation: 这里空气中的花粉浓得让你环顾四周时几乎打出喷嚏。数十棵巨树直指天空，高得让你甚至无法确定它们究竟有多高。恐怕得有些像样的设备，你才有资格猜上一猜。几乎与你一样高的蕨类长满四周。小路本身很窄，被来往踩踏得坚实，与两侧松软的泥土不同。
rows.raw: "The air here is thick with pollen, nearly bringing a sneeze to your nose as you look about. Dozens of gigantic trees stretch toward the sky, so high that you’re not even sure how high they reach. You’d need some decent equipment to even begin to hazard a guess. Ferns nearly as tall as you have grown up on all sides. The path itself is narrow and packed hard by traffic, unlike the soft earth alongside it."

rows.original: FERNGROWTH BEND 1
rows.raw: "FERNGROWTH BEND 1"

rows.original: Ferngrowth Bend
rows.raw: "Ferngrowth Bend"

rows.original: The claustrophobic path twists here, cocked to wind north and west around the trunk of a giant, gray-barked tree. The lower branches are covered with leaves of the deepest purple, large, wet looking leaves that seem to dip under their own weight. No sunlight reaches past the upper canopy to fall on them, but the tree is producing them all the same. The ferns around the path are tall and alien but undoubtedly similar to Earth’s. Convergent evolution at work, you suppose.
rows.translation: 这条令人憋闷的小路在这里拐弯，绕着一棵灰皮巨树的树干向北和向西延伸。低处的枝条覆满深紫色叶片，硕大湿润，看起来连自身重量都难以承受，低低地垂着。没有阳光能穿过上层树冠照到它们，但这棵树仍然长出了这些叶子。路旁的蕨类高大而陌生，却无疑与地球蕨类相似。你猜，这是趋同演化的结果。
rows.raw: "The claustrophobic path twists here, cocked to wind north and west around the trunk of a giant, gray-barked tree. The lower branches are covered with leaves of the deepest purple, large, wet looking leaves that seem to dip under their own weight. No sunlight reaches past the upper canopy to fall on them, but the tree is producing them all the same. The ferns around the path are tall and alien but undoubtedly similar to Earth’s. Convergent evolution at work, you suppose."

rows.original: FERNGROWTH PATH 3
rows.raw: "FERNGROWTH PATH 3"

rows.original: Ferngrowth Path
rows.raw: "Ferngrowth Path"

rows.original: Hanging ominously overhead, gigantic ferns tower over the path. While this casts the area into deep shadow, it also broadens the navigable area quite nicely, allowing you to see something besides bushy green leaves for a chance. The ground on either side is a deep, rich brown, and moist with water that constantly seems to drip from the plants above. It is bare except for the ferns and flat, round disks that you surmise are mushroom-like in nature.
rows.translation: 巨大的蕨类阴森地悬在上方，高高笼罩小路。虽然这让此地陷入浓重阴影，但也相当好地拓宽了可通行区域，让你终于能看到茂密绿叶之外的东西。两侧的土地呈浓郁的深褐色，上方植物似乎不断滴下水珠，使地面湿漉漉的。除了蕨类与一些扁平的圆盘状物，这里光秃秃的；你猜那些圆盘大概是类似蘑菇的东西。
rows.raw: "Hanging ominously overhead, gigantic ferns tower over the path. While this casts the area into deep shadow, it also broadens the navigable area quite nicely, allowing you to see something besides bushy green leaves for a chance. The ground on either side is a deep, rich brown, and moist with water that constantly seems to drip from the plants above. It is bare except for the ferns and flat, round disks that you surmise are mushroom-like in nature."

rows.original: FERNGROWTH PATH 4
rows.raw: "FERNGROWTH PATH 4"

rows.original: Ferngrowth Path
rows.raw: "Ferngrowth Path"

rows.original: Ferns sprout up on all sides of the path, but for some reason, they haven’t encroached on it just yet. These particular specimens reach up about four feet, but just to the west there is a patch of them so giant that they tower overhead. You can also see that the vegetation and terrain around the path changes wildly to the east. There, the paths are much more open and the vegetation less dense. How odd.
rows.translation: 小路四周长满蕨类，但不知为什么，它们还没有侵占道路。这些蕨类大约四英尺高，西边不远处却有一片巨大得足以高过你头顶。你还能看见东面的小路周围，植被和地形发生了剧烈变化。那边的道路开阔得多，植被也稀疏一些。真奇怪。
rows.raw: "Ferns sprout up on all sides of the path, but for some reason, they haven’t encroached on it just yet. These particular specimens reach up about four feet, but just to the west there is a patch of them so giant that they tower overhead. You can also see that the vegetation and terrain around the path changes wildly to the east. There, the paths are much more open and the vegetation less dense. How odd."

rows.original: FERNS AT LICHENS 1
rows.raw: "FERNS AT LICHENS 1"

rows.original: Ferns and Lichens
rows.raw: "Ferns and Lichens"

rows.original: The ferns that hug the pathway to the west die off here under the weight of some very aggressive lichens that have scoured them away. The western path fades here, but the ground is open to the north and south so that you can tread across soft earth in whichever direction you like. A copse of gray trees covered in bioluminescent lichens grows to the east, the trunks so close together that there’s no decent way to travel past them. The colorful composite organisms also carpet the ground in a blanket of shifting, almost psychedelic hues.
rows.translation: 西面紧贴小路的蕨类在这里消失了，被极具侵略性的地衣压制、清除。西来的小路到此渐渐不见，但南北两面土地开阔，你可以随意踏过松软的泥土。一片覆盖着生物发光地衣的灰树丛长在东面，树干挤得很紧，没什么可供穿行的空隙。那些色彩鲜艳的共生生物也铺满地面，像一条色调不断变幻、近乎迷幻的地毯。
rows.raw: "The ferns that hug the pathway to the west die off here under the weight of some very aggressive lichens that have scoured them away. The western path fades here, but the ground is open to the north and south so that you can tread across soft earth in whichever direction you like. A copse of gray trees covered in bioluminescent lichens grows to the east, the trunks so close together that there’s no decent way to travel past them. The colorful composite organisms also carpet the ground in a blanket of shifting, almost psychedelic hues."

rows.original: LICHENS BEND 1
rows.raw: "LICHENS BEND 1"

rows.original: Lichen Bend
rows.raw: "Lichen Bend"

rows.original: Twisting away, the wall of grown-over trees curves north and east from here, leaving you free to walk in either direction unhindered. Unfortunately, thorny bushes nearly six-feet high have grown up out of the lichen-covered ground to the west and south. What little you can see beyond them seems deeper, darker, and danker than the area you now inhabit. Glowing yellow lichens bathe the area around you in gentle luminance as you weigh your options.
rows.translation: 长满植被的树墙在这里弯向北方和东方，你可以畅通无阻地往这两个方向走。可惜，西面和南面覆盖地衣的土壤上长出了将近六英尺高的荆棘灌木。透过它们勉强可见的地方，似乎比你现在所处之地更深、更暗、更湿。你权衡去向时，发黄光的地衣将周围沐浴在柔和光芒中。
rows.raw: "Twisting away, the wall of grown-over trees curves north and east from here, leaving you free to walk in either direction unhindered. Unfortunately, thorny bushes nearly six-feet high have grown up out of the lichen-covered ground to the west and south. What little you can see beyond them seems deeper, darker, and danker than the area you now inhabit. Glowing yellow lichens bathe the area around you in gentle luminance as you weigh your options."

rows.original: LICHENS 1
rows.raw: "LICHENS 1"

rows.original: Lichen Jungle
rows.raw: "Lichen Jungle"

rows.original: Hardly anything seems to grow here but trees, thorns, and lichens, and the lichens have grown over both of the former. The trees grow so closely together to the north that it would be impossible to squeeze between them, while the thorns to the south are so large and thick that getting through them would be a huge pain. Purplish lights twinkle from some of the lichens around you, and it seems like every new step exposes you to a new color or trait from the oddly earth-like, indigenous life-form.
rows.translation: 这里似乎几乎只长着树木、荆棘和地衣，而后者已经爬满前两者。北面的树木挤得密不透风，根本无法从中穿过；南面的荆棘则又粗又密，想穿过去必然痛苦不堪。周围一些地衣闪烁着紫色光点，似乎每走一步，你都能在这种奇异却又像地球生物的本土生命身上发现新的色彩或特征。
rows.raw: "Hardly anything seems to grow here but trees, thorns, and lichens, and the lichens have grown over both of the former. The trees grow so closely together to the north that it would be impossible to squeeze between them, while the thorns to the south are so large and thick that getting through them would be a huge pain. Purplish lights twinkle from some of the lichens around you, and it seems like every new step exposes you to a new color or trait from the oddly earth-like, indigenous life-form."

rows.original: LICHENS AT IRONWOODS 1
rows.raw: "LICHENS AT IRONWOODS 1"

rows.original: Ironwoods and Lichens
rows.raw: "Ironwoods and Lichens"

rows.original: Here, dozens of multihued lichens clash against a larger and entirely different type of jungle life. Gigantic trees, each at least a dozen feet around, tower over you. Their rusty red bark gives them a surprisingly familiar appearance until you brush your hand against one. The stuff flakes right off on your fingers! Underneath where you touched shines a silvery metallic color. These trees’ bark is literally iron hard.
rows.translation: 这里，数十种颜色各异的地衣与另一种更巨大、完全不同的丛林生命交相映衬。巨树高耸在你头顶，每棵树干周长至少十二英尺。它们铁锈红的树皮意外地令人熟悉，直到你伸手碰到其中一棵。那东西竟直接在你的指间剥落了！碰过的地方下面露出闪亮的银色金属光泽。这些树的树皮真有铁那么硬。
rows.raw: "Here, dozens of multihued lichens clash against a larger and entirely different type of jungle life. Gigantic trees, each at least a dozen feet around, tower over you. Their rusty red bark gives them a surprisingly familiar appearance until you brush your hand against one. The stuff flakes right off on your fingers! Underneath where you touched shines a silvery metallic color. These trees’ bark is literally iron hard."

rows.original: LICHENS AND IRONWOODS 1
rows.raw: "LICHENS AND IRONWOODS 1"

rows.original: Ironwoods and Lichens
rows.raw: "Ironwoods and Lichens"

rows.original: There’s plenty of space to explore on this north-south causeway thanks to the lichen that seems to have eaten back most of the other plant-life. Tight clusters of trees block the way west, and another gigantic variety sprouts up to the east, covered in rust-red bark that closer inspection reveals to be actual iron. The lichens bathe everything but the trees to the east in gentle bioluminescence. They can’t seem to grow on the ferrous coverings of the eastern trunks and die off that way.
rows.translation: 这条南北向通道有充足的探索空间，因为地衣似乎已经吞噬、逼退了大部分其他植物。密集的树丛挡住西面，东面则长着另一种巨型树木，覆着铁锈红的树皮；仔细一看，那竟然真是铁。除了东面的树，地衣将一切沐浴在柔和的生物光中。它们似乎无法在东面树干的铁质外皮上生长，到了那里便枯死了。
rows.raw: "There’s plenty of space to explore on this north-south causeway thanks to the lichen that seems to have eaten back most of the other plant-life. Tight clusters of trees block the way west, and another gigantic variety sprouts up to the east, covered in rust-red bark that closer inspection reveals to be actual iron. The lichens bathe everything but the trees to the east in gentle bioluminescence. They can’t seem to grow on the ferrous coverings of the eastern trunks and die off that way."

rows.original: LICHENS AND IRONWOODS 2
rows.raw: "LICHENS AND IRONWOODS 2"

rows.original: Ironwoods and Lichens
rows.raw: "Ironwoods and Lichens"

rows.original: Springing lightly under your [pc.feet] as you move, the soft soil and lichenous mulch below makes your journey surprisingly pleasant, aside from the omnipresent humidity. A wall of gray trees blocks the way west, and a trunk as big as three tanks put together blocks the east. Buzzing insects swirl around everywhere, busy on their own errands. Thankfully they don’t seem to have much interest in you, perhaps due to your alien physiology.
rows.translation: 你行走时，[pc.feet]下松软的泥土与地衣腐殖质轻轻回弹。除了无处不在的潮气，这段路竟走得相当愉快。灰色树墙堵住西面，东面则被一根有三辆坦克加起来那么大的树干挡住。嗡嗡作响的昆虫四处盘旋，各忙各的。幸好它们似乎对你没什么兴趣，也许是因为你异于本地生物的生理构造。
rows.raw: "Springing lightly under your [pc.feet] as you move, the soft soil and lichenous mulch below makes your journey surprisingly pleasant, aside from the omnipresent humidity. A wall of gray trees blocks the way west, and a trunk as big as three tanks put together blocks the east. Buzzing insects swirl around everywhere, busy on their own errands. Thankfully they don’t seem to have much interest in you, perhaps due to your alien physiology."

rows.original: LICHENS AND IRONWOODS 3
rows.raw: "LICHENS AND IRONWOODS 3"

rows.original: Ironwoods and Lichens
rows.raw: "Ironwoods and Lichens"

rows.original: The jungle here is marvelously colorful. Hues of verdant green swim between vibrant yellows and lurid reds, shining up from the interwoven lichens in a rainbow of beauteous light. Whenever you press down upon some of it, the light brightens, lighting the way as you go. Ferrous trees as big as buildings rise up to the east, and smaller gray ones to the west cluster so tightly that you cannot go in that direction. There is an obvious track leading east between the looming giants, though: the undergrowth and even some of the trees have been cut back mechanically. The smell of sawdust hangs in the air.
rows.translation: 这里的丛林色彩美得惊人。翠绿在明黄与艳红之间流动，交织的地衣散发出彩虹般绚丽的光芒。每当你踩上去，光就变亮，沿途照亮道路。东面耸立着楼房般巨大的铁质树木，西边较小的灰树则紧密成丛，让你无法向那个方向前进。不过，巨树间有一条明显向东延伸的通道：灌木甚至部分树木都被机器砍掉了。空气中弥漫着木屑气味。
rows.raw: "The jungle here is marvelously colorful. Hues of verdant green swim between vibrant yellows and lurid reds, shining up from the interwoven lichens in a rainbow of beauteous light. Whenever you press down upon some of it, the light brightens, lighting the way as you go. Ferrous trees as big as buildings rise up to the east, and smaller gray ones to the west cluster so tightly that you cannot go in that direction. There is an obvious track leading east between the looming giants, though: the undergrowth and even some of the trees have been cut back mechanically. The smell of sawdust hangs in the air."

rows.original: LICHENS AT IRONWOODS 2
rows.raw: "LICHENS AT IRONWOODS 2"

rows.original: Ironwoods and Lichens
rows.raw: "Ironwoods and Lichens"

rows.original: While the path you now tread is fairly devoid of undergrowth due to some aggressive, alien lichens, there is no shortage of tree life to bar your way. A copse of gray trunks so thick that a child would be challenged to squeeze between them stands defiantly among the lichens to the southwest, even if there’s a path that circumnavigates their northern edge to your west. To the east, huge trees at least thirty feet around dot the landscape, covered in what appears to be rusty red bark. If you touch it, the red comes away like old rust, revealing a gleaming, metallic tree-trunk below. They appear to thin out a bit to the south-east - unadulterated light can be seen in that direction.
rows.translation: 虽然侵略性的外星地衣让脚下道路几乎没有灌木，但挡路的树木却不缺。西南面一片灰树干顽强地长在地衣中，挤得连孩子都难以钻过，不过你西边倒有一条沿着它们北缘绕行的小路。东面散布着周长至少三十英尺的巨树，覆着看似铁锈红的树皮。伸手一碰，红色便像旧铁锈一样脱落，露出下面闪亮的金属树干。它们在东南面似乎稀疏了些，那个方向能看见毫无遮挡的阳光。
rows.raw: "While the path you now tread is fairly devoid of undergrowth due to some aggressive, alien lichens, there is no shortage of tree life to bar your way. A copse of gray trunks so thick that a child would be challenged to squeeze between them stands defiantly among the lichens to the southwest, even if there’s a path that circumnavigates their northern edge to your west. To the east, huge trees at least thirty feet around dot the landscape, covered in what appears to be rusty red bark. If you touch it, the red comes away like old rust, revealing a gleaming, metallic tree-trunk below. They appear to thin out a bit to the south-east - unadulterated light can be seen in that direction."

rows.original: LICHENS 2
rows.raw: "LICHENS 2"

rows.original: Lichen Jungle
rows.raw: "Lichen Jungle"

rows.original: There is little plant-growth here aside from the multi-hued lichens that drape everything in their almost luminescent hues, yet somehow a group of gray-barked trees has managed to endure in the center of it all, clustered closely enough to block anyone not driving a lumber harvester. Thick thorns obscure the way north from view. Luckily, the open path you now stand upon continues both east and west of here, though it opens up for more in the former direction.
rows.translation: 除了用近乎发光的各种色彩覆盖一切的地衣，这里几乎没有其他植物，但一丛灰皮树不知为何在其中顽强存活，紧密到足以挡住任何没开伐木机的人。北面的浓密荆棘遮住了视野。幸好你脚下的开阔道路同时向东西两边延伸，其中东面更为宽敞。

Thick thorns obscure the way north from view. Luckily, the open path you now stand upon continues both east and west of here, though it opens up for more in the former direction."

rows.original: LICHENS BEND 2
rows.raw: "LICHENS BEND 2"

rows.original: Lichen Bend
rows.raw: "Lichen Bend"

rows.original: You nearly stumble face first into a mess of brambles, hidden behind a camouflaging layer of brown-green lichens that covers them like camo netting. They seem to go on forever to the north and west, effectively arresting any travel in those directions for now. Meanwhile, the path you’re now striding across twists away to the east and south, both directions equally overgrown with the odd life.
rows.translation: 你差点一头栽进一团荆棘，它们被一层褐绿色地衣藏住，像盖着伪装网。荆棘似乎无尽地向北和向西延伸，眼下彻底阻断了这两个方向的通行。与此同时，你脚下的道路弯向东方和南方，两边同样长满这种奇怪的生命。

They seem to go on forever to the north and west, effectively arresting any travel in those directions for now. Meanwhile, the path you’re now striding across twists away to the east and south, both directions equally overgrown with the odd life."

rows.original: LICHENS 3
rows.raw: "LICHENS 3"

rows.original: Lichen Jungle
rows.raw: "Lichen Jungle"

rows.original: Glowing lights of all colors assault your senses as you travel through this segment of humid forest, nearly dazzling you with their natural variations and shifting palettes. The lichens that have overgrown everything here are the source of the unearthly auras. At least you have something pretty to look at while you explore. Between the durable brambles to the west and some dense, boring-looking trees to the east, you’re hemmed onto the surprisingly open path you now tread. It leads north and south.
rows.translation: 穿过这片潮湿森林时，各色光芒冲击着你的感官，天然变幻的色调几乎晃花了你的眼睛。爬满一切的地衣正是这些奇异光晕的来源。至少探索时还有漂亮景色可看。西面坚韧的荆棘与东面浓密而平平无奇的树木，将你夹在脚下这条意外开阔的道路上。道路通向南北。
rows.raw: "Glowing lights of all colors assault your senses as you travel through this segment of humid forest, nearly dazzling you with their natural variations and shifting palettes. The lichens that have overgrown everything here are the source of the unearthly auras. At least you have something pretty to look at while you explore. Between the durable brambles to the west and some dense, boring-looking trees to the east, you’re hemmed onto the surprisingly open path you now tread. It leads north and south."

rows.original: LICHENS 4
rows.raw: "LICHENS 4"

rows.original: Lichen Jungle
rows.raw: "Lichen Jungle"

rows.original: As you travel through the glowing vegetation, it reacts to you in certain places, brightening as you near some lichenous outcroppings and dimming as you approach others. Regardless, the stuff has grown over everything, even the tough-looking trees that bar the way to the east like silent sentinels and thick, prickly thorn bushes that have grown as tall as you to the west. The lichen-carpeted path between the two travels north and south.
rows.translation: 你穿过发光植被时，它会在某些地方对你产生反应：接近某些地衣簇时变亮，接近另一些时则变暗。无论如何，这东西已经爬满了一切，连东面像沉默哨兵一样挡路的结实树木，以及西面长得与你等高的浓密刺灌木都不例外。两者之间铺着地衣的小路通向南北。
rows.raw: "As you travel through the glowing vegetation, it reacts to you in certain places, brightening as you near some lichenous outcroppings and dimming as you approach others. Regardless, the stuff has grown over everything, even the tough-looking trees that bar the way to the east like silent sentinels and thick, prickly thorn bushes that have grown as tall as you to the west. The lichen-carpeted path between the two travels north and south."

rows.original: IRONWOODS 1
rows.raw: "IRONWOODS 1"

rows.original: The Ironwoods
rows.raw: "The Ironwoods"

rows.original: There really isn’t any name more fitting for this section of Mhen’ga’s wilderness than the ironwoods. The trees here are gigantic enough to be awe-inspiring and tough enough to give more than a few lumber harvesting devices trouble. Rust is caked all over their bark, but if you brush it away, you can expose the silvery sheen of their metallic bark. The natural path you follow between them is barely obstructed by any brush as the dense canopy high above keeps things shaded enough to discourage new growth.
rows.translation: 门加这片荒野实在没有比铁木林更合适的名字。这里的树木巨大得令人敬畏，也坚硬得足以让不少伐木设备头疼。树皮上结满铁锈，但拂去锈层，就能露出金属树皮银亮的光泽。你沿着树间天然形成的小路前进，几乎没有灌木拦路，因为高处浓密的树冠遮住阳光，抑制了新生植物。
rows.raw: "There really isn’t any name more fitting for this section of Mhen’ga’s wilderness than the ironwoods. The trees here are gigantic enough to be awe-inspiring and tough enough to give more than a few lumber harvesting devices trouble. Rust is caked all over their bark, but if you brush it away, you can expose the silvery sheen of their metallic bark. The natural path you follow between them is barely obstructed by any brush as the dense canopy high above keeps things shaded enough to discourage new growth."

rows.original: IRONWOODS BEND 1
rows.raw: "IRONWOODS BEND 1"

rows.original: Ironwoods Bend
rows.raw: "Ironwoods Bend"

rows.original: Turning a sharp corner, the way between these gigantic trees veers away to the east and south. They grow like walls in their own right thanks to their tremendous size, and the branches above are so high that ones as thick as terran tree trunks look like little more than twigs. You shudder at the scale of it all as you plan your next move.
rows.translation: 巨树间的道路在这里急转，分别向东方和南方延伸。它们体积庞大，本身就像一堵堵墙；上方枝条高得连地球树干般粗的枝杈都显得像细枝。你为这惊人的规模战栗，同时盘算下一步。
rows.raw: "Turning a sharp corner, the way between these gigantic trees veers away to the east and south. They grow like walls in their own right thanks to their tremendous size, and the branches above are so high that ones as thick as terran tree trunks look like little more than twigs. You shudder at the scale of it all as you plan your next move."

rows.original: IRONWOODS 2
rows.raw: "IRONWOODS 2"

rows.original: The Ironwoods
rows.raw: "The Ironwoods"

rows.original: A fair amount of underbrush has grown here, and the soil is fairly damp. As you might expect, you can hear the babbling of a gentle-sounding brook somewhere to the east. It is likely responsible for the surge in vegetation around you, even in the dim light the ironwoods allow to reach the jungle floor. There’s still enough open ground to move to the east and the west without much issue.
rows.translation: 这里长着不少灌木，泥土也相当潮湿。正如你所料，东面某处能听见轻柔的小溪潺潺作响。即使铁木只让微光照到丛林地面，那条溪流很可能还是让周围植被繁盛起来。这里依然有足够的空地，让你轻松往东西两边走。

It is likely responsible for the surge in vegetation around you, even in the dim light the ironwoods allow to reach the jungle floor. There’s still enough open ground to move to the east and the west without much issue."

rows.original: BABBLING BROOK 1
rows.raw: "BABBLING BROOK 1"

rows.original: Babbling Brook
rows.raw: "Babbling Brook"

rows.original: Gleaming waters ripple as they flow past you, traveling from north to south in a winding torrent of liquid refreshment. Of course, this is a jungle, so the waters are probably full of parasites in spite of their apparent clarity. Ferns, bushes, and flowers of exotic colorations and appearances line the banks, and the stream itself is only a few inches deep. You should be able to cross it without issue. The path picks up on the other side, winding east and west past the gigantic ironwoods that seem so prevalent here.
rows.translation: 波光粼粼的流水从你身旁流过，由北向南蜿蜒，仿佛一股清爽的液体。当然，这里毕竟是丛林，水看起来虽清，里面大概满是寄生虫。形色奇异的蕨类、灌木和花朵簇拥溪岸，溪水本身只有几英寸深，应该能轻松涉过。对岸接上了小路，向东西两面蜿蜒，绕过这里随处可见的巨型铁木。
rows.raw: "Gleaming waters ripple as they flow past you, traveling from north to south in a winding torrent of liquid refreshment. Of course, this is a jungle, so the waters are probably full of parasites in spite of their apparent clarity. rows.original: IRONWOODS 3
rows.raw: "IRONWOODS 3"

rows.original: The Ironwoods
rows.raw: "The Ironwoods"

rows.original: Between the huge trunks of the red-tinted ironwoods, a large amount of vegetation has grown. Exotic bushes two feet high rustle on either side of the damp path, their leaves a matte blue. You can hear the sound of running water to the west, indicating the stream you crossed to get out this far. You idly brush a flake of rust from your [pc.skinFurScales] as you walk, frowning up at the tree that’s shedding such filth. You can go east and west.
rows.translation: 泛红的铁木巨干之间长满植被。两英尺高的奇异灌木在潮湿小路两侧沙沙作响，叶片是暗淡的蓝色。西面传来流水声，说明你穿过的那条小溪就在那边。你边走边随手从[pc.skinFurScales]上拂掉一片铁锈，皱眉望向那棵掉落脏东西的树。你可以往东或往西走。

You idly brush a flake of rust from your [pc.skinFurScales] as you walk, frowning up at the tree that’s shedding such filth. You can go east and west."

rows.original: IRONWOODS BEND 2
rows.raw: "IRONWOODS BEND 2"

rows.original: Ironwoods Bend
rows.raw: "Ironwoods Bend"

rows.original: A trunk as wide as a small graffball court towers above to the northeast, and the winding little trail you’ve been following curves around to the west and south. This seems to be the last of the immense rusty trunks if you go south, though a great many can be seen along the way to the west. Orange-leaved plants glimmer along either side of this trail to the south. You even spot some tracks, though you are unable to determine what kind of animal left them. They definitely don’t belong to any species you’re familiar with.
rows.translation: 东北面一根有小型格拉夫球场那么粗的树干高耸而起，你一直沿着走的蜿蜒小径则转向西方和南方。往南似乎就会离开这些巨大的锈色树干，不过西面的路上还能看到许多。南面的小径两侧闪着橙叶植物的光彩。你甚至发现了一些足迹，却认不出是什么动物留下的。它们肯定不属于任何你熟悉的物种。

This seems to be the last of the immense rusty trunks if you go south, though a great many can be seen along the way to the west. Orange-leaved plants glimmer along either side of this trail to the south. You even spot some tracks, though you are unable to determine what kind of animal left them. They definitely don’t belong to any species you’re familiar with."

rows.raw: "DENSE ORANGE 1"

rows.original: The Dense Orange
rows.raw: "The Dense Orange"

rows.original: PUMPKING_MAIN_GATE
rows.raw: "PUMPKING_MAIN_GATE"

rows.original: Orange-hued plants of all descriptions grow thickly here, forcing you to struggle past crimson vines and trample the occasional green sprout on your way. It’s rough traveling, but at least there’s still the path. It seems to have been kept clear by animals of some kind; more than a few vibrant leaves have bite-shaped chunks missing out of them. The path struggles through to the north and south.
rows.translation: 各种橙色植物在这里密集生长，迫使你挤过深红藤蔓，途中偶尔还得踩过绿色嫩芽。这段路很难走，但至少还有路。似乎有某种动物维持着道路畅通；不少鲜艳叶片都缺了像被咬掉的一块。小路艰难地向南北两边穿过植被。

It’s rough traveling, but at least there’s still the path. It seems to have been kept clear by animals of some kind; more than a few vibrant leaves have bite-shaped chunks missing out of them. The path struggles through to the north and south."

rows.original: DENSE ORANGE 2
rows.raw: "DENSE ORANGE 2"

rows.original: The Dense Orange
rows.raw: "The Dense Orange"

rows.original: The jungle on either side is flooded with orangish plants of all sizes and descriptions. There are waist-high, peach-colored ferns. There are trees with tangerine vines covering their trunks. There’s even tufts of round-bladed, orange grass under[pc.foot]. The way through this mess of spectacularly hued organic growth looks well traveled, though no obvious tracks reveal themselves. You can continue north and south from here.
rows.translation: 两侧丛林被各种大小、形状的橙色植物淹没。这里有齐腰高的桃色蕨类，有树干缠满橘色藤蔓的树，甚至[pc.foot]下还有一簇簇圆叶橙草。穿过这片绚烂植被的道路看起来常有人走，却没有明显足迹。你可以从这里继续向北或向南。
rows.raw: "The jungle on either side is flooded with orangish plants of all sizes and descriptions. There are waist-high, peach-colored ferns. There are trees with tangerine vines covering their trunks. There’s even tufts of round-bladed, orange grass under[pc.foot]. The way through this mess of spectacularly hued organic growth looks well traveled, though no obvious tracks reveal themselves. You can continue north and south from here."

rows.raw: "DENSE ORANGE 3"

rows.original: The Dense Orange
rows.raw: "The Dense Orange"

rows.original: Caterpillars as big as your thumb are swarming all over a crimson-trunked tree. A closer look reveals that the arboreal victim is already missing all its leaves and likely dead. The odd insects chitter noisily as they devour the bark, completely oblivious to your presence. You leave them and consider the trail before you; it snakes north-south through the vibrant jungle. The babbling of a brook or river can be heard distantly to the west, but there is no way through the brush in that direction.
rows.translation: 和你拇指一样大的毛毛虫爬满一棵深红树干的树。仔细一看，这棵受害的树已经没有一片叶子，大概早死了。奇异的昆虫一边啃食树皮一边吵闹地唧唧叫，对你的存在毫不在意。你离开它们，打量面前的小径；它蜿蜒穿过鲜艳丛林，通向南北。西面远处隐约传来溪流或河流的潺潺声，但那边没有穿过灌木的路。

The odd insects chitter noisily as they devour the bark, completely oblivious to your presence. You leave them and consider the trail before you; it snakes north-south through the vibrant jungle. The babbling of a brook or river can be heard distantly to the west, but there is no way through the brush in that direction."

rows.raw: "DENSE ORANGE 4"

rows.original: The Dense Orange
rows.raw: "The Dense Orange"

rows.original: Treading carefully, you do your best to traverse Mhen’ga’s less-than-hospitable terrain without injuring yourself, and thus far, it’s going fairly well. This small trail is the only way through the dense orange undergrowth that surrounds it. With enough time and effort it might be possible to blaze your own trail through the shimmering, peach-hued leaves, but it would take so long that by the time you got anywhere, the Planet Rush would be over and Mhen’ga colonized. You can follow the path north and south.
rows.translation: 你小心落脚，尽力在门加不友善的地形上穿行，避免受伤，目前还算顺利。这条小径是穿过周围浓密橙色灌木的唯一通道。只要有足够的时间和力气，也许能从那些闪亮的桃色叶片间自行开路，但耗时太长，等你走到某个地方时，星球开拓潮大概都结束了，门加也早已殖民完毕。你可以沿小路往南北走。

This small trail is the only way through the dense orange undergrowth that surrounds it. With enough time and effort it might be possible to blaze your own trail through the shimmering, peach-hued leaves, but it would take so long that by the time you got anywhere, the Planet Rush would be over and Mhen’ga colonized. You can follow the path north and south."

rows.raw: "ORANGE INTERSECTION 1"

rows.original: Orange Intersection
rows.raw: "Orange Intersection"

rows.original: The tangerine-dyed foliage is split by the meeting of two paths here. One, a narrow, old path, travels north and south through the candy-colored growth. The other snakes off to the east. It looks much less traveled. Indeed, you might not have noticed it if the gap in the plant-life weren’t so obviously illuminated thanks to the dayglow tone of the surrounding leaves.
rows.translation: 这里两条小路相交，将橘色植被分开。其中一条狭窄古老的道路向南北穿过糖果色植物，另一条则蜿蜒向东，看起来鲜有人走。的确，如果不是周围叶片鲜艳得像在发光，将植物间的缺口照得格外显眼，你也许根本不会发现它。

It looks much less traveled. Indeed, you might not have noticed it if the gap in the plant-life weren’t so obviously illuminated thanks to the dayglow tone of the surrounding leaves."

rows.raw: "DENSE ORANGE 5"

rows.raw: "The Dense Orange"

rows.raw: "DARK ORANGE CORNER 1"

rows.original: Orange plants of every shape and size grow in droves around you. Though some bear fruit of crimson or green, most types are a nearly matching shade of tangerine, perhaps to camouflage them against their peers or some other unknown purpose. Regardless, the path you’re standing on leads north towards an intersection and south towards a westward bend.
rows.translation: 各种形状大小的橙色植物成群生长在四周。虽然有些结着深红或绿色的果实，但大多数都呈近乎一致的橘色，也许是为了在同类中伪装自己，也许另有未知的用途。无论如何，脚下的小路向北通往一个岔口，向南则通往一处向西转的弯道。
rows.raw: "Orange plants of every shape and size grow in droves around you. Though some bear fruit of crimson or green, most types are a nearly matching shade of tangerine, perhaps to camouflage them against their peers or some other unknown purpose. Regardless, the path you’re standing on leads north towards an intersection and south towards a westward bend."

rows.original: DARK ORANGE CORNER 1
rows.raw: "DARK ORANGE CORNER 1"

rows.original: Dark Orange Corner
rows.raw: "Dark Orange Corner"

rows.original: You stand on the edge of darkness and light (relative to this jungle, anyway). If you follow the path to the west, the forest turns almost unacceptably dark. The canopy above that part of the woods is so dense that only a few, weak beams of light penetrate down to the forest floor. To the north, the woods lighten to a dramatic degree thanks to brilliant, almost neon plant-life that grows on all sides of the well-trod path.
rows.translation: 你站在黑暗与光明的交界处，至少对这片丛林而言是如此。沿小路向西，森林会变得暗得几乎难以忍受。那片树林上方的树冠过于浓密，只有几束微弱光线能透到地面。北面的树林则明亮得惊人，常有人走的小路四周长满鲜艳得近乎霓虹色的植物。
rows.raw: "You stand on the edge of darkness and light (relative to this jungle, anyway). If you follow the path to the west, the forest turns almost unacceptably dark. The canopy above that part of the woods is so dense that only a few, weak beams of light penetrate down to the forest floor. To the north, the woods lighten to a dramatic degree thanks to brilliant, almost neon plant-life that grows on all sides of the well-trod path."

rows.original: DEEP FOREST 1
rows.raw: "DEEP FOREST 1"

rows.original: Deep Forest
rows.raw: "Deep Forest"

rows.original: Navigation is tricky with so little light to illuminate the way, but the lack of visible light assists you in other ways, keeping brush and undergrowth to an absolute minimum. If you were so inclined, you could easily wander around the gloomy woods. It would be wise not to wander too far, however; you don’t want to get lost on such a wild planet. The woodland trail makes a straight line east to west. In the former direction, the forest lightens. In the latter, a small brook crosses the trail. The waters are crystal clear and shallow enough to cross without issue.
rows.translation: 光线如此稀少，辨路很困难，但缺光也有好处，让灌木和矮生植物少到极致。只要愿意，你可以轻松在阴暗树林中四处闲逛。不过最好别走太远，你可不想在这样一颗野性星球上迷路。林间小径笔直贯穿东西。东面的森林比较明亮，西面则有一条小溪横过小径。溪水清澈，浅得足以轻松涉过。
rows.raw: "Navigation is tricky with so little light to illuminate the way, but the lack of visible light assists you in other ways, keeping brush and undergrowth to an absolute minimum. If you were so inclined, you could easily wander around the gloomy woods. It would be wise not to wander too far, however; you don’t want to get lost on such a wild planet. The woodland trail makes a straight line east to west. In the former direction, the forest lightens. In the latter, a small brook crosses the trail. The waters are crystal clear and shallow enough to cross without issue."

rows.original: DEEP INTERSECTION 1
rows.raw: "DEEP INTERSECTION 1"

rows.original: Deep Intersection
rows.raw: "Deep Intersection"

rows.original: The well-packed earth splits off in a ‘T’ intersection - an east fork, a south fork, and a west fork. In the east-west route, the trail remains steady and smooth through the near darkness. To the south, you can see shafts of sunlight flickering down through the treetops, but it also smells thick and damp with humidity, pollen, and spores. A babbling brook crosses the path just east of here. It’s barely a few inches deep and so placid that the crossing would be little more than a damp footnote on your journey.
rows.translation: 压实的泥土在这里分成“T”形岔口，分别向东、向南和向西。东西向的小径穿过近乎漆黑的林地，始终平坦稳固。南面可以看见阳光穿过树梢，闪闪烁烁，但空气闻起来也充满潮气、花粉和孢子，湿重黏腻。就在东边不远，一条小溪潺潺流过道路，水深仅几英寸，平静得涉过去只会成为旅途中一个略微湿润的小插曲。
rows.raw: "The well-packed earth splits off in a ‘T’ intersection - an east fork, a south fork, and a west fork. In the east-west route, the trail remains steady and smooth through the near darkness. To the south, you can see shafts of sunlight flickering down through the treetops, but it also smells thick and damp with humidity, pollen, and spores. A babbling brook crosses the path just east of here. It’s barely a few inches deep and so placid that the crossing would be little more than a damp footnote on your journey."

rows.original: Deep Forest
rows.raw: "Deep Forest"

rows.original: The shadows here move with a kind of unnerving motion, twisting this way and that as unseen breezes rustle the leaves some hundreds of feet above. You continually flick your gaze around, and in a way, you’re thankful that the darkness has kept the bushes down to minimum here. There’s less places for potential foes to lurk. Unless... they’re above you? You jerk back, staring at the trees in alarm. Emptiness. Well, you can always follow the path east through the darkness or west towards a more illuminated bend.
rows.translation: 不见形影的微风吹动数百英尺高处的叶片，令这里的阴影不安地扭来扭去。你不断四下扫视，某种意义上庆幸黑暗让这里的灌木十分稀少，潜在敌人能藏身的地方也少。除非……它们在你头上？你猛地后退，惊恐地望向树木。空无一物。好吧，你总可以沿路向东穿过黑暗，或向西前往更明亮的弯道。

rows.original: Twisting, the path curves away to the north and the east. To the east, the canopy above has grown in so thick that the forest floor is in a perpetual nightfall. To the north, strange, reddish trees clash with all varieties of colored lichens. Bits of sunlight do stream down to illuminate the area you’re standing in, but it is neither as bright or as gloomy as the north and the east respectively.
rows.translation: 小路在此弯向北方和东方。东面的树冠长得极密，让林地陷入永恒的暮夜。北面，奇怪的红色树木与各种颜色的地衣争奇斗艳。少许阳光洒下，照亮你的立足之处，不过这里既没有北面那么亮，也没有东面那么暗。

To the north, strange, reddish trees clash with all varieties of colored lichens. Bits of sunlight do stream down to illuminate the area you’re standing in, but it is neither as bright or as gloomy as the north and the east respectively."

rows.original: There’s so much plant-life surrounding this path that it’s very difficult to follow. Under[pc.foot], you spot recently trampled grasses and mushroom-like growth. Whoever blazed this trail did it not so long ago, and judging by how some of the vegetation is growing back in, there hasn’t been enough traffic to keep the jungle from coming in to reclaim it. A junction with a more traveled route lies to the west. To the east, the narrow way continues.
rows.translation: 这条路被大量植物包围，十分难走。你在[pc.foot]下发现了刚被踩倒的草和类似蘑菇的东西。不久前才有人开出了这条路，从植被重新长入的程度看，过路者还不够多，阻止不了丛林收回它。西面有一处与更常有人行走的道路相接的路口。东面，狭路还在延伸。

rows.original: This unkempt, small trail bends south and west here. The foliage on either side is closing in dangerously, making it difficult to move forward without much risk, and the air here is rather stuffy. High above, you can see a number of broken branches and the odd scorch marks here and there. They seem to descend towards the south - the same direction this path is leading. You can go south, deeper into the humid jungle, or west, where the air is a little clearer.
rows.translation: 这条无人维护的小径在这里转向南方和西方。两旁植物危险地合拢，想继续前进又不冒风险相当困难，空气也颇为闷热。高处能看见不少断枝和零星焦痕。它们似乎向南逐渐降低，恰好与道路方向一致。你可以向南深入潮湿丛林，也可以向西去空气稍清爽的地方。

rows.original: The scorch marks that marred the trees high above to the north continue down and to the south here. You can see them dipping closer and closer to the jungle floor, and it truly is a jungle here. The air is far more humid than it is to the north. The buzz from the myriad life-forms, many of them insectile, is nearly deafening this deep in the jungle. The trunks of the trees seem thicker, the plant-life denser. This is unquestionably what you’d classify as ‘deep jungle’. To the north, the path leads to a slightly less overgrown area. To the south, the jungle worsens.
rows.translation: 北面高高树木上的焦痕在这里继续下降，向南延伸。你能看见它们离丛林地面越来越近，而这里确实是十足的丛林。空气比北面潮湿得多。深入此地，无数生命发出的嗡鸣几乎震耳欲聋，其中许多都是虫类。树干似乎更粗，植物也更密。这里无疑称得上“丛林深处”。北面，小径通向植被稍稀疏的区域；南面，丛林则更加繁茂。

rows.original: Droplets of water fall from higher up in this verdant, almost claustrophobic jungle. Everything seems to be coated in a fine layer of humidity from the omnipresent moisture. Perhaps it would explain why the scorched leaves on either side of the path never caught fire. A divot in the ground starts here, burrowing away to the south. It doesn’t look to get much deeper, but it does look to have charred the earth with carbon as it went. The source lies to the south.
rows.translation: 这片郁郁葱葱、几乎令人窒息的丛林里，水珠从高处落下。无处不在的水汽似乎让一切都覆着一层细密湿意。也许这能解释为什么道路两旁烧焦的叶子没有起火。一道地面凹痕从这里开始，向南延伸。看起来它不会变得太深，但经过的泥土显然都被烧得焦黑。源头在南面。

rows.original: There is so much pollen in the air here that you can’t help but stifle a series of uncontrollable sneezes. The entire place is covered in vines, flowers, and overgrowth that lacks a decent word in your language to describe it. Some of the dangling cords of plant matter even appear to be prehensile, twitching to grasp a fist-sized insect out of the air. You hear the crack of an exoskeleton break after. You had best be on guard here.
rows.translation: 这里空气中的花粉太多，你不得不压抑一连串无法控制的喷嚏。整个地方覆盖着藤蔓、花朵和茂密植物，你的语言里甚至没有合适的词来形容。其中一些垂下的植物绳索似乎还具备抓握能力，会抽动着从空中攫住拳头大的昆虫。随后你听见外骨骼碎裂的脆响。你最好在这里提高警惕。

rows.original:
At first this area looks like a bend, only allowing passage north or west. However, on second glance there is a tiny passage east through the incredibly overgrown vegetation. It hardly seems safe to squeeze through such a tight path, since it leaves you open to attack by carnivorous flora and fauna.

Small shafts of sunlight sometimes illuminate the odd patch of forest floor, but they are more like candles on a dark night than the floodlights you desire.
rows.translation:
乍看之下，这里像是一个弯道，只能向北或向西通行。但再看一眼，你便发现茂密到惊人的植被中有一条向东的小通道。挤过这么窄的路似乎不太安全，因为这会让你暴露在食肉动植物的攻击之下。

细小光束偶尔照亮一块林地，但它们更像黑夜里的蜡烛，而不是你渴望的探照灯。

It hardly seems safe to squeeze through such a tight path, since it leaves you open to attack by carnivorous flora and fauna.\n\nSmall shafts of sunlight sometimes illuminate the odd patch of forest floor, but they are more like candles on a dark night than the floodlights you desire."

rows.original: There are three distinct paths that you could follow from this point: one to the east, one to the south, and one to the west. The latter two show a distinct difference in the bordering plant-life; it’s almost entirely vines covered in flowers. You can spot the odd tree-trunk here or there, but they’re completely overgrown by the green tendrils. They seem almost... strangled. It would be wise not to stray too far from the openings in that direction. To the east, the trail looks a little less threatening, but it is still in the deep, dark jungle.
rows.translation: 从这里有三条明显的道路可走：一条向东，一条向南，一条向西。后两条路旁的植物有明显变化，几乎全是开满花的藤蔓。偶尔能看见树干，但它们已被绿色卷须完全覆盖，仿佛……被勒死了。往那边走时，最好别离开空隙太远。东面的小径看起来威胁小些，但仍处在幽暗的丛林深处。

rows.original: A vine lashes out at your [pc.foot]. Kicking it away, you briefly stumble, but nothing seems to capitalize on your momentary loss of balance. You’re probably not the prey it was looking for. There’s so many of those plant-like tentacles here that they may as well be impenetrable walls of squirming flesh. Something has been keeping them pruned back from this path enough to navigate. You can go north and south from here.
rows.translation: 一根藤蔓抽向你的[pc.foot]。你将它踢开，短暂踉跄了一下，不过似乎没有东西趁你失去平衡而发动袭击。你大概不是它要找的猎物。这里类似触手的植物多得几乎组成了一堵无法穿透的蠕动肉墙。有什么东西一直修剪着它们，让这条路还能通行。你可以从这里向北或向南走。

rows.original: The path through the tentacles takes a gentle curve to the north and east underfoot. It seems almost mechanical in the smoothness of its arc and somehow manages to stay free of the encroaching mass of vines. In fact, none of the vines bother you in the slightest as you consider your options. You hear the crack of an insect falling prey to the wriggling plantlife, ominously encouraging you to leave this place behind.
rows.translation: 触手丛中的小路在你脚下平缓地弯向北方和东方。弧线流畅得几乎像机器画出来的，而且不知怎么始终没有被藤蔓侵占。事实上，你考虑去向时，没有一根藤蔓来骚扰你。你听见一只昆虫落入蠕动植物之口时发出的碎裂声，不祥地催促你赶快离开此地。

rows.original: The unnatural, squirming walls on either side undulate like the waves of an ocean stuck on its side. It’s enough to set one’s nerves on edge, and the darkness of the deep jungle’s atmosphere doesn’t really help. A lazily buzzing bug with at least twelve finger-sized legs crosses your way, but it doesn’t stop to pay you any attention. To the west, the vines thin. To the east, both the tendrils and the path continue on much the same.
rows.translation: 两侧不自然的蠕动墙壁起伏着，仿佛被竖起来的海洋浪涛。这足以令人神经紧绷，丛林深处的黑暗气氛也毫无帮助。一只至少长着十二条手指般大小的腿的虫子，懒洋洋地嗡鸣着飞过，没有停下来理会你。西面的藤蔓稀疏了些。东面，卷须与道路都依然如故地延伸。

It’s enough to set one’s nerves on edge, and the darkness of the deep jungle’s atmosphere doesn’t really help. rows.original: A rock, almost mountain-like in proportions, towers overhead to the west of here. It’s so tall that you would be in its shadow if everything weren’t already so deeply steeped in darkness. You wager it rises up at least a few hundred feet into the air, its walls almost completely sheer. It’s been there long enough to have accumulated a healthy covering of mosses, fungi, and other growths. You can go north and south around it or east on a trail that’s surrounded by tentacles.
rows.translation: 西面耸立着一块几乎山一般巨大的岩石。它高得惊人，如果这里原本没有如此漆黑，你大概就会站在它的阴影里。你估计它至少高达数百英尺，岩壁几乎完全垂直。它在这里的时间已经久到足以长满茂盛的苔藓、真菌和其他植物。你可以向南北绕行，也可以往东走那条被触手环绕的小径。

rows.original: You stand at what could be called the corner of the mountainous boulder if it were less jagged and more orderly in its change of direction. There’s enough clear space around it for you to keep going to the south or the west along the rock face. An infestation of vines, more tentacles really, blocks the way to the north and the east. Looking at how they move, you don’t have any desire to get too close to them.
rows.translation: 如果这块山一般的巨石没那么参差不齐，转折也更规整，你所站的地方就可以称为它的拐角。周围有足够的空地，让你沿岩壁继续向南或向西。北面和东面被泛滥的藤蔓堵住，其实说是触手更合适。看着它们蠕动的样子，你一点也不想靠近。

rows.original: A flat, almost featureless rock wall rises up to the south of here, towering over you by hundreds of feet. Its cracks and crevices are almost entirely filled with colorful forms of plant life, but for some reason, nothing has grown that close to it, enabling you to walk by it to the east and the west as you wish. To the north, there’s thousands of vines bundled together. Most hang there limply, yet some are moving, squirming like tentacles. A path leads north between them, if you dare head through them.
rows.translation: 南面竖起一堵平坦、几乎毫无特征的石壁，比你高出数百英尺。裂隙几乎全被五颜六色的植物填满，但不知为什么，没有植物生长在紧贴岩壁的地方，让你能随意沿着它向东西两边走。北面纠缠着成千上万根藤蔓。大多数软软垂着，但有些正像触手般蠕动。如果你敢穿过去，它们之间有条向北的小路。

Its cracks and crevices are almost entirely filled with colorful forms of plant life, but for some reason, nothing has grown that close to it, enabling you to walk by it to the east and the west as you wish.
