rows.original: There are so many vines here that you can barely see the trees responsible for the light-obscuring canopy high above. One thing you can be sure of is that there are almost no other kinds of plants this close to the ground; the wriggling mass of botanical tentacles has consumed it all. One snaps into the air to snag a fist-sized bug as you walk, popping its exoskeleton a moment later. It lowers its prey out of sight before you can see any more. The path opens up next to a large rock to the south, or you can follow the trail to the east, through the vines.
rows.translation: 这里的藤蔓多得让你几乎看不见那些撑起高处遮光树冠的树木。可以确定的是，贴近地面的地方几乎没有其他植物；这团蠕动的植物触手把它们全吞掉了。你走过时，一根触手猛地抽向空中，抓住拳头大的昆虫，片刻便捏碎它的外骨骼。还没等你看清更多，它便把猎物放低，藏出了视野。南面，小路在一块大石旁变得开阔；你也可以沿路向东，穿过藤蔓。
rows.raw: "There are so many vines here that you can barely see the trees responsible for the light-obscuring canopy high above. One thing you can be sure of is that there are almost no other kinds of plants this close to the ground; the wriggling mass of botanical tentacles has consumed it all. One snaps into the air to snag a fist-sized bug as you walk, popping its exoskeleton a moment later. It lowers its prey out of sight before you can see any more. The path opens up next to a large rock to the south, or you can follow the trail to the east, through the vines."

rows.original: VINED JUNGLE 5
rows.raw: "VINED JUNGLE 5"

rows.original: Vined Jungle
rows.raw: "Vined Jungle"

rows.original: Placing your [pc.feet] very carefully, you take great pains not to step on any of the vines around you, lest they turn out to be predatory monstrosities. Whatever cleared the path must have instilled a healthy fear in the tendrils, because while some flail through the air above or alongside you, none reach out after you. You suspect you are mostly safe so long as you stay on the path. It leads east and west away from here.
rows.translation: 你极为小心地放下[pc.feet]，尽力不踩到身边任何藤蔓，以防它们其实是捕食怪物。清理出这条路的东西一定让这些卷须心生畏惧，因为虽然有些在你头顶或身旁挥舞，却没有一根伸过来抓你。你猜只要留在小路上，大体就安全。道路从这里向东西延伸。
rows.raw: "Placing your [pc.feet] very carefully, you take great pains not to step on any of the vines around you, lest they turn out to be predatory monstrosities. Whatever cleared the path must have instilled a healthy fear in the tendrils, because while some flail through the air above or alongside you, none reach out after you. You suspect you are mostly safe so long as you stay on the path. It leads east and west away from here."

rows.original: VINED JUNGLE 6
rows.raw: "VINED JUNGLE 6"

rows.original: Vined Jungle
rows.raw: "Vined Jungle"

rows.original: Between the darkness, the squirming plants, and the gigantic bugs that constantly flit by, you’re ready to step somewhere that doesn’t seem so obviously dangerous. A few rays of amber sunlight do trickle down, but they only serve to highlight the moist sheen that covers the green mounds. To the east, there appears to be a three-way fork. The path continues to the west unbroken.
rows.translation: 黑暗、蠕动的植物和不断飞过的巨型昆虫，已经让你迫切想走到一个看起来没那么明显危险的地方。虽然几缕琥珀色阳光透了下来，却只映出了绿色堆积物上湿润的光泽。东面似乎有一个三岔路口。小路则继续不间断地向西延伸。
rows.raw: "Between the darkness, the squirming plants, and the gigantic bugs that constantly flit by, you’re ready to step somewhere that doesn’t seem so obviously dangerous. A few rays of amber sunlight do trickle down, but they only serve to highlight the moist sheen that covers the green mounds. To the east, there appears to be a three-way fork. The path continues to the west unbroken."

rows.original: OVERGROWN ROCK 4
rows.raw: "OVERGROWN ROCK 4"

rows.original: Gigantic Rock
rows.raw: "Gigantic Rock"

rows.original: The rock face is jagged and uneven as you crest this corner of the mountainous boulder. Its craggy surface is rough and broken, and a number of boulders have fallen into a crude pile around it. There’s about fifteen feet of relatively clear space hugging its base that you can easily travel through. To the south, the jungle is so thick and dense that it would be difficult if not impossible to traverse without first burning back the overgrowth. The air here is almost as dank as the visibility is poor.
rows.translation: 绕过这块山一般巨石的拐角时，你看见岩面崎岖不平，粗糙破碎，不少落石在周围堆成杂乱石堆。岩石底部附近有大约十五英尺宽的相对空地，可以轻松通过。南面丛林浓密得惊人，不先烧掉植物，想穿过恐怕极难，甚至不可能。这里空气的湿重程度几乎与能见度的恶劣程度不相上下。
rows.raw: "The rock face is jagged and uneven as you crest this corner of the mountainous boulder. Its craggy surface is rough and broken, and a number of boulders have fallen into a crude pile around it. There’s about fifteen feet of relatively clear space hugging its base that you can easily travel through. To the south, the jungle is so thick and dense that it would be difficult if not impossible to traverse without first burning back the overgrowth. The air here is almost as dank as the visibility is poor."

rows.original: OVERGROWN ROCK 5
rows.raw: "OVERGROWN ROCK 5"

rows.original: Gigantic Rock
rows.raw: "Gigantic Rock"

rows.original: Climbing high up into the canopy, this gray-colored, monolithic slab of rock almost seems to have burst from the ground ages ago, perhaps forced out by Mhen’ga’s unearthly subterranean forces. Its surface is relatively unmarked aside from some tiny fissures that the plants have worked into it. The open space around it continues to the east and west; in the latter direction, the rock has broken apart enough to create a pile of rocks around its base.
rows.translation: 这块灰色巨石高高伸入树冠，看起来仿佛早在很久以前就从地面迸出，也许是被门加奇异的地下力量挤上来的。除了植物钻出的细小裂缝，表面相当完整。周围空地向东西两边延伸；西面岩石破裂得较多，在底部形成一堆碎石。
rows.raw: "Climbing high up into the canopy, this gray-colored, monolithic slab of rock almost seems to have burst from the ground ages ago, perhaps forced out by Mhen’ga’s unearthly subterranean forces. Its surface is relatively unmarked aside from some tiny fissures that the plants have worked into it. The open space around it continues to the east and west; in the latter direction, the rock has broken apart enough to create a pile of rocks around its base."

rows.original: OVERGROWN ROCK 6
rows.raw: "OVERGROWN ROCK 6"

rows.original: Gigantic Rock
rows.raw: "Gigantic Rock"

rows.original: The humidity is almost overpowering here. It makes the ground damp, it makes the rock shine, and it makes your [pc.skinFurScales] uncomfortably clammy. Leaves the size of small cars hang off the side of a trunk as big around as a small room. You could probably push past them if it weren’t for the thorny bushes and toothed flowers underneath. Even if you cut into the deep jungle that way, you’d be lost in no time. It’d be better to follow the open space along the sides of this rock to the east and west.
rows.translation: 这里的潮湿几乎令人无法忍受。地面湿漉漉的，岩石泛着水光，你的[pc.skinFurScales]也黏腻得难受。一根粗如小房间的树干侧面垂下小汽车般大的叶片。若不是下面还有荆棘灌木和长牙的花朵，你大概可以挤过去。但就算从那里闯进密林，你也很快就会迷路。最好还是沿巨石两侧的空地向东西走。
rows.raw: "The humidity is almost overpowering here. It makes the ground damp, it makes the rock shine, and it makes your [pc.skinFurScales] uncomfortably clammy. Leaves the size of small cars hang off the side of a trunk as big around as a small room. You could probably push past them if it weren’t for the thorny bushes and toothed flowers underneath. Even if you cut into the deep jungle that way, you’d be lost in no time. It’d be better to follow the open space along the sides of this rock to the east and west."

rows.original: There is a vertical band of a different mineral running up through the rock wall, a streak of something pitch black that seems to draw in the light. You could probably scan it with your codex and radio it in to your dad’s company for a quick prospector’s fee.
rows.translation: 岩壁中有一道不同矿物构成的竖纹，一抹漆黑似乎吸走了光线。你大概可以用法典扫描，再通过无线电报给父亲的公司，轻松赚一笔勘探费。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere is a vertical band of a different mineral running up through the rock wall, a streak of something pitch black that seems to draw in the light. You could probably scan it with your codex and radio it in to your dad’s company for a quick prospector’s fee."

rows.original: Scan Rock
rows.translation: 扫描岩石
rows.raw: "Scan Rock"

rows.original: There’s a deposit of Oxonium here, but you’ve already called in the claim to your dad’s company. They’ll probably be out to mine it once the frontier settles down a little bit.
rows.translation: 这里有一处奥克索尼姆矿藏，不过你已经把开采权申报给父亲的公司了。等边境稍微安定下来，他们大概就会过来采矿。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a deposit of Oxonium here, but you’ve already called in the claim to your dad’s company. They’ll probably be out to mine it once the frontier settles down a little bit."

rows.original: OVERGROWN ROCK 7
rows.raw: "OVERGROWN ROCK 7"

rows.original: Gigantic Rock
rows.raw: "Gigantic Rock"

rows.original: A nest of overgrown beetles erupts off the side of the rock like water from a geyser, exploding out in all directions. Their translucent wings shimmer where they cross some of the few rays of light lucky enough to penetrate this far. You wait for them to flutter off before advancing much farther, wiping some of the accumulated moisture from your brow. You can follow along the rock to the east and west. It blocks the way north, and going south into the rustling wall of alien plants would likely be a bad idea.
rows.translation: 一窝硕大的甲虫像喷泉般从岩石侧面涌出，朝四面八方炸开。少数侥幸照到这么深处的光线掠过它们时，半透明的翅膀闪闪发亮。你等它们飞散才继续前进，同时擦去额上积累的水汽。你可以沿岩石向东西两边走。岩石挡住了北面，而向南钻进沙沙作响的外星植物墙，恐怕不是好主意。
rows.raw: "A nest of overgrown beetles erupts off the side of the rock like water from a geyser, exploding out in all directions. Their translucent wings shimmer where they cross some of the few rays of light lucky enough to penetrate this far. You wait for them to flutter off before advancing much farther, wiping some of the accumulated moisture from your brow. You can follow along the rock to the east and west. It blocks the way north, and going south into the rustling wall of alien plants would likely be a bad idea."

rows.original: OVERGROWN ROCK 8
rows.raw: "OVERGROWN ROCK 8"

rows.original: Gigantic Rock
rows.raw: "Gigantic Rock"

rows.original: There’s a series of half-broken, hard corners around the edge of this granite-like monolith. You can follow it to the north and east; there’s plenty of room around it to walk, so long as you don’t mind the humidity and darkness of this part of the jungle. High as it is, the column-like trees stretch higher still and cover it all with their dense wall of greenery. You doubt that even if you had the means to climb up there that there would be any more illumination to be found. You’ll have to find your way out of the deep jungle if you ever want decent lighting again.
rows.translation: 这块类似花岗岩的巨石边缘有一连串破损的硬折角。你可以沿着它向北和向东走；只要不介意这片丛林的潮湿与黑暗，周围就有足够的步行空间。尽管它高耸，柱状树木却还要高，把一切笼罩在浓密的绿墙之下。你怀疑即使有办法爬上去，也找不到更多光线。想重新获得像样的照明，你必须走出丛林深处。
rows.raw: "There’s a series of half-broken, hard corners around the edge of this granite-like monolith. You can follow it to the north and east; there’s plenty of room around it to walk, so long as you don’t mind the humidity and darkness of this part of the jungle. High as it is, the column-like trees stretch higher still and cover it all with their dense wall of greenery. You doubt that even if you had the means to climb up there that there would be any more illumination to be found. You’ll have to find your way out of the deep jungle if you ever want decent lighting again."

rows.original: OVERGROWN ROCK 9
rows.raw: "OVERGROWN ROCK 9"

rows.original: Gigantic Rock
rows.raw: "Gigantic Rock"

rows.original: Following alongside the stone protrusion, you’re treated to all manner of exotic sights and sounds. You hear animal calls that sound like high-pitched whistles. There’s a bird whose squawk reminds you of the sound of a laser weapon going off. You even see a flower that pivots to follow you, its petals glowing an almost ultraviolet color. This truly is a strange and wonderful planet, but a touch dangerous too. The path leads north and south.
rows.translation: 沿着凸起的岩石走，你见识了各种奇异景象与声音。有的动物鸣叫像尖细的口哨；有只鸟的叫声让你想起激光武器开火。你甚至看见一朵花转向追随着你，花瓣发出近乎紫外线的颜色。这真是一颗奇妙而美丽的星球，只是也有些危险。小路通往南北。
rows.raw: "Following alongside the stone protrusion, you’re treated to all manner of exotic sights and sounds. You hear animal calls that sound like high-pitched whistles. There’s a bird whose squawk reminds you of the sound of a laser weapon going off. You even see a flower that pivots to follow you, its petals glowing an almost ultraviolet color. This truly is a strange and wonderful planet, but a touch dangerous too. The path leads north and south."

rows.original: OVERGROWN ROCK 10
rows.raw: "OVERGROWN ROCK 10"

rows.original: Gigantic Rock
rows.raw: "Gigantic Rock"

rows.original: You stand at one corner of the giant stone. From where you’re standing, you can’t even make out the top, but you can see that its surface is riddled with mosses and lichen-like growths. You wager that it has been here for quite a long time, though you’d need a geologist for an accurate guess. The surrounding plant life has stayed away from the rocky protrusion for some reason, leaving a fifteen foot wide path that you can follow around it. There is also a small, maybe three foot wide, trail in between a few dozen person-sized leaves.
rows.translation: 你站在巨石的一角。从这里根本看不见顶端，但能看见表面布满苔藓和类似地衣的生物。你估计它在这里已有很长时间，不过要准确判断，还得找地质学家。周围植物不知为何避开了这块突石，留出一条十五英尺宽的道路，可以绕着它走。此外还有一条约三英尺宽的小径，夹在几十片人一般大的叶子之间。
rows.raw: "You stand at one corner of the giant stone. From where you’re standing, you can’t even make out the top, but you can see that its surface is riddled with mosses and lichen-like growths. You wager that it has been here for quite a long time, though you’d need a geologist for an accurate guess. The surrounding plant life has stayed away from the rocky protrusion for some reason, leaving a fifteen foot wide path that you can follow around it. There is also a small, maybe three foot wide, trail in between a few dozen person-sized leaves."

rows.original: OVERGROWN ROCK 11
rows.raw: "OVERGROWN ROCK 11"

rows.original: Gigantic Rock
rows.raw: "Gigantic Rock"

rows.original: There’s a gigantic rock here; its sheer walls almost stretch up to the canopy itself. Though covered in moss and small vines, it does not look to have succumbed to the jungle’s clutches just yet. There is a path around it, leading east and west, while another path leads away to the north. That trail leads between an army of blooming purple flowers. There are so many of them that they look almost like a sea of amethyst, rustling slightly in gentle breezes.
rows.translation: 这里有一块巨大的岩石，陡峭岩壁几乎直达树冠。虽然覆着苔藓和细藤，它看起来还没有屈服于丛林的侵吞。一条道路绕着它向东西延伸，另一条则向北离开巨石，通入大片盛开的紫花之间。花朵多得仿佛紫水晶海洋，在微风中轻轻沙沙作响。
rows.raw: "There’s a gigantic rock here; its sheer walls almost stretch up to the canopy itself. Though covered in moss and small vines, it does not look to have succumbed to the jungle’s clutches just yet. There is a path around it, leading east and west, while another path leads away to the north. That trail leads between an army of blooming purple flowers. There are so many of them that they look almost like a sea of amethyst, rustling slightly in gentle breezes."

rows.original: OVERGROWN ROCK 12
rows.raw: "OVERGROWN ROCK 12"

rows.original: Gigantic Rock
rows.raw: "Gigantic Rock"

rows.original: The jungle to the north of this stone behemoth looks increasingly odd the further you go to the east. Giant flowers and vines give way to squirming masses of tentacles, some of which appear to be predatory from the way they swat at some of the passing bugs. The smooth, mossy surface of the rock is there to the south as always, and the loamy dirt alongside it never seems to become too tangled with growth. You can go east and west from here.
rows.translation: 越往东走，这块巨石北面的丛林看起来越发古怪。巨花与藤蔓逐渐变成蠕动的触手团，有些从拍打路过昆虫的动作看，似乎具有捕食性。巨石光滑而覆着苔藓的表面仍像往常一样在南面，它旁边的肥沃泥土似乎始终不会被植物缠满。你可以从这里往东或往西。
rows.raw: "The jungle to the north of this stone behemoth looks increasingly odd the further you go to the east. Giant flowers and vines give way to squirming masses of tentacles, some of which appear to be predatory from the way they swat at some of the passing bugs. The smooth, mossy surface of the rock is there to the south as always, and the loamy dirt alongside it never seems to become too tangled with growth. You can go east and west from here."

rows.original: GIANT LEAVES 1
rows.raw: "GIANT LEAVES 1"

rows.original: Giant Leaves
rows.raw: "Giant Leaves"

rows.original: Leaves of the deepest emerald surround you on all sides, growing off corded stalks that resemble miniature trees. Moisture beads on the leaves, trickling down into muddy puddles around their base. To the east of here, you can make out what looks like a cliff wall towering up into the canopy. Winding south, the gap between the leaves leads even deeper into this humid jungle.
rows.translation: 四周尽是深翡翠色的叶片，从像微型树木的绳索状茎秆上长出。水珠凝在叶面，顺着叶片流入根部周围泥泞的水洼。东面隐约有一堵岩壁，高耸至树冠。叶片间的空隙蜿蜒向南，通往这片潮湿丛林更深处。
rows.raw: "Leaves of the deepest emerald surround you on all sides, growing off corded stalks that resemble miniature trees. Moisture beads on the leaves, trickling down into muddy puddles around their base. To the east of here, you can make out what looks like a cliff wall towering up into the canopy. Winding south, the gap between the leaves leads even deeper into this humid jungle."

rows.original: GIANT LEAVES 2
rows.raw: "GIANT LEAVES 2"

rows.original: Giant Leaves
rows.raw: "Giant Leaves"

rows.original: You can see that the leaves to either side of you have been chewed away, probably by some native herbivore. Threading between them, the path rolls on to the north and to the south. The ground is mushy and soft with the amount of humidity, almost like mud, and the leaves grow in even thicker the farther south you go.
rows.translation: 你能看见两侧叶片都被啃过，大概是某种本土食草动物的杰作。小径在叶片间穿梭，向南北延伸。湿气让地面软烂得几乎像泥浆，越往南，叶片也越密。
rows.raw: "You can see that the leaves to either side of you have been chewed away, probably by some native herbivore. Threading between them, the path rolls on to the north and to the south. The ground is mushy and soft with the amount of humidity, almost like mud, and the leaves grow in even thicker the farther south you go."

rows.original: GIANT LEAVES 3
rows.raw: "GIANT LEAVES 3"

rows.original: Giant Leaves
rows.raw: "Giant Leaves"

rows.original: There’s nothing but leaves in every direction except north. Every other way is just a wall of torso-sized, shimmering fronds. They’re even above you, glistening dully with collected moisture. It looks like a dead end, for now. You can either hang around here or go back through the dense plants to the north.
rows.translation: 除了北面，其他方向全是叶子。每条路都被躯干般大小、闪闪发光的叶片组成的墙堵住。头顶也全是叶子，积着的水汽让它们泛着暗光。目前看来是条死路。你可以在这里待着，也可以穿过密集植物回到北面。
rows.raw: "There’s nothing but leaves in every direction except north. Every other way is just a wall of torso-sized, shimmering fronds. They’re even above you, glistening dully with collected moisture. It looks like a dead end, for now. You can either hang around here or go back through the dense plants to the north."

rows.original: You crunch your way through the brush, swatting irritability at the odd fern that decides to accost you - which is most of them. As much as you’d like to avoid it, the thick, choking ferns rustle rather noisily with every step you make. The jungle life isn’t exactly quiet either, what with the shrill cries of the birds and bees. And the local avian and bee-inspired population, too. Despite all the noise, however, you can still make out something distinctly unnatural whispering from a bit away, like thick fans of some bit of industrial machinery. Like, say, something that hovers.
rows.translation: 你踩着灌木发出嘎吱声，烦躁地拍开胆敢纠缠你的蕨叶，而几乎每一株都在这么做。尽管你想避免发出动静，但拥挤浓密的蕨类在你每一步落下时都会大声沙沙作响。丛林里的生命也绝不安静，鸟和蜂都在尖声鸣叫。当地那些像鸟和像蜂的智慧居民也一样。不过，尽管如此嘈杂，你仍能辨出不远处有一种明显不自然的低鸣，像某种工业机械厚重风扇的声音。比如说，某种会悬浮的东西。
rows.raw: "You crunch your way through the brush, swatting irritability at the odd fern that decides to accost you - which is most of them. As much as you’d like to avoid it, the thick, choking ferns rustle rather noisily with every step you make. The jungle life isn’t exactly quiet either, what with the shrill cries of the birds and bees. And the local avian and bee-inspired population, too. Despite all the noise, however, you can still make out something distinctly unnatural whispering from a bit away, like thick fans of some bit of industrial machinery. Like, say, something that hovers."

rows.original: You glance down to your codex, curiously. The scanner doesn’t appear to be detecting anything, though whether it’s because whatever is making the noise doesn’t register as a threat or is simply out of the diminutive range you’re not sure. Figures. Probably just a survey probe drone....
rows.translation: 你好奇地低头看向法典。扫描器似乎什么都没探测到，不过你不确定是因为发声的东西不被判定为威胁，还是单纯处于它可怜的探测范围之外。果然。大概只是台勘测无人探机罢了……
rows.raw: "\n\nYou glance down to your codex, curiously. The scanner doesn’t appear to be detecting anything, though whether it’s because whatever is making the noise doesn’t register as a threat or is simply out of the diminutive range you’re not sure. Figures. Probably just a survey probe drone...."

rows.original: The task of finding Carl’s wayward robot suddenly springs to mind. That’s probably it! You thrust your way through the greens once again, yanking at any leaves that come your way for propulsion as you chase after that whispering sound. Soon enough it gets louder and louder, until....
rows.translation: 寻找卡尔失控机器人的任务突然浮上心头。多半就是它！你再次挤进绿叶中，抓住挡路的叶子借力，追向那阵低鸣。很快，声音越来越响，直到……
rows.raw: "\n\nThe task of finding Carl’s wayward robot suddenly springs to mind. That’s probably it! You thrust your way through the greens once again, yanking at any leaves that come your way for propulsion as you chase after that whispering sound. Soon enough it gets louder and louder, until...."

rows.original: You poke your head out from a bush and find yourself looking into a clearing in the jungle floor. While there are plenty of low hanging plants still, the sky is mercifully visible up above and the space is relatively clear of trees and other obstructions, at least any tall ones. A perfect arena to fight the prey that’s hovering in the middle!
rows.translation: 你从灌木里探出头，看见丛林地面的一片空地。虽然仍有许多低垂植物，但谢天谢地，上方能看见天空，这里也相对没有树木和其他障碍物，至少没有高大的障碍物。真是与中央悬浮的猎物交战的完美场地！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou poke your head out from a bush and find yourself looking into a clearing in the jungle floor. While there are plenty of low hanging plants still, the sky is mercifully visible up above and the space is relatively clear of trees and other obstructions, at least any tall ones. A perfect arena to fight the prey that’s hovering in the middle!"

rows.original: The machina isn’t exactly large as far as industrial robots go, about the size of an average human torso - just like Carl said. The machine looks to be comprised of two steel-gray colored parts; a circular core, shaped in a way very similar to a tire made of uncompromising metal while the top is a sometimes-translucent dome, with an insignificant gap in between the two pieces. Small, flickering lights shine through the faux-glass, identifying its various visible sensors and the like. Below, attached to the undercarriage is the main concern, though; a dozen spindly little robotic arms all holding onto various tools and gadgets. You recognize one of them as a welder, while there are a few grasping hands among them. Everything else is a bit of a toss-up, though.
rows.translation: 以工业机器人而言，这台机器并不算大，约莫只有普通人类躯干那么大，正如卡尔所说。它似乎由两个钢灰色部分构成：圆形核心，形状很像用坚硬金属做的轮胎；顶部则是时而透明的穹罩，两部分之间留着微小空隙。细小闪灯透过仿玻璃外罩，标出各种可见传感器之类的装置。不过，真正令人担心的是底盘下方：十二条细长机械臂，全都握着各种工具和装置。你认出其中一件是焊枪，也看出几只抓握手。至于剩下那些，就不好说了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe machina isn’t exactly large as far as industrial robots go, about the size of an average human torso - just like Carl said. The machine looks to be comprised of two steel-gray colored parts; a circular core, shaped in a way very similar to a tire made of uncompromising metal while the top is a sometimes-translucent dome, with an insignificant gap in between the two pieces. Small, flickering lights shine through the faux-glass, identifying its various visible sensors and the like. Below, attached to the undercarriage is the main concern, though; a dozen spindly little robotic arms all holding onto various tools and gadgets. You recognize one of them as a welder, while there are a few grasping hands among them. Everything else is a bit of a toss-up, though."

rows.original: You look away from the machine after a moment, surveying the ‘arena’ as you realize something smells off. The smell of death fills your nostrils for one grisly moment as you realize just what that corrupted machine has been doing to the local wildlife. As a point of order, it lifts up the corpse of a small local marsupial from the cloak of leaves in its grasping hand, tugging out its messy bones before chirping.
rows.translation: 片刻后，你将目光从机器身上移开，打量这处“竞技场”，这才意识到气味不对。你惊骇地明白这台故障机器对当地野生动物做了什么，死亡的气息一瞬间充满鼻腔。仿佛为了证明这一点，它用抓握手从叶幕中举起一只本地小型有袋动物的尸体，扯出血肉模糊的骨骼，随后发出一声鸣叫。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look away from the machine after a moment, surveying the ‘arena’ as you realize something smells off. The smell of death fills your nostrils for one grisly moment as you realize just what that corrupted machine has been doing to the local wildlife. As a point of order, it lifts up the corpse of a small local marsupial from the cloak of leaves in its grasping hand, tugging out its messy bones before chirping."

rows.original: “Insufficient material.”
rows.translation: “材料不足。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Insufficient material.”"

rows.original: That’s... rather macabre!
rows.translation: 这……可真够可怕的！
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s... rather macabre!"

rows.original: The worst kind of fell mood!
rows.translation: 最糟糕的邪恶狂想！
rows.raw: " The worst kind of fell mood!"

rows.original: You know full well this is Carl’s machina, gone off the deep end with whatever programming corruption it received. You’ll have to defeat this thing before it hurts someone - or someone else maybe, you can’t see the mess under the sometimes bloodied plants.
rows.translation: 你很清楚这就是卡尔的机器，不知程序遭了什么损坏，已经彻底失控。你必须在它伤人之前击败它，或者说，在它再次伤人之前；那些偶尔沾血的植物下面到底多惨，你也看不清。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou know full well this is Carl’s machina, gone off the deep end with whatever programming corruption it received. You’ll have to defeat this thing before it hurts someone - or someone else maybe, you can’t see the mess under the sometimes bloodied plants."

rows.original: This will be a hard fight just from looking at the tools it’s carrying and its thick, industrial nature. Given the scene, you’re not sure you’d make it out if you lose.
rows.translation: 光看它携带的工具和厚实的工业机体，这就会是一场苦战。再看看现场，你不确定输了还能不能活着离开。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis will be a hard fight just from looking at the tools it’s carrying and its thick, industrial nature. Given the scene, you’re not sure you’d make it out if you lose."

rows.original: The machina hasn’t noticed you yet, though. You could engage it or fight another day.
rows.translation: 不过，机器还没发现你。你可以出手，也可以改日再战。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe machina hasn’t noticed you yet, though. You could engage it or fight another day."

rows.original: Fight
rows.translation: 战斗
rows.raw: "Fight"

rows.original: Back Off
rows.translation: 后退
rows.raw: "Back Off"

rows.original: GIANT LEAVES 2
rows.raw: "GIANT LEAVES 2"

rows.original: MACHINA
rows.raw: "MACHINA"

rows.original: Machina
rows.translation: 玛奇娜
rows.raw: "Machina"

rows.original: Magic Ted
rows.raw: "Magic Ted"

rows.original: You loom over the fallen, inert machine as it lays there sprawled across a particularly large, low-hanging fern. After you give it a few kicks to make sure, you are confident that the robot has been knocked out from the damage. You feel a swell of pride kick up in your chest at the victory, though that immediately starts to falter under the realization you still need to lug this thing back. Ugh.
rows.translation: 机器倒下后不再动弹，摊在一株特别大的低垂蕨类上，你站在它上方。又踢了几脚确认后，你确信损伤已经让机器人瘫痪了。胜利让你的胸中涌起自豪，但一想到还得把它拖回去，那份自豪立刻开始消退。唉。
rows.raw: "You loom over the fallen, inert machine as it lays there sprawled across a particularly large, low-hanging fern. After you give it a few kicks to make sure, you are confident that the robot has been knocked out from the damage. You feel a swell of pride kick up in your chest at the victory, though that immediately starts to falter under the realization you still need to lug this thing back. Ugh."

rows.original: You lean over the machine, brushing off the limp appendage-arms to either side. It looks an awful lot like a jellyfish, come to think of it. You recall Carl saying there was a factory-reset button somewhere in the undercarriage, so reach your hand into the mess and grope about. The outlet for its coolant, a few wires here and there. A button, a vent for what you can only assume is-- Wait, a button. You press in on the small, out-of-the-way thing firmly.
rows.translation: 你俯身靠近机器，将软垂的机械臂拨向两侧。说起来，它还真像一只水母。你记得卡尔说底盘某处有个恢复出厂设置按钮，便把手伸进杂乱零件间摸索。冷却液出口，几根电线。一个按钮，一个排气口，你猜它可能是——等等，按钮。你用力按下那个藏在偏僻角落里的小东西。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lean over the machine, brushing off the limp appendage-arms to either side. It looks an awful lot like a jellyfish, come to think of it. You recall Carl saying there was a factory-reset button somewhere in the undercarriage, so reach your hand into the mess and grope about. The outlet for its coolant, a few wires here and there. A button, a vent for what you can only assume is-- Wait, a button. You press in on the small, out-of-the-way thing firmly."

rows.original: Immediately the robot chirps and you yank your hand away, preparing to go back to fighting. However, instead of aggression the machine lazily hovers itself upright, spins in place once and then continues upwards. You can only watch as it rises up past the trees and floats to off to the side - towards town, you realize. Looks like it’s going to what it considers home after you reset it.
rows.translation: 机器人立刻鸣叫起来，你猛地缩手，准备继续战斗。然而，机器没有发动攻击，而是慢悠悠地悬浮起身，原地转了一圈，然后继续升高。你只能看着它升过树梢，朝侧面飘去；你意识到，那是镇子的方向。看来重置后，它要回自己认定的家了。
rows.raw: "\n\nImmediately the robot chirps and you yank your hand away, preparing to go back to fighting. However, instead of aggression the machine lazily hovers itself upright, spins in place once and then continues upwards. You can only watch as it rises up past the trees and floats to off to the side - towards town, you realize. Looks like it’s going to what it considers home after you reset it."

rows.original: Best speak with Carl when you get back.
rows.translation: 回去后最好找卡尔谈谈。
rows.raw: " Best speak with Carl when you get back. "

rows.original: Magic Ted
rows.raw: "Magic Ted"

rows.original: Though you sink to your [pc.knees] in need, that all changes when the robot fires a huge metal slug at you.
rows.translation: 尽管你因欲望而跪在[pc.knees]上，但机器人向你射来一枚巨大的金属弹丸时，一切都变了。
rows.raw: "Though you sink to your [pc.knees] in need, that all changes when the robot fires a huge metal slug at you.\n\n"

rows.original: Pain.
rows.translation: 痛苦。
rows.raw: "Pain."

rows.original: You are wracked by waves and waves of pain, your vision becoming a hazy blur as your body falls against the thick ferns and other plants below. You can feel the damp ground all around you, knowing it’ll be the last thing you’ll get to feel - besides pain. As the machine looms closer, tools whirring ominously, you close your eyes, resigned.
rows.translation: 一波又一波痛苦折磨着你，身体倒向下方浓密的蕨类和其他植物，视野变得模糊不清。你能感觉到周围湿冷的地面，明白除了痛苦，这将是你最后能感受到的东西。机器逼近，工具发出不祥的嗡鸣，你认命地闭上眼睛。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou are wracked by waves and waves of pain, your vision becoming a hazy blur as your body falls against the thick ferns and other plants below. You can feel the damp ground all around you, knowing it’ll be the last thing you’ll get to feel - besides pain. As the machine looms closer, tools whirring ominously, you close your eyes, resigned."

rows.original: This is how the handpicked heir of Steele goes out. Not in a blaze of glory, not from sexual fatigue, not from old age after fucking over the life of your test tube baby. No, from a fucking gun smith’s attendant robot.
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔亲自挑选的继承人就这样死去。没有壮烈赴死，没有纵欲而亡，也没有在毁掉试管婴儿后代的人生之后寿终正寝。没有，居然死在一个他妈的枪匠助手机器人手里。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis is how the handpicked heir of Steele goes out. Not in a blaze of glory, not from sexual fatigue, not from old age after fucking over the life of your test tube baby. No, from a fucking gun smith’s attendant robot."

rows.original: MACHINA
rows.raw: "MACHINA"

rows.original: PURPLE FLOWERS 1
rows.raw: "PURPLE FLOWERS 1"

rows.original: Purple Flowers
rows.raw: "Purple Flowers"

rows.original: You’re on a path that winds its way through masses of purple blooms of all sizes and descriptions. Some are almost as big as an average man, others are so tiny you could fit two or three on a pinky finger. Insects swarm around them, content to harvest the flower’s nectar instead of bothering you. You’re grateful; some of them seem to be packing dangerous-looking stingers. You can go south and west along the path.
rows.translation: 你走在一条蜿蜒小路上，四周尽是各种形态大小的紫花。有些几乎与普通人一样大，有些则小到能在小指上放两三朵。昆虫在花间成群飞舞，满足地采集花蜜，没有来骚扰你。你很庆幸，其中一些似乎带着危险的毒刺。你可以沿路向南或向西。
rows.raw: "You’re on a path that winds its way through masses of purple blooms of all sizes and descriptions. Some are almost as big as an average man, others are so tiny you could fit two or three on a pinky finger. Insects swarm around them, content to harvest the flower’s nectar instead of bothering you. You’re grateful; some of them seem to be packing dangerous-looking stingers. You can go south and west along the path."

rows.original: PURPLE FLOWERS 2
rows.raw: "PURPLE FLOWERS 2"

rows.original: Purple Flowers
rows.raw: "Purple Flowers"

rows.original: The air is almost sickeningly sweet here. Between the humid jungle air and the densely packed flowering plants, it feels almost as if there’s no oxygen in here to breathe! Something - or someone - has kept the blooming plants from encroaching onto this trail. You’re secretly thankful for whatever has kept the plants pruned back as you consider your options: east or west.
rows.translation: 这里空气甜腻得几乎令人作呕。潮湿的丛林空气加上密集的开花植物，让人觉得仿佛都没氧气可吸！有什么东西，或者什么人，一直阻止花丛侵占这条小径。你暗自感激修剪植物的那位，同时考虑去向：往东还是往西。
rows.raw: "The air is almost sickeningly sweet here. Between the humid jungle air and the densely packed flowering plants, it feels almost as if there’s no oxygen in here to breathe! Something - or someone - has kept the blooming plants from encroaching onto this trail. You’re secretly thankful for whatever has kept the plants pruned back as you consider your options: east or west."

rows.original: PURPLE FLOWERS 3
rows.raw: "PURPLE FLOWERS 3"

rows.original: Purple Flowers
rows.raw: "Purple Flowers"

rows.original: Both sides of the trail are ringed in curtains of amethyst blooms. The violet flowers are so densely packed, and the air so humid and heavily scented, that you can barely breathe. Their smell would normally be pleasant, but there are just too many of them! The local bugs don’t seem to mind; they’re here in droves. You can pass through the buzzing insects to the east, deeper into the deep jungle, or go north to Esbeth.
rows.translation: 小径两侧环绕着紫水晶色的花幕。紫花密密层层，空气湿重又香得浓烈，让你几乎无法呼吸。这香味本来应该很好闻，但花实在太多了！当地昆虫似乎不介意，成群结队地待在这里。你可以穿过嗡鸣虫群向东，深入丛林，或向北前往埃斯贝斯。
rows.raw: "Both sides of the trail are ringed in curtains of amethyst blooms. The violet flowers are so densely packed, and the air so humid and heavily scented, that you can barely breathe. Their smell would normally be pleasant, but there are just too many of them! The local bugs don’t seem to mind; they’re here in droves. You can pass through the buzzing insects to the east, deeper into the deep jungle, or go north to Esbeth."

rows.original: PURPLE FLOWERS 4
rows.raw: "PURPLE FLOWERS 4"

rows.original: Purple Flowers
rows.raw: "Purple Flowers"

rows.original: All around this gently winding woodpath, there are numerous flowers growing, all in bloom. It isn’t too bad here. They tint the air pleasantly with their sweet aroma, and they haven’t grown up enough to truly stop you from wandering off the trail if you wanted. However, the jungle changes to the south. The trees are taller, the canopy is thicker, the air is humid, and the flowers have overgrown everything except the path. You could head back north, toward Esbeth, or south, into the deep jungle.
rows.translation: 这条缓缓蜿蜒的林间小径四周长着许多花，此刻全都盛开。这里还算不错。甜香为气息添了几分宜人，而且植物还没长到真能阻止你随意离开道路的程度。不过南面的丛林变了样。树更高，树冠更密，空气湿热，除了道路，其他地方都被花占满。你可以向北返回埃斯贝斯，也可以向南进入丛林深处。
rows.raw: "All around this gently winding woodpath, there are numerous flowers growing, all in bloom. It isn’t too bad here. They tint the air pleasantly with their sweet aroma, and they haven’t grown up enough to truly stop you from wandering off the trail if you wanted. However, the jungle changes to the south. The trees are taller, the canopy is thicker, the air is humid, and the flowers have overgrown everything except the path. You could head back north, toward Esbeth, or south, into the deep jungle."

rows.raw: "SCRAPYARD MAINTENANCE"

rows.raw: "Scrapyard Maintenance"

rows.raw: "PENNY'S OFFICE"

rows.raw: "U.G.C. Peacekeepers"

rows.original: The interior of this office is painted a cool, soothing blue, but even that can’t hide the fact that nobody wants to have to spend much time here. The whole place looks stout and secure, even the doors and windows. The latter of which bear solid metal bars. A few doors occupy the far side of the room, but they’re on the opposite side of a large, imposing desk. Computer equipment sits in a high pile, capped with an inactive light, the kind which you’d expect to see on top of a hovercar or police cruiser.
rows.translation: 这间办公室内部刷成冷静舒缓的蓝色，但即便如此，也掩盖不了没人愿意在这里久待的事实。整个地方看起来结实牢靠，连门窗也一样，窗户上更装着坚固的金属栏杆。房间远端有几扇门，却都在一张庞大威严的办公桌另一侧。电脑设备堆得很高，顶上摆着一盏熄灭的警灯，就是你以为会装在悬浮车或巡逻警车上的那种。
rows.raw: "The interior of this office is painted a cool, soothing blue, but even that can’t hide the fact that nobody wants to have to spend much time here. The whole place looks stout and secure, even the doors and windows. The latter of which bear solid metal bars. A few doors occupy the far side of the room, but they’re on the opposite side of a large, imposing desk. Computer equipment sits in a high pile, capped with an inactive light, the kind which you’d expect to see on top of a hovercar or police cruiser."

rows.original: KELLY'S OFFICE
rows.raw: "KELLY'S OFFICE"

rows.original: Xenogen Office
rows.raw: "Xenogen Office"

rows.original: The inside of this office is decorated in the style of high class terrans, with wood grain floors and eggshell-toned walls illuminated by angled glowbulbs. A few potted plants sit around the periphery, obviously non-native. Well-concealed vents in the ceilings feed a steady influx of purified, cooled air into this chamber to keep it comfortable. Across the room is an expansive desk equipped with everything you would expect to find on a classy secretary’s desk: a terminal, old-fashioned writing utensils, holopaper, and even a small statue of a busty centaur. A monolithic white door sits framed in the western wall, while a simpler one is in the southern, leading back outside.
rows.translation: 这间办公室按照地球上层人士的风格装饰，木纹地板，蛋壳色墙壁，被倾斜的发光灯泡照亮。几盆明显并非本地的植物摆在四周。天花板上隐藏良好的通风口持续向室内送入净化的冷空气，维持舒适。房间对面是一张宽大的办公桌，摆着你想象中体面秘书桌上应有的一切：终端、老式书写工具、全息纸，甚至还有一尊丰乳半人马的小雕像。西墙嵌着一扇厚重的白色门，南面则是较简单的一扇，通往外面。

A few potted plants sit around the periphery, obviously non-native. Well-concealed vents in the ceilings feed a steady influx of purified, cooled air into this chamber to keep it comfortable. Across the room is an expansive desk equipped with everything you would expect to find on a classy secretary’s desk: a terminal, old-fashioned writing utensils, holopaper, and even a small statue of a busty centaur. A monolithic white door sits framed in the western wall, while a simpler one is in the southern, leading back outside."

rows.original: JULIAN'S OFFICE
rows.raw: "JULIAN'S OFFICE"

rows.original: Scientist’s Office
rows.raw: "Scientist’s Office"

rows.original: The pure white, self-illuminating walls, floor, and ceiling provide a perfectly uniform distribution of luminance, lending the whole space a dream-like, heavenly quality. More strange than the lighting is the desk that curves through the northern half of this chamber. It’s carved from one solid piece of translucent material that reflects the light into dazzling patterns of hypnotizing shine. The doorway to the east is the same featureless alabaster. It doesn’t even have a doorknob, instead relying on proximity scanners and motorized retractors to slide it out of the way and into the wall. This place feels nothing like the rest of Esbeth.
rows.translation: 纯白、自发光的墙壁、地板与天花板均匀地照亮每个角落，让整个空间如梦似幻，宛若天堂。比灯光更奇特的是横贯房间北半部的弧形办公桌。它由一整块半透明材料雕成，反射光线，形成耀眼而令人沉迷的闪光图案。东面的门也是同样毫无纹饰的雪白。它甚至没有门把手，而是依赖接近扫描器和电动收缩装置，将门滑开，收入墙内。这里与埃斯贝斯其他地方完全不同。
rows.raw: "The pure white, self-illuminating walls, floor, and ceiling provide a perfectly uniform distribution of luminance, lending the whole space a dream-like, heavenly quality. More strange than the lighting is the desk that curves through the northern half of this chamber. It’s carved from one solid piece of translucent material that reflects the light into dazzling patterns of hypnotizing shine. The doorway to the east is the same featureless alabaster. It doesn’t even have a doorknob, instead relying on proximity scanners and motorized retractors to slide it out of the way and into the wall. This place feels nothing like the rest of Esbeth."

rows.raw: "ESBETH MEDICAL OFFICE"

rows.original: Medical Office
rows.raw: "Medical Office"

rows.original:
The inside of the medical office is about as ramshackle and rundown as the outside of the shack. Standard manufactured alumiplate forms the walls, and the floor is made of the same bland, reflective stuff. Discarded wrappers and bits of clothing are scattered everywhere. There isn’t even a trash receptacle anywhere to put it into. More importantly, a single bed is built into the east wall, covered in fresh fabric of one kind or another. The only piece of equipment that looks moderately well-maintained is a seemingly worn chair close to the bed.

rows.original: You wipe your brow. You are clutching onto a bulging outcrop of red stone, maybe 30 feet off the ground. You can find handholds and are reasonably stable, but also frighteningly exposed. Behind you, you can hear the shift and hiss of leaves in the breeze; you are almost beyond the reach of those towering ironwoods, but not quite. The cascade tumbles down nearby, the flume of water no longer obscured by the white veil it throws up at the bottom. It’s impossible to make out anything above, but it looks like you can keep climbing upwards if you have the strength, or inch your way back down to the scrub steps.
rows.translation: 你擦了擦额头，紧抓着一块凸出的红石，离地大约三十英尺。这里有地方下手，姿势也算稳固，但暴露得令人心惊。身后能听见树叶在风中移动、嘶响；你几乎爬出了那些高大铁木的范围，但还差一点。瀑布在附近奔流而下，水柱已不再被底部腾起的白色水幕遮挡。上方什么都看不清，不过只要还有力气，似乎就能继续攀爬，也可以一点点退回长着灌木的阶地。

rows.original: The cliff face steps in here like a skewed pile of books, offering a place for you to stand in reasonable comfort as long as you keep a tight grip on the rock. To one side a spindly tree like a long, dark asparagus grows out of the rock, bulbous head waggling in the wind. Remarkable what can cling to life in the most perilous of places. Above you, the rock marches back outwards threateningly; you don’t want to even try and climb onto that. It’s just about possible to descend though. Or you could sidle along the ledge towards the hushing crash of the waterfall, see if you can progress from there.
rows.translation: 这里的崖面像一堆歪斜的书本般逐层向内收，让你只要紧抓岩石，就能相当舒适地站立。一旁有棵细树从岩缝里长出，像一根又长又黑的芦笋，圆鼓鼓的顶端随风摇晃。生命能在最危险的地方扎根，真是不可思议。上方岩石却又令人不安地向外凸出，你连试着爬上去都不愿意。不过下去勉强还算可行。或者你可以沿岩架侧身挪向瀑布低沉的轰鸣，看看能否从那里继续前进。

rows.original: You take deep breaths, clutching onto the dank rock. The waterfall thunders directly overhead, raw elemental power that is hard to comprehend, much less handle being underneath. Here, the cliff face offers a gradual advance upwards - if you’ve got the stomach to climb under the gigantic flume of water, feel its spray on your back and [pc.hair], risk the slippery, mossy, jagged stone under hand and foot. If you can just keep pulling yourself upwards, it looks like there’s a level shoulder ahead - or you can shuffle back towards the dry ledge.
rows.translation: 你抓着湿冷岩石，深深呼吸。瀑布就在正上方轰鸣，那种原始的自然威力难以理解，置身其下更是难以承受。这里崖面逐渐上升，只要你有胆量在巨大水柱下面攀爬，任水雾打湿后背和[pc.hair]，冒着手脚下湿滑、多苔而尖锐岩石的风险。只要不停往上拉，前方似乎就有平坦的崖肩；或者，你可以挪回干燥岩架。

rows.original: You are on a higgledy-piggledy run of loose sunburned rock, above the lenient shoulder. You really are a considerable distance up now - the sound of the waterfall is running liquid and a distant crash far below - but at least it’s no longer a straight drop down. The loose, crumbling rock means you have to be careful as you climb. To the east you can see a crevice in the gray rock face 45 degrees to the one you are currently on. A tough, fibrous rope bridge strung across the cliff wall and the smoothness wrought by many feet around its entrance suggest it’s frequently visited by the zil. Meanwhile you think you can just about see the tops of some wax structures to the west, beyond the head of the falls.
rows.translation: 你正在较平缓的崖肩上方，攀着一片被阳光晒红、杂乱松散的岩石。现在你确实已爬得相当高，瀑布声变成流动的水声，以及遥远下方的轰响；但至少这里不再是笔直的落差。碎裂松动的岩石让你必须小心攀爬。东面可见一处灰色崖壁裂缝，与当前崖面成45度角。一座由坚韧纤维绳索编成的桥横跨崖壁，入口周围被许多脚步磨得光滑，说明兹尔经常来此。同时，你觉得在西面瀑布源头之外，隐约能看见一些蜡制建筑的顶端。

rows.original:
You are in a narrow passageway in the jungle. The vegetation curves in an arc heading from the west to the south. The south end dips on a slow descent. The temperature here is cool and moist. There is glowing bioluminescent lichen growing on the trees here.

South looks a little misty. It might get a little hard to see if you head in that direction.
rows.translation:
你身处丛林中的狭窄通道。植被弯成一道由西向南的弧线，南端缓缓下坡。这里凉爽潮湿，树上长着会发光的生物地衣。

南面似乎有些雾。如果朝那个方向走，视线可能会变得不太好。

The temperature here is cool and moist. There is glowing bioluminescent lichen growing on the trees here.\n\nSouth looks a little misty. It might get a little hard to see if you head in that direction."

rows.original: There’s a great big crater plunged into the forest floor here, surrounded by the shattered husks of Mhen’gan trees that have been blasted back by the impact. Smoke rises lazily from the inside of the crater, emanating from a sphere of metal surrounded by cracked mirrored wings. A satellite!
rows.translation: 这里的林地被砸出一个巨大陨坑，周围是冲击波推倒、震碎的门加树木残骸。坑内缓缓升起烟雾，源头是一颗金属球，四周围着破裂的镜面翼板。一颗卫星！

rows.original:
The path here heads directly north to south on a steep slant. The more you move south, the more you seem to descend into a natural valley. The trees here seem to be defying the incline, strangely growing taller and thicker the further the path descends.

This area is thin with mist. It seems to get thicker further down. Even so, you can still see the flickering of the luminous tree lichen.
rows.translation:
这里的小路沿陡坡笔直贯穿南北。越往南，你似乎就越深入一处天然山谷。树木仿佛违背坡势，随着道路下降，反而古怪地越长越高、越长越粗。

此地有层薄雾，往下似乎越来越浓。即便如此，你仍能看见树上发光地衣的闪烁。

The trees here seem to be defying the incline, strangely growing taller and thicker the further the path descends.\n\nThis area is thin with mist. It seems to get thicker further down. Even so, you can still see the flickering of the luminous tree lichen."

rows.original:
The foliage is thinner here than the rest of the jungle. In every direction there are thick, ancient looking trees, possibly centuries old. Their pale trunks are covered in bioluminescent lichen. This is rather helpful as the whole area is covered in dewy fog.

The path here continues north and upward, or south to what looks like the valley floor. The mist seems thinner to the north.
rows.translation:
这里的植被比丛林其他地方稀疏。四面都是粗壮而古老的树木，可能已有几百年树龄。苍白树干上覆着生物发光地衣。整片区域都笼罩在湿雾中，这些光倒很有用。

这里的道路向北继续上升，或向南通向看似谷底的地方。北面的雾似乎较薄。

rows.original:
You are standing at the bottom of a thick, misty valley, surrounded by colossal trees covered in luminous lichen. The pulsing colors light up the eerily thick mist. This doesn’t feel like a safe place to be standing. The temperature here is very cold and it is very wet.

To the north there is a path leading up and out of the fog filled valley. You seem free to move in any other direction, but the fog makes it hard to see what awaits you there.
rows.translation:
你站在浓雾山谷的底部，四周是覆着发光地衣的巨树。脉动的色彩照亮了诡异而浓厚的雾气。站在这里让人觉得不安全。此地非常寒冷，也非常潮湿。

北面有条向上的道路，可以走出雾谷。其他方向似乎都能去，但雾让你看不清那边有什么在等待。

You seem free to move in any other direction, but the fog makes it hard to see what awaits you there."

rows.original:
Gigantic, ghostly trees tower around you, looming within the pervasive mist. Flickering sparks, which you know to be lichen, wink at you from every direction, like a million glowing eyes staring at you.

It’s hard to find your way here. There’s mist in every direction, and the ground is flat and wet. Which way will you go?
rows.translation:
巨大而幽灵般的树木耸立在四周，隐现于无处不在的雾中。你知道那些闪烁的光点是地衣，它们从各个方向向你眨眼，像百万只发亮眼睛正盯着你。

这里很难辨路。四面都是雾，地面又平又湿。你要往哪边走？

There’s mist in every direction, and the ground is flat and wet. Which way will you go?"

rows.translation: 巨大而幽灵般的树木耸立在四周，隐现于无处不在的雾中。你知道那些闪烁的光点是地衣，它们从各个方向向你眨眼，像百万只发亮眼睛正盯着你。\n\n这里很难辨路。四面都是雾，地面又平又湿。你要往哪边走？
rows.raw: "Gigantic, ghostly trees tower around you, looming within the pervasive mist. Flickering sparks, which you know to be lichen, wink at you from every direction, like a million glowing eyes staring at you.\\n\\nIt’s hard to find your way here. There’s mist in every direction, and the ground is flat and wet. Which way will you go?"

rows.original: MISTY VALLEY 2
rows.raw: "MISTY VALLEY 2"

rows.original: Misty Valley
rows.raw: "Misty Valley"

rows.original:
Pale, monolithic trees loom all around you, like ancient gods watching your every move. You can’t see the canopy at all, nor much of anything else through the thick fog that surrounds you. Bioluminescent lines run up each tree like arteries of light, blinking and pulsing.

You almost step into a small river to the north-east as you are blinded by the opaque mist. The only safe ways to walk seem to be east or south.
rows.translation:
苍白的巨树高耸四周，像古老神明监视你的一举一动。浓雾包围着你，完全看不见树冠，其他东西也几乎看不见。每棵树上都有发光纹路，像光组成的动脉，闪烁脉动。

不透明的雾遮住视线，你差点踏进东北面一条小河。似乎只有往东或往南才安全。

rows.raw: "Misty Valley"

rows.original:
Towering, titan-sized trees surround you from every direction, each one pale as death and lined with luminous lichen. The omnipresent mist has almost completely deprived you of sight - you can barely see five feet in front of you. 

Instead of vision, you are left with sounds of dripping water, rustling leaves, and clicking insects. It only looks safe to walk west or south; elsewhere the ground looks treacherous.
rows.translation:
如泰坦般高大的树木从四面包围你，每棵都死一般苍白，覆着发光地衣。无处不在的雾几乎完全夺去了视力，你连五英尺外都难看清。 

失去视觉后，留下的只有滴水声、树叶沙沙声和昆虫咔嗒声。似乎只有往西或往南安全；其他地方的地面看起来都很危险。

It only looks safe to walk west or south; elsewhere the ground looks treacherous."

rows.original:
Your visibility has been reduced to the point you can barely see your own hand in front of your [pc.face]. Even the luminous lichen are barely visible as you are completely surrounded by mist. There is a sharp chill to the air and you think you hear footsteps nearby.

You consult your Codex, and it tells you that you came from the north. Aided by your digital compass, all you can really do is retrace your steps.
rows.translation:
能见度已经低到你几乎看不清[pc.face]前自己的手。四周全是雾，连发光地衣都隐约难辨。空气透着刺骨寒意，你似乎听见附近有脚步声。

你查看法典，它告诉你来时走的是北面。有数字罗盘帮助，你其实也只能原路返回。

rows.original:
The fog here is so thick you can barely see in front of your nose, and that’s dangerous. You’re not sure if your next step is going to meet solid ground, or be over the edge of a ravine. Given that you can’t see where you’re going, it seems smart to turn back.

You’re pretty sure you came from the north. Thankfully, your Codex remembers which way that is.
rows.translation:
这里的雾浓得让你几乎看不见鼻子前面的东西，很危险。你不知道下一步会踩上实地，还是迈过深沟边缘。既然看不清去路，回头似乎才明智。

你很确定自己是从北面来的。幸好法典记得北方在哪。

rows.original: You spot a strange, bulb-tipped staff half-covered by the growth. Old gouges in the ground show signs of a struggle, perhaps the fate of its previous owner. You could take the staff if you wished.
rows.translation: 你发现一根奇怪的法杖，顶端呈球状，半截被植物覆盖。地上的旧沟痕显示这里发生过搏斗，或许揭示了前任主人的命运。想要的话，你可以拿走它。

rows.original:
The fog seems a bit thinner here. You’re standing on the edge of a narrow gorge that runs from the east. You can hear a trickling at the bottom and can see an easy way down. There’s also a fallen tree spanning the gorge offering an easy way across.

You could follow the gorge to the east and downstream, or head north or south. The felled tree looks sturdy so you’re fairly sure it will hold your weight.
rows.translation:
这里的雾似乎薄了些。你站在一条从东面延伸过来的狭窄峡谷边缘。谷底能听见流水声，也能看见一条容易下去的路。还有一棵倒树横跨峡谷，方便通往对岸。

你可以沿峡谷向东顺流而下，也可以向北或向南。倒树看起来很结实，你相当确定它承受得住你的重量。

The felled tree looks sturdy so you’re fairly sure it will hold your weight."

rows.original:
This narrow gorge runs to the east with a small creek running through its center. It trickles down from the west where a small path leads up and out of the gorge. Walls of earth surround you on the other sides, looming like the sides of a massive grave.

It’s hard to walk here without getting your [pc.feet] wet. The temperature is noticeably cooler, but at least there’s less mist about.
rows.translation:
这条狭窄峡谷向东延伸，一条小溪流经中央。溪水从西面潺潺而下，那里有条小路可以向上走出峡谷。其他几面都是土墙，像巨大坟墓的侧壁般耸立。

在这里走，很难不打湿[pc.feet]。温度明显低了些，但至少雾少了。

Walls of earth surround you on the other sides, looming like the sides of a massive grave.\n\nIt’s hard to walk here without getting your [pc.feet] wet. The temperature is noticeably cooler, but at least there’s less mist about."

rows.original:
The sides of the chasm are quite high here and the canopy thick. Very little light reaches where you stand, making it hard to see about. Icy water splashes up and against your [pc.feet]. The creek running through the heart of the gorge runs quite fast here.

You can continue up or downstream. To the north, there is a root-lined break in the gorge you could use to climb up and out.
rows.translation:
这里峡谷两壁相当高，树冠也浓密。很少有光能照到你站立的地方，四周难以看清。冰冷的水溅到[pc.feet]上。流经峡谷中央的小溪在这里相当湍急。

你可以继续往上游或下游走。北面峡壁有一处布满树根的缺口，可以用来爬出峡谷。

To the north, there is a root-lined break in the gorge you could use to climb up and out."

rows.original: You are standing underneath a short, stubbly tree that looks positively squashed compared to its towering peers. The gnarled branches are warped and sickly looking, almost as if giant hands have molded it without a single care for aesthetics.
rows.translation: 你站在一棵矮小粗短的树下面，与四周高耸的同类相比，它简直像被压扁了。扭曲枝杈畸形而病态，仿佛一双巨手毫不顾及美感地把它捏成了这样。
rows.raw: "You are standing underneath a short, stubbly tree that looks positively squashed compared to its towering peers. The gnarled branches are warped and sickly looking, almost as if giant hands have molded it without a single care for aesthetics."

rows.raw: "UTHRA HARVEST DAY"

rows.original: UTHRA HARVEST DAY
rows.raw: "UTHRA HARVEST DAY"

rows.original: Even worse, an obsidian sap is seeping gruesomely from wound-like gaps in the tree surface. Not a single glimmer of light reflects off the eerily black substance, contrasting violently with your misty white surroundings.
rows.translation: 更糟糕的是，黑曜石般的树液从树皮伤口一样的裂隙中渗出，看着令人不适。那诡异漆黑的物质不反射一丝光，与周围雾蒙蒙的白色形成强烈对比。
rows.raw: "\n\nEven worse, an obsidian sap is seeping gruesomely from wound-like gaps in the tree surface. Not a single glimmer of light reflects off the eerily black substance, contrasting violently with your misty white surroundings."

rows.raw: "Harvest sap from the Uthra Tree"

rows.original: You have harvested the obsidian colored sap from the ugly tree and no more flows from its surface. You’ll have to give it time to produce some more.
rows.translation: 你已经从丑陋的树上采集过黑曜石色树液，现在树表不再流出树液。你得给它时间重新分泌。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou have harvested the obsidian colored sap from the ugly tree and no more flows from its surface. You’ll have to give it time to produce some more."

rows.original: You have recently harvested sap from the Uthra Tree and must allow it to regenerate.
rows.translation: 你最近已经采集过乌斯拉树的树液，必须等它再生。
rows.raw: "You have recently harvested sap from the Uthra Tree and must allow it to regenerate."

rows.original: The roots of the deformed tree are large and pervasive, blocking passage in almost every direction. The only path left open to you is back down into the river lined gorge.
rows.translation: 这棵畸形树的根系粗大而蔓延四处，几乎挡住所有方向。唯一敞开的路，是回到有河流经过的峡谷里。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe roots of the deformed tree are large and pervasive, blocking passage in almost every direction. The only path left open to you is back down into the river lined gorge."

rows.original: BLADED FERNS 1
rows.raw: "BLADED FERNS 1"

rows.original: Bladed Ferns
rows.raw: "Bladed Ferns"

rows.original:
The fog here has a thin but pervasive quality, shrouding everything in a layer of light white. You can pick up vague impressions of familiar shapes around you that you assume are trees and bushes.

Due to the mist you almost brush against a mass of pale shrubs and ferns lined with silvery, blade-like leaves. You can see crimson blood smeared across a good portion of the razor edged foliage.

There seems to be gaps in the vicious vegetation to the north and south. Any other direction looks to be a death trap.
rows.translation:
这里的雾薄而弥漫，给一切罩上一层淡白。你能模糊辨出周围熟悉的形状，猜它们是树木和灌木。

雾中，你差点擦到一团苍白灌木与蕨类，上面长着银色刀片般的叶子。大片锋利叶片上都涂着深红血迹。

这些凶险植物之间，南北两面似乎都有缺口。其他方向看起来全是死亡陷阱。

rows.original:
Here the air is rife with mist and the ground littered with razor leaved shrubs and bushes. Only the glimmering of silver leaves warns you of impending danger; each step an exercise in extreme caution.

It seems like a natural defense against unprotected intruders. You spot the skeleton of a massive creature surrounded by the bladed ferns. You suspect they did not exercise the same level of prudence.

Through the maze-like foliage, you can see a path leading north and another west. Everywhere else is filled with painful looking thickets packed close together.
rows.translation:
这里空气充满雾气，地面满是长着剃刀叶片的灌木丛。只有银叶的微光提醒你即将遭遇的危险；每一步都必须极度小心。

这似乎是抵御毫无防护的入侵者的天然防御。你发现一具巨型生物的骨架，被刀刃蕨类包围。你怀疑它当初没有像你这样谨慎。

透过迷宫般的植被，可以看见一条向北的路与一条向西的路。其他地方都挤满看起来会让人痛不欲生的密集灌木。

rows.original:
You are surrounded by pale, majestic trees of impossible height that stretch skyward and out of view. The area is misty but in chunks, fog lining the ground like a blanket while other portions wrap intimately around the ancient monoliths.

This whole area seems peaceful and the air is crisp and cool. It feels oddly peaceful, unlike the rest of the Mhen’gan jungle. You’re aware that appearances can be deceiving.

A mess of tree roots to the north and south bar your path. Everywhere else seems fair game.
rows.translation:
你被苍白而雄伟的树木包围，它们高得难以置信，直入天空，消失在视野外。此地雾气一团团分布，有的像毯子铺在地面，另一些则亲密地缠绕古老巨木。

整片区域似乎很宁静，空气清新凉爽。与门加丛林其他地方不同，这里平静得古怪。你明白外表可能具有欺骗性。

南北两面纠缠的树根挡住道路，其他方向似乎都能通行。

rows.original:
Ancient Saole trees tower around you in every direction, each with countless branches weaving a tapestry of wood above you. Thick, ethereal fog slips through every gap the wooden spider web offers. A blanket of mist licks your [pc.feet] and steals them from view.

There is a jutting rock face here with water trickling down it. You can head either north or east.
rows.translation:
古老的萨奥勒树在四面高耸，每棵都有无数枝条，在你头顶织成木质锦毯。浓厚而飘渺的雾穿过这张木质蛛网的每一处空隙。一层雾轻舔[pc.feet]，将它们遮出视野。

这里有一块突出的岩壁，上面淌着细水。你可以向北或向东走。

rows.original:
The colossal Saole trees are further apart here, allowing for more light to stream down to the forest floor. Because of this, it is easy to spot the broken regional shield generator with a spear sticking out of it.

Given the trajectory of the spear, it seems to have been thrown from above into the device. There is a well worn path to the west of the device. On the other, it curves and fades off to the south.
rows.translation:
这里的巨型萨奥勒树间距更大，让更多光线照到林地。因此，你很容易看见一台损坏的区域护盾发生器，上面插着一支长矛。

从长矛的轨迹看，它似乎是从上方被投向装置的。装置西边有条常有人走的小路，另一侧则弯向南方，逐渐隐没。

rows.original: The interior of the Gold Myr building is lavishly decorated, its walls covered in tapestries and portraits of the Queen and her daughters, while the floors are bedecked in lush carpets with pillows placed around for guests to sit on. Several colonists are in here, enjoying honey wine or reclining on the pillows, chatting quietly with the resident ant-girls. While not packed per se, the interior of the “embassy” is certainly more lively than you might expect from the spartan exterior. A large double door atop a short flight of marble stairs leads to another chamber, guarded by a pair of myr soldiers with hammers and handguns close at hand. They seem relaxed, though, and both give you a friendly nod when you enter.
rows.translation: 金米尔建筑的内部装饰奢华，墙上挂满壁毯，以及女王和她女儿们的画像；地面铺着厚实地毯，周围摆了供客人落座的软枕。 几位殖民者正在这里享用蜂蜜酒，或斜倚软枕，与住在这里的蚁女轻声交谈。虽然说不上拥挤，但这座“大使馆”的内部，肯定比简朴外观让人预想的要热闹得多。 短短一段大理石台阶上，有一扇通往另一个房间的大双开门。两名米尔士兵守在门边，战锤和手枪触手可及。不过她们看起来很放松，你进来时，两人都友好地点了点头。

rows.original: With the entrance obscured by a curtain of moss, there’s little light to be found within Mhen’ga’s subterranean depths aside from the flickering sparks of Penny’s weapons. The cave walls glisten in the unreliable illumination due to the inherent moisture in the air, stretching away to the west.
rows.translation: 入口被一帘苔藓遮住，除了佩妮武器闪烁的火花，门加地下深处几乎没有光。潮湿空气让向西延伸的洞壁在不稳定的照明中泛着水光。

rows.original: Cave Split
rows.raw: "Cave Split"

rows.original: The dank interior of this cave system splits north and south from hear, as well as east back towards where you entered. Penny and a few stunted stalactites are all you have for company.
rows.translation: 这片洞穴内部湿冷，从这里分别向北和向南分岔，向东则通回你进入的地方。陪伴你的只有佩妮和几根发育不全的钟乳石。

rows.original: Twisting around the corner to the west, the cave burrows deeper into Mhen’ga’s fertile soil. There’s a source of illumination a little further in that direction. Perhaps it bears investigating. The cave’s entrance lies north and east.
rows.translation: 洞穴在西面绕过转角，继续深入门加肥沃的土壤。那个方向稍远处有一处光源，也许值得调查。洞穴入口在北面和东面。
rows.raw: "Twisting around the corner to the west, the cave burrows deeper into Mhen’ga’s fertile soil. There’s a source of illumination a little further in that direction. Perhaps it bears investigating. The cave’s entrance lies north and east."

rows.raw: "PQUEST_Q10"

rows.original: Light Shaft
rows.raw: "Light Shaft"

rows.original: A shaft of gloriously bright light shines down from a wide-open hole in the ceiling. Up above, you can spot the leafy green of the jungle canopy and the purple of alien moss, though no way to climb up presents itself, not that there’s any reason to take such a perilous journey. Your goals lie elsewhere - deeper and to the west. You’ll need to turn back.
rows.translation: 一道灿烂明亮的光柱从洞顶敞开的大洞照下。上方可以看见丛林树冠的绿叶，以及外星苔藓的紫色，却没有能爬上去的路。当然，也没有理由进行如此危险的攀爬。你的目标在别处，在更深的西面。你得转回去。

rows.original: Glossy brown roots race through the walls, weaving between rocky outcroppings and loamy soil. Without them, you have no doubt this cave would’ve collapsed long ago. It’s almost like the roots themselves are the only thing holding it together, like a sort of organic reinforcement.
rows.translation: 光滑的褐色树根穿过洞壁，交织在岩石凸起和肥沃泥土之间。你毫不怀疑，没有它们，这个洞早就塌了。简直像只有树根本身在支撑它，构成某种有机加固结构。

rows.raw: "PQUEST_S4"

rows.original: Cave Bend
rows.raw: "Cave Bend"

rows.original: This underground tunnel goes a bit windy, flowing west before jerking back north. It’s straighter south, but that’s back the way you came. Droplets of water occasionally splash down from the ceiling, carving small channels in the rock underfoot. You’ll need to move carefully if you don’t want to slip.
rows.translation: 这条地下隧道有些曲折，先向西延伸，又猛地转向北方。南面更直，但那是你来时的路。水珠偶尔从洞顶落下，在脚下岩石上蚀出小沟。想避免滑倒，就得小心移动。

Droplets of water occasionally splash down from the ceiling, carving small channels in the rock underfoot. You’ll need to move carefully if you don’t want to slip."

rows.original: Cave Bend
rows.raw: "Cave Bend"

rows.original: The humid tunnel slopes down to the north and shifts east around tree trunk-sized root. Webs of thin, stringy roots dangle from the ceiling to collect the condensation. You’re forced to brush them aside almost every other step, they grow so thickly, absorbing ambient sound so well that the only thing you can hear are your own movements and the unsubtle crackling of Penny’s tonfas.
rows.translation: 潮湿隧道向北下倾，又绕着一根树干般粗的树根转向东面。纤细丝状树根织成网，从洞顶垂下，收集凝结的水汽。它们长得太密，你几乎每隔一步就得将其拨开；它们又如此善于吸收环境声音，让你只能听见自己的动作，以及佩妮拐棍发出的响亮噼啪声。
rows.raw: "The humid tunnel slopes down to the north and shifts east around tree trunk-sized root. Webs of thin, stringy roots dangle from the ceiling to collect the condensation. You’re forced to brush them aside almost every other step, they grow so thickly, absorbing ambient sound so well that the only thing you can hear are your own movements and the unsubtle crackling of Penny’s tonfas."

rows.original: The cave slopes deeper to the west, opening up as it goes. The ceilings are higher there and less obscured by roots and moss. Back to the south, the tunnel grows more claustrophobic, with annoying-looking sheets of dangling roots.
rows.translation: 洞穴向西越走越深，也越来越开阔。那边洞顶更高，遮挡的树根和苔藓更少。回头朝南，隧道则变得逼仄，垂下的片片树根看着就烦人。
rows.raw: "The cave slopes deeper to the west, opening up as it goes. The ceilings are higher there and less obscured by roots and moss. Back to the south, the tunnel grows more claustrophobic, with annoying-looking sheets of dangling roots."

rows.original: PQUEST_O2
rows.raw: "PQUEST_O2"

rows.original: Venus Ziltraps
rows.raw: "Venus Ziltraps"

rows.original: The two venus ziltrap pods remain exactly where you first saw them, rooted to the floor and ceiling by pillar-like growths, their ‘pods’ snugly ensconcing a pair of captive lawbreakers. The creatures themselves don’t pay you much mind, content with the bounty they’ve secured, and aside from the occasional orgasmic squirming of a mind-broken smuggler through the taut green walls of a pod, nothing moves.
rows.translation: 那两个维纳斯兹尔陷阱荚舱仍待在你最初看见它们的地方，被柱状组织固定在地面与洞顶之间，两个“荚舱”紧紧包着一对被俘的违法者。这些生物满足于到手的丰收，没怎么理你；除了偶尔能透过绷紧的绿色舱壁看见一个精神崩溃的走私者高潮扭动，什么都没有动。

rows.original: PQUEST_M2
rows.raw: "PQUEST_M2"

rows.original: More Pods
rows.raw: "More Pods"

rows.original: The deeper you push into the cave, the more venus ziltrap pods you see. There’s four in close proximity, all occupied by drugged, ecstatic zil if the honeyed aroma in the air is any indication. Red eyes peek out of one pod to look at you, then vanish back inside with a playful wink. To the east are the two pods with the captured smugglers. To the south, the cave dives deeper, closer to the purported Oxonium stash.
rows.translation: 越深入洞穴，你看见的维纳斯兹尔陷阱荚舱就越多。附近就有四个，如果空气中蜂蜜般的香气能说明什么，它们全都装着被药物迷倒、欣喜若狂的兹尔。一双红眼睛从一只荚舱里探出，看了看你，俏皮地眨了一下，又缩了回去。东面是关着走私者的那两个荚舱。南面洞穴继续深入，离据说藏着奥克索尼姆的地方更近。

There’s four in close proximity, all occupied by drugged, ecstatic zil if the honeyed aroma in the air is any indication. Red eyes peek out of one pod to look at you, then vanish back inside with a playful wink. To the east are the two pods with the captured smugglers. To the south, the cave dives deeper, closer to the purported Oxonium stash."

rows.raw: "PQUEST_M4"

rows.original: Pod Corner
rows.raw: "Pod Corner"

rows.original: The cave itself runs west, deeper underground, and north, back through the occupied pods, but more pressing is the presence of two empty venus ziltraps.
rows.translation: 洞穴向西通往更深的地下，向北则通回那些已被占用的荚舱，但眼下更迫切的问题是这里有两个空着的维纳斯兹尔陷阱。
rows.raw: "The cave itself runs west, deeper underground, and north, back through the occupied pods, but more pressing is the presence of two empty venus ziltraps."

rows.original: PQUEST_K4
rows.raw: "PQUEST_K4"

rows.original: A Few More Pods
rows.raw: "A Few More Pods"

rows.original: You stride through a great deal of venus ziltrap pods. These are all occupied with the wriggling forms of mind-broken captives. Occasionally you hear the high pitched moans of a climaxing zil, but a far more familiar sound is the murmuring, pleased coos of the ziltraps themselves. The plant-girls you fought lie to the east. According to Penny’s readings, the Oxonium is west. A small crack in the wall splits north, wafting an awful scent.
rows.translation: 你穿过大量维纳斯兹尔陷阱荚舱。里面全都装着精神崩溃、扭动不休的俘虏。偶尔能听见兹尔高潮时的尖细呻吟，但更常听到的是维纳斯兹尔陷阱自己低声、愉悦的呢喃。这些你战斗过的植物女孩在东面。根据佩妮的读数，奥克索尼姆在西面。北墙裂开一道小缝，飘出难闻气味。

Occasionally you hear the high pitched moans of a climaxing zil, but a far more familiar sound is the murmuring, pleased coos of the ziltraps themselves. The plant-girls you fought lie to the east. According to Penny’s readings, the Oxonium is west. A small crack in the wall splits north, wafting an awful scent."

rows.original: PQUEST_K2
rows.raw: "PQUEST_K2"

rows.original: Rotten Garbage
rows.raw: "Rotten Garbage"

rows.original: Tossed into this dim, dank corner are the belongings of the many, many captives in the room to the south, almost entirely zil, judging by the fetid honey, centipede-eaten loincloths, and mushroom-covered wood spears. This close to the pile, you have to struggle not to sick up. It would be best to move back south.
rows.translation: 这个昏暗潮湿的角落堆着南面房间里众多俘虏的随身物品。从发臭的蜂蜜、被蜈蚣啃食的缠腰布和长满蘑菇的木矛判断，主人几乎全是兹尔。靠得这么近，你费了好大劲才忍住没吐出来。最好还是回南面去。
rows.raw: "Tossed into this dim, dank corner are the belongings of the many, many captives in the room to the south, almost entirely zil, judging by the fetid honey, centipede-eaten loincloths, and mushroom-covered wood spears. This close to the pile, you have to struggle not to sick up. It would be best to move back south."

rows.original: PQUEST_I4
rows.raw: "PQUEST_I4"

rows.original: Fat Ziltrap Pod
rows.raw: "Fat Ziltrap Pod"

rows.original:
The grove of venus ziltraps to the east thins out to a single, enormous pod here. Its fleshy green walls are so thick that you can’t make any details of the trapped victim - or victims. Two (or even three) zil could be crammed inside, servicing some plant-woman with all their heart - or perhaps one enormous naleen. You’ll never know.

A dangerous-sounding rumble can be heard to the south.
rows.translation:
东面的维纳斯兹尔陷阱丛在这里逐渐稀疏，只剩一只巨大的荚舱。它肉质的绿色舱壁厚得让你看不清被困者，甚至不知道里面是一位还是多位。里面可能挤着两三个兹尔，正全心全意服侍某位植物女人，也可能是一条巨大的纳林。你永远也不会知道。

南面传来听着很危险的隆隆声。

rows.original: Mining Operation
rows.raw: "Mining Operation"

rows.original: To the west the cave system opens into a colossal crater so wide that not even the planet’s tremendous canopy can completely crowd it out. Jet wash spills out of an autonomous dropship as it comes to a gentle stop in the very center of the area, while three mining robots trundle around, putting their drills to work directly on the Oxonium deposits.
rows.translation: 西面，洞穴系统通入一座巨大陨坑，宽阔得连这颗星球庞大的树冠都无法彻底遮住。一艘自主运输艇在区域正中央缓缓停稳，喷气尾流四散；三台采矿机器人则在周围隆隆移动，直接将钻头投入奥克索尼姆矿藏。
